claim.id: Nezha (哪吒), kadang disebut Nezha Sang Putra Mahkota (哪吒太子) atau Natha, adalah dewa pelindung dalam Taoisme, Buddhisme, Konfusianisme, dan agama rakyat Tiongkok.
claim.en: Nezha (哪吒), sometimes called Nezha the Crown Prince (哪吒太子) or Natha, is a protection deity in Taoism, Buddhism, Confucianism, and Chinese folk religion.

claims_provenance.quote: Nezha (哪吒, Nézhā) or sometimes Nezha the Crown Prince (哪吒太子, Nézhā Tàizǐ), or Natha, is a protection deity in Taoism, Buddhism, Confucianism, and Chinese folk religion.

claim.id: Nama resmi Taoisnya adalah 'Marsekal Altar Tengah' (中壇元帥). Setelah menjadi dewa, ia diberi gelar 'Pangeran Ketiga Teratai' (蓮花三太子).
claim.en: His official Taoist name is 'Marshal of the Central Altar' (中壇元帥). After he became a deity he was given the title 'Third Lotus Prince' (蓮花三太子).

claims_provenance.quote: His official Taoist name is "Marshal of the Central Altar" (中壇元帥). He was then given the title "Third Lotus Prince" (蓮花三太子) after he became a deity.

claim.id: Nezha dipuja dalam agama rakyat Tiongkok dan disebut 'Marsekal Altar Tengah' (三坛大会元帅) atau 'Pangeran Ketiga' (三太子).
claim.en: Nezha is worshipped in Chinese folk religion and is called 'Marshal of the Central Altar' (三坛大会元帅) or the 'Third Prince' (三太子).

claims_provenance.quote: Nezha is worshipped in Chinese folk religion and is called "Marshal of the Central Altar" (三坛大会元帅), or the "Third Prince" (三太子).

claim.id: Seperti dalam cerita rakyat tradisional, Nezha terbang cepat dengan roda angin-api (風火輪), sehingga ia juga dianggap dewa pelindung banyak pengemudi profesional, seperti sopir truk, taksi, atau bus wisata.
claim.en: As in traditional folklore, Nezha flies around swiftly on his wind fire wheels, so he is also regarded as the tutelary god of many professional drivers, such as truck, taxi, or sightseeing-bus drivers.

claims_provenance.quote: As in traditional folklore, Nezha flies around swiftly on his wind fire wheels, so he is also regarded as the tutelary god of many professional drivers, like trucks, taxis, or sightseeing bus drivers.

claim.id: Nezha juga sering dianggap dewa pelindung anak-anak dan bakti anak. Orang tua mempersembahkan sesaji kepada Nezha dengan harapan anak mereka tumbuh kuat, sehat, berbakti, dan hormat.
claim.en: Nezha is also often regarded as the patron god of children and filial piety. Parents would make an offering to Nezha hoping their children would grow up strong, healthy, dutiful, and respectful.

claims_provenance.quote: Nezha is also often regarded as the patron god of children and filial piety. Parents would make an offering to Nezha with the hope that their children would grow up strong, healthy, and be dutiful and respectful.

claim.id: Menurut deskripsi buku Meir Shahar, legenda dan kultus Nezha dapat ditelusuri lebih dari dua ribu tahun ke asalnya di India, tempat Nezha bermula sebagai makhluk mitologis bernama Nalakūbara, yang petualangan seksualnya dirayakan dalam epos Sanskerta sejak abad-abad pertama SM.
claim.en: According to the description of Meir Shahar's book, the legend and cult of Nezha reach back over two thousand years to their origins in India, where Nezha began as a mythological being named Nalakūbara, whose sexual misadventures were celebrated in the Sanskrit epics as early as the first centuries BCE.

claims_provenance.quote: Finally, the book offers a detailed history of the legend and the cult reaching back over two thousand years to its origins in India, where Nezha began as a mythological being named Nalakūbara, whose sexual misadventures were celebrated in the Sanskrit epics as early as the first centuries BCE.
claims_provenance.source_citation: University of Hawai'i Press — Oedipal God: The Chinese Nezha and His Indian Origins (book page)

claim.id: Menurut deskripsi buku Shahar, Nezha sang bayi pemberontak dipuja dengan berbagai cara oleh biksu Buddha, pendeta Dao, dan perantara roh yang kerasukan.
claim.en: According to the description of Shahar's book, the rebellious infant Nezha has been venerated in many ways by Buddhist monks, Daoist priests, and possessed spirit mediums.

claims_provenance.quote: Crossing the boundaries between China’s diverse religious traditions, it tracks the rebellious infant in the many ways he has been venerated by Buddhist monks, Daoist priests, and possessed spirit mediums
claims_provenance.source_citation: University of Hawai'i Press — Oedipal God: The Chinese Nezha and His Indian Origins (book page)

claim.id: Menurut deskripsi buku Shahar, Nezha telah dimuliakan selama lebih dari seribu tahun dan termasuk dewa Tiongkok yang paling tangguh dan penuh teka-teki.
claim.en: According to the description of Shahar's book, Nezha has been celebrated for over a millennium and is among the most formidable and enigmatic of all Chinese gods.

claims_provenance.quote: Celebrated for over a millennium, Nezha is among the most formidable and enigmatic of all Chinese gods.
claims_provenance.source_citation: University of Hawai'i Press — Oedipal God: The Chinese Nezha and His Indian Origins (book page)

claim.id: Shahar berpendapat bahwa, meski hubungan ayah-anak itu buruk, etika Konfusian menuntut dorongan oedipal menyamar sebagai bakti anak dalam kisah Nezha, sehingga sang dewa kecil bunuh diri sebelum mencoba membalas dendam kepada ayahnya.
claim.en: Shahar argues that, despite a disastrous father-son relationship, Confucian ethics require the oedipal drive to masquerade as filial piety in Nezha's story, dictating that the child-god kill himself before trying to avenge himself on his father.

claims_provenance.quote: Shahar argues that, despite a disastrous father-son relationship, Confucian ethics require that the oedipal drive masquerade as filial piety in Nezha’s story, dictating that the child-god kill himself before trying to avenge himself upon his father.
claims_provenance.source_citation: University of Hawai'i Press — Oedipal God: The Chinese Nezha and His Indian Origins (book page)

claim.id: Menurut Meir Shahar, nama Nezha berasal dari Nalakuvara, yang digambarkan sebagai jenderal yaksa heroik dalam Mahamayuri.
claim.en: According to Meir Shahar, the name Nezha comes from Nalakuvara, depicted as a heroic yaksha general in the Mahamayuri.

claims_provenance.quote: According to Meir Shahar, the name Nezha comes from Nalakuvara, depicted as a heroic yaksha general in the Mahamayuri.

claim.id: Bentuk asli 那羅鳩婆羅 berubah menjadi 捺羅俱跋羅, 那吒矩韈囉, dan akhirnya 那吒 (Nazha). Penambahan 'radikal mulut' (口) pada Na (那) mengubah nama menjadi bentuk sekarang, Nezha (哪吒).
claim.en: The original variant 那羅鳩婆羅 changed to 捺羅俱跋羅, 那吒矩韈囉, and finally 那吒 (Nazha). Adding the 'mouth radical' (口) to Na (那) gives the current form Nezha (哪吒).

claims_provenance.quote: The original variant 那羅鳩婆羅 changed to 捺羅俱跋羅, 那吒矩韈囉 and finally 那吒 (Nazha). The simple addition of the "mouth radical" (口) to Na (那) changes the name to the current form Nezha (哪吒).

claim.id: Dalam novel Perjalanan ke Barat, ketika sang Raja Langit melahirkan putra ini, di telapak tangan kirinya ada aksara 'Ne' (哪) dan di telapak tangan kanannya aksara 'zha' (吒), sehingga ia dinamai Nezha.
claim.en: In the novel Journey to the West, when the Heavenly King had this son, the character 'Ne' (哪) was on his left palm and 'zha' (吒) on his right palm, hence the name Nezha.

claims_provenance.quote: 原來天王生此子時，他左手掌上有個「哪」字，右手掌上有個「吒」字，故名哪吒。
claims_provenance.source_citation: Wikisource (中文維基文庫) — 西遊記 第八十三回 心猿識得丹頭 姹女還歸本性

claim.id: Dalam novel Fengshen Yanyi, Nyonya Yin mengandung selama tiga tahun enam bulan tanpa melahirkan, dan Li Jing cemas serta berkata bahwa kehamilan sepanjang itu pasti pertanda siluman atau makhluk aneh.
claim.en: In the novel Fengshen Yanyi, Lady Yin was pregnant for three years and six months without giving birth, and Li Jing, worried, said that a pregnancy so long must mean a demon or a monster.

claims_provenance.quote: 殷夫人後又懷孕在身，已及三年零六個月，倘不生產。李靖時常心下憂疑，一日，指夫人之腹，言曰：「孕懷三載有餘，尚不降生，非妖即怪。」
claims_provenance.source_citation: Wikisource (中文維基文庫) — 封神演義 第十二回 陳塘關哪吒出世

claim.id: Dalam Fengshen Yanyi, Li Jing menebas sebuah bola daging yang berputar seperti roda; bola itu terbelah dan keluarlah seorang anak laki-laki dengan cahaya merah, bermuka putih, bergelang emas di tangan kanan, dan berselempang kain merah di perutnya.
claim.en: In Fengshen Yanyi, Li Jing slashes a ball of flesh that turns like a wheel; it splits open and a small boy jumps out amid red light, with a face white as powder, a golden bracelet on his right hand, and a red silk cloth around his belly.

claims_provenance.quote: 有一肉毬，滴溜溜圓轉如輪。李靖大驚，望肉毬上一劍砍去，劃然有聲。分開肉毬，跳出一個小孩兒來，滿地紅光，面如傅粉，右手套一金鐲，肚腹上圍著一塊紅綾，金光射目。
claims_provenance.source_citation: Wikisource (中文維基文庫) — 封神演義 第十二回 陳塘關哪吒出世

claim.id: Dalam Fengshen Yanyi, narator menyatakan bahwa dewa ini lahir di Chentang Pass sebagai penjelmaan Lingzhu Zi dan pembuka jalan bagi Jiang Ziya; gelang emasnya bernama Qiankun Quan (乾坤圈) dan kain merahnya Huntian Ling (混天綾), pusaka Gua Jinguang di Gunung Qianyuan.
claim.en: In Fengshen Yanyi, the narrator states that this divine being was born at Chentang Pass as an incarnation of Lingzhu Zi and as Jiang Ziya's vanguard; the golden bracelet is the Qiankun Quan (乾坤圈) and the red silk the Huntian Ling (混天綾), treasures of Jinguang Cave on Mount Qianyuan.

claims_provenance.quote: 這位神聖下世，出在陳塘關，乃姜子牙先行官是也；靈珠子化身。金鐲是「乾坤圈」，紅綾名曰「混天綾。」此物乃是乾元山鎮金光洞之寶。
claims_provenance.source_citation: Wikisource (中文維基文庫) — 封神演義 第十二回 陳塘關哪吒出世

claim.id: Dalam Fengshen Yanyi, Li Jing menyebut ketiga putranya: Jinzha (murid Wenshu Guangfa Tianzun) dan Muzha (murid Puxian Zhenren); sang Daois lalu menamai putra ketiga 'Nezha'.
claim.en: In Fengshen Yanyi, Li Jing names his three sons: Jinzha (a disciple of Wenshu Guangfa Tianzun) and Muzha (a disciple of Puxian Zhenren); the Daoist then names the third son 'Nezha'.

claims_provenance.quote: 李靖答曰：「不才有三子；長曰金吒，拜五龍山雲霄洞文殊廣法天尊為師；次曰木吒，拜九宮山白鶴洞普賢真人為師。老師既要此子為門下，但憑起一名諱，便拜道長為師。」道人曰：「此子第三，取名叫做『哪吒』。」
claims_provenance.source_citation: Wikisource (中文維基文庫) — 封神演義 第十二回 陳塘關哪吒出世

claim.id: Dalam Fengshen Yanyi, sang Daois memperkenalkan diri sebagai Taiyi Zhenren dari Gua Jinguang di Gunung Qianyuan, yang datang memberi selamat atas kelahiran putra Li Jing.
claim.en: In Fengshen Yanyi, the Daoist introduces himself as Taiyi Zhenren of Jinguang Cave on Mount Qianyuan, who has come to congratulate Li Jing on the birth of his son.

claims_provenance.quote: 貧道乃乾元山金光洞太乙真人是也。聞得將軍生了公子，特來賀喜。借令公子一看，不知尊意如何？
claims_provenance.source_citation: Wikisource (中文維基文庫) — 封神演義 第十二回 陳塘關哪吒出世

claim.id: Dalam Fengshen Yanyi, Nezha mandi di Sungai Jiuwan di muara Laut Timur dengan mencelupkan pusakanya; air menjadi merah, sungai bergoyang, dan istana kristal ikut berguncang.
claim.en: In Fengshen Yanyi, Nezha bathes in the Jiuwan River at the mouth of the East Sea and dips his treasure in the water; the water turns red, the river shakes, and the crystal palace rattles.

claims_provenance.quote: 不知這河是九灣河，是東海口上。哪吒將此寶放在水中，把水俱映紅了。擺一擺，江河晃動，搖一搖，乾坤動撼。那哪吒洗澡，不覺那水晶宮已愰的亂響。
claims_provenance.source_citation: Wikisource (中文維基文庫) — 封神演義 第十二回 陳塘關哪吒出世

claim.id: Dalam Fengshen Yanyi, Nezha mengangkat Qiankun Quan ke udara dan benda itu menimpa kepala yaksa pengintai Li Gen hingga ia tewas di tepi sungai.
claim.en: In Fengshen Yanyi, Nezha raises the Qiankun Quan into the air and it strikes the head of the patrolling yaksha Li Gen, who dies on the bank.

claims_provenance.quote: 把右手套的乾坤圈望空中一舉。此寶原係崑崙山玉虛宮所賜太乙真人鎮金光洞之物，夜叉那裏經得起，那寶打將下來，正落在夜叉頭上，只打的腦漿迸流，即死於岸上。
claims_provenance.source_citation: Wikisource (中文維基文庫) — 封神演義 第十二回 陳塘關哪吒出世

claim.id: Dalam Fengshen Yanyi, Nezha memukul putra ketiga Raja Naga dengan Qiankun Quan hingga wujud aslinya, seekor naga, tampak; ia lalu mencabut urat sang naga untuk dijadikan ikat pinggang bagi ayahnya.
claim.en: In Fengshen Yanyi, Nezha strikes the Dragon King's third son with the Qiankun Quan until his true form, a dragon, appears; he then pulls out its sinew to make a belt for his father.

claims_provenance.quote: 提起乾坤圈，照頂門一下，把三太子的元身打出，是一條龍，在地上挺直。哪吒曰：「打出這小龍的本像來了。也罷，把他的筋抽去，做一條龍筋絛與俺父親束甲。」
claims_provenance.source_citation: Wikisource (中文維基文庫) — 封神演義 第十二回 陳塘關哪吒出世

claim.id: Dalam Fengshen Yanyi, Ao Guang murka dan, setelah menjelma menjadi seorang terpelajar, pergi ke Chentang Pass dan mengumumkan dirinya sebagai kenalan lama yang berkunjung.
claim.en: In Fengshen Yanyi, Ao Guang, furious, transforms into a scholar, goes to Chentang Pass, and announces himself as an old acquaintance come to visit.

claims_provenance.quote: 敖光大怒，恨不能即與其子報仇，隨化一秀士，逕往陳塘關來。至於帥府，對門官曰：「你與我傳報，有故人敖光拜訪。」
claims_provenance.source_citation: Wikisource (中文維基文庫) — 封神演義 第十二回 陳塘關哪吒出世

claim.id: Dalam Fengshen Yanyi, Nezha menyatakan bahwa ia yang membunuh Ao Bing dan Li Gen sehingga ia sendiri yang harus menanggung akibatnya, mengaku sebagai Lingzhu Zi, dan berkata akan mengembalikan daging dan tulangnya kepada orang tuanya agar mereka tidak terbebani.
claim.en: In Fengshen Yanyi, Nezha declares that he killed Ao Bing and Li Gen and must pay for it himself, says he is Lingzhu Zi, and says he will return his flesh and bones to his parents so that they are not burdened.

claims_provenance.quote: 『一人行事一人當』，我打死敖丙、李艮，我當償命，豈有子連累父母之理！」乃對敖光曰：「我一身非輕，乃靈珠子是也。奉玉虛符命，應運下世。我今日剖腹、剜腸、剔骨肉，還於父母，不累雙親。
claims_provenance.source_citation: Wikisource (中文維基文庫) — 封神演義 第十三回 太乙真人收石磯

claim.id: Dalam Fengshen Yanyi, Nezha dengan pedang di tangan kanan memotong sebelah lengannya lalu membelah perutnya sendiri; ia mati dan para Raja Naga melaporkan sesuai ucapannya.
claim.en: In Fengshen Yanyi, Nezha, sword in his right hand, cuts off an arm and then slits open his own belly; he dies, and the Dragon Kings report according to his words.

claims_provenance.quote: 哪吒便右手提劍，先去一臂膊，後自剖其腹，剜腸剔骨，散了七魂三魄，一命歸泉。四龍王據哪吒之言回旨。
claims_provenance.source_citation: Wikisource (中文維基文庫) — 封神演義 第十三回 太乙真人收石磯

claim.id: Dalam Fengshen Yanyi, roh Nezha tak punya tempat bersandar; ia berasal dari penjelmaan pusaka yang meminjam darah dan sari tubuh sehingga memiliki roh, dan ia melayang tertiup angin sampai ke Gunung Qianyuan.
claim.en: In Fengshen Yanyi, Nezha's spirit has nothing to rest on; he was the manifestation of a treasure that borrowed essence and blood and so has a spirit, and he drifts on the wind to Mount Qianyuan.

claims_provenance.quote: 哪吒魂無所依，魄無所倚──他原是寶貝化現，借了精血，故有魂魄。哪吒飄飄蕩蕩，隨風而至，逕到乾元山來。
claims_provenance.source_citation: Wikisource (中文維基文庫) — 封神演義 第十三回 太乙真人收石磯

claim.id: Dalam Fengshen Yanyi, Taiyi Zhenren menyuruh Nezha menemui ibunya dalam mimpi dan meminta dibangunkan sebuah istana persinggahan (行宮) di Gunung Cuiping, empat puluh li dari pass itu; setelah menerima dupa selama tiga tahun ia dapat kembali ke dunia manusia untuk membantu sang penguasa sejati.
claim.en: In Fengshen Yanyi, Taiyi Zhenren tells Nezha to appear in his mother's dream and ask for a shrine-palace (行宮) on Mount Cuiping, forty li from the pass; after receiving incense for three years he can return to the human world to assist the true ruler.

claims_provenance.quote: 真人吩咐哪吒：「此處非汝安身之所。你回到陳塘關，托一夢與你母親，離關四十里，有一翠屏山，山上有一空地，令你母親造一座哪吒行宮，你受香煙三載，又可立於人間，輔佐真主。
claims_provenance.source_citation: Wikisource (中文維基文庫) — 封神演義 第十四回 哪吒現蓮花化身

claim.id: Dalam Fengshen Yanyi, Nezha menampakkan kesaktian di Gunung Cuiping; penduduk dari dekat dan jauh berdatangan membawa dupa, makin ramai dari hari ke hari, dan doa memohon berkah atau penangkal bencana selalu terkabul.
claim.en: In Fengshen Yanyi, Nezha manifests his power at Mount Cuiping; residents from near and far come with incense in growing numbers day by day, and prayers for blessings or the warding off of disaster are always answered.

claims_provenance.quote: 哪吒在翠屏山顯聖，四方遠近居民，俱來進香，紛紛如蟻，日盛一日，往往不斷。祈福禳災，無不感應。
claims_provenance.source_citation: Wikisource (中文維基文庫) — 封神演義 第十四回 哪吒現蓮花化身

claim.id: Dalam Fengshen Yanyi, Li Jing menghancurkan arca emas Nezha dengan cambuk, menendang roboh arca hakim hantu, dan memerintahkan agar kuil dibakar.
claim.en: In Fengshen Yanyi, Li Jing smashes Nezha's golden statue with a whip, kicks over the ghost-judge statues, and orders the temple burned.

claims_provenance.quote: 罵罷，提六陳鞭，一鞭把哪吒金身打的粉碎。李靖怒發，復一腳蹬倒鬼判。傳令：「放火，燒了廟宇。」
claims_provenance.source_citation: Wikisource (中文維基文庫) — 封神演義 第十四回 哪吒現蓮花化身

claim.id: Dalam Fengshen Yanyi, Taiyi Zhenren menata kelopak teratai dan tangkai daun teratai menjadi tubuh dengan tiga ratus ruas tulang, lalu menaruh sebutir pil emas di tengahnya.
claim.en: In Fengshen Yanyi, Taiyi Zhenren arranges lotus petals and lotus-leaf stalks into a body with three hundred joints of bone, then places a grain of golden elixir at its center.

claims_provenance.quote: 真人將花勒下瓣兒，鋪成三才，又將荷葉梗兒折成三百骨節，三個荷葉，按上、中、下，按天、地、人。真人將一粒金丹放於居中
claims_provenance.source_citation: Wikisource (中文維基文庫) — 封神演義 第十四回 哪吒現蓮花化身

claim.id: Dalam Fengshen Yanyi, para pengawal melaporkan bahwa putra ketiga berdiri di atas dua roda angin-api dan memegang tombak berujung api.
claim.en: In Fengshen Yanyi, the guards report that the third son stands on two wind-fire wheels and holds a fire-tipped spear.

claims_provenance.quote: 外面有三公子，腳踏風火二輪，手提火尖鎗，口稱老爺姓諱，不知何故，請老爺定奪。
claims_provenance.source_citation: Wikisource (中文維基文庫) — 封神演義 第十四回 哪吒現蓮花化身

claim.id: Dalam Fengshen Yanyi, seorang Daois menurunkan sebuah pagoda yang mengurung Nezha, lalu menepuknya hingga api berkobar di dalam dan Nezha berteriak minta ampun.
claim.en: In Fengshen Yanyi, a Daoist drops a pagoda that traps Nezha and claps it so that fire breaks out inside and Nezha cries for mercy.

claims_provenance.quote: 只見祥雲繚繞，紫霧盤旋，一物往下落來，把哪吒罩在玲瓏塔裏。道人雙手在塔上一拍，塔裏火發，把哪吒燒的大叫：「饒命！」
claims_provenance.source_citation: Wikisource (中文維基文庫) — 封神演義 第十四回 哪吒現蓮花化身

claim.id: Dalam Fengshen Yanyi, Daois itu ternyata diundang Taiyi Zhenren untuk menjinakkan watak Nezha agar mengakui ikatan ayah-anak; kemudian keempat ayah dan putra itu menjadi suci dengan tubuh jasmani, dan Li Jing menjadi Raja Langit Pembawa Pagoda.
claim.en: In Fengshen Yanyi, the Daoist turns out to have been invited by Taiyi Zhenren to temper Nezha's nature so that he acknowledges the father-son bond; later the father and three sons become sages in the flesh, and Li Jing is the Pagoda-Bearing Heavenly King.

claims_provenance.quote: 道人原是太乙真人請到此間磨哪吒之性，以認父子之情。後來父子四人，肉身成聖，托塔天王乃李靖也。
claims_provenance.source_citation: Wikisource (中文維基文庫) — 封神演義 第十四回 哪吒現蓮花化身

claim.id: Dalam Fengshen Yanyi, syair penutup bab menyebut bahwa tanpa kekuatan gaib Randeng, ayah dan anak itu sulit rukun kembali berkat pagoda emas.
claim.en: In Fengshen Yanyi, the closing verse of the chapter says that without Randeng's spiritual power the father and son could hardly have been reunited by the golden pagoda.

claims_provenance.quote: 黃金造就玲瓏塔，萬道毫光透九重。不是燃燈施法力，難教父子復相從。
claims_provenance.source_citation: Wikisource (中文維基文庫) — 封神演義 第十四回 哪吒現蓮花化身

claim.id: Dalam novel Perjalanan ke Barat, Nezha mengembalikan daging kepada ibu dan tulang kepada ayah, rohnya pergi memohon kepada Buddha di Surga Barat, dan Buddha menghidupkannya kembali dengan akar teratai sebagai tulang dan daun teratai sebagai pakaian.
claim.en: In the novel Journey to the West, Nezha returns his flesh to his mother and his bones to his father, his spirit goes to plead with the Buddha in the Western Paradise, and the Buddha revives him with lotus root for bones and lotus leaf for clothing.

claims_provenance.quote: 割肉還母，剔骨還父，還了父精母血。一點靈魂，徑到西方極樂世界告佛。佛正與眾菩薩講經，只聞得幢幡寶蓋有人叫道：「救命！」佛慧眼一看，知是哪吒之魂，即將碧藕為骨，荷葉為衣，念動起死回生真言，哪吒遂得了性命。
claims_provenance.source_citation: Wikisource (中文維基文庫) — 西遊記 第八十三回 心猿識得丹頭 姹女還歸本性

claim.id: Dalam Perjalanan ke Barat, Rulai (Buddha) memberi sang ayah sebuah pagoda emas yang berlapis-lapis Buddha dan menyuruh Nezha menganggap Buddha sebagai ayah sehingga dendam selesai; inilah asal gelar Li Tianwang Pembawa Pagoda.
claim.en: In Journey to the West, the Tathagata gives the father a golden pagoda with Buddhas on every level and tells Nezha to take the Buddha as his father, ending the grudge; this is why Li Tianwang is called the Pagoda-Bearer.

claims_provenance.quote: 如來以和為尚，賜他一座玲瓏剔透舍利子如意黃金寶塔。那塔上層層有佛，豔豔光明。喚哪吒以佛為父，解釋了冤仇。所以稱為托塔李天王者，此也。
claims_provenance.source_citation: Wikisource (中文維基文庫) — 西遊記 第八十三回 心猿識得丹頭 姹女還歸本性

claim.id: Dalam Perjalanan ke Barat, setelah hidup kembali Nezha memakai kekuatan gaibnya untuk menaklukkan sembilan puluh enam gua siluman, dan kemudian hendak membunuh sang Raja Langit untuk membalas dendam atas tulangnya yang dikupas.
claim.en: In Journey to the West, after being revived Nezha uses his divine power to subdue ninety-six caves of demons, and later wants to kill the Heavenly King to avenge having stripped his own bones.

claims_provenance.quote: 運用神力，法降九十六洞妖魔，神通廣大。後來要殺天王，報那剔骨之仇。
claims_provenance.source_citation: Wikisource (中文維基文庫) — 西遊記 第八十三回 心猿識得丹頭 姹女還歸本性

claim.id: Dalam Perjalanan ke Barat, Raja Langit Li Jing dan Pangeran Ketiga Nezha mengajukan diri menaklukkan 'siluman' Sun Wukong; Kaisar Giok mengangkat Li Jing sebagai Marsekal Penakluk Iblis dan Nezha sebagai Dewa Agung Haihui Tiga Altar.
claim.en: In Journey to the West, the Pagoda-Bearing Heavenly King Li Jing and Third Prince Nezha volunteer to subdue the 'monster' Sun Wukong; the Jade Emperor appoints Li Jing Great Marshal Subduer of Demons and Nezha Great Deity of the Three Altars' Sea Assembly.

claims_provenance.quote: 班部中閃上托塔李天王與哪吒三太子，越班奏上道：「萬歲，微臣不才，請旨降此妖怪。」玉帝大喜，即封托塔天王李靖為降魔大元帥，哪吒三太子為三壇海會大神，即刻興師下界。
claims_provenance.source_citation: Wikisource (中文維基文庫) — 西遊記 第四回 官封弼馬心何足 名注齊天意未寧

claim.id: Dalam Perjalanan ke Barat, Nezha berteriak 'Berubah!' dan menjadi bertiga kepala berenam lengan, memegang enam senjata: pedang pembasmi siluman, golok pemotong siluman, tali pengikat siluman, pentungan penakluk siluman, bola bersulam, dan roda api.
claim.en: In Journey to the West, Nezha shouts 'Change!' and becomes three-headed and six-armed, holding six weapons: a demon-slaying sword, a demon-cutting blade, a demon-binding rope, a demon-subduing pestle, an embroidered ball, and a fire wheel.

claims_provenance.quote: 那哪吒奮怒，大喝一聲，叫：「變！」即變做三頭六臂，惡狠狠，手持著六般兵器，乃是斬妖劍、砍妖刀、縛妖索、降妖杵、繡毬兒、火輪兒，丫丫叉叉，撲面來打。
claims_provenance.source_citation: Wikisource (中文維基文庫) — 西遊記 第四回 官封弼馬心何足 名注齊天意未寧

claim.id: Menurut Wikipedia, dalam Sanjiao Soushen Daquan (Kumpulan Lengkap Dewa Tiga Ajaran) zaman Yuan, sebelum menjelma ke dunia fana Nezha adalah dewa agung di bawah Kaisar Giok yang mengenakan roda emas di kepala, bertiga kepala, bermata sembilan, bertangan delapan, dan dapat mengembuskan awan biru dari mulutnya.
claim.en: According to Wikipedia, in the Yuan-dynasty Sanjiao Soushen Daquan (Complete Collection of Deities of the Three Religions), before his reincarnation into the mortal realm Nezha was a great immortal under the Jade Emperor who wears a golden wheel around his head, has three heads, nine eyes, and eight arms, and can blow azure clouds out of his mouth.

claims_provenance.quote: In the Yuan dynasty Sanjiao Soushen Daquan (Complete Collection of Deities of the Three Religions), prior to his reincarnation into the mortal realm, Nezha was a great immortal under the Jade Emperor, who wears a golden wheel around his head, has three heads, nine eyes, and eight arms, and can blow azure clouds out of his mouth.

claim.id: Dalam budaya populer, pembunuhan Li Gen dan Ao Bing oleh Nezha sering dipandang sebagai akibat Ao Guang menuntut anak laki-laki dan perempuan dari Chentang Pass sebagai korban persembahan.
claim.en: In popular culture, Nezha's killing of Li Gen and Ao Bing is often seen as a result of Ao Guang demanding young boys and girls from Chentang Pass as sacrifices.

claims_provenance.quote: In popular culture, Nezha's killing of Li Gen and Ao Bing is often seen as a result of Ao Guang demanding young boys and girls from Chentang Pass as sacrifices.

claim.id: Menurut Wikipedia, alur yang dijelaskan sebelumnya (tuntutan korban dan ancaman banjir) hanya ditemukan dalam film Shanghai Animation Film Studio tahun 1979, Nezha Conquers the Dragon King, dan tidak ada dalam novel Fengshen Yanyi maupun adaptasi opera zaman Qing.
claim.en: According to Wikipedia, the plot described just before (the demand for sacrifices and the flood threat) is found only in the 1979 Shanghai Animation Film Studio movie Nezha Conquers the Dragon King, and not in the Fengshen Yanyi novel or Qing-dynasty opera adaptations.

claims_provenance.quote: The above plot is only found in the 1979 Shanghai Animation Film Studio movie, Nezha Conquers the Dragon King, and not in the Fengshen Yanyi novel or Qing dynasty opera adaptations.

claim.id: Popularitas tokoh ini meningkat pada 1979 dengan film animasi panjang Nezha Conquers the Dragon King, yang diputar di Festival Film Cannes 1980 dan dianggap salah satu karya klasik besar animasi Tiongkok.
claim.en: The character increased in popularity in 1979 with the animated feature film Nezha Conquers the Dragon King, which was screened at the 1980 Cannes Film Festival and is considered one of the great classic works of Chinese animation.

claims_provenance.quote: The character increased in popularity in 1979 with the animated feature film Nezha Conquers the Dragon King, which was screened at the 1980 Cannes Film Festival and is considered one of the great classic works of Chinese animation.

claim.id: Pada 26 Juli 2019, film animasi panjang lain, Ne Zha, lebih sukses dan memecahkan banyak rekor pendapatan sepanjang masa, termasuk film berpendapatan tertinggi ketiga di Tiongkok dan film animasi berpendapatan tertinggi dari luar Amerika Serikat.
claim.en: On 26 July 2019, another animated feature film, Ne Zha, was more successful, setting numerous all-time box-office records, including third-highest-grossing of all films in China and highest-grossing animated film from outside the United States.

claims_provenance.quote: On 26 July 2019, another animated feature film, Ne Zha, was more successful, setting numerous all-time records for box-office grosses, including third-highest-grossing of all films in China and highest-grossing animated film from outside the United States.

claim.id: Sekuelnya, Ne Zha 2 (2025), mencetak rekor pendapatan lebih jauh, menjadi film berpendapatan tertinggi di Tiongkok, film berbahasa non-Inggris berpendapatan tertinggi sepanjang masa, dan film animasi berpendapatan tertinggi sepanjang masa.
claim.en: A sequel, Ne Zha 2 (2025), set further box-office records, becoming the highest-grossing film in China, the highest-grossing non-English-language film of all time, and the highest-grossing animated movie of all time.

claims_provenance.quote: A sequel, Ne Zha 2 (2025), set further box office records, becoming the highest-grossing film in China, and the highest grossing non-English language film of all time, and the highest grossing animated movie of all time.

claim.id: Menurut Wikipedia, dalam Perjalanan ke Barat Nezha bertarung melawan Raja Kera Sun Wukong ketika yang terakhir memberontak melawan Kaisar Giok; keduanya kemudian menjadi teman.
claim.en: According to Wikipedia, in Journey to the West Nezha fought the Monkey King Sun Wukong when the latter rebelled against the Jade Emperor; they later became friends.

claims_provenance.quote: He fought the Monkey King, Sun Wukong, when the latter rebelled against the Jade Emperor. They later became friends.

claim.id: Menurut pengantar Wikisource, Fengshen Yanyi (封神演義), yang biasa disebut Fengshen Bang, adalah novel dewa-iblis Tiongkok; pengarangnya disebut Chen Zhonglin (atau Xu Zhonglin) dari Dinasti Ming.
claim.en: According to the Wikisource introduction, Fengshen Yanyi (封神演義), commonly called Fengshen Bang, is a Chinese novel of gods and demons whose author is given as Chen Zhonglin (or Xu Zhonglin) of the Ming dynasty.

claims_provenance.quote: 《封神演義》，一般俗稱《封神榜》，又名《商周列國全傳》、《武王伐紂外史》、《封神傳》。是一部中國神魔小說，作者是明朝的陳仲琳（或許仲琳）
claims_provenance.source_citation: Wikisource (中文維基文庫) — 封神演義 (頁首簡介)

claim.id: Menurut pengantar Wikisource, Fengshen Yanyi kira-kira rampung ditulis pada masa Longqing dan Wanli; novel ini terdiri dari seratus bab dengan latar Jiang Ziya membantu wangsa Zhou (Raja Wen dan Raja Wu) menyerang Zhou raja Shang.

claim.en: In Fengshen Yanyi, the revived Nezha rebukes Li Jing for whipping his golden statue and burning his shrine-palace on Mount Cuiping, then thrusts his spear at Li Jing's head to avenge that one lash.

claim.en: According to the book description, Meir Shahar recounts Nezha's riveting tale, which culminates in suicide and attempted patricide, and uncovers hidden tensions in the Chinese family system.

text.id: Menurut satu kajian, asalnya dapat ditelusuri ke tokoh dalam epos Sanskerta abad-abad pertama SM; dalam sastra, tokoh novel zaman Dinasti Ming.
text.en: According to one study, his origins can be traced to a figure of the Sanskrit epics of the first centuries BCE; in literature, a character in novels of the Ming dynasty.

short_description.id: Nezha adalah dewa pelindung dalam agama rakyat Tiongkok, Taoisme, dan Buddhisme, yang bergelar Marsekal Altar Tengah, yang juga tampil sebagai tokoh dalam novel Fengshen Yanyi dan Perjalanan ke Barat.
short_description.en: Nezha is a protection deity in Chinese folk religion, Taoism, and Buddhism, with the title Marshal of the Central Altar, who also appears as a character in the novels Fengshen Yanyi and Journey to the West.

long_description.id: Nezha adalah dewa pelindung dalam Taoisme, Buddhisme, Konfusianisme, dan agama rakyat Tiongkok. Nama Taoisnya yang resmi adalah Marsekal Altar Tengah, dan setelah menjadi dewa ia diberi gelar Pangeran Ketiga Teratai. Dalam pemujaan rakyat ia juga disebut Pangeran Ketiga. Menurut Meir Shahar, ia telah dimuliakan selama lebih dari seribu tahun.
long_description.en: Across Chinese folk religion, Taoism, Buddhism, and Confucianism, Nezha is a protective deity. The Taoist tradition officially names him Marshal of the Central Altar, and once he became a deity he received the title Third Lotus Prince. In popular worship he is also called the Third Prince. According to Meir Shahar, he has been celebrated for over a millennium.

long_description.id: Menurut Meir Shahar, Nezha bermula sebagai makhluk mitologis bernama Nalakūbara dalam epos Sanskerta, dan nama Nezha berasal dari Nalakuvara, yang digambarkan sebagai jenderal yaksa heroik dalam Mahamayuri. Kajian yang sama menyebut ia telah dipuja oleh biksu Buddha, pendeta Dao, dan perantara roh. Novel Perjalanan ke Barat memberi penjelasan lain tentang nama itu: Nezha lahir dengan aksara 'Ne' di telapak tangan kiri dan 'zha' di telapak tangan kanan.
long_description.en: According to Meir Shahar, Nezha began as a mythological being named Nalakūbara in the Sanskrit epics, and the name Nezha derives from Nalakuvara, portrayed as a heroic yaksha general in the Mahamayuri. The same study says he has been venerated by Buddhist monks, Daoist priests, and spirit mediums. The novel Journey to the West gives a different explanation of the name: Nezha was born with the character 'Ne' on his left palm and 'zha' on his right palm.

long_description.id: Dalam pemujaan, Nezha dianggap dewa pelindung banyak pengemudi profesional karena ia terbang cepat dengan roda angin-api, dan juga dewa pelindung anak-anak dan bakti anak. Orang tua mempersembahkan sesaji kepadanya agar anak mereka tumbuh kuat, sehat, dan berbakti. Shahar menafsirkan bahwa dalam kisahnya, etika Konfusian menuntut dorongan oedipal menyamar sebagai bakti anak.
long_description.en: In worship, Nezha is regarded as the tutelary god of many professional drivers because he flies swiftly on his wind-fire wheels, and also as the patron god of children and filial piety. Parents make offerings to him so that their children will grow up strong, healthy, and dutiful. Shahar interprets his story as one in which Confucian ethics require the oedipal drive to masquerade as filial piety.

long_description.id: Dalam novel Fengshen Yanyi dari zaman Dinasti Ming, Nezha adalah putra Li Jing yang lahir dari bola daging setelah dikandung lebih dari tiga tahun, dan merupakan penjelmaan Lingzhu Zi. Saat mandi di Sungai Jiuwan ia membunuh yaksa Li Gen dan putra Raja Naga, Ao Bing, lalu mengembalikan daging dan tulangnya kepada orang tuanya. Rohnya pergi ke Gunung Qianyuan; ia dipuja di sebuah kuil di Gunung Cuiping hingga Li Jing menghancurkannya, lalu Taiyi Zhenren membangkitkannya dalam tubuh teratai. Ia lalu menyerang Li Jing untuk membalas dendam hingga seorang Daois mengurungnya dengan pagoda, dan Li Jing menjadi Raja Langit Pembawa Pagoda.
long_description.en: In the novel Fengshen Yanyi of the Ming dynasty, Nezha is Li Jing's son, born from a ball of flesh after more than three years' gestation, and an incarnation of Lingzhu Zi. While bathing in the Jiuwan River he kills the yaksha Li Gen and the Dragon King's son Ao Bing, then returns his flesh and bones to his parents. His spirit goes to Mount Qianyuan; he is worshiped at a shrine on Mount Cuiping until Li Jing destroys it, and Taiyi Zhenren then raises him in a lotus body. He then attacks Li Jing in revenge until a Daoist traps him in a pagoda, and Li Jing becomes the Pagoda-Bearing Heavenly King.

long_description.id: Dalam novel Perjalanan ke Barat dari zaman Dinasti Ming, Nezha tampil sebagai Pangeran Ketiga yang bersama ayahnya, Raja Langit Li Jing, diangkat untuk menaklukkan Sun Wukong. Ia berubah menjadi bertiga kepala berenam lengan dan memegang enam senjata. Kisah asalnya diceritakan berbeda: Buddha, bukan Taiyi Zhenren, yang menghidupkannya kembali, dan pagoda diberikan Rulai kepada sang ayah. Penggambaran dalam novel ini adalah tokoh sastra, terpisah dari praktik pemujaan rakyat.
long_description.en: In the novel Journey to the West of the Ming dynasty, Nezha appears as the Third Prince who, with his father the Heavenly King Li Jing, is appointed to subdue Sun Wukong. He transforms into a three-headed, six-armed figure holding six weapons. His origin story is told differently: the Buddha, not Taiyi Zhenren, revives him, and the pagoda is given to the father by the Tathagata. This novel portrayal is a literary characterization, separate from the practice of folk worship.

cultural_context.id: Dalam pemujaan, Nezha dianggap pelindung pengemudi profesional serta anak-anak dan bakti anak; orang tua mempersembahkan sesaji agar anak mereka tumbuh kuat, sehat, dan berbakti. Shahar menyebut kisahnya mengungkap ketegangan tersembunyi dalam sistem keluarga Tiongkok.
cultural_context.en: In worship, Nezha is regarded as protector of professional drivers and of children and filial piety; parents make offerings so that their children grow up strong, healthy, and dutiful. Shahar says his story uncovers hidden tensions in the Chinese family system.

etymology.original_form: 哪吒 (Nézhā), dari 那吒 (Nazha) dan Nalakuvara

literal_meaning.id: Menurut Meir Shahar, nama ini berasal dari Nalakuvara; penambahan 'radikal mulut' (口) pada Na (那) menghasilkan bentuk sekarang. Novel Perjalanan ke Barat memberi penjelasan lain dari aksara di telapak tangan.
literal_meaning.en: According to Meir Shahar the name comes from Nalakuvara; adding the 'mouth radical' (口) to Na (那) gives the present form. The novel Journey to the West gives a different explanation from characters on the palms.

who.id: Dewa pelindung Tiongkok yang dikenal dengan gelar Marsekal Altar Tengah dan Pangeran Ketiga.
who.en: A Chinese protection deity known by the titles Marshal of the Central Altar and Third Prince.

origin.id: Menurut satu kajian, ia berawal dari Nalakūbara dalam epos Sanskerta di India; dalam novel Fengshen Yanyi ia lahir di Chentang Pass.
origin.en: According to one study he began as Nalakūbara of the Sanskrit epics in India; in the novel Fengshen Yanyi he is born at Chentang Pass.

role.id: Dewa pelindung yang dipuja sebagai pelindung pengemudi serta anak-anak dan bakti anak.
role.en: A protection deity worshiped as protector of drivers and of children and filial piety.

famous_for.id: Paling dikenal lewat kisah dalam novel Fengshen Yanyi: membunuh putra Raja Naga, mengembalikan daging dan tulangnya kepada orang tuanya, lalu dibangkitkan dalam tubuh teratai.
famous_for.en: Best known for the story in the novel Fengshen Yanyi: killing the Dragon King's son, returning his flesh and bones to his parents, and being raised in a lotus body.

did_you_know.id: Menurut Wikipedia, alur bahwa Ao Guang menuntut anak-anak sebagai korban dan mengancam membanjiri Chentang Pass hanya ditemukan dalam film 1979 Nezha Conquers the Dragon King, bukan dalam novel Fengshen Yanyi.
did_you_know.en: According to Wikipedia, the plot in which Ao Guang demands children as sacrifices and threatens to flood Chentang Pass is found only in the 1979 film Nezha Conquers the Dragon King, not in the novel Fengshen Yanyi.

description.id: Menurut Wikipedia, dalam cerita rakyat tradisional Nezha terbang cepat dengan roda angin-api; dalam Fengshen Yanyi ia berdiri di atas dua roda itu.
description.en: According to Wikipedia, in traditional folklore Nezha flies swiftly on his wind-fire wheels; in Fengshen Yanyi he stands on the two wheels.

sources.title: Oedipal God: The Chinese Nezha and His Indian Origins (book page)
sources.author: Meir Shahar

claims.quote: Nezha (哪吒, Nézhā) or sometimes Nezha the Crown Prince (哪吒太子, Nézhā Tàizǐ), or Natha, is a protection deity in Taoism, Buddhism, Confucianism, and Chinese folk religion.

statement.id: Nezha (哪吒), kadang disebut Nezha Sang Putra Mahkota (哪吒太子) atau Natha, adalah dewa pelindung dalam Taoisme, Buddhisme, Konfusianisme, dan agama rakyat Tiongkok.
statement.en: Nezha (哪吒), sometimes called Nezha the Crown Prince (哪吒太子) or Natha, is a protection deity in Taoism, Buddhism, Confucianism, and Chinese folk religion.

claims.quote: His official Taoist name is "Marshal of the Central Altar" (中壇元帥). He was then given the title "Third Lotus Prince" (蓮花三太子) after he became a deity.

statement.id: Nama resmi Taoisnya adalah 'Marsekal Altar Tengah' (中壇元帥). Setelah menjadi dewa, ia diberi gelar 'Pangeran Ketiga Teratai' (蓮花三太子).
statement.en: His official Taoist name is 'Marshal of the Central Altar' (中壇元帥). After he became a deity he was given the title 'Third Lotus Prince' (蓮花三太子).

claims.quote: Nezha is worshipped in Chinese folk religion and is called "Marshal of the Central Altar" (三坛大会元帅), or the "Third Prince" (三太子).

statement.id: Nezha dipuja dalam agama rakyat Tiongkok dan disebut 'Marsekal Altar Tengah' (三坛大会元帅) atau 'Pangeran Ketiga' (三太子).
statement.en: Nezha is worshipped in Chinese folk religion and is called 'Marshal of the Central Altar' (三坛大会元帅) or the 'Third Prince' (三太子).

claims.quote: As in traditional folklore, Nezha flies around swiftly on his wind fire wheels, so he is also regarded as the tutelary god of many professional drivers, like trucks, taxis, or sightseeing bus drivers.

statement.id: Seperti dalam cerita rakyat tradisional, Nezha terbang cepat dengan roda angin-api (風火輪), sehingga ia juga dianggap dewa pelindung banyak pengemudi profesional, seperti sopir truk, taksi, atau bus wisata.
statement.en: As in traditional folklore, Nezha flies around swiftly on his wind fire wheels, so he is also regarded as the tutelary god of many professional drivers, such as truck, taxi, or sightseeing-bus drivers.

claims.quote: Nezha is also often regarded as the patron god of children and filial piety. Parents would make an offering to Nezha with the hope that their children would grow up strong, healthy, and be dutiful and respectful.

statement.id: Nezha juga sering dianggap dewa pelindung anak-anak dan bakti anak. Orang tua mempersembahkan sesaji kepada Nezha dengan harapan anak mereka tumbuh kuat, sehat, berbakti, dan hormat.
statement.en: Nezha is also often regarded as the patron god of children and filial piety. Parents would make an offering to Nezha hoping their children would grow up strong, healthy, dutiful, and respectful.

claims.quote: Finally, the book offers a detailed history of the legend and the cult reaching back over two thousand years to its origins in India, where Nezha began as a mythological being named Nalakūbara, whose sexual misadventures were celebrated in the Sanskrit epics as early as the first centuries BCE.

statement.id: Menurut deskripsi buku Meir Shahar, legenda dan kultus Nezha dapat ditelusuri lebih dari dua ribu tahun ke asalnya di India, tempat Nezha bermula sebagai makhluk mitologis bernama Nalakūbara, yang petualangan seksualnya dirayakan dalam epos Sanskerta sejak abad-abad pertama SM.
statement.en: According to the description of Meir Shahar's book, the legend and cult of Nezha reach back over two thousand years to their origins in India, where Nezha began as a mythological being named Nalakūbara, whose sexual misadventures were celebrated in the Sanskrit epics as early as the first centuries BCE.

claims.quote: Crossing the boundaries between China’s diverse religious traditions, it tracks the rebellious infant in the many ways he has been venerated by Buddhist monks, Daoist priests, and possessed spirit mediums

statement.id: Menurut deskripsi buku Shahar, Nezha sang bayi pemberontak dipuja dengan berbagai cara oleh biksu Buddha, pendeta Dao, dan perantara roh yang kerasukan.
statement.en: According to the description of Shahar's book, the rebellious infant Nezha has been venerated in many ways by Buddhist monks, Daoist priests, and possessed spirit mediums.

claims.quote: Celebrated for over a millennium, Nezha is among the most formidable and enigmatic of all Chinese gods.

statement.id: Menurut deskripsi buku Shahar, Nezha telah dimuliakan selama lebih dari seribu tahun dan termasuk dewa Tiongkok yang paling tangguh dan penuh teka-teki.
statement.en: According to the description of Shahar's book, Nezha has been celebrated for over a millennium and is among the most formidable and enigmatic of all Chinese gods.

claims.quote: Shahar argues that, despite a disastrous father-son relationship, Confucian ethics require that the oedipal drive masquerade as filial piety in Nezha’s story, dictating that the child-god kill himself before trying to avenge himself upon his father.

statement.id: Shahar berpendapat bahwa, meski hubungan ayah-anak itu buruk, etika Konfusian menuntut dorongan oedipal menyamar sebagai bakti anak dalam kisah Nezha, sehingga sang dewa kecil bunuh diri sebelum mencoba membalas dendam kepada ayahnya.
statement.en: Shahar argues that, despite a disastrous father-son relationship, Confucian ethics require the oedipal drive to masquerade as filial piety in Nezha's story, dictating that the child-god kill himself before trying to avenge himself on his father.

claims.quote: According to Meir Shahar, the name Nezha comes from Nalakuvara, depicted as a heroic yaksha general in the Mahamayuri.

statement.id: Menurut Meir Shahar, nama Nezha berasal dari Nalakuvara, yang digambarkan sebagai jenderal yaksa heroik dalam Mahamayuri.
statement.en: According to Meir Shahar, the name Nezha comes from Nalakuvara, depicted as a heroic yaksha general in the Mahamayuri.

claims.quote: The original variant 那羅鳩婆羅 changed to 捺羅俱跋羅, 那吒矩韈囉 and finally 那吒 (Nazha). The simple addition of the "mouth radical" (口) to Na (那) changes the name to the current form Nezha (哪吒).

statement.id: Bentuk asli 那羅鳩婆羅 berubah menjadi 捺羅俱跋羅, 那吒矩韈囉, dan akhirnya 那吒 (Nazha). Penambahan 'radikal mulut' (口) pada Na (那) mengubah nama menjadi bentuk sekarang, Nezha (哪吒).
statement.en: The original variant 那羅鳩婆羅 changed to 捺羅俱跋羅, 那吒矩韈囉, and finally 那吒 (Nazha). Adding the 'mouth radical' (口) to Na (那) gives the current form Nezha (哪吒).

claims.quote: 原來天王生此子時，他左手掌上有個「哪」字，右手掌上有個「吒」字，故名哪吒。

statement.id: Dalam novel Perjalanan ke Barat, ketika sang Raja Langit melahirkan putra ini, di telapak tangan kirinya ada aksara 'Ne' (哪) dan di telapak tangan kanannya aksara 'zha' (吒), sehingga ia dinamai Nezha.
statement.en: In the novel Journey to the West, when the Heavenly King had this son, the character 'Ne' (哪) was on his left palm and 'zha' (吒) on his right palm, hence the name Nezha.

claims.quote: 殷夫人後又懷孕在身，已及三年零六個月，倘不生產。李靖時常心下憂疑，一日，指夫人之腹，言曰：「孕懷三載有餘，尚不降生，非妖即怪。」

statement.id: Dalam novel Fengshen Yanyi, Nyonya Yin mengandung selama tiga tahun enam bulan tanpa melahirkan, dan Li Jing cemas serta berkata bahwa kehamilan sepanjang itu pasti pertanda siluman atau makhluk aneh.
statement.en: In the novel Fengshen Yanyi, Lady Yin was pregnant for three years and six months without giving birth, and Li Jing, worried, said that a pregnancy so long must mean a demon or a monster.

claims.quote: 有一肉毬，滴溜溜圓轉如輪。李靖大驚，望肉毬上一劍砍去，劃然有聲。分開肉毬，跳出一個小孩兒來，滿地紅光，面如傅粉，右手套一金鐲，肚腹上圍著一塊紅綾，金光射目。

statement.id: Dalam Fengshen Yanyi, Li Jing menebas sebuah bola daging yang berputar seperti roda; bola itu terbelah dan keluarlah seorang anak laki-laki dengan cahaya merah, bermuka putih, bergelang emas di tangan kanan, dan berselempang kain merah di perutnya.
statement.en: In Fengshen Yanyi, Li Jing slashes a ball of flesh that turns like a wheel; it splits open and a small boy jumps out amid red light, with a face white as powder, a golden bracelet on his right hand, and a red silk cloth around his belly.

claims.quote: 這位神聖下世，出在陳塘關，乃姜子牙先行官是也；靈珠子化身。金鐲是「乾坤圈」，紅綾名曰「混天綾。」此物乃是乾元山鎮金光洞之寶。

statement.id: Dalam Fengshen Yanyi, narator menyatakan bahwa dewa ini lahir di Chentang Pass sebagai penjelmaan Lingzhu Zi dan pembuka jalan bagi Jiang Ziya; gelang emasnya bernama Qiankun Quan (乾坤圈) dan kain merahnya Huntian Ling (混天綾), pusaka Gua Jinguang di Gunung Qianyuan.
statement.en: In Fengshen Yanyi, the narrator states that this divine being was born at Chentang Pass as an incarnation of Lingzhu Zi and as Jiang Ziya's vanguard; the golden bracelet is the Qiankun Quan (乾坤圈) and the red silk the Huntian Ling (混天綾), treasures of Jinguang Cave on Mount Qianyuan.

claims.quote: 李靖答曰：「不才有三子；長曰金吒，拜五龍山雲霄洞文殊廣法天尊為師；次曰木吒，拜九宮山白鶴洞普賢真人為師。老師既要此子為門下，但憑起一名諱，便拜道長為師。」道人曰：「此子第三，取名叫做『哪吒』。」

statement.id: Dalam Fengshen Yanyi, Li Jing menyebut ketiga putranya: Jinzha (murid Wenshu Guangfa Tianzun) dan Muzha (murid Puxian Zhenren); sang Daois lalu menamai putra ketiga 'Nezha'.
statement.en: In Fengshen Yanyi, Li Jing names his three sons: Jinzha (a disciple of Wenshu Guangfa Tianzun) and Muzha (a disciple of Puxian Zhenren); the Daoist then names the third son 'Nezha'.

claims.quote: 貧道乃乾元山金光洞太乙真人是也。聞得將軍生了公子，特來賀喜。借令公子一看，不知尊意如何？

statement.id: Dalam Fengshen Yanyi, sang Daois memperkenalkan diri sebagai Taiyi Zhenren dari Gua Jinguang di Gunung Qianyuan, yang datang memberi selamat atas kelahiran putra Li Jing.
statement.en: In Fengshen Yanyi, the Daoist introduces himself as Taiyi Zhenren of Jinguang Cave on Mount Qianyuan, who has come to congratulate Li Jing on the birth of his son.

claims.quote: 不知這河是九灣河，是東海口上。哪吒將此寶放在水中，把水俱映紅了。擺一擺，江河晃動，搖一搖，乾坤動撼。那哪吒洗澡，不覺那水晶宮已愰的亂響。

statement.id: Dalam Fengshen Yanyi, Nezha mandi di Sungai Jiuwan di muara Laut Timur dengan mencelupkan pusakanya; air menjadi merah, sungai bergoyang, dan istana kristal ikut berguncang.
statement.en: In Fengshen Yanyi, Nezha bathes in the Jiuwan River at the mouth of the East Sea and dips his treasure in the water; the water turns red, the river shakes, and the crystal palace rattles.

claims.quote: 把右手套的乾坤圈望空中一舉。此寶原係崑崙山玉虛宮所賜太乙真人鎮金光洞之物，夜叉那裏經得起，那寶打將下來，正落在夜叉頭上，只打的腦漿迸流，即死於岸上。

statement.id: Dalam Fengshen Yanyi, Nezha mengangkat Qiankun Quan ke udara dan benda itu menimpa kepala yaksa pengintai Li Gen hingga ia tewas di tepi sungai.
statement.en: In Fengshen Yanyi, Nezha raises the Qiankun Quan into the air and it strikes the head of the patrolling yaksha Li Gen, who dies on the bank.

claims.quote: 提起乾坤圈，照頂門一下，把三太子的元身打出，是一條龍，在地上挺直。哪吒曰：「打出這小龍的本像來了。也罷，把他的筋抽去，做一條龍筋絛與俺父親束甲。」

statement.id: Dalam Fengshen Yanyi, Nezha memukul putra ketiga Raja Naga dengan Qiankun Quan hingga wujud aslinya, seekor naga, tampak; ia lalu mencabut urat sang naga untuk dijadikan ikat pinggang bagi ayahnya.
statement.en: In Fengshen Yanyi, Nezha strikes the Dragon King's third son with the Qiankun Quan until his true form, a dragon, appears; he then pulls out its sinew to make a belt for his father.

claims.quote: 敖光大怒，恨不能即與其子報仇，隨化一秀士，逕往陳塘關來。至於帥府，對門官曰：「你與我傳報，有故人敖光拜訪。」

statement.id: Dalam Fengshen Yanyi, Ao Guang murka dan, setelah menjelma menjadi seorang terpelajar, pergi ke Chentang Pass dan mengumumkan dirinya sebagai kenalan lama yang berkunjung.
statement.en: In Fengshen Yanyi, Ao Guang, furious, transforms into a scholar, goes to Chentang Pass, and announces himself as an old acquaintance come to visit.

claims.quote: 『一人行事一人當』，我打死敖丙、李艮，我當償命，豈有子連累父母之理！」乃對敖光曰：「我一身非輕，乃靈珠子是也。奉玉虛符命，應運下世。我今日剖腹、剜腸、剔骨肉，還於父母，不累雙親。

statement.id: Dalam Fengshen Yanyi, Nezha menyatakan bahwa ia yang membunuh Ao Bing dan Li Gen sehingga ia sendiri yang harus menanggung akibatnya, mengaku sebagai Lingzhu Zi, dan berkata akan mengembalikan daging dan tulangnya kepada orang tuanya agar mereka tidak terbebani.
statement.en: In Fengshen Yanyi, Nezha declares that he killed Ao Bing and Li Gen and must pay for it himself, says he is Lingzhu Zi, and says he will return his flesh and bones to his parents so that they are not burdened.

claims.quote: 哪吒便右手提劍，先去一臂膊，後自剖其腹，剜腸剔骨，散了七魂三魄，一命歸泉。四龍王據哪吒之言回旨。

statement.id: Dalam Fengshen Yanyi, Nezha dengan pedang di tangan kanan memotong sebelah lengannya lalu membelah perutnya sendiri; ia mati dan para Raja Naga melaporkan sesuai ucapannya.
statement.en: In Fengshen Yanyi, Nezha, sword in his right hand, cuts off an arm and then slits open his own belly; he dies, and the Dragon Kings report according to his words.

claims.quote: 哪吒魂無所依，魄無所倚──他原是寶貝化現，借了精血，故有魂魄。哪吒飄飄蕩蕩，隨風而至，逕到乾元山來。

statement.id: Dalam Fengshen Yanyi, roh Nezha tak punya tempat bersandar; ia berasal dari penjelmaan pusaka yang meminjam darah dan sari tubuh sehingga memiliki roh, dan ia melayang tertiup angin sampai ke Gunung Qianyuan.
statement.en: In Fengshen Yanyi, Nezha's spirit has nothing to rest on; he was the manifestation of a treasure that borrowed essence and blood and so has a spirit, and he drifts on the wind to Mount Qianyuan.

claims.quote: 真人吩咐哪吒：「此處非汝安身之所。你回到陳塘關，托一夢與你母親，離關四十里，有一翠屏山，山上有一空地，令你母親造一座哪吒行宮，你受香煙三載，又可立於人間，輔佐真主。

statement.id: Dalam Fengshen Yanyi, Taiyi Zhenren menyuruh Nezha menemui ibunya dalam mimpi dan meminta dibangunkan sebuah istana persinggahan (行宮) di Gunung Cuiping, empat puluh li dari pass itu; setelah menerima dupa selama tiga tahun ia dapat kembali ke dunia manusia untuk membantu sang penguasa sejati.
statement.en: In Fengshen Yanyi, Taiyi Zhenren tells Nezha to appear in his mother's dream and ask for a shrine-palace (行宮) on Mount Cuiping, forty li from the pass; after receiving incense for three years he can return to the human world to assist the true ruler.

claims.quote: 哪吒在翠屏山顯聖，四方遠近居民，俱來進香，紛紛如蟻，日盛一日，往往不斷。祈福禳災，無不感應。

statement.id: Dalam Fengshen Yanyi, Nezha menampakkan kesaktian di Gunung Cuiping; penduduk dari dekat dan jauh berdatangan membawa dupa, makin ramai dari hari ke hari, dan doa memohon berkah atau penangkal bencana selalu terkabul.
statement.en: In Fengshen Yanyi, Nezha manifests his power at Mount Cuiping; residents from near and far come with incense in growing numbers day by day, and prayers for blessings or the warding off of disaster are always answered.

claims.quote: 罵罷，提六陳鞭，一鞭把哪吒金身打的粉碎。李靖怒發，復一腳蹬倒鬼判。傳令：「放火，燒了廟宇。」

statement.id: Dalam Fengshen Yanyi, Li Jing menghancurkan arca emas Nezha dengan cambuk, menendang roboh arca hakim hantu, dan memerintahkan agar kuil dibakar.
statement.en: In Fengshen Yanyi, Li Jing smashes Nezha's golden statue with a whip, kicks over the ghost-judge statues, and orders the temple burned.

claims.quote: 真人將花勒下瓣兒，鋪成三才，又將荷葉梗兒折成三百骨節，三個荷葉，按上、中、下，按天、地、人。真人將一粒金丹放於居中

statement.id: Dalam Fengshen Yanyi, Taiyi Zhenren menata kelopak teratai dan tangkai daun teratai menjadi tubuh dengan tiga ratus ruas tulang, lalu menaruh sebutir pil emas di tengahnya.
statement.en: In Fengshen Yanyi, Taiyi Zhenren arranges lotus petals and lotus-leaf stalks into a body with three hundred joints of bone, then places a grain of golden elixir at its center.

claims.quote: 外面有三公子，腳踏風火二輪，手提火尖鎗，口稱老爺姓諱，不知何故，請老爺定奪。

statement.id: Dalam Fengshen Yanyi, para pengawal melaporkan bahwa putra ketiga berdiri di atas dua roda angin-api dan memegang tombak berujung api.
statement.en: In Fengshen Yanyi, the guards report that the third son stands on two wind-fire wheels and holds a fire-tipped spear.

claims.quote: 只見祥雲繚繞，紫霧盤旋，一物往下落來，把哪吒罩在玲瓏塔裏。道人雙手在塔上一拍，塔裏火發，把哪吒燒的大叫：「饒命！」

statement.id: Dalam Fengshen Yanyi, seorang Daois menurunkan sebuah pagoda yang mengurung Nezha, lalu menepuknya hingga api berkobar di dalam dan Nezha berteriak minta ampun.
statement.en: In Fengshen Yanyi, a Daoist drops a pagoda that traps Nezha and claps it so that fire breaks out inside and Nezha cries for mercy.

claims.quote: 道人原是太乙真人請到此間磨哪吒之性，以認父子之情。後來父子四人，肉身成聖，托塔天王乃李靖也。

statement.id: Dalam Fengshen Yanyi, Daois itu ternyata diundang Taiyi Zhenren untuk menjinakkan watak Nezha agar mengakui ikatan ayah-anak; kemudian keempat ayah dan putra itu menjadi suci dengan tubuh jasmani, dan Li Jing menjadi Raja Langit Pembawa Pagoda.
statement.en: In Fengshen Yanyi, the Daoist turns out to have been invited by Taiyi Zhenren to temper Nezha's nature so that he acknowledges the father-son bond; later the father and three sons become sages in the flesh, and Li Jing is the Pagoda-Bearing Heavenly King.

claims.quote: 黃金造就玲瓏塔，萬道毫光透九重。不是燃燈施法力，難教父子復相從。

statement.id: Dalam Fengshen Yanyi, syair penutup bab menyebut bahwa tanpa kekuatan gaib Randeng, ayah dan anak itu sulit rukun kembali berkat pagoda emas.
statement.en: In Fengshen Yanyi, the closing verse of the chapter says that without Randeng's spiritual power the father and son could hardly have been reunited by the golden pagoda.

claims.quote: 割肉還母，剔骨還父，還了父精母血。一點靈魂，徑到西方極樂世界告佛。佛正與眾菩薩講經，只聞得幢幡寶蓋有人叫道：「救命！」佛慧眼一看，知是哪吒之魂，即將碧藕為骨，荷葉為衣，念動起死回生真言，哪吒遂得了性命。

statement.id: Dalam novel Perjalanan ke Barat, Nezha mengembalikan daging kepada ibu dan tulang kepada ayah, rohnya pergi memohon kepada Buddha di Surga Barat, dan Buddha menghidupkannya kembali dengan akar teratai sebagai tulang dan daun teratai sebagai pakaian.
statement.en: In the novel Journey to the West, Nezha returns his flesh to his mother and his bones to his father, his spirit goes to plead with the Buddha in the Western Paradise, and the Buddha revives him with lotus root for bones and lotus leaf for clothing.

claims.quote: 如來以和為尚，賜他一座玲瓏剔透舍利子如意黃金寶塔。那塔上層層有佛，豔豔光明。喚哪吒以佛為父，解釋了冤仇。所以稱為托塔李天王者，此也。

statement.id: Dalam Perjalanan ke Barat, Rulai (Buddha) memberi sang ayah sebuah pagoda emas yang berlapis-lapis Buddha dan menyuruh Nezha menganggap Buddha sebagai ayah sehingga dendam selesai; inilah asal gelar Li Tianwang Pembawa Pagoda.
statement.en: In Journey to the West, the Tathagata gives the father a golden pagoda with Buddhas on every level and tells Nezha to take the Buddha as his father, ending the grudge; this is why Li Tianwang is called the Pagoda-Bearer.

claims.quote: 運用神力，法降九十六洞妖魔，神通廣大。後來要殺天王，報那剔骨之仇。

statement.id: Dalam Perjalanan ke Barat, setelah hidup kembali Nezha memakai kekuatan gaibnya untuk menaklukkan sembilan puluh enam gua siluman, dan kemudian hendak membunuh sang Raja Langit untuk membalas dendam atas tulangnya yang dikupas.
statement.en: In Journey to the West, after being revived Nezha uses his divine power to subdue ninety-six caves of demons, and later wants to kill the Heavenly King to avenge having stripped his own bones.

claims.quote: 班部中閃上托塔李天王與哪吒三太子，越班奏上道：「萬歲，微臣不才，請旨降此妖怪。」玉帝大喜，即封托塔天王李靖為降魔大元帥，哪吒三太子為三壇海會大神，即刻興師下界。

short_description.id: Kresna, juga disebut Govinda, Madhava, dan Gopala, adalah dewa utama agama Hindu yang dipuja sebagai awatara kedelapan Wisnu sekaligus Tuhan Yang Mahatinggi, tokoh sentral Mahabharata dan penyampai Bhagavad Gita.
short_description.en: Krishna, known too as Govinda, Madhava and Gopala, is a leading Hindu god honoured both as Vishnu's eighth avatar and as the supreme deity, a central figure of the Mahabharata and teacher of the Bhagavad Gita.

long_description.id:
Kresna, juga dikenal sebagai Govinda, Madhava, Gopala, dan banyak nama lain, adalah dewa utama agama Hindu. Ia dipuja sebagai awatara kedelapan Wisnu dan sebagai Tuhan Yang Mahatinggi, dan dihormati karena kasih, welas asih, perlindungan, dan kelembutannya. Hari kelahirannya dirayakan setiap tahun pada Krishna Janmashtami, yang jatuh pada akhir Agustus atau awal September.

Kresna sering digambarkan berkulit gelap sesuai arti namanya, hitam atau gelap. Menurut Wikipedia, ia tokoh sentral dalam Mahabharata, Bhagavata Purana, Brahma Vaivarta Purana, dan Bhagavad Gita, yang menggambarkannya sebagai negarawan ilahi, guru, penyelamat dharma, kusir kereta, dan kadang penggembala sapi. Menurut World History Encyclopedia, perannya ganda: ia penghukum perbuatan manusia sekaligus pembawa pencerahan.

Ia lahir di Mathura dari Dewaki dan Wasudewa, tetapi dibesarkan Nanda dan Yashoda di Gokul untuk menghindari pamannya, Raja Kamsa yang zalim. Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Wisnu mencabut dua helai rambut dan rambut hitam ditanamkan ke rahim Devaki; Kamsa, yang telah diperingatkan tentang anak kedelapan, membunuh tujuh anak lebih dahulu, dan Wasudewa menyembunyikan Krishna di Vrindavana tempat ia tumbuh sebagai penggembala yang memikat para gopi.

Kisah hidupnya memuat banyak keajaiban: ia memikat para gopi dengan seruling ilahinya dan mengangkat Bukit Govardhan untuk melindungi kaumnya dari hujan dahsyat. Wisnu Purana menyebut ia menahan gunung itu dengan satu tangan, bertekad membunuh ular Kāliya, dan menindih Kansa hingga tewas. Menurut World History Encyclopedia, ia juga mengalahkan Putana, Kaliya, dan Pancajana, dan mencuri pohon Parijata dari Indra.

Kemudian ia mendirikan kota Dvaraka dan menjadi kusir kereta Arjuna dalam perang Kurukshetra. Menurut World History Encyclopedia ia melantunkan Bhagavad Gita pada malam sebelum perang; dalam Gita ia menyatakan seluruh alam semesta diciptakan olehnya, dan dalam terjemahan Arnold Krishna berkata ia adalah Roh dalam hati setiap makhluk, memperlihatkan semua rupa-Nya kepada Arjuna, lalu kembali ke rupa Krishna yang dikenalnya. Ia tewas oleh panah pemburu yang mengenai tumitnya, dan tujuh hari kemudian Dvaraka tenggelam.

Menurut World History Encyclopedia, kini banyak penganut memuja Krishna sebagai dewa Hindu tertinggi dan ia terutama dihormati di Bengal dan Udupi, dengan hari kelahirannya dirayakan pada Krishna Janmashtami. Dalam seni Hindu ia biasanya berkulit gelap, berjubah kuning, berbulu merak di rambut, dan memainkan seruling; dalam seni Khmer pengangkatan Gunung Govardhana menjadi adegan yang paling populer, antara lain di Angkor Wat. Menurut World History Encyclopedia, ia mungkin pahlawan paling populer dalam mitologi Hindu.
long_description.en:
Krishna, called also Govinda, Madhava, Gopala and by many other names, is one of the great gods of Hinduism. Devotees honour him both as Vishnu's eighth avatar and as the highest god in his own right, cherishing him for his love, mercy, protection and gentleness. His birth is celebrated each year at Krishna Janmashtami, in late August or early September.

Artists often give Krishna dark skin, matching his name, which means black or dark. According to Wikipedia he figures centrally in texts including Mahabharata, Bhagavata Purana, Brahma Vaivarta Purana and Bhagavad Gita, which present him as divine statesman, teacher, savior of dharma, charioteer and at times a cowherd. According to the World History Encyclopedia his role is twofold: he punishes human deeds yet also brings enlightenment.

He was born in Mathura to Devaki and Vasudeva, but raised by Nanda and Yashoda in Gokul to escape his uncle, the tyrant king Kamsa. According to the World History Encyclopedia, Vishnu pulled two hairs and the black one was planted in Devaki's womb; Kamsa, warned about the eighth child, killed seven children first, and Vasudeva hid Krishna in Vrindavana, where he grew up as a cowherd who stirred the hearts of the gopis.

Wonders run through his story: his flute charmed the gopis, and he raised Govardhan Hill as a shelter for his people against torrential rain. The Vishnu Purana says he held the mountain with one hand, resolved to slay the serpent Kāliya and crushed Kansa to death. According to the World History Encyclopedia he also overcame Putana, Kaliya and Pancajana and stole the Parijata tree from Indra.

He went on to found the city of Dvaraka and drive Arjuna's chariot in the Kurukshetra War. According to the World History Encyclopedia he recounted the Bhagavad Gita on the eve of the battle; in the Gita he states that the whole universe was created by him, and in Arnold's translation Krishna says he is the Spirit in every creature's heart, shows Arjuna all his semblances and then returns to the Krishna form Arjuna knew. He was killed by a hunter's arrow striking his heel, and seven days later Dvaraka was submerged.

According to the World History Encyclopedia, many believers today worship Krishna as the supreme Hindu god and he is especially revered in Bengal and Udupi, with his birthday celebrated at Krishna Janmashtami. In Hindu art he typically has dark skin, a yellow robe, a peacock feather in his hair and a flute; in Khmer art the lifting of Mount Govardhana is the most popular scene, at sites such as Angkor Wat. The World History Encyclopedia calls him perhaps the most popular of all the heroes of Hindu mythology.

cultural_context.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, many believers today worship Krishna as the supreme Hindu god, especially in Bengal and Udupi; Wikipedia records that Hindus celebrate his birthday each year at Krishna Janmashtami, and in Khmer art the lifting of Mount Govardhana is the most popular scene of his adventures.

Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Wisnu mencabut dua helai rambut dan rambut hitam ditanamkan ke rahim Devaki; Kamsa yang diperingatkan tentang anak kedelapan telah membunuh tujuh anak sebelumnya, dan Wasudewa menyembunyikan Krishna di Vrindavana. Wisnu Purana menyebut suara dari langit yang memperingatkan Kansa.
summary.en: According to Wikipedia, Krishna was born in Mathura to Devaki and Vasudeva but raised by Nanda and Yashoda in Gokul to escape his uncle, the tyrant king Kamsa. According to the World History Encyclopedia, Vishnu pulled two hairs and the black one was planted in Devaki's womb; Kamsa, warned about the eighth child, had killed seven children before, and Vasudeva hid Krishna in Vrindavana. summary.id: Krishna mengangkat Bukit Govardhan untuk melindungi kaumnya dari hujan dahsyat. Menurut World History Encyclopedia banjir itu dikirim Indra, dan menurut Wisnu Purana ia menahan gunung dengan satu tangan selama tujuh hari tujuh malam sementara awan Indra menurunkan hujan.

role.en: Rescuer of Vraja from the poisonous serpent

summary.id: Wisnu Purana menceritakan Krishna melihat kolam berisi ular Kāliya yang mendidih oleh api bisa, lalu bertekad membunuhnya agar penduduk Vraja bebas dari rasa takut; World History Encyclopedia menyebut Kaliya di antara musuh yang ia kalahkan.
summary.en: The Vishnu Purana tells how Krishna saw the pool of the serpent Kāliya boiling with the fires of poison and resolved to slay it so that Vraja's people would be free of fear; the World History Encyclopedia lists Kaliya among the enemies he defeated.

summary.id: Krishna mengalahkan tiran Kamsa dan kemudian menjadi raja Mathura; dalam Wisnu Purana ia menarik rambut Kansa, menjatuhkannya ke tanah, dan menimpanya hingga Kansa tewas.
summary.en: Krishna dealt with the tyrant Kamsa and afterwards became king of Mathura; in the Vishnu Purana he seizes Kansa by the hair, throws him to the ground and falls upon him until Kansa dies.

summary.id: Krishna menjadi kusir kereta Arjuna dalam perang di Kurukshetra antara Pandawa dan Kaurawa, dan pada malam sebelum perang itu ia melantunkan Bhagavad Gita. Dalam Gita ia menyatakan dirinya Roh dalam hati setiap makhluk dan, menurut World History Encyclopedia, bahwa seluruh alam semesta diciptakan olehnya; ia memperlihatkan kepada Arjuna semua rupa-Nya.
summary.en: Krishna was Arjuna's charioteer in the war at Kurukshetra between the Pandavas and the Kauravas, and on the eve of the battle he recounted the Bhagavad Gita. In the Gita he declares himself the Spirit in every creature's heart, and, according to the World History Encyclopedia, that the whole universe was created by him; he shows Arjuna all his semblances.

title.en: The theft of the Parijata tree

role.en: Thief of the tree from Indra

summary.id: Krishna mencuri pohon suci Parijata dari Indra dan mengalahkannya, menanamnya di Dvaraka, tetapi setelah ia wafat pohon itu dikembalikan kepada Indra.
summary.en: Krishna stole the sacred Parijata tree from Indra, defeating him, and planted it at Dvaraka, but on his death it was returned to Indra.

role.id: Pendiri kota yang tenggelam setelah wafatnya
role.en: Founder of the city that sinks after his death
