claim.id: Journey to the West (Xiyouji) adalah novel Tiongkok yang terbit pada abad ke-16 pada masa dinasti Ming dan dikaitkan dengan Wu Cheng'en.
claim.en: Journey to the West (Xiyouji) is a Chinese novel published in the 16th century during the Ming dynasty and attributed to Wu Cheng'en.

claims_provenance.quote: is a Chinese novel published in the 16th century during the Ming dynasty and attributed to Wu Cheng'en.

claim.id: Bagian awal novel menceritakan petualangan awal Sun Wukong, seekor kera yang lahir di Gunung Bunga dan Buah (Flower Fruit Mountain) dari telur batu, yang mempelajari Tao, 72 transformasi, ilmu tempur, dan rahasia keabadian.
claim.en: The opening part of the novel deals with the early exploits of Sun Wukong, a monkey born on Flower Fruit Mountain from a stone egg, who learns the Tao, 72 transformations, combat, and the secrets of immortality.

claims_provenance.quote: The beginning part of the story deals with the earlier exploits of Sun Wukong, a monkey born on Flower Fruit Mountain from a stone egg that forms from an ancient rock created by the coupling of Heaven and Earth, who learns the art of the Tao, 72 polymorphic transformations, combat, and secrets of immortality

claim.id: Sun Wukong, juga dikenal sebagai Raja Kera (Monkey King), adalah tokoh sastra dan keagamaan yang paling dikenal sebagai salah satu tokoh utama novel Tiongkok abad ke-16 Journey to the West.
claim.en: Sun Wukong, also known as the Monkey King, is a literary and religious figure best known as one of the main characters of the 16th-century Chinese novel Journey to the West.

claims_provenance.quote: also known as the Monkey King, is a literary and religious figure best known as one of the main characters in the 16th-century Chinese novel Journey to the West.

claim.id: Dalam novel, Sun Wukong adalah kera cerdas (kemungkinan rhesus makaka atau monyet hidung pesek emas) yang lahir dari batu dan memperoleh kekuatan gaib lewat latihan Tao serta makanan surgawi.
claim.en: In the novel Sun Wukong is an intelligent monkey (likely a rhesus macaque or a golden snub-nosed monkey) born from a stone who gains supernatural powers through Taoist practice and heavenly food.

claims_provenance.quote: In the novel, Sun Wukong is an intelligent monkey (likely a rhesus macaque or a golden snub-nosed monkey) born from a stone who acquires supernatural powers through Taoist practices and consuming heavenly victuals.

claim.id: Setelah memberontak melawan surga, ia dipenjara di bawah gunung oleh Buddha. Lima ratus tahun kemudian ia menemani biksu Tang Sanzang, yang menunggang White Dragon Horse, bersama dua murid lain, Zhu Bajie dan Sha Heshang, mengambil sutra Buddha di Barat.
claim.en: After rebelling against heaven he is imprisoned under a mountain by the Buddha. Five hundred years later he accompanies the monk Tang Sanzang, who rides the White Dragon Horse, with two other disciples, Zhu Bajie and Sha Heshang, to obtain Buddhist sutras in the West.

claims_provenance.quote: After rebelling against heaven, he is imprisoned under a mountain by the Buddha. Five hundred years later, he accompanies the monk Tang Sanzang riding on the White Dragon Horse and two other disciples, Zhu Bajie and Sha Heshang, on a journey to obtain Buddhist sutras in the West or Western Paradise, where Buddha and his followers dwell.

claim.id: Sun Wukong memiliki banyak kemampuan, antara lain kekuatan supernatural; ia mampu memikul beban dua gunung berat di bahunya.
claim.en: Sun Wukong has many abilities, including supernatural strength; he can support the weight of two heavy mountains on his shoulders.

claims_provenance.quote: Sun Wukong possesses many abilities. He has supernatural strength and is able to support the weight of two heavy mountains on his shoulders

claim.id: Sun Wukong memperoleh 72 Transformasi Duniawi, yang memberinya 72 kekuatan unik, termasuk kemampuan berubah menjadi hewan dan benda.
claim.en: Sun Wukong acquires the 72 Earthly Transformations, which give him 72 unique powers, including the ability to transform into animals and objects.

claims_provenance.quote: Sun Wukong acquires the 72 Earthly Transformations, which allow him to access 72 unique powers, including the ability to transform into animals and objects.

claim.id: Kemampuan salto awan sering digambarkan sebagai Wukong menunggang awan; guru Puti Zushi mengajarkannya agar Wukong memiliki cara terbang yang cocok dengan kegemarannya melompat.
claim.en: The cloud somersault is often portrayed as Wukong riding a cloud; his master Puti Zushi taught it to give him a style of flying suited to his love of jumping.

claims_provenance.quote: The ability, oft portrayed as Wukong riding a nimbus-like cloud, requires a magic hand sign, an oral spell, a fist clench, and a body shake. Wukong's master Puti Zushi taught this ability to the monkey to give him a style of flying that complements his penchant for jumping.

claim.id: Sun Wukong dikatakan memperoleh keabadian lewat sembilan cara dan peristiwa berbeda, yang menjadikannya salah satu makhluk paling abadi dan kebal di seluruh ciptaan.
claim.en: Sun Wukong is said to have gained immortality through nine different means and instances, making him one of the most immortal and invincible beings in all of creation.

claims_provenance.quote: Sun Wukong is said to have gained immortality through nine different means and instances, which together made him one of the most immortal and invincible beings in all of creation.

claim.id: Guanyin memberi Tang Sanzang sebuah lingkaran gaib dari Buddha yang tidak dapat dilepas setelah Raja Kera dibujuk memakainya; saat Tang Sanzang melafalkan sutra tertentu, lingkaran itu mengetat dan menimbulkan sakit kepala tak tertahankan.
claim.en: Guanyin gives Tang Sanzang a magical circlet from the Buddha that can never be removed once the Monkey King is tricked into wearing it; when Tang Sanzang chants a certain sutra the band tightens and causes an unbearable headache.

claims_provenance.quote: a magical circlet which, once the Monkey King is tricked into putting it on, can never be removed. When Tang Sanzang chants a certain sutra, the band will tighten and cause an unbearable headache.

claim.id: Marga Sūn diberikan sebagai lelucon tentang kera, karena kera juga disebut húsūn (猢猻), kata yang dapat berarti kera secara harfiah maupun kiasan.
claim.en: The surname Sūn was given as an in-joke about the monkey, since monkeys are also called húsūn (猢猻), a word that can mean a monkey literally or figuratively.

claims_provenance.quote: The surname Sūn was given as an in-joke about the monkey, as monkeys are also called húsūn (猢猻), and can mean either a literal or a figurative monkey (or a macaque).

claim.id: Nama pemberian Wùkōng berarti "tersadar akan kekosongan", kadang diterjemahkan "sadar akan kehampaan".
claim.en: The given name Wùkōng means "awakened to emptiness", sometimes translated as "aware of vacuity".

claims_provenance.quote: The given name, Wùkōng, means "awakened to emptiness", sometimes translated as "aware of vacuity".

claim.id: Nama Sun Wukong dilafalkan Son Gokū dalam bahasa Jepang, Tôn Ngộ Không dalam bahasa Vietnam, Sung Ghokong atau Sung Gokhong dalam bahasa Jawa, dan Sun Gokong dalam bahasa Melayu, di antara bahasa lain.
claim.en: Sun Wukong is pronounced Son Gokū in Japanese, Tôn Ngộ Không in Vietnamese, Sung Ghokong or Sung Gokhong in Javanese and Sun Gokong in Malay, among other languages.

claims_provenance.quote: Son Gokū in Japanese, Sonogong in Korean ... Tôn Ngộ Không in Vietnamese, Sung Ghokong or Sung Gokhong in Javanese, Sun Ngokong in Thai, Wu Khone in Burmese, and Sun Gokong in Malay.

claim.id: Prototipe sastra tertua yang diketahui dari Sun Wukong muncul dalam buku pegangan juru cerita dinasti Song (960–1279), Poetic Tale of Tripitaka of the Great Tang Fetching Scriptures, teks 17 bab yang menyebutnya "Monkey Pilgrim" (猴行者, Hou Xingzhe).
claim.en: The earliest known literary prototype of Sun Wukong appears in a Song dynasty (960–1279) storyteller's prompt-book, Poetic Tale of Tripitaka of the Great Tang Fetching Scriptures, a 17-chapter text that calls him the "Monkey Pilgrim" (猴行者, Hou Xingzhe).

claims_provenance.quote: The earliest known literary prototype of Sun Wukong appears in the Song dynasty (960–1279) storyteller's prompt-book Poetic Tale of Tripitaka of the Great Tang Fetching Scriptures (大唐三藏取經詩話). In this 17-chapter text, the character is known as the "Monkey Pilgrim" (猴行者, Hou Xingzhe).

claim.id: Berbeda dari novel dinasti Ming yang menceritakan kera dibebaskan dari bawah gunung, Monkey Pilgrim mendekati Xuanzang atas kehendaknya sendiri.
claim.en: Unlike the Ming dynasty classic, in which the monkey is freed from under a mountain, the Monkey Pilgrim approaches Xuanzang of his own accord.

claims_provenance.quote: Unlike the Ming dynasty classic where the monkey is freed from under a mountain, the Monkey Pilgrim voluntarily approaches Xuanzang

claim.id: Dalam teks itu, Monkey Pilgrim menjadi satu-satunya pelindung gaib Xuanzang, karena tokoh Zhu Bajie (Pigsy) dan Sha Wujing (Sandy) belum dikembangkan sepenuhnya sebagai sesama murid.
claim.en: In that text the Monkey Pilgrim is Xuanzang's sole magical protector, since the characters of Zhu Bajie (Pigsy) and Sha Wujing (Sandy) had not yet been fully developed as fellow disciples.

claims_provenance.quote: Throughout the text, the Monkey Pilgrim serves as Xuanzang's sole magical protector, as the characters of Zhu Bajie (Pigsy) and Sha Wujing (Sandy) had not yet been fully developed as fellow disciples.

claim.id: Hu Shih pertama kali mengusulkan bahwa Wu Cheng'en mungkin dipengaruhi dewa Hindu Hanuman dari Ramayana dalam penggambarannya tentang Raja Kera.
claim.en: Hu Shih first suggested that Wu Cheng'en may have been influenced by the Hindu deity Hanuman of the Ramayana in his depictions of the Monkey King.

claims_provenance.quote: Hu Shih first suggested that Wu Cheng'en may have been influenced by the Hindu deity Hanuman from the Ramayana in his depictions of the Monkey King.

claim.id: Sebaliknya, Lu Xun mengusulkan dewa Tiongkok abad ke-9 Wuzhiqi, yang muncul sebagai saudara Sun Wukong dalam kisah dinasti Yuan yang lebih tua, sebagai sumber inspirasinya.
claim.en: Instead, Lu Xun suggested the 9th-century Chinese deity Wuzhiqi, who appears as a sibling of Sun Wukong in older Yuan dynasty stories, as the inspiration.

claims_provenance.quote: Instead, Lu Xun suggested the 9th-century Chinese deity Wuzhiqi, who appears as a sibling of Sun Wukong in older Yuan dynasty stories, as the inspiration.

claim.id: Menurut Li Tianfei, Raja Kera dalam novel akhir menggabungkan dua tradisi cerita rakyat terpisah yang bersatu pada masa dinasti Yuan (1271–1368).
claim.en: According to Li Tianfei, the Monkey King of the final novel combines two separate folklore traditions that merged during the Yuan dynasty (1271–1368).

claims_provenance.quote: According to Li, the Monkey King in the final novel combines two separate folklore traditions that merged during the Yuan dynasty (1271–1368).

claim.id: Di beberapa bagian Tiongkok selatan, termasuk Sichuan, Fujian, dan Guangdong, cerita rakyat setempat memuat roh kera perkasa yang dipuja dan diberi gelar seperti "Great Sage Equal to Heaven" (齐天大圣).
claim.en: In parts of southern China, including Sichuan, Fujian and Guangdong, local folklore featured powerful ape spirits that were worshipped and given titles such as "Great Sage Equal to Heaven" (齐天大圣).

claims_provenance.quote: In parts of southern China, including Sichuan, Fujian, and Guangdong, local folklore featured powerful ape spirits that were worshipped and given titles such as "Great Sage Equal to Heaven" (齐天大圣).

claim.id: Ia membentuk persaudaraan bernama Tujuh Resi (Seven Sages, 七聖) dengan Bull Demon King (牛魔王) serta raja-raja siluman lain, antara lain Raja Roc dan Raja Singa.
claim.en: He forms a brotherhood called the Seven Sages (七聖) with the Bull Demon King (牛魔王) and other spirit kings, among them the Roc Demon King and the Lion Spirit King.

claims_provenance.quote: He forms a brotherhood called the Seven Sages (七聖) with the Bull Demon King (牛魔王), the Saurian Demon King (蛟魔王), the Roc Demon King (鵬魔王), the Lion Spirit King (獅狔王), the Macaque Spirit King (獼猴王), and the snub-nosed monkey Spirit King (禺狨王).

claim.id: Guanyin menyarankan Erlang Shen, keponakan Kaisar Giok, melawan Wukong; Wukong dan Erlang sama kuat; keduanya akhirnya berubah menjadi sosok menakutkan yang membuat pasukan kera Wukong lari ketakutan.
claim.en: Guanyin suggests the Jade Emperor's nephew Erlang Shen fight Wukong; Wukong and Erlang are evenly matched and eventually both turn into terrifying figures, which scares Wukong's monkey army away.

claims_provenance.quote: Guanyin suggests the Jade Emperor's nephew Erlang Shen fight Wukong. Wukong and Erlang are evenly matched and eventually, both turn into terrifying figures, which scares Wukong's monkey army away.

claim.id: Sun Wukong mengalahkan 100.000 prajurit langit Army of Heaven, 28 rasi bintang, dan Empat Raja Surgawi di bawah komando Devaraja Li dan putra ketiganya, Nezha.
claim.en: Sun Wukong defeats the Army of Heaven's 100,000 celestial warriors, the 28 constellations and the Four Heavenly Kings, under the command of Devaraja Li and his third son Nezha.

claims_provenance.quote: Sun Wukong defeats the Army of Heaven's 100,000 celestial warriors, the 28 constellations and the Four Heavenly Kings, under the command of Devaraja Li and his third son, Princes Nezha, despite the Heavenly weapons used against him.

claim.id: Sesama primata rohani Wukong antara lain Six-Eared Macaque (六耳獼猴), yang menjadi salah satu lawannya dalam alur utama.
claim.en: Wukong's fellow spiritual primates include the Six-Eared Macaque (六耳獼猴), who is one of his antagonists in the main storyline.

claims_provenance.quote: His fellow spiritual primates are the Six-Eared Macaque (六耳獼猴), who is one of his antagonists in the main storyline

claim.id: Novel satir pendek Xiyoubu (sekitar 1640) mengisahkan Sun Wukong terjebak di dunia mimpi gaib ciptaan Qing Fish Demon, perwujudan keinginan.
claim.en: The brief satirical novel Xiyoubu (c. 1640) follows Sun Wukong trapped in a magical dream world created by the Qing Fish Demon, the embodiment of desire.

claims_provenance.quote: The brief satirical novel Xiyoubu (西遊補; "Supplement to the Journey to the West"), c. 1640, follows Sun Wukong as he is trapped in a magical dream world created by the Qing Fish Demon, the embodiment of desire

claim.id: A Chinese Odyssey adalah film komedi fantasi yang dibuat di Hong Kong pada 1995.
claim.en: A Chinese Odyssey is a fantasy comedy film made in Hong Kong in 1995.

claims_provenance.quote: A Chinese Odyssey is a fantasy comedy film made in Hong Kong 1995.

claim.id: Donnie Yen memerankan Sun Wukong dalam film The Monkey King tahun 2014.
claim.en: Donnie Yen plays Sun Wukong in the 2014 movie The Monkey King.

claims_provenance.quote: Martial Arts Superstar Donnie Yen plays Sun Wukong in the 2014 movie The Monkey King

claim.id: Tokoh Son Goku dalam Dragon Ball didasarkan pada Sun Wukong, terlihat dari ekor kera, tongkat, awan terbang, dan namanya.
claim.en: The character Son Goku in Dragon Ball is based on Sun Wukong, as shown by his monkey tail, staff, flying cloud and name.

claims_provenance.quote: The character of Son Goku in Dragon Ball is based on Sun Wukong, as attested by his monkey tail, staff, flying cloud, and name

claim.id: Tokoh Monkey dalam serial televisi Jepang Monkey tahun 1978 didasarkan pada Sun Wukong.
claim.en: The character Monkey in the 1978 Japanese television series Monkey is based on Sun Wukong.

claims_provenance.quote: The character of Monkey in the 1978 Japanese television series Monkey is based on Sun Wukong.

claim.id: Dalam pengantar terjemahannya tahun 1913, Timothy Richard menulis bahwa Sun Wu Kung adalah kera yang melambangkan pikiran manusia yang tak terkendali, sang penemu, jenius pencipta yang penuh akal.
claim.en: In the introduction to his 1913 translation, Timothy Richard writes that Sun Wu Kung is a monkey who personates the irrepressible human mind, the discoverer, the inventive genius, full of resource.

claims_provenance.quote: Sun Wu Kung. A monkey who personates the irrepressible human mind, the discoverer, the inventive genius, full of resource
claims_provenance.source_citation: Internet Archive (Cornell University Library copy) — A mission to heaven : a great Chinese epic and allegory (full text)

claim.id: Dalam terjemahan Richard (1913), suatu hari batu hidup itu terbelah dan menghasilkan telur batu bundar; setelah terkena udara, telur itu menjadi kera batu dengan kelima indra lengkap dan mampu merayap serta berlari.
claim.en: In Richard's 1913 translation, one day the living stone split open and produced a round stone egg; after exposure to the air it became a stone monkey with the five senses complete, able to creep and run.

claims_provenance.quote: On a certain day it split open and produced a stone egg, round like a big ball. After exposure to the air, this was transformed into a stone monkey with the five senses of the body complete, and able to creep and run.
claims_provenance.source_citation: Internet Archive (Cornell University Library copy) — A mission to heaven : a great Chinese epic and allegory (full text)

claim.id: Richard menjelaskan bahwa topi berduri yang dipakai Kera menusuk kepalanya dan menimbulkan sakit hebat bila Sang Guru memerintahkan pekerjaan sulit dan Kera ragu.
claim.en: Richard explains that the hat of spikes worn by the Monkey pricks his head and gives great pain when the Master orders some very difficult work and the Monkey hesitates.

claims_provenance.quote: the Master orders some very difficult work to be done, and the Monkey hesitates, the spikes enter into his head and give great pain.
claims_provenance.source_citation: Internet Archive (Cornell University Library copy) — A mission to heaven : a great Chinese epic and allegory (full text)

claim.id: Dalam teks asli novel (bab 1), sebuah batu yang mengandung "kantong gaib" pecah pada suatu hari dan melahirkan telur batu sebesar bola; terkena angin, telur itu menjadi kera batu dengan panca indra dan keempat anggota badan lengkap.
claim.en: In the original text (chapter 1), a stone holding an immortal "womb" split open one day and produced a stone egg the size of a ball; touched by the wind it became a stone monkey with all five senses and four limbs complete.

claims_provenance.quote: 內育仙胞，一日迸裂，產一石卵，似圓毬樣大。因見風，化作一個石猴，五官俱備，四肢皆全。

claim.id: Para kera memberi hormat dan menyebutnya "千歲大王"; kera batu itu pun naik takhta, menanggalkan kata "batu" dari namanya, dan disebut Raja Kera Tampan (美猴王).
claim.en: The monkeys bow and hail him as "千歲大王"; the stone ape then ascends the throne, drops the word "stone" from his name, and is called the Handsome Monkey King (美猴王).

claims_provenance.quote: 眾猴聽說，即拱伏無違，一個個序齒排班，朝上禮拜，都稱「千歲大王」。自此，石猿高登王位，將「石」字兒隱了，遂稱「美猴王」。

claim.id: Raja Kera Tampan memimpin sekelompok kera dan monyet; mereka berkelana di Gunung Bunga dan Buah (花果山) pada siang hari dan bermalam di Gua Tirai Air (水簾洞) pada malam hari.
claim.en: The Handsome Monkey King led a troop of apes and monkeys; by day they roamed Flower Fruit Mountain (花果山) and by night they lodged in the Water Curtain Cave (水簾洞).

claims_provenance.quote: 美猴王領一群猿猴、獼猴、馬猴等，分派了君臣佐使。朝遊花果山，暮宿水簾洞

claim.id: Raja Kera memutuskan turun gunung, mengembara jauh untuk mencari tiga golongan makhluk yang luput dari kematian, agar belajar hidup abadi dan menghindari bencana dari Raja Yama.
claim.en: The Monkey King resolves to leave the mountain and wander far to find the three kinds of beings who escape death, so as to learn ageless long life and avoid the hardship of King Yama.

claims_provenance.quote: 我明日就辭汝等下山，雲遊海角，遠涉天涯，務必訪此三者，學一個不老長生，常躲過閻君之難。

claim.id: Sang guru (祖師) berkata bahwa urutan dua belas aksara nama perguruannya jatuh pada aksara "悟" bagi si kera, lalu memberinya nama dharma "孫悟空"; si kera menerimanya dengan gembira.
claim.en: The patriarch (祖師) says that in his school's sequence of twelve characters the monkey's turn falls on the character "悟", and gives him the dharma name "孫悟空", which the monkey gladly accepts.

claims_provenance.quote: 祖師道：「乃廣、大、智、慧、真、如、性、海、穎、悟、圓、覺十二字。排到你，正當『悟』字。與你起個法名叫做『孫悟空』，好麼？」猴王笑道：「好！好！好！自今就叫做孫悟空也。」

claim.id: Sang guru menilai tubuh si kera buruk tetapi mirip kera pemakan buah pinus, lalu memberinya marga "孫" setelah membahas aksara 猢 dan 猻.
claim.en: The patriarch says the monkey's body is unlovely yet like a pine-nut-eating macaque (猢猻), and after discussing the characters 猢 and 猻 gives him the surname "孫".

claims_provenance.quote: 你身軀雖是鄙陋，卻像個食松果的猢猻。我與你就身上取個姓氏，意思教你姓『猢』。猢字去了個獸傍，乃是個古月。古者，老也；月者，陰也。老陰不能化育，教你姓『猻』倒好。猻字去了獸傍，乃是個子系。子者，兒男也；系者。嬰細也，正合嬰兒之本論。教你姓『孫』罷。

claim.id: Dalam bab 2, si Raja Kera menguasai satu hal lalu seratus hal lain menyusul; ia mempelajari rumus lisan, berlatih sendiri, dan menguasai tujuh puluh dua perubahan wujud.
claim.en: In chapter 2 the Monkey King, once one opening is clear, finds a hundred open; he learns the oral formula, practises on his own, and masters the seventy-two transformations.

claims_provenance.quote: 這猴王也是他一竅通時百竅通，當時習了口訣，自修自煉，將七十二般變化都學成了。

claim.id: Sang guru mengajarkan awan salto: dengan rumus tangan, mantra, kepalan, dan guncangan tubuh, sekali salto menempuh seratus delapan ribu li.
claim.en: The patriarch teaches the somersault cloud: with a hand sign, a spell, a clenched fist and a shake of the body, one somersault covers 108,000 li.

claims_provenance.quote: 這朵雲，捻著訣，念動真言，攢緊了拳，將身一抖，跳將起來，一觔斗就有十萬八千里路哩。

claim.id: Dalam bab 3, senjata yang dipilih Wukong berujung dua gelang emas dengan batang besi hitam di tengah, bertuliskan "如意金箍棒" (tongkat gelang emas sesuka hati) seberat 13.500 kati.
claim.en: In chapter 3 the weapon Wukong takes has two gold bands at its ends and a length of black iron between them, inscribed "如意金箍棒" (Ruyi Jingu Bang), weighing 13,500 jin.

claims_provenance.quote: 悟空十分歡喜，拿出海藏看時，原來兩頭是兩個金箍，中間乃一段烏鐵。緊挨箍有鐫成的一行字，喚做：「如意金箍棒，重一萬三千五百斤。

claim.id: Kaisar Giok menetapkan Wukong sebagai "弼馬溫" (pengurus kuda) dan mengirimnya ke istal kerajaan untuk menjabat.
claim.en: The Jade Emperor decrees that Wukong be made a "弼馬溫" (keeper of the horses) and sends him to the imperial stables to take up the post.

claims_provenance.quote: 玉帝傳旨道：「就除他做個弼馬溫罷。」眾臣叫謝恩，他也只朝上唱個大喏。玉帝又差木德星官送他去御馬監到任。

claim.id: Setelah menolak jabatan pengurus kuda, Wukong menyiapkan panji bertuliskan "齊天大聖" dan memerintahkan agar ia hanya disebut Sang Resi Setara Langit, bukan raja.
claim.en: After the horse-keeper post, a banner reading "齊天大聖" (Great Sage Equal to Heaven) is set up and Wukong orders that he be called by that title and no longer "king".

claims_provenance.quote: 就做個齊天大聖，有何不可？」猴王聞說，歡喜不勝，連道幾個「好！好！好！」教四健將：「就替我快置個旌旗，旗上寫『齊天大聖』四大字，立竿張掛。自此以後，只稱我為齊天大聖，不許再稱大王。

claim.id: Kaisar Giok menugaskan Wukong mengurus Kebun Persik Panjang Umur (蟠桃園) sementara waktu.
claim.en: The Jade Emperor assigns Wukong to take charge of the Peach Garden (蟠桃園) for the time being.

claims_provenance.quote: 朕見你身閑無事，與你件執事：你且權管那蟠桃園，早晚好生在意。

claim.id: Buddha menantang Wukong bertaruh: bila Wukong mampu sekali salto keluar dari telapak tangan kanannya, ia dianggap menang.
claim.en: The Buddha proposes a wager: if Wukong can somersault out of his right palm in a single leap, Wukong wins.

claims_provenance.quote: 佛祖道：「我與你打個賭賽：你若有本事，一觔斗打出我這右手掌中，算你贏

claim.id: Buddha membalik telapak tangannya, mendorong Raja Kera keluar dari gerbang barat surga, dan mengubah lima jarinya menjadi lima gunung berantai bernama Gunung Lima Unsur (五行山).
claim.en: The Buddha turns his palm, pushes the Monkey King out of the West Heaven Gate, and turns his five fingers into five linked mountains called the Five Elements Mountain (五行山).

claims_provenance.quote: 被佛祖翻掌一撲，把這猴王推出西天門外，將五指化作金、木、水、火、土五座聯山，喚名「五行山」

claim.id: Di akhir novel, Buddha menyebut Sun Wukong pernah mengacau istana langit dan ditindih di bawah Gunung Lima Unsur; karena jasanya menaklukkan iblis di sepanjang jalan, ia dianugerahi gelar Buddha Pemenang Pertempuran (鬥戰勝佛).
claim.en: At the end of the novel the Buddha recalls that Sun Wukong made havoc in the heavenly palace and was pressed under the Five Elements Mountain, and for his merit in subduing demons along the way names him the Buddha Victorious in Fighting (鬥戰勝佛).

claims_provenance.quote: 孫悟空，汝因大鬧天宮，吾以甚深法力，壓在五行山下，幸天災滿足，歸於釋教；且喜汝隱惡揚善，在途中煉魔降怪有功，全終全始，加陞大職正果，汝為鬥戰勝佛。

text.id: Tokoh novel abad ke-16 pada masa dinasti Ming; prototipe sastranya sudah ada dalam teks dinasti Song
text.en: Character of a 16th-century Ming dynasty novel; a literary prototype already appears in a Song dynasty text

short_description.id: Sun Wukong, si Raja Kera, adalah tokoh novel klasik Tiongkok Journey to the West: kera yang lahir dari batu, belajar kesaktian dan keabadian, memberontak melawan surga, lalu mengawal biksu Tang Sanzang dalam perjalanan mengambil sutra.
short_description.en: Sun Wukong, the Monkey King, is a character of the classic Chinese novel Journey to the West: a monkey born from a stone who learns magic and immortality, rebels against heaven, and then escorts the monk Tang Sanzang on his journey to fetch scriptures.

long_description.id: Sun Wukong adalah tokoh sastra: ia salah satu tokoh utama novel Journey to the West, yang terbit pada abad ke-16 pada masa dinasti Ming dan dikaitkan dengan Wu Cheng'en. Ia disebut tokoh sastra sekaligus keagamaan; julukan yang paling dikenal adalah Raja Kera.
long_description.en: Sun Wukong is a literary character: he is one of the main characters of Journey to the West, a novel that appeared in the 16th century under the Ming dynasty and is credited to Wu Cheng'en. Both a literary and a religious figure by description, he is best known by the nickname Monkey King.

long_description.id: Menurut teks novel, ia lahir dari telur batu di Gunung Bunga dan Buah, lalu diangkat menjadi raja para kera dan tinggal di Gua Tirai Air. Setelah dinamai Sun Wukong oleh gurunya, ia mempelajari 72 perubahan wujud dan salto awan yang menempuh seratus delapan ribu li sekali lompat.
long_description.en: According to the novel he is born from a stone egg on Flower Fruit Mountain and becomes king of the monkeys, living in the Water Curtain Cave. After his teacher names him Sun Wukong he learns the 72 transformations and a cloud somersault that covers 108,000 li in one leap.

long_description.id: Ia memperoleh tongkat Ruyi Jingu Bang, diberi jabatan pengurus kuda dan penjaga kebun persik di surga, lalu memberontak. Setelah Buddha menahannya di bawah Gunung Lima Unsur selama lima ratus tahun, ia menjadi murid Tang Sanzang bersama Zhu Bajie dan Sha Heshang; sebuah lingkaran gaib di kepalanya mengetat bila Tang Sanzang melafalkan sutra tertentu.
long_description.en: He obtains the staff Ruyi Jingu Bang, is given posts as keeper of the horses and guardian of the peach garden in heaven, and then rebels. After the Buddha confines him under the Five Elements Mountain for five hundred years he becomes a disciple of Tang Sanzang with Zhu Bajie and Sha Heshang; a magical circlet on his head tightens when Tang Sanzang chants a certain sutra.

long_description.id: Di akhir novel, Buddha menganugerahinya gelar Buddha Pemenang Pertempuran. Para peneliti menelusuri asal-usulnya ke tokoh Monkey Pilgrim dalam teks dinasti Song, dan memperdebatkan pengaruh Hanuman, Wuzhiqi, serta tradisi kera di Tiongkok selatan.
long_description.en: At the end of the novel the Buddha gives him the title Buddha Victorious in Fighting. Scholars trace his origins to the Monkey Pilgrim of a Song dynasty text and debate the influence of Hanuman, Wuzhiqi and ape traditions of southern China.

cultural_context.id: Dalam pengantar terjemahannya tahun 1913, Timothy Richard menafsirkan Sun Wu Kung sebagai kera yang melambangkan pikiran manusia yang tak terkendali, sang penemu, dan jenius pencipta; ini tafsiran penerjemah, bukan pernyataan novel itu sendiri.
cultural_context.en: In the introduction to his 1913 translation Timothy Richard interprets Sun Wu Kung as a monkey who personates the irrepressible human mind, the discoverer and the inventive genius; this is the translator's interpretation, not a statement of the novel itself.

literal_meaning.id: Marga Sūn mengacu pada kata húsūn (猢猻) yang berarti kera; nama pemberian Wùkōng berarti "tersadar akan kekosongan".
literal_meaning.en: The surname Sūn plays on húsūn (猢猻), "monkey"; the given name Wùkōng means "awakened to emptiness".

who.id: Kera sakti yang lahir dari batu dalam novel klasik Tiongkok Journey to the West.
who.en: A magical monkey born from a stone in the classic Chinese novel Journey to the West.

origin.id: Tokoh sastra dari novel Tiongkok abad ke-16 yang dikaitkan dengan Wu Cheng'en, dengan prototipe dalam teks dinasti Song.
origin.en: A literary character from a 16th-century Chinese novel attributed to Wu Cheng'en, with a prototype in a Song dynasty text.

role.id: Murid dan pengawal Tang Sanzang dalam perjalanan mengambil sutra Buddha di Barat.
role.en: Disciple and escort of Tang Sanzang on the journey to fetch Buddhist sutras in the West.

famous_for.id: Memberontak melawan surga dengan tongkat sakti, 72 perubahan wujud, dan salto awan, lalu menjadi Buddha Pemenang Pertempuran.
famous_for.en: Rebelling against heaven with a magic staff, 72 transformations and a cloud somersault, and later becoming the Buddha Victorious in Fighting.

did_you_know.id: Menurut teks novel, tongkat Ruyi Jingu Bang yang dipilih Wukong di bab 3 bertuliskan berat 13.500 kati.
did_you_know.en: According to the novel text, the Ruyi Jingu Bang that Wukong takes in chapter 3 is inscribed with a weight of 13,500 jin.

description.id: 72 Transformasi Duniawi memberinya 72 kekuatan unik, termasuk berubah menjadi hewan dan benda; novel menyebut ia menguasai tujuh puluh dua perubahan wujud.
description.en: The 72 Earthly Transformations give him 72 unique powers, including transforming into animals and objects; the novel says he masters seventy-two transformations.

description.id: Dalam novel, sekali salto menempuh seratus delapan ribu li; disebut sebagai cara terbang yang diajarkan gurunya.
description.en: In the novel one somersault covers 108,000 li; it is described as a style of flying taught by his master.

description.id: Ia mampu memikul beban dua gunung berat di bahunya.
description.en: He can support the weight of two heavy mountains on his shoulders.

description.id: Ia dikatakan memperoleh keabadian lewat sembilan cara dan peristiwa berbeda.
description.en: He is said to have gained immortality through nine different means and instances.

description.id: Tongkat berujung dua gelang emas bertuliskan berat 13.500 kati yang diambil Wukong dalam bab 3.
description.en: A staff with two gold bands at its ends inscribed with a weight of 13,500 jin, which Wukong takes in chapter 3.

description.id: Lingkaran gaib dari Buddha tidak dapat dilepas, dan mengetat serta menimbulkan sakit kepala saat Tang Sanzang melafalkan sutra tertentu; Richard menyebut topi berduri serupa yang menusuk kepala Kera saat ia ragu menjalankan perintah sulit.
description.en: A magical circlet from the Buddha cannot be removed, and it tightens and causes a headache when Tang Sanzang chants a certain sutra; Richard describes a similar hat of spikes that pricks the Monkey's head when he hesitates over a hard task.

description.id: Dalam buku pegangan juru cerita dinasti Song, tokoh ini disebut Monkey Pilgrim, mendekati Xuanzang atas kehendaknya sendiri, dan menjadi satu-satunya pelindung gaibnya karena Zhu Bajie dan Sha Wujing belum sepenuhnya berkembang.
description.en: In the Song dynasty storyteller's prompt-book he is called the Monkey Pilgrim, approaches Xuanzang of his own accord, and is his sole magical protector since Zhu Bajie and Sha Wujing were not yet fully developed.

title.en: Birth and crowning as Monkey King

summary.id: Kera batu lahir dari telur batu, memasuki air terjun yang menyembunyikan gua, dan diangkat menjadi raja kera dengan nama Raja Kera Tampan.
summary.en: The stone monkey is born from a stone egg, enters the waterfall hiding a cave, and is made king of the monkeys as the Handsome Monkey King.

title.en: Learning magic and receiving his name

summary.id: Ia meninggalkan gunung mencari keabadian, menerima nama dharma Sun Wukong, dan menguasai 72 perubahan wujud serta salto awan.
summary.en: He leaves the mountain to seek immortality, receives the dharma name Sun Wukong, and masters the 72 transformations and the cloud somersault.

summary.id: Setelah diberi jabatan pengurus kuda dan penjaga kebun persik, Wukong memberontak melawan surga dan mengalahkan pasukan langit.
summary.en: After being made keeper of the horses and guardian of the peach garden, Wukong rebels against heaven and defeats its armies.

role.en: The one who loses the wager

summary.id: Wukong bertaruh dengan Buddha, tidak mampu keluar dari telapak tangannya, dan ditindih di bawah Gunung Lima Unsur.
summary.en: Wukong wagers with the Buddha, fails to leave his palm, and is pressed beneath the Five Elements Mountain.

summary.id: Lima ratus tahun kemudian ia menemani Tang Sanzang bersama Zhu Bajie dan Sha Heshang, dan di akhir novel menjadi Buddha Pemenang Pertempuran.
summary.en: Five hundred years later he accompanies Tang Sanzang with Zhu Bajie and Sha Heshang, and at the end of the novel becomes the Buddha Victorious in Fighting.

statement.id: Journey to the West (Xiyouji) adalah novel Tiongkok yang terbit pada abad ke-16 pada masa dinasti Ming dan dikaitkan dengan Wu Cheng'en.
statement.en: Journey to the West (Xiyouji) is a Chinese novel published in the 16th century during the Ming dynasty and attributed to Wu Cheng'en.

claims.quote: The beginning part of the story deals with the earlier exploits of Sun Wukong, a monkey born on Flower Fruit Mountain from a stone egg that forms from an ancient rock created by the coupling of Heaven and Earth, who learns the art of the Tao, 72 polymorphic transformations, combat, and secrets of immortality

statement.id: Bagian awal novel menceritakan petualangan awal Sun Wukong, seekor kera yang lahir di Gunung Bunga dan Buah (Flower Fruit Mountain) dari telur batu, yang mempelajari Tao, 72 transformasi, ilmu tempur, dan rahasia keabadian.
statement.en: The opening part of the novel deals with the early exploits of Sun Wukong, a monkey born on Flower Fruit Mountain from a stone egg, who learns the Tao, 72 transformations, combat, and the secrets of immortality.

claims.quote: also known as the Monkey King, is a literary and religious figure best known as one of the main characters in the 16th-century Chinese novel Journey to the West.

statement.id: Sun Wukong, juga dikenal sebagai Raja Kera (Monkey King), adalah tokoh sastra dan keagamaan yang paling dikenal sebagai salah satu tokoh utama novel Tiongkok abad ke-16 Journey to the West.
statement.en: Sun Wukong, also known as the Monkey King, is a literary and religious figure best known as one of the main characters of the 16th-century Chinese novel Journey to the West.

claims.quote: In the novel, Sun Wukong is an intelligent monkey (likely a rhesus macaque or a golden snub-nosed monkey) born from a stone who acquires supernatural powers through Taoist practices and consuming heavenly victuals.

statement.id: Dalam novel, Sun Wukong adalah kera cerdas (kemungkinan rhesus makaka atau monyet hidung pesek emas) yang lahir dari batu dan memperoleh kekuatan gaib lewat latihan Tao serta makanan surgawi.
statement.en: In the novel Sun Wukong is an intelligent monkey (likely a rhesus macaque or a golden snub-nosed monkey) born from a stone who gains supernatural powers through Taoist practice and heavenly food.

claims.quote: After rebelling against heaven, he is imprisoned under a mountain by the Buddha. Five hundred years later, he accompanies the monk Tang Sanzang riding on the White Dragon Horse and two other disciples, Zhu Bajie and Sha Heshang, on a journey to obtain Buddhist sutras in the West or Western Paradise, where Buddha and his followers dwell.

statement.id: Setelah memberontak melawan surga, ia dipenjara di bawah gunung oleh Buddha. Lima ratus tahun kemudian ia menemani biksu Tang Sanzang, yang menunggang White Dragon Horse, bersama dua murid lain, Zhu Bajie dan Sha Heshang, mengambil sutra Buddha di Barat.
statement.en: After rebelling against heaven he is imprisoned under a mountain by the Buddha. Five hundred years later he accompanies the monk Tang Sanzang, who rides the White Dragon Horse, with two other disciples, Zhu Bajie and Sha Heshang, to obtain Buddhist sutras in the West.

claims.quote: Sun Wukong possesses many abilities. He has supernatural strength and is able to support the weight of two heavy mountains on his shoulders

statement.id: Sun Wukong memiliki banyak kemampuan, antara lain kekuatan supernatural; ia mampu memikul beban dua gunung berat di bahunya.
statement.en: Sun Wukong has many abilities, including supernatural strength; he can support the weight of two heavy mountains on his shoulders.

claims.quote: Sun Wukong acquires the 72 Earthly Transformations, which allow him to access 72 unique powers, including the ability to transform into animals and objects.

statement.id: Sun Wukong memperoleh 72 Transformasi Duniawi, yang memberinya 72 kekuatan unik, termasuk kemampuan berubah menjadi hewan dan benda.
statement.en: Sun Wukong acquires the 72 Earthly Transformations, which give him 72 unique powers, including the ability to transform into animals and objects.

claims.quote: The ability, oft portrayed as Wukong riding a nimbus-like cloud, requires a magic hand sign, an oral spell, a fist clench, and a body shake. Wukong's master Puti Zushi taught this ability to the monkey to give him a style of flying that complements his penchant for jumping.

statement.id: Kemampuan salto awan sering digambarkan sebagai Wukong menunggang awan; guru Puti Zushi mengajarkannya agar Wukong memiliki cara terbang yang cocok dengan kegemarannya melompat.
statement.en: The cloud somersault is often portrayed as Wukong riding a cloud; his master Puti Zushi taught it to give him a style of flying suited to his love of jumping.

claims.quote: Sun Wukong is said to have gained immortality through nine different means and instances, which together made him one of the most immortal and invincible beings in all of creation.

statement.id: Sun Wukong dikatakan memperoleh keabadian lewat sembilan cara dan peristiwa berbeda, yang menjadikannya salah satu makhluk paling abadi dan kebal di seluruh ciptaan.
statement.en: Sun Wukong is said to have gained immortality through nine different means and instances, making him one of the most immortal and invincible beings in all of creation.

claims.quote: a magical circlet which, once the Monkey King is tricked into putting it on, can never be removed. When Tang Sanzang chants a certain sutra, the band will tighten and cause an unbearable headache.

statement.id: Guanyin memberi Tang Sanzang sebuah lingkaran gaib dari Buddha yang tidak dapat dilepas setelah Raja Kera dibujuk memakainya; saat Tang Sanzang melafalkan sutra tertentu, lingkaran itu mengetat dan menimbulkan sakit kepala tak tertahankan.
statement.en: Guanyin gives Tang Sanzang a magical circlet from the Buddha that can never be removed once the Monkey King is tricked into wearing it; when Tang Sanzang chants a certain sutra the band tightens and causes an unbearable headache.

claims.quote: The surname Sūn was given as an in-joke about the monkey, as monkeys are also called húsūn (猢猻), and can mean either a literal or a figurative monkey (or a macaque).

statement.id: Marga Sūn diberikan sebagai lelucon tentang kera, karena kera juga disebut húsūn (猢猻), kata yang dapat berarti kera secara harfiah maupun kiasan.
statement.en: The surname Sūn was given as an in-joke about the monkey, since monkeys are also called húsūn (猢猻), a word that can mean a monkey literally or figuratively.

claims.quote: The given name, Wùkōng, means "awakened to emptiness", sometimes translated as "aware of vacuity".

statement.id: Nama pemberian Wùkōng berarti "tersadar akan kekosongan", kadang diterjemahkan "sadar akan kehampaan".
statement.en: The given name Wùkōng means "awakened to emptiness", sometimes translated as "aware of vacuity".

claims.quote: Son Gokū in Japanese, Sonogong in Korean ... Tôn Ngộ Không in Vietnamese, Sung Ghokong or Sung Gokhong in Javanese, Sun Ngokong in Thai, Wu Khone in Burmese, and Sun Gokong in Malay.

statement.id: Nama Sun Wukong dilafalkan Son Gokū dalam bahasa Jepang, Tôn Ngộ Không dalam bahasa Vietnam, Sung Ghokong atau Sung Gokhong dalam bahasa Jawa, dan Sun Gokong dalam bahasa Melayu, di antara bahasa lain.
statement.en: Sun Wukong is pronounced Son Gokū in Japanese, Tôn Ngộ Không in Vietnamese, Sung Ghokong or Sung Gokhong in Javanese and Sun Gokong in Malay, among other languages.

claims.quote: The earliest known literary prototype of Sun Wukong appears in the Song dynasty (960–1279) storyteller's prompt-book Poetic Tale of Tripitaka of the Great Tang Fetching Scriptures (大唐三藏取經詩話). In this 17-chapter text, the character is known as the "Monkey Pilgrim" (猴行者, Hou Xingzhe).

statement.id: Prototipe sastra tertua yang diketahui dari Sun Wukong muncul dalam buku pegangan juru cerita dinasti Song (960–1279), Poetic Tale of Tripitaka of the Great Tang Fetching Scriptures, teks 17 bab yang menyebutnya "Monkey Pilgrim" (猴行者, Hou Xingzhe).
statement.en: The earliest known literary prototype of Sun Wukong appears in a Song dynasty (960–1279) storyteller's prompt-book, Poetic Tale of Tripitaka of the Great Tang Fetching Scriptures, a 17-chapter text that calls him the "Monkey Pilgrim" (猴行者, Hou Xingzhe).

claims.quote: Unlike the Ming dynasty classic where the monkey is freed from under a mountain, the Monkey Pilgrim voluntarily approaches Xuanzang

statement.id: Berbeda dari novel dinasti Ming yang menceritakan kera dibebaskan dari bawah gunung, Monkey Pilgrim mendekati Xuanzang atas kehendaknya sendiri.
statement.en: Unlike the Ming dynasty classic, in which the monkey is freed from under a mountain, the Monkey Pilgrim approaches Xuanzang of his own accord.

claims.quote: Throughout the text, the Monkey Pilgrim serves as Xuanzang's sole magical protector, as the characters of Zhu Bajie (Pigsy) and Sha Wujing (Sandy) had not yet been fully developed as fellow disciples.

statement.id: Dalam teks itu, Monkey Pilgrim menjadi satu-satunya pelindung gaib Xuanzang, karena tokoh Zhu Bajie (Pigsy) dan Sha Wujing (Sandy) belum dikembangkan sepenuhnya sebagai sesama murid.
statement.en: In that text the Monkey Pilgrim is Xuanzang's sole magical protector, since the characters of Zhu Bajie (Pigsy) and Sha Wujing (Sandy) had not yet been fully developed as fellow disciples.

claims.quote: Hu Shih first suggested that Wu Cheng'en may have been influenced by the Hindu deity Hanuman from the Ramayana in his depictions of the Monkey King.

statement.id: Hu Shih pertama kali mengusulkan bahwa Wu Cheng'en mungkin dipengaruhi dewa Hindu Hanuman dari Ramayana dalam penggambarannya tentang Raja Kera.
statement.en: Hu Shih first suggested that Wu Cheng'en may have been influenced by the Hindu deity Hanuman of the Ramayana in his depictions of the Monkey King.

claims.quote: Instead, Lu Xun suggested the 9th-century Chinese deity Wuzhiqi, who appears as a sibling of Sun Wukong in older Yuan dynasty stories, as the inspiration.

statement.id: Sebaliknya, Lu Xun mengusulkan dewa Tiongkok abad ke-9 Wuzhiqi, yang muncul sebagai saudara Sun Wukong dalam kisah dinasti Yuan yang lebih tua, sebagai sumber inspirasinya.
statement.en: Instead, Lu Xun suggested the 9th-century Chinese deity Wuzhiqi, who appears as a sibling of Sun Wukong in older Yuan dynasty stories, as the inspiration.

claims.quote: According to Li, the Monkey King in the final novel combines two separate folklore traditions that merged during the Yuan dynasty (1271–1368).

statement.id: Menurut Li Tianfei, Raja Kera dalam novel akhir menggabungkan dua tradisi cerita rakyat terpisah yang bersatu pada masa dinasti Yuan (1271–1368).
statement.en: According to Li Tianfei, the Monkey King of the final novel combines two separate folklore traditions that merged during the Yuan dynasty (1271–1368).

claims.quote: In parts of southern China, including Sichuan, Fujian, and Guangdong, local folklore featured powerful ape spirits that were worshipped and given titles such as "Great Sage Equal to Heaven" (齐天大圣).

statement.id: Di beberapa bagian Tiongkok selatan, termasuk Sichuan, Fujian, dan Guangdong, cerita rakyat setempat memuat roh kera perkasa yang dipuja dan diberi gelar seperti "Great Sage Equal to Heaven" (齐天大圣).
statement.en: In parts of southern China, including Sichuan, Fujian and Guangdong, local folklore featured powerful ape spirits that were worshipped and given titles such as "Great Sage Equal to Heaven" (齐天大圣).

claims.quote: He forms a brotherhood called the Seven Sages (七聖) with the Bull Demon King (牛魔王), the Saurian Demon King (蛟魔王), the Roc Demon King (鵬魔王), the Lion Spirit King (獅狔王), the Macaque Spirit King (獼猴王), and the snub-nosed monkey Spirit King (禺狨王).

statement.id: Ia membentuk persaudaraan bernama Tujuh Resi (Seven Sages, 七聖) dengan Bull Demon King (牛魔王) serta raja-raja siluman lain, antara lain Raja Roc dan Raja Singa.
statement.en: He forms a brotherhood called the Seven Sages (七聖) with the Bull Demon King (牛魔王) and other spirit kings, among them the Roc Demon King and the Lion Spirit King.

claims.quote: Guanyin suggests the Jade Emperor's nephew Erlang Shen fight Wukong. Wukong and Erlang are evenly matched and eventually, both turn into terrifying figures, which scares Wukong's monkey army away.

statement.id: Guanyin menyarankan Erlang Shen, keponakan Kaisar Giok, melawan Wukong; Wukong dan Erlang sama kuat; keduanya akhirnya berubah menjadi sosok menakutkan yang membuat pasukan kera Wukong lari ketakutan.
statement.en: Guanyin suggests the Jade Emperor's nephew Erlang Shen fight Wukong; Wukong and Erlang are evenly matched and eventually both turn into terrifying figures, which scares Wukong's monkey army away.

claims.quote: Sun Wukong defeats the Army of Heaven's 100,000 celestial warriors, the 28 constellations and the Four Heavenly Kings, under the command of Devaraja Li and his third son, Princes Nezha, despite the Heavenly weapons used against him.

statement.id: Sun Wukong mengalahkan 100.000 prajurit langit Army of Heaven, 28 rasi bintang, dan Empat Raja Surgawi di bawah komando Devaraja Li dan putra ketiganya, Nezha.
statement.en: Sun Wukong defeats the Army of Heaven's 100,000 celestial warriors, the 28 constellations and the Four Heavenly Kings, under the command of Devaraja Li and his third son Nezha.

claims.quote: His fellow spiritual primates are the Six-Eared Macaque (六耳獼猴), who is one of his antagonists in the main storyline

statement.id: Sesama primata rohani Wukong antara lain Six-Eared Macaque (六耳獼猴), yang menjadi salah satu lawannya dalam alur utama.
statement.en: Wukong's fellow spiritual primates include the Six-Eared Macaque (六耳獼猴), who is one of his antagonists in the main storyline.

claims.quote: The brief satirical novel Xiyoubu (西遊補; "Supplement to the Journey to the West"), c. 1640, follows Sun Wukong as he is trapped in a magical dream world created by the Qing Fish Demon, the embodiment of desire

statement.id: Novel satir pendek Xiyoubu (sekitar 1640) mengisahkan Sun Wukong terjebak di dunia mimpi gaib ciptaan Qing Fish Demon, perwujudan keinginan.
statement.en: The brief satirical novel Xiyoubu (c. 1640) follows Sun Wukong trapped in a magical dream world created by the Qing Fish Demon, the embodiment of desire.

claims.quote: A Chinese Odyssey is a fantasy comedy film made in Hong Kong 1995.

statement.id: A Chinese Odyssey adalah film komedi fantasi yang dibuat di Hong Kong pada 1995.
statement.en: A Chinese Odyssey is a fantasy comedy film made in Hong Kong in 1995.

claims.quote: Martial Arts Superstar Donnie Yen plays Sun Wukong in the 2014 movie The Monkey King

statement.id: Donnie Yen memerankan Sun Wukong dalam film The Monkey King tahun 2014.
statement.en: Donnie Yen plays Sun Wukong in the 2014 movie The Monkey King.

claims.quote: The character of Son Goku in Dragon Ball is based on Sun Wukong, as attested by his monkey tail, staff, flying cloud, and name

statement.id: Tokoh Son Goku dalam Dragon Ball didasarkan pada Sun Wukong, terlihat dari ekor kera, tongkat, awan terbang, dan namanya.
statement.en: The character Son Goku in Dragon Ball is based on Sun Wukong, as shown by his monkey tail, staff, flying cloud and name.

claims.quote: The character of Monkey in the 1978 Japanese television series Monkey is based on Sun Wukong.

statement.id: Tokoh Monkey dalam serial televisi Jepang Monkey tahun 1978 didasarkan pada Sun Wukong.
statement.en: The character Monkey in the 1978 Japanese television series Monkey is based on Sun Wukong.

claims.quote: Sun Wu Kung. A monkey who personates the irrepressible human mind, the discoverer, the inventive genius, full of resource

statement.id: Dalam pengantar terjemahannya tahun 1913, Timothy Richard menulis bahwa Sun Wu Kung adalah kera yang melambangkan pikiran manusia yang tak terkendali, sang penemu, jenius pencipta yang penuh akal.
statement.en: In the introduction to his 1913 translation, Timothy Richard writes that Sun Wu Kung is a monkey who personates the irrepressible human mind, the discoverer, the inventive genius, full of resource.

claims.quote: On a certain day it split open and produced a stone egg, round like a big ball. After exposure to the air, this was transformed into a stone monkey with the five senses of the body complete, and able to creep and run.

statement.id: Dalam terjemahan Richard (1913), suatu hari batu hidup itu terbelah dan menghasilkan telur batu bundar; setelah terkena udara, telur itu menjadi kera batu dengan kelima indra lengkap dan mampu merayap serta berlari.
statement.en: In Richard's 1913 translation, one day the living stone split open and produced a round stone egg; after exposure to the air it became a stone monkey with the five senses complete, able to creep and run.

claims.quote: the Master orders some very difficult work to be done, and the Monkey hesitates, the spikes enter into his head and give great pain.

statement.id: Richard menjelaskan bahwa topi berduri yang dipakai Kera menusuk kepalanya dan menimbulkan sakit hebat bila Sang Guru memerintahkan pekerjaan sulit dan Kera ragu.
statement.en: Richard explains that the hat of spikes worn by the Monkey pricks his head and gives great pain when the Master orders some very difficult work and the Monkey hesitates.

claims.quote: 內育仙胞，一日迸裂，產一石卵，似圓毬樣大。因見風，化作一個石猴，五官俱備，四肢皆全。

statement.id: Dalam teks asli novel (bab 1), sebuah batu yang mengandung "kantong gaib" pecah pada suatu hari dan melahirkan telur batu sebesar bola; terkena angin, telur itu menjadi kera batu dengan panca indra dan keempat anggota badan lengkap.
statement.en: In the original text (chapter 1), a stone holding an immortal "womb" split open one day and produced a stone egg the size of a ball; touched by the wind it became a stone monkey with all five senses and four limbs complete.

claims.quote: 眾猴聽說，即拱伏無違，一個個序齒排班，朝上禮拜，都稱「千歲大王」。自此，石猿高登王位，將「石」字兒隱了，遂稱「美猴王」。

statement.id: Para kera memberi hormat dan menyebutnya "千歲大王"; kera batu itu pun naik takhta, menanggalkan kata "batu" dari namanya, dan disebut Raja Kera Tampan (美猴王).
statement.en: The monkeys bow and hail him as "千歲大王"; the stone ape then ascends the throne, drops the word "stone" from his name, and is called the Handsome Monkey King (美猴王).

claims.quote: 美猴王領一群猿猴、獼猴、馬猴等，分派了君臣佐使。朝遊花果山，暮宿水簾洞

statement.id: Raja Kera Tampan memimpin sekelompok kera dan monyet; mereka berkelana di Gunung Bunga dan Buah (花果山) pada siang hari dan bermalam di Gua Tirai Air (水簾洞) pada malam hari.
statement.en: The Handsome Monkey King led a troop of apes and monkeys; by day they roamed Flower Fruit Mountain (花果山) and by night they lodged in the Water Curtain Cave (水簾洞).

claims.quote: 我明日就辭汝等下山，雲遊海角，遠涉天涯，務必訪此三者，學一個不老長生，常躲過閻君之難。

statement.id: Raja Kera memutuskan turun gunung, mengembara jauh untuk mencari tiga golongan makhluk yang luput dari kematian, agar belajar hidup abadi dan menghindari bencana dari Raja Yama.
statement.en: The Monkey King resolves to leave the mountain and wander far to find the three kinds of beings who escape death, so as to learn ageless long life and avoid the hardship of King Yama.

claims.quote: 祖師道：「乃廣、大、智、慧、真、如、性、海、穎、悟、圓、覺十二字。排到你，正當『悟』字。與你起個法名叫做『孫悟空』，好麼？」猴王笑道：「好！好！好！自今就叫做孫悟空也。」

statement.id: Sang guru (祖師) berkata bahwa urutan dua belas aksara nama perguruannya jatuh pada aksara "悟" bagi si kera, lalu memberinya nama dharma "孫悟空"; si kera menerimanya dengan gembira.
statement.en: The patriarch (祖師) says that in his school's sequence of twelve characters the monkey's turn falls on the character "悟", and gives him the dharma name "孫悟空", which the monkey gladly accepts.

claims.quote: 你身軀雖是鄙陋，卻像個食松果的猢猻。我與你就身上取個姓氏，意思教你姓『猢』。猢字去了個獸傍，乃是個古月。古者，老也；月者，陰也。老陰不能化育，教你姓『猻』倒好。猻字去了獸傍，乃是個子系。子者，兒男也；系者。嬰細也，正合嬰兒之本論。教你姓『孫』罷。

statement.id: Sang guru menilai tubuh si kera buruk tetapi mirip kera pemakan buah pinus, lalu memberinya marga "孫" setelah membahas aksara 猢 dan 猻.
statement.en: The patriarch says the monkey's body is unlovely yet like a pine-nut-eating macaque (猢猻), and after discussing the characters 猢 and 猻 gives him the surname "孫".

claims.quote: 這猴王也是他一竅通時百竅通，當時習了口訣，自修自煉，將七十二般變化都學成了。

statement.id: Dalam bab 2, si Raja Kera menguasai satu hal lalu seratus hal lain menyusul; ia mempelajari rumus lisan, berlatih sendiri, dan menguasai tujuh puluh dua perubahan wujud.
statement.en: In chapter 2 the Monkey King, once one opening is clear, finds a hundred open; he learns the oral formula, practises on his own, and masters the seventy-two transformations.

claims.quote: 這朵雲，捻著訣，念動真言，攢緊了拳，將身一抖，跳將起來，一觔斗就有十萬八千里路哩。

statement.id: Sang guru mengajarkan awan salto: dengan rumus tangan, mantra, kepalan, dan guncangan tubuh, sekali salto menempuh seratus delapan ribu li.
statement.en: The patriarch teaches the somersault cloud: with a hand sign, a spell, a clenched fist and a shake of the body, one somersault covers 108,000 li.

claims.quote: 悟空十分歡喜，拿出海藏看時，原來兩頭是兩個金箍，中間乃一段烏鐵。緊挨箍有鐫成的一行字，喚做：「如意金箍棒，重一萬三千五百斤。

statement.id: Dalam bab 3, senjata yang dipilih Wukong berujung dua gelang emas dengan batang besi hitam di tengah, bertuliskan "如意金箍棒" (tongkat gelang emas sesuka hati) seberat 13.500 kati.
statement.en: In chapter 3 the weapon Wukong takes has two gold bands at its ends and a length of black iron between them, inscribed "如意金箍棒" (Ruyi Jingu Bang), weighing 13,500 jin.

claims.quote: 玉帝傳旨道：「就除他做個弼馬溫罷。」眾臣叫謝恩，他也只朝上唱個大喏。玉帝又差木德星官送他去御馬監到任。

statement.id: Kaisar Giok menetapkan Wukong sebagai "弼馬溫" (pengurus kuda) dan mengirimnya ke istal kerajaan untuk menjabat.
statement.en: The Jade Emperor decrees that Wukong be made a "弼馬溫" (keeper of the horses) and sends him to the imperial stables to take up the post.

claims.quote: 就做個齊天大聖，有何不可？」猴王聞說，歡喜不勝，連道幾個「好！好！好！」教四健將：「就替我快置個旌旗，旗上寫『齊天大聖』四大字，立竿張掛。自此以後，只稱我為齊天大聖，不許再稱大王。

statement.id: Setelah menolak jabatan pengurus kuda, Wukong menyiapkan panji bertuliskan "齊天大聖" dan memerintahkan agar ia hanya disebut Sang Resi Setara Langit, bukan raja.
statement.en: After the horse-keeper post, a banner reading "齊天大聖" (Great Sage Equal to Heaven) is set up and Wukong orders that he be called by that title and no longer "king".

claims.quote: 朕見你身閑無事，與你件執事：你且權管那蟠桃園，早晚好生在意。

statement.id: Kaisar Giok menugaskan Wukong mengurus Kebun Persik Panjang Umur (蟠桃園) sementara waktu.
statement.en: The Jade Emperor assigns Wukong to take charge of the Peach Garden (蟠桃園) for the time being.

claims.quote: 佛祖道：「我與你打個賭賽：你若有本事，一觔斗打出我這右手掌中，算你贏

statement.id: Buddha menantang Wukong bertaruh: bila Wukong mampu sekali salto keluar dari telapak tangan kanannya, ia dianggap menang.
statement.en: The Buddha proposes a wager: if Wukong can somersault out of his right palm in a single leap, Wukong wins.

claims.quote: 被佛祖翻掌一撲，把這猴王推出西天門外，將五指化作金、木、水、火、土五座聯山，喚名「五行山」

statement.id: Buddha membalik telapak tangannya, mendorong Raja Kera keluar dari gerbang barat surga, dan mengubah lima jarinya menjadi lima gunung berantai bernama Gunung Lima Unsur (五行山).
statement.en: The Buddha turns his palm, pushes the Monkey King out of the West Heaven Gate, and turns his five fingers into five linked mountains called the Five Elements Mountain (五行山).

claims.quote: 孫悟空，汝因大鬧天宮，吾以甚深法力，壓在五行山下，幸天災滿足，歸於釋教；且喜汝隱惡揚善，在途中煉魔降怪有功，全終全始，加陞大職正果，汝為鬥戰勝佛。

statement.id: Di akhir novel, Buddha menyebut Sun Wukong pernah mengacau istana langit dan ditindih di bawah Gunung Lima Unsur; karena jasanya menaklukkan iblis di sepanjang jalan, ia dianugerahi gelar Buddha Pemenang Pertempuran (鬥戰勝佛).
statement.en: At the end of the novel the Buddha recalls that Sun Wukong made havoc in the heavenly palace and was pressed under the Five Elements Mountain, and for his merit in subduing demons along the way names him the Buddha Victorious in Fighting (鬥戰勝佛).

summary.id: Hu Shih mengusulkan pengaruh Hanuman dari Ramayana.
summary.en: Hu Shih suggested the influence of Hanuman of the Ramayana.

summary.id: Lu Xun mengusulkan dewa Wuzhiqi sebagai sumber inspirasi.
summary.en: Lu Xun suggested the deity Wuzhiqi as the inspiration.

summary.id: Li Tianfei berpendapat tokoh ini gabungan dua tradisi cerita rakyat yang menyatu pada masa Yuan.
summary.en: Li Tianfei argues the character combines two folklore traditions that merged in the Yuan dynasty.

gaps.searched: Sumber yang dibuka menggambarkan pemberontakan dan pengabdian sekaligus tanpa satu pernyataan sifat; dikosongkan.
Tidak ada sumber yang membandingkan secara eksplisit tradisi dan penggambaran modern.

Helen Hayes, The Buddhist Pilgrim's Progress (1930): tidak ditemukan teks daring yang bisa dibuka; sebagai gantinya dipakai terjemahan Timothy Richard 1913 (archive.org) dan teks Tionghoa asli di Wikisource. Britannica diblokir (403) dan worldhistory.org tidak merespons.

short_description.id: Wisnu, juga disebut Narayana dan Hari, adalah salah satu dewa utama agama Hindu, Yang Mahatinggi dalam tradisi Waisnawa, dan Sang Pemelihara dalam Trimurti yang turun ke dunia sebagai awatara.
short_description.en: Vishnu, also called Narayana and Hari, is one of the principal deities of Hinduism, the Supreme Being in Vaishnavism and the Preserver within the Trimurti, who descends to the world as avatars.

long_description.id:
Wisnu, yang namanya berarti Yang Meliputi Segala, juga dikenal sebagai Narayana dan Hari, adalah salah satu dewa utama agama Hindu. Ia Yang Mahatinggi dalam tradisi Waisnawa, salah satu tradisi besar agama Hindu masa kini, dan dewa pemeliharaan. Dalam Trimurti, yang juga mencakup Brahma dan Siwa, Wisnu dikenal sebagai Sang Pemelihara, dan Lakshmi adalah pasangannya.

Dalam aspek welas asihnya, Wisnu digambarkan sebagai makhluk mahatahu yang berbaring di atas lilitan ular Sesha di samudra susu purba, Kshira Sagara, bersama pasangannya, Lakshmi. Setiap kali dunia terancam kejahatan dan kekacauan, Wisnu turun dalam wujud awatara untuk memulihkan tatanan kosmis dan melindungi dharma. Dashavatara adalah sepuluh awatara utamanya, dan dari kesepuluhnya Rama dan Kresna paling banyak dipuja.

Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Wisnu memiliki sepuluh awatara, berupa manusia, hewan, atau campuran keduanya. Dalam wujud Kurma ia menopang gunung saat samudra diaduk, lalu menjelma Maya yang jelita untuk membuat para raksasa melepaskan nektar kepada para dewa. Sebagai Varaha ia mengangkat Bumi dari dasar laut setelah bertarung seribu tahun, sebagai Matsya ia membawa kapal bagi Manu, sebagai Vamana ia melintasi langit, Bumi, dan Dunia Bawah dengan tiga langkah, dan sebagai manusia-singa Nara-Simha ia menjawab tantangan Hiranya-Kasipu. Wisnu Purana menambahkan bahwa Hari sendiri, sebagai kura-kura di Lautan Susu, menopang tongkat pengaduk.

Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Wisnu paling sering digambarkan berwarna biru, kadang menunggang Garuda, dan bersenjatakan cakram Sudarsanacakra; di keempat tangannya ia sering memegang kerang, gada atau pedang, dan teratai. Ia dianggap tinggal di kota Vaikuntha di Gunung Meru, dan dikaitkan dengan matahari lewat nama Surya Narayana. Wisnu Purana menggambarkannya duduk di atas Garuda dengan kerang, cakram, dan gada, serta menyebut Janārddana sebagai pencipta, pemelihara, dan pelebur alam semesta.

Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Wisnu adalah dewa terpenting Waisnawa, sekte Hindu terbesar, dan ia memiliki tiga istri: Lakshmi, Sarasvati, dan Ganga, dua yang terakhir akhirnya ia kirim kepada Brahma dan Siwa. Menurut Wikipedia, arca Wisnu berlengan empat dari abad ke-4 hingga ke-9 ditemukan di Thailand dan mirip dengan arca di India kuno, dan sebagian kuil Wisnu besar tertua di India berasal dari masa Kekaisaran Gupta.
long_description.en:
Vishnu, whose name means the All-Pervasive, is also called Narayana and Hari and ranks among the chief gods of Hinduism. Vaishnavism, one of the great Hindu traditions today, reveres him as the highest being and god of preservation. In the Trimurti, with Brahma and Shiva, he is the Preserver, and Lakshmi is his partner.

In his benevolent aspects Vishnu is depicted as an omniscient being lying on the coils of the serpent Shesha in the primeval ocean of milk, Kshira Sagara, with his consort Lakshmi. Whenever the world is threatened by evil and chaos, Vishnu descends as an avatar to restore cosmic order and protect dharma. The Dashavatara are his ten primary avatars, of whom Rama and Krishna are the most worshipped.

According to the World History Encyclopedia, Vishnu has ten avatars, as people, animals or a mix of both. As Kurma he held up the mountain while the ocean was churned and then became the beautiful Maya so that the demons would give up the nectar to the gods. As Varaha he raised the Earth from the sea bottom after a thousand-year fight, as Matsya he carried a ship for Manu, as Vamana he crossed the world in three steps, and as the man-lion Nara-Simha he answered Hiranya-Kasipu's challenge. The Vishnu Purana adds that Hari himself, as a tortoise in the Milky sea, supported the churning-stick.

According to the World History Encyclopedia, Vishnu is most often depicted coloured blue, sometimes rides Garuda and bears the Sudarsanacakra discus; in his four hands he often holds a conch, a mace or sword, and a lotus. He is considered to dwell in the city of Vaikuntha on Mt. Meru and is linked with the sun through the name Surya Narayana. The Vishnu Purana shows him seated on Garuda with the shell, discus and mace, and calls Janārddana the creator, preserver and destroyer of the universe.

According to the World History Encyclopedia, Vishnu is the foremost god of Vaishnavism, which it describes as the largest Hindu sect, and has three wives, Lakshmi, Sarasvati and Ganga, the latter two eventually sent to Brahma and Shiva. According to Wikipedia, statues of four-armed Vishnu from the 4th to 9th century have been found in Thailand and mirror those of ancient India, and some of the earliest surviving grand Vishnu temples in India date from the Gupta Empire period.

summary.id: Para dewa dan raksasa mengaduk samudra dengan Gunung Mandara dan ular Vasuki sebagai tali, tetapi tidak sanggup menahan gunung itu, sehingga Wisnu menopangnya sebagai kura-kura Kurma. Wisnu Purana juga menyebut Hari sendiri, sebagai kura-kura di Lautan Susu, menjadi penopang tongkat pengaduk.
summary.en: The gods and demons churned the ocean with Mount Mandara and the serpent Vasuki as a rope but could not handle the mountain, so Vishnu held it up as the tortoise Kurma. He then became Maya to take the nectar from the demons and give it to the gods. The Vishnu Purana likewise says that Hari himself, as a tortoise in the Milky sea, became the support of the churning-stick.

summary.en: As the gigantic boar Varaha, Vishnu fought the giant Daitya for a thousand years after Hiranyaksha took the Earth to the bottom of the sea, then raised the Earth on his tusk.

Manu, the sage and son of Vivsavat-Sun, was washing in a river one day when a small fish suddenly jumped into his hand. ... Vishnu then reappeared on the scene as the gigantic fish, this time with golden scales and a single horn, and carrying the promised ship for Manu.

claim.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Vishnu confronted the giant warrior Bali as a dwarf Brahman called Vamana; with his first step he cleared the sky, with the second the Earth and with the last the Underworld, leaving nothing for the giants.

claims_provenance.quote: Vishnu was persuaded by the gods to interrupt his meditations and confront the giant warrior Bali, which he did in the form of a dwarf Brahman (or priest) called Vamana. ... with his first step he cleared the sky, with the second the Earth and, with his final step, the Underworld, thus leaving nothing for the poor giants.

claims_provenance.quote: Vishnu appeared as the man-lion Nara-Simha when Hiranya-Kasipu (King of the Asuras or Demons) not only impiously called for people to worship him as a god but also foolishly challenged Vishnu to show himself there and then if the god really were omnipresent.

claim.id: Dalam Wisnu Purana, apa pun yang dilahirkan makhluk hidup dianggap bagian Hari, dan apa pun yang membinasakan makhluk dianggap bagian Janārddana sebagai Rudra; dengan demikian Janārddana adalah pencipta, pemelihara, dan pelebur alam semesta.
claim.en: In the Vishnu Purana, whatever is generated by a living being is considered a portion of Hari, and whatever destroys a living being the destroying portion of Janārddana as Rudra; in this way Janārddana is the creator, preserver and destroyer of the universe.

claims_provenance.quote: Whatever is generated by any living being, O twice-born one—the agent is considered as a portion of Hari. And whatever destroys any living being, moveable or immoveable, is considered as the destroying portion of Janārddana as Rudra. In this wise Janārddana is the creator, preserver and destroyer of the universe.

summary.id: Para dewa dan raksasa mengaduk samudra dengan Gunung Mandara dan ular Vasuki sebagai tali, tetapi tidak sanggup menahan gunung itu, sehingga Wisnu menopangnya sebagai kura-kura Kurma. Ia kemudian menjelma Maya untuk mengambil nektar dari para raksasa dan memberikannya kepada para dewa. Wisnu Purana juga menyebut Hari sendiri, sebagai kura-kura di Lautan Susu, menjadi penopang tongkat pengaduk.
summary.en: The gods and demons churned the ocean with Mount Mandara and the serpent Vasuki as a rope but could not handle the mountain, so Vishnu held it up as the tortoise Kurma. He then became Maya to take the nectar from the demons and give it to the gods. The Vishnu Purana likewise says that Hari himself, as a tortoise in the Milky sea, became the support of the churning-stick.

short_description.id: Wisnu, juga disebut Narayana dan Hari, adalah salah satu dewa utama agama Hindu, Yang Mahatinggi dalam tradisi Waisnawa, dan Sang Pemelihara dalam Trimurti yang turun ke dunia sebagai awatara.
short_description.en: Vishnu, also called Narayana and Hari, is one of the principal deities of Hinduism, the Supreme Being in Vaishnavism and the Preserver within the Trimurti, who descends to the world as avatars.

long_description.id: Wisnu, yang namanya berarti Yang Meliputi Segala, juga dikenal sebagai Narayana dan Hari, adalah salah satu dewa utama agama Hindu. Ia Yang Mahatinggi dalam tradisi Waisnawa, salah satu tradisi besar agama Hindu masa kini, dan dewa pemeliharaan. Dalam Trimurti, yang juga mencakup Brahma dan Siwa, Wisnu dikenal sebagai Sang Pemelihara, dan Lakshmi adalah pasangannya.
long_description.en: Vishnu, whose name means the All-Pervasive, is also called Narayana and Hari and ranks among the chief gods of Hinduism. Vaishnavism, one of the great Hindu traditions today, reveres him as the highest being and god of preservation. In the Trimurti, with Brahma and Shiva, he is the Preserver, and Lakshmi is his partner.

long_description.id: Dalam aspek welas asihnya, Wisnu digambarkan sebagai makhluk mahatahu yang berbaring di atas lilitan ular Sesha di samudra susu purba, Kshira Sagara, bersama pasangannya, Lakshmi. Setiap kali dunia terancam kejahatan dan kekacauan, Wisnu turun dalam wujud awatara untuk memulihkan tatanan kosmis dan melindungi dharma. Dashavatara adalah sepuluh awatara utamanya, dan dari kesepuluhnya Rama dan Kresna paling banyak dipuja.
long_description.en: In his benevolent aspects Vishnu is depicted as an omniscient being lying on the coils of the serpent Shesha in the primeval ocean of milk, Kshira Sagara, with his consort Lakshmi. Whenever the world is threatened by evil and chaos, Vishnu descends as an avatar to restore cosmic order and protect dharma. The Dashavatara are his ten primary avatars, of whom Rama and Krishna are the most worshipped.

long_description.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Wisnu memiliki sepuluh awatara, berupa manusia, hewan, atau campuran keduanya. Dalam wujud Kurma ia menopang gunung saat samudra diaduk, lalu menjelma Maya yang jelita untuk membuat para raksasa melepaskan nektar kepada para dewa. Sebagai Varaha ia mengangkat Bumi dari dasar laut setelah bertarung seribu tahun, sebagai Matsya ia membawa kapal bagi Manu, sebagai Vamana ia melintasi langit, Bumi, dan Dunia Bawah dengan tiga langkah, dan sebagai manusia-singa Nara-Simha ia menjawab tantangan Hiranya-Kasipu. Wisnu Purana menambahkan bahwa Hari sendiri, sebagai kura-kura di Lautan Susu, menopang tongkat pengaduk.
long_description.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Vishnu has ten avatars, as people, animals or a mix of both. As Kurma he held up the mountain while the ocean was churned and then became the beautiful Maya so that the demons would give up the nectar to the gods. As Varaha he raised the Earth from the sea bottom after a thousand-year fight, as Matsya he carried a ship for Manu, as Vamana he crossed the world in three steps, and as the man-lion Nara-Simha he answered Hiranya-Kasipu's challenge. The Vishnu Purana adds that Hari himself, as a tortoise in the Milky sea, supported the churning-stick.

long_description.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Wisnu paling sering digambarkan berwarna biru, kadang menunggang Garuda, dan bersenjatakan cakram Sudarsanacakra; di keempat tangannya ia sering memegang kerang, gada atau pedang, dan teratai. Ia dianggap tinggal di kota Vaikuntha di Gunung Meru, dan dikaitkan dengan matahari lewat nama Surya Narayana. Wisnu Purana menggambarkannya duduk di atas Garuda dengan kerang, cakram, dan gada, serta menyebut Janārddana sebagai pencipta, pemelihara, dan pelebur alam semesta.
long_description.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Vishnu is most often depicted coloured blue, sometimes rides Garuda and bears the Sudarsanacakra discus; in his four hands he often holds a conch, a mace or sword, and a lotus. He is considered to dwell in the city of Vaikuntha on Mt. Meru and is linked with the sun through the name Surya Narayana. The Vishnu Purana shows him seated on Garuda with the shell, discus and mace, and calls Janārddana the creator, preserver and destroyer of the universe.

long_description.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Wisnu adalah dewa terpenting Waisnawa, sekte Hindu terbesar, dan ia memiliki tiga istri: Lakshmi, Sarasvati, dan Ganga, dua yang terakhir akhirnya ia kirim kepada Brahma dan Siwa. Menurut Wikipedia, arca Wisnu berlengan empat dari abad ke-4 hingga ke-9 ditemukan di Thailand dan mirip dengan arca di India kuno, dan sebagian kuil Wisnu besar tertua di India berasal dari masa Kekaisaran Gupta.
long_description.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Vishnu is the foremost god of Vaishnavism, which it describes as the largest Hindu sect, and has three wives, Lakshmi, Sarasvati and Ganga, the latter two eventually sent to Brahma and Shiva. According to Wikipedia, statues of four-armed Vishnu from the 4th to 9th century have been found in Thailand and mirror those of ancient India, and some of the earliest surviving grand Vishnu temples in India date from the Gupta Empire period.
