The Dashavatara are the ten primary avatars of Vishnu. Of these ten, Rama and Krishna are the most worshipped

statement.id: Setiap kali dunia terancam kejahatan dan kekacauan, Wisnu turun sebagai awatara untuk memulihkan tatanan kosmis dan melindungi dharma; Dashavatara adalah sepuluh awatara utamanya, dan Rama serta Kresna paling banyak dipuja.
statement.en: Whenever the world is threatened by evil and chaos, Vishnu descends as an avatar to restore cosmic order and protect dharma; the Dashavatara are his ten primary avatars, Rama and Krishna the most worshipped.

claims.quote: Vishnu (also spelled Viṣṇu, Sanskrit: विष्णु) means 'all pervasive'

statement.id: Nama Wisnu (विष्णु, juga ditulis Viṣṇu) berarti 'meliputi segala'.
statement.en: The name Vishnu (Sanskrit: विष्णु, also spelled Viṣṇu) means 'all pervasive'.

claims.quote: Vishnu is the Preserver and guardian of men, he protects the order of things (dharma), and he appears on earth in various incarnations (avatars) to fight demons and to maintain cosmic harmony.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Wisnu adalah pemelihara dan pelindung manusia yang menjaga dharma dan muncul di bumi dalam berbagai awatara untuk melawan raksasa.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Vishnu is the Preserver and guardian of humanity who protects dharma and appears on earth in various avatars to fight demons.

claims.quote: To mix the ocean they decided to use the holy Mt. Mandara with the giant serpent Vasuki (or Ananta) as a turning rope; one end to be pulled by Demons and the other by the gods. However, neither group could handle such a weight and they called for Vishnu to hold it. This he did in the form of Kurma, the giant tortoise, supporting the mountain on his shell.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, untuk mengaduk samudra para dewa dan raksasa memakai Gunung Mandara dengan ular raksasa Vasuki (atau Ananta) sebagai tali, tetapi tidak sanggup menahan bebannya sehingga memanggil Wisnu, yang menopang gunung itu di punggungnya dalam wujud Kurma, kura-kura raksasa.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, to churn the ocean the gods and demons used Mount Mandara with the giant serpent Vasuki (or Ananta) as a rope, but could not handle its weight and called on Vishnu, who held the mountain on his shell in the form of Kurma, the giant tortoise.

claims.quote: according to Medhātith (c. 1000 CE), 'one who is everything and inside everything'

statement.id: Menurut Medhātith (sekitar 1000 M), Wisnu berarti 'yang adalah segalanya dan berada di dalam segalanya'.
statement.en: According to Medhātith (c. 1000 CE), Vishnu means 'one who is everything and inside everything'.

claims.quote: In Thailand, for example, statues of four-armed Vishnu have been found in provinces near Malaysia and dated to be from the 4th to 9th-century, and this mirror those found in ancient India.

statement.id: Menurut Wikipedia, di Thailand ditemukan patung Wisnu berlengan empat di provinsi dekat Malaysia yang berasal dari abad ke-4 hingga ke-9, dan patung itu mirip dengan yang ditemukan di India kuno.
statement.en: According to Wikipedia, statues of four-armed Vishnu found in Thai provinces near Malaysia date from the 4th to 9th century and mirror those found in ancient India.

claims.quote: Some of the earliest surviving grand Vishnu temples in India have been dated to the Gupta Empire period.

statement.id: Menurut Wikipedia, sebagian kuil Wisnu besar tertua yang masih bertahan di India berasal dari masa Kekaisaran Gupta.
statement.en: According to Wikipedia, some of the earliest surviving grand Vishnu temples in India have been dated to the Gupta Empire period.

claims.quote: Vishnu is the most important god of Vaishnavism, the largest Hindu sect. Indeed, to illustrate Vishnu's superior status, Brahma is, in some accounts, considered to have been born from a lotus flower which grew from Vishnu's naval.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Wisnu adalah dewa terpenting Waisnawa, sekte Hindu terbesar; sebagai tanda kedudukannya yang unggul, dalam beberapa kisah Brahma dianggap lahir dari bunga teratai yang tumbuh dari pusar Wisnu.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Vishnu is the most important god of Vaishnavism, the largest Hindu sect; to illustrate his superior status, in some accounts Brahma is born from a lotus flower that grew from Vishnu's navel.

claims.quote: Vishnu was married to Lakshmi (the goddess of good fortune), Sarawati (the goddess of wisdom) and Ganga (the goddess who is the personification of the River Ganges). However, unable to live with the quarrels between his three wives, Vishnu eventually sent Ganga to Shiva and Sarawati to Brahma.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Wisnu menikah dengan Lakshmi (dewi keberuntungan), Sarasvati (dewi kebijaksanaan), dan Ganga (personifikasi Sungai Gangga), tetapi karena pertengkaran istri-istrinya ia mengirim Ganga kepada Siwa dan Sarasvati kepada Brahma.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Vishnu was married to Lakshmi (goddess of good fortune), Sarawati (goddess of wisdom) and Ganga (personification of the River Ganges), but unable to bear their quarrels he sent Ganga to Shiva and Sarawati to Brahma.

claims.quote: He is considered to live in the city of Vaikuntha on Mt. Meru, where everything is made of shining gold and fabulous jewels and where there are lakes resplendent with lotus flowers.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Wisnu dianggap tinggal di kota Vaikuntha di Gunung Meru, tempat segalanya terbuat dari emas berkilau dan permata, dengan danau-danau yang dipenuhi teratai.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Vishnu is considered to live in the city of Vaikuntha on Mt. Meru, where everything is made of shining gold and jewels and lakes are resplendent with lotus flowers.

claims.quote: Vishnu has ten avatars or worldly appearances, which are people, animals or a mix of both.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Wisnu memiliki sepuluh awatara atau penampakan duniawi, berupa manusia, hewan, atau campuran keduanya.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Vishnu has ten avatars or worldly appearances, which are people, animals or a mix of both.

claims.quote: As Varaha, the gigantic boar, he defeated the giant Daitya after Hiranyaksha had mischievously taken the Earth (Bhumi-devi) to the bottom of the sea. The incredible fight between the two lasted for a thousand years but Vishnu prevailed and finally raised the Earth from the watery depths, carrying it on his tusk.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, sebagai Varaha, babi hutan raksasa, Wisnu mengalahkan raksasa Daitya setelah Hiranyaksha membawa Bumi (Bhumi-devi) ke dasar laut; setelah pertarungan seribu tahun, Wisnu menang dan mengangkat Bumi dari kedalaman dengan taringnya.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, as Varaha, the gigantic boar, Vishnu defeated the giant Daitya after Hiranyaksha took the Earth (Bhumi-devi) to the bottom of the sea; after a fight lasting a thousand years Vishnu prevailed and raised the Earth from the depths on his tusk.

claims.quote: Fortunately, Vishnu interceded in the form of the beautiful Maya (the personification of Illusion) and, suitably distracted, the Demons relinquished the nectar which Vishnu graciously gave to the gods, allowing them the possibility of immortality.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Wisnu menjelma Maya yang jelita (personifikasi Ilusi) hingga para raksasa terpedaya dan melepaskan nektar, yang lalu ia berikan kepada para dewa sehingga mereka berpeluang hidup abadi.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Vishnu took the form of the beautiful Maya (the personification of Illusion), so that the distracted Demons relinquished the nectar, which he gave to the gods, allowing them the possibility of immortality.

claims.quote: Vishnu appears as another avatar in the form of the fish Matsya. Manu, the sage and son of Vivsavat-Sun, was washing in a river one day when a small fish suddenly jumped into his hand. ... Vishnu then reappeared on the scene as the gigantic fish, this time with golden scales and a single horn, and carrying the promised ship for Manu.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Wisnu muncul sebagai awatara ikan Matsya yang melompat ke tangan Manu; kelak ia tampil sebagai ikan raksasa bersisik emas dan bertanduk satu yang membawa kapal bagi Manu.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Vishnu appears as the avatar of the fish Matsya, who jumped into the hand of Manu; later he reappears as the gigantic fish with golden scales and a single horn carrying the promised ship for Manu.

claims.quote: Vishnu was persuaded by the gods to interrupt his meditations and confront the giant warrior Bali, which he did in the form of a dwarf Brahman (or priest) called Vamana. ... with his first step he cleared the sky, with the second the Earth and, with his final step, the Underworld, thus leaving nothing for the poor giants.
claims.locator: The Legend of the Three Steps

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Wisnu menghadapi pahlawan raksasa Bali dalam wujud brahmana kerdil bernama Vamana; dengan langkah pertama ia melintasi langit, dengan yang kedua Bumi, dan dengan yang terakhir Dunia Bawah, sehingga tak ada yang tersisa bagi para raksasa.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Vishnu confronted the giant warrior Bali as a dwarf Brahman called Vamana; with his first step he cleared the sky, with the second the Earth and with the last the Underworld, leaving nothing for the giants.

claims.quote: For this reason, Vishnu is often also called Trivikrama, meaning 'of the three steps'.
claims.locator: The Legend of the Three Steps

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Wisnu sering pula disebut Trivikrama, yang berarti 'yang bertiga langkah'.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Vishnu is often also called Trivikrama, meaning 'of the three steps'.

claims.quote: Vishnu appeared as the man-lion Nara-Simha when Hiranya-Kasipu (King of the Asuras or Demons) not only impiously called for people to worship him as a god but also foolishly challenged Vishnu to show himself there and then if the god really were omnipresent.
claims.locator: The Legend of the Three Steps

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Wisnu tampil sebagai manusia-singa Nara-Simha ketika Hiranya-Kasipu, Raja Asura, menyerukan agar orang menyembahnya sebagai dewa dan menantang Wisnu menunjukkan diri jika benar mahahadir.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Vishnu appeared as the man-lion Nara-Simha when Hiranya-Kasipu, King of the Asuras, called on people to worship him as a god and challenged Vishnu to show himself if he were really omnipresent.

claims.quote: he is most often depicted coloured blue and sometimes rides Garuda, a gigantic half-man, half-bird creature which devours snakes.
claims.locator: How is Vishnu Representated in Art?

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, dalam seni Hindu Wisnu paling sering digambarkan berwarna biru dan kadang menunggang Garuda, makhluk raksasa setengah manusia setengah burung yang memangsa ular.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, in Hindu art Vishnu is most often depicted coloured blue and sometimes rides Garuda, a gigantic half-man, half-bird creature that devours snakes.

claims.quote: His weapon is the Sudarsanacakra or discus (chakra), perhaps representative of his association with the sun but also, with its thousand spokes, symbolic of the wheel of time. He often holds various other objects in his (usually) four hands such as a conch shell trumpet which sounds the Creation, a mace (gada) or a sword which represents strength, and a lotus
claims.locator: How is Vishnu Representated in Art?

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, senjata Wisnu adalah cakram Sudarsanacakra, mungkin lambang kaitannya dengan matahari dan roda waktu; di keempat tangannya ia sering memegang kerang sangkakala penanda Penciptaan, gada atau pedang lambang kekuatan, dan teratai.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Vishnu's weapon is the Sudarsanacakra discus, perhaps representing his link with the sun and the wheel of time; in his usually four hands he often holds a conch shell trumpet that sounds the Creation, a mace or sword representing strength, and a lotus.

claims.quote: Certainly, Vishnu was associated with the sun, as one of his other names suggests - Surya Narayana.
claims.locator: The Legend of the Three Steps

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Wisnu dikaitkan dengan matahari, seperti ditunjukkan salah satu namanya yang lain, Surya Narayana.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Vishnu was associated with the sun, as one of his other names, Surya Narayana, suggests.

claims.quote: Whatever is generated by any living being, O twice-born one—the agent is considered as a portion of Hari. And whatever destroys any living being, moveable or immoveable, is considered as the destroying portion of Janārddana as Rudra. In this wise Janārddana is the creator, preserver and destroyer of the universe.

statement.id: Dalam Wisnu Purana, apa pun yang dilahirkan makhluk hidup dianggap bagian Hari, dan apa pun yang membinasakan makhluk dianggap bagian Janārddana sebagai Rudra; dengan demikian Janārddana adalah pencipta, pemelihara, dan pelebur alam semesta.
statement.en: In the Vishnu Purana, whatever is generated by a living being is considered a portion of Hari, and whatever destroys a living being the destroying portion of Janārddana as Rudra; in this way Janārddana is the creator, preserver and destroyer of the universe.

claims.quote: And, O mighty ascetic, remaining in the midst of the Milky sea in the shape of a tortoise, the revered Hari himself became the support of the churning-stick.
claims.locator: Vishnu Purana, Book I (Churning of the Milky sea)

statement.id: Dalam Wisnu Purana, Hari sendiri, dalam wujud kura-kura di tengah Lautan Susu, menjadi penopang tongkat pengaduk.
statement.en: In the Vishnu Purana, the revered Hari himself, in the shape of a tortoise in the midst of the Milky sea, became the support of the churning-stick.

claims.quote: Having thus recited the prayer the celestials beheld Hari the supreme lord of all, seated on Garuda, armed with the shell, the discus, and the mace.
claims.locator: Vishnu Purana, Book III (prayer of the celestials)

statement.id: Dalam Wisnu Purana, para dewa melihat Hari, penguasa tertinggi segalanya, duduk di atas Garuda dengan kerang, cakram, dan gada.
statement.en: In the Vishnu Purana, the celestials behold Hari, the supreme lord of all, seated on Garuda, armed with the shell, the discus and the mace.

short_description.id: Zeus adalah dewa tertinggi dalam jajaran dewa Yunani, dewa langit dan guntur yang memerintah sebagai raja para dewa di Gunung Olimpus dan menggenggam petir sebagai senjatanya.
short_description.en: Zeus is the supreme deity of the Greek pantheon, a sky and thunder god who rules as king of the gods on Mount Olympus and wields the lightning bolt as his weapon.

long_description.id:
Zeus adalah dewa tertinggi dalam jajaran dewa Yunani, dewa langit dan guntur dalam agama dan mitologi Yunani kuno yang memerintah sebagai raja para dewa di Gunung Olimpus. Menurut theoi.com, ia dewa langit, cuaca, hukum dan ketertiban, takdir, serta kekuasaan raja, digambarkan sebagai laki-laki dewasa berwibawa berjanggut gelap, dengan atribut petir, tongkat kerajaan, dan elang. Di Roma kuno, Zeus disamakan dengan Jupiter.

Zeus adalah putra Titan Kronos dan Rheia. Kronos menelan setiap anaknya begitu lahir, tetapi Rhea menyelamatkan Zeus dengan memberi Kronos sebuah batu berbalut kain. Menurut theoi.com, Zeus dibesarkan diam-diam di Gunung Dikte di Kreta dan diasuh para nimfa dengan susu kambing Amaltheia. Setelah dewasa ia merekrut dewi Metis, yang menyuguhkan ramuan ajaib kepada Kronos sehingga Kronos memuntahkan para dewa muda yang telah ditelannya.

Kekuasaannya diperoleh melalui perang. Menurut theoi.com, Zeus membebaskan para raksasa dari Tartaros, dipersenjatai petir oleh para Kyklopes, dan dibantu para Hekatonkheires mengalahkan Kronos dan para Titan. Zeus dan saudara-saudaranya lalu mengundi kekuasaan atas kosmos: Zeus mendapat langit, Poseidon laut, dan Haides dunia bawah. Ia kemudian menjatuhkan raja para Giant dengan petirnya, dan sempat dikalahkan Typhoeus sebelum Pan mencuri kembali kekuatannya sehingga Zeus menang dan mengurung raksasa itu di bawah Gunung Etna.

Dalam kebanyakan tradisi, Zeus menikah dengan Hera, saudarinya, yang menurut theoi.com ia rayu dalam rupa burung kukuk. Ia juga terkenal karena banyak petualangan cintanya, yang melahirkan banyak keturunan ilahi dan pahlawan, termasuk Apollo, Artemis, Hermes, Persephone, Dionysus, Perseus, dan Herakles; menurut theoi.com ia merayu banyak perempuan fana dalam berbagai samaran, seperti angsa untuk Leda dan banteng untuk Europa. Athena lahir dari Metis, yang ditelan Zeus setelah ramalan menyatakan putranya akan menggantikannya, dan keluar dari kepala Zeus.

Menurut theoi.com, atribut Zeus yang paling khas adalah petir yang ia genggam seperti lembing, disertai tongkat kerajaan, takhta, elang, Nike mini, dan aigis. Hewan sucinya adalah elang dan banteng, dan tanaman sucinya adalah pohon ek holm dan zaitun; di orakel Dodona para imamnya terilhami desir daun ek, dan di Olimpiade para pemenang dimahkotai daun zaitun dari hutan sucinya. Takhtanya dijaga Kratos, Zelos, Nike, dan Bia, dan Hermes menjadi juru bicara pribadinya.

Zeus juga menegakkan keadilan dan hukuman. Menurut World History Encyclopedia, ia raja kedua belas dewa Olimpus; ia mengendalikan cuaca, memberi tanda dan pertanda, dan menegakkan keadilan serta ketertiban dari Gunung Olimpus. Menurut theoi.com, ia menghukum Prometheus yang memberi manusia api curian dengan mengirim Pandora ke bumi, memutuskan menghapus manusia yang bejat dengan banjir besar sambil menyelamatkan Deukalion dan Pyrrha, dan menghukum Tantalos, Lykaon, Ixion, dan Salmoneus.
long_description.en:
Zeus stands at the head of the Greek pantheon: god of the sky and of thunder in ancient Greek religion and myth, reigning over the gods from Mount Olympus. Theoi.com describes him as lord of sky, weather, law and order, destiny and kingship, shown as a dignified bearded man in his prime holding a thunderbolt and sceptre, with an eagle. In ancient Rome he was equated with Jupiter.

Zeus is the child of the Titans Kronos and Rheia. Kronos swallowed each child at birth, but Rhea saved Zeus by giving Kronos a stone wrapped in swaddling cloth. According to theoi.com, Zeus was raised in secret on Mount Dikte in Crete, nursed by nymphs on the milk of the goat Amaltheia. On coming of age he recruited the goddess Metis, who served Kronos a magical draught that made him disgorge the young gods he had devoured.

His rule was won through war. According to theoi.com, Zeus freed the giants from Tartaros, was armed with lightning-bolts by the Kyklopes and, aided by the Hekatonkheires, defeated Kronos and the Titans. Zeus and his brothers then cast lots to share out the universe, and Zeus received the sky, Poseidon the ocean and Haides the world below. He later laid low the king of the Giants with his lightning, and was for a time defeated by Typhoeus until Pan stole back his strength, so that Zeus won and bound the monster beneath Mount Etna.

In most traditions Zeus is married to Hera, his sister, whom according to theoi.com he seduced in the guise of a cuckoo-bird. He was also infamous for his many love affairs, which produced numerous divine and heroic offspring, including Apollo, Artemis, Hermes, Persephone, Dionysus, Perseus and Heracles; according to theoi.com he seduced many mortal women in various disguises, such as a swan for Leda and a bull for Europa. Athena was born of Metis, whom Zeus swallowed after an oracle said her son would replace him, and emerged from Zeus's head.

According to theoi.com, Zeus's most distinctive attribute was the lightning bolt he wielded like a javelin, together with a royal sceptre, a throne, an eagle, a miniature Nike and the aigis. His sacred animals were the eagle and the bull, and his sacred plants the holm oak and the olive; at the Dodona oracle his priests drew inspiration from the sound of oak foliage, while victors at the Olympic Games wore wreaths of olive from the god's sacred grove. His throne was guarded by Kratos, Zelos, Nike and Bia, and Hermes served as his personal herald.

Zeus was also an enforcer of justice and punishment. According to the World History Encyclopedia, he was king of the twelve Olympian gods; he controlled the weather, offered signs and omens, and dispensed justice and order from Mount Olympus. According to theoi.com he punished Prometheus, who gave mankind stolen fire, by sending Pandora to earth, decided to wipe wicked mankind out with a great deluge while sparing Deukalion and Pyrrha, and punished Tantalos, Lykaon, Ixion and Salmoneus.

who.id: Raja para dewa Yunani.
who.en: King of the Greek gods.

role.id: Raja para dewa dan penguasa langit, cuaca, hukum, dan ketertiban.
role.en: King of the gods and ruler of sky, weather, law and order.

famous_for.id: Petirnya, kemenangannya atas para Titan, Giant, dan Typhoeus, serta banyak petualangan cintanya.
famous_for.en: His thunderbolt, his victories over the Titans, Giants and Typhoeus, and his many love affairs.

did_you_know.id: Di Olimpiade kuno, para pemenang dimahkotai karangan daun zaitun yang dipetik dari hutan suci Zeus.
did_you_know.en: In the ancient Olympic Games, winners wore wreaths of olive taken from the sacred grove of Zeus.

cultural_context.id: Menurut theoi.com, di orakel kuno Dodona para imam Zeus terilhami desir daun ek, dan di Olimpiade para pemenang dimahkotai karangan daun zaitun dari hutan suci sang dewa.
cultural_context.en: According to theoi.com, at the ancient oracle of Dodona the priests of Zeus drew inspiration from the sound of oak foliage, while Olympic victors wore wreaths of olive taken from the god's sacred grove.

description.id: Menurut theoi.com ia dewa langit dan cuaca, dan menurut World History Encyclopedia ia mengendalikan cuaca.
description.en: According to theoi.com he is god of sky and weather, and according to the World History Encyclopedia he controlled the weather.

description.id: Para Kyklopes mempersenjatai Zeus dengan petir, yang ia genggam seperti lembing; dengan petir mematikannya ia menjatuhkan raja para Giant.
description.en: The Kyklopes armed Zeus with lightning-bolts, which he wields like a javelin; with his deadly lightning-bolts he laid low the king of the Giants.

description.id: Merayu perempuan fana dan Hera dalam berbagai rupa, seperti angsa, banteng, hujan emas, dan burung kukuk.
description.en: Seduced mortal women and Hera in various guises, such as a swan, a bull, a shower of gold and a cuckoo-bird.

description.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Zeus memberi tanda dan pertanda.
description.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Zeus offered signs and omens.

description.id: Dalam pertarungan dengan Typhoeus, Zeus dikalahkan dan otot-otot kakinya dirobek hingga tak berdaya, sampai Pan mencuri kembali kekuatannya.
description.en: In combat with Typhoeus, Zeus was defeated and the sinews torn from his limbs, leaving him helpless until Pan stole back his strength.

summary.id: Rhea menyelamatkan Zeus dari Kronos dengan memberinya batu berbalut kain; Zeus dibesarkan di Gunung Dikte, Kreta, lalu memaksa Kronos memuntahkan saudara-saudaranya.
summary.en: Rhea saved Zeus from Cronus by handing him a swaddled stone; Zeus grew up on Mount Dikte, Crete, then forced Cronus to disgorge his siblings.

summary.id: Setelah dewasa Zeus merekrut Metis untuk membuat Kronos memuntahkan saudara-saudaranya, membebaskan para raksasa dari Tartaros, dan dengan petir dari para Kyklopes serta lemparan batu para Hekatonkheires mengalahkan Kronos dan sekutunya, yang dibuang ke penjara di bawah bumi. Sesudahnya ia dan saudara-saudaranya mengundi kekuasaan: Zeus mendapat langit, Poseidon laut, dan Haides dunia bawah.
summary.en: On coming of age Zeus recruited Metis to make Kronos disgorge his siblings, freed the giants from Tartaros and, with lightning from the Kyklopes and boulders from the Hekatonkheires, defeated Kronos and his allies, who were banished to a prison beneath the earth. Afterwards he and his brothers cast lots to share the universe among them, and he received the sky, Poseidon the ocean and Haides the world below.

role.en: Father who swallowed the child's mother

summary.id: Zeus menelan Metis yang sedang hamil setelah ramalan menyatakan putranya akan menggantikannya; Athena lahir di perutnya dan keluar langsung dari kepalanya.
summary.en: Zeus swallowed the pregnant Metis after an oracle said her son would replace him; Athena was born in his belly and birthed directly from his head.

summary.id: Prometheus memberi manusia api yang dicuri dari para dewa; Zeus menghukum dengan memerintahkan penciptaan Pandora, yang dikirim ke bumi membawa bejana penuh malapetaka.
summary.en: Prometheus gave mankind fire stolen from the gods; Zeus punished this by ordering the creation of Pandora, sent to earth with a vessel full of troubles.

summary.id: Zeus memutuskan menghapus manusia yang bejat dengan banjir besar; hanya Deukalion dan Pyrrha yang diselamatkan dan mengisi kembali dunia dengan batu yang menjelma manusia.
summary.en: Zeus decided to wipe out wicked mankind with a great deluge; only Deukalion and Pyrrha were spared, repopulating the world with stones that turned into men.

summary.id: Atas dorongan Gaia para Giant mengepung benteng Olimpos, tetapi Zeus menjatuhkan raja mereka dan banyak lainnya dengan petirnya.
summary.en: At Gaia's urging the Giants besieged the fortress of Olympos, but Zeus laid low their king and many others with his lightning-bolts.

role.en: God who loses and then wins

summary.id: Typhoeus menyerang Olimpos dan mengalahkan Zeus dengan merobek otot-otot kakinya. Pan mencuri kembali kekuatan Zeus, yang kemudian menang dan mengurung Typhoeus di bawah Gunung Etna.
summary.en: Typhoeus attacked Olympos and defeated Zeus by tearing the sinews from his limbs. Pan stole back Zeus's strength, and Zeus then won and bound Typhoeus beneath Mount Etna.

summary.id: Zeus menghukum Tantalos, Lykaon, Ixion, dan Salmoneus karena kedurhakaan dan kejahatan mereka terhadap para dewa.
summary.en: Zeus punished Tantalos, Lykaon, Ixion and Salmoneus for their impiety and crimes against the gods.

description.id: Tempat Zeus memerintah sebagai raja para dewa.
description.en: Where Zeus rules as king of the gods.

claim.id: Zeus (Ζεύς) adalah dewa tertinggi jajaran dewa Yunani, dewa langit dan guntur dalam agama dan mitologi Yunani kuno yang memerintah sebagai raja para dewa di Gunung Olimpus.
claim.en: Zeus (Ζεύς) is the supreme deity of the Greek pantheon, a sky and thunder god of ancient Greek religion and mythology who rules as king of the gods on Mount Olympus.

claims_provenance.quote: is the supreme deity of the Greek pantheon. He is a sky and thunder god in ancient Greek religion and mythology, who rules as king of the gods on Mount Olympus.

claim.id: Menurut theoi.com, Zeus raja para dewa dan dewa langit, cuaca, hukum dan ketertiban, takdir, serta kekuasaan raja, digambarkan sebagai laki-laki dewasa berwibawa berjanggut gelap, dengan atribut petir, tongkat kerajaan, dan elang.
claim.en: According to theoi.com, Zeus was King of the Gods and god of sky, weather, law and order, destiny and kingship, shown as a regal mature man with a dark beard, with the lightning bolt, royal sceptre and eagle.

claims_provenance.quote: ZEUS was the King of the Gods and the god of the sky, weather, law and order, destiny and fate, and kingship. He was depicted as a regal, mature man with a sturdy figure and dark beard. His usual attributes were a lightning bolt, a royal sceptre and an eagle.

claim.id: Di Roma kuno, Zeus disamakan dengan dewa Jupiter.
claim.en: In ancient Rome, Zeus was identified with Jupiter.

claims_provenance.quote: In ancient Rome, Zeus was identified with the god Jupiter.

claim.id: Zeus anak bungsu Titan Kronos dan Rhea; Kronos menelan setiap anaknya saat lahir, tetapi Zeus diselamatkan ibunya yang memberi Kronos batu berbalut kain.
claim.en: Zeus was the youngest child of the Titans Kronos and Rhea; Kronos devoured each child at birth, but Zeus escaped when his mother gave the Titan a swaddled stone.

claims_provenance.quote: Zeus was the youngest child of the Titans Kronos (Cronus) and Rheia. Kronos devoured each of his children as they were born, but Zeus escaped this fate when his mother spirited him away, handing the Titan a stone substitute wrapped in swaddling cloth.

claim.id: Menurut theoi.com, Zeus dibesarkan secara rahasia di Gunung Dikte di Kreta dan diasuh para nimfa dengan susu kambing Amaltheia.
claim.en: According to theoi.com, Zeus was raised in secrecy on Mount Dikte in Crete, where nymphs nursed him on the milk of the goat Amaltheia.

claims_provenance.quote: The god was raised in secrecy on Mount Dikte in Krete (Crete) where he was nursed by nymphs on the milk of the goat Amaltheia

claim.id: Dalam kebanyakan tradisi Zeus menikah dengan Hera, yang biasanya dikatakan melahirkan Ares, Eileithyia, Hebe, dan Hefaistos.
claim.en: In most traditions Zeus is married to Hera, by whom he is usually said to have fathered Ares, Eileithyia, Hebe and Hephaestus.

claims_provenance.quote: In most traditions, he is married to Hera, by whom he is usually said to have fathered Ares, Eileithyia, Hebe, and Hephaestus.

claim.id: Zeus terkenal karena petualangan cintanya yang melahirkan banyak keturunan ilahi dan pahlawan, termasuk Apollo, Artemis, Hermes, Persephone, Dionysus, Perseus, dan Herakles.
claim.en: Zeus was infamous for love affairs producing many divine and heroic offspring, including Apollo, Artemis, Hermes, Persephone, Dionysus, Perseus and Heracles.

claims_provenance.quote: Zeus was also infamous for his erotic escapades. These resulted in many divine and heroic offspring, including Apollo, Artemis, Hermes, Persephone, Dionysus, Perseus, Heracles, Helen of Troy, Minos, and the Muses.

claim.id: Menurut theoi.com, Zeus merayu banyak perempuan fana dalam samaran, misalnya Leda sebagai angsa, Europa sebagai banteng, dan Danae sebagai hujan emas.
claim.en: According to theoi.com, Zeus seduced many mortal women in disguise, such as Leda as a swan, Europa as a bull and Danae as a shower of gold.

claims_provenance.quote: Zeus seduced many mortal woman including Leda in the guise of a swan, Europa as a bull, Danae as a shower of gold

claim.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Zeus raja kedua belas dewa Olimpus dan dewa tertinggi agama Yunani; ia mengendalikan cuaca, memberi tanda dan pertanda, dan menegakkan keadilan serta ketertiban dari Gunung Olimpus.
claim.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Zeus was king of the twelve Olympians and supreme Greek god; he controlled the weather, gave signs and omens, and dispensed justice and order from Mount Olympus.

claims_provenance.quote: Zeus was the king of the 12 Olympian gods and the supreme god in Greek religion. Zeus is often referred to as the Father, as the god of thunder, and the 'cloud-gatherer'. Zeus controlled the weather and offered signs and omens.

claim.id: Nama Zeus adalah lanjutan Yunani dari *Dyēus, nama dewa langit siang dalam bahasa Proto-Indo-Eropa.
claim.en: Zeus is the Greek continuation of *Dyēus, the Proto-Indo-European god of the daytime sky.

claims_provenance.quote: Zeus is the Greek continuation of *Dyēus, the name of the Proto-Indo-European god of the daytime sky

claim.id: Menurut theoi.com, setelah Titan jatuh, Zeus dan saudara-saudaranya mengundi pembagian kekuasaan atas kosmos: Zeus mendapat langit, Poseidon laut, dan Haides dunia bawah.
claim.en: According to theoi.com, once the Titan-gods had fallen, Zeus and his brothers drew lots to divide the cosmos among themselves, with Zeus receiving the heavens, Poseidon the sea and Haides the underworld.

claims_provenance.quote: After the fall of the Titan-gods, Zeus and his brothers drew lots to divide rule of the cosmos - Zeus won the heavens, Poseidon the sea and Haides the underworld.

claim.id: Menurut theoi.com, Zeus membebaskan enam putra raksasa Langit dari jurang Tartaros; para Kyklopes mempersenjatainya dengan petir dan para Hekatonkheires membantunya menyerang Titan dengan lemparan batu, hingga Kronos dan sekutunya kalah dan dibuang ke penjara di bawah bumi.
claim.en: According to theoi.com, Zeus freed the six giant sons of Heaven from the pit of Tartaros; the Kyklopes armed him with lightning-bolts and the Hekatonkheires aided his assault on the Titanes with thrown boulders, until Kronos and his allies were defeated and banished to a prison beneath the earth.

claims_provenance.quote: Zeus liberated the six giant-sons of Heaven from the pit of Tartaros. In gratitude the Kyklopes (Cyclopes) armed him with lightning-bolts and the Hekatonkheires (Hundred-Handed) aided him in his assault on the Titanes with volleys of thrown boulders. Kronos and his allies were eventually defeated and banished to a prison beneath the earth.

claim.id: Menurut theoi.com, setelah dewasa Zeus merekrut dewi Metis, yang menyuguhkan ramuan ajaib kepada Kronos sehingga ia memuntahkan para dewa muda yang telah ditelannya.
claim.en: According to theoi.com, on coming of age Zeus recruited the goddess Metis, who served Kronos a magical draught that made him disgorge the young gods he had devoured.

claims_provenance.quote: Upon coming of age Zeus recruited the goddess Metis to his cause. She served the Titan Kronos a magical draught which caused him to disgorge the young gods he had devoured.

claim.id: Menurut theoi.com, Zeus menelan Metis yang sedang hamil ketika sebuah ramalan menyatakan putranya ditakdirkan menggantikannya sebagai Raja Para Dewa; anak mereka, Athena, kemudian lahir di perutnya dan keluar langsung dari kepalanya.
claim.en: According to theoi.com, Zeus devoured the pregnant Metis when an oracle revealed that her son was destined to replace him as King of the Gods; their child Athena was later born in his belly and birthed directly from his head.

claims_provenance.quote: Zeus devoured the pregnant goddess Metis when an oracle revealed that her son was destined to replace him as King of the Gods. Their child, Athena, was subsequently born in his belly and birthed directly from his head.

claim.id: Menurut theoi.com, Zeus menikahi saudarinya Hera, ratu langit, setelah merayunya dalam rupa burung kukuk.
claim.en: According to theoi.com, Zeus married his sister Hera, queen of the heavens, after seducing her in the guise of a cuckoo-bird.

claims_provenance.quote: Zeus married his sister Hera, queen of the heavens, after seducing her in the guise of a cuckoo-bird.

claim.id: Menurut theoi.com, Prometheus menciptakan umat manusia dan memberi mereka api yang dicuri dari para dewa; Zeus menghukumnya dengan memerintahkan penciptaan perempuan pertama, Pandora, yang dikirim ke bumi membawa bejana penuh malapetaka.
claim.en: According to theoi.com, Prometheus crafted the race of man and gave them fire stolen from the gods; Zeus punished this by ordering the creation of the first woman, Pandora, sent to earth with a vessel full of troubles.

claims_provenance.quote: Prometheus crafted the race of man and gave them fire stolen from the gods of heaven. Zeus punished this act by ordering the creation of the first woman, Pandora, and sent her to earth with a vessel full of troubles to plague mankind.

claim.id: Menurut theoi.com, Zeus memutuskan menghapus generasi awal manusia yang bejat dengan banjir besar; pasangan saleh Deukalion dan Pyrrha diselamatkan dan memulihkan dunia dengan melempar batu yang menjelma manusia.
claim.en: According to theoi.com, Zeus decided to wipe the wicked early generations of man from the earth with a great deluge; the virtuous couple Deukalion and Pyrrha were spared and repopulated the world with cast stones that turned into men.

claims_provenance.quote: The early generations of man descended into wickedness and corruption and Zeus decided to wipe them from the face of the earth with a great deluge. One virtuous couple, Deukalion and Pyrrha, were spared and afterwards allowed to repopulate the world with the casting of stones which transformed into men.

claim.id: Menurut theoi.com, Gaia yang murka atas pemenjaraan para Titan mendorong para Giant memberontak melawan dewa-dewa Olimpos; mereka mengepung benteng surgawi, tetapi Zeus menjatuhkan raja mereka dan banyak lainnya dengan petirnya yang mematikan.
claim.en: According to theoi.com, Gaia, angered by the imprisonment of the Titanes, urged the Giants to rise against the gods of Olympos; they besieged the heavenly fortress but Zeus laid low their king and many others with his deadly lightning-bolts.

claims_provenance.quote: The earth-goddess Gaia (Gaea), angered by the imprisonment of the Titanes, urged the Giants to rise up against the gods of Olympos. They laid siege to the heavenly fortress but Zeus laid low their king and many others with his deadly lightning-bolts.

claim.id: Menurut theoi.com, Gaia melahirkan Typhoeus, raksasa paling mengerikan, yang menyerang Olimpos; para dewa melarikan diri dan Zeus sendiri dikalahkan, otot-otot kakinya dirobek hingga tak berdaya. Pan kemudian mencuri kembali kekuatannya, dan Zeus memenangkan pertarungan ulang serta mengurung Typhoeus di bawah Gunung Etna.
claim.en: According to theoi.com, Gaia produced Typhoeus, the most monstrous of the giants, and set him upon Olympos; the gods fled and Zeus himself was defeated, the sinews torn from his limbs. Pan later stole back the god's strength, and Zeus defeated the giant in a rematch and bound him beneath Mount Etna.

claims_provenance.quote: Gaia produced one more giant, Typhoeus, the most monstrous of his kind and set him upon Olympos. The rest of the gods fled in horror and Zeus himself was defeated in combat with the monster tearing the sinews from his limbs rendering him helpless. Pan later stole back the god's strength and, restored, Zeus defeated the giant in a rematch and bound him beneath Mount Etna.

claim.id: Menurut theoi.com, Zeus menghukum para penjahat terburuk dalam mitos karena kedurhakaan mereka, di antaranya Tantalos yang mencuri ambrosia, Lykaon yang menghidangkan daging manusia kepada para dewa, Ixion yang mencoba memperkosa Hera, dan Salmoneus yang menirukan Zeus.
claim.en: According to theoi.com, Zeus punished the worst villains of myth for impiety, including Tantalos who stole ambrosia, Lykaon who served human flesh to the gods, Ixion who attempted to rape Hera, and Salmoneus who tried to imitate Zeus.

claims_provenance.quote: Zeus punished the worst villians of myth for their impiety and crimes against the gods including Tantalos who stole ambrosia from heaven, Lykaon (Lycaon) who served human flesh to the gods, Ixion who attempted to rape Zeus' wife the goddess Hera, and Salmoneus who tried to imitate Zeus and steal the worship that was due the gods.

claim.id: Menurut theoi.com, atribut Zeus yang paling khas adalah petirnya yang digenggam seperti lembing; atribut lainnya mencakup tongkat kerajaan, takhta, elang, Nike mini, dan aigis (pelindung lengan dari kulit kambing).
claim.en: According to theoi.com, Zeus' most distinctive attribute was his lightning bolt wielded like a javelin; others included a royal sceptre, a throne, an eagle, a miniature Nike and the aigis (a goat-skin arm-guard).

claims_provenance.quote: Zeus' most distinctive attribute was his stylized lightning bolt which he wielded in his hand like a javelin. His other attributes included a royal sceptre, a throne, an eagle, a miniature Nike (winged goddess of victory), and the aigis (a goat-skin arm-guard).

claim.id: Menurut theoi.com, hewan suci Zeus adalah elang dan banteng; dalam mitos ia menculik pemuda Ganymede dalam rupa elang dan gadis Europa dalam rupa banteng.
claim.en: According to theoi.com, Zeus' sacred animals were the eagle and the bull; in myth he abducted the youth Ganymede as an eagle and the maiden Europa as a bull.

claims_provenance.quote: Zeus' sacred animals were the eagle and the bull. In myth he abducted the youth Ganymede in the shape of an eagle and the maiden Europa in the guise of a bull.

claim.id: Menurut theoi.com, tanaman suci Zeus adalah pohon ek holm dan zaitun; di orakel kuno Dodona para imam terilhami desir daun ek, dan di Olimpiade para pemenang dimahkotai karangan daun zaitun dari hutan suci sang dewa.
claim.en: According to theoi.com, Zeus' sacred plants were the holm oak and the olive tree; at the ancient oracle of Dodona his priests were inspired by the rustling of oak-leaves, and at the Olympic Games victors were crowned with olive-leaves from the god's sacred grove.

claims_provenance.quote: His sacred plants were the evergreen holm oak and the olive tree. At the ancient oracle of Dodona Zeus' priests were inspired by the rustling of oak-leaves, and at the Olympic Games victors were crowned with a wreath of olive-leaves picked from the god's sacred grove.

claim.id: Menurut theoi.com, takhta Zeus dijaga empat roh bersayap, dua laki-laki dan dua perempuan, bernama Kratos (Kekuatan), Zelos (Persaingan), Nike (Kemenangan), dan Bia (Paksaan).
claim.en: According to theoi.com, Zeus' throne was guarded by four winged spirits, two male and two female, named Kratos (Strength), Zelos (Rivalry), Nike (Victory) and Bia (Force).

claims_provenance.quote: His throne was guarded by four winged spirits, two male and two female, named Kratos (Strength), Zelos (Rivalry), Nike (Victory) and Bia (Force).

claim.id: Menurut theoi.com, Hermes adalah juru bicara pribadi Zeus yang bertugas sebagai diplomat, utusan, dan agen umum kehendak sang dewa.
claim.en: According to theoi.com, Hermes was Zeus' personal herald, acting as diplomat, envoy and general agent of the god's will.

claims_provenance.quote: The god Hermes was Zeus' personal herald who acted as diplomat, envoy and general agent of the god's will.

claim.id: Menurut theoi.com, putra fana kesayangan Zeus adalah Herakles, yang ia dukung sepanjang cobaannya dan akhirnya diterima di Olimpos sebagai dewa.
claim.en: According to theoi.com, Zeus' favorite mortal son was Herakles, whom he supported throughout his trials and eventually welcomed to Olympos as a god.

claims_provenance.quote: The god's favorite mortal son was Herakles (Heracles) whom he supported throughout his trials and eventually welcomed to Olympos as a god.

claim.id: Menurut theoi.com, Zeus adalah putra Titan Kronos dan Rheia serta cucu Ouranos (Langit) dan Gaia (Bumi), dan saudara Poseidon, Haides, Hera, Demeter, dan Hestia.
claim.en: According to theoi.com, Zeus was a son of the Titans Kronos and Rheia, a grandson of Ouranos (the Sky) and Gaia (the Earth), and a brother of Poseidon, Haides, Hera, Demeter and Hestia.

claims_provenance.quote: Zeus was a son of the Titans Kronos (Cronus) and Rheia and a grandson of Ouranos (the Sky) and Gaia (the Earth). He was a brother of the gods Poseidon, Haides, Hera, Demeter and Hestia.

claim.id: Menurut theoi.com, Zeus menikahi saudarinya, dewi langit Hera, dan mereka memiliki tiga anak: Ares, Hebe, dan Eileithyia.
claim.en: According to theoi.com, Zeus married his sister, the sky-goddess Hera, and they had three children: Ares, Hebe and Eileithyia.

claims_provenance.quote: Zeus married his sister, the sky-goddess Hera, and they had three children - Ares, Hebe and Eileithyia.

cultural_context.id: Menurut theoi.com, di orakel kuno Dodona para imam Zeus terilhami desir daun ek, dan di Olimpiade para pemenang dimahkotai karangan daun zaitun dari hutan suci sang dewa.
cultural_context.en: According to theoi.com, at the ancient oracle of Dodona the priests of Zeus drew inspiration from the sound of oak foliage, while Olympic victors wore wreaths of olive taken from the god's sacred grove.

who.id: Raja para dewa Yunani.
who.en: King of the Greek gods.

role.id: Raja para dewa dan penguasa langit, cuaca, hukum, dan ketertiban.
role.en: King of the gods and ruler of sky, weather, law and order.

famous_for.id: Petirnya, kemenangannya atas para Titan, Giant, dan Typhoeus, serta banyak petualangan cintanya.
famous_for.en: His thunderbolt, his victories over the Titans, Giants and Typhoeus, and his many love affairs.

did_you_know.id: Di Olimpiade kuno, para pemenang dimahkotai karangan daun zaitun yang dipetik dari hutan suci Zeus.
did_you_know.en: In the ancient Olympic Games, winners wore wreaths of olive taken from the sacred grove of Zeus.

description.id: Menurut theoi.com ia dewa langit dan cuaca, dan menurut World History Encyclopedia ia mengendalikan cuaca.
description.en: According to theoi.com he is god of sky and weather, and according to the World History Encyclopedia he controlled the weather.

description.id: Para Kyklopes mempersenjatai Zeus dengan petir, yang ia genggam seperti lembing; dengan petir mematikannya ia menjatuhkan raja para Giant.
description.en: The Kyklopes armed Zeus with lightning-bolts, which he wields like a javelin; with his deadly lightning-bolts he laid low the king of the Giants.

description.id: Merayu perempuan fana dan Hera dalam berbagai rupa, seperti angsa, banteng, hujan emas, dan burung kukuk.
description.en: Seduced mortal women and Hera in various guises, such as a swan, a bull, a shower of gold and a cuckoo-bird.

description.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Zeus memberi tanda dan pertanda.
description.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Zeus offered signs and omens.

description.id: Dalam pertarungan dengan Typhoeus, Zeus dikalahkan dan otot-otot kakinya dirobek hingga tak berdaya, sampai Pan mencuri kembali kekuatannya.
description.en: In combat with Typhoeus, Zeus was defeated and the sinews torn from his limbs, leaving him helpless until Pan stole back his strength.

summary.id: Rhea menyelamatkan Zeus dari Kronos dengan memberinya batu berbalut kain; Zeus dibesarkan di Gunung Dikte, Kreta, lalu memaksa Kronos memuntahkan saudara-saudaranya.
summary.en: Rhea saved Zeus from Cronus by handing him a swaddled stone; Zeus grew up on Mount Dikte, Crete, then forced Cronus to disgorge his siblings.

summary.id: Setelah dewasa Zeus merekrut Metis untuk membuat Kronos memuntahkan saudara-saudaranya, membebaskan para raksasa dari Tartaros, dan dengan petir dari para Kyklopes serta lemparan batu para Hekatonkheires mengalahkan Kronos dan sekutunya, yang dibuang ke penjara di bawah bumi. Sesudahnya ia dan saudara-saudaranya mengundi kekuasaan: Zeus mendapat langit, Poseidon laut, dan Haides dunia bawah.
summary.en: On coming of age Zeus recruited Metis to make Kronos disgorge his siblings, freed the giants from Tartaros and, with lightning from the Kyklopes and boulders from the Hekatonkheires, defeated Kronos and his allies, who were banished to a prison beneath the earth. Afterwards he and his brothers cast lots to share the universe among them, and he received the sky, Poseidon the ocean and Haides the world below.

role.en: Father who swallowed the child's mother

summary.id: Zeus menelan Metis yang sedang hamil setelah ramalan menyatakan putranya akan menggantikannya; Athena lahir di perutnya dan keluar langsung dari kepalanya.
summary.en: Zeus swallowed the pregnant Metis after an oracle said her son would replace him; Athena was born in his belly and birthed directly from his head.

summary.id: Prometheus memberi manusia api yang dicuri dari para dewa; Zeus menghukum dengan memerintahkan penciptaan Pandora, yang dikirim ke bumi membawa bejana penuh malapetaka.
summary.en: Prometheus gave mankind fire stolen from the gods; Zeus punished this by ordering the creation of Pandora, sent to earth with a vessel full of troubles.

summary.id: Zeus memutuskan menghapus manusia yang bejat dengan banjir besar; hanya Deukalion dan Pyrrha yang diselamatkan dan mengisi kembali dunia dengan batu yang menjelma manusia.
summary.en: Zeus decided to wipe out wicked mankind with a great deluge; only Deukalion and Pyrrha were spared, repopulating the world with stones that turned into men.

summary.id: Atas dorongan Gaia para Giant mengepung benteng Olimpos, tetapi Zeus menjatuhkan raja mereka dan banyak lainnya dengan petirnya.
summary.en: At Gaia's urging the Giants besieged the fortress of Olympos, but Zeus laid low their king and many others with his lightning-bolts.

role.en: God who loses and then wins

summary.id: Typhoeus menyerang Olimpos dan mengalahkan Zeus dengan merobek otot-otot kakinya. Pan mencuri kembali kekuatan Zeus, yang kemudian menang dan mengurung Typhoeus di bawah Gunung Etna.
summary.en: Typhoeus attacked Olympos and defeated Zeus by tearing the sinews from his limbs. Pan stole back Zeus's strength, and Zeus then won and bound Typhoeus beneath Mount Etna.

summary.en: Zeus punished Tantalos, Lykaon, Ixion and Salmoneus for their impiety and crimes against the gods.

short_description.id: Zeus adalah dewa tertinggi dalam jajaran dewa Yunani, dewa langit dan guntur yang memerintah sebagai raja para dewa di Gunung Olimpus dan menggenggam petir sebagai senjatanya.
short_description.en: Zeus is the supreme deity of the Greek pantheon, a sky and thunder god who rules as king of the gods on Mount Olympus and wields the lightning bolt as his weapon.

long_description.id: Zeus adalah dewa tertinggi dalam jajaran dewa Yunani, dewa langit dan guntur dalam agama dan mitologi Yunani kuno yang memerintah sebagai raja para dewa di Gunung Olimpus. Menurut theoi.com, ia dewa langit, cuaca, hukum dan ketertiban, takdir, serta kekuasaan raja, digambarkan sebagai laki-laki dewasa berwibawa berjanggut gelap, dengan atribut petir, tongkat kerajaan, dan elang. Di Roma kuno, Zeus disamakan dengan Jupiter.
long_description.en: Zeus stands at the head of the Greek pantheon: god of the sky and of thunder in ancient Greek religion and myth, reigning over the gods from Mount Olympus. Theoi.com describes him as lord of sky, weather, law and order, destiny and kingship, shown as a dignified bearded man in his prime holding a thunderbolt and sceptre, with an eagle. In ancient Rome he was equated with Jupiter.

long_description.id: Zeus adalah putra Titan Kronos dan Rheia. Kronos menelan setiap anaknya begitu lahir, tetapi Rhea menyelamatkan Zeus dengan memberi Kronos sebuah batu berbalut kain. Menurut theoi.com, Zeus dibesarkan diam-diam di Gunung Dikte di Kreta dan diasuh para nimfa dengan susu kambing Amaltheia. Setelah dewasa ia merekrut dewi Metis, yang menyuguhkan ramuan ajaib kepada Kronos sehingga Kronos memuntahkan para dewa muda yang telah ditelannya.
long_description.en: Zeus is the child of the Titans Kronos and Rheia. Kronos swallowed each child at birth, but Rhea saved Zeus by giving Kronos a stone wrapped in swaddling cloth. According to theoi.com, Zeus was raised in secret on Mount Dikte in Crete, nursed by nymphs on the milk of the goat Amaltheia. On coming of age he recruited the goddess Metis, who served Kronos a magical draught that made him disgorge the young gods he had devoured.

long_description.id: Kekuasaannya diperoleh melalui perang. Menurut theoi.com, Zeus membebaskan para raksasa dari Tartaros, dipersenjatai petir oleh para Kyklopes, dan dibantu para Hekatonkheires mengalahkan Kronos dan para Titan. Zeus dan saudara-saudaranya lalu mengundi kekuasaan atas kosmos: Zeus mendapat langit, Poseidon laut, dan Haides dunia bawah. Ia kemudian menjatuhkan raja para Giant dengan petirnya, dan sempat dikalahkan Typhoeus sebelum Pan mencuri kembali kekuatannya sehingga Zeus menang dan mengurung raksasa itu di bawah Gunung Etna.
long_description.en: His rule was won through war. According to theoi.com, Zeus freed the giants from Tartaros, was armed with lightning-bolts by the Kyklopes and, aided by the Hekatonkheires, defeated Kronos and the Titans. Zeus and his brothers then cast lots to share out the universe, and Zeus received the sky, Poseidon the ocean and Haides the world below. He later laid low the king of the Giants with his lightning, and was for a time defeated by Typhoeus until Pan stole back his strength, so that Zeus won and bound the monster beneath Mount Etna.

long_description.id: Dalam kebanyakan tradisi, Zeus menikah dengan Hera, saudarinya, yang menurut theoi.com ia rayu dalam rupa burung kukuk. Ia juga terkenal karena banyak petualangan cintanya, yang melahirkan banyak keturunan ilahi dan pahlawan, termasuk Apollo, Artemis, Hermes, Persephone, Dionysus, Perseus, dan Herakles; menurut theoi.com ia merayu banyak perempuan fana dalam berbagai samaran, seperti angsa untuk Leda dan banteng untuk Europa. Athena lahir dari Metis, yang ditelan Zeus setelah ramalan menyatakan putranya akan menggantikannya, dan keluar dari kepala Zeus.
long_description.en: In most traditions Zeus is married to Hera, his sister, whom according to theoi.com he seduced in the guise of a cuckoo-bird. He was also infamous for his many love affairs, which produced numerous divine and heroic offspring, including Apollo, Artemis, Hermes, Persephone, Dionysus, Perseus and Heracles; according to theoi.com he seduced many mortal women in various disguises, such as a swan for Leda and a bull for Europa. Athena was born of Metis, whom Zeus swallowed after an oracle said her son would replace him, and emerged from Zeus's head.

long_description.id: Menurut theoi.com, atribut Zeus yang paling khas adalah petir yang ia genggam seperti lembing, disertai tongkat kerajaan, takhta, elang, Nike mini, dan aigis. Hewan sucinya adalah elang dan banteng, dan tanaman sucinya adalah pohon ek holm dan zaitun; di orakel Dodona para imamnya terilhami desir daun ek, dan di Olimpiade para pemenang dimahkotai daun zaitun dari hutan sucinya. Takhtanya dijaga Kratos, Zelos, Nike, dan Bia, dan Hermes menjadi juru bicara pribadinya.
long_description.en: According to theoi.com, Zeus's most distinctive attribute was the lightning bolt he wielded like a javelin, together with a royal sceptre, a throne, an eagle, a miniature Nike and the aigis. His sacred animals were the eagle and the bull, and his sacred plants the holm oak and the olive; at the Dodona oracle his priests drew inspiration from the sound of oak foliage, while victors at the Olympic Games wore wreaths of olive from the god's sacred grove. His throne was guarded by Kratos, Zelos, Nike and Bia, and Hermes served as his personal herald.

long_description.id: Zeus juga menegakkan keadilan dan hukuman. Menurut World History Encyclopedia, ia raja kedua belas dewa Olimpus; ia mengendalikan cuaca, memberi tanda dan pertanda, dan menegakkan keadilan serta ketertiban dari Gunung Olimpus. Menurut theoi.com, ia menghukum Prometheus yang memberi manusia api curian dengan mengirim Pandora ke bumi, memutuskan menghapus manusia yang bejat dengan banjir besar sambil menyelamatkan Deukalion dan Pyrrha, dan menghukum Tantalos, Lykaon, Ixion, dan Salmoneus.
long_description.en: Zeus was also an enforcer of justice and punishment. According to the World History Encyclopedia, he was king of the twelve Olympian gods; he controlled the weather, offered signs and omens, and dispensed justice and order from Mount Olympus. According to theoi.com he punished Prometheus, who gave mankind stolen fire, by sending Pandora to earth, decided to wipe wicked mankind out with a great deluge while sparing Deukalion and Pyrrha, and punished Tantalos, Lykaon, Ixion and Salmoneus.

claims.quote: is the supreme deity of the Greek pantheon. He is a sky and thunder god in ancient Greek religion and mythology, who rules as king of the gods on Mount Olympus.

statement.en: Zeus (Ζεύς) is the supreme deity of the Greek pantheon, a sky and thunder god of ancient Greek religion and mythology who rules as king of the gods on Mount Olympus.

claims.quote: ZEUS was the King of the Gods and the god of the sky, weather, law and order, destiny and fate, and kingship. He was depicted as a regal, mature man with a sturdy figure and dark beard. His usual attributes were a lightning bolt, a royal sceptre and an eagle.

statement.id: Menurut theoi.com, Zeus raja para dewa dan dewa langit, cuaca, hukum dan ketertiban, takdir, serta kekuasaan raja, digambarkan sebagai laki-laki dewasa berwibawa berjanggut gelap, dengan atribut petir, tongkat kerajaan, dan elang.
statement.en: According to theoi.com, Zeus was King of the Gods and god of sky, weather, law and order, destiny and kingship, shown as a regal mature man with a dark beard, with the lightning bolt, royal sceptre and eagle.

claims.quote: In ancient Rome, Zeus was identified with the god Jupiter.

statement.id: Di Roma kuno, Zeus disamakan dengan dewa Jupiter.
statement.en: In ancient Rome, Zeus was identified with Jupiter.

claims.quote: Zeus was the youngest child of the Titans Kronos (Cronus) and Rheia. Kronos devoured each of his children as they were born, but Zeus escaped this fate when his mother spirited him away, handing the Titan a stone substitute wrapped in swaddling cloth.

statement.en: Zeus was the youngest child of the Titans Kronos and Rhea; Kronos devoured each child at birth, but Zeus escaped when his mother gave the Titan a swaddled stone.

claims.quote: The god was raised in secrecy on Mount Dikte in Krete (Crete) where he was nursed by nymphs on the milk of the goat Amaltheia

statement.id: Menurut theoi.com, Zeus dibesarkan secara rahasia di Gunung Dikte di Kreta dan diasuh para nimfa dengan susu kambing Amaltheia.
statement.en: According to theoi.com, Zeus was raised in secrecy on Mount Dikte in Crete, where nymphs nursed him on the milk of the goat Amaltheia.

claims.quote: In most traditions, he is married to Hera, by whom he is usually said to have fathered Ares, Eileithyia, Hebe, and Hephaestus.

statement.en: In most traditions Zeus is married to Hera, by whom he is usually said to have fathered Ares, Eileithyia, Hebe and Hephaestus.

statement.id: Menurut theoi.com, Zeus merayu banyak perempuan fana dalam samaran, misalnya Leda sebagai angsa, Europa sebagai banteng, dan Danae sebagai hujan emas.
statement.en: According to theoi.com, Zeus seduced many mortal women in disguise, such as Leda as a swan, Europa as a bull and Danae as a shower of gold.

claims.quote: Zeus was the king of the 12 Olympian gods and the supreme god in Greek religion. Zeus is often referred to as the Father, as the god of thunder, and the 'cloud-gatherer'. Zeus controlled the weather and offered signs and omens.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Zeus raja kedua belas dewa Olimpus dan dewa tertinggi agama Yunani; ia mengendalikan cuaca, memberi tanda dan pertanda, dan menegakkan keadilan serta ketertiban dari Gunung Olimpus.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Zeus was king of the twelve Olympians and supreme Greek god; he controlled the weather, gave signs and omens, and dispensed justice and order from Mount Olympus.

claims.quote: Zeus is the Greek continuation of *Dyēus, the name of the Proto-Indo-European god of the daytime sky

statement.id: Nama Zeus adalah lanjutan Yunani dari *Dyēus, nama dewa langit siang dalam bahasa Proto-Indo-Eropa.
statement.en: Zeus is the Greek continuation of *Dyēus, the Proto-Indo-European god of the daytime sky.

claims.quote: After the fall of the Titan-gods, Zeus and his brothers drew lots to divide rule of the cosmos - Zeus won the heavens, Poseidon the sea and Haides the underworld.

statement.id: Menurut theoi.com, setelah Titan jatuh, Zeus dan saudara-saudaranya mengundi pembagian kekuasaan atas kosmos: Zeus mendapat langit, Poseidon laut, dan Haides dunia bawah.
statement.en: According to theoi.com, once the Titan-gods had fallen, Zeus and his brothers drew lots to divide the cosmos among themselves, with Zeus receiving the heavens, Poseidon the sea and Haides the underworld.

claims.quote: Zeus liberated the six giant-sons of Heaven from the pit of Tartaros. In gratitude the Kyklopes (Cyclopes) armed him with lightning-bolts and the Hekatonkheires (Hundred-Handed) aided him in his assault on the Titanes with volleys of thrown boulders. Kronos and his allies were eventually defeated and banished to a prison beneath the earth.

statement.id: Menurut theoi.com, Zeus membebaskan enam putra raksasa Langit dari jurang Tartaros; para Kyklopes mempersenjatainya dengan petir dan para Hekatonkheires membantunya menyerang Titan dengan lemparan batu, hingga Kronos dan sekutunya kalah dan dibuang ke penjara di bawah bumi.
statement.en: According to theoi.com, Zeus freed the six giant sons of Heaven from the pit of Tartaros; the Kyklopes armed him with lightning-bolts and the Hekatonkheires aided his assault on the Titanes with thrown boulders, until Kronos and his allies were defeated and banished to a prison beneath the earth.

claims.quote: Upon coming of age Zeus recruited the goddess Metis to his cause. She served the Titan Kronos a magical draught which caused him to disgorge the young gods he had devoured.

statement.id: Menurut theoi.com, setelah dewasa Zeus merekrut dewi Metis, yang menyuguhkan ramuan ajaib kepada Kronos sehingga ia memuntahkan para dewa muda yang telah ditelannya.
statement.en: According to theoi.com, on coming of age Zeus recruited the goddess Metis, who served Kronos a magical draught that made him disgorge the young gods he had devoured.

claims.quote: Zeus devoured the pregnant goddess Metis when an oracle revealed that her son was destined to replace him as King of the Gods. Their child, Athena, was subsequently born in his belly and birthed directly from his head.

statement.id: Menurut theoi.com, Zeus menelan Metis yang sedang hamil ketika sebuah ramalan menyatakan putranya ditakdirkan menggantikannya sebagai Raja Para Dewa; anak mereka, Athena, kemudian lahir di perutnya dan keluar langsung dari kepalanya.
statement.en: According to theoi.com, Zeus devoured the pregnant Metis when an oracle revealed that her son was destined to replace him as King of the Gods; their child Athena was later born in his belly and birthed directly from his head.

claims.quote: Zeus married his sister Hera, queen of the heavens, after seducing her in the guise of a cuckoo-bird.

statement.id: Menurut theoi.com, Zeus menikahi saudarinya Hera, ratu langit, setelah merayunya dalam rupa burung kukuk.
statement.en: According to theoi.com, Zeus married his sister Hera, queen of the heavens, after seducing her in the guise of a cuckoo-bird.

claims.quote: Prometheus crafted the race of man and gave them fire stolen from the gods of heaven. Zeus punished this act by ordering the creation of the first woman, Pandora, and sent her to earth with a vessel full of troubles to plague mankind.

statement.id: Menurut theoi.com, Prometheus menciptakan umat manusia dan memberi mereka api yang dicuri dari para dewa; Zeus menghukumnya dengan memerintahkan penciptaan perempuan pertama, Pandora, yang dikirim ke bumi membawa bejana penuh malapetaka.
statement.en: According to theoi.com, Prometheus crafted the race of man and gave them fire stolen from the gods; Zeus punished this by ordering the creation of the first woman, Pandora, sent to earth with a vessel full of troubles.

claims.quote: The early generations of man descended into wickedness and corruption and Zeus decided to wipe them from the face of the earth with a great deluge. One virtuous couple, Deukalion and Pyrrha, were spared and afterwards allowed to repopulate the world with the casting of stones which transformed into men.

statement.id: Menurut theoi.com, Zeus memutuskan menghapus generasi awal manusia yang bejat dengan banjir besar; pasangan saleh Deukalion dan Pyrrha diselamatkan dan memulihkan dunia dengan melempar batu yang menjelma manusia.
statement.en: According to theoi.com, Zeus decided to wipe the wicked early generations of man from the earth with a great deluge; the virtuous couple Deukalion and Pyrrha were spared and repopulated the world with cast stones that turned into men.

claims.quote: The earth-goddess Gaia (Gaea), angered by the imprisonment of the Titanes, urged the Giants to rise up against the gods of Olympos. They laid siege to the heavenly fortress but Zeus laid low their king and many others with his deadly lightning-bolts.

statement.id: Menurut theoi.com, Gaia yang murka atas pemenjaraan para Titan mendorong para Giant memberontak melawan dewa-dewa Olimpos; mereka mengepung benteng surgawi, tetapi Zeus menjatuhkan raja mereka dan banyak lainnya dengan petirnya yang mematikan.
statement.en: According to theoi.com, Gaia, angered by the imprisonment of the Titanes, urged the Giants to rise against the gods of Olympos; they besieged the heavenly fortress but Zeus laid low their king and many others with his deadly lightning-bolts.

claims.quote: Gaia produced one more giant, Typhoeus, the most monstrous of his kind and set him upon Olympos. The rest of the gods fled in horror and Zeus himself was defeated in combat with the monster tearing the sinews from his limbs rendering him helpless. Pan later stole back the god's strength and, restored, Zeus defeated the giant in a rematch and bound him beneath Mount Etna.

statement.id: Menurut theoi.com, Gaia melahirkan Typhoeus, raksasa paling mengerikan, yang menyerang Olimpos; para dewa melarikan diri dan Zeus sendiri dikalahkan, otot-otot kakinya dirobek hingga tak berdaya. Pan kemudian mencuri kembali kekuatannya, dan Zeus memenangkan pertarungan ulang serta mengurung Typhoeus di bawah Gunung Etna.
statement.en: According to theoi.com, Gaia produced Typhoeus, the most monstrous of the giants, and set him upon Olympos; the gods fled and Zeus himself was defeated, the sinews torn from his limbs. Pan later stole back the god's strength, and Zeus defeated the giant in a rematch and bound him beneath Mount Etna.

claims.quote: Zeus punished the worst villians of myth for their impiety and crimes against the gods including Tantalos who stole ambrosia from heaven, Lykaon (Lycaon) who served human flesh to the gods, Ixion who attempted to rape Zeus' wife the goddess Hera, and Salmoneus who tried to imitate Zeus and steal the worship that was due the gods.

statement.id: Menurut theoi.com, Zeus menghukum para penjahat terburuk dalam mitos karena kedurhakaan mereka, di antaranya Tantalos yang mencuri ambrosia, Lykaon yang menghidangkan daging manusia kepada para dewa, Ixion yang mencoba memperkosa Hera, dan Salmoneus yang menirukan Zeus.
statement.en: According to theoi.com, Zeus punished the worst villains of myth for impiety, including Tantalos who stole ambrosia, Lykaon who served human flesh to the gods, Ixion who attempted to rape Hera, and Salmoneus who tried to imitate Zeus.

claims.quote: Zeus' most distinctive attribute was his stylized lightning bolt which he wielded in his hand like a javelin. His other attributes included a royal sceptre, a throne, an eagle, a miniature Nike (winged goddess of victory), and the aigis (a goat-skin arm-guard).

statement.id: Menurut theoi.com, atribut Zeus yang paling khas adalah petirnya yang digenggam seperti lembing; atribut lainnya mencakup tongkat kerajaan, takhta, elang, Nike mini, dan aigis (pelindung lengan dari kulit kambing).
statement.en: According to theoi.com, Zeus' most distinctive attribute was his lightning bolt wielded like a javelin; others included a royal sceptre, a throne, an eagle, a miniature Nike and the aigis (a goat-skin arm-guard).

claims.quote: Zeus' sacred animals were the eagle and the bull. In myth he abducted the youth Ganymede in the shape of an eagle and the maiden Europa in the guise of a bull.

statement.id: Menurut theoi.com, hewan suci Zeus adalah elang dan banteng; dalam mitos ia menculik pemuda Ganymede dalam rupa elang dan gadis Europa dalam rupa banteng.
statement.en: According to theoi.com, Zeus' sacred animals were the eagle and the bull; in myth he abducted the youth Ganymede as an eagle and the maiden Europa as a bull.

claims.quote: His sacred plants were the evergreen holm oak and the olive tree. At the ancient oracle of Dodona Zeus' priests were inspired by the rustling of oak-leaves, and at the Olympic Games victors were crowned with a wreath of olive-leaves picked from the god's sacred grove.

statement.id: Menurut theoi.com, tanaman suci Zeus adalah pohon ek holm dan zaitun; di orakel kuno Dodona para imam terilhami desir daun ek, dan di Olimpiade para pemenang dimahkotai karangan daun zaitun dari hutan suci sang dewa.
statement.en: According to theoi.com, Zeus' sacred plants were the holm oak and the olive tree; at the ancient oracle of Dodona his priests were inspired by the rustling of oak-leaves, and at the Olympic Games victors were crowned with olive-leaves from the god's sacred grove.

claims.quote: His throne was guarded by four winged spirits, two male and two female, named Kratos (Strength), Zelos (Rivalry), Nike (Victory) and Bia (Force).

statement.id: Menurut theoi.com, takhta Zeus dijaga empat roh bersayap, dua laki-laki dan dua perempuan, bernama Kratos (Kekuatan), Zelos (Persaingan), Nike (Kemenangan), dan Bia (Paksaan).
statement.en: According to theoi.com, Zeus' throne was guarded by four winged spirits, two male and two female, named Kratos (Strength), Zelos (Rivalry), Nike (Victory) and Bia (Force).

short_description.id: Apollo adalah salah satu dewa Olimpus dalam agama dan mitologi Yunani kuno, dengan fungsi cahaya, penyembuhan, nubuat, musik, puisi, dan panahan; putra Zeus dan Leto serta saudara kembar Artemis.
short_description.en: Apollo is one of the Olympian gods of ancient Greek religion and myth, with functions including light, healing, prophecy, music, poetry and archery; son of Zeus and Leto and twin of Artemis.

long_description.id:
Apollo adalah salah satu dewa Olimpus dalam agama dan mitologi Yunani kuno, dengan fungsi yang mencakup cahaya, penyembuhan, nubuat, musik, puisi, dan panahan. Ia putra Zeus dan Leto serta saudara kembar Artemis, dan menurut World History Encyclopedia ia lahir di Pulau Delos. Menurut theoi.com, ia digambarkan sebagai pemuda tampan tanpa janggut berambut panjang. Busurnya, menurut World History Encyclopedia, dibuat oleh Hephaestus.

Sebagai dewa pelindung Delphi (Apollo Pythios), Apollo adalah dewa orakel Delphi dan dewa penyucian ritual, dan nubuatnya sering dimintai petunjuk. Menurut legenda yang dicatat World History Encyclopedia, ia mendirikan orakel itu di tempat ia membunuh ular Python, dan Pythian Games dimulai untuk memperingati kematian makhluk itu. Sumber klasik berbeda soal pemilik orakel sebelumnya: menurut Apollodorus orakel itu milik Themis, sedangkan menurut Hyginus milik Python sendiri.

Apollo umumnya dipandang sebagai dewa penolong yang menolak kejahatan, bergelar Alexicacus. Ia membebaskan manusia dari wabah, tetapi juga dapat mendatangkan penyakit dan wabah dengan panahnya; menurut theoi.com, kematian mendadak dipercaya akibat panah Apollo. Dalam Iliad, menurut World History Encyclopedia, ia berpihak kepada bangsa Troya dan membawa wabah kepada bangsa Achaea. Sisi gelapnya juga tampak pada kisah Niobe dan satir Marsyas.

Sebagai dewa mousike, Apollo membawahi segala musik, lagu, tari, dan puisi; ia penemu musik dawai dan sering menjadi pendamping para Muse. Menurut World History Encyclopedia, ia memperoleh liranya dari Hermes. Anaknya yang paling terkenal antara lain Orpheus dan Asclepius; Zeus membunuh Asclepius karena menghidupkan kembali seorang manusia fana, dan Apollo membalas dengan membunuh para Kiklops.

Dalam seni Yunani kuno Apollo paling sering tampil sebagai pemuda rupawan tanpa janggut dan dikenali dari kithara atau lira, trivet perunggu, rusa, serta busur dan tempat anak panah. Menurut World History Encyclopedia, benda yang dikaitkan dengannya mencakup busur perak dan kithara dari cangkang kura-kura; sumber lain menambahkan pedang, plektrum, dan trivet persembahan sebagai lambang nubuatnya. Ia juga mengawasi upacara inisiasi para pemuda yang memasuki masyarakat warga dan menjadi prajurit.

Dalam konteks sastra, Apollo melambangkan keselarasan, keteraturan, dan nalar, yang dikontraskan dengan Dionysus. Ia sering dikaitkan dengan matahari dan Helios, tetapi sumber berbeda soal sejak kapan kaitan itu ada. Menurut tradisi Yunani ia membantu para pemukim mendirikan kota Troya, tetapi kisah ini mungkin mencerminkan pengaruh dari arah sebaliknya, karena teks Het menyebut dewa Asia Kecil bernama Appaliunas atau Apalunas.
long_description.en:
Apollo is a god of the Olympian circle in ancient Greek religion and mythology. Light, healing, prophecy, music, poetry and archery all fall within his domains. Zeus and Leto are his parents and Artemis is his twin; the World History Encyclopedia places his birth on the island of Delos. Theoi.com says he was pictured as a handsome youth, beardless and long-haired. The same encyclopedia says his bow was made by Hephaestus.

Apollo, patron god of Delphi (Apollo Pythios), is the god of the Delphic oracle and of ritual purification, and people often sought guidance from his oracles. A legend recorded by the World History Encyclopedia says he founded the oracle on the spot where he killed the serpent Python, and that the Pythian games began in memory of that creature. Classical sources disagree about who held the oracle before him: Apollodorus names Themis, while Hyginus says Python held it himself.

Apollo was generally regarded as a helper who turns evil away, bearing the title Alexicacus. He rescued people from epidemics, yet his arrows could also bring sickness and plague; theoi.com notes that sudden deaths were believed to come from his arrows. In the Iliad, says the World History Encyclopedia, he takes the Trojan side and sends plague upon the Achaeans. His darker side also shows in the stories of Niobe and the satyr Marsyas.

As god of mousike, Apollo presides over every kind of music, song, dance and poetry; he invented string music and often keeps company with the Muses. The World History Encyclopedia says he obtained his lyre from Hermes. Among his best-known children are Orpheus and Asclepius; Zeus killed Asclepius for reviving a mortal, and Apollo took revenge by killing the Cyclopes.

In ancient Greek art Apollo most often appears as a handsome beardless youth, recognised by a kithara or lyre, a bronze tripod, a deer, and a bow and quiver. The World History Encyclopedia lists a silver bow and a kithara made from a tortoise shell among his associated objects; a second source adds the sword, the plectrum and the sacrificial tripod as an emblem of his prophetic power. He also oversaw the initiation rites of young men entering the full civic community and becoming warriors.

In literary contexts Apollo stands for harmony, order and reason, set against Dionysus. He is often linked with the sun and Helios, though sources differ on how early that link dates. Greek tradition says he helped colonists found the city of Troy, but this may reflect influence running the other way, since Hittite texts mention an Asia Minor god called Appaliunas or Apalunas.

literal_meaning.id: Asal katanya tidak jelas; orang Yunani paling sering mengaitkannya dengan kata kerja apollymi, "menghancurkan".
literal_meaning.en: Its origin is unclear; the Greeks most often linked it with the verb apollymi, "to destroy".

who.en: An Olympian god whose functions include light, healing, prophecy, music, poetry and archery.

famous_for.en: Slaying the serpent Python at Delphi, presiding over music and prophecy, and being both helper and bringer of plague.

did_you_know.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Apollo konon langsung berubah dari bayi menjadi pria dewasa pada kecapan pertama ambrosia.
did_you_know.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Apollo was said to have changed at once from babe to man at his first taste of ambrosia.

cultural_context.id: Menurut Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology di theoi.com, Apollo beserta pemujaan, festival, dan orakelnya lebih besar pengaruhnya atas orang Yunani daripada dewa lain mana pun. Menurut World History Encyclopedia, ia sangat dicintai kemungkinan besar karena kaitannya dengan musik, puisi, penyucian, penyembuhan, dan pengobatan.
cultural_context.en: According to the Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology on theoi.com, Apollo and his worship, festivals and oracles had more influence on the Greeks than any other god. According to the World History Encyclopedia he was much loved most likely because of his links with music, poetry, purification, healing and medicine.

description.en: As god of the Delphic oracle, Apollo's prophecies were often consulted for guidance in various matters.

description.id: Pengobatan dan penyembuhan dikaitkan dengan Apollo, secara langsung atau lewat putranya Asclepius; ia membebaskan manusia dari wabah.
description.en: Medicine and healing are associated with Apollo, directly or through his son Asclepius; he delivered people from epidemics.

description.id: Dengan panahnya Apollo dapat mendatangkan penyakit dan wabah; kematian mendadak dipercaya akibat panahnya.
description.en: With his arrows Apollo could bring ill health and plague; sudden deaths were believed to be the effect of his arrows.

description.id: Sebagai dewa mousike, Apollo membawahi segala musik, lagu, tari, dan puisi, dan ia penemu musik dawai.
description.en: As god of mousike Apollo presides over all music, song, dance and poetry, and invented string music.

summary.id: Apollo, putra Zeus dan Leto serta saudara kembar Artemis, lahir di Pulau Delos. Pada kecapan pertama ambrosia ia konon langsung menjadi pria dewasa, lalu diberi busur buatan Hephaestus.
summary.en: Apollo, son of Zeus and Leto and twin of Artemis, was born on the island of Delos. At his first taste of ambrosia he was said to become a man at once, and was then given a bow made by Hephaestus.

title.en: Slaying Python and founding the Delphic oracle

role.en: Slayer of the serpent and master of the oracle
