short_description.id: Poseidon adalah dewa Olimpus dalam agama Yunani kuno yang membawahi laut, badai, gempa bumi, dan kuda, serta pelindung para pelaut.
short_description.en: Poseidon is an Olympian god of ancient Greek religion presiding over the sea, storms, earthquakes, and horses, and a protector of seafarers.

long_description.id:
Poseidon adalah salah satu dari dua belas dewa Olimpus dalam agama dan mitologi Yunani kuno yang membawahi laut, badai, gempa bumi, dan kuda. Ia pelindung para pelaut dan penjaga banyak kota Helenik. World History Encyclopedia menyebutnya dewa laut dan sungai, pencipta badai dan banjir, serta pelindung pelaut dan pelindung kuda. Theoi menggambarkannya sebagai pria dewasa berbadan kekar dengan janggut gelap yang memegang trisula, yaitu tombak ikan bermata tiga, dan World History Encyclopedia menambahkan bahwa trisula itu dibuat para Kiklops. Menurut Theoi, hewan sucinya adalah banteng, kuda, dan lumba-lumba.

Dalam Iliad 15, Poseidon sendiri berkata bahwa ia dan Zeus serta Hades adalah tiga bersaudara putra Cronos dan Rhea; ketika undian dikocok ia memperoleh laut kelabu, Hades kegelapan, dan Zeus langit luas, dan Iris menyapanya sebagai "Pemeluk Bumi, dewa berambut gelap". Menurut Theoi, pembagian itu terjadi setelah jatuhnya para Titan dan laut menjadi wilayahnya. Ia dikisahkan ditelan ayahnya, Kronos, saat lahir, dan kemudian bersama saudara-saudaranya mengalahkan dewa-dewa yang lebih tua dengan trisula buatan para Kiklops. Entri kamus yang dimuat Theoi mencatat bahwa dalam puisi paling awal ia setara Zeus dalam martabat tetapi lebih lemah.

Entri kamus yang dimuat Theoi menyebut Poseidon sebagai penguasa laut yang menghimpun awan dan memanggil badai, tetapi juga dapat memberi pelayaran yang berhasil dan menyelamatkan orang yang dalam bahaya. Menurut Wikipedia, bila ia tersinggung atau diabaikan, konon ia menghantam tanah dengan trisulanya sehingga timbul gempa, orang tenggelam, dan kapal karam. Istananya, menurut entri itu, berada di kedalaman laut dekat Aegae di Euboea, dan kudanya menarik keretanya di atas ombak; ia dianggap pencipta kuda serta pelindung pacuan kuda.

Poseidon tampil dalam banyak kisah: ia bertanding melawan Athena untuk menguasai Athena, membantu membangun tembok Troya lalu mengirim monster laut ketika Raja Laomedon menolak membayar, dan menimpa Polybotes dengan pulau Kos. Dalam Odyssey, ia mengutuk Odiseus mengembara di laut sepuluh tahun karena putranya Polyphemus dibutakan. Ia menikahi Amphitrite, dan putra mereka adalah Triton; ia juga disebut ayah Theseus, Pegasos, Arion, dan Polyphemos.

Pemujaan Poseidon berasal dari akhir Zaman Perunggu dan peradaban Mycenae, dan Pylos menjadikannya dewa utama. Pesta Isthmia dekat Korintus diadakan untuk menghormatinya, dan kuil abad ke-5 SM-nya masih berdiri di Sounion. Dalam seni ia paling sering digambarkan dewasa dan berjanggut dengan trisula. Entri kamus yang dimuat Theoi mencatat bahwa kurban untuknya pada umumnya berupa banteng hitam dan putih, dan pacuan kuda serta kereta diadakan untuk menghormatinya di tanah genting Korintus, sedangkan World History Encyclopedia mencatat bahwa para pelaut dan nelayan di mana-mana memberi persembahan nazar kepadanya demi perlindungan. Menurut Wikipedia, Poseidon masih dipuja hingga kini dalam agama Helenik modern.
long_description.en:
In ancient Greek religion and mythology, Poseidon ranks among the twelve Olympians and has charge of the sea, storms, earthquakes, and horses. He protects seafarers and guards many Hellenic cities. World History Encyclopedia calls him god of seas and rivers, maker of storms and floods, protector of mariners and patron of horses. Theoi depicts him as a mature man of sturdy build with a dark beard holding a trident, a three-pronged fishing spear, and World History Encyclopedia adds that the trident was fashioned by the Cyclopes. According to Theoi, his sacred animals were the bull, the horse and the dolphin.

In Iliad 15, Poseidon himself says that he, Zeus, and Hades are three brethren, sons of Cronos and Rhea; when the lots were shaken he won the grey sea, Hades the murky darkness, and Zeus the broad heaven, and Iris addresses him as "O Earth-Enfolder, thou dark-haired god". According to Theoi, the division happened after the fall of the Titans and the sea became his domain. He is said to have been swallowed by his father Kronos at birth, and later with his brothers he defeated the elder gods using a trident crafted by the Cyclopes. The dictionary entry reproduced by Theoi notes that in the earliest poems he is equal to Zeus in dignity but weaker.

The dictionary entry reproduced by Theoi presents Poseidon as ruler of the sea who gathers clouds and calls forth storms, but who can also grant a successful voyage and save those in danger. According to Wikipedia, if he was slighted or neglected he was said to strike the earth with his trident, bringing earthquakes, drownings, and shipwrecks. His palace, according to that entry, was in the depth of the sea near Aegae in Euboea, and his fish-tailed horses drew his chariot; he was regarded as the creator of the horse and the protector of horse races.

Poseidon features in many stories: he contests Athens with Athena, helps build the walls of Troy and then sends a sea-monster when King Laomedon refuses to pay, and crushes Polybotes beneath the island of Kos. In the Odyssey he curses Odysseus to wander the sea for ten years because his son Polyphemus was blinded. He married Amphitrite, and their son was Triton; he is also named as father of Theseus, Pegasos, Arion, and Polyphemos.

Worship of Poseidon dates to the late Bronze Age and the Mycenaean civilization, and Pylos had him as its main god. The Isthmian games near Corinth were held in his honour, and his 5th-century BCE temple still stands at Sounion. In art he is most often shown mature and bearded with a trident. According to the dictionary entry reproduced by Theoi, he was usually offered black and white bulls, and the Corinthian isthmus hosted horse and chariot races for him; World History Encyclopedia adds that mariners and fishermen everywhere made votive offerings to him for protection. According to Wikipedia, Poseidon is still worshipped today in modern Hellenic religion.

summary.en: After the Titans fell, Poseidon and his brothers drew lots for the cosmos, and the sea became his domain.

summary.id: Para Kiklops membuat trisula ajaib bagi Poseidon, dan bersama Zeus dan Haides ia mengalahkan dewa-dewa yang lebih tua serta memenjarakan mereka di Tartaros.
summary.en: The Kyklopes made a magical trident for Poseidon; together with Zeus and Haides he overcame the elder gods and shut them away in Tartaros.

role.en: Poseidon offers gifts to the city.

summary.id: Poseidon bertanding melawan Athena untuk menguasai Athena; hadiah zaitun dari Athena lebih disukai, dan Poseidon menurut Theoi menimpakan kekeringan pada negeri itu.
summary.en: Poseidon contested Athens with Athena; Athena's olive tree gained greater favour, and according to Theoi Poseidon afflicted the land with drought.

role.id: Poseidon membangun tembok lalu membalas penolakan membayar.
role.en: Poseidon builds the walls and avenges the refusal to pay.

summary.id: Poseidon membantu membangun tembok Troya; ketika Raja Laomedon menolak membayar upah yang dijanjikan, ia mengirim monster laut. World History Encyclopedia mencatat versi lain, bahwa ia diwajibkan membangunnya sebagai hukuman atas upaya menggulingkan Zeus.
summary.en: Poseidon helped build the walls of Troy; when King Laomedon refused the promised payment, he sent a sea-monster. World History Encyclopedia records another version, in which he was made to build them as punishment for trying to overthrow Zeus.

role.en: Poseidon punishes the one who blinded his son.

summary.id: Odiseus membutakan Polyphemus, putra Poseidon, dan Poseidon menghukumnya dengan badai serta mengutuknya mengembara di laut selama sepuluh tahun.
summary.en: Odysseus blinds Polyphemus, Poseidon's son, and Poseidon punishes him with storms and curses him to wander the sea for ten years.

summary.id: Karena Minos tidak mengurbankan banteng pemberian sang dewa, Poseidon menyihir Pasiphae hingga jatuh cinta pada banteng itu, dan lahirlah Minotaur.
summary.en: Because Minos failed to sacrifice the bull given by the god, Poseidon bewitched Pasiphae into falling in love with the bull, and the Minotaur resulted.

caption.en: Poseidon — AI artistic interpretation based on features in folklore sources.

sources.title: Homer, Iliad, Book 15 (trans. A. T. Murray)
sources.author: Homer; translated by A. T. Murray

claim.id: Poseidon adalah dewa Olimpus Yunani kuno yang membawahi laut, badai, gempa bumi, dan kuda.
claim.en: Poseidon is an ancient Greek Olympian god of the sea, storms, earthquakes, and horses.

claims_provenance.quote: is one of the twelve Olympians in ancient Greek religion and mythology, presiding over the sea, storms, earthquakes and horses.

claim.id: Poseidon disebut pelindung pelaut dan banyak kota Yunani.
claim.en: Poseidon is described as a protector of seafarers and many Hellenic cities.

claims_provenance.quote: He was the protector of seafarers and the guardian of many Hellenic cities and colonies.

claim.id: Padanan Romawi Poseidon adalah Neptune.
claim.en: Poseidon's Roman counterpart is Neptune.

claims_provenance.quote: His Roman equivalent is Neptune.

claim.id: Theoi menyebut Poseidon dewa laut, gempa, banjir, kekeringan, dan kuda, digambarkan sebagai pria dewasa berjanggut dengan trisula.
claim.en: Theoi describes Poseidon as god of the sea, earthquakes, floods, drought, and horses, shown as a bearded mature man with a trident.

claims_provenance.quote: POSEIDON was the Olympian god of the sea, earthquakes, floods, drought and horses. He was depicted as a mature man with a sturdy build and dark beard holding a trident

claim.id: Menurut Theoi, Poseidon dan saudara-saudaranya mengundi kosmos setelah jatuhnya para Titan, dan Poseidon mendapat laut.
claim.en: According to Theoi, Poseidon and his brothers drew lots for the cosmos after the Titans fell, and Poseidon received the sea.

claims_provenance.quote: Poseidon and his brothers drew lots for the division of the cosmos after the fall of the Titanes, and won the sea as his domain.

claim.id: World History Encyclopedia menyebut Poseidon dewa laut dan sungai, pembuat badai dan banjir, serta pembawa gempa.
claim.en: World History Encyclopedia calls Poseidon god of seas and rivers, creator of storms and floods, and bringer of earthquakes.

claims_provenance.quote: Poseidon was the Greek god of the sea and rivers, creator of storms and floods, and the bringer of earthquakes and destruction.

claim.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Poseidon melindungi pelaut dan menjadi pelindung kuda.
claim.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, Poseidon protected mariners and was patron of horses.

claims_provenance.quote: He was a protector to mariners and, as a tamer of horses, the patron of that animal and horse breeding.

claim.id: Dalam Odisseia, Odiseus membuat Poseidon marah dengan membutakan Polifemos, putranya, sehingga Poseidon menghukumnya dengan badai.
claim.en: In the Odyssey, Odysseus angers Poseidon by blinding his son Polyphemus, and Poseidon punishes him with storms.

claims_provenance.quote: In the Odyssey, during the sea-voyage from Troy back home to Ithaca, the Greek hero Odysseus provokes Poseidon's fury by blinding his son, the Cyclops Polyphemus, resulting in Poseidon punishing him with storms

claim.id: Menurut Theoi, atribut Poseidon yang paling khas adalah trisula, tombak ikan bermata tiga; kadang ia juga memegang batu karang yang dipenuhi makhluk laut.
claim.en: According to Theoi, Poseidon's most distinctive attribute was the trident, a three-pronged fishing spear; he sometimes also wielded a boulder encrusted with sea creatures.

claims_provenance.quote: Poseidon's most distinctive attribute was the trident, a three-pronged fishing spear. He sometimes also wielded a boulder encrusted with sea creatures

claim.id: Menurut Theoi, hewan suci Poseidon adalah banteng, kuda, dan lumba-lumba.
claim.en: According to Theoi, Poseidon's sacred animals were the bull, the horse and the dolphin.

claims_provenance.quote: Poseidon's sacred animals were the bull, the horse and the dolphin.

claim.id: Menurut Theoi, keretanya ditarik sepasang kuda berekor ikan (bahasa Yunani: hippokampoi).
claim.en: According to Theoi, his chariot was drawn by a pair of fish-tailed horses (Greek: hippokampoi).

claims_provenance.quote: His chariot was drawn by a pair of fish-tailed horses (Greek: hippokampoi).

claim.id: Menurut Theoi, Poseidon bertanding melawan dewi Athena untuk menguasai Athena dan menghasilkan kuda pertama sebagai hadiah; ketika sang raja menolak memberinya hadiah kemenangan, ia menimpakan kekeringan pada negeri itu.
claim.en: According to Theoi, Poseidon entered a contest with the goddess Athena for dominion over Athens and produced the very first horse as a gift; when the king refused him the prize, he afflicted the land with drought.

claims_provenance.quote: He entered a contest with the goddess Athena for dominion over Athens and produced the very first horse as a gift. But the king refused him the prize and in anger Poseidon afflicted the land with drought.

claim.id: Menurut Theoi, Poseidon membantu membangun tembok kota Troya, tetapi ketika Raja Laomedon menolak membayar upah yang dijanjikan, ia mengirim monster laut untuk merusak negeri itu.
claim.en: According to Theoi, Poseidon helped build the walls of Troy, but when King Laomedon refused the promised payment, he sent a sea-monster to ravage the land.

claims_provenance.quote: The god helped build the walls of the city of Troy, but when King Laomedon refused the payment he had promised, Poseidon sent a sea-monster to ravage the land.

claim.id: Menurut Theoi, ketika para Gigantes mengepung dewa-dewa Olimpus, Poseidon menimpa Polybotes dengan pulau Kos.
claim.en: According to Theoi, when the Gigantes (Giants) besieged the gods of Olympos, Poseidon crushed Polybotes beneath the island of Kos.

claims_provenance.quote: When the Gigantes (Giants) besieged the gods of Olympos, Poseidon crushed Polybotes beneath the island of Kos (Cos).

claim.id: Menurut entri kamus yang dimuat Theoi, lambang kekuasaan Poseidon adalah trisula, yang ia pakai untuk memecahkan batu karang, memanggil atau menenangkan badai, mengguncang bumi, dan sebagainya.
claim.en: According to the dictionary entry reproduced by Theoi, the symbol of Poseidon's power was the trident, with which he used to shatter rocks, call forth or subdue storms, shake the earth, and the like.

claims_provenance.quote: The symbol of Poseidon's power was the trident, or a spear with three points, with which he used to shatter rocks, to call forth or subdue storms, to shake the earth, and the like.

claim.id: Menurut Theoi, Poseidon menikahi dewi laut Amphitrite, anak sulung Nereus, ikatan pernikahan yang mengamankan kekuasaannya atas laut; putra mereka adalah dewa berekor ikan, Triton.
claim.en: According to Theoi, Poseidon married the marine-goddess Amphitrite, eldest child of Nereus, a marital alliance which secured his dominion over the sea; their son was the fish-tailed god Triton.

claims_provenance.quote: Poseidon married the marine-goddess Amphitrite, eldest child of Nereus, first born son of Pontos (the Sea), a marital alliance which secured his dominion over the sea. Their son was the fish-tailed god Triton.

claim.id: Entri kamus yang dimuat Theoi menyatakan bahwa sebagai penguasa laut, Poseidon digambarkan mengumpulkan awan dan memanggil badai, tetapi juga mampu memberi pelayaran yang berhasil dan menyelamatkan orang yang dalam bahaya, dan semua dewa laut lain tunduk kepadanya.
claim.en: The dictionary entry reproduced by Theoi says that, as ruler of the sea, Poseidon is described as gathering clouds and calling forth storms, but also as able to grant a successful voyage and save those in danger, and all other marine divinities are subject to him.

claims_provenance.quote: Being the ruler of the sea (the Mediterranean), he is described as gathering clouds and calling forth storms, but at the same he has it in his power to grant a successful voyage and save those who are in danger, and all other marine divinities are subject to him.

claim.id: Entri kamus yang dimuat Theoi menyatakan bahwa istana Poseidon berada di kedalaman laut dekat Aegae di Euboea.
claim.en: The dictionary entry reproduced by Theoi says the palace of Poseidon was in the depth of the sea near Aegae in Euboea.

claims_provenance.quote: The palace of Poseidon was in the depth of the sea near Aegae in Euboea

claim.id: Entri kamus yang dimuat Theoi menyatakan bahwa Poseidon dianggap pencipta kuda, dipercaya mengajarkan manusia mengendalikan kuda dengan kekang, serta pencetus dan pelindung pacuan kuda.
claim.en: The dictionary entry reproduced by Theoi says Poseidon was regarded as the creator of the horse, believed to have taught men to manage horses by the bridle, and to have been the originator and protector of horse races.

claims_provenance.quote: He was further regarded as the creator of the horse, and was accordingly believed to have taught men the art of managing horses by the bridle, and to have been the originator and protector of horse races.

claim.id: Menurut Theoi, Poseidon juga memiliki banyak keturunan, termasuk raksasa seperti Antaios dan Kiklops Polyphemos, kuda ajaib seperti Pegasos dan Arion, serta berbagai raja dan pahlawan manusia seperti Theseus dan Bellerophontes.
claim.en: According to Theoi, Poseidon also had numerous offspring, including giants such as Antaios and the cyclops Polyphemos, magical horses like Pegasos and Arion, and various human kings and heroes including Theseus and Bellerophontes.

claims_provenance.quote: He also had numerous mortal offspring including giants such as Antaios and the cyclops Polyphemos, magical horses like Pegasos and Arion, and various human kings, heroes and villians including Theseus and Bellerophontes.

claim.id: Menurut Theoi, dalam Perang Titan, para Kiklops membuat trisula ajaib bagi Poseidon, dan bersama saudara-saudaranya Zeus dan Haides ia mengalahkan dewa-dewa yang lebih tua serta memenjarakan mereka di Tartaros.
claim.en: According to Theoi, during the War of the Titanes the Kyklopes crafted a magical trident for Poseidon, and with his brothers Zeus and Haides he defeated the elder gods and imprisoned them in Tartaros.

claims_provenance.quote: During the War of the Titanes, the Kyklopes (Cyclopes) crafted a magical trident for Poseidon, and together with his brothers Zeus and Haides he defeated the elder gods and imprisoned them in Tartaros.

claim.id: Menurut Theoi, saat lahir Poseidon ditelan bulat-bulat oleh ayahnya Kronos, tetapi Zeus kemudian meminta bantuan dewi Metis yang memberi sang Titan ramuan ajaib sehingga ia memuntahkan sang dewa.
claim.en: According to Theoi, at birth Poseidon was swallowed whole by his father Kronos, but Zeus later enlisted the goddess Metis, who fed the Titan a magical elixir causing him to disgorge the god.

claims_provenance.quote: At birth Poseidon was swallowed whole by his father Kronos (Cronus), but Zeus later enlisted the aid of the goddess Metis who fed the Titan a magical elixir causing him to disgorge the god.

claim.id: Entri kamus yang dimuat Theoi menyatakan bahwa dalam puisi-puisi paling awal Poseidon digambarkan setara dengan Zeus dalam martabat, tetapi lebih lemah.
claim.en: The dictionary entry reproduced by Theoi says that in the earliest poems Poseidon is described as equal to Zeus in dignity, but weaker.

claims_provenance.quote: In the earliest poems, Poseidon is described as indeed equal to Zeus in dignity, but weaker.

claim.id: Entri kamus yang dimuat Theoi mencatat bahwa Herodotus menyatakan nama dan pemujaan Poseidon diimpor ke Yunani dari Libya, tetapi ia kemungkinan dewa berasal dari bangsa Pelasgia.
claim.en: The dictionary entry reproduced by Theoi notes that Herodotus states the name and worship of Poseidon was imported to the Greeks from Libya, but that he was probably a divinity of Pelasgian origin.

claims_provenance.quote: Herodotus (ii. 50, iv. 188) states, that the name and worship of Poseidon was imported to the Greeks from Libya, but he was probably a divinity of Pelasgian origin

claim.id: Entri kamus yang dimuat Theoi menyatakan bahwa kurban untuk Poseidon pada umumnya berupa banteng hitam dan putih.
claim.en: The dictionary entry reproduced by Theoi says the sacrifices offered to him generally consisted of black and white bulls.

claims_provenance.quote: The sacrifices offered to him generally consisted of black and white bulls

claim.id: Entri kamus yang dimuat Theoi menyatakan bahwa pacuan kuda dan kereta diadakan untuk menghormatinya di tanah genting Korintus.
claim.en: The dictionary entry reproduced by Theoi says horse and chariot races were held in his honour on the Corinthian isthmus.

claims_provenance.quote: horse and chariot races were held in his honour on the Corinthian isthmus

claim.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, pemujaan Poseidon berasal dari akhir Zaman Perunggu dan peradaban Mycenae (puncaknya abad ke-15 hingga ke-12 SM), dibuktikan oleh prasasti Linear B yang ditemukan di Pylos dan Knossos.
claim.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, cults to Poseidon date back to the late Bronze Age and the Mycenaean civilization (at its peak from the 15th to 12th century BCE), as attested by Linear B inscriptions found at Pylos and Knossos.

claims_provenance.quote: Cults to Poseidon date as far back as the late Bronze Age and the Mycenaean civilization (at its peak from the 15th to 12th century BCE), as attested by Linear B inscriptions found at Pylos in the Peloponnese and Knossos on Crete.

claim.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Pylos menjadikan Poseidon dewa utamanya dengan seorang pendeta perempuan sebagai kepala pemujaannya.
claim.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, Pylos had Poseidon as its main god with a priestess as the head of his cult.

claims_provenance.quote: Pylos, we know, had Poseidon as its main god with a priestess as the head of his cult.

claim.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Poseidon sering ikut campur dalam rencana Zeus dan pernah mencoba menggulingkannya dengan bantuan Hera dan Athena; sebagai hukuman atas pengkhianatan itu ia diwajibkan membangun tembok Troya.
claim.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, Poseidon often interfered in the plans of Zeus and once attempted to overthrow his brother with the aid of Hera and Athena; as punishment for this treachery he was made to build the walls of Troy.

claims_provenance.quote: Seemingly not content with the seas alone, Poseidon often interfered in the plans of Zeus, and once even attempted to overthrow his brother with the aid of Hera and Athena. It was as punishment for this treachery that Poseidon was made to build the magnificent walls of Troy.

claim.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Homeros dan Hesiodos paling sering menyebut Poseidon sebagai 'Penggoyang Bumi yang bergemuruh', 'si berambut gelap', dan 'pelingkar bumi'.
claim.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, Homer and Hesiod most often describe Poseidon as 'deep sounding Earth-shaker', the 'dark-haired one' and 'encircler of the earth'.

claims_provenance.quote: Poseidon is most often described by both Homer and Hesiod as 'deep sounding Earth-shaker', the 'dark-haired one' and 'encircler of the earth.'

claim.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, sebagai balas dendam atas dibutakannya putranya Polyphemus, Poseidon mengutuk Odiseus mengembara di laut selama sepuluh tahun.
claim.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, in revenge for the blinding of his son Polyphemus, Poseidon cursed Odysseus to wander the sea for ten years.

claims_provenance.quote: In revenge for the blinding of his son Polyphemus, he cursed Odysseus to wander the sea for ten years.

claim.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Poseidon sangat dihormati di Tanah Genting Korintus dan menjadi pusat pacuan kuda serta acara lain pada Pesta Isthmia Panhelenik yang diadakan untuk menghormatinya dekat Korintus.
claim.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, Poseidon was particularly revered at the Isthmus of Corinth and was the focus of horse races and other events at the Panhellenic Isthmian games held in his honour near Corinth.

claims_provenance.quote: The god was particularly revered here and was the focus of horse races and other events at the Panhellenic Isthmian games which were held in his honour near Corinth.

claim.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Sounion adalah situs strategis yang dekat dengan sang dewa, dan kuil abad ke-5 SM-nya masih berdiri di tanjung yang menghadap kapal-kapal yang memasuki Teluk Saronik.
claim.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, Sounion was another strategic site close to the god, and his 5th-century BCE temple still stands on the promontory overlooking ships entering the Saronic gulf.

claims_provenance.quote: Sounion was another strategic site close to the god, and his 5th-century BCE temple still stands on the promontory which overlooks ships entering the Saronic gulf.

claim.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, dalam pertandingan legendaris melawan Athena untuk menjadi pelindung Athena, Poseidon menawarkan mata air asin dan seekor kuda, tetapi hadiah pohon zaitun dari Athena lebih disukai.
claim.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, in the legendary competition with Athena for the patronage of Athens, Poseidon offered a saltwater spring and a horse, but Athena's gift of an olive tree gained greater favour.

claims_provenance.quote: In the legendary competition with Athena to win the patronage of Athens, Poseidon offered to the city the gifts of a saltwater spring and a horse. However, Athena's gift of an olive tree gained greater favour

claim.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, dalam seni Yunani kuno Poseidon paling sering digambarkan dewasa dan berjanggut, sering mengacungkan trisula buatan para Kiklops yang ia pakai menciptakan gempa dengan menghantamkannya ke tanah.
claim.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, in ancient Greek art Poseidon is most commonly depicted as mature and bearded, often brandishing his trident, fashioned by the Cyclopes, with which he would create earthquakes by striking it to the ground.

claims_provenance.quote: Poseidon is most commonly depicted in ancient Greek art as mature and bearded. He often brandishes his trident, fashioned by the Cyclopes, with which he would create earthquakes by striking it to the ground.

claim.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Poseidon bertanggung jawab atas Minotaur: karena Minos tidak mengurbankan banteng pemberian sang dewa, Poseidon menyihir istri Minos, Pasiphae, hingga jatuh cinta pada banteng itu.
claim.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, Poseidon was responsible for the Minotaur: Minos' failure to sacrifice the bull given by the god resulted in Poseidon bewitching Minos' wife Pasiphae into falling in love with the bull.

claims_provenance.quote: Poseidon was himself responsible for another terrible creature - the Minotaur. Minos' failure to sacrifice the bull given as a gift by the god resulted in Poseidon bewitching Minos' wife Pasiphae into falling in love with the bull

claim.id: Dalam Iliad 15 (terjemahan Murray), Poseidon berkata bahwa mereka tiga bersaudara, putra Cronos dan Rhea; ketika undian dikocok ia memperoleh laut kelabu sebagai tempat tinggalnya, Hades memperoleh kegelapan, dan Zeus memperoleh langit luas.
claim.en: In Iliad 15 (Murray translation), Poseidon says they are three brethren, begotten of Cronos and Rhea; when the lots were shaken he won the grey sea for his habitation, Hades the murky darkness, and Zeus the broad heaven.

claims_provenance.quote: three brethren are we, begotten of Cronos, and born of Rhea,—Zeus, and myself, and the third is Hades ... I verily, when the lots were shaken, won for my portion the grey sea to be my habitation for ever, and Hades won the murky darkness, while Zeus won the broad heaven amid the air and the clouds
claims_provenance.source_citation: Perseus Digital Library, Tufts University — Homer, Iliad, Book 15 (trans. A. T. Murray)

claim.id: Dalam Iliad 15 (terjemahan Murray), Iris menyapa Poseidon sebagai "Pemeluk Bumi, dewa berambut gelap".
claim.en: In Iliad 15 (Murray translation), Iris addresses Poseidon as "O Earth-Enfolder, thou dark-haired god".

claims_provenance.quote: Is it thus in good sooth, O Earth-Enfolder, thou dark-haired god, that I am to bear to Zeus this message, unyielding and harsh
claims_provenance.source_citation: Perseus Digital Library, Tufts University — Homer, Iliad, Book 15 (trans. A. T. Murray)

claim.id: Menurut Wikipedia, asal-usul nama "Poseidon" tidak jelas dan etimologi yang mungkin saling bertentangan di kalangan sarjana.
claim.en: According to Wikipedia, the origins of the name "Poseidon" are unclear and the possible etymologies are contradictive among the scholars.

claims_provenance.quote: The origins of the name "Poseidon" are unclear and the possible etymologies are contradictive among the scholars.

claim.id: Menurut Wikipedia, satu teori memecah nama itu menjadi unsur yang berarti "suami" atau "tuan".
claim.en: According to Wikipedia, one theory breaks the name down into an element meaning "husband" or "lord".

claims_provenance.quote: One theory breaks it down into an element meaning "husband" or "lord"

claim.id: Menurut Wikipedia, teori lain akan menjadikan Poseidon penguasa perairan.
claim.en: According to Wikipedia, another theory would make Poseidon the master of waters.

claims_provenance.quote: This would make *Posei-dawōn into the master of waters.

claim.id: Menurut Wikipedia, pada Yunani Zaman Perunggu pra-Olimpus, Poseidon dipuja sebagai dewa utama di Pylos dan Thebes dengan gelar kultus "penggoyang bumi".
claim.en: According to Wikipedia, in pre-Olympian Bronze Age Greece Poseidon was venerated as a chief deity at Pylos and Thebes, with the cult title "earth shaker".

claims_provenance.quote: In pre-Olympian Bronze Age Greece, Poseidon was venerated as a chief deity at Pylos and Thebes, with the cult title "earth shaker"

claim.id: Menurut Wikipedia, dalam sisi ramahnya Poseidon dipandang menciptakan pulau baru dan memberi laut tenang; ketika tersinggung atau diabaikan, ia konon menghantam tanah dengan trisulanya dan menimbulkan mata air kacau, gempa, kecelakaan tenggelam, dan karamnya kapal.
claim.en: According to Wikipedia, in his benign aspect Poseidon was seen as creating new islands and offering calm seas; when offended or ignored, he supposedly struck the ground with his trident and caused chaotic springs, earthquakes, drownings and shipwrecks.

claims_provenance.quote: In his benign aspect, Poseidon was seen as creating new islands and offering calm seas. When offended or ignored, he supposedly struck the ground with his trident and caused chaotic springs, earthquakes, drownings and shipwrecks.

claim.id: Menurut Wikipedia, dalam Timaeus dan Critias karya Plato, pulau legendaris Atlantis adalah wilayah kekuasaan Poseidon.
claim.en: According to Wikipedia, in Plato's Timaeus and Critias the legendary island of Atlantis was Poseidon's domain.

claims_provenance.quote: In Plato's Timaeus and Critias, the legendary island of Atlantis was Poseidon's domain.

claim.id: Menurut Wikipedia, Poseidon masih dipuja hingga kini dalam agama Helenik modern, bersama dewa-dewa Yunani lainnya.
claim.en: According to Wikipedia, Poseidon is still worshipped today in modern Hellenic religion, among other Greek gods.

claims_provenance.quote: Poseidon is still worshipped today in modern Hellenic religion, among other Greek gods.

claim.id: Menurut Wikipedia, Himne Homerik untuk Poseidon menyapanya sebagai "penggerak bumi dan laut mandul, dewa samudra yang juga penguasa Gunung Helicon dan Aegae yang luas", dan menyebut sifat gandanya: "penjinak kuda dan penyelamat kapal".
claim.en: According to Wikipedia, the Homeric Hymn to Poseidon addresses him as "mover of the earth and barren sea, god of the deep who is also lord of Mount Helicon and wide Aegae", and specifies his twofold nature: "a tamer of horses and a saviour of ships".

claims_provenance.quote: A hymn to Poseidon included among the Homeric Hymns is a brief invocation, a seven-line introduction that addresses the god as both "mover of the earth and barren sea, god of the deep who is also lord of Mount Helicon and wide Aegae", and specifies his twofold nature as an Olympian: "a tamer of horses and a saviour of ships".

claim.id: Menurut Wikipedia, Poseidon muncul dalam seri novel Percy Jackson & the Olympians, di mana ia adalah ayah tokoh utamanya, Percy Jackson.
claim.en: According to Wikipedia, Poseidon appears in the Percy Jackson & the Olympians novel series, where he is the father of the titular protagonist Percy Jackson.

claims_provenance.quote: Poseidon appears in the Percy Jackson & the Olympians novel series, where he is the father of the titular protagonist Percy Jackson.

claim.id: Menurut Wikipedia, Poseidon muncul dalam film Jason and the Argonauts tahun 1963.
claim.en: According to Wikipedia, Poseidon appeared in the 1963 film Jason and the Argonauts.

claims_provenance.quote: Poseidon appeared in the 1963 film Jason and the Argonauts.

claim.id: Menurut Wikipedia, dalam Theogony karya Hesiodos, Poseidon "berbaring di padang rumput lembut di antara bunga musim semi" bersama Gorgon Medusa, dan dua keturunan, kuda bersayap Pegasus dan prajurit Chrysaor, lahir ketika pahlawan Perseus memenggal kepala Medusa.
claim.en: According to Wikipedia, in Hesiod's Theogony Poseidon "lay down in a soft meadow among spring flowers" with the Gorgon Medusa, and two offspring, the winged horse Pegasus and the warrior Chrysaor, were born when the hero Perseus cut off Medusa's head.

claims_provenance.quote: According to Hesiod's Theogony, Poseidon "lay down in a soft meadow among spring flowers" with the Gorgon Medusa and two offspring, the winged horse Pegasus and the warrior Chrysaor, were born when the hero Perseus cut off Medusa's head

claim.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, para pelaut dan nelayan di mana-mana memberi persembahan nazar kepada Poseidon demi perlindungan.
claim.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, mariners and fishermen everywhere made votive offerings to Poseidon for protection.

claims_provenance.quote: mariners and fishermen everywhere made votive offerings to Poseidon for protection

research_gaps.note: Belum memverifikasi berkas Wikimedia Commons yang tepat beserta lisensinya; gambar tidak ditambah pada tugas ini.
Sumber yang dibuka (Wikipedia, Theoi, World History Encyclopedia, Iliad terjemahan Murray) tidak menyatakan satu nilai tunggal untuk sifat, kecenderungan, atau habitat; tidak diisi.
Hanya Wikipedia (bagian In modern culture) yang memuat penggambaran modern; hanya dua yang dikutip. Permainan video yang disebut di sana tidak dikutip.

short_description.id: Poseidon adalah dewa Olimpus dalam agama Yunani kuno yang membawahi laut, badai, gempa bumi, dan kuda, serta pelindung para pelaut.
short_description.en: Poseidon is an Olympian god of ancient Greek religion presiding over the sea, storms, earthquakes, and horses, and a protector of seafarers.

long_description.id: Poseidon adalah salah satu dari dua belas dewa Olimpus dalam agama dan mitologi Yunani kuno yang membawahi laut, badai, gempa bumi, dan kuda. Ia pelindung para pelaut dan penjaga banyak kota Helenik. World History Encyclopedia menyebutnya dewa laut dan sungai, pencipta badai dan banjir, serta pelindung pelaut dan pelindung kuda. Theoi menggambarkannya sebagai pria dewasa berbadan kekar dengan janggut gelap yang memegang trisula, yaitu tombak ikan bermata tiga, dan World History Encyclopedia menambahkan bahwa trisula itu dibuat para Kiklops. Menurut Theoi, hewan sucinya adalah banteng, kuda, dan lumba-lumba.
long_description.en: In ancient Greek religion and mythology, Poseidon ranks among the twelve Olympians and has charge of the sea, storms, earthquakes, and horses. He protects seafarers and guards many Hellenic cities. World History Encyclopedia calls him god of seas and rivers, maker of storms and floods, protector of mariners and patron of horses. Theoi depicts him as a mature man of sturdy build with a dark beard holding a trident, a three-pronged fishing spear, and World History Encyclopedia adds that the trident was fashioned by the Cyclopes. According to Theoi, his sacred animals were the bull, the horse and the dolphin.

long_description.id: Dalam Iliad 15, Poseidon sendiri berkata bahwa ia dan Zeus serta Hades adalah tiga bersaudara putra Cronos dan Rhea; ketika undian dikocok ia memperoleh laut kelabu, Hades kegelapan, dan Zeus langit luas, dan Iris menyapanya sebagai "Pemeluk Bumi, dewa berambut gelap". Menurut Theoi, pembagian itu terjadi setelah jatuhnya para Titan dan laut menjadi wilayahnya. Ia dikisahkan ditelan ayahnya, Kronos, saat lahir, dan kemudian bersama saudara-saudaranya mengalahkan dewa-dewa yang lebih tua dengan trisula buatan para Kiklops. Entri kamus yang dimuat Theoi mencatat bahwa dalam puisi paling awal ia setara Zeus dalam martabat tetapi lebih lemah.
long_description.en: In Iliad 15, Poseidon himself says that he, Zeus, and Hades are three brethren, sons of Cronos and Rhea; when the lots were shaken he won the grey sea, Hades the murky darkness, and Zeus the broad heaven, and Iris addresses him as "O Earth-Enfolder, thou dark-haired god". According to Theoi, the division happened after the fall of the Titans and the sea became his domain. He is said to have been swallowed by his father Kronos at birth, and later with his brothers he defeated the elder gods using a trident crafted by the Cyclopes. The dictionary entry reproduced by Theoi notes that in the earliest poems he is equal to Zeus in dignity but weaker.

long_description.id: Entri kamus yang dimuat Theoi menyebut Poseidon sebagai penguasa laut yang menghimpun awan dan memanggil badai, tetapi juga dapat memberi pelayaran yang berhasil dan menyelamatkan orang yang dalam bahaya. Menurut Wikipedia, bila ia tersinggung atau diabaikan, konon ia menghantam tanah dengan trisulanya sehingga timbul gempa, orang tenggelam, dan kapal karam. Istananya, menurut entri itu, berada di kedalaman laut dekat Aegae di Euboea, dan kudanya menarik keretanya di atas ombak; ia dianggap pencipta kuda serta pelindung pacuan kuda.
long_description.en: The dictionary entry reproduced by Theoi presents Poseidon as ruler of the sea who gathers clouds and calls forth storms, but who can also grant a successful voyage and save those in danger. According to Wikipedia, if he was slighted or neglected he was said to strike the earth with his trident, bringing earthquakes, drownings, and shipwrecks. His palace, according to that entry, was in the depth of the sea near Aegae in Euboea, and his fish-tailed horses drew his chariot; he was regarded as the creator of the horse and the protector of horse races.

long_description.id: Poseidon tampil dalam banyak kisah: ia bertanding melawan Athena untuk menguasai Athena, membantu membangun tembok Troya lalu mengirim monster laut ketika Raja Laomedon menolak membayar, dan menimpa Polybotes dengan pulau Kos. Dalam Odyssey, ia mengutuk Odiseus mengembara di laut sepuluh tahun karena putranya Polyphemus dibutakan. Ia menikahi Amphitrite, dan putra mereka adalah Triton; ia juga disebut ayah Theseus, Pegasos, Arion, dan Polyphemos.
long_description.en: Poseidon features in many stories: he contests Athens with Athena, helps build the walls of Troy and then sends a sea-monster when King Laomedon refuses to pay, and crushes Polybotes beneath the island of Kos. In the Odyssey he curses Odysseus to wander the sea for ten years because his son Polyphemus was blinded. He married Amphitrite, and their son was Triton; he is also named as father of Theseus, Pegasos, Arion, and Polyphemos.

long_description.id: Pemujaan Poseidon berasal dari akhir Zaman Perunggu dan peradaban Mycenae, dan Pylos menjadikannya dewa utama. Pesta Isthmia dekat Korintus diadakan untuk menghormatinya, dan kuil abad ke-5 SM-nya masih berdiri di Sounion. Dalam seni ia paling sering digambarkan dewasa dan berjanggut dengan trisula. Entri kamus yang dimuat Theoi mencatat bahwa kurban untuknya pada umumnya berupa banteng hitam dan putih, dan pacuan kuda serta kereta diadakan untuk menghormatinya di tanah genting Korintus, sedangkan World History Encyclopedia mencatat bahwa para pelaut dan nelayan di mana-mana memberi persembahan nazar kepadanya demi perlindungan. Menurut Wikipedia, Poseidon masih dipuja hingga kini dalam agama Helenik modern.
long_description.en: Worship of Poseidon dates to the late Bronze Age and the Mycenaean civilization, and Pylos had him as its main god. The Isthmian games near Corinth were held in his honour, and his 5th-century BCE temple still stands at Sounion. In art he is most often shown mature and bearded with a trident. According to the dictionary entry reproduced by Theoi, he was usually offered black and white bulls, and the Corinthian isthmus hosted horse and chariot races for him; World History Encyclopedia adds that mariners and fishermen everywhere made votive offerings to him for protection. According to Wikipedia, Poseidon is still worshipped today in modern Hellenic religion.

cultural_context.id: Menurut Wikipedia, Himne Homerik menyebut sifat ganda Poseidon sebagai dewa Olimpus: penjinak kuda dan penyelamat kapal; menurut World History Encyclopedia, para pelaut dan nelayan di mana-mana memberi persembahan nazar kepadanya demi perlindungan.
cultural_context.en: According to Wikipedia, the Homeric Hymn gives him a double office among the Olympians, tamer of horses and saviour of ships; according to World History Encyclopedia, mariners and fishermen everywhere made votive offerings to him for protection.

literal_meaning.id: Tidak jelas; salah satu teori menafsirkannya sebagai "suami/tuan" dari unsur kedua, teori lain sebagai "penguasa perairan"
literal_meaning.en: Unclear; one theory reads an element meaning "husband" or "lord", another reads "master of waters"

who.id: Dewa Olimpus penguasa laut, badai, gempa bumi, dan kuda.
who.en: Olympian god of the sea, storms, earthquakes, and horses.

role.id: Pelindung para pelaut dan penjaga banyak kota Helenik.
role.en: Protector of seafarers and guardian of many Hellenic cities.

famous_for.id: Menerima laut ketika kosmos dibagi di antara tiga bersaudara, serta murkanya kepada Odiseus.
famous_for.en: Receiving the sea when the cosmos was divided among three brothers, and his wrath against Odysseus.

did_you_know.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Poseidon sering digambarkan dalam seni dengan trisula buatan para Kiklops yang ia pakai menciptakan gempa dengan menghantamkannya ke tanah.
did_you_know.en: World History Encyclopedia notes that in art Poseidon often wields a trident made by the Cyclopes, which he used to cause earthquakes by hitting the ground.

description.id: Menurut entri kamus yang dimuat Theoi, dengan trisulanya Poseidon memecahkan batu karang, memanggil atau menenangkan badai, dan mengguncang bumi.
description.en: According to the dictionary entry reproduced by Theoi, with his trident Poseidon shatters rocks, calls forth or subdues storms, and shakes the earth.

description.id: Poseidon dikaitkan dengan gempa bumi; World History Encyclopedia menyatakan ia menciptakannya dengan menghantamkan trisula ke tanah.
description.en: Poseidon is associated with earthquakes; World History Encyclopedia says he creates them by striking his trident to the ground.

description.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Poseidon mengutuk Odiseus mengembara di laut selama sepuluh tahun.
description.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, Poseidon cursed Odysseus to wander the sea for ten years.

description.id: Menurut entri kamus yang dimuat Theoi, Poseidon mampu memberi pelayaran yang berhasil dan menyelamatkan orang yang dalam bahaya.
description.en: According to the dictionary entry reproduced by Theoi, Poseidon is able to grant a successful voyage and save those in danger.

description.id: Entri kamus yang dimuat Theoi menyatakan bahwa dalam puisi-puisi paling awal Poseidon setara dengan Zeus dalam martabat tetapi lebih lemah.
description.en: The dictionary entry reproduced by Theoi says that in the earliest poems Poseidon is equal to Zeus in dignity but weaker.

summary.id: Sesudah para Titan jatuh, Poseidon dan saudara-saudaranya mengundi bagian kosmos; laut menjadi wilayah Poseidon.
summary.en: After the Titans fell, Poseidon and his brothers drew lots for the cosmos, and the sea became his domain.

summary.id: Para Kiklops membuat trisula ajaib bagi Poseidon, dan bersama Zeus dan Haides ia mengalahkan dewa-dewa yang lebih tua serta memenjarakan mereka di Tartaros.
summary.en: The Kyklopes made a magical trident for Poseidon; together with Zeus and Haides he overcame the elder gods and shut them away in Tartaros.

role.id: Poseidon menawarkan hadiah bagi kota itu.
role.en: Poseidon offers gifts to the city.

summary.id: Poseidon bertanding melawan Athena untuk menguasai Athena; hadiah zaitun dari Athena lebih disukai, dan Poseidon menurut Theoi menimpakan kekeringan pada negeri itu.
summary.en: Poseidon contested Athens with Athena; Athena's olive tree gained greater favour, and according to Theoi Poseidon afflicted the land with drought.

role.id: Poseidon membangun tembok lalu membalas penolakan membayar.
role.en: Poseidon builds the walls and avenges the refusal to pay.

summary.id: Poseidon membantu membangun tembok Troya; ketika Raja Laomedon menolak membayar upah yang dijanjikan, ia mengirim monster laut. World History Encyclopedia mencatat versi lain, bahwa ia diwajibkan membangunnya sebagai hukuman atas upaya menggulingkan Zeus.
summary.en: Poseidon helped build the walls of Troy; when King Laomedon refused the promised payment, he sent a sea-monster. World History Encyclopedia records another version, in which he was made to build them as punishment for trying to overthrow Zeus.

role.en: Poseidon punishes the one who blinded his son.

summary.id: Odiseus membutakan Polyphemus, putra Poseidon, dan Poseidon menghukumnya dengan badai serta mengutuknya mengembara di laut selama sepuluh tahun.
summary.en: Odysseus blinds Polyphemus, Poseidon's son, and Poseidon punishes him with storms and curses him to wander the sea for ten years.

summary.id: Karena Minos tidak mengurbankan banteng pemberian sang dewa, Poseidon menyihir Pasiphae hingga jatuh cinta pada banteng itu, dan lahirlah Minotaur.
summary.en: Because Minos failed to sacrifice the bull given by the god, Poseidon bewitched Pasiphae into falling in love with the bull, and the Minotaur resulted.

description.id: Istana Poseidon di kedalaman laut dekat Aegae di Euboea.
description.en: The palace of Poseidon in the depth of the sea near Aegae in Euboea.

description.id: Tempat Poseidon sangat dihormati dan pesta Isthmia diadakan untuk menghormatinya.
description.en: Where Poseidon was particularly revered and the Isthmian games were held in his honour.

description.id: Tanjung tempat kuil abad ke-5 SM untuk Poseidon masih berdiri.
description.en: The promontory where his 5th-century BCE temple still stands.

description.id: Menurut Wikipedia, dalam Timaeus dan Critias karya Plato pulau legendaris Atlantis adalah wilayah kekuasaan Poseidon.
description.en: According to Wikipedia, in Plato's Timaeus and Critias the legendary island of Atlantis was Poseidon's domain.

description.id: Kota yang menjadikan Poseidon dewa utamanya dengan seorang pendeta perempuan sebagai kepala pemujaannya.
description.en: A city that had Poseidon as its main god with a priestess as head of his cult.

description.id: Pemujaan Poseidon dibuktikan oleh prasasti Linear B di Pylos dan Knossos pada masa peradaban Mycenae (puncaknya abad ke-15 hingga ke-12 SM).
description.en: Cults to Poseidon are attested by Linear B inscriptions at Pylos and Knossos in the Mycenaean civilization (at its peak from the 15th to 12th century BCE).

description.id: Kuil Poseidon dari abad ke-5 SM masih berdiri di tanjung Sounion.
description.en: His 5th-century BCE temple still stands on the promontory at Sounion.

statement.en: Poseidon is an ancient Greek Olympian god of the sea, storms, earthquakes, and horses.

claims.quote: He was the protector of seafarers and the guardian of many Hellenic cities and colonies.

statement.id: Poseidon disebut pelindung pelaut dan banyak kota Yunani.
statement.en: Poseidon is described as a protector of seafarers and many Hellenic cities.

statement.id: Padanan Romawi Poseidon adalah Neptune.
statement.en: Poseidon's Roman counterpart is Neptune.

claims.quote: POSEIDON was the Olympian god of the sea, earthquakes, floods, drought and horses. He was depicted as a mature man with a sturdy build and dark beard holding a trident

statement.id: Theoi menyebut Poseidon dewa laut, gempa, banjir, kekeringan, dan kuda, digambarkan sebagai pria dewasa berjanggut dengan trisula.
statement.en: Theoi describes Poseidon as god of the sea, earthquakes, floods, drought, and horses, shown as a bearded mature man with a trident.

claims.quote: Poseidon and his brothers drew lots for the division of the cosmos after the fall of the Titanes, and won the sea as his domain.

statement.id: Menurut Theoi, Poseidon dan saudara-saudaranya mengundi kosmos setelah jatuhnya para Titan, dan Poseidon mendapat laut.
statement.en: According to Theoi, Poseidon and his brothers drew lots for the cosmos after the Titans fell, and Poseidon received the sea.

claims.quote: Poseidon was the Greek god of the sea and rivers, creator of storms and floods, and the bringer of earthquakes and destruction.

statement.id: World History Encyclopedia menyebut Poseidon dewa laut dan sungai, pembuat badai dan banjir, serta pembawa gempa.
statement.en: World History Encyclopedia calls Poseidon god of seas and rivers, creator of storms and floods, and bringer of earthquakes.

claims.quote: He was a protector to mariners and, as a tamer of horses, the patron of that animal and horse breeding.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Poseidon melindungi pelaut dan menjadi pelindung kuda.
statement.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, Poseidon protected mariners and was patron of horses.

claims.quote: In the Odyssey, during the sea-voyage from Troy back home to Ithaca, the Greek hero Odysseus provokes Poseidon's fury by blinding his son, the Cyclops Polyphemus, resulting in Poseidon punishing him with storms

statement.id: Dalam Odisseia, Odiseus membuat Poseidon marah dengan membutakan Polifemos, putranya, sehingga Poseidon menghukumnya dengan badai.
statement.en: In the Odyssey, Odysseus angers Poseidon by blinding his son Polyphemus, and Poseidon punishes him with storms.

claims.quote: Poseidon's most distinctive attribute was the trident, a three-pronged fishing spear. He sometimes also wielded a boulder encrusted with sea creatures

statement.en: According to Theoi, Poseidon's most distinctive attribute was the trident, a three-pronged fishing spear; he sometimes also wielded a boulder encrusted with sea creatures.

claims.quote: Poseidon's sacred animals were the bull, the horse and the dolphin.

statement.id: Menurut Theoi, hewan suci Poseidon adalah banteng, kuda, dan lumba-lumba.
statement.en: According to Theoi, Poseidon's sacred animals were the bull, the horse and the dolphin.

claims.quote: His chariot was drawn by a pair of fish-tailed horses (Greek: hippokampoi).

statement.id: Menurut Theoi, keretanya ditarik sepasang kuda berekor ikan (bahasa Yunani: hippokampoi).
statement.en: According to Theoi, his chariot was drawn by a pair of fish-tailed horses (Greek: hippokampoi).

claims.quote: He entered a contest with the goddess Athena for dominion over Athens and produced the very first horse as a gift. But the king refused him the prize and in anger Poseidon afflicted the land with drought.

statement.id: Menurut Theoi, Poseidon bertanding melawan dewi Athena untuk menguasai Athena dan menghasilkan kuda pertama sebagai hadiah; ketika sang raja menolak memberinya hadiah kemenangan, ia menimpakan kekeringan pada negeri itu.
statement.en: According to Theoi, Poseidon entered a contest with the goddess Athena for dominion over Athens and produced the very first horse as a gift; when the king refused him the prize, he afflicted the land with drought.

claims.quote: The god helped build the walls of the city of Troy, but when King Laomedon refused the payment he had promised, Poseidon sent a sea-monster to ravage the land.

statement.id: Menurut Theoi, Poseidon membantu membangun tembok kota Troya, tetapi ketika Raja Laomedon menolak membayar upah yang dijanjikan, ia mengirim monster laut untuk merusak negeri itu.
statement.en: According to Theoi, Poseidon helped build the walls of Troy, but when King Laomedon refused the promised payment, he sent a sea-monster to ravage the land.

claims.quote: When the Gigantes (Giants) besieged the gods of Olympos, Poseidon crushed Polybotes beneath the island of Kos (Cos).

statement.id: Menurut Theoi, ketika para Gigantes mengepung dewa-dewa Olimpus, Poseidon menimpa Polybotes dengan pulau Kos.
statement.en: According to Theoi, when the Gigantes (Giants) besieged the gods of Olympos, Poseidon crushed Polybotes beneath the island of Kos.

claims.quote: The symbol of Poseidon's power was the trident, or a spear with three points, with which he used to shatter rocks, to call forth or subdue storms, to shake the earth, and the like.

statement.id: Menurut entri kamus yang dimuat Theoi, lambang kekuasaan Poseidon adalah trisula, yang ia pakai untuk memecahkan batu karang, memanggil atau menenangkan badai, mengguncang bumi, dan sebagainya.
statement.en: According to the dictionary entry reproduced by Theoi, the symbol of Poseidon's power was the trident, with which he used to shatter rocks, call forth or subdue storms, shake the earth, and the like.

statement.id: Menurut Theoi, Poseidon menikahi dewi laut Amphitrite, anak sulung Nereus, ikatan pernikahan yang mengamankan kekuasaannya atas laut; putra mereka adalah dewa berekor ikan, Triton.
statement.en: According to Theoi, Poseidon married the marine-goddess Amphitrite, eldest child of Nereus, a marital alliance which secured his dominion over the sea; their son was the fish-tailed god Triton.

claims.quote: Being the ruler of the sea (the Mediterranean), he is described as gathering clouds and calling forth storms, but at the same he has it in his power to grant a successful voyage and save those who are in danger, and all other marine divinities are subject to him.

statement.id: Entri kamus yang dimuat Theoi menyatakan bahwa sebagai penguasa laut, Poseidon digambarkan mengumpulkan awan dan memanggil badai, tetapi juga mampu memberi pelayaran yang berhasil dan menyelamatkan orang yang dalam bahaya, dan semua dewa laut lain tunduk kepadanya.
statement.en: The dictionary entry reproduced by Theoi says that, as ruler of the sea, Poseidon is described as gathering clouds and calling forth storms, but also as able to grant a successful voyage and save those in danger, and all other marine divinities are subject to him.

statement.id: Entri kamus yang dimuat Theoi menyatakan bahwa istana Poseidon berada di kedalaman laut dekat Aegae di Euboea.
statement.en: The dictionary entry reproduced by Theoi says the palace of Poseidon was in the depth of the sea near Aegae in Euboea.

claims.quote: He was further regarded as the creator of the horse, and was accordingly believed to have taught men the art of managing horses by the bridle, and to have been the originator and protector of horse races.

statement.id: Entri kamus yang dimuat Theoi menyatakan bahwa Poseidon dianggap pencipta kuda, dipercaya mengajarkan manusia mengendalikan kuda dengan kekang, serta pencetus dan pelindung pacuan kuda.
statement.en: The dictionary entry reproduced by Theoi says Poseidon was regarded as the creator of the horse, believed to have taught men to manage horses by the bridle, and to have been the originator and protector of horse races.

claims.quote: He also had numerous mortal offspring including giants such as Antaios and the cyclops Polyphemos, magical horses like Pegasos and Arion, and various human kings, heroes and villians including Theseus and Bellerophontes.

statement.id: Menurut Theoi, Poseidon juga memiliki banyak keturunan, termasuk raksasa seperti Antaios dan Kiklops Polyphemos, kuda ajaib seperti Pegasos dan Arion, serta berbagai raja dan pahlawan manusia seperti Theseus dan Bellerophontes.
statement.en: According to Theoi, Poseidon also had numerous offspring, including giants such as Antaios and the cyclops Polyphemos, magical horses like Pegasos and Arion, and various human kings and heroes including Theseus and Bellerophontes.

claims.quote: During the War of the Titanes, the Kyklopes (Cyclopes) crafted a magical trident for Poseidon, and together with his brothers Zeus and Haides he defeated the elder gods and imprisoned them in Tartaros.

statement.id: Menurut Theoi, dalam Perang Titan, para Kiklops membuat trisula ajaib bagi Poseidon, dan bersama saudara-saudaranya Zeus dan Haides ia mengalahkan dewa-dewa yang lebih tua serta memenjarakan mereka di Tartaros.
statement.en: According to Theoi, during the War of the Titanes the Kyklopes crafted a magical trident for Poseidon, and with his brothers Zeus and Haides he defeated the elder gods and imprisoned them in Tartaros.

claims.quote: At birth Poseidon was swallowed whole by his father Kronos (Cronus), but Zeus later enlisted the aid of the goddess Metis who fed the Titan a magical elixir causing him to disgorge the god.

statement.id: Menurut Theoi, saat lahir Poseidon ditelan bulat-bulat oleh ayahnya Kronos, tetapi Zeus kemudian meminta bantuan dewi Metis yang memberi sang Titan ramuan ajaib sehingga ia memuntahkan sang dewa.
statement.en: According to Theoi, at birth Poseidon was swallowed whole by his father Kronos, but Zeus later enlisted the goddess Metis, who fed the Titan a magical elixir causing him to disgorge the god.

claims.quote: In the earliest poems, Poseidon is described as indeed equal to Zeus in dignity, but weaker.

statement.id: Entri kamus yang dimuat Theoi menyatakan bahwa dalam puisi-puisi paling awal Poseidon digambarkan setara dengan Zeus dalam martabat, tetapi lebih lemah.
statement.en: The dictionary entry reproduced by Theoi says that in the earliest poems Poseidon is described as equal to Zeus in dignity, but weaker.

claims.quote: Herodotus (ii. 50, iv. 188) states, that the name and worship of Poseidon was imported to the Greeks from Libya, but he was probably a divinity of Pelasgian origin

statement.id: Entri kamus yang dimuat Theoi mencatat bahwa Herodotus menyatakan nama dan pemujaan Poseidon diimpor ke Yunani dari Libya, tetapi ia kemungkinan dewa berasal dari bangsa Pelasgia.
statement.en: The dictionary entry reproduced by Theoi notes that Herodotus states the name and worship of Poseidon was imported to the Greeks from Libya, but that he was probably a divinity of Pelasgian origin.

claims.quote: The sacrifices offered to him generally consisted of black and white bulls

statement.id: Entri kamus yang dimuat Theoi menyatakan bahwa kurban untuk Poseidon pada umumnya berupa banteng hitam dan putih.
statement.en: The dictionary entry reproduced by Theoi says the sacrifices offered to him generally consisted of black and white bulls.

claims.quote: horse and chariot races were held in his honour on the Corinthian isthmus

statement.id: Entri kamus yang dimuat Theoi menyatakan bahwa pacuan kuda dan kereta diadakan untuk menghormatinya di tanah genting Korintus.
statement.en: The dictionary entry reproduced by Theoi says horse and chariot races were held in his honour on the Corinthian isthmus.

claims.quote: Cults to Poseidon date as far back as the late Bronze Age and the Mycenaean civilization (at its peak from the 15th to 12th century BCE), as attested by Linear B inscriptions found at Pylos in the Peloponnese and Knossos on Crete.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, pemujaan Poseidon berasal dari akhir Zaman Perunggu dan peradaban Mycenae (puncaknya abad ke-15 hingga ke-12 SM), dibuktikan oleh prasasti Linear B yang ditemukan di Pylos dan Knossos.
statement.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, cults to Poseidon date back to the late Bronze Age and the Mycenaean civilization (at its peak from the 15th to 12th century BCE), as attested by Linear B inscriptions found at Pylos and Knossos.

claims.quote: Pylos, we know, had Poseidon as its main god with a priestess as the head of his cult.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Pylos menjadikan Poseidon dewa utamanya dengan seorang pendeta perempuan sebagai kepala pemujaannya.
statement.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, Pylos had Poseidon as its main god with a priestess as the head of his cult.

claims.quote: Seemingly not content with the seas alone, Poseidon often interfered in the plans of Zeus, and once even attempted to overthrow his brother with the aid of Hera and Athena. It was as punishment for this treachery that Poseidon was made to build the magnificent walls of Troy.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Poseidon sering ikut campur dalam rencana Zeus dan pernah mencoba menggulingkannya dengan bantuan Hera dan Athena; sebagai hukuman atas pengkhianatan itu ia diwajibkan membangun tembok Troya.
statement.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, Poseidon often interfered in the plans of Zeus and once attempted to overthrow his brother with the aid of Hera and Athena; as punishment for this treachery he was made to build the walls of Troy.

claims.quote: Poseidon is most often described by both Homer and Hesiod as 'deep sounding Earth-shaker', the 'dark-haired one' and 'encircler of the earth.'

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Homeros dan Hesiodos paling sering menyebut Poseidon sebagai 'Penggoyang Bumi yang bergemuruh', 'si berambut gelap', dan 'pelingkar bumi'.
statement.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, Homer and Hesiod most often describe Poseidon as 'deep sounding Earth-shaker', the 'dark-haired one' and 'encircler of the earth'.

claims.quote: In revenge for the blinding of his son Polyphemus, he cursed Odysseus to wander the sea for ten years.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, sebagai balas dendam atas dibutakannya putranya Polyphemus, Poseidon mengutuk Odiseus mengembara di laut selama sepuluh tahun.
statement.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, in revenge for the blinding of his son Polyphemus, Poseidon cursed Odysseus to wander the sea for ten years.

claims.quote: The god was particularly revered here and was the focus of horse races and other events at the Panhellenic Isthmian games which were held in his honour near Corinth.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Poseidon sangat dihormati di Tanah Genting Korintus dan menjadi pusat pacuan kuda serta acara lain pada Pesta Isthmia Panhelenik yang diadakan untuk menghormatinya dekat Korintus.
statement.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, Poseidon was particularly revered at the Isthmus of Corinth and was the focus of horse races and other events at the Panhellenic Isthmian games held in his honour near Corinth.

claims.quote: Sounion was another strategic site close to the god, and his 5th-century BCE temple still stands on the promontory which overlooks ships entering the Saronic gulf.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Sounion adalah situs strategis yang dekat dengan sang dewa, dan kuil abad ke-5 SM-nya masih berdiri di tanjung yang menghadap kapal-kapal yang memasuki Teluk Saronik.
statement.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, Sounion was another strategic site close to the god, and his 5th-century BCE temple still stands on the promontory overlooking ships entering the Saronic gulf.

claims.quote: In the legendary competition with Athena to win the patronage of Athens, Poseidon offered to the city the gifts of a saltwater spring and a horse. However, Athena's gift of an olive tree gained greater favour

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, dalam pertandingan legendaris melawan Athena untuk menjadi pelindung Athena, Poseidon menawarkan mata air asin dan seekor kuda, tetapi hadiah pohon zaitun dari Athena lebih disukai.
statement.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, in the legendary competition with Athena for the patronage of Athens, Poseidon offered a saltwater spring and a horse, but Athena's gift of an olive tree gained greater favour.

claims.quote: Poseidon is most commonly depicted in ancient Greek art as mature and bearded. He often brandishes his trident, fashioned by the Cyclopes, with which he would create earthquakes by striking it to the ground.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, dalam seni Yunani kuno Poseidon paling sering digambarkan dewasa dan berjanggut, sering mengacungkan trisula buatan para Kiklops yang ia pakai menciptakan gempa dengan menghantamkannya ke tanah.
statement.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, in ancient Greek art Poseidon is most commonly depicted as mature and bearded, often brandishing his trident, fashioned by the Cyclopes, with which he would create earthquakes by striking it to the ground.

claims.quote: Poseidon was himself responsible for another terrible creature - the Minotaur. Minos' failure to sacrifice the bull given as a gift by the god resulted in Poseidon bewitching Minos' wife Pasiphae into falling in love with the bull

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Poseidon bertanggung jawab atas Minotaur: karena Minos tidak mengurbankan banteng pemberian sang dewa, Poseidon menyihir istri Minos, Pasiphae, hingga jatuh cinta pada banteng itu.
statement.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, Poseidon was responsible for the Minotaur: Minos' failure to sacrifice the bull given by the god resulted in Poseidon bewitching Minos' wife Pasiphae into falling in love with the bull.

claims.quote: three brethren are we, begotten of Cronos, and born of Rhea,—Zeus, and myself, and the third is Hades ... I verily, when the lots were shaken, won for my portion the grey sea to be my habitation for ever, and Hades won the murky darkness, while Zeus won the broad heaven amid the air and the clouds

statement.id: Dalam Iliad 15 (terjemahan Murray), Poseidon berkata bahwa mereka tiga bersaudara, putra Cronos dan Rhea; ketika undian dikocok ia memperoleh laut kelabu sebagai tempat tinggalnya, Hades memperoleh kegelapan, dan Zeus memperoleh langit luas.
statement.en: In Iliad 15 (Murray translation), Poseidon says they are three brethren, begotten of Cronos and Rhea; when the lots were shaken he won the grey sea for his habitation, Hades the murky darkness, and Zeus the broad heaven.

claims.quote: Is it thus in good sooth, O Earth-Enfolder, thou dark-haired god, that I am to bear to Zeus this message, unyielding and harsh

statement.id: Dalam Iliad 15 (terjemahan Murray), Iris menyapa Poseidon sebagai "Pemeluk Bumi, dewa berambut gelap".
statement.en: In Iliad 15 (Murray translation), Iris addresses Poseidon as "O Earth-Enfolder, thou dark-haired god".

claims.quote: The origins of the name "Poseidon" are unclear and the possible etymologies are contradictive among the scholars.

statement.id: Menurut Wikipedia, asal-usul nama "Poseidon" tidak jelas dan etimologi yang mungkin saling bertentangan di kalangan sarjana.
statement.en: According to Wikipedia, the origins of the name "Poseidon" are unclear and the possible etymologies are contradictive among the scholars.

claims.quote: One theory breaks it down into an element meaning "husband" or "lord"

statement.id: Menurut Wikipedia, satu teori memecah nama itu menjadi unsur yang berarti "suami" atau "tuan".
statement.en: According to Wikipedia, one theory breaks the name down into an element meaning "husband" or "lord".

claims.quote: This would make *Posei-dawōn into the master of waters.

statement.id: Menurut Wikipedia, teori lain akan menjadikan Poseidon penguasa perairan.
statement.en: According to Wikipedia, another theory would make Poseidon the master of waters.

claims.quote: In pre-Olympian Bronze Age Greece, Poseidon was venerated as a chief deity at Pylos and Thebes, with the cult title "earth shaker"

statement.id: Menurut Wikipedia, pada Yunani Zaman Perunggu pra-Olimpus, Poseidon dipuja sebagai dewa utama di Pylos dan Thebes dengan gelar kultus "penggoyang bumi".
statement.en: According to Wikipedia, in pre-Olympian Bronze Age Greece Poseidon was venerated as a chief deity at Pylos and Thebes, with the cult title "earth shaker".

claims.quote: In his benign aspect, Poseidon was seen as creating new islands and offering calm seas. When offended or ignored, he supposedly struck the ground with his trident and caused chaotic springs, earthquakes, drownings and shipwrecks.

statement.id: Menurut Wikipedia, dalam sisi ramahnya Poseidon dipandang menciptakan pulau baru dan memberi laut tenang; ketika tersinggung atau diabaikan, ia konon menghantam tanah dengan trisulanya dan menimbulkan mata air kacau, gempa, kecelakaan tenggelam, dan karamnya kapal.
statement.en: According to Wikipedia, in his benign aspect Poseidon was seen as creating new islands and offering calm seas; when offended or ignored, he supposedly struck the ground with his trident and caused chaotic springs, earthquakes, drownings and shipwrecks.

claims.quote: In Plato's Timaeus and Critias, the legendary island of Atlantis was Poseidon's domain.

statement.id: Menurut Wikipedia, dalam Timaeus dan Critias karya Plato, pulau legendaris Atlantis adalah wilayah kekuasaan Poseidon.
statement.en: According to Wikipedia, in Plato's Timaeus and Critias the legendary island of Atlantis was Poseidon's domain.

claims.quote: Poseidon is still worshipped today in modern Hellenic religion, among other Greek gods.

statement.id: Menurut Wikipedia, Poseidon masih dipuja hingga kini dalam agama Helenik modern, bersama dewa-dewa Yunani lainnya.
statement.en: According to Wikipedia, Poseidon is still worshipped today in modern Hellenic religion, among other Greek gods.

claims.quote: A hymn to Poseidon included among the Homeric Hymns is a brief invocation, a seven-line introduction that addresses the god as both "mover of the earth and barren sea, god of the deep who is also lord of Mount Helicon and wide Aegae", and specifies his twofold nature as an Olympian: "a tamer of horses and a saviour of ships".

statement.id: Menurut Wikipedia, Himne Homerik untuk Poseidon menyapanya sebagai "penggerak bumi dan laut mandul, dewa samudra yang juga penguasa Gunung Helicon dan Aegae yang luas", dan menyebut sifat gandanya: "penjinak kuda dan penyelamat kapal".
statement.en: According to Wikipedia, the Homeric Hymn to Poseidon addresses him as "mover of the earth and barren sea, god of the deep who is also lord of Mount Helicon and wide Aegae", and specifies his twofold nature: "a tamer of horses and a saviour of ships".

claims.quote: Poseidon appears in the Percy Jackson & the Olympians novel series, where he is the father of the titular protagonist Percy Jackson.

statement.id: Menurut Wikipedia, Poseidon muncul dalam seri novel Percy Jackson & the Olympians, di mana ia adalah ayah tokoh utamanya, Percy Jackson.
statement.en: According to Wikipedia, Poseidon appears in the Percy Jackson & the Olympians novel series, where he is the father of the titular protagonist Percy Jackson.

claims.quote: Poseidon appeared in the 1963 film Jason and the Argonauts.

statement.id: Menurut Wikipedia, Poseidon muncul dalam film Jason and the Argonauts tahun 1963.
statement.en: According to Wikipedia, Poseidon appeared in the 1963 film Jason and the Argonauts.

claims.quote: According to Hesiod's Theogony, Poseidon "lay down in a soft meadow among spring flowers" with the Gorgon Medusa and two offspring, the winged horse Pegasus and the warrior Chrysaor, were born when the hero Perseus cut off Medusa's head

statement.id: Menurut Wikipedia, dalam Theogony karya Hesiodos, Poseidon "berbaring di padang rumput lembut di antara bunga musim semi" bersama Gorgon Medusa, dan dua keturunan, kuda bersayap Pegasus dan prajurit Chrysaor, lahir ketika pahlawan Perseus memenggal kepala Medusa.
statement.en: According to Wikipedia, in Hesiod's Theogony Poseidon "lay down in a soft meadow among spring flowers" with the Gorgon Medusa, and two offspring, the winged horse Pegasus and the warrior Chrysaor, were born when the hero Perseus cut off Medusa's head.

claims.quote: mariners and fishermen everywhere made votive offerings to Poseidon for protection

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, para pelaut dan nelayan di mana-mana memberi persembahan nazar kepada Poseidon demi perlindungan.
statement.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, mariners and fishermen everywhere made votive offerings to Poseidon for protection.

summary.id: Menurut Theoi, Poseidon membantu membangun tembok itu, lalu mengirim monster laut karena Raja Laomedon menolak membayar.
summary.en: According to Theoi, Poseidon helped build the walls, then sent a sea-monster because King Laomedon refused to pay.

summary.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, ia diwajibkan membangunnya sebagai hukuman atas upaya menggulingkan Zeus bersama Hera dan Athena.
summary.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, he was made to build them as punishment for trying to overthrow Zeus with Hera and Athena.

summary.en: The dictionary entry reproduced by Theoi notes Herodotus states his worship was imported from Libya, but that he was probably of Pelasgian origin.

summary.en: Wikipedia notes that the etymology of the name is unclear and the theories contradict each other: one reads "husband" or "lord", another "master of waters".

short_description.id: Artemis adalah dewi perburuan, alam liar, dan hewan dalam agama Yunani kuno, sekaligus pelindung anak perempuan dan perempuan yang melahirkan.
short_description.en: Artemis is a goddess of hunting, wilderness, and animals in ancient Greek religion, and a protector of girls and of women in childbirth.

long_description.id:
Dalam agama Yunani kuno, Artemis membawahi perburuan, alam liar, hewan, dan kelahiran anak. Ia putri Leto dan Zeus serta saudara kembar Apollo, dan kerap dikisahkan berkeliaran di hutan dan gunung bersama para nimfa. Tempat kelahirannya disebut Delos atau Ortygia, dan sebagian tradisi bahkan menyebut orang tua yang berbeda.

Atribut Artemis yang paling khas adalah busur dan anak panah, dan hewan sucinya adalah rusa. Seni Yunani kuno paling sering menggambarkannya sebagai gadis pemburu dengan tabung panah dan busur atau tombak. Penggambaran awal menampilkannya sebagai dewi hewan, bersayap dan memegang hewan di kedua tangan.

Artemis dipandang sebagai pelindung anak dan perempuan yang melahirkan, tetapi juga sebagai pembawa kematian mendadak dan penyakit bagi perempuan dan anak perempuan. Ia dapat pula menyembuhkan, seperti saat menyembuhkan Aeneas. Dalam himne klasik ia melepaskan anak panah di pegunungan, dan bagi orang yang ia pandang dengan ramah ladang dan ternak berkembang.

Kisah-kisah Artemis menampilkan sisi pelindung dan sisi murkanya. Karena ia murka, armada Akhaia terhenti hingga Iphigenia hendak dikorbankan, lalu ia menggantinya dengan seekor rusa. Pemburu Actaion diubahnya menjadi rusa jantan dan dicabik anjingnya sendiri, dan para putri Niobe dibunuh dengan busurnya.

Kuil Artemis di Ephesus mulai dibangun sekitar 550 SM dan dianggap salah satu Tujuh Keajaiban Dunia Kuno. Pemujaannya juga ada di Brauron, tempat ritus peralihan bagi gadis muda diselenggarakan, dan di Sparta serta Athena ia dipuja sebagai Artemis Agrotera. Di Ephesus pemujaannya memuat unsur dari timur dan satu sumber ensiklopedis menganggap Artemis Ephesus berbeda dari dewi Yunani.
long_description.en:
In ancient Greek religion Artemis presides over hunting, wilderness, animals, and childbirth. She is the daughter of Leto and Zeus and twin sister of Apollo, and is often said to roam forests and mountains with nymphs. Her birthplace is given as Delos or Ortygia, and some traditions even name different parents.

Artemis's most distinctive attributes are her bow and arrows, and the deer is her sacred animal. Ancient Greek art most often shows her as a maiden huntress with quiver and bow or a spear. Early representations present her as a goddess of animals, winged and holding an animal in each hand.

Artemis is regarded as a protector of children and of women in childbirth, yet also as a bringer of sudden death and disease to women and girls. She can also heal, as when she heals Aeneas. In classical hymns she sends her arrows over the mountains, and for those she regards graciously the fields and livestock prosper.

Stories of Artemis show both her protective and her wrathful sides. In her anger the Achaean fleet is held back until Iphigenia is about to be sacrificed, and she then substitutes a deer. The hunter Actaion is turned into a stag and torn apart by his own dogs, and Niobe's daughters are killed by her bow.

The temple of Artemis at Ephesus, begun around 550 BCE, ranked among the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World. Her cult was also found at Brauron, where rites of passage for young girls were held, and at Sparta and Athens she was worshipped as Artemis Agrotera. At Ephesus her cult included eastern elements, and one scholarly source considers the Ephesian Artemis distinct from the Greek goddess.
