literal_meaning.en: The origin of the name is uncertain; various origins have been proposed.

who.id: Dewi perburuan, alam liar, dan hewan dalam agama Yunani kuno.
who.en: Goddess of hunting, wilderness, and animals in ancient Greek religion.

role.id: Pelindung anak perempuan dan perempuan saat melahirkan.
role.en: Patron of girls and protector of women in childbirth.

famous_for.id: Kuilnya di Ephesus, salah satu Tujuh Keajaiban Dunia Kuno.
famous_for.en: Her temple at Ephesus, one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World.

did_you_know.id: Dalam kisah yang dicatat World History Encyclopedia, Artemis kecil meminta kepada ayahnya keperawanan abadi, banyak nama seperti Apollo, serta busur dan anak panah.
did_you_know.en: In the account recorded by World History Encyclopedia, the young Artemis asks her father for eternal virginity, as many names as Apollo, and a bow and arrow.

cultural_context.id: Sumber menyebut Artemis dipuja sebagai pelindung anak perempuan dan perempuan muda serta penolong saat melahirkan, dan di Brauron ia menjadi pusat ritus peralihan bagi gadis dan calon pengantin.
cultural_context.en: Sources describe Artemis as worshipped as a patron of girls and young women and as a helper in childbirth, and at Brauron she was the focus of rites of passage for girls and brides-to-be.

name.en: Huntress and mistress of wild animals

description.id: Sumber menyebut kekuatan khususnya mencakup menjadi pemburu luar biasa dan penguasa semua hewan liar.
description.en: A source says her special powers include being an extraordinary huntress and the mistress of all wild animals.

description.id: Bersama Apollon, ia dipandang sebagai pembawa kematian mendadak dan penyakit, dengan sasaran perempuan dan anak perempuan.
description.en: Together with Apollon she is seen as a bringer of sudden death and disease, targeting women and girls.

description.id: Ia menyembuhkan Aeneas yang terluka, dan satu sumber menyebutnya menyembuhkan serta meringankan penderitaan manusia.
description.en: She heals the wounded Aeneas, and one source says she cured and alleviated the sufferings of mortals.

description.id: Dalam kisah, ia mengubah Actaion menjadi rusa jantan dan Callisto menjadi beruang.
description.en: In stories she turns Actaion into a stag and Callisto into a bear.

description.id: Di Sparta dan di Athena (setelah Pertempuran Marathon) Artemis dipuja sebagai Artemis Agrotera dan dipandang sebagai dewi pertempuran.
description.en: At Sparta and at Athens (after the Battle of Marathon) Artemis was worshipped as Artemis Agrotera and regarded as a goddess of battle.

description.id: Di Ephesus ia dipuja sebagai dewi kesuburan dengan unsur dari timur, dan lebah, kurma, serta rusa jantan menjadi lambang utamanya. Satu sumber ensiklopedis menyebut Artemis Ephesus dewi yang sama sekali berbeda dari dewi Yunani.
description.en: At Ephesus she was revered as a fertility deity with eastern elements, and the bee, date palm, and stag were her principal symbols. One encyclopedic source calls the Ephesian Artemis a divinity totally distinct from the Greek goddess.

role.id: Dewi yang murka lalu menyelamatkan Iphigenia.
role.en: The angered goddess who then rescues Iphigenia.

summary.id: Agamemnon membuat Artemis murka dengan membunuh rusanya, sehingga armada Akhaia tidak bisa berlayar. Setelah Iphigenia dikorbankan, Artemis menggantinya dengan rusa dan menjadikannya pendeta di Tauris.
summary.en: Agamemnon angers Artemis by killing her deer, and the Achaean fleet cannot sail. When Iphigenia is offered in sacrifice, Artemis substitutes a deer and makes her a priestess at Tauris.

role.id: Dewi yang mengubah pemburu menjadi rusa jantan.
role.en: The goddess who turns a hunter into a stag.

summary.id: Actaion diubah menjadi rusa jantan lalu dicabik anjing-anjingnya sendiri; sebabnya adalah bualannya sebagai pemburu atau, dalam versi lain, karena ia mengintip Artemis mandi.
summary.en: Actaion is turned into a stag and torn apart by his own dogs, for boasting as a hunter or, in another version, for spying on Artemis bathing.

role.id: Dewi yang mengubah pengiringnya menjadi beruang.
role.en: The goddess who turns her attendant into a bear.

summary.id: Callisto, dayang sang dewi yang dirayu Zeus, diubah Artemis menjadi beruang dan diasingkan; Zeus kemudian menjadikan Callisto dan putranya Arcas rasi beruang besar dan kecil.
summary.en: Callisto, the goddess's handmaiden whom Zeus seduced, is turned into a bear and exiled by Artemis; Zeus later turns Callisto and her son Arcas into the great and little bear constellations.

role.id: Dewi yang membunuh, atau tertipu membunuh, Orion.
role.en: The goddess who kills, or is tricked into killing, Orion.

summary.id: World History Encyclopedia menyebut Artemis membunuh Orion setelah percobaan pemerkosaan, sedangkan Theoi menyebut Apollon menipunya hingga ia membunuh Orion dan ia lalu menempatkan Orion di antara bintang.
summary.en: World History Encyclopedia says Artemis kills Orion after an attempted rape, while Theoi says Apollon tricks her into killing him and she places him among the stars.

role.id: Dewi yang mengirim babi hutan sebagai hukuman.

summary.en: Artemis sends a huge boar to ravage Kalydon after the city neglects to sacrifice to her.

role.en: The goddess who kills with her bow.

summary.id: Setelah Niobe membual melampaui Leto, Artemis membunuh putri-putrinya dengan busur.
summary.en: After Niobe boasts of surpassing Leto, Artemis kills her daughters with her bow.

role.en: The goddess who takes the form of a doe to trick the giants.

summary.en: When the Aloadai try to storm Olympos, Artemis takes the form of a doe and runs between them so that they strike each other dead.

description.en: The handles of the Francois vase show Artemis holding a panther and stag and lions.

note.en: The hunter whom Artemis kills in the stories.

note.en: Artemis's attendant who is turned into a bear.

note.en: The girl Artemis saves from sacrifice and makes a priestess.

summary.en: One tradition makes her a daughter of Demeter, and an Egyptian story makes her the daughter of Dionysus and Isis.

claim.id: Artemis adalah dewi Yunani kuno yang membawahi perburuan, alam liar, hewan, dan kelahiran anak.
claim.en: Artemis is an ancient Greek goddess of hunting, wilderness, animals, and childbirth.

claims_provenance.quote: is the goddess of hunting, the wilderness, wild animals, transitions, nature, vegetation, childbirth, care of children, and chastity.

claim.id: Artemis adalah putri Leto dan Zeus serta saudara kembar Apollo.
claim.en: Artemis is Leto and Zeus's daughter and Apollo's twin.

claims_provenance.quote: Artemis was the daughter of Leto and Zeus, and twin sister of Apollo.

claim.id: Artemis sering dikisahkan berkeliaran di hutan dan gunung bersama para nimfa.
claim.en: Artemis was said to roam forests and mountains with nymphs.

claims_provenance.quote: She was often said to roam the forests and mountains, attended by an entourage of nymphs.

claim.id: Padanan Artemis dalam tradisi Romawi adalah Diana.
claim.en: Artemis's Roman counterpart is Diana.

claims_provenance.quote: The goddess Diana is her Roman equivalent.

claim.id: Dalam seni kuno Artemis lazim digambarkan sebagai gadis atau perempuan muda dengan busur dan tabung anak panah.
claim.en: Ancient art commonly shows Artemis as a girl or young woman with a hunting bow and quiver.

claims_provenance.quote: In ancient art Artemis was usually depicted as a girl or young maiden with a hunting bow and quiver of arrows.

claim.id: Artemis menjadi pelindung gadis, perempuan muda, dan perempuan yang melahirkan; situs pemujaannya yang terkenal adalah Kuil Artemis di Ephesus, salah satu Tujuh Keajaiban Dunia Kuno.
claim.en: Artemis protected girls, young women, and women in childbirth; her famous temple at Ephesus was one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World.

claims_provenance.quote: Daughter of Zeus and sister of Apollo, Artemis was a patron of girls and young women, and a protectress during childbirth. Artemis was widely worshipped but her most famous cult site was the Temple of Artemis at Ephesus, one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World.

claim.id: Raja Agamemnon membuat Artemis murka karena membunuh seekor rusa di hutan suci; sebagai hukuman Artemis membuat armada Akhaia terjebak tanpa angin, dan hanya pengorbanan Iphigenia yang akan menenangkannya.
claim.en: King Agamemnon displeased Artemis by killing one of her deer in a sacred grove; as punishment she becalmed the Achaean fleet, and only the sacrifice of Iphigenia would appease her.

claims_provenance.quote: The king had displeased the goddess by killing one of her deer in a sacred grove. As punishment, Artemis becalmed the Achaean fleet and only the sacrifice of Iphigenia would appease the goddess into granting a fair wind to Troy.

claim.id: Agamemnon mengorbankan putrinya, tetapi pada saat terakhir sang dewi menggantinya dengan seekor rusa dan menjadikan Iphigenia pendeta di tempat sucinya di Tauris.
claim.en: Agamemnon offered his daughter, but at the last moment the goddess substituted a deer and made Iphigenia a priestess at her sanctuary at Tauris.

claims_provenance.quote: Agamemnon duly offered his daughter in sacrifice, but in pity and at the last moment, the goddess substituted a deer for the girl and made Iphigenia a priestess at her sanctuary at Tauris.

claim.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Artemis dikatakan membunuh pemburu Orion setelah Orion berusaha memperkosa Artemis sendiri atau salah satu pengikutnya.
claim.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, Artemis is said to have killed the hunter Orion after his attempted rape of either Artemis herself or one of her followers.

claims_provenance.quote: The goddess is said to have killed the hunter Orion after his attempted rape of either Artemis herself or one of her followers.

claim.id: Menurut Theoi, Orion adalah sahabat sang dewi; Apollon yang cemburu memperdayainya hingga ia membunuh Orion dengan anak panah dari jauh, lalu Artemis menempatkan Orion di antara bintang sebagai rasi Orion.
claim.en: According to Theoi, Orion was the goddess's companion; her jealous brother Apollon tricked her into killing him with a distant bow-shot, and in grief Artemis placed him among the stars as the constellation Orion.

claims_provenance.quote: The handsome giant Orion was a companion of the goddess but her jealous brother Apollon tricked her into killing him with a distant bow-shot. In her grief Artemis placed him amongst the stars as the constellation Orion.

claim.id: Artemis mengubah Callisto, salah satu pengiringnya, menjadi beruang setelah Callisto tidur dengan Zeus; Zeus kemudian mengubah Callisto dan putranya Arcas menjadi rasi beruang besar dan beruang kecil.
claim.en: Artemis turned Callisto, one of her entourage, into a bear after she lay with Zeus, who then turned her and her son Arcas into the constellations of the great and little bear.

claims_provenance.quote: Artemis turned Callisto, one of the goddess' entourage, into a bear after she had lain with Zeus, who then turned her and her son Arcas into the constellations the great and little bear

claim.id: Pemburu Actaion diubah Artemis menjadi rusa jantan, entah karena berani membual bahwa ia pemburu yang lebih hebat, entah (dalam versi lain) karena mengintip Artemis mandi di kolam hutan; ia lalu dicabik oleh 50 anjing pemburunya sendiri.
claim.en: The hunter Actaion was turned into a stag by Artemis, either for boasting he was the greater hunter or (in another version) for spying on her bathing in a forest pool; he was then torn apart by his own 50 hunting dogs.

claims_provenance.quote: The hunter Actaion, after he dared boast he was the greater hunter or, in another version, had spied on Artemis while she had bathed in a forest pool, was turned into a stag by the goddess. Actaion was then torn to pieces by his own pack of 50 hunting dogs.

claim.id: Artemis memakai busurnya untuk membunuh enam (dalam sebagian kisah tujuh) putri Niobe setelah Niobe membual bahwa kemampuannya melahirkan lebih besar daripada Leto.
claim.en: Artemis uses her bow to kill the six (or in some accounts seven) daughters of Niobe after Niobe boasted that her childbearing capacity was greater than Leto's.

claims_provenance.quote: The goddess uses her bow to mercilessly kill the six (or in some accounts seven) daughters of Niobe following her boast that her childbearing capacity was greater than Leto's.

claim.id: Artemis mengirim babi hutan raksasa untuk merusak Kalydon setelah kota itu lalai mempersembahkan kurban kepadanya.
claim.en: Artemis sent a huge boar to ravage Kalydon after the city neglected to sacrifice to her.

claims_provenance.quote: Finally, Artemis sent a huge boar to ravage Kalydon after the city had neglected to sacrifice to the goddess.

claim.id: Ketika raksasa Aloadai mencoba menyerbu Olimpos, Artemis berwujud rusa betina dan berlari di antara mereka sehingga keduanya melempar tombak, meleset, dan saling membunuh.
claim.en: When the Aloadai giants tried to storm Olympos, Artemis took the form of a doe and ran between them, so that the pair cast their spears, missed, and struck each other dead.

claims_provenance.quote: When the Aloadai (Aloadae) giants tried to storm Olympos, Artemis assumed the form of a doe and raced between them causing the pair to cast their spears, miss, and strike each other dead.

claim.id: Artemis menjadi sekutu ilahi bangsa Troya dalam Perang Troya; dalam bentrokan antarkubu dewa ia berhadapan dengan Hera, yang merebut busurnya, memukulinya, dan membuatnya lari menangis ke Olimpos.
claim.en: Artemis was a divine ally of the Trojans in the Trojan War; in a clash between rival factions of gods she confronted Hera, who tore the bow from her hands, beat her, and sent her fleeing to Olympos in tears.

claims_provenance.quote: Artemis was a divine ally of the Trojans during the Trojan War. In a clash between the rival factions of gods she confronted Hera, but the Queen of the Gods tore the bow from her hands, beat her about the head, and sent her fleeing back to Olympos in tears.

claim.id: Atribut Artemis yang paling khas adalah busur dan anak panah; ia kadang juga dilengkapi tabung panah, sepasang tombak berburu, obor, lira, dan/atau kendi air.
claim.en: Artemis' most distinctive attributes were her bow and arrows; she was also sometimes equipped with a quiver, a pair of hunting spears, a torch, a lyre, and/or a water-jug.

claims_provenance.quote: Artemis' most distinctive attributes were her bow and arrows but she was also sometimes equipped with a quiver, pair of hunting spears, torch, lyre, and/or water-jug.

claim.id: Hewan suci Artemis adalah rusa; ia mengendarai kereta yang ditarik sepasang rusa dan sering digambarkan memegang atau memburu rusa atau berjubah kulit rusa.
claim.en: Artemis' sacred animal was the deer; she drove a chariot drawn by a pair of deer and was often shown holding or hunting a deer or wearing a deer-skin cape.

claims_provenance.quote: Artemis' sacred animal was the deer. She drove a chariot drawn by a pair of the beasts and was often depicted holding or hunting a deer or with a deer-skin cape draped over her shoulders.

claim.id: Artemis dan Apollon juga dipandang sebagai pembawa kematian mendadak dan penyakit; Artemis menyasar perempuan dan anak perempuan, Apollon laki-laki dan anak laki-laki.
claim.en: Artemis and Apollon were also bringers of sudden death and disease; Artemis targeted women and girls, Apollon men and boys.

claims_provenance.quote: Together the two gods were also bringers of sudden death and disease--Artemis targetted women and girls, Apollon men and boys.

claim.id: Dalam mendukung bangsa Troya, Artemis menyembuhkan Aeneas setelah Aeneas dilukai Diomedes.
claim.en: Supporting the Trojans, Artemis heals Aeneas after he is wounded by Diomedes.

claims_provenance.quote: Supporting the Trojans, she notably heals Aeneas after he is wounded by Diomedes.

claim.id: Himne Homerik 27 melukiskan Artemis menarik busur emasnya di bukit berbayang dan puncak berangin, bersuka dalam perburuan, dan melepaskan anak panah yang menyakitkan.
claim.en: Homeric Hymn 27 describes Artemis drawing her golden bow over shadowy hills and windy peaks, rejoicing in the chase, and sending out grievous shafts.

claims_provenance.quote: Over the shadowy hills and windy peaks she draws her golden bow, rejoicing in the chase, and sends out grievous shafts.
claims_provenance.locator: Classical Literature Quotes, Homeric Hymn 27 to Artemis (trans. Evelyn-White)

claim.id: Himne Kallimakhos kepada Artemis menyebut bahwa bagi orang yang dipandang Artemis dengan ramah, ladang berbuah melimpah, ternak berkaki empat berkembang, dan kemakmuran mereka bertambah.
claim.en: Callimachus's Hymn to Artemis says that for those on whom Artemis looks graciously, the tilled land bears corn abundantly, four-footed livestock prosper, and their prosperity grows.

claims_provenance.quote: But on whomsoever thou lookest smiling and gracious, for them the tilth bears the corn-ear abundantly, and abundantly prospers the four-footed breed, and abundant waxes their prosperity
claims_provenance.locator: Classical Literature Quotes, Callimachus Hymn 3 to Artemis (trans. Mair)

claim.id: Kuil Artemis yang termasyhur di Ephesus mulai dibangun sekitar 550 SM; ketika selesai setelah kerja selama seabad, ukurannya hampir dua kali Parthenon di Athena, dan dianggap salah satu Tujuh Keajaiban Dunia Kuno.
claim.en: The famous temple of Artemis at Ephesus was begun c. 550 BCE; finished after a century of labour, it was almost twice the size of Athens' Parthenon and regarded as one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World.

claims_provenance.quote: The famous temple of Artemis at the city (begun c. 550 BCE) was almost twice the size of Athens' Parthenon when it was finally finished after a century of labour; it was regarded as one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World.

claim.id: Tempat pemujaan Artemis yang penting lainnya mencakup tempat suci di Brauron, Tauris, Magnesia, Perge, dan pulau Delos, tempat ia lahir dalam sebagian versi mitos dan membantu kelahiran saudaranya Apollo.
claim.en: Other notable places of worship of Artemis were sanctuaries at Brauron, Tauris, Magnesia, Perge, and on the island of Delos, where she was born in some versions of the myth and assisted the birth of her brother Apollo.

claims_provenance.quote: Other notable places of worship of Artemis were the sanctuaries at Brauron, Tauris, Magnesia, Perge, and on the island of Delos, where the goddess was born in some myth versions and where she assisted the birth of her brother Apollo.

claim.id: Di Brauron, di pantai timur Attika, sebuah situs kuil dan mata air suci dipakai dari abad ke-8 hingga ke-3 SM dan menjadi tempat ritus peralihan bagi gadis muda dan calon pengantin.
claim.en: At Brauron, on the east coast of Attica, a temple site and sacred spring was in use from the 8th to 3rd century BCE and hosted rites of passage for young girls and brides-to-be.

claims_provenance.quote: At Brauron, on the east coast of Attica, a temple site and sacred spring was in use from the 8th to 3rd century BCE and hosted rites of passage for young girls and brides-to-be.

claim.id: Dalam seni Yunani kuno Artemis paling sering digambarkan sebagai gadis pemburu yang cantik dengan tabung panah dan busur, atau sebagai alternatif dengan tombak.
claim.en: In ancient Greek art Artemis is most frequently portrayed as a beautiful maiden huntress with quiver and bow or, alternatively, a spear.

claims_provenance.quote: Artemis is most frequently portrayed in ancient Greek art as a beautiful maiden huntress with quiver and bow or, alternatively, a spear.
claims_provenance.locator: How is Artemis Represented in Art?

claim.id: Penggambaran awal menekankan peran Artemis sebagai dewi hewan dan menampilkannya bersayap dengan seekor burung atau hewan di tiap tangan; pada gagang Vas Francois (570-565 SM) ia memegang macan tutul dan rusa jantan di satu adegan dan singa di adegan lain.
claim.en: Early representations emphasise her role as goddess of animals and show her winged with a bird or animal in each hand; on the handles of the Francois vase (570-565 BCE) she holds a panther and stag in one depiction and lions in another.

claims_provenance.quote: Early representations also emphasise her role as goddess of animals and show her winged with a bird or animal in each hand. For example, on the handles of the celebrated Francois vase (570-565 BCE), she holds a panther and stag in one depiction and lions in another.
claims_provenance.locator: How is Artemis Represented in Art?

claim.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Artemis lahir di Delos atau Ortygia (dekat Ephesus di Turki bagian barat) dan merupakan saudari kembar Apollo.
claim.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, Artemis was born either on Delos or Ortygia (near Ephesus in Western Turkey) and is Apollo's twin sister.

claims_provenance.quote: Born either on Delos or Ortygia (near Ephesus in Western Turkey), she is the twin sister of the god Apollo.

claim.id: Menurut Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology yang dikutip Theoi, satu tradisi menyebut Artemis putri Demeter, bukan Leto, dan menurut kisah Mesir ia putri Dionysus dan Isis, sedangkan Leto hanya pengasuhnya.
claim.en: According to the Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology reproduced on Theoi, one tradition made Artemis a daughter of Demeter rather than Leto, and an Egyptian story made her the daughter of Dionysus and Isis, with Leto only her nurse.

claims_provenance.quote: Artemis was a daughter of Demeter, and not of Leto, while according to an Egyptian story (Herod. ii. 156) she was the daughter of Dionysus and Isis, and Leto was only her nurse.
claims_provenance.locator: Encyclopedia (Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology)

claim.id: Bentuk nama Artemis yang paling awal terbukti adalah bentuk Yunani Mykenai yang ditulis dalam Linear B di Pylos.
claim.en: The earliest attested forms of the name Artemis are Mycenaean Greek, written in Linear B at Pylos.

claims_provenance.quote: the earliest attested forms of the name Artemis are the Mycenaean Greek ... written in Linear B at Pylos.

claim.id: Asal-usul nama "Artemis" masih belum pasti, meski berbagai asal telah diusulkan.
claim.en: The etymology of the name "Artemis" remains uncertain, though various origins have been proposed.

claims_provenance.quote: The etymology of the name "Artemis" (n., f.) remains uncertain, though various origins have been proposed.

claim.id: Artemis adalah dewi kourotrofik (pengasuh anak), pelindung anak-anak terutama anak perempuan serta anak hewan, dan dipuja serta ditakuti sebagai salah satu dewi utama persalinan dan kebidanan bersama Eileithyia dan Hera.
claim.en: Artemis was a kourotrophic (child-nurturing) deity, protector of children, especially girls, and animal cubs, and was worshipped and feared as one of the primary goddesses of childbirth and midwifery along with Eileithyia and Hera.

claims_provenance.quote: Artemis was a kourotrophic (child-nurturing) deity, being the protector of children, especially girls, and animal cubs. She was worshipped and feared as one of the primary goddesses of childbirth and midwifery along with Eileithyia and Hera.

claim.id: Menurut Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology, seperti Apollo yang tidak hanya merusak tetapi juga menangkal malapetaka, Artemis pada saat yang sama menyembuhkan dan meringankan penderitaan manusia.
claim.en: According to the Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology, just as Apollo not only destroyed but also averted evils, Artemis at the same time cured and alleviated the sufferings of mortals.

claims_provenance.quote: As Apollo was not only a destructive god, but also averted the evils which it was in his power to inflict, so Artemis was at the same time a thea ... that is, she cured and alleviated the sufferings of mortals.
claims_provenance.locator: Encyclopedia (Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology)

claim.id: Di Sparta dan Athena (setelah Pertempuran Marathon tahun 490 SM) Artemis dipuja sebagai Artemis Agrotera dan dipandang sebagai dewi pertempuran; orang Sparta mengorbankan seekor kambing kepadanya sebelum bertempur.
claim.en: At Sparta and Athens (after the Battle of Marathon of 490 BCE) Artemis was worshipped as Artemis Agrotera and regarded as a goddess of battle, the Spartans sacrificing a goat to her before an engagement.

claims_provenance.quote: At Sparta and Athens (after the Battle of Marathon of 490 BCE), Artemis was worshipped as Artemis Agrotera and regarded as a goddess of battle, a goat being sacrificed to her before an engagement by the Spartans

claim.id: Sebagai dewi kesuburan, Artemis Ephesia sangat dipuja di Ephesus; pemujaannya memuat unsur-unsur dari timur (dipinjam dari dewi seperti Isis, Kibele, dan "Nyonya Para Hewan") dengan lebah, kurma, dan rusa jantan sebagai lambang utama.
claim.en: As a deity of fertility, Artemis Ephesia was particularly revered at Ephesus; her cult included eastern elements (borrowed from goddesses such as Isis, Cybele, and the "Mistress of the Animals") and her principal symbols were the bee, date palm, and stag.

claims_provenance.quote: As a deity of fertility, Artemis Ephesia was particularly revered at Ephesus, near to what many believed was her birthplace, Ortygia. Here, her cult included eastern elements (borrowed from goddesses such as Isis, Cybele, and the "Mistress of the Animals") and her principal symbols were the bee, date palm, and stag.

claim.id: Menurut Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology, Artemis dari Ephesus adalah dewi yang sama sekali berbeda dari dewi Yunani bernama sama.
claim.en: According to the Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology, the Ephesian Artemis was a divinity totally distinct from the Greek goddess of the same name.

claims_provenance.quote: The Ephesian Artemis was a divinity totally distinct from the Greek goddess of the same name.
claims_provenance.locator: Encyclopedia (Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology)

claim.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, kekuatan khusus Artemis mencakup menjadi pemburu luar biasa dan penguasa semua hewan liar.
claim.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, Artemis's special powers include being an extraordinary huntress and the mistress of all wild animals.

claims_provenance.quote: The goddess Artemis has special powers which include being an extraordinary huntress and the mistress of all wild animals.

claim.id: Dalam permintaannya kepada Zeus, Artemis kecil memohon keperawanan abadi, sebanyak nama saudaranya Apollo, busur dan anak panah seperti milik Apollo, dan tugas membawa cahaya.
claim.en: In her request to Zeus, the young Artemis asks for eternal virginity, as many names as her brother Apollo, a bow and arrow like his, and the office of bringing light.

claims_provenance.quote: Pray give me eternal virginity; as many names as my brother Apollo; a bow and arrow like his; the office of bringing light;

claim.id: Menurut Theoi, Kallisto adalah dayang sang dewi yang dirayu Zeus dengan menyamar sebagai dirinya; ketika Artemis tahu gadis itu hamil, ia mengubahnya menjadi beruang dan mengasingkannya ke alam liar.
claim.en: According to Theoi, Kallisto was a handmaiden of the goddess whom Zeus seduced by assuming her form; when Artemis discovered she was pregnant she transformed her into a bear and exiled her to the wilds.

claims_provenance.quote: Kallisto (Callisto) was a handmaiden of the goddess who Zeus seduced by assuming her form. When Artemis discovered the girl was pregnant she transformed her into a bear and exiled her to the wilds.

short_description.id: Artemis adalah dewi perburuan, alam liar, dan hewan dalam agama Yunani kuno, sekaligus pelindung anak perempuan dan perempuan yang melahirkan.
short_description.en: Artemis is a goddess of hunting, wilderness, and animals in ancient Greek religion, and a protector of girls and of women in childbirth.

long_description.id: Dalam agama Yunani kuno, Artemis membawahi perburuan, alam liar, hewan, dan kelahiran anak. Ia putri Leto dan Zeus serta saudara kembar Apollo, dan kerap dikisahkan berkeliaran di hutan dan gunung bersama para nimfa. Tempat kelahirannya disebut Delos atau Ortygia, dan sebagian tradisi bahkan menyebut orang tua yang berbeda.
long_description.en: In ancient Greek religion Artemis presides over hunting, wilderness, animals, and childbirth. She is the daughter of Leto and Zeus and twin sister of Apollo, and is often said to roam forests and mountains with nymphs. Her birthplace is given as Delos or Ortygia, and some traditions even name different parents.

long_description.id: Atribut Artemis yang paling khas adalah busur dan anak panah, dan hewan sucinya adalah rusa. Seni Yunani kuno paling sering menggambarkannya sebagai gadis pemburu dengan tabung panah dan busur atau tombak. Penggambaran awal menampilkannya sebagai dewi hewan, bersayap dan memegang hewan di kedua tangan.
long_description.en: Artemis's most distinctive attributes are her bow and arrows, and the deer is her sacred animal. Ancient Greek art most often shows her as a maiden huntress with quiver and bow or a spear. Early representations present her as a goddess of animals, winged and holding an animal in each hand.

long_description.id: Artemis dipandang sebagai pelindung anak dan perempuan yang melahirkan, tetapi juga sebagai pembawa kematian mendadak dan penyakit bagi perempuan dan anak perempuan. Ia dapat pula menyembuhkan, seperti saat menyembuhkan Aeneas. Dalam himne klasik ia melepaskan anak panah di pegunungan, dan bagi orang yang ia pandang dengan ramah ladang dan ternak berkembang.
long_description.en: Artemis is regarded as a protector of children and of women in childbirth, yet also as a bringer of sudden death and disease to women and girls. She can also heal, as when she heals Aeneas. In classical hymns she sends her arrows over the mountains, and for those she regards graciously the fields and livestock prosper.

long_description.id: Kisah-kisah Artemis menampilkan sisi pelindung dan sisi murkanya. Karena ia murka, armada Akhaia terhenti hingga Iphigenia hendak dikorbankan, lalu ia menggantinya dengan seekor rusa. Pemburu Actaion diubahnya menjadi rusa jantan dan dicabik anjingnya sendiri, dan para putri Niobe dibunuh dengan busurnya.
long_description.en: Stories of Artemis show both her protective and her wrathful sides. In her anger the Achaean fleet is held back until Iphigenia is about to be sacrificed, and she then substitutes a deer. The hunter Actaion is turned into a stag and torn apart by his own dogs, and Niobe's daughters are killed by her bow.

long_description.id: Kuil Artemis di Ephesus mulai dibangun sekitar 550 SM dan dianggap salah satu Tujuh Keajaiban Dunia Kuno. Pemujaannya juga ada di Brauron, tempat ritus peralihan bagi gadis muda diselenggarakan, dan di Sparta serta Athena ia dipuja sebagai Artemis Agrotera. Di Ephesus pemujaannya memuat unsur dari timur dan satu sumber ensiklopedis menganggap Artemis Ephesus berbeda dari dewi Yunani.
long_description.en: The temple of Artemis at Ephesus, begun around 550 BCE, ranked among the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World. Her cult was also found at Brauron, where rites of passage for young girls were held, and at Sparta and Athens she was worshipped as Artemis Agrotera. At Ephesus her cult included eastern elements, and one scholarly source considers the Ephesian Artemis distinct from the Greek goddess.

cultural_context.id: Sumber menyebut Artemis dipuja sebagai pelindung anak perempuan dan perempuan muda serta penolong saat melahirkan, dan di Brauron ia menjadi pusat ritus peralihan bagi gadis dan calon pengantin.
cultural_context.en: Sources describe Artemis as worshipped as a patron of girls and young women and as a helper in childbirth, and at Brauron she was the focus of rites of passage for girls and brides-to-be.

literal_meaning.id: Asal-usul nama ini belum pasti; berbagai asal telah diusulkan.
literal_meaning.en: The origin of the name is uncertain; various origins have been proposed.

who.id: Dewi perburuan, alam liar, dan hewan dalam agama Yunani kuno.
who.en: Goddess of hunting, wilderness, and animals in ancient Greek religion.

role.id: Pelindung anak perempuan dan perempuan saat melahirkan.
role.en: Patron of girls and protector of women in childbirth.

famous_for.en: Her temple at Ephesus, one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World.

did_you_know.id: Dalam kisah yang dicatat World History Encyclopedia, Artemis kecil meminta kepada ayahnya keperawanan abadi, banyak nama seperti Apollo, serta busur dan anak panah.
did_you_know.en: In the account recorded by World History Encyclopedia, the young Artemis asks her father for eternal virginity, as many names as Apollo, and a bow and arrow.

name.en: Huntress and mistress of wild animals

description.id: Sumber menyebut kekuatan khususnya mencakup menjadi pemburu luar biasa dan penguasa semua hewan liar.
description.en: A source says her special powers include being an extraordinary huntress and the mistress of all wild animals.

description.id: Bersama Apollon, ia dipandang sebagai pembawa kematian mendadak dan penyakit, dengan sasaran perempuan dan anak perempuan.
description.en: Together with Apollon she is seen as a bringer of sudden death and disease, targeting women and girls.

description.id: Ia menyembuhkan Aeneas yang terluka, dan satu sumber menyebutnya menyembuhkan serta meringankan penderitaan manusia.
description.en: She heals the wounded Aeneas, and one source says she cured and alleviated the sufferings of mortals.

description.id: Dalam kisah, ia mengubah Actaion menjadi rusa jantan dan Callisto menjadi beruang.
description.en: In stories she turns Actaion into a stag and Callisto into a bear.

description.id: Di Sparta dan di Athena (setelah Pertempuran Marathon) Artemis dipuja sebagai Artemis Agrotera dan dipandang sebagai dewi pertempuran.
description.en: At Sparta and at Athens (after the Battle of Marathon) Artemis was worshipped as Artemis Agrotera and regarded as a goddess of battle.

description.id: Di Ephesus ia dipuja sebagai dewi kesuburan dengan unsur dari timur, dan lebah, kurma, serta rusa jantan menjadi lambang utamanya. Satu sumber ensiklopedis menyebut Artemis Ephesus dewi yang sama sekali berbeda dari dewi Yunani.
description.en: At Ephesus she was revered as a fertility deity with eastern elements, and the bee, date palm, and stag were her principal symbols. One encyclopedic source calls the Ephesian Artemis a divinity totally distinct from the Greek goddess.

role.id: Dewi yang murka lalu menyelamatkan Iphigenia.
role.en: The angered goddess who then rescues Iphigenia.

summary.id: Agamemnon membuat Artemis murka dengan membunuh rusanya, sehingga armada Akhaia tidak bisa berlayar. Setelah Iphigenia dikorbankan, Artemis menggantinya dengan rusa dan menjadikannya pendeta di Tauris.
summary.en: Agamemnon angers Artemis by killing her deer, and the Achaean fleet cannot sail. When Iphigenia is offered in sacrifice, Artemis substitutes a deer and makes her a priestess at Tauris.

role.id: Dewi yang mengubah pemburu menjadi rusa jantan.
role.en: The goddess who turns a hunter into a stag.

summary.id: Actaion diubah menjadi rusa jantan lalu dicabik anjing-anjingnya sendiri; sebabnya adalah bualannya sebagai pemburu atau, dalam versi lain, karena ia mengintip Artemis mandi.
summary.en: Actaion is turned into a stag and torn apart by his own dogs, for boasting as a hunter or, in another version, for spying on Artemis bathing.

role.id: Dewi yang mengubah pengiringnya menjadi beruang.
role.en: The goddess who turns her attendant into a bear.

summary.id: Callisto, dayang sang dewi yang dirayu Zeus, diubah Artemis menjadi beruang dan diasingkan; Zeus kemudian menjadikan Callisto dan putranya Arcas rasi beruang besar dan kecil.
summary.en: Callisto, the goddess's handmaiden whom Zeus seduced, is turned into a bear and exiled by Artemis; Zeus later turns Callisto and her son Arcas into the great and little bear constellations.

role.id: Dewi yang membunuh, atau tertipu membunuh, Orion.
role.en: The goddess who kills, or is tricked into killing, Orion.

summary.id: World History Encyclopedia menyebut Artemis membunuh Orion setelah percobaan pemerkosaan, sedangkan Theoi menyebut Apollon menipunya hingga ia membunuh Orion dan ia lalu menempatkan Orion di antara bintang.
summary.en: World History Encyclopedia says Artemis kills Orion after an attempted rape, while Theoi says Apollon tricks her into killing him and she places him among the stars.

role.id: Dewi yang mengirim babi hutan sebagai hukuman.
role.en: The goddess who sends a boar as punishment.

summary.id: Artemis mengirim babi hutan raksasa untuk merusak Kalydon setelah kota itu lalai berkurban kepadanya.
summary.en: Artemis sends a huge boar to ravage Kalydon after the city neglects to sacrifice to her.

role.en: The goddess who kills with her bow.

summary.id: Setelah Niobe membual melampaui Leto, Artemis membunuh putri-putrinya dengan busur.
summary.en: After Niobe boasts of surpassing Leto, Artemis kills her daughters with her bow.

role.id: Dewi yang berwujud rusa betina untuk memperdaya raksasa.
role.en: The goddess who takes the form of a doe to trick the giants.

summary.id: Saat Aloadai mencoba menyerbu Olimpos, Artemis berwujud rusa betina dan berlari di antara mereka sehingga mereka saling membunuh.
summary.en: When the Aloadai try to storm Olympos, Artemis takes the form of a doe and runs between them so that they strike each other dead.

description.id: Kota tempat Kuil Artemis dibangun mulai sekitar 550 SM, yang dianggap salah satu Tujuh Keajaiban Dunia Kuno.
description.en: City of the Temple of Artemis, begun c. 550 BCE and regarded as one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World.

description.id: Situs kuil dan mata air suci di pantai timur Attika, tempat ritus peralihan bagi gadis dan calon pengantin.
description.en: Temple site and sacred spring on the east coast of Attica, host to rites of passage for girls and brides-to-be.

description.id: Pulau tempat Artemis lahir dalam sebagian versi mitos dan tempat ia membantu kelahiran Apollo.
description.en: Island where Artemis was born in some versions of the myth and where she assisted the birth of Apollo.

description.id: Lokasi tempat suci Artemis tempat Iphigenia dijadikan pendeta.
description.en: Location of the Artemis sanctuary where Iphigenia was made a priestess.

learning_questions.id: Bagaimana peran Artemis dalam perburuan dan kelahiran anak ditampilkan dalam sumber?
learning_questions.en: How do the sources present Artemis's roles in hunting and childbirth?

learning_questions.id: Mengapa sumber-sumber berbeda mengenai kematian Orion?
learning_questions.en: Why might sources differ about the death of Orion?

learning_questions.id: Apa yang dapat dipelajari dari perbedaan antara Artemis di Ephesus dan Artemis Yunani lainnya?
learning_questions.en: What can be learned from the difference between the Ephesian Artemis and other Greek Artemis traditions?

claims.quote: is the goddess of hunting, the wilderness, wild animals, transitions, nature, vegetation, childbirth, care of children, and chastity.

statement.id: Artemis adalah dewi Yunani kuno yang membawahi perburuan, alam liar, hewan, dan kelahiran anak.
statement.en: Artemis is an ancient Greek goddess of hunting, wilderness, animals, and childbirth.

claims.quote: Artemis was the daughter of Leto and Zeus, and twin sister of Apollo.

statement.id: Artemis adalah putri Leto dan Zeus serta saudara kembar Apollo.
statement.en: Artemis is Leto and Zeus's daughter and Apollo's twin.

claims.quote: She was often said to roam the forests and mountains, attended by an entourage of nymphs.

statement.id: Artemis sering dikisahkan berkeliaran di hutan dan gunung bersama para nimfa.
statement.en: Artemis was said to roam forests and mountains with nymphs.

claims.quote: The goddess Diana is her Roman equivalent.

statement.id: Padanan Artemis dalam tradisi Romawi adalah Diana.
statement.en: Artemis's Roman counterpart is Diana.

claims.quote: In ancient art Artemis was usually depicted as a girl or young maiden with a hunting bow and quiver of arrows.

statement.id: Dalam seni kuno Artemis lazim digambarkan sebagai gadis atau perempuan muda dengan busur dan tabung anak panah.
statement.en: Ancient art commonly shows Artemis as a girl or young woman with a hunting bow and quiver.

claims.quote: Daughter of Zeus and sister of Apollo, Artemis was a patron of girls and young women, and a protectress during childbirth. Artemis was widely worshipped but her most famous cult site was the Temple of Artemis at Ephesus, one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World.

statement.id: Artemis menjadi pelindung gadis, perempuan muda, dan perempuan yang melahirkan; situs pemujaannya yang terkenal adalah Kuil Artemis di Ephesus, salah satu Tujuh Keajaiban Dunia Kuno.
statement.en: Artemis protected girls, young women, and women in childbirth; her famous temple at Ephesus was one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World.

claims.quote: The king had displeased the goddess by killing one of her deer in a sacred grove. As punishment, Artemis becalmed the Achaean fleet and only the sacrifice of Iphigenia would appease the goddess into granting a fair wind to Troy.

statement.id: Raja Agamemnon membuat Artemis murka karena membunuh seekor rusa di hutan suci; sebagai hukuman Artemis membuat armada Akhaia terjebak tanpa angin, dan hanya pengorbanan Iphigenia yang akan menenangkannya.
statement.en: King Agamemnon displeased Artemis by killing one of her deer in a sacred grove; as punishment she becalmed the Achaean fleet, and only the sacrifice of Iphigenia would appease her.

claims.quote: Agamemnon duly offered his daughter in sacrifice, but in pity and at the last moment, the goddess substituted a deer for the girl and made Iphigenia a priestess at her sanctuary at Tauris.

statement.id: Agamemnon mengorbankan putrinya, tetapi pada saat terakhir sang dewi menggantinya dengan seekor rusa dan menjadikan Iphigenia pendeta di tempat sucinya di Tauris.
statement.en: Agamemnon offered his daughter, but at the last moment the goddess substituted a deer and made Iphigenia a priestess at her sanctuary at Tauris.

claims.quote: The goddess is said to have killed the hunter Orion after his attempted rape of either Artemis herself or one of her followers.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Artemis dikatakan membunuh pemburu Orion setelah Orion berusaha memperkosa Artemis sendiri atau salah satu pengikutnya.
statement.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, Artemis is said to have killed the hunter Orion after his attempted rape of either Artemis herself or one of her followers.

claims.quote: The handsome giant Orion was a companion of the goddess but her jealous brother Apollon tricked her into killing him with a distant bow-shot. In her grief Artemis placed him amongst the stars as the constellation Orion.

statement.id: Menurut Theoi, Orion adalah sahabat sang dewi; Apollon yang cemburu memperdayainya hingga ia membunuh Orion dengan anak panah dari jauh, lalu Artemis menempatkan Orion di antara bintang sebagai rasi Orion.
statement.en: According to Theoi, Orion was the goddess's companion; her jealous brother Apollon tricked her into killing him with a distant bow-shot, and in grief Artemis placed him among the stars as the constellation Orion.

claims.quote: Artemis turned Callisto, one of the goddess' entourage, into a bear after she had lain with Zeus, who then turned her and her son Arcas into the constellations the great and little bear

statement.id: Artemis mengubah Callisto, salah satu pengiringnya, menjadi beruang setelah Callisto tidur dengan Zeus; Zeus kemudian mengubah Callisto dan putranya Arcas menjadi rasi beruang besar dan beruang kecil.
statement.en: Artemis turned Callisto, one of her entourage, into a bear after she lay with Zeus, who then turned her and her son Arcas into the constellations of the great and little bear.

claims.quote: The hunter Actaion, after he dared boast he was the greater hunter or, in another version, had spied on Artemis while she had bathed in a forest pool, was turned into a stag by the goddess. Actaion was then torn to pieces by his own pack of 50 hunting dogs.

statement.id: Pemburu Actaion diubah Artemis menjadi rusa jantan, entah karena berani membual bahwa ia pemburu yang lebih hebat, entah (dalam versi lain) karena mengintip Artemis mandi di kolam hutan; ia lalu dicabik oleh 50 anjing pemburunya sendiri.
statement.en: The hunter Actaion was turned into a stag by Artemis, either for boasting he was the greater hunter or (in another version) for spying on her bathing in a forest pool; he was then torn apart by his own 50 hunting dogs.

claims.quote: The goddess uses her bow to mercilessly kill the six (or in some accounts seven) daughters of Niobe following her boast that her childbearing capacity was greater than Leto's.

statement.id: Artemis memakai busurnya untuk membunuh enam (dalam sebagian kisah tujuh) putri Niobe setelah Niobe membual bahwa kemampuannya melahirkan lebih besar daripada Leto.
statement.en: Artemis uses her bow to kill the six (or in some accounts seven) daughters of Niobe after Niobe boasted that her childbearing capacity was greater than Leto's.

claims.quote: Finally, Artemis sent a huge boar to ravage Kalydon after the city had neglected to sacrifice to the goddess.

statement.id: Artemis mengirim babi hutan raksasa untuk merusak Kalydon setelah kota itu lalai mempersembahkan kurban kepadanya.
statement.en: Artemis sent a huge boar to ravage Kalydon after the city neglected to sacrifice to her.

claims.quote: When the Aloadai (Aloadae) giants tried to storm Olympos, Artemis assumed the form of a doe and raced between them causing the pair to cast their spears, miss, and strike each other dead.

statement.id: Ketika raksasa Aloadai mencoba menyerbu Olimpos, Artemis berwujud rusa betina dan berlari di antara mereka sehingga keduanya melempar tombak, meleset, dan saling membunuh.
statement.en: When the Aloadai giants tried to storm Olympos, Artemis took the form of a doe and ran between them, so that the pair cast their spears, missed, and struck each other dead.

claims.quote: Artemis was a divine ally of the Trojans during the Trojan War. In a clash between the rival factions of gods she confronted Hera, but the Queen of the Gods tore the bow from her hands, beat her about the head, and sent her fleeing back to Olympos in tears.

statement.id: Artemis menjadi sekutu ilahi bangsa Troya dalam Perang Troya; dalam bentrokan antarkubu dewa ia berhadapan dengan Hera, yang merebut busurnya, memukulinya, dan membuatnya lari menangis ke Olimpos.
statement.en: Artemis was a divine ally of the Trojans in the Trojan War; in a clash between rival factions of gods she confronted Hera, who tore the bow from her hands, beat her, and sent her fleeing to Olympos in tears.

claims.quote: Artemis' most distinctive attributes were her bow and arrows but she was also sometimes equipped with a quiver, pair of hunting spears, torch, lyre, and/or water-jug.

statement.id: Atribut Artemis yang paling khas adalah busur dan anak panah; ia kadang juga dilengkapi tabung panah, sepasang tombak berburu, obor, lira, dan/atau kendi air.
statement.en: Artemis' most distinctive attributes were her bow and arrows; she was also sometimes equipped with a quiver, a pair of hunting spears, a torch, a lyre, and/or a water-jug.

claims.quote: Artemis' sacred animal was the deer. She drove a chariot drawn by a pair of the beasts and was often depicted holding or hunting a deer or with a deer-skin cape draped over her shoulders.

statement.id: Hewan suci Artemis adalah rusa; ia mengendarai kereta yang ditarik sepasang rusa dan sering digambarkan memegang atau memburu rusa atau berjubah kulit rusa.
statement.en: Artemis' sacred animal was the deer; she drove a chariot drawn by a pair of deer and was often shown holding or hunting a deer or wearing a deer-skin cape.

claims.quote: Together the two gods were also bringers of sudden death and disease--Artemis targetted women and girls, Apollon men and boys.

statement.id: Artemis dan Apollon juga dipandang sebagai pembawa kematian mendadak dan penyakit; Artemis menyasar perempuan dan anak perempuan, Apollon laki-laki dan anak laki-laki.
statement.en: Artemis and Apollon were also bringers of sudden death and disease; Artemis targeted women and girls, Apollon men and boys.

claims.quote: Supporting the Trojans, she notably heals Aeneas after he is wounded by Diomedes.

statement.id: Dalam mendukung bangsa Troya, Artemis menyembuhkan Aeneas setelah Aeneas dilukai Diomedes.
statement.en: Supporting the Trojans, Artemis heals Aeneas after he is wounded by Diomedes.

claims.quote: Over the shadowy hills and windy peaks she draws her golden bow, rejoicing in the chase, and sends out grievous shafts.
claims.locator: Classical Literature Quotes, Homeric Hymn 27 to Artemis (trans. Evelyn-White)

statement.id: Himne Homerik 27 melukiskan Artemis menarik busur emasnya di bukit berbayang dan puncak berangin, bersuka dalam perburuan, dan melepaskan anak panah yang menyakitkan.
statement.en: Homeric Hymn 27 describes Artemis drawing her golden bow over shadowy hills and windy peaks, rejoicing in the chase, and sending out grievous shafts.

claims.quote: But on whomsoever thou lookest smiling and gracious, for them the tilth bears the corn-ear abundantly, and abundantly prospers the four-footed breed, and abundant waxes their prosperity
claims.locator: Classical Literature Quotes, Callimachus Hymn 3 to Artemis (trans. Mair)

statement.id: Himne Kallimakhos kepada Artemis menyebut bahwa bagi orang yang dipandang Artemis dengan ramah, ladang berbuah melimpah, ternak berkaki empat berkembang, dan kemakmuran mereka bertambah.
statement.en: Callimachus's Hymn to Artemis says that for those on whom Artemis looks graciously, the tilled land bears corn abundantly, four-footed livestock prosper, and their prosperity grows.

claims.quote: The famous temple of Artemis at the city (begun c. 550 BCE) was almost twice the size of Athens' Parthenon when it was finally finished after a century of labour; it was regarded as one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World.

statement.id: Kuil Artemis yang termasyhur di Ephesus mulai dibangun sekitar 550 SM; ketika selesai setelah kerja selama seabad, ukurannya hampir dua kali Parthenon di Athena, dan dianggap salah satu Tujuh Keajaiban Dunia Kuno.
statement.en: The famous temple of Artemis at Ephesus was begun c. 550 BCE; finished after a century of labour, it was almost twice the size of Athens' Parthenon and regarded as one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World.

claims.quote: Other notable places of worship of Artemis were the sanctuaries at Brauron, Tauris, Magnesia, Perge, and on the island of Delos, where the goddess was born in some myth versions and where she assisted the birth of her brother Apollo.

statement.id: Tempat pemujaan Artemis yang penting lainnya mencakup tempat suci di Brauron, Tauris, Magnesia, Perge, dan pulau Delos, tempat ia lahir dalam sebagian versi mitos dan membantu kelahiran saudaranya Apollo.
statement.en: Other notable places of worship of Artemis were sanctuaries at Brauron, Tauris, Magnesia, Perge, and on the island of Delos, where she was born in some versions of the myth and assisted the birth of her brother Apollo.

claims.quote: At Brauron, on the east coast of Attica, a temple site and sacred spring was in use from the 8th to 3rd century BCE and hosted rites of passage for young girls and brides-to-be.

statement.id: Di Brauron, di pantai timur Attika, sebuah situs kuil dan mata air suci dipakai dari abad ke-8 hingga ke-3 SM dan menjadi tempat ritus peralihan bagi gadis muda dan calon pengantin.
statement.en: At Brauron, on the east coast of Attica, a temple site and sacred spring was in use from the 8th to 3rd century BCE and hosted rites of passage for young girls and brides-to-be.

claims.quote: Artemis is most frequently portrayed in ancient Greek art as a beautiful maiden huntress with quiver and bow or, alternatively, a spear.
claims.locator: How is Artemis Represented in Art?

statement.id: Dalam seni Yunani kuno Artemis paling sering digambarkan sebagai gadis pemburu yang cantik dengan tabung panah dan busur, atau sebagai alternatif dengan tombak.
statement.en: In ancient Greek art Artemis is most frequently portrayed as a beautiful maiden huntress with quiver and bow or, alternatively, a spear.

claims.quote: Early representations also emphasise her role as goddess of animals and show her winged with a bird or animal in each hand. For example, on the handles of the celebrated Francois vase (570-565 BCE), she holds a panther and stag in one depiction and lions in another.
claims.locator: How is Artemis Represented in Art?

statement.id: Penggambaran awal menekankan peran Artemis sebagai dewi hewan dan menampilkannya bersayap dengan seekor burung atau hewan di tiap tangan; pada gagang Vas Francois (570-565 SM) ia memegang macan tutul dan rusa jantan di satu adegan dan singa di adegan lain.
statement.en: Early representations emphasise her role as goddess of animals and show her winged with a bird or animal in each hand; on the handles of the Francois vase (570-565 BCE) she holds a panther and stag in one depiction and lions in another.

claims.quote: Born either on Delos or Ortygia (near Ephesus in Western Turkey), she is the twin sister of the god Apollo.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Artemis lahir di Delos atau Ortygia (dekat Ephesus di Turki bagian barat) dan merupakan saudari kembar Apollo.
statement.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, Artemis was born either on Delos or Ortygia (near Ephesus in Western Turkey) and is Apollo's twin sister.

claims.quote: Artemis was a daughter of Demeter, and not of Leto, while according to an Egyptian story (Herod. ii. 156) she was the daughter of Dionysus and Isis, and Leto was only her nurse.
claims.locator: Encyclopedia (Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology)

statement.id: Menurut Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology yang dikutip Theoi, satu tradisi menyebut Artemis putri Demeter, bukan Leto, dan menurut kisah Mesir ia putri Dionysus dan Isis, sedangkan Leto hanya pengasuhnya.
statement.en: According to the Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology reproduced on Theoi, one tradition made Artemis a daughter of Demeter rather than Leto, and an Egyptian story made her the daughter of Dionysus and Isis, with Leto only her nurse.

claims.quote: the earliest attested forms of the name Artemis are the Mycenaean Greek ... written in Linear B at Pylos.

statement.id: Bentuk nama Artemis yang paling awal terbukti adalah bentuk Yunani Mykenai yang ditulis dalam Linear B di Pylos.
statement.en: The earliest attested forms of the name Artemis are Mycenaean Greek, written in Linear B at Pylos.

claims.quote: The etymology of the name "Artemis" (n., f.) remains uncertain, though various origins have been proposed.

statement.id: Asal-usul nama "Artemis" masih belum pasti, meski berbagai asal telah diusulkan.
statement.en: The etymology of the name "Artemis" remains uncertain, though various origins have been proposed.

claims.quote: Artemis was a kourotrophic (child-nurturing) deity, being the protector of children, especially girls, and animal cubs. She was worshipped and feared as one of the primary goddesses of childbirth and midwifery along with Eileithyia and Hera.

statement.id: Artemis adalah dewi kourotrofik (pengasuh anak), pelindung anak-anak terutama anak perempuan serta anak hewan, dan dipuja serta ditakuti sebagai salah satu dewi utama persalinan dan kebidanan bersama Eileithyia dan Hera.
statement.en: Artemis was a kourotrophic (child-nurturing) deity, protector of children, especially girls, and animal cubs, and was worshipped and feared as one of the primary goddesses of childbirth and midwifery along with Eileithyia and Hera.

claims.quote: As Apollo was not only a destructive god, but also averted the evils which it was in his power to inflict, so Artemis was at the same time a thea ... that is, she cured and alleviated the sufferings of mortals.
claims.locator: Encyclopedia (Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology)

statement.id: Menurut Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology, seperti Apollo yang tidak hanya merusak tetapi juga menangkal malapetaka, Artemis pada saat yang sama menyembuhkan dan meringankan penderitaan manusia.
statement.en: According to the Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology, just as Apollo not only destroyed but also averted evils, Artemis at the same time cured and alleviated the sufferings of mortals.

claims.quote: At Sparta and Athens (after the Battle of Marathon of 490 BCE), Artemis was worshipped as Artemis Agrotera and regarded as a goddess of battle, a goat being sacrificed to her before an engagement by the Spartans

statement.id: Di Sparta dan Athena (setelah Pertempuran Marathon tahun 490 SM) Artemis dipuja sebagai Artemis Agrotera dan dipandang sebagai dewi pertempuran; orang Sparta mengorbankan seekor kambing kepadanya sebelum bertempur.
statement.en: At Sparta and Athens (after the Battle of Marathon of 490 BCE) Artemis was worshipped as Artemis Agrotera and regarded as a goddess of battle, the Spartans sacrificing a goat to her before an engagement.

claims.quote: As a deity of fertility, Artemis Ephesia was particularly revered at Ephesus, near to what many believed was her birthplace, Ortygia. Here, her cult included eastern elements (borrowed from goddesses such as Isis, Cybele, and the "Mistress of the Animals") and her principal symbols were the bee, date palm, and stag.

statement.id: Sebagai dewi kesuburan, Artemis Ephesia sangat dipuja di Ephesus; pemujaannya memuat unsur-unsur dari timur (dipinjam dari dewi seperti Isis, Kibele, dan "Nyonya Para Hewan") dengan lebah, kurma, dan rusa jantan sebagai lambang utama.
statement.en: As a deity of fertility, Artemis Ephesia was particularly revered at Ephesus; her cult included eastern elements (borrowed from goddesses such as Isis, Cybele, and the "Mistress of the Animals") and her principal symbols were the bee, date palm, and stag.

claims.quote: The Ephesian Artemis was a divinity totally distinct from the Greek goddess of the same name.
claims.locator: Encyclopedia (Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology)

statement.id: Menurut Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology, Artemis dari Ephesus adalah dewi yang sama sekali berbeda dari dewi Yunani bernama sama.
statement.en: According to the Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology, the Ephesian Artemis was a divinity totally distinct from the Greek goddess of the same name.

claims.quote: The goddess Artemis has special powers which include being an extraordinary huntress and the mistress of all wild animals.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, kekuatan khusus Artemis mencakup menjadi pemburu luar biasa dan penguasa semua hewan liar.
statement.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, Artemis's special powers include being an extraordinary huntress and the mistress of all wild animals.

claims.quote: Pray give me eternal virginity; as many names as my brother Apollo; a bow and arrow like his; the office of bringing light;

statement.id: Dalam permintaannya kepada Zeus, Artemis kecil memohon keperawanan abadi, sebanyak nama saudaranya Apollo, busur dan anak panah seperti milik Apollo, dan tugas membawa cahaya.
statement.en: In her request to Zeus, the young Artemis asks for eternal virginity, as many names as her brother Apollo, a bow and arrow like his, and the office of bringing light.

claims.quote: Kallisto (Callisto) was a handmaiden of the goddess who Zeus seduced by assuming her form. When Artemis discovered the girl was pregnant she transformed her into a bear and exiled her to the wilds.

statement.id: Menurut Theoi, Kallisto adalah dayang sang dewi yang dirayu Zeus dengan menyamar sebagai dirinya; ketika Artemis tahu gadis itu hamil, ia mengubahnya menjadi beruang dan mengasingkannya ke alam liar.
statement.en: According to Theoi, Kallisto was a handmaiden of the goddess whom Zeus seduced by assuming her form; when Artemis discovered she was pregnant she transformed her into a bear and exiled her to the wilds.

short_description.id: Hera adalah dewi perkawinan, perempuan, dan keluarga dalam agama Yunani kuno, serta ratu para dewa Olimpus dan istri sekaligus saudari Zeus.
short_description.en: Hera is the goddess of marriage, women, and family in ancient Greek religion, queen of the Olympian gods, and the sister and wife of Zeus.

long_description.id:
Hera adalah dewi perkawinan, perempuan, dan keluarga dalam agama Yunani kuno, dan dalam mitologi ia menjadi ratu di antara dua belas dewa Olimpus serta saudari dan istri Zeus. Menurut entri kamus yang dimuat Theoi, Hera adalah satu-satunya dewi Olimpus yang benar-benar menikah, sehingga ia dewi perkawinan dan kelahiran anak. Dalam seni ia digambarkan sebagai sosok berwibawa yang duduk di singgasana atau berdiri, bermahkota, memegang tongkat kerajaan atau delima, dan hewan sucinya mencakup sapi, burung kukuk, dan merak.

Hera adalah putri Cronus dan Rhea, dan saudari Hestia, Demeter, Hades, Poseidon, serta Zeus. Dalam Iliad 4 ia menyebut dirinya putri Cronus yang paling dihormati. Bersama Zeus ia menjadi ibu Ares, Hebe, dan Eileithyia. Menurut Theoi ia melahirkan Hephaistos seorang diri lalu melemparkannya dari surga karena lahir cacat, sedangkan World History Encyclopedia mencatat versi lain, bahwa Zeus yang melemparkannya karena kepincangannya.

Mitos tentang Hera banyak berkisar pada perkawinannya dengan Zeus. Menurut Theoi, Zeus merayunya dengan menyamar sebagai burung kukuk. World History Encyclopedia menyebut Hera setia kepada Zeus tetapi terkenal cemburu dan pendendam terhadap kekasih suaminya dan anak-anak mereka. Entri kamus yang dimuat Theoi mencatat wataknya menurut Homer ditandai cemburu, keras kepala, dan suka bertengkar, bahwa ia jauh lebih rendah daripada Zeus dalam kekuasaan, dan bahkan pernah digantung Zeus di awan.

Hera dikisahkan menghukum para kekasih Zeus dan anak-anak mereka: Leto, Semele, dan Alkmene dianiaya; Io menjadi sasaran seekor lalat pengganggu; dan Hercules ditimpa ular, kegilaan, serta dua belas pekerjaan. Ia juga membuat Tiresias buta, dan Ixion dihukum dengan roda berapi karena mencoba menodainya. Di sisi lain, ia membantu Jason dan para Argonaut, dan dalam perang Troya ia berpihak pada bangsa Akhaia karena dendam kepada Paris.

Pemujaan Hera berpusat di Argos, yang memiliki tempat suci untuknya sejak pertengahan abad ke-8 SM menurut World History Encyclopedia. Dalam Iliad, Hera menyebut Argos, Sparta, dan Mycenae sebagai tiga kota yang paling disayanginya. Ia juga dipuja di Olympia, Tiryns, dan Samos, dan di seluruh Yunani diadakan perlombaan perempuan Heraia serta festival pernikahan tahunan. Padanannya dalam tradisi Romawi adalah Juno.
long_description.en:
Hera is the goddess of marriage, women, and family in ancient Greek religion, and in myth she is queen among the twelve Olympians and the sister and wife of Zeus. According to the dictionary entry reproduced by Theoi, she was the only really married goddess among the Olympians, and hence goddess of marriage and of the birth of children. In art she appears as a dignified figure enthroned or standing, crowned, holding a royal sceptre or a pomegranate, and her sacred animals include the cow, cuckoo, and peacock.

Hera was born to Cronus and Rhea, and her siblings include Hestia, Demeter, Hades, Poseidon, and Zeus. In Iliad 4 she calls herself the most honoured of Cronos's daughters. With Zeus she is the mother of Ares, Hebe, and Eileithyia. According to Theoi she produced Hephaistos alone and cast him from heaven because he was born crippled, while World History Encyclopedia records another version in which Zeus threw him because of his lameness.

Myths about Hera revolve largely around her marriage to Zeus. According to Theoi, Zeus seduced her in the guise of a cuckoo. World History Encyclopedia says Hera was faithful to Zeus but famous for a jealous and vengeful nature aimed at her husband's lovers and their children. The dictionary entry reproduced by Theoi notes that her character in Homer is marked by jealousy, obstinacy, and a quarrelling disposition, that she is far inferior to Zeus in power, and that he once even hung her up in the clouds.

Hera is said to punish Zeus's lovers and their children: Leto, Semele, and Alkmene are persecuted; Io is pursued by a gadfly; and Hercules is beset by snakes, madness, and twelve labours. She also struck Tiresias blind, and Ixion was punished with a fiery wheel for trying to violate her. On the other side, she assisted Jason and the Argonauts, and in the Trojan War she sided with the Achaeans out of a grudge against Paris.

Hera's cult centred on Argos, which had a sanctuary for her from the mid-8th century BCE according to World History Encyclopedia. In the Iliad, Hera names Argos, Sparta, and Mycenae as the three cities dearest to her. She was also worshipped at Olympia, Tiryns, and Samos, and across Greece the women's competitions called Heraia and annual marriage festivals were held. Her Roman counterpart is Juno.

literal_meaning.en: Unclear; proposals include "mistress" (Burkert) and "young cow, heifer" (van Windekens)

who.id: Dewi perkawinan, perempuan, dan keluarga, ratu para dewa Olimpus.
who.en: Goddess of marriage, women, and family, queen of the Olympians.

role.id: Pelindung perkawinan dan perempuan, serta istri Zeus.
role.en: Protector of marriage and women, and wife of Zeus.

famous_for.id: Watak cemburu dan pendendam terhadap kekasih Zeus dan anak-anak mereka, serta perannya dalam kisah Hercules dan perang Troya.
famous_for.en: Her jealous and vengeful nature toward Zeus's lovers and their children, and her part in the stories of Hercules and the Trojan War.

did_you_know.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, seratus mata Argos si penjaga Io dipasang Hera pada sayap burung merak.
did_you_know.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, Hera set the 100 eyes of Argos, the guard of Io, on the wings of the peacock.

cultural_context.id: Menurut Theoi, Hera adalah satu-satunya dewi Olimpus yang benar-benar menikah sehingga menjadi dewi perkawinan dan kelahiran anak; World History Encyclopedia mencatat bahwa pemujaannya mencakup perlombaan olahraga perempuan Heraia dan festival pernikahan tahunan di mana pasangan memeragakan ulang pernikahan Zeus dan Hera.
cultural_context.en: According to Theoi, Hera was the only really married goddess among the Olympians, hence goddess of marriage and childbirth; World History Encyclopedia records that her cult included the women's sporting competitions called Heraia and annual marriage festivals in which couples re-enacted the marriage of Zeus and Hera.

description.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Hera berjanji mengutuk negeri mana pun yang memberi perlindungan kepada Leto yang sedang hamil.
description.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, Hera promised to curse any land that gave the pregnant Leto refuge.

description.id: Menurut entri kamus yang dimuat Theoi, puisi Homeros menampilkan Hera mampu menganugerahkan kuasa nubuat, satu-satunya hal yang membuatnya setara kekuasaan dengan Zeus.
description.en: According to the dictionary entry reproduced by Theoi, the Homeric poems show Hera able to confer the power of prophecy, the one point in which her power is similar to Zeus.

description.id: Dalam kisah-kisah, Hera mengirim ular dan kegilaan kepada Hercules, mengirim lalat pengganggu kepada Io, dan membutakan Tiresias.
description.en: In the stories, Hera sends snakes and madness against Hercules, a gadfly against Io, and strikes Tiresias blind.

name.id: Lebih rendah daripada Zeus dalam kekuasaan

description.id: Menurut entri kamus yang dimuat Theoi, Hera jauh lebih rendah daripada Zeus dalam kekuasaan dan harus menaatinya; dalam satu kisah Zeus menggantungnya di awan dengan tangan dirantai.
description.en: According to the dictionary entry reproduced by Theoi, Hera is far inferior to Zeus in power and must obey him; in one story Zeus hung her in the clouds with her hands chained.

summary.en: One story records Zeus courting Hera in the guise of a cuckoo.

role.en: Hera bears and casts out her son, in one version.

summary.id: Menurut Theoi, Hera melahirkan Hephaistos seorang diri dan melemparkannya dari surga karena lahir cacat; World History Encyclopedia mencatat versi lain di mana Zeus yang melemparkannya.
summary.en: According to Theoi, Hera produced Hephaistos alone and cast him from heaven because he was born crippled; World History Encyclopedia records another version in which Zeus threw him.

summary.id: Hera menempatkan seratus mata Argos pada sayap burung merak, dan mengirim seekor lalat pengganggu untuk terus menyiksa Io.
summary.en: Hera set Argos's 100 eyes on the wings of the peacock and sent a gadfly to continually pester Io.

summary.id: Hera menunda kelahiran Hercules, mengirim dua ular, membuatnya gila hingga membunuh keluarganya, dan membuat Eurystheus menugaskan dua belas pekerjaan.
summary.en: Hera delayed Hercules's birth, sent two snakes, drove him mad so that he killed his family, and had Eurystheus set him twelve labours.

summary.en: Hera competed against Aphrodite and Athene for the golden apple; because Paris chose Aphrodite she never forgave him and schemed for Troy's downfall.

summary.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, Juno in Roman culture principally represented good family and faithful marriage rather than the avenger.
