claim.id: Hera adalah dewi perkawinan, perempuan, dan keluarga Yunani kuno serta ratu Olimpus, saudari dan istri Zeus.
claim.en: Hera is the ancient Greek goddess of marriage, women, and family, queen of the Olympians, and Zeus's sister and wife.

claims_provenance.quote: is the goddess of marriage, women, and family, and the protector of women during childbirth. In Greek mythology, she is queen among the twelve Olympians on Mount Olympus, sister and wife of Zeus

claim.id: Hera biasanya digambarkan sebagai perempuan berwibawa yang berdiri atau bertakhta, dengan mahkota.
claim.en: Hera is usually shown as a dignified woman standing or enthroned, crowned.

claims_provenance.quote: Her iconography usually presents her as a dignified, matronly figure, upright or enthroned, crowned with a polos or diadem, sometimes veiled as a married woman.

claim.id: Padanan Hera dalam tradisi Romawi adalah Juno.
claim.en: Hera's Roman counterpart is Juno.

claims_provenance.quote: Her Roman counterpart is Juno.

claim.id: Menurut Theoi, Hera adalah ratu dewa Olimpus dan dewi perkawinan, perempuan, langit, serta bintang.
claim.en: According to Theoi, Hera is queen of the Olympians and goddess of marriage, women, the sky, and stars.

claims_provenance.quote: HERA was the Olympian queen of the gods, and the goddess of marriage, women, the sky and the stars of heaven.

claim.id: Salah satu kisah Hera menceritakan Zeus merayunya dengan menyamar sebagai burung kukuk.
claim.en: One Hera story recounts Zeus courting her in the guise of a cuckoo.

claims_provenance.quote: Her marriage to Zeus who seduced her in the guise of a cuckoo bird.

claim.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Hera digambarkan setia kepada Zeus namun cemburu dan membalas pasangan lain suaminya dan anak-anak mereka.
claim.en: World History Encyclopedia describes Hera as faithful to Zeus yet jealous and vengeful toward his other partners and their children.

claims_provenance.quote: Hera was always faithful to Zeus but she was famous for her jealous and vengeful nature, principally aimed against her husband's lovers and their illegitimate children.

claim.id: Hera adalah pelindung Argos, yang memiliki tempat suci untuknya sejak pertengahan abad ke-8 SM.
claim.en: Hera was patron of Argos, which had a sanctuary for her from the mid-eighth century BCE.

claims_provenance.quote: She was the patron of Argos, which possessed a sanctuary to the goddess from the mid-8th century BCE.

claim.id: Menurut Theoi, Hera biasanya digambarkan sebagai perempuan cantik bermahkota yang memegang tongkat kerajaan berujung teratai, kadang disertai singa, burung kukuk, atau elang.
claim.en: According to Theoi, Hera was usually depicted as a beautiful woman wearing a crown and holding a royal, lotus-tipped sceptre, sometimes accompanied by a lion, cuckoo or hawk.

claims_provenance.quote: She was usually depicted as a beautiful woman wearing a crown and holding a royal, lotus-tipped sceptre, and sometimes accompanied by a lion, cuckoo or hawk.

claim.id: Theoi menyebut penganiayaan Hera terhadap para kekasih Zeus, termasuk Leto, Semele, dan Alkmene, sebagai salah satu mitos terkenalnya.
claim.en: Theoi lists Hera's persecution of the consorts of Zeus, including Leto, Semele and Alkmene, among her more famous myths.

claims_provenance.quote: Her persecution of the consorts of Zeus including Leto, Semele and Alkmene (Alcmena).

claim.id: Theoi menyebut bahwa Hera membantu para Argonaut dalam pencarian bulu domba emas, dan pemimpin mereka, Iason (Jason), adalah salah satu kesayangannya.
claim.en: Theoi records Hera assisting the Argonauts in their quest for the golden fleece, their leader Iason (Jason) being one of her favourites.

claims_provenance.quote: The assisting of the Argonauts in their quest for the golden fleece, their leader Iason (Jason) being one of her favourites.

claim.id: Menurut Theoi, Ixion dirantai pada roda berapi sebagai hukuman karena mencoba menodai sang dewi.
claim.en: According to Theoi, Ixion was chained to a fiery wheel as punishment for attempting to violate the goddess.

claims_provenance.quote: The punishment of Ixion, who was chained to a fiery wheel for attempting to violate the goddess.

claim.id: Menurut Theoi, Hera melahirkan Hephaistos (Hephaestus) seorang diri tanpa ayah dan melemparkannya dari surga karena ia lahir cacat.
claim.en: According to Theoi, Hera produced Hephaistos (Hephaestus) alone without a father and cast him from heaven because he was born crippled.

claims_provenance.quote: The birth of Hephaistos (Hephaestus) who she produced alone without a father and cast from heaven because he was born crippled.

claim.id: Menurut Theoi, dalam penghakiman Paris, Hera bersaing melawan Aphrodite dan Athene untuk memperebutkan apel emas.
claim.en: According to Theoi, in the judgement of Paris Hera competed against Aphrodite and Athene for the prize of the golden apple.

claims_provenance.quote: The judgement of Paris, in which she competed against Aphrodite and Athene for the prize of the golden apple.

claim.id: Menurut entri kamus yang dimuat Theoi, Hera adalah satu-satunya dewi Olimpus yang benar-benar menikah, sehingga ia dewi perkawinan dan kelahiran anak.
claim.en: According to the dictionary entry reproduced by Theoi, Hera was the only really married goddess among the Olympians, and hence she is the goddess of marriage and of the birth of children.

claims_provenance.quote: Properly speaking, Hera was the only really married goddess among the Olympians ... and hence she is the goddess of marriage and of the birth of children.

claim.id: Entri kamus yang dimuat Theoi menyatakan bahwa watak Hera menurut Homer tidak terlalu ramah, dengan ciri utama cemburu, keras kepala, dan suka bertengkar.
claim.en: The dictionary entry reproduced by Theoi says Hera's character, as described by Homer, is not very amiable, its main features being jealousy, obstinacy, and a quarrelling disposition.

claims_provenance.quote: Her character, as described by Homer, is not of a very amiable kind, and its main features are jealousy, obstinacy, and a quarrelling disposition

claim.id: Entri kamus yang dimuat Theoi mencatat bahwa dalam perselisihan Zeus tidak hanya mengancam tetapi memukul Hera, dan pernah menggantungnya di awan dengan tangan dirantai dan dua landasan di kakinya.
claim.en: The dictionary entry reproduced by Theoi records that Zeus not only threatens but beats her, and once hung her up in the clouds, her hands chained and two anvils suspended from her feet.

claims_provenance.quote: Zeus, in such cases, not only threatens, but beats her; and once he even hung her up in the clouds, her hands chained, and with two anvils suspended from her feet

claim.id: Menurut entri kamus yang dimuat Theoi, satu-satunya hal yang membuat puisi Homeros menampilkan Hera sama berkuasa dengan Zeus ialah kemampuannya menganugerahkan kuasa nubuat.
claim.en: According to the dictionary entry reproduced by Theoi, the one point in which the Homeric poems show Hera with power similar to Zeus is that she is able to confer the power of prophecy.

claims_provenance.quote: There is only one point in which the Homeric poems represent Hera as possessed of similar power with Zeus, viz. she is able to confer the power of prophecy

claim.id: Menurut tradisi yang dimuat Theoi, Hera pernah bersengketa dengan Poseidon atas Argos, tetapi dewa-dewa sungai negeri itu memutuskan Argos untuknya.
claim.en: According to a tradition reproduced by Theoi, Hera had disputed the possession of Argos with Poseidon, but the river-gods of the country adjudicated it to her.

claims_provenance.quote: According to tradition, Hera had disputed the possession of Argos with Poseidon, but the river-gods of the country adjudicated it to her.

claim.id: Entri kamus yang dimuat Theoi menyatakan bahwa tempat suci Hera yang paling termasyhur terletak di antara Argos dan Mycenae, di kaki Gunung Euboea.
claim.en: The dictionary entry reproduced by Theoi says Hera's most celebrated sanctuary was situated between Argos and Mycenae, at the foot of Mount Euboea.

claims_provenance.quote: Her most celebrated sanctuary was situated between Argos and Mycenae, at the foot of Mount Euboea.

claim.id: Menurut entri kamus yang dimuat Theoi, arca Hera yang duduk dan kolosal di kuil itu dibuat dari emas dan gading oleh Polycletus.
claim.en: According to the dictionary entry reproduced by Theoi, the sitting colossal statue of Hera in this temple, made of gold and ivory, was the work of Polycletus.

claims_provenance.quote: The sitting colossal statue of Hera in this temple, made of gold and ivory, was the work of Polycletus.

claim.id: Himne Homerik 12 (terjemahan Evelyn-White) menyanyikan Hera yang bertakhta emas, yang dilahirkan Rhea, ratu para makhluk abadi, melampaui semua dalam keindahan, saudari dan istri Zeus yang menggelegar.
claim.en: Homeric Hymn 12 (Evelyn-White translation) sings of golden-throned Hera whom Rhea bare, queen of the Immortals, surpassing all in beauty, sister and wife of loud-thundering Zeus.

claims_provenance.quote: I sing of golden-throned Hera whom Rhea bare. Queen of the Immortals is she, surpassing all in beauty: she is the sister and wife of loud-thundering Zeus

claim.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Hera adalah putri Cronus dan Rhea, dan ibu Ares (dewa perang), Hebe (dewi masa muda), dan Eileithyia (dewi persalinan), semuanya bersama Zeus.
claim.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, Hera was the daughter of Cronus and Rhea, and mother of Ares (god of war), Hebe (goddess of youth), and Eileithyia (goddess of childbirth), all with Zeus.

claims_provenance.quote: Hera was the daughter of Cronus and Rhea, and mother of Ares (god of war), Hebe (goddess of youth), and Eileithyia (goddess of childbirth), all with Zeus.

claim.id: World History Encyclopedia mencatat bahwa Hera melemparkan Hephaistos dari Gunung Olympus karena keburukan rupanya sehingga ia menjadi pincang; menurut kisah lain, Zeus melemparkannya dari surga justru karena kepincangannya.
claim.en: World History Encyclopedia records that Hera threw Hephaistos from Mount Olympus because of his ugliness, so that he became lame; in other accounts Zeus threw him from the heavens precisely because of his lameness.

claims_provenance.quote: However, Hera threw Hephaistos from Mount Olympus because of his ugliness, and crashing to earth, the god became lame. In other accounts, Hephaistos was thrown from the heavens by Zeus precisely because of his lameness.

claim.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, dalam kisah Io, Hera kemudian menempatkan seratus mata Argos pada sayap seekor burung, yaitu merak.
claim.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, in the story of Io Hera then set Argos's 100 eyes on the wings of a bird, the peacock.

claims_provenance.quote: In memory, Hera then set his 100 eyes on the wings of a bird - the peacock.

claim.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Hera mengirim seekor lalat pengganggu untuk terus menyiksa Io yang malang.
claim.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, Hera sent a gadfly to continually pester the unfortunate Io.

claims_provenance.quote: Finally, not to be outdone, the Greek goddess sent a gadfly to continually pester the unfortunate Io.

claim.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Hera menunda kelahiran Hercules agar sepupunya Eurystheus dapat merebut takhta Tiryns, mengirim dua ular untuk membunuh bayi itu, membuatnya gila hingga membunuh istri dan anak-anaknya, dan membuat Eurystheus menugaskan dua belas pekerjaan kepadanya.
claim.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, Hera delayed Hercules's birth so his cousin Eurystheus could claim the throne of Tiryns, sent two snakes to kill the infant, caused him to go mad and kill his own wife and children, and had Eurystheus set him his twelve labours.

claims_provenance.quote: Hera delayed his birth so that his cousin Eurystheus could claim the throne of Tiryns, sent two snakes to kill the infant while he slept, caused the hero to become mad and kill his own wife and children, and had Eurystheus set the hero his twelve labours

claim.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, dalam Iliad Hera mendukung bangsa Akhaia dan sering bersekongkol dengan dewa lain demi runtuhnya Troya, karena ia tidak pernah memaafkan pangeran Paris yang memilih Aphrodite sebagai dewi tercantik.
claim.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, in the Iliad Hera supports the Achaeans and frequently schemes with other deities to bring down Troy, as she never forgave the Trojan prince Paris for choosing Aphrodite as the most beautiful goddess.

claims_provenance.quote: The goddess supports the Achaeans and frequently schemes with other deities to bring the downfall of Troy, as she never forgave the Trojan prince Paris for choosing Aphrodite above her as the most beautiful goddess.

claim.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Hera memiliki kuil di Olympia (650-600 SM), dan Tiryns menjadi pusat pemujaan penting baginya pada abad ke-7 SM.
claim.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, Hera had a temple at Olympia (650-600 BCE), and Tiryns was an important cult centre to the goddess in the 7th century BCE.

claims_provenance.quote: She also had a temple dedicated to her at Olympia (650-600 BCE), and Tiryns was an important cult centre to the goddess in the 7th century BCE.

claim.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, pulau Samos, yang dalam beberapa kisah adalah tempat kelahiran sang dewi, telah menjadi pusat pemujaannya sejak periode Mycenae pada pertengahan milenium ke-2 SM.
claim.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, the island of Samos, in some accounts the goddess's birthplace, had been a centre of her cult as far back as the Mycenaean period in the mid-2nd millennium BCE.

claims_provenance.quote: The island of Samos, in some accounts the birthplace of the goddess, had been a centre for cult worship of the Greek goddess as far back as the Mycenaean period in the mid-2nd millennium BCE

claim.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, di seluruh Yunani diadakan perlombaan olahraga perempuan bernama Heraia untuk menghormati Hera, begitu pula festival pernikahan tahunan ketika pasangan memeragakan ulang pernikahan Zeus dan Hera.
claim.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, across Greece sporting competitions for women, the Heraia, were held in Hera's honour, as were annual marriage festivals in which couples re-enacted the marriage of Zeus and Hera.

claims_provenance.quote: Across Greece, sporting competitions for women, the Heraia, were held in Hera's honour, as were annual marriage festivals (hierogamy) when couples re-enacted the marriage of Zeus and Hera.

claim.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, dalam seni Hera paling sering duduk di singgasana, kadang bermahkota (polos), memegang tongkat kerajaan, dan bercadar pengantin; kadang ia memegang delima, lambang kesuburan.
claim.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, in art Hera is most often seated on a throne, sometimes wearing a crown (polos), holding a royal sceptre, and wearing a bridal veil; on occasion she holds a pomegranate, a traditional symbol of fertility.

claims_provenance.quote: She is most often seated on a throne and sometimes wears a crown (polos), holds a royal sceptre, and wears a bridal veil. On occasion she is also depicted holding a pomegranate, a traditional symbol of fertility.
claims_provenance.locator: How was Hera Represented in Art?

claim.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, dalam budaya Romawi sang dewi hidup terus sebagai Juno, yang terutama mewakili sifat keluarga baik dan pernikahan setia, bukan pembalas dendam yang cemburu atas perselingkuhan.
claim.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, in Roman culture the goddess lived on as Juno, who principally represented the good family and faithful marriage attributes of Hera rather than the jealous avenger of infidelity.

claims_provenance.quote: In Roman culture the goddess lived on as Juno, although she principally represented the good family and faithful marriage attributes of Hera rather than the jealous avenger of infidelity.

claim.id: Dalam Iliad 4 (terjemahan Murray), Hera berkata kepada Zeus bahwa tiga kota yang paling disayanginya adalah Argos, Sparta, dan Mycenae.
claim.en: In Iliad 4 (Murray translation), Hera tells Zeus that the three cities dearest in her sight are Argos, Sparta, and Mycenae.

claims_provenance.quote: Verily have I three cities that are far dearest in my sight, Argos and Sparta and broad-wayed Mycenae
claims_provenance.source_citation: Perseus Digital Library, Tufts University — Homer, Iliad, Book 4 (trans. A. T. Murray)

claim.id: Dalam Iliad 4 (terjemahan Murray), Hera berkata bahwa Cronos memperanakkannya sebagai putri yang paling dihormati, dengan dua alasan: ia yang tertua dan disebut istri Zeus, sedangkan Zeus raja di antara semua makhluk abadi.
claim.en: In Iliad 4 (Murray translation), Hera says Cronos begat her as the most honoured of his daughters in twofold wise: she is eldest and is called Zeus's wife, whilst he is king among all the immortals.

claims_provenance.quote: crooked-counselling Cronos begat me as the most honoured of his daughters ... in twofold wise, for that I am eldest, and am called thy wife, whilst thou art king among all the immortals.
claims_provenance.source_citation: Perseus Digital Library, Tufts University — Homer, Iliad, Book 4 (trans. A. T. Murray)

claim.id: Menurut Wikipedia, Walter Burkert mencatat pendapat para sarjana tentang arti "Nyonya" sebagai bentuk feminin dari Heros, "Tuan", dengan asal-usul yang tidak pasti.
claim.en: According to Wikipedia, Walter Burkert records scholars' arguments for the meaning "Mistress" as a feminine to Heros, "Master", with uncertain origin.

claims_provenance.quote: In a note in his Greek Religion, Walter Burkert records scholars' arguments "for the meaning Mistress as a feminine to Heros, Master", with uncertain origin.

claim.id: Menurut Wikipedia, A. J. van Windekens mengusulkan arti "sapi muda", yang sesuai dengan julukan umum Hera, βοῶπις (boōpis, "bermata sapi").
claim.en: According to Wikipedia, A. J. van Windekens proposes the meaning "young cow, heifer", consonant with Hera's common epithet βοῶπις (boōpis, "cow-eyed").

claims_provenance.quote: A. J. van Windekens proposes the meaning "young cow, heifer", which is consonant with Hera's common epithet βοῶπις (boōpis, "cow-eyed").

claim.id: Menurut Wikipedia, hewan suci Hera mencakup sapi, burung kukuk, dan merak, dan ia kadang digambarkan memegang delima sebagai lambang keabadian.
claim.en: According to Wikipedia, her sacred animals include the cow, cuckoo, and peacock, and she is sometimes shown holding a pomegranate as an emblem of immortality.

claims_provenance.quote: Her sacred animals include the cow, cuckoo, and peacock. She is sometimes shown holding a pomegranate as an emblem of immortality.

claim.id: Menurut Wikipedia, dalam Iliad Hera, Poseidon, dan Athena bersekongkol untuk mengalahkan Zeus dan mengikatnya.
claim.en: According to Wikipedia, in the Iliad Hera, Poseidon, and Athena conspire to overpower Zeus and tie him in bonds.

claims_provenance.quote: In the Iliad, Homer tells of another attempted overthrow, in which Hera, Poseidon, and Athena conspire to overpower Zeus and tie him in bonds.

claim.id: Menurut Wikipedia, ketika Tiresias memihak Zeus, Hera membutakannya.
claim.en: According to Wikipedia, when Tiresias sided with Zeus, Hera struck him blind.

claims_provenance.quote: When Tiresias sided with Zeus, Hera struck him blind.

claim.id: Menurut Wikipedia, Hera adalah putri para Titan Cronus dan Rhea, serta saudari Hestia, Demeter, Hades, Poseidon, dan Zeus.
claim.en: According to Wikipedia, Hera is the daughter of the Titans Cronus and Rhea, and the sister of Hestia, Demeter, Hades, Poseidon, and Zeus.

claims_provenance.quote: Hera is the daughter of the Titans Cronus and Rhea, and the sister of Hestia, Demeter, Hades, Poseidon, and Zeus.

claim.id: Menurut Wikipedia, nama Hera (Hḗrā atau Hḗrē) tercatat dalam bahasa Yunani Mycenae, ditulis dalam silabaria Linear B sebagai 𐀁𐀨 e-ra, pada lempeng yang ditemukan di Pylos dan Thebes.
claim.en: According to Wikipedia, the name Hera (Hḗrā or Hḗrē) is attested in Mycenaean Greek, written in Linear B as 𐀁𐀨 e-ra on tablets found in Pylos and Thebes.

claims_provenance.quote: The name Hera (Hḗrā or Hḗrē) is attested in Mycenaean Greek, written in Linear B syllabary as 𐀁𐀨 e-ra, appearing on tablets found in Pylos and Thebes

claim.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Leto dihukum karena Hera berjanji mengutuk negeri mana pun yang memberi perlindungan kepada dewi yang sedang hamil itu.
claim.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, Leto was punished through Hera promising to curse any land that gave the pregnant goddess refuge.

claims_provenance.quote: Leto was so punished through Hera promising to curse any land that gave the pregnant goddess refuge.

claim.id: Entri kamus yang dimuat Theoi menyatakan bahwa Hera jauh lebih rendah daripada Zeus dalam kekuasaan dan harus menaatinya tanpa syarat.
claim.en: The dictionary entry reproduced by Theoi says Hera is far inferior to Zeus in power and must obey him unconditionally.

claims_provenance.quote: but she is, notwithstanding, far inferior to him in power; she must obey him unconditionally

claim.id: Menurut Wikipedia, Hera adalah ibu tiri sekaligus musuh Heracles, dan nama Heracles berarti "Kemuliaan Hera".
claim.en: According to Wikipedia, Hera is the stepmother and enemy of Heracles, and the name Heracles means "Glory of Hera".

claims_provenance.quote: Hera is the stepmother and enemy of Heracles. The name Heracles means "Glory of Hera".

claim.id: Entri kamus yang dimuat Theoi menyatakan bahwa Hera bukan, seperti Zeus, ratu para dewa dan manusia, melainkan hanya istri dewa tertinggi, dan bahwa gagasan tentangnya sebagai ratu surga berasal dari masa yang jauh lebih kemudian.
claim.en: The dictionary entry reproduced by Theoi states that Hera is not, like Zeus, the queen of gods and men, but simply the wife of the supreme god, and that the idea of her as queen of heaven is of a much later date.

claims_provenance.quote: Hera therefore is not, like Zeus, the queen of gods and men, but simply the wife of the supreme god. The idea of her being the queen of heaven, with regal wealth and power, is of a much later date.

text.id: Namanya tercatat dalam tablet Linear B dari masa Yunani Mycenae di Pylos dan Thebes
text.en: Her name is attested on Linear B tablets of the Mycenaean Greek period found at Pylos and Thebes

short_description.id: Hera adalah dewi perkawinan, perempuan, dan keluarga dalam agama Yunani kuno, serta ratu para dewa Olimpus dan istri sekaligus saudari Zeus.
short_description.en: Hera is the goddess of marriage, women, and family in ancient Greek religion, queen of the Olympian gods, and the sister and wife of Zeus.

long_description.id: Hera adalah dewi perkawinan, perempuan, dan keluarga dalam agama Yunani kuno, dan dalam mitologi ia menjadi ratu di antara dua belas dewa Olimpus serta saudari dan istri Zeus. Menurut entri kamus yang dimuat Theoi, Hera adalah satu-satunya dewi Olimpus yang benar-benar menikah, sehingga ia dewi perkawinan dan kelahiran anak. Dalam seni ia digambarkan sebagai sosok berwibawa yang duduk di singgasana atau berdiri, bermahkota, memegang tongkat kerajaan atau delima, dan hewan sucinya mencakup sapi, burung kukuk, dan merak.
long_description.en: Hera is the goddess of marriage, women, and family in ancient Greek religion, and in myth she is queen among the twelve Olympians and the sister and wife of Zeus. According to the dictionary entry reproduced by Theoi, she was the only really married goddess among the Olympians, and hence goddess of marriage and of the birth of children. In art she appears as a dignified figure enthroned or standing, crowned, holding a royal sceptre or a pomegranate, and her sacred animals include the cow, cuckoo, and peacock.

long_description.id: Hera adalah putri Cronus dan Rhea, dan saudari Hestia, Demeter, Hades, Poseidon, serta Zeus. Dalam Iliad 4 ia menyebut dirinya putri Cronus yang paling dihormati. Bersama Zeus ia menjadi ibu Ares, Hebe, dan Eileithyia. Menurut Theoi ia melahirkan Hephaistos seorang diri lalu melemparkannya dari surga karena lahir cacat, sedangkan World History Encyclopedia mencatat versi lain, bahwa Zeus yang melemparkannya karena kepincangannya.
long_description.en: Hera was born to Cronus and Rhea, and her siblings include Hestia, Demeter, Hades, Poseidon, and Zeus. In Iliad 4 she calls herself the most honoured of Cronos's daughters. With Zeus she is the mother of Ares, Hebe, and Eileithyia. According to Theoi she produced Hephaistos alone and cast him from heaven because he was born crippled, while World History Encyclopedia records another version in which Zeus threw him because of his lameness.

long_description.id: Mitos tentang Hera banyak berkisar pada perkawinannya dengan Zeus. Menurut Theoi, Zeus merayunya dengan menyamar sebagai burung kukuk. World History Encyclopedia menyebut Hera setia kepada Zeus tetapi terkenal cemburu dan pendendam terhadap kekasih suaminya dan anak-anak mereka. Entri kamus yang dimuat Theoi mencatat wataknya menurut Homer ditandai cemburu, keras kepala, dan suka bertengkar, bahwa ia jauh lebih rendah daripada Zeus dalam kekuasaan, dan bahkan pernah digantung Zeus di awan.
long_description.en: Myths about Hera revolve largely around her marriage to Zeus. According to Theoi, Zeus seduced her in the guise of a cuckoo. World History Encyclopedia says Hera was faithful to Zeus but famous for a jealous and vengeful nature aimed at her husband's lovers and their children. The dictionary entry reproduced by Theoi notes that her character in Homer is marked by jealousy, obstinacy, and a quarrelling disposition, that she is far inferior to Zeus in power, and that he once even hung her up in the clouds.

long_description.id: Hera dikisahkan menghukum para kekasih Zeus dan anak-anak mereka: Leto, Semele, dan Alkmene dianiaya; Io menjadi sasaran seekor lalat pengganggu; dan Hercules ditimpa ular, kegilaan, serta dua belas pekerjaan. Ia juga membuat Tiresias buta, dan Ixion dihukum dengan roda berapi karena mencoba menodainya. Di sisi lain, ia membantu Jason dan para Argonaut, dan dalam perang Troya ia berpihak pada bangsa Akhaia karena dendam kepada Paris.
long_description.en: Hera is said to punish Zeus's lovers and their children: Leto, Semele, and Alkmene are persecuted; Io is pursued by a gadfly; and Hercules is beset by snakes, madness, and twelve labours. She also struck Tiresias blind, and Ixion was punished with a fiery wheel for trying to violate her. On the other side, she assisted Jason and the Argonauts, and in the Trojan War she sided with the Achaeans out of a grudge against Paris.

long_description.id: Pemujaan Hera berpusat di Argos, yang memiliki tempat suci untuknya sejak pertengahan abad ke-8 SM menurut World History Encyclopedia. Dalam Iliad, Hera menyebut Argos, Sparta, dan Mycenae sebagai tiga kota yang paling disayanginya. Ia juga dipuja di Olympia, Tiryns, dan Samos, dan di seluruh Yunani diadakan perlombaan perempuan Heraia serta festival pernikahan tahunan. Padanannya dalam tradisi Romawi adalah Juno.
long_description.en: Hera's cult centred on Argos, which had a sanctuary for her from the mid-8th century BCE according to World History Encyclopedia. In the Iliad, Hera names Argos, Sparta, and Mycenae as the three cities dearest to her. She was also worshipped at Olympia, Tiryns, and Samos, and across Greece the women's competitions called Heraia and annual marriage festivals were held. Her Roman counterpart is Juno.

cultural_context.id: Menurut Theoi, Hera adalah satu-satunya dewi Olimpus yang benar-benar menikah sehingga menjadi dewi perkawinan dan kelahiran anak; World History Encyclopedia mencatat bahwa pemujaannya mencakup perlombaan olahraga perempuan Heraia dan festival pernikahan tahunan di mana pasangan memeragakan ulang pernikahan Zeus dan Hera.
cultural_context.en: According to Theoi, Hera was the only really married goddess among the Olympians, hence goddess of marriage and childbirth; World History Encyclopedia records that her cult included the women's sporting competitions called Heraia and annual marriage festivals in which couples re-enacted the marriage of Zeus and Hera.

literal_meaning.id: Tidak jelas; usulan antara lain "nyonya" (Burkert) dan "sapi muda" (van Windekens)
literal_meaning.en: Unclear; proposals include "mistress" (Burkert) and "young cow, heifer" (van Windekens)

who.id: Dewi perkawinan, perempuan, dan keluarga, ratu para dewa Olimpus.
who.en: Goddess of marriage, women, and family, queen of the Olympians.

role.id: Pelindung perkawinan dan perempuan, serta istri Zeus.
role.en: Protector of marriage and women, and wife of Zeus.

famous_for.id: Watak cemburu dan pendendam terhadap kekasih Zeus dan anak-anak mereka, serta perannya dalam kisah Hercules dan perang Troya.
famous_for.en: Her jealous and vengeful nature toward Zeus's lovers and their children, and her part in the stories of Hercules and the Trojan War.

did_you_know.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, seratus mata Argos si penjaga Io dipasang Hera pada sayap burung merak.
did_you_know.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, Hera set the 100 eyes of Argos, the guard of Io, on the wings of the peacock.

description.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Hera berjanji mengutuk negeri mana pun yang memberi perlindungan kepada Leto yang sedang hamil.
description.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, Hera promised to curse any land that gave the pregnant Leto refuge.

description.id: Menurut entri kamus yang dimuat Theoi, puisi Homeros menampilkan Hera mampu menganugerahkan kuasa nubuat, satu-satunya hal yang membuatnya setara kekuasaan dengan Zeus.
description.en: According to the dictionary entry reproduced by Theoi, the Homeric poems show Hera able to confer the power of prophecy, the one point in which her power is similar to Zeus.

description.id: Dalam kisah-kisah, Hera mengirim ular dan kegilaan kepada Hercules, mengirim lalat pengganggu kepada Io, dan membutakan Tiresias.
description.en: In the stories, Hera sends snakes and madness against Hercules, a gadfly against Io, and strikes Tiresias blind.

name.id: Lebih rendah daripada Zeus dalam kekuasaan

description.id: Menurut entri kamus yang dimuat Theoi, Hera jauh lebih rendah daripada Zeus dalam kekuasaan dan harus menaatinya; dalam satu kisah Zeus menggantungnya di awan dengan tangan dirantai.
description.en: According to the dictionary entry reproduced by Theoi, Hera is far inferior to Zeus in power and must obey him; in one story Zeus hung her in the clouds with her hands chained.

summary.id: Sebuah kisah mencatat Zeus merayu Hera dalam wujud burung kukuk.
summary.en: One story records Zeus courting Hera in the guise of a cuckoo.

role.id: Hera melahirkan dan membuang putranya, menurut satu versi.

summary.id: Menurut Theoi, Hera melahirkan Hephaistos seorang diri dan melemparkannya dari surga karena lahir cacat; World History Encyclopedia mencatat versi lain di mana Zeus yang melemparkannya.
summary.en: According to Theoi, Hera produced Hephaistos alone and cast him from heaven because he was born crippled; World History Encyclopedia records another version in which Zeus threw him.

role.id: Hera menyiksa Io dan mengabadikan mata Argos pada merak.
role.en: Hera torments Io and sets Argos's eyes on the peacock.

summary.id: Hera menempatkan seratus mata Argos pada sayap burung merak, dan mengirim seekor lalat pengganggu untuk terus menyiksa Io.
summary.en: Hera set Argos's 100 eyes on the wings of the peacock and sent a gadfly to continually pester Io.

summary.id: Hera menunda kelahiran Hercules, mengirim dua ular, membuatnya gila hingga membunuh keluarganya, dan membuat Eurystheus menugaskan dua belas pekerjaan.
summary.en: Hera delayed Hercules's birth, sent two snakes, drove him mad so that he killed his family, and had Eurystheus set him twelve labours.

title.en: The judgement of Paris and the Trojan War

role.id: Hera bersaing memperebutkan apel emas dan kemudian mendukung bangsa Akhaia.
role.en: Hera competes for the golden apple and later supports the Achaeans.

summary.id: Hera bersaing melawan Aphrodite dan Athene untuk apel emas; karena Paris memilih Aphrodite, ia tidak memaafkannya dan bersekongkol demi runtuhnya Troya.
summary.en: Hera competed against Aphrodite and Athene for the golden apple; because Paris chose Aphrodite she never forgave him and schemed for Troy's downfall.

role.id: Hera bersekongkol dengan Poseidon dan Athena.
role.en: Hera conspires with Poseidon and Athena.

summary.id: Dalam Iliad, Hera, Poseidon, dan Athena bersekongkol untuk mengalahkan Zeus dan mengikatnya.
summary.en: The Iliad has Hera, Poseidon, and Athena plotting together to overcome Zeus and bind him.

description.id: Kota yang memiliki tempat suci untuk Hera sejak pertengahan abad ke-8 SM; menurut tradisi, kota ini dimenangkan Hera dari Poseidon.
description.en: A city with a sanctuary of Hera from the mid-8th century BCE; by tradition Hera won it in a dispute with Poseidon.

name.en: The sanctuary between Argos and Mycenae

description.id: Tempat suci Hera yang paling termasyhur, di kaki Gunung Euboea, tempat arca duduk Hera dari emas dan gading karya Polycletus.
description.en: Hera's most celebrated sanctuary, at the foot of Mount Euboea, with the seated gold-and-ivory statue of Hera by Polycletus.

description.id: Tempat kuil Hera (650-600 SM).
description.en: The site of a temple of Hera (650-600 BCE).

description.en: An important cult centre of Hera in the 7th century BCE.

description.id: Pulau yang dalam beberapa kisah adalah tempat kelahiran Hera dan pusat pemujaannya sejak periode Mycenae.
description.en: An island that in some accounts is Hera's birthplace and was a centre of her cult from the Mycenaean period.

description.id: Samos telah menjadi pusat pemujaan Hera sejak periode Mycenae pada pertengahan milenium ke-2 SM.
description.en: Samos was a centre of Hera's cult as far back as the Mycenaean period in the mid-2nd millennium BCE.

description.id: Argos memiliki tempat suci untuk Hera sejak pertengahan abad ke-8 SM.
description.en: Argos possessed a sanctuary to Hera from the mid-8th century BCE.

sources.author: Homer; translated by A. T. Murray

claims.quote: is the goddess of marriage, women, and family, and the protector of women during childbirth. In Greek mythology, she is queen among the twelve Olympians on Mount Olympus, sister and wife of Zeus

statement.id: Hera adalah dewi perkawinan, perempuan, dan keluarga Yunani kuno serta ratu Olimpus, saudari dan istri Zeus.
statement.en: Hera is the ancient Greek goddess of marriage, women, and family, queen of the Olympians, and Zeus's sister and wife.

claims.quote: Her iconography usually presents her as a dignified, matronly figure, upright or enthroned, crowned with a polos or diadem, sometimes veiled as a married woman.

statement.id: Hera biasanya digambarkan sebagai perempuan berwibawa yang berdiri atau bertakhta, dengan mahkota.
statement.en: Hera is usually shown as a dignified woman standing or enthroned, crowned.

claims.quote: Her Roman counterpart is Juno.

statement.id: Padanan Hera dalam tradisi Romawi adalah Juno.
statement.en: Hera's Roman counterpart is Juno.

claims.quote: HERA was the Olympian queen of the gods, and the goddess of marriage, women, the sky and the stars of heaven.

statement.id: Menurut Theoi, Hera adalah ratu dewa Olimpus dan dewi perkawinan, perempuan, langit, serta bintang.
statement.en: According to Theoi, Hera is queen of the Olympians and goddess of marriage, women, the sky, and stars.

claims.quote: Her marriage to Zeus who seduced her in the guise of a cuckoo bird.

statement.id: Salah satu kisah Hera menceritakan Zeus merayunya dengan menyamar sebagai burung kukuk.
statement.en: One Hera story recounts Zeus courting her in the guise of a cuckoo.

claims.quote: Hera was always faithful to Zeus but she was famous for her jealous and vengeful nature, principally aimed against her husband's lovers and their illegitimate children.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Hera digambarkan setia kepada Zeus namun cemburu dan membalas pasangan lain suaminya dan anak-anak mereka.
statement.en: World History Encyclopedia describes Hera as faithful to Zeus yet jealous and vengeful toward his other partners and their children.

claims.quote: She was the patron of Argos, which possessed a sanctuary to the goddess from the mid-8th century BCE.

statement.id: Hera adalah pelindung Argos, yang memiliki tempat suci untuknya sejak pertengahan abad ke-8 SM.
statement.en: Hera was patron of Argos, which had a sanctuary for her from the mid-eighth century BCE.

claims.quote: She was usually depicted as a beautiful woman wearing a crown and holding a royal, lotus-tipped sceptre, and sometimes accompanied by a lion, cuckoo or hawk.

statement.id: Menurut Theoi, Hera biasanya digambarkan sebagai perempuan cantik bermahkota yang memegang tongkat kerajaan berujung teratai, kadang disertai singa, burung kukuk, atau elang.
statement.en: According to Theoi, Hera was usually depicted as a beautiful woman wearing a crown and holding a royal, lotus-tipped sceptre, sometimes accompanied by a lion, cuckoo or hawk.

claims.quote: Her persecution of the consorts of Zeus including Leto, Semele and Alkmene (Alcmena).

statement.id: Theoi menyebut penganiayaan Hera terhadap para kekasih Zeus, termasuk Leto, Semele, dan Alkmene, sebagai salah satu mitos terkenalnya.
statement.en: Theoi lists Hera's persecution of the consorts of Zeus, including Leto, Semele and Alkmene, among her more famous myths.

claims.quote: The assisting of the Argonauts in their quest for the golden fleece, their leader Iason (Jason) being one of her favourites.

statement.id: Theoi menyebut bahwa Hera membantu para Argonaut dalam pencarian bulu domba emas, dan pemimpin mereka, Iason (Jason), adalah salah satu kesayangannya.
statement.en: Theoi records Hera assisting the Argonauts in their quest for the golden fleece, their leader Iason (Jason) being one of her favourites.

claims.quote: The punishment of Ixion, who was chained to a fiery wheel for attempting to violate the goddess.

statement.id: Menurut Theoi, Ixion dirantai pada roda berapi sebagai hukuman karena mencoba menodai sang dewi.
statement.en: According to Theoi, Ixion was chained to a fiery wheel as punishment for attempting to violate the goddess.

claims.quote: The birth of Hephaistos (Hephaestus) who she produced alone without a father and cast from heaven because he was born crippled.

statement.id: Menurut Theoi, Hera melahirkan Hephaistos (Hephaestus) seorang diri tanpa ayah dan melemparkannya dari surga karena ia lahir cacat.
statement.en: According to Theoi, Hera produced Hephaistos (Hephaestus) alone without a father and cast him from heaven because he was born crippled.

claims.quote: The judgement of Paris, in which she competed against Aphrodite and Athene for the prize of the golden apple.

statement.id: Menurut Theoi, dalam penghakiman Paris, Hera bersaing melawan Aphrodite dan Athene untuk memperebutkan apel emas.
statement.en: According to Theoi, in the judgement of Paris Hera competed against Aphrodite and Athene for the prize of the golden apple.

claims.quote: Properly speaking, Hera was the only really married goddess among the Olympians ... and hence she is the goddess of marriage and of the birth of children.

statement.id: Menurut entri kamus yang dimuat Theoi, Hera adalah satu-satunya dewi Olimpus yang benar-benar menikah, sehingga ia dewi perkawinan dan kelahiran anak.
statement.en: According to the dictionary entry reproduced by Theoi, Hera was the only really married goddess among the Olympians, and hence she is the goddess of marriage and of the birth of children.

claims.quote: Her character, as described by Homer, is not of a very amiable kind, and its main features are jealousy, obstinacy, and a quarrelling disposition

statement.id: Entri kamus yang dimuat Theoi menyatakan bahwa watak Hera menurut Homer tidak terlalu ramah, dengan ciri utama cemburu, keras kepala, dan suka bertengkar.
statement.en: The dictionary entry reproduced by Theoi says Hera's character, as described by Homer, is not very amiable, its main features being jealousy, obstinacy, and a quarrelling disposition.

claims.quote: Zeus, in such cases, not only threatens, but beats her; and once he even hung her up in the clouds, her hands chained, and with two anvils suspended from her feet

statement.id: Entri kamus yang dimuat Theoi mencatat bahwa dalam perselisihan Zeus tidak hanya mengancam tetapi memukul Hera, dan pernah menggantungnya di awan dengan tangan dirantai dan dua landasan di kakinya.
statement.en: The dictionary entry reproduced by Theoi records that Zeus not only threatens but beats her, and once hung her up in the clouds, her hands chained and two anvils suspended from her feet.

claims.quote: There is only one point in which the Homeric poems represent Hera as possessed of similar power with Zeus, viz. she is able to confer the power of prophecy

statement.id: Menurut entri kamus yang dimuat Theoi, satu-satunya hal yang membuat puisi Homeros menampilkan Hera sama berkuasa dengan Zeus ialah kemampuannya menganugerahkan kuasa nubuat.
statement.en: According to the dictionary entry reproduced by Theoi, the one point in which the Homeric poems show Hera with power similar to Zeus is that she is able to confer the power of prophecy.

claims.quote: According to tradition, Hera had disputed the possession of Argos with Poseidon, but the river-gods of the country adjudicated it to her.

statement.id: Menurut tradisi yang dimuat Theoi, Hera pernah bersengketa dengan Poseidon atas Argos, tetapi dewa-dewa sungai negeri itu memutuskan Argos untuknya.
statement.en: According to a tradition reproduced by Theoi, Hera had disputed the possession of Argos with Poseidon, but the river-gods of the country adjudicated it to her.

claims.quote: Her most celebrated sanctuary was situated between Argos and Mycenae, at the foot of Mount Euboea.

statement.id: Entri kamus yang dimuat Theoi menyatakan bahwa tempat suci Hera yang paling termasyhur terletak di antara Argos dan Mycenae, di kaki Gunung Euboea.
statement.en: The dictionary entry reproduced by Theoi says Hera's most celebrated sanctuary was situated between Argos and Mycenae, at the foot of Mount Euboea.

claims.quote: The sitting colossal statue of Hera in this temple, made of gold and ivory, was the work of Polycletus.

statement.id: Menurut entri kamus yang dimuat Theoi, arca Hera yang duduk dan kolosal di kuil itu dibuat dari emas dan gading oleh Polycletus.
statement.en: According to the dictionary entry reproduced by Theoi, the sitting colossal statue of Hera in this temple, made of gold and ivory, was the work of Polycletus.

claims.quote: I sing of golden-throned Hera whom Rhea bare. Queen of the Immortals is she, surpassing all in beauty: she is the sister and wife of loud-thundering Zeus

statement.id: Himne Homerik 12 (terjemahan Evelyn-White) menyanyikan Hera yang bertakhta emas, yang dilahirkan Rhea, ratu para makhluk abadi, melampaui semua dalam keindahan, saudari dan istri Zeus yang menggelegar.
statement.en: Homeric Hymn 12 (Evelyn-White translation) sings of golden-throned Hera whom Rhea bare, queen of the Immortals, surpassing all in beauty, sister and wife of loud-thundering Zeus.

claims.quote: Hera was the daughter of Cronus and Rhea, and mother of Ares (god of war), Hebe (goddess of youth), and Eileithyia (goddess of childbirth), all with Zeus.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Hera adalah putri Cronus dan Rhea, dan ibu Ares (dewa perang), Hebe (dewi masa muda), dan Eileithyia (dewi persalinan), semuanya bersama Zeus.
statement.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, Hera was the daughter of Cronus and Rhea, and mother of Ares (god of war), Hebe (goddess of youth), and Eileithyia (goddess of childbirth), all with Zeus.

claims.quote: However, Hera threw Hephaistos from Mount Olympus because of his ugliness, and crashing to earth, the god became lame. In other accounts, Hephaistos was thrown from the heavens by Zeus precisely because of his lameness.

statement.id: World History Encyclopedia mencatat bahwa Hera melemparkan Hephaistos dari Gunung Olympus karena keburukan rupanya sehingga ia menjadi pincang; menurut kisah lain, Zeus melemparkannya dari surga justru karena kepincangannya.
statement.en: World History Encyclopedia records that Hera threw Hephaistos from Mount Olympus because of his ugliness, so that he became lame; in other accounts Zeus threw him from the heavens precisely because of his lameness.

claims.quote: In memory, Hera then set his 100 eyes on the wings of a bird - the peacock.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, dalam kisah Io, Hera kemudian menempatkan seratus mata Argos pada sayap seekor burung, yaitu merak.
statement.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, in the story of Io Hera then set Argos's 100 eyes on the wings of a bird, the peacock.

claims.quote: Finally, not to be outdone, the Greek goddess sent a gadfly to continually pester the unfortunate Io.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Hera mengirim seekor lalat pengganggu untuk terus menyiksa Io yang malang.
statement.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, Hera sent a gadfly to continually pester the unfortunate Io.

claims.quote: Hera delayed his birth so that his cousin Eurystheus could claim the throne of Tiryns, sent two snakes to kill the infant while he slept, caused the hero to become mad and kill his own wife and children, and had Eurystheus set the hero his twelve labours

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Hera menunda kelahiran Hercules agar sepupunya Eurystheus dapat merebut takhta Tiryns, mengirim dua ular untuk membunuh bayi itu, membuatnya gila hingga membunuh istri dan anak-anaknya, dan membuat Eurystheus menugaskan dua belas pekerjaan kepadanya.
statement.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, Hera delayed Hercules's birth so his cousin Eurystheus could claim the throne of Tiryns, sent two snakes to kill the infant, caused him to go mad and kill his own wife and children, and had Eurystheus set him his twelve labours.

claims.quote: The goddess supports the Achaeans and frequently schemes with other deities to bring the downfall of Troy, as she never forgave the Trojan prince Paris for choosing Aphrodite above her as the most beautiful goddess.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, dalam Iliad Hera mendukung bangsa Akhaia dan sering bersekongkol dengan dewa lain demi runtuhnya Troya, karena ia tidak pernah memaafkan pangeran Paris yang memilih Aphrodite sebagai dewi tercantik.
statement.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, in the Iliad Hera supports the Achaeans and frequently schemes with other deities to bring down Troy, as she never forgave the Trojan prince Paris for choosing Aphrodite as the most beautiful goddess.

claims.quote: She also had a temple dedicated to her at Olympia (650-600 BCE), and Tiryns was an important cult centre to the goddess in the 7th century BCE.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Hera memiliki kuil di Olympia (650-600 SM), dan Tiryns menjadi pusat pemujaan penting baginya pada abad ke-7 SM.
statement.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, Hera had a temple at Olympia (650-600 BCE), and Tiryns was an important cult centre to the goddess in the 7th century BCE.

claims.quote: The island of Samos, in some accounts the birthplace of the goddess, had been a centre for cult worship of the Greek goddess as far back as the Mycenaean period in the mid-2nd millennium BCE

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, pulau Samos, yang dalam beberapa kisah adalah tempat kelahiran sang dewi, telah menjadi pusat pemujaannya sejak periode Mycenae pada pertengahan milenium ke-2 SM.
statement.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, the island of Samos, in some accounts the goddess's birthplace, had been a centre of her cult as far back as the Mycenaean period in the mid-2nd millennium BCE.

claims.quote: Across Greece, sporting competitions for women, the Heraia, were held in Hera's honour, as were annual marriage festivals (hierogamy) when couples re-enacted the marriage of Zeus and Hera.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, di seluruh Yunani diadakan perlombaan olahraga perempuan bernama Heraia untuk menghormati Hera, begitu pula festival pernikahan tahunan ketika pasangan memeragakan ulang pernikahan Zeus dan Hera.
statement.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, across Greece sporting competitions for women, the Heraia, were held in Hera's honour, as were annual marriage festivals in which couples re-enacted the marriage of Zeus and Hera.

claims.quote: She is most often seated on a throne and sometimes wears a crown (polos), holds a royal sceptre, and wears a bridal veil. On occasion she is also depicted holding a pomegranate, a traditional symbol of fertility.

short_description.id: Gabriel adalah malaikat agung yang menyampaikan kehendak Tuhan kepada manusia, dikenal dalam Yudaisme, Kristen, dan Islam.
short_description.en: Gabriel is an archangel who announces God's will to humankind and is known in Judaism, Christianity, and Islam.

long_description.id:
Gabriel adalah malaikat agung yang berkuasa menyampaikan kehendak Tuhan kepada manusia sebagai utusan Tuhan, dan ia dikenal dalam Yudaisme, Kristen, dan Islam. Dalam Kitab Daniel, Gabriel menjelaskan penglihatan-penglihatan Daniel; terjemahan King James menyebutnya "terbang dengan cepat" ketika datang kepada Daniel. Menurut Catholic Encyclopedia, dalam Daniel 8 ia menjelaskan penglihatan tentang domba jantan bertanduk sebagai pertanda kehancuran Kekaisaran Persia oleh Aleksander Agung dari Makedonia.

Dalam Injil Lukas, Gabriel memberitahukan kelahiran Yohanes Pembaptis kepada Zakharia; malaikat itu berkata, "Akulah Gabriel, yang berdiri di hadirat Allah." Lukas 1:26 menyatakan bahwa Gabriel diutus ke sebuah kota di Galilea bernama Nazaret, dan ia memberi tahu Maria bahwa ia akan melahirkan Yesus. Banyak cabang Kekristenan, termasuk Ortodoksi Timur, Gereja Katolik, Lutheranisme, dan Anglikanisme, menghormati Gabriel sebagai santo.

Menurut Jewish Encyclopedia, Michael berdiri di sisi kanan Tuhan dan Gabriel di sisi kiri-Nya. Michael lebih banyak berada di surga, sedangkan Gabriel adalah utusan Tuhan yang menjalankan kehendak-Nya di bumi. Dalam tradisi Yahudi itu ia berwujud manusia, bersayap seperti semua malaikat, dikaitkan dengan api, dan pergi menghancurkan Sodom serta menyelamatkan Lot setelah menampakkan diri kepada Abraham.

Umat Muslim meyakini bahwa Gabriel membawa Al-Qur'an kepada Muhammad dengan izin Allah, menurut terjemahan Al-Baqarah 2:97, dan bahwa ia ditugaskan menyampaikan kitab-kitab dari Tuhan kepada para nabi dan rasul. Metropolitan Museum of Art mencatat keyakinan bahwa firman Tuhan disampaikan kepadanya dalam bahasa Arab. Menurut tradisi hadis, Jibril dikatakan memiliki enam ratus sayap. Menurut terjemahan At-Tahrim 66:4, Gabriel termasuk pihak yang menjadi penolong orang yang dilindungi Allah.
long_description.en:
Gabriel is an archangel who brings God's will to people as God's messenger, and he is known in Judaism, Christianity, and Islam. In the Book of Daniel, Gabriel explains Daniel's visions; the King James translation says he was caused to fly swiftly when he came to Daniel. The Catholic Encyclopedia reads the horned-ram vision of Daniel 8, which Gabriel explains, as pointing to Alexander the Great of Macedon destroying the Persian Empire.

In the Gospel of Luke, Gabriel announces the birth of John the Baptist to Zechariah; the angel says, "I am Gabriel, that stand in the presence of God." Luke 1:26 says Gabriel was sent to a city of Galilee named Nazareth, and he tells Mary that she will bear Jesus. Gabriel is also honored as a saint by many Christian branches, among them Eastern Orthodoxy, the Catholic Church, Lutheranism, and Anglicanism.

According to the Jewish Encyclopedia, Michael stands at the right hand of God and Gabriel at His left. Michael is more occupied in heaven, while Gabriel is God's messenger who executes His will on earth. In that Jewish tradition he has the form of a man, has wings like all the angels, is associated with fire, and went to destroy Sodom and save Lot after appearing to Abraham.

Muslims believe that Gabriel brought the Quran to Muhammad by God's permission, according to a translation of Al-Baqarah 2:97, and that his task was to carry the scriptures from God to the prophets and messengers. The Metropolitan Museum of Art records the belief that the word of God was revealed to him in Arabic. Hadith traditions say Jibril has six hundred wings. In a translation of At-Tahrim 66:4, Gabriel is among those named as assistants of the one whom Allah protects.

who.id: Malaikat agung pembawa pesan kehendak Tuhan kepada manusia.
who.en: An archangel who announces God's will to humankind.

role.id: Menjelaskan penglihatan Daniel, mewartakan kelahiran Yohanes Pembaptis kepada Zakharia dan kelahiran Yesus kepada Maria, serta, menurut keyakinan Muslim, menyampaikan wahyu kepada Muhammad.
role.en: He explains Daniel's visions, announces John the Baptist's birth to Zechariah and Jesus's birth to Mary, and, in Muslim belief, conveys revelation to Muhammad.

famous_for.id: Memberitahukan kepada Maria bahwa ia akan melahirkan Yesus.
famous_for.en: Telling Mary that she will bear Jesus.

did_you_know.id: Tokoh sastra yang lazim menampilkan Gabriel meniup terompet kebangkitan, tetapi menurut Wikipedia Alkitab tidak pernah menyebut Gabriel sebagai peniup terompet itu.
did_you_know.en: A familiar literary trope shows Gabriel blowing the trumpet of resurrection, but according to Wikipedia the Bible never specifies Gabriel as the trumpeter.

cultural_context.id: Menurut Catholic Encyclopedia, dalam tradisi Kristen Gabriel adalah malaikat Inkarnasi, Penghiburan, dan belas kasih, sedangkan Michael lebih menjadi malaikat penghakiman; sumber yang sama mencatat bahwa orang Yahudi memandang Gabriel sebagai malaikat penghakiman dan Michael sebagai malaikat belas kasih.
cultural_context.en: According to the Catholic Encyclopedia, in Christian tradition Gabriel is the angel of the Incarnation, of Consolation, and of mercy, while Michael is rather the angel of judgment; the same source notes that the Jews regard Gabriel as the angel of judgment and Michael as the angel of mercy.

short_description.id: Gabriel adalah malaikat agung yang menyampaikan kehendak Tuhan kepada manusia, dikenal dalam Yudaisme, Kristen, dan Islam.
short_description.en: Gabriel is an archangel who announces God's will to humankind and is known in Judaism, Christianity, and Islam.

long_description.id: Gabriel adalah malaikat agung yang berkuasa menyampaikan kehendak Tuhan kepada manusia sebagai utusan Tuhan, dan ia dikenal dalam Yudaisme, Kristen, dan Islam. Dalam Kitab Daniel, Gabriel menjelaskan penglihatan-penglihatan Daniel; terjemahan King James menyebutnya "terbang dengan cepat" ketika datang kepada Daniel. Menurut Catholic Encyclopedia, dalam Daniel 8 ia menjelaskan penglihatan tentang domba jantan bertanduk sebagai pertanda kehancuran Kekaisaran Persia oleh Aleksander Agung dari Makedonia.
long_description.en: Gabriel is an archangel who brings God's will to people as God's messenger, and he is known in Judaism, Christianity, and Islam. In the Book of Daniel, Gabriel explains Daniel's visions; the King James translation says he was caused to fly swiftly when he came to Daniel. The Catholic Encyclopedia reads the horned-ram vision of Daniel 8, which Gabriel explains, as pointing to Alexander the Great of Macedon destroying the Persian Empire.

long_description.id: Dalam Injil Lukas, Gabriel memberitahukan kelahiran Yohanes Pembaptis kepada Zakharia; malaikat itu berkata, "Akulah Gabriel, yang berdiri di hadirat Allah." Lukas 1:26 menyatakan bahwa Gabriel diutus ke sebuah kota di Galilea bernama Nazaret, dan ia memberi tahu Maria bahwa ia akan melahirkan Yesus. Banyak cabang Kekristenan, termasuk Ortodoksi Timur, Gereja Katolik, Lutheranisme, dan Anglikanisme, menghormati Gabriel sebagai santo.
long_description.en: In the Gospel of Luke, Gabriel announces the birth of John the Baptist to Zechariah; the angel says, "I am Gabriel, that stand in the presence of God." Luke 1:26 says Gabriel was sent to a city of Galilee named Nazareth, and he tells Mary that she will bear Jesus. Gabriel is also honored as a saint by many Christian branches, among them Eastern Orthodoxy, the Catholic Church, Lutheranism, and Anglicanism.

long_description.id: Menurut Jewish Encyclopedia, Michael berdiri di sisi kanan Tuhan dan Gabriel di sisi kiri-Nya. Michael lebih banyak berada di surga, sedangkan Gabriel adalah utusan Tuhan yang menjalankan kehendak-Nya di bumi. Dalam tradisi Yahudi itu ia berwujud manusia, bersayap seperti semua malaikat, dikaitkan dengan api, dan pergi menghancurkan Sodom serta menyelamatkan Lot setelah menampakkan diri kepada Abraham.
long_description.en: According to the Jewish Encyclopedia, Michael stands at the right hand of God and Gabriel at His left. Michael is more occupied in heaven, while Gabriel is God's messenger who executes His will on earth. In that Jewish tradition he has the form of a man, has wings like all the angels, is associated with fire, and went to destroy Sodom and save Lot after appearing to Abraham.

long_description.id: Umat Muslim meyakini bahwa Gabriel membawa Al-Qur'an kepada Muhammad dengan izin Allah, menurut terjemahan Al-Baqarah 2:97, dan bahwa ia ditugaskan menyampaikan kitab-kitab dari Tuhan kepada para nabi dan rasul. Metropolitan Museum of Art mencatat keyakinan bahwa firman Tuhan disampaikan kepadanya dalam bahasa Arab. Menurut tradisi hadis, Jibril dikatakan memiliki enam ratus sayap. Menurut terjemahan At-Tahrim 66:4, Gabriel termasuk pihak yang menjadi penolong orang yang dilindungi Allah.
long_description.en: Muslims believe that Gabriel brought the Quran to Muhammad by God's permission, according to a translation of Al-Baqarah 2:97, and that his task was to carry the scriptures from God to the prophets and messengers. The Metropolitan Museum of Art records the belief that the word of God was revealed to him in Arabic. Hadith traditions say Jibril has six hundred wings. In a translation of At-Tahrim 66:4, Gabriel is among those named as assistants of the one whom Allah protects.

cultural_context.id: Menurut Catholic Encyclopedia, dalam tradisi Kristen Gabriel adalah malaikat Inkarnasi, Penghiburan, dan belas kasih, sedangkan Michael lebih menjadi malaikat penghakiman; sumber yang sama mencatat bahwa orang Yahudi memandang Gabriel sebagai malaikat penghakiman dan Michael sebagai malaikat belas kasih.
cultural_context.en: According to the Catholic Encyclopedia, in Christian tradition Gabriel is the angel of the Incarnation, of Consolation, and of mercy, while Michael is rather the angel of judgment; the same source notes that the Jews regard Gabriel as the angel of judgment and Michael as the angel of mercy.

short_description.id: Venus adalah dewi Romawi cinta, kecantikan, kesuburan, kemakmuran, dan kemenangan, serta leluhur bangsa Romawi melalui putranya Aeneas.
short_description.en: Venus is a Roman goddess of love, beauty, fertility, prosperity, and victory, and in myth the ancestor of the Roman people through her son Aeneas.

long_description.id:
Dalam agama Romawi, Venus dipandang sebagai dewi cinta, kecantikan, hasrat, kesuburan, kemakmuran, dan kemenangan. Mitologi Romawi menyebut Aeneas sebagai putranya dan menghubungkannya dengan leluhur bangsa Romawi. Bangsa Romawi mengadaptasi kisah dan penggambaran Aphrodite Yunani untuk Venus, tetapi satu sumber menyebut Venus juga memiliki wewenang yang melampaui Aphrodite.

Dalam kisah, Venus memiliki dua kekasih ilahi utama, yaitu suaminya Vulcan dan Mars. Dengan Mars ia dikatakan melahirkan Timor, Metus, Concordia, dan para Cupid, dan Vulcan pernah menjebak keduanya dengan jaring. Ia juga memiliki kekasih fana seperti Anchises, yang bersamanya ia memiliki putra Aeneas, dan Adonis.

Pemujaan Venus di Roma mencakup banyak gelar. Kuil pertamanya tercatat pada 295 SM untuk Venus Obsequens, dan kuil serta pemujaan Venus Erycina dan Venus Verticordia kemudian didirikan untuk kaum plebeian. Bulannya adalah April, dengan festival seperti Veneralia untuk Venus Verticordia. Pada akhir Republik, tokoh-tokoh seperti Sulla, Pompeius, dan Julius Caesar mengklaim restunya.

Dalam seni, Venus sering digambarkan telanjang, dan banyak patungnya mirip dengan Aphrodite dari Knidos dan Venus de Milo. Dalam Metamorphoses Ovidius ia hadir pada festivalnya di Siprus ketika Pygmalion berdoa, dan ia terluka oleh anak panah putranya sebelum jatuh cinta pada Adonis. Sebuah esai museum menyebut Venus dan putranya Cupid sebagai perwujudan cinta dalam syair.
long_description.en:
In Roman religion Venus is a goddess of love, beauty, desire, fertility, prosperity, and victory. Roman myth names Aeneas as her son and connects her with the ancestry of the Roman people. Romans adapted the stories and imagery of the Greek Aphrodite for Venus, though one source says Venus also held powers beyond Aphrodite.

In stories Venus has two main divine lovers, her husband Vulcan and Mars. With Mars she is said to have borne Timor, Metus, Concordia, and the Cupids, and Vulcan once trapped the two lovers in a net. She also has mortal lovers such as Anchises, with whom she has a son Aeneas, and Adonis.

Venus was worshipped in Rome under many titles. Her first temple is recorded in 295 BCE for Venus Obsequens, and temples and cults of Venus Erycina and Venus Verticordia were later founded for the plebeians. Her month was April, with festivals such as the Veneralia for Venus Verticordia. At the close of the Republic, figures such as Sulla, Pompey, and Julius Caesar claimed her favor.

In art Venus was often depicted nude, and many sculptures resemble the Aphrodite of Cnidus and the Venus de Milo. In Ovid's Metamorphoses she is present at her festival in Cyprus when Pygmalion prays, and she is grazed by her son's arrow before falling for Adonis. A museum essay presents Venus and her son Cupid as embodiments of love in verse.

claims_provenance.quote: The two goddesses both grew enamored with the mortal, so they fought until Zeus decided that Adonis would spend one-third the year with each of them and a third wherever he pleased. Ultimately, he spent his time with Venus until he was killed by a boar.

claim.id: Dalam Metamorphoses Ovidius, Venus hadir pada festivalnya sendiri dan memahami arti doa Pygmalion; sebagai tanda restu, nyala api menyala tiga kali dan memancarkan lidah api yang runcing ke udara.
claim.en: In Ovid's Metamorphoses, Venus, present at her own festival, understood the meaning of Pygmalion's prayer; as a favourable omen the flame was kindled three times and sent a tapering flame into the air.

claims_provenance.quote: The golden Venus, as she herself was present at her own festival, understood what that prayer meant; and as an omen of the Divinity being favourable, thrice was the flame kindled up, and it sent up a tapering flame into the air.
claims_provenance.source_citation: Project Gutenberg — The Metamorphoses of Ovid, Books VIII-XV (translated by Henry T. Riley)

claim.id: Dalam kisah Pygmalion versi Ovidius, sang dewi hadir pada pernikahan yang ia wujudkan, dan setelah bulan sembilan kali purnama perempuan itu melahirkan Paphos, yang namanya dipakai pulau tersebut.
claim.en: In Ovid's Pygmalion story the goddess was present at the marriage she effected, and after nine full moons the woman bore Paphos, from whom the island took its name.

claims_provenance.quote: The Goddess was present at the marriage which she ... effected. And now, the horns of the moon having been nine times gathered into a full orb, she brought forth Paphos; from whom the island derived its name.
claims_provenance.source_citation: Project Gutenberg — The Metamorphoses of Ovid, Books VIII-XV (translated by Henry T. Riley)

claim.id: Dalam Metamorphoses Ovidius, ketika putranya yang menyandang tabung panah mencium ibunya, ia tanpa sadar menggores dada sang dewi dengan anak panahnya; sang dewi yang terluka mendorong putranya menjauh.
claim.en: In Ovid's Metamorphoses, as her quiver-bearing son kisses his mother he unwittingly grazes her breast with an arrow, and the wounded goddess pushes her son away.

claims_provenance.quote: For, while the boy that wears the quiver is giving kisses to his mother, he unconsciously grazes her breast with a protruding arrow. The Goddess, wounded, pushed away her son with her hand.
claims_provenance.locator: Book X, Fable IX (Venus and Adonis)
claims_provenance.source_citation: Project Gutenberg — The Metamorphoses of Ovid, Books VIII-XV (translated by Henry T. Riley)

claim.en: The Latin theonym Venus and the common noun venus ('love, charm') stem from a Proto-Italic form reconstructed as *wenos- ('desire').

claims_provenance.quote: The Latin theonym Venus and the common noun venus ('love, charm') stem from a Proto-Italic form reconstructed as *wenos- ('desire')

claim.id: Wikipedia menyebut Cupid dan Amor sebagai dua nama untuk dewa cinta Romawi yang sama, putra Venus yang ayahnya disebut Merkurius, Vulcan, atau Mars.
claim.en: Wikipedia says Cupid and Amor are taken to be different names for the same Roman love-god, the son of Venus, fathered by Mercury, Vulcan or Mars.

claims_provenance.quote: Cupid (lust or desire) and Amor (affectionate love) are taken to be different names for the same Roman love-god, the son of Venus, fathered by Mercury, Vulcan or Mars.

claim.id: Venus pernah digambarkan sebagai mungkin "ciptaan paling orisinal dari panteon Romawi" dan sebagai dewi asli yang "tak terdefinisi jelas dan bersifat menyerap".
claim.en: Venus has been described as perhaps "the most original creation of the Roman pantheon" and as "an ill-defined and assimilative" native goddess.

claims_provenance.quote: Venus has been described as perhaps "the most original creation of the Roman pantheon", and "an ill-defined and assimilative" native goddess

claim.id: Julius Caesar mengklaim Venus sebagai leluhurnya; Venus menjadi pusat banyak festival keagamaan dan dipuja dalam agama Romawi dengan banyak gelar kultus.
claim.en: Julius Caesar claimed her as his ancestor; Venus was central to many religious festivals and revered in Roman religion under numerous cult titles.

claims_provenance.quote: Julius Caesar claimed her as his ancestor. Venus was central to many religious festivals, and was revered in Roman religion under numerous cult titles.

claim.id: Pada akhir Republik Romawi, sebagian orang Romawi mengklaim restu Venus dan bersaing merebutnya, misalnya Sulla yang memakai nama Felix (bahasa Latin untuk 'beruntung') dan menisbahkan keberuntungannya kepada Venus Felix.
claim.en: At the close of the Roman Republic some Romans laid claim to Venus's favor and competed for it, for example Sulla, who adopted the name Felix (Latin for lucky) and credited Venus Felix with his divine favor.

claims_provenance.quote: At the close of the Roman Republic, some Romans laid claim to Venus' favor and competed for it, such as Sulla (adopting the name Felix, Latin for lucky, and accrediting Venus Felix to his divine favor)

research_gaps.note: Tidak menambah gambar; instruksi agen utama melarang menambah atau mengubah gambar.

short_description.id: Venus adalah dewi Romawi cinta, kecantikan, kesuburan, kemakmuran, dan kemenangan, serta leluhur bangsa Romawi melalui putranya Aeneas.
short_description.en: Venus is a Roman goddess of love, beauty, fertility, prosperity, and victory, and in myth the ancestor of the Roman people through her son Aeneas.

long_description.id: Dalam agama Romawi, Venus dipandang sebagai dewi cinta, kecantikan, hasrat, kesuburan, kemakmuran, dan kemenangan. Mitologi Romawi menyebut Aeneas sebagai putranya dan menghubungkannya dengan leluhur bangsa Romawi. Bangsa Romawi mengadaptasi kisah dan penggambaran Aphrodite Yunani untuk Venus, tetapi satu sumber menyebut Venus juga memiliki wewenang yang melampaui Aphrodite.
long_description.en: In Roman religion Venus is a goddess of love, beauty, desire, fertility, prosperity, and victory. Roman myth names Aeneas as her son and connects her with the ancestry of the Roman people. Romans adapted the stories and imagery of the Greek Aphrodite for Venus, though one source says Venus also held powers beyond Aphrodite.

long_description.id: Dalam kisah, Venus memiliki dua kekasih ilahi utama, yaitu suaminya Vulcan dan Mars. Dengan Mars ia dikatakan melahirkan Timor, Metus, Concordia, dan para Cupid, dan Vulcan pernah menjebak keduanya dengan jaring. Ia juga memiliki kekasih fana seperti Anchises, yang bersamanya ia memiliki putra Aeneas, dan Adonis.
long_description.en: In stories Venus has two main divine lovers, her husband Vulcan and Mars. With Mars she is said to have borne Timor, Metus, Concordia, and the Cupids, and Vulcan once trapped the two lovers in a net. She also has mortal lovers such as Anchises, with whom she has a son Aeneas, and Adonis.

long_description.id: Pemujaan Venus di Roma mencakup banyak gelar. Kuil pertamanya tercatat pada 295 SM untuk Venus Obsequens, dan kuil serta pemujaan Venus Erycina dan Venus Verticordia kemudian didirikan untuk kaum plebeian. Bulannya adalah April, dengan festival seperti Veneralia untuk Venus Verticordia. Pada akhir Republik, tokoh-tokoh seperti Sulla, Pompeius, dan Julius Caesar mengklaim restunya.
long_description.en: Venus was worshipped in Rome under many titles. Her first temple is recorded in 295 BCE for Venus Obsequens, and temples and cults of Venus Erycina and Venus Verticordia were later founded for the plebeians. Her month was April, with festivals such as the Veneralia for Venus Verticordia. At the close of the Republic, figures such as Sulla, Pompey, and Julius Caesar claimed her favor.

long_description.id: Dalam seni, Venus sering digambarkan telanjang, dan banyak patungnya mirip dengan Aphrodite dari Knidos dan Venus de Milo. Dalam Metamorphoses Ovidius ia hadir pada festivalnya di Siprus ketika Pygmalion berdoa, dan ia terluka oleh anak panah putranya sebelum jatuh cinta pada Adonis. Sebuah esai museum menyebut Venus dan putranya Cupid sebagai perwujudan cinta dalam syair.
long_description.en: In art Venus was often depicted nude, and many sculptures resemble the Aphrodite of Cnidus and the Venus de Milo. In Ovid's Metamorphoses she is present at her festival in Cyprus when Pygmalion prays, and she is grazed by her son's arrow before falling for Adonis. A museum essay presents Venus and her son Cupid as embodiments of love in verse.

cultural_context.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, pada akhir Republik Romawi sebagian orang Romawi bersaing merebut restu Venus, dan Hadrianus pada 139 M mendedikasikan kuil bagi Venus dan Roma Aeterna sehingga Venus menjadi ibu pelindung negara Romawi.
cultural_context.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, at the close of the Roman Republic some Romans competed for Venus's favor, and Hadrian in 139 CE dedicated a temple to Venus and Roma Aeterna, making Venus the protective mother of the Roman state.

literal_meaning.en: From a reconstructed Proto-Italic form *wenos- ('desire'); the common noun venus means 'love, charm'.

statement.en: With Mars, Venus bore Timor (the personification of fear), his twin Metus (the personification of terror), Concordia (the goddess of harmony and concord), and the Cupids, winged love deities who represented different aspects of love.

statement.en: Rome laid siege to Eryx, offered the goddess a magnificent temple, and took her image back to Rome; this foreign image eventually became Rome's Venus Genetrix (Venus the Mother).

statement.id: Bulan Venus adalah April (awal musim semi dan kesuburan), saat sebagian besar festivalnya diadakan; pada 1 April festival Veneralia diadakan untuk menghormati Venus Verticordia.
statement.en: Venus' month was April (the beginning of spring and fertility), when most of her festivals were held; on 1 April the Veneralia was held in honor of Venus Verticordia.

claims.quote: Pompey (who dedicated, in 55 BCE, a temple to Venus Victrix - Venus of Victory), Julius Caesar (who claimed favor with Venus Victrix and Venus Genetrix), and Hadrian (who, in 139 CE, dedicated a temple to Venus and Roma Aeterna - Eternal Rome - making Venus the protective mother of the Roman state).

statement.id: Pompeius mendedikasikan pada 55 SM sebuah kuil bagi Venus Victrix (Venus Sang Pemenang), Julius Caesar mengklaim restu Venus Victrix dan Venus Genetrix, dan Hadrianus pada 139 M mendedikasikan kuil bagi Venus dan Roma Aeterna sehingga Venus menjadi ibu pelindung negara Romawi.
statement.en: Pompey dedicated a temple to Venus Victrix (Venus of Victory) in 55 BCE, Julius Caesar claimed favor with Venus Victrix and Venus Genetrix, and Hadrian in 139 CE dedicated a temple to Venus and Roma Aeterna, making Venus the protective mother of the Roman state.

claims.quote: In Virgil's Aeneid, the Trojan hero Aeneas is led to Latium by his mother in her celestial form: the evening star.

statement.en: In Virgil's Aeneid, Aeneas is led to Latium by his mother in her celestial form, the evening star.

statement.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, Venus was often depicted nude, and most sculptures of Venus closely resembled the Aphrodite of Cnidus and the Venus de Milo.

claims.quote: The two goddesses both grew enamored with the mortal, so they fought until Zeus decided that Adonis would spend one-third the year with each of them and a third wherever he pleased. Ultimately, he spent his time with Venus until he was killed by a boar.

statement.id: Venus dan Proserpina sama-sama jatuh cinta pada Adonis dan bertengkar hingga Zeus memutuskan Adonis menghabiskan sepertiga tahun dengan masing-masing dan sepertiga sisanya di tempat yang ia suka; akhirnya ia bersama Venus sampai dibunuh babi hutan.
statement.en: Venus and Proserpina both became enamored with Adonis and fought until Zeus decided Adonis would spend a third of the year with each and a third wherever he pleased; ultimately he stayed with Venus until killed by a boar.

claims.quote: The golden Venus, as she herself was present at her own festival, understood what that prayer meant; and as an omen of the Divinity being favourable, thrice was the flame kindled up, and it sent up a tapering flame into the air.

statement.id: Dalam Metamorphoses Ovidius, Venus hadir pada festivalnya sendiri dan memahami arti doa Pygmalion; sebagai tanda restu, nyala api menyala tiga kali dan memancarkan lidah api yang runcing ke udara.
statement.en: In Ovid's Metamorphoses, Venus, present at her own festival, understood the meaning of Pygmalion's prayer; as a favourable omen the flame was kindled three times and sent a tapering flame into the air.

claims.quote: The Goddess was present at the marriage which she ... effected. And now, the horns of the moon having been nine times gathered into a full orb, she brought forth Paphos; from whom the island derived its name.

statement.id: Dalam kisah Pygmalion versi Ovidius, sang dewi hadir pada pernikahan yang ia wujudkan, dan setelah bulan sembilan kali purnama perempuan itu melahirkan Paphos, yang namanya dipakai pulau tersebut.
statement.en: In Ovid's Pygmalion story the goddess was present at the marriage she effected, and after nine full moons the woman bore Paphos, from whom the island took its name.

claims.quote: For, while the boy that wears the quiver is giving kisses to his mother, he unconsciously grazes her breast with a protruding arrow. The Goddess, wounded, pushed away her son with her hand.

statement.en: In Ovid's Metamorphoses, as her quiver-bearing son kisses his mother he unwittingly grazes her breast with an arrow, and the wounded goddess pushes her son away.

statement.en: The Latin theonym Venus and the common noun venus ('love, charm') stem from a Proto-Italic form reconstructed as *wenos- ('desire').

statement.en: Venus has been described as perhaps "the most original creation of the Roman pantheon" and as "an ill-defined and assimilative" native goddess.

claims.quote: At the close of the Roman Republic, some Romans laid claim to Venus' favor and competed for it, such as Sulla (adopting the name Felix, Latin for lucky, and accrediting Venus Felix to his divine favor)

statement.id: Pada akhir Republik Romawi, sebagian orang Romawi mengklaim restu Venus dan bersaing merebutnya, misalnya Sulla yang memakai nama Felix (bahasa Latin untuk 'beruntung') dan menisbahkan keberuntungannya kepada Venus Felix.
statement.en: At the close of the Roman Republic some Romans laid claim to Venus's favor and competed for it, for example Sulla, who adopted the name Felix (Latin for lucky) and credited Venus Felix with his divine favor.
