short_description.id: Monster Frankenstein adalah makhluk ciptaan Victor Frankenstein dalam novel Mary Shelley (1818), sosok setinggi sekitar delapan kaki yang dihidupkan lalu ditinggalkan penciptanya.
short_description.en: Frankenstein's monster is the creature made by Victor Frankenstein in Mary Shelley's 1818 novel, a being of about eight feet in height who is brought to life and then abandoned by his creator.

long_description.id:
Monster Frankenstein adalah tokoh fiksi, bukan makhluk dari cerita rakyat. Ia pertama kali muncul dalam novel Frankenstein; or, The Modern Prometheus karya Mary Shelley (1818) sebagai antagonis utamanya. Novel itu pertama kali terbit secara anonim pada 1818 dan disebut Encyclopedia.com sebagai gabungan roman Gotik, petualangan fiksi ilmiah, dan kisah horor. Novel aslinya tidak memberi tokoh ini nama khusus; Victor Frankenstein menyebutnya antara lain "creature", "fiend", "wretch", dan "devil".

Dalam novel, Victor menghidupkan makhluk itu pada suatu malam November dengan "percikan keberadaan" setelah mengumpulkan bahan dari rumah jagal, ruang bedah, dan tulang dari rumah mayat. Karena bagian tubuh yang kecil menyulitkan pekerjaannya, ia memutuskan membuat sosok bertubuh raksasa, sekitar delapan kaki tingginya. Anggota tubuhnya proporsional dan fitur wajahnya dipilih agar indah, tetapi kulit kuningnya nyaris tidak menutupi otot dan arteri, rambutnya hitam mengilap, giginya putih seperti mutiara, dan matanya berair. Begitu karyanya selesai, Victor dipenuhi kengerian dan rasa jijik. Menurut Wikipedia, Victor melakukannya di loteng rumah pondokannya di Ingolstadt. Pada awal novel, Walton dan awak kapalnya melihat sosok berbentuk manusia yang tampak bertubuh raksasa mengemudikan kereta luncur anjing.

Dalam kisahnya sendiri, makhluk itu mengingat awal keberadaannya sebagai rangkaian sensasi yang kacau. Ia lebih lincah daripada manusia, dapat hidup dengan makanan yang lebih kasar, dan tahan panas serta dingin dengan lebih sedikit kerusakan pada tubuhnya. Menurut Encyclopedia.com, ia belajar berbicara dengan mengamati sebuah keluarga, dan ia kemudian mendapat buku Paradise Lost, Plutarch's Lives, dan Sorrows of Werter. Ia menyebut dirinya ciptaan Frankenstein yang seharusnya menjadi Adam tetapi lebih seperti malaikat yang jatuh, dan mengatakan bahwa ia dahulu baik hati sebelum kesengsaraan membuatnya menjadi iblis. Sarjana Joseph Carroll menggambarkan sang monster sebagai tokoh yang menempati wilayah perbatasan antara ciri protagonis dan antagonis. Ia juga berkata bahwa ia jahat karena sengsara, dijauhi dan dibenci seluruh umat manusia.

Setelah ditolak keluarga yang ia amati, makhluk itu meminta Victor membuat pasangan yang sama buruk rupanya. Ia membunuh William, adik Victor, dan menuduh Justine Moritz. Victor membuat makhluk perempuan di sebuah pulau di Orkney tetapi menghancurkannya sebelum selesai; sang monster lalu mengancam akan bersama Victor pada malam pernikahannya, dan membunuh Henry Clerval serta Elizabeth Lavenza. Pada akhirnya sang monster berjanji mengumpulkan tumpukan kayu pemakamannya dan membakar tubuhnya di ujung paling utara dunia, lalu pergi dan tidak pernah terlihat lagi.

Wikipedia dan Encyclopedia.com mengaitkan judul novel dengan Prometheus dari mitologi Yunani, yang menurut Encyclopedia.com mencuri api dari Zeus dan memberikannya kepada manusia. Wikipedia menyebut citra monster yang paling dikenal dalam budaya populer berasal dari penampilan Boris Karloff dalam film Frankenstein (1931), dan menyatakan bahwa versi itu sangat sedikit menyerupai sumber aslinya.
long_description.en:
Frankenstein's monster is a fictional character, not a figure of folk tradition. He first appeared in Mary Shelley's novel Frankenstein; or, The Modern Prometheus (1818) as its main antagonist. The novel was first published anonymously in 1818 and Encyclopedia.com describes it as equal parts Gothic romance, science-fiction adventure, and horror story. The original novel gives the character no specific name; Victor Frankenstein variously calls him the "creature", "fiend", "wretch", and "devil", among other terms.

In the novel, Victor brings the creature to life on a night in November with a "spark of being", after gathering materials from the dissecting room, the slaughter-house, and bones from charnel-houses. Because small parts hindered his work, he resolved to make the being of gigantic stature, about eight feet in height. The limbs are in proportion and the features were chosen as beautiful, yet the yellow skin scarcely covers the muscles and arteries beneath, the hair is lustrous black, the teeth pearly white, and the eyes watery. Once the work is finished, Victor is filled with breathless horror and disgust. According to Wikipedia, Victor does this in the attic of his boarding house in Ingolstadt. Early in the novel, Walton and his crew see a being of the shape of a man, apparently of gigantic stature, guiding a dog sledge.

In his own account, the creature remembers the start of his existence as a confused multiplicity of sensations. He is more agile than humans, can subsist on coarser diet, and bears heat and cold with less injury to his frame. According to Encyclopedia.com, he teaches himself to speak by observing a family, and he later obtains three books: Paradise Lost, Plutarch's Lives (one volume), and The Sorrows of Werter. He calls himself Frankenstein's creature who ought to have been Adam but is rather the fallen angel, and says he was benevolent and good until misery made him a fiend. The scholar Joseph Carroll places the monster in a borderland between the traits that usually mark protagonists and those that mark antagonists. He also says he is malicious because he is miserable, shunned and hated by all mankind.

After being rejected by the family he observed, the creature asks Victor to make him a mate as hideous as himself. He kills Victor's younger brother William and frames Justine Moritz. Victor builds a female creature on an island in Orkney but destroys it before it is complete; the monster then threatens to be with Victor on his wedding night, and kills Henry Clerval and Elizabeth Lavenza. In the end the monster pledges to collect his funeral pile and consume his frame at the northernmost extremity of the globe, then departs, never to be seen again.

Wikipedia and Encyclopedia.com link the novel's title to Prometheus of Greek mythology, who according to Encyclopedia.com steals fire from Zeus and gives it to mortals. Wikipedia says the monster's best-known popular image comes from Boris Karloff's performance in the 1931 film Frankenstein, and that this version resembles the source material very little.

era: A literary character from a novel first published anonymously in 1818.

literal_meaning.id: "Monster milik Frankenstein": nama keluarga penciptanya, yang pada akhirnya dipakai untuk menyebut makhluk itu.
literal_meaning.en: "The monster of Frankenstein": the creator's family name, eventually used to refer to the creature.

who.id: Makhluk ciptaan Victor Frankenstein dari tubuh yang dirakit dan dihidupkan, dalam novel Mary Shelley.
who.en: The creature that Victor Frankenstein assembles and brings to life, in Mary Shelley's novel.

origin.id: Tokoh ciptaan Mary Shelley yang pertama muncul dalam novel yang terbit pada 1818.
origin.en: A character created by Mary Shelley who first appeared in the novel published in 1818.

role.id: Antagonis utama novel yang, setelah ditinggalkan penciptanya, mencari balas dendam.
role.en: The main antagonist of the novel who, after being abandoned by his creator, seeks revenge.

famous_for.en: Known as a horror icon whose name is often conflated with that of his creator.

did_you_know.id: Pada 1823 Mary Shelley menghadiri pertunjukan panggung pertama novelnya dan menulis kepada temannya Leigh Hunt bahwa cara menamai yang tidak bernama itu "cukup bagus".
did_you_know.en: In 1823 Mary Shelley attended a stage adaptation of her novel and wrote to her friend Leigh Hunt that this nameless mode of naming the unnameable was rather good.

cultural_context.id: Menurut Encyclopedia.com, subjudul novel, The Modern Prometheus, mengacu pada tema utamanya, dan Frankenstein dalam novel itu menyerupai Prometheus karena mengambil kekuatan seperti dewa saat menemukan rahasia penciptaan.
cultural_context.en: According to Encyclopedia.com, the subtitle The Modern Prometheus points to the novel's central theme, and Frankenstein, like Prometheus, takes on godlike powers on discovering the secrets of creation.

description.id: Menurut kisahnya sendiri, makhluk itu lebih lincah daripada manusia, dapat hidup dengan makanan yang lebih kasar, dan tahan panas dan dingin dengan lebih sedikit kerusakan pada tubuhnya.
description.en: By his own account, the creature is more agile than humans, can subsist on coarser diet, and bears extremes of heat and cold with less injury to his frame.

summary.id: Victor Frankenstein menciptakan makhluk itu lalu lari ketakutan. Makhluk itu belajar dari sebuah keluarga, ditolak, dan menuntut pasangan dari penciptanya. Setelah Victor menghancurkan makhluk perempuan yang belum selesai, makhluk itu membunuh orang-orang yang dekat dengan Victor, dan akhirnya berjanji membakar dirinya sendiri di utara jauh.
summary.en: Victor Frankenstein creates the creature and flees in horror. The creature learns from a family, is rejected, and demands a mate from his creator. After Victor destroys the unfinished female creature, the creature kills people close to Victor and finally pledges to incinerate himself in the far north.

text.id: Tokoh sastra dari novel yang pertama kali terbit secara anonim pada 1818.
text.en: A literary character from a novel first published anonymously in 1818.

short_description.id: Monster Frankenstein adalah makhluk ciptaan Victor Frankenstein dalam novel Mary Shelley (1818), sosok setinggi sekitar delapan kaki yang dihidupkan lalu ditinggalkan penciptanya.
short_description.en: Frankenstein's monster is the creature made by Victor Frankenstein in Mary Shelley's 1818 novel, a being of about eight feet in height who is brought to life and then abandoned by his creator.

long_description.id: Monster Frankenstein adalah tokoh fiksi, bukan makhluk dari cerita rakyat. Ia pertama kali muncul dalam novel Frankenstein; or, The Modern Prometheus karya Mary Shelley (1818) sebagai antagonis utamanya. Novel itu pertama kali terbit secara anonim pada 1818 dan disebut Encyclopedia.com sebagai gabungan roman Gotik, petualangan fiksi ilmiah, dan kisah horor. Novel aslinya tidak memberi tokoh ini nama khusus; Victor Frankenstein menyebutnya antara lain "creature", "fiend", "wretch", dan "devil".
long_description.en: Frankenstein's monster is a fictional character, not a figure of folk tradition. He first appeared in Mary Shelley's novel Frankenstein; or, The Modern Prometheus (1818) as its main antagonist. The novel was first published anonymously in 1818 and Encyclopedia.com describes it as equal parts Gothic romance, science-fiction adventure, and horror story. The original novel gives the character no specific name; Victor Frankenstein variously calls him the "creature", "fiend", "wretch", and "devil", among other terms.

long_description.id: Dalam novel, Victor menghidupkan makhluk itu pada suatu malam November dengan "percikan keberadaan" setelah mengumpulkan bahan dari rumah jagal, ruang bedah, dan tulang dari rumah mayat. Karena bagian tubuh yang kecil menyulitkan pekerjaannya, ia memutuskan membuat sosok bertubuh raksasa, sekitar delapan kaki tingginya. Anggota tubuhnya proporsional dan fitur wajahnya dipilih agar indah, tetapi kulit kuningnya nyaris tidak menutupi otot dan arteri, rambutnya hitam mengilap, giginya putih seperti mutiara, dan matanya berair. Begitu karyanya selesai, Victor dipenuhi kengerian dan rasa jijik. Menurut Wikipedia, Victor melakukannya di loteng rumah pondokannya di Ingolstadt. Pada awal novel, Walton dan awak kapalnya melihat sosok berbentuk manusia yang tampak bertubuh raksasa mengemudikan kereta luncur anjing.
long_description.en: In the novel, Victor brings the creature to life on a night in November with a "spark of being", after gathering materials from the dissecting room, the slaughter-house, and bones from charnel-houses. Because small parts hindered his work, he resolved to make the being of gigantic stature, about eight feet in height. The limbs are in proportion and the features were chosen as beautiful, yet the yellow skin scarcely covers the muscles and arteries beneath, the hair is lustrous black, the teeth pearly white, and the eyes watery. Once the work is finished, Victor is filled with breathless horror and disgust. According to Wikipedia, Victor does this in the attic of his boarding house in Ingolstadt. Early in the novel, Walton and his crew see a being of the shape of a man, apparently of gigantic stature, guiding a dog sledge.

long_description.id: Dalam kisahnya sendiri, makhluk itu mengingat awal keberadaannya sebagai rangkaian sensasi yang kacau. Ia lebih lincah daripada manusia, dapat hidup dengan makanan yang lebih kasar, dan tahan panas serta dingin dengan lebih sedikit kerusakan pada tubuhnya. Menurut Encyclopedia.com, ia belajar berbicara dengan mengamati sebuah keluarga, dan ia kemudian mendapat buku Paradise Lost, Plutarch's Lives, dan Sorrows of Werter. Ia menyebut dirinya ciptaan Frankenstein yang seharusnya menjadi Adam tetapi lebih seperti malaikat yang jatuh, dan mengatakan bahwa ia dahulu baik hati sebelum kesengsaraan membuatnya menjadi iblis. Sarjana Joseph Carroll menggambarkan sang monster sebagai tokoh yang menempati wilayah perbatasan antara ciri protagonis dan antagonis. Ia juga berkata bahwa ia jahat karena sengsara, dijauhi dan dibenci seluruh umat manusia.
long_description.en: In his own account, the creature remembers the start of his existence as a confused multiplicity of sensations. He is more agile than humans, can subsist on coarser diet, and bears heat and cold with less injury to his frame. According to Encyclopedia.com, he teaches himself to speak by observing a family, and he later obtains three books: Paradise Lost, Plutarch's Lives (one volume), and The Sorrows of Werter. He calls himself Frankenstein's creature who ought to have been Adam but is rather the fallen angel, and says he was benevolent and good until misery made him a fiend. The scholar Joseph Carroll places the monster in a borderland between the traits that usually mark protagonists and those that mark antagonists. He also says he is malicious because he is miserable, shunned and hated by all mankind.

long_description.id: Setelah ditolak keluarga yang ia amati, makhluk itu meminta Victor membuat pasangan yang sama buruk rupanya. Ia membunuh William, adik Victor, dan menuduh Justine Moritz. Victor membuat makhluk perempuan di sebuah pulau di Orkney tetapi menghancurkannya sebelum selesai; sang monster lalu mengancam akan bersama Victor pada malam pernikahannya, dan membunuh Henry Clerval serta Elizabeth Lavenza. Pada akhirnya sang monster berjanji mengumpulkan tumpukan kayu pemakamannya dan membakar tubuhnya di ujung paling utara dunia, lalu pergi dan tidak pernah terlihat lagi.
long_description.en: After being rejected by the family he observed, the creature asks Victor to make him a mate as hideous as himself. He kills Victor's younger brother William and frames Justine Moritz. Victor builds a female creature on an island in Orkney but destroys it before it is complete; the monster then threatens to be with Victor on his wedding night, and kills Henry Clerval and Elizabeth Lavenza. In the end the monster pledges to collect his funeral pile and consume his frame at the northernmost extremity of the globe, then departs, never to be seen again.

long_description.id: Wikipedia dan Encyclopedia.com mengaitkan judul novel dengan Prometheus dari mitologi Yunani, yang menurut Encyclopedia.com mencuri api dari Zeus dan memberikannya kepada manusia. Wikipedia menyebut citra monster yang paling dikenal dalam budaya populer berasal dari penampilan Boris Karloff dalam film Frankenstein (1931), dan menyatakan bahwa versi itu sangat sedikit menyerupai sumber aslinya.
long_description.en: Wikipedia and Encyclopedia.com link the novel's title to Prometheus of Greek mythology, who according to Encyclopedia.com steals fire from Zeus and gives it to mortals. Wikipedia says the monster's best-known popular image comes from Boris Karloff's performance in the 1931 film Frankenstein, and that this version resembles the source material very little.

cultural_context.id: Menurut Encyclopedia.com, subjudul novel, The Modern Prometheus, mengacu pada tema utamanya, dan Frankenstein dalam novel itu menyerupai Prometheus karena mengambil kekuatan seperti dewa saat menemukan rahasia penciptaan.
cultural_context.en: According to Encyclopedia.com, the subtitle The Modern Prometheus points to the novel's central theme, and Frankenstein, like Prometheus, takes on godlike powers on discovering the secrets of creation.

literal_meaning.id: "Monster milik Frankenstein": nama keluarga penciptanya, yang pada akhirnya dipakai untuk menyebut makhluk itu.
literal_meaning.en: "The monster of Frankenstein": the creator's family name, eventually used to refer to the creature.

who.id: Makhluk ciptaan Victor Frankenstein dari tubuh yang dirakit dan dihidupkan, dalam novel Mary Shelley.
who.en: The creature that Victor Frankenstein assembles and brings to life, in Mary Shelley's novel.

origin.id: Tokoh ciptaan Mary Shelley yang pertama muncul dalam novel yang terbit pada 1818.
origin.en: A character created by Mary Shelley who first appeared in the novel published in 1818.

role.id: Antagonis utama novel yang, setelah ditinggalkan penciptanya, mencari balas dendam.
role.en: The main antagonist of the novel who, after being abandoned by his creator, seeks revenge.

famous_for.id: Dikenal sebagai ikon horor, dan namanya sering disamakan dengan nama penciptanya.
famous_for.en: Known as a horror icon whose name is often conflated with that of his creator.

did_you_know.id: Pada 1823 Mary Shelley menghadiri pertunjukan panggung pertama novelnya dan menulis kepada temannya Leigh Hunt bahwa cara menamai yang tidak bernama itu "cukup bagus".
did_you_know.en: In 1823 Mary Shelley attended a stage adaptation of her novel and wrote to her friend Leigh Hunt that this nameless mode of naming the unnameable was rather good.

description.id: Menurut kisahnya sendiri, makhluk itu lebih lincah daripada manusia, dapat hidup dengan makanan yang lebih kasar, dan tahan panas dan dingin dengan lebih sedikit kerusakan pada tubuhnya.
description.en: By his own account, the creature is more agile than humans, can subsist on coarser diet, and bears extremes of heat and cold with less injury to his frame.

description.id: Victor melihat sosok itu mendekat dengan kecepatan di atas manusia, melompati celah-celah es.
description.en: Victor sees the figure advancing with superhuman speed, bounding over crevices in the ice.

description.id: Menurut Encyclopedia.com, makhluk itu mengajari dirinya berbicara setelah mengamati sebuah keluarga, dan kemudian mempelajari buku yang ditemukannya.
description.en: According to Encyclopedia.com, the creature teaches himself to speak after observing a family, and later learns from books he finds.

summary.id: Victor Frankenstein menciptakan makhluk itu lalu lari ketakutan. Makhluk itu belajar dari sebuah keluarga, ditolak, dan menuntut pasangan dari penciptanya. Setelah Victor menghancurkan makhluk perempuan yang belum selesai, makhluk itu membunuh orang-orang yang dekat dengan Victor, dan akhirnya berjanji membakar dirinya sendiri di utara jauh.
summary.en: Victor Frankenstein creates the creature and flees in horror. The creature learns from a family, is rejected, and demands a mate from his creator. After Victor destroys the unfinished female creature, the creature kills people close to Victor and finally pledges to incinerate himself in the far north.

description.id: Tempat Victor belajar sains di universitas dan, menurut Wikipedia, membangun makhluk itu di loteng rumah pondokannya.
description.en: Where Victor studies science at the university and, according to Wikipedia, builds the creature in the attic of his boarding house.

description.id: Tempat, menurut Wikipedia, Victor membuat makhluk perempuan di sebuah pulau terpencil sebelum menghancurkannya.
description.en: Where, according to Wikipedia, Victor constructs a female creature on a remote island before destroying it.

name.en: The northernmost extremity of the globe

description.id: Menurut Wikipedia, sang monster berjanji membakar dirinya di sini; dalam teks novel ia berjanji mengumpulkan tumpukan kayu pemakamannya dan membakar tubuhnya.
description.en: According to Wikipedia, the monster pledges to incinerate himself here; in the novel's text he pledges to collect his funeral pile and consume his frame.

description.id: Novel Frankenstein; or, The Modern Prometheus pertama kali terbit secara anonim, memperkenalkan sang monster.
description.en: The novel Frankenstein; or, The Modern Prometheus was first published anonymously, introducing the monster.

description.id: Mary Shelley menghadiri pertunjukan Presumption karya Richard Brinsley Peake, adaptasi panggung pertama yang sukses dari novelnya.
description.en: Mary Shelley attended a performance of Richard Brinsley Peake's Presumption, the first successful stage adaptation of her novel.

description.en: A picture of the creature appeared in the 1831 edition.

note.id: Pencipta sang makhluk; Wikipedia menyebut bahwa ia kemudian menjadi asal nama sang monster.
note.en: The creature's creator; Wikipedia says he later became the monster's namesake.

note.id: Judul novel membandingkan Victor Frankenstein, pencipta sang makhluk, dengan Prometheus dari mitologi.
note.en: The novel's title compares Victor Frankenstein, the creature's creator, to the mythological Prometheus.

description.id: Menurut Wikipedia, citra monster yang paling dikenal dalam budaya populer berasal dari penampilan Boris Karloff dalam film Frankenstein 1931.
description.en: According to Wikipedia, the best-known image of the monster in popular culture derives from Boris Karloff's portrayal in the 1931 movie Frankenstein.

description.id: Menurut Wikipedia, dalam sekuel ini narasi pembingkai menyebut sang monster sebagai Frankenstein.
description.en: According to Wikipedia, in this sequel the frame narration refers to the monster as Frankenstein.

description.id: Menurut Wikipedia, dalam novel Dean Koontz yang pertama kali terbit pada 2004, sang makhluk diberi nama Deucalion.
description.en: According to Wikipedia, in Dean Koontz's novel first published in 2004, the creature is named Deucalion.

description.id: Menurut Wikipedia, dalam film ini Ratu Gargoyle Leonore memberinya nama Adam karena Victor tidak pernah memberinya nama.
description.en: According to Wikipedia, in this film the Queen of the Gargoyles, Leonore, gives him the name Adam after understanding Victor never gave him one.

traditional.id: Menurut Wikipedia, dalam novel sang makhluk digambarkan jauh lebih lentur daripada manusia.
traditional.en: According to Wikipedia, in the novel the creature is described as much more flexible than a human.

modern.id: Menurut Wikipedia, sejak penampilan Karloff sang makhluk hampir selalu tampil sebagai sosok menjulang mirip mayat hidup, sering berkepala datar bersudut dan berbaut di leher, dan versi itu sangat sedikit menyerupai sumber aslinya.
modern.en: According to Wikipedia, since Karloff's portrayal the creature almost always appears as a towering, undead-like figure, often with a flat-topped angular head and bolts on his neck, and that version bears little resemblance to the source material.

learning_questions.id: Mengapa nama "Frankenstein" bisa bergeser dari pencipta ke makhluknya?
learning_questions.en: Why might the name "Frankenstein" have shifted from the creator to the creature?

learning_questions.id: Apa perbedaan antara makhluk dalam novel dan citra film yang lebih populer?
learning_questions.en: What differs between the creature in the novel and the more popular film image?

learning_questions.id: Bagaimana kita menimbang tanggung jawab pencipta terhadap ciptaannya dalam kisah ini?
learning_questions.en: How do we weigh a creator's responsibility for his creation in this story?

claims.quote: It was on a dreary night of November that I beheld the accomplishment of my toils. With an anxiety that almost amounted to agony, I collected the instruments of life around me, that I might infuse a spark of being into the lifeless thing that lay at my feet.

statement.id: Victor menceritakan bahwa pada suatu malam November ia menyelesaikan karyanya dan mengumpulkan alat-alat kehidupan agar dapat menanamkan percikan keberadaan pada benda tak bernyawa di kakinya.
statement.en: Victor recounts that on a dreary night of November he completed his toils and collected the instruments of life so that he might infuse a spark of being into the lifeless thing at his feet.

claims.quote: I saw the dull yellow eye of the creature open; it breathed hard, and a convulsive motion agitated its limbs.

statement.id: Victor melihat mata kuning pudar makhluk itu terbuka; makhluk itu bernapas berat dan anggota tubuhnya digerakkan oleh gerak kejang.
statement.en: Victor sees the dull yellow eye of the creature open; it breathes hard and a convulsive motion agitates its limbs.

claims.quote: His limbs were in proportion, and I had selected his features as beautiful. Beautiful! Great God! His yellow skin scarcely covered the work of muscles and arteries beneath; his hair was of a lustrous black, and flowing; his teeth of a pearly whiteness; but these luxuriances only formed a more horrid contrast with his watery eyes

statement.id: Victor menggambarkan anggota tubuh makhluk itu proporsional dan fiturnya dipilih agar indah, tetapi kulit kuningnya nyaris tidak menutupi otot dan arteri, rambutnya hitam mengilap dan terurai, giginya seputih mutiara, dan semua itu hanya menambah kontras mengerikan dengan matanya yang berair.
statement.en: Victor describes the creature's limbs as in proportion and the features selected as beautiful, yet the yellow skin scarcely covers the muscles and arteries beneath, the hair is lustrous black and flowing, the teeth pearly white, and these only form a more horrid contrast with his watery eyes.

claims.quote: I resolved, contrary to my first intention, to make the being of a gigantic stature, that is to say, about eight feet in height, and proportionably large.

statement.id: Victor memutuskan, berlawanan dengan niat semula, membuat makhluk itu bertubuh raksasa, yaitu sekitar delapan kaki tingginya dan besar secara proporsional.
statement.en: Victor resolves, contrary to his first intention, to make the being of a gigantic stature, that is, about eight feet in height and proportionably large.

claims.quote: I collected bones from charnel-houses and disturbed, with profane fingers, the tremendous secrets of the human frame. ... The dissecting room and the slaughter-house furnished many of my materials

statement.id: Victor mengumpulkan tulang dari rumah mayat dan mengganggu rahasia besar tubuh manusia; ruang bedah dan rumah jagal menyediakan banyak bahan karyanya.
statement.en: Victor collects bones from charnel-houses and disturbs the tremendous secrets of the human frame; the dissecting room and the slaughter-house furnish many of his materials.

claims.quote: now that I had finished, the beauty of the dream vanished, and breathless horror and disgust filled my heart.

statement.id: Setelah karyanya selesai, keindahan mimpi Victor lenyap dan hatinya dipenuhi kengerian yang menyesakkan serta rasa jijik.
statement.en: Once his work is finished, the beauty of Victor's dream vanishes and breathless horror and disgust fill his heart.

claims.quote: I was more agile than they and could subsist upon coarser diet; I bore the extremes of heat and cold with less injury to my frame; my stature far exceeded theirs.

statement.id: Makhluk itu berkata ia lebih lincah daripada mereka, dapat hidup dengan makanan yang lebih kasar, tahan panas dan dingin dengan lebih sedikit kerusakan pada tubuhnya, dan jauh lebih tinggi.
statement.en: The creature says he was more agile than they and could subsist upon coarser diet, bore the extremes of heat and cold with less injury to his frame, and far exceeded their stature.

claims.quote: I suddenly beheld the figure of a man, at some distance, advancing towards me with superhuman speed. He bounded over the crevices in the ice, among which I had walked with caution; his stature, also, as he approached, seemed to exceed that of man.

statement.id: Victor melihat sosok seperti manusia mendekat dengan kecepatan di atas manusia, melompati celah-celah es, dan tingginya tampak melebihi manusia.
statement.en: Victor sees a figure of a man advancing with superhuman speed, bounding over the crevices in the ice, whose stature seems to exceed that of man.

claims.quote: a being which had the shape of a man, but apparently of gigantic stature, sat in the sledge and guided the dogs.

statement.id: Walton dan awak kapalnya melihat sosok berbentuk manusia tetapi tampak bertubuh raksasa duduk di kereta luncur dan mengemudikan anjing-anjingnya.
statement.en: Walton and his crew see a being with the shape of a man but apparently of gigantic stature sitting in a sledge and guiding the dogs.

claims.quote: I eagerly seized the prize and returned with it to my hovel. Fortunately the books were written in the language, the elements of which I had acquired at the cottage; they consisted of Paradise Lost, a volume of Plutarch’s Lives, and the Sorrows of Werter.

statement.id: Makhluk itu mengambil buku-buku yang ditulis dalam bahasa yang unsur-unsurnya telah ia pelajari di pondok, yaitu Paradise Lost, satu jilid Plutarch's Lives, dan Sorrows of Werter.
statement.en: The creature seizes books written in the language whose elements he acquired at the cottage: Paradise Lost, a volume of Plutarch's Lives, and the Sorrows of Werter.

claims.quote: Remember that I am thy creature; I ought to be thy Adam, but I am rather the fallen angel, whom thou drivest from joy for no misdeed.

statement.id: Makhluk itu berkata kepada Frankenstein bahwa ia adalah ciptaannya, yang seharusnya menjadi Adam tetapi lebih seperti malaikat yang jatuh, yang diusir dari kegembiraan tanpa kesalahan.
statement.en: The creature tells Frankenstein that he is his creature, who ought to be his Adam but is rather the fallen angel whom he drives from joy for no misdeed.

claims.quote: I was benevolent and good; misery made me a fiend.

statement.id: Makhluk itu berkata bahwa ia dahulu baik hati dan baik, dan kesengsaraan membuatnya menjadi iblis.
statement.en: The creature says he was benevolent and good, and that misery made him a fiend.

claims.quote: I am malicious because I am miserable. Am I not shunned and hated by all mankind?

statement.id: Makhluk itu berkata ia jahat karena ia sengsara, dan bertanya apakah ia tidak dijauhi dan dibenci seluruh umat manusia.
statement.en: The creature says he is malicious because he is miserable, and asks whether he is not shunned and hated by all mankind.

claims.quote: I demand a creature of another sex, but as hideous as myself; the gratification is small, but it is all that I can receive, and it shall content me.

statement.id: Makhluk itu menuntut makhluk berjenis kelamin lain yang sama buruk rupanya, dan berkata bahwa hanya itu yang dapat ia terima dan itu akan memuaskannya.
statement.en: The creature demands a creature of another sex, as hideous as himself, saying it is all he can receive and it shall content him.

claims.quote: I grasped his throat to silence him, and in a moment he lay dead at my feet.

statement.id: Makhluk itu menceritakan bahwa ia mencengkeram leher seorang anak untuk membungkamnya dan dalam sekejap anak itu terbaring mati di kakinya.
statement.en: The creature recounts that he grasped a child's throat to silence him and in a moment the child lay dead at his feet.

claims.quote: It is well. I go; but remember, I shall be with you on your wedding-night.

statement.id: Makhluk itu berkata kepada Victor bahwa ia pergi, tetapi mengingatkan bahwa ia akan bersama Victor pada malam pernikahannya.
statement.en: The creature tells Victor that he goes, but reminds him that he will be with him on his wedding-night.

claims.quote: I shall collect my funeral pile and consume to ashes this miserable frame, that its remains may afford no light to any curious and unhallowed wretch who would create such another as I have been.

statement.id: Makhluk itu berjanji mengumpulkan tumpukan kayu pemakamannya dan membakar tubuh malangnya sampai menjadi abu agar sisa-sisanya tidak memberi petunjuk kepada orang lain yang ingin menciptakan makhluk seperti dirinya.
statement.en: The creature pledges to collect his funeral pile and consume his miserable frame to ashes so that its remains may afford no light to anyone who would create such another as he has been.

claims.quote: It is with considerable difficulty that I remember the original era of my being; all the events of that period appear confused and indistinct. A strange multiplicity of sensations seized me

statement.id: Makhluk itu berkata sulit mengingat awal keberadaannya; peristiwa masa itu tampak kabur, dan serangkaian sensasi aneh menguasainya.
statement.en: The creature says it is with considerable difficulty that he remembers the original era of his being; the events appear confused and indistinct, and a strange multiplicity of sensations seized him.

claims.quote: First published anonymously in 1818, the book came to be regarded as Shelley's masterpiece and paved the way for such horror genre classics as Bram Stoker's Dracula and Robert Louis Stevenson's The Strange Case of Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde.

statement.id: Menurut Encyclopedia.com, novel itu pertama kali terbit secara anonim pada 1818, dianggap sebagai mahakarya Shelley, dan membuka jalan bagi klasik horor seperti Dracula karya Bram Stoker dan The Strange Case of Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde karya Robert Louis Stevenson.
statement.en: According to Encyclopedia.com, the book was first published anonymously in 1818, came to be regarded as Shelley's masterpiece, and paved the way for horror classics such as Bram Stoker's Dracula and Robert Louis Stevenson's The Strange Case of Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde.

claims.quote: Equal parts Gothic romance, science-fiction adventure, and horror story, Frankenstein has spawned numerous stage and screen adaptations, emerging as an icon of modern popular culture.

statement.id: Frankenstein adalah campuran roman Gotik, petualangan fiksi ilmiah, dan kisah horor, melahirkan banyak adaptasi panggung dan layar serta menjadi ikon budaya populer modern.
statement.en: Frankenstein is equal parts Gothic romance, science-fiction adventure, and horror story, has spawned numerous stage and screen adaptations, and has emerged as an icon of modern popular culture.

claims.quote: Doctor Frankenstein soon becomes fixated on the idea of creating a superior race and uses the body parts of corpses to assemble a synthetic man, imbued with the spark of life through galvanic electrical power. When the creature comes to life, the doctor is repulsed by it and flees

statement.id: Dokter Frankenstein terpaku pada gagasan menciptakan ras unggul dan merakit manusia sintetis dari bagian tubuh mayat, yang diberi percikan kehidupan lewat tenaga listrik galvanik; ketika makhluk itu hidup, sang dokter muak dan lari.
statement.en: Doctor Frankenstein becomes fixated on the idea of creating a superior race and assembles a synthetic man from the body parts of corpses, imbued with the spark of life through galvanic electrical power; when the creature comes to life, the doctor is repulsed and flees.

claims.quote: In Greek mythology, Prometheus steals fire from Zeus, the ruler of the heavens, and gives it to the mortals for the benefit of mankind. Like Prometheus, Frankenstein assumes godlike powers when he uncovers the secrets of creation and fabricates a new life.

statement.id: Menurut Encyclopedia.com, dalam mitologi Yunani, Prometheus mencuri api dari Zeus dan memberikannya kepada manusia; seperti Prometheus, Frankenstein memperoleh kekuatan seperti dewa ketika menemukan rahasia penciptaan dan membuat kehidupan baru.
statement.en: According to Encyclopedia.com, in Greek mythology Prometheus steals fire from Zeus and gives it to mortals; like Prometheus, Frankenstein assumes godlike powers when he uncovers the secrets of creation and fabricates a new life.

claims.quote: Having spent the winter and spring observing a poor but loving family, the creature teaches himself to speak.

statement.id: Menurut Encyclopedia.com, setelah mengamati sebuah keluarga miskin tetapi penuh kasih selama musim dingin dan semi, sang makhluk mengajari dirinya berbicara.
statement.en: According to Encyclopedia.com, having spent the winter and spring observing a poor but loving family, the creature teaches himself to speak.

claims.quote: The creature tells Walton of his unbearable loneliness, expresses remorse for his actions, and leaves the ship to die alone on the ice.

statement.id: Sang makhluk menceritakan kesepiannya yang tak tertahankan kepada Walton, menyatakan penyesalan atas perbuatannya, dan meninggalkan kapal untuk mati sendirian di atas es.
statement.en: The creature tells Walton of his unbearable loneliness, expresses remorse for his actions, and leaves the ship to die alone on the ice.

claims.quote: Yet his attempt to approach the family is thwarted by his hideous appearance. The creature begs Frankenstein to provide him with a mate

statement.id: Upaya sang makhluk mendekati keluarga itu digagalkan oleh penampilannya yang mengerikan, dan ia memohon kepada Frankenstein agar menyediakan pasangan baginya.
statement.en: The creature's attempt to approach the family is thwarted by his hideous appearance, and he begs Frankenstein to provide him with a mate.

statement.id: Frankenstein meninggalkan rumah untuk belajar sains di Universitas Ingolstadt di Bavaria, Jerman.
statement.en: Frankenstein leaves home to study science at the University of Ingolstadt in Bavaria, Germany.

claims.quote: The novel adopts Frankenstein's perspective as he recounts his childhood in Geneva, Switzerland.

statement.id: Novel mengambil sudut pandang Frankenstein saat ia menceritakan masa kecilnya di Jenewa, Swiss.
statement.en: The novel adopts Frankenstein's perspective as he recounts his childhood in Geneva, Switzerland.

claims.quote: Frankenstein's monster, commonly referred to as Frankenstein, is a fictional character that first appeared in Mary Shelley's 1818 novel Frankenstein; or, The Modern Prometheus as its main antagonist.

statement.id: Monster Frankenstein, yang biasa disebut Frankenstein, adalah tokoh fiksi yang pertama kali muncul dalam novel Mary Shelley tahun 1818, Frankenstein; or, The Modern Prometheus, sebagai antagonis utamanya.
statement.en: Frankenstein's monster, commonly referred to as Frankenstein, is a fictional character that first appeared in Mary Shelley's 1818 novel Frankenstein; or, The Modern Prometheus as its main antagonist.

claims.quote: Mary Shelley's original novel does not give the character a specific name. In the novel, Victor Frankenstein variously refers to his creation as the "creature", "fiend", "spectre", "dæmon", "wretch", "devil", "thing", "being", and "ogre".

statement.id: Novel asli Mary Shelley tidak memberi tokoh ini nama khusus; Victor Frankenstein menyebut ciptaannya dengan berbagai istilah: creature, fiend, spectre, dæmon, wretch, devil, thing, being, dan ogre.
statement.en: Mary Shelley's original novel does not give the character a specific name; Victor Frankenstein variously refers to his creation as the creature, fiend, spectre, dæmon, wretch, devil, thing, being, and ogre.

claims.quote: Frankenstein's creation referred to himself as a "monster" at least once, as did the residents of a hamlet who saw the creature towards the end of the novel.

statement.id: Ciptaan Frankenstein menyebut dirinya "monster" setidaknya satu kali, begitu pula penduduk sebuah dusun yang melihatnya menjelang akhir novel.
statement.en: Frankenstein's creation referred to himself as a "monster" at least once, as did the residents of a hamlet who saw the creature towards the end of the novel.

claims.quote: Shelley's title compares the monster's creator, Victor Frankenstein, who later became the monster's namesake, to the mythological character Prometheus, who fashioned humans out of clay and gave them fire.

statement.id: Judul karya Shelley membandingkan pencipta sang monster, Victor Frankenstein, yang kemudian menjadi asal nama sang monster, dengan tokoh mitologi Prometheus, yang membentuk manusia dari tanah liat dan memberi mereka api.
statement.en: Shelley's title compares the monster's creator, Victor Frankenstein, who later became the monster's namesake, to the mythological character Prometheus, who fashioned humans out of clay and gave them fire.

claims.quote: According to the scholar Joseph Carroll, the monster occupies "a border territory between the characteristics that typically define protagonists and antagonists".

statement.id: Menurut sarjana Joseph Carroll, sang monster menempati "wilayah perbatasan antara ciri-ciri yang lazimnya menentukan protagonis dan antagonis".
statement.en: According to the scholar Joseph Carroll, the monster occupies "a border territory between the characteristics that typically define protagonists and antagonists".

claims.quote: The most popularly recognized version is Boris Karloff's portrayal of the monster in the 1930s films Frankenstein, Bride of Frankenstein, and Son of Frankenstein, though that incarnation bears little resemblance to the source material.

statement.id: Versi yang paling dikenal luas adalah penampilan Boris Karloff sebagai sang monster dalam film-film 1930-an Frankenstein, Bride of Frankenstein, dan Son of Frankenstein, meskipun wujud itu sangat sedikit menyerupai sumber aslinya.
statement.en: The most popularly recognized version is Boris Karloff's portrayal of the monster in the 1930s films Frankenstein, Bride of Frankenstein, and Son of Frankenstein, though that incarnation bears little resemblance to the source material.

claims.quote: Since Karloff's portrayal, the creature almost always appears as a towering, undead-like figure, often with a flat-topped angular head and bolts on his neck to serve as electrical connectors or grotesque electrodes.

statement.id: Sejak penampilan Karloff, sang makhluk hampir selalu tampil sebagai sosok menjulang mirip mayat hidup, sering berkepala datar bersudut dan berbaut di leher yang berfungsi sebagai penghubung listrik atau elektrode mengerikan.
statement.en: Since Karloff's portrayal, the creature almost always appears as a towering, undead-like figure, often with a flat-topped angular head and bolts on his neck serving as electrical connectors or grotesque electrodes.

claims.quote: (as opposed to the novel, in which he is described as much more flexible than a human)

statement.id: Wikipedia menyatakan bahwa, berbeda dengan versi film yang berjalan kaku, dalam novel sang makhluk digambarkan jauh lebih lentur daripada manusia.
statement.en: Wikipedia states that, as opposed to the stiff-legged film version, in the novel the creature is described as much more flexible than a human.

claims.quote: Victor Frankenstein builds the creature over a two-year period in the attic of his boarding house in Ingolstadt after discovering a scientific principle which allows him to create life from non-living matter.

statement.id: Victor Frankenstein membangun makhluk itu selama dua tahun di loteng rumah pondokannya di Ingolstadt setelah menemukan prinsip ilmiah yang memungkinkannya menciptakan kehidupan dari benda tak hidup.
statement.en: Victor Frankenstein builds the creature over a two-year period in the attic of his boarding house in Ingolstadt after discovering a scientific principle that allows him to create life from non-living matter.

claims.quote: Later, the monster boards the ship, but upon finding Frankenstein dead, is overcome by grief and pledges to incinerate himself at "the Northernmost extremity of the globe". He then departs, never to be seen again.

statement.id: Kemudian sang monster naik ke kapal, tetapi mendapati Frankenstein sudah mati, ia dikuasai duka dan berjanji membakar dirinya di "ujung paling utara dunia"; ia lalu pergi dan tidak pernah terlihat lagi.
statement.en: Later the monster boards the ship but, finding Frankenstein dead, is overcome by grief and pledges to incinerate himself at the northernmost extremity of the globe; he then departs, never to be seen again.

claims.quote: Within a decade of publication, the name of the creator, "Frankenstein", was used to refer to the creature, but it did not become firmly established until much later.

statement.id: Dalam satu dekade setelah terbit, nama sang pencipta, "Frankenstein", dipakai untuk menyebut makhluknya, tetapi pemakaian itu baru mapan jauh kemudian.
statement.en: Within a decade of publication the creator's name, "Frankenstein", was used to refer to the creature, but it did not become firmly established until much later.

claims.quote: In 1823, Shelley herself attended a performance of Richard Brinsley Peake's Presumption, the first successful stage adaptation of her novel.

statement.id: Pada 1823 Shelley sendiri menghadiri pertunjukan Presumption karya Richard Brinsley Peake, adaptasi panggung pertama yang sukses dari novelnya.
statement.en: In 1823 Shelley herself attended a performance of Richard Brinsley Peake's Presumption, the first successful stage adaptation of her novel.

claims.quote: she wrote to her friend Leigh Hunt. "This nameless mode of naming the unnameable is rather good."

statement.id: Shelley menulis kepada temannya Leigh Hunt bahwa cara menamai yang tidak bernama itu cukup bagus.
statement.en: Shelley wrote to her friend Leigh Hunt that this nameless mode of naming the unnameable is rather good.

claims.quote: Frankenstein agrees, and eventually constructs a female creature on a remote island in Orkney, but aghast at the possibility of creating a race of monsters, destroys the female creature before it is complete.

statement.id: Frankenstein setuju dan akhirnya membuat makhluk perempuan di sebuah pulau terpencil di Orkney, tetapi ngeri akan kemungkinan menciptakan ras monster, ia menghancurkannya sebelum selesai.
statement.en: Frankenstein agrees and eventually constructs a female creature on a remote island in Orkney but, aghast at the possibility of creating a race of monsters, destroys it before it is complete.

claims.quote: After leaving his creator, the creature goes on to kill Victor's best friend, Henry Clerval, and later kills Frankenstein's bride, Elizabeth Lavenza, on their wedding night, whereupon Frankenstein's father dies of grief.

statement.id: Setelah meninggalkan penciptanya, sang makhluk membunuh sahabat terbaik Victor, Henry Clerval, dan kemudian mempelai Frankenstein, Elizabeth Lavenza, pada malam pernikahan mereka, lalu ayah Frankenstein meninggal karena duka.
statement.en: After leaving his creator, the creature kills Victor's best friend Henry Clerval and later Frankenstein's bride Elizabeth Lavenza on their wedding night, whereupon Frankenstein's father dies of grief.

claims.quote: The best-known image of Frankenstein's monster in popular culture derives from Boris Karloff's portrayal in the 1931 movie Frankenstein, in which he wore makeup applied and designed by Jack P. Pierce

statement.id: Citra sang monster yang paling dikenal dalam budaya populer berasal dari penampilan Boris Karloff dalam film Frankenstein 1931, dengan riasan yang diterapkan dan dirancang oleh Jack P. Pierce.
statement.en: The best-known image of Frankenstein's monster in popular culture derives from Boris Karloff's portrayal in the 1931 movie Frankenstein, with makeup applied and designed by Jack P. Pierce.

claims.quote: However, in the sequel Bride of Frankenstein (1935), the frame narration by a character representing Shelley's friend Lord Byron does refer to the monster as Frankenstein.

statement.id: Dalam sekuel Bride of Frankenstein (1935), narasi pembingkai oleh tokoh yang mewakili teman Shelley, Lord Byron, menyebut sang monster sebagai Frankenstein.
statement.en: In the sequel Bride of Frankenstein (1935), the frame narration by a character representing Shelley's friend Lord Byron does refer to the monster as Frankenstein.

claims.quote: For example, in Dean Koontz's Frankenstein, first published in 2004, the creature is named "Deucalion", after the character from Greek mythology

statement.id: Dalam novel Frankenstein karya Dean Koontz yang pertama kali terbit pada 2004, sang makhluk bernama "Deucalion", sesuai tokoh dari mitologi Yunani.
statement.en: In Dean Koontz's Frankenstein, first published in 2004, the creature is named "Deucalion", after the character from Greek mythology.

claims.quote: Another example is the 2014 film I, Frankenstein, where the Queen of the Gargoyles Leonore gives him the name "Adam" after understanding Victor never gave him one.

statement.id: Dalam film I, Frankenstein (2014), Ratu Gargoyle Leonore memberinya nama "Adam" setelah memahami bahwa Victor tidak pernah memberinya nama.
statement.en: In the 2014 film I, Frankenstein, the Queen of the Gargoyles, Leonore, gives him the name "Adam" after understanding Victor never gave him one.

claims.quote: A picture of the creature appeared in the 1831 edition.

statement.id: Sebuah gambar sang makhluk muncul dalam edisi 1831.
statement.en: A picture of the creature appeared in the 1831 edition.

claims.quote: The monster kills Victor's younger brother William upon learning of the boy's relation to his creator and frames Justine Moritz, a young woman who lives with the Frankensteins, as the culprit

statement.id: Sang monster membunuh adik Victor, William, setelah mengetahui hubungan anak itu dengan penciptanya, dan menuduh Justine Moritz, seorang perempuan yang tinggal bersama keluarga Frankenstein, sebagai pelakunya.
statement.en: The monster kills Victor's younger brother William upon learning of the boy's relation to his creator and frames Justine Moritz, a young woman who lives with the Frankensteins, as the culprit.

summary.id: Encyclopedia.com meringkas bahwa sang makhluk meninggalkan kapal untuk mati sendirian di atas es.
summary.en: Encyclopedia.com summarizes that the creature leaves the ship to die alone on the ice.

summary.id: Dalam teks novel dan menurut Wikipedia, sang monster berjanji membakar dirinya di ujung paling utara dunia.
summary.en: In the novel's text and according to Wikipedia, the monster pledges to incinerate himself at the northernmost extremity of the globe.

short_description.id: Tengri adalah sebutan dewa utama dalam tradisi Turk dan Mongol awal.
short_description.en: Tengri names a principal deity in early Turkic and Mongol traditions.

long_description.id:
Tengri adalah sebutan dewa utama dalam tradisi Turk dan Mongol awal. Konsep Tengri mencakup langit biru yang jernih dan peran dewa nasib. Dalam mitos penciptaan Mongol, Tengri Khairkhan muncul sebagai pencipta bumi.

Han shu mencatat bahwa orang Xiongnu menyebut langit 撐犁 dan menamai pemimpin mereka 撐犁孤塗單于. Sebuah artikel rujukan menyebut bentuk tertua nama itu dalam arsip Tiongkok sebagai 撑犁 dan menduganya transkripsi dari Tängri, serta menyatakan bahwa kata tengri umumnya diasumsikan semula berarti "langit".

Menurut artikel yang sama, Tengri adalah dewa nasional bangsa Göktürk dan para khan mereka mendasarkan kekuasaan pada mandat dari Tengri. Prasasti untuk Kul Tigin, dalam terjemahan yang dikutip, menyebut bahwa langit biru di atas dan bumi cokelat di bawah diciptakan, dan di antara keduanya manusia diciptakan. Dalam prasasti Orkhon, Bilge Kagan menyebut dirinya sebagai Turk yang seperti Tengri dan lahir dari Tengri.
long_description.en:
Tengri names a principal deity in early Turkic and Mongol traditions. The Tengri concept includes the clear blue sky and a deity of fate. In Mongol creation mythology, Tengri Khairkhan appears as the creator of the earth.

The Han shu records that the Xiongnu call heaven 撐犁 and named their ruler 撐犁孤塗單于. A reference article gives the oldest form of the name in Chinese annals as 撑犁 and hypothesizes that it transcribes Tängri, and it states that the word tengri is generally assumed to have originally meant "sky".

According to the same article, Tengri was the national god of the Göktürks and their khans based their power on a mandate from Tengri. The inscription for Kul Tigin, in the translation quoted, says that the blue sky above and the brown earth below were created, and between them a human being was created. In the Orkhon inscriptions, Bilge Kaghan calls himself Tengri-like and Tengri-born.

literal_meaning.en: The word tengri is generally assumed to have originally meant "sky".

claim.id: Konsep Tengri mencakup langit biru yang jernih dan peran dewa nasib.
claim.en: The Tengri concept includes the clear blue sky and a deity of fate.

claims_provenance.quote: 「テングリ」は中国史における「天」概念と非常に類似しており、天上世界を指すとともに運命神であることも共通している。ただし中国史において天の人格神である天帝が北極星と同一視されているのに対し、テングリは澄みきった青空のことであると考えられており、その点で相違する。「テングリ」崇拝は匈奴の時代から確認されている。

claim.id: Dalam mitos penciptaan Mongol, Tengri Khairkhan muncul sebagai pencipta bumi.
claim.en: In Mongol creation mythology, Tengri Khairkhan appears as the creator of the earth.

claims_provenance.quote: また、人格神としての「テングリ」はモンゴルの宇宙創造神話において「テングリ・ハイラハン」という地上を作った創造神として現れ、これも中国には見られない。ブリヤート族の神話では「西の善きテングリ」「東の悪しきテングリ」という表現が見られ、この二元性は祆教の影響によるものとも考えられている。また、このことからテングリは必ずしも唯一的な存在ではないことも看取され、これも天とは相違する。テングリは男性神であり、女性神である大地に対応する。

claim.id: Han shu (漢書) mencatat bahwa orang Xiongnu menyebut langit 撐犁 (chengli) dan anak 孤塗 (gutu); negeri itu menyebut pemimpinnya 撐犁孤塗單于, dan kata 單于 dijelaskan sebagai "luas besar" yang melambangkan keserupaan dengan langit.
claim.en: The Han shu (漢書) records that the Xiongnu call heaven 撐犁 (chengli) and a son 孤塗 (gutu); their state called its ruler 撐犁孤塗單于, and the word 單于 is explained as meaning "vast and great", said to express resemblance to heaven.

claims_provenance.quote: 單于姓攣鞮氏，其國稱之曰「撐犁孤塗單于」。匈奴謂天為「撐犁」，謂子為「孤塗」，單于者，廣大之貌也，言其象天單于然也。
claims_provenance.source_citation: Wikisource (Chinese) — 漢書/卷094上 (匈奴傳上)

claim.id: Menurut artikel ini, bentuk tertua nama itu tercatat dalam arsip Tiongkok sejak abad ke-4 SM dalam uraian kepercayaan Xiongnu, berbentuk 撑犁 (Cheng-li), yang diduga merupakan transkripsi Tiongkok dari Tängri.
claim.en: According to this article, the oldest form of the name is recorded in Chinese annals from the 4th century BC describing Xiongnu beliefs, in the form 撑犁 (Cheng-li), hypothesized to be a Chinese transcription of Tängri.

claims_provenance.quote: The oldest form of the name is recorded in Chinese annals from the 4th century BC, describing the beliefs of the Xiongnu. It takes the form 撑犁/Cheng-li, which is hypothesized to be a Chinese transcription of Tängri.

claim.en: According to this article, Tengri was the national god of the Göktürks, described as the "god of the Turks" (Türük Tängrisi), and the Göktürk khans based their power on a mandate from Tengri.

claims_provenance.quote: Tengri was the national god of the Göktürks, described as the "god of the Turks" (Türük Tängrisi). The Göktürk khans based their power on a mandate from Tengri.

claim.en: The article quotes the inscription dedicated to Kul Tigin (in the translation provided by the Language Committee of the Republic of Kazakhstan): "When the blue sky [Tengri] above and the brown earth below were created, between them a human being was created."

claim.en: The article quotes the Orkhon inscriptions, where Bilge Kaghan calls himself "Tengri-like and Tengri-born Turk Bilge Kaghan" who succeeded to the throne at that time.

statement.id: Han shu (漢書) mencatat bahwa orang Xiongnu menyebut langit 撐犁 (chengli) dan anak 孤塗 (gutu); negeri itu menyebut pemimpinnya 撐犁孤塗單于, dan kata 單于 dijelaskan sebagai "luas besar" yang melambangkan keserupaan dengan langit.
statement.en: The Han shu (漢書) records that the Xiongnu call heaven 撐犁 (chengli) and a son 孤塗 (gutu); their state called its ruler 撐犁孤塗單于, and the word 單于 is explained as meaning "vast and great", said to express resemblance to heaven.

claims.quote: The oldest form of the name is recorded in Chinese annals from the 4th century BC, describing the beliefs of the Xiongnu. It takes the form 撑犁/Cheng-li, which is hypothesized to be a Chinese transcription of Tängri.

statement.id: Menurut artikel ini, bentuk tertua nama itu tercatat dalam arsip Tiongkok sejak abad ke-4 SM dalam uraian kepercayaan Xiongnu, berbentuk 撑犁 (Cheng-li), yang diduga merupakan transkripsi Tiongkok dari Tängri.
statement.en: According to this article, the oldest form of the name is recorded in Chinese annals from the 4th century BC describing Xiongnu beliefs, in the form 撑犁 (Cheng-li), hypothesized to be a Chinese transcription of Tängri.

claims.quote: It is generally assumed the term tengri originally meant "sky".

statement.id: Artikel ini menyatakan bahwa kata tengri umumnya diasumsikan semula berarti "langit".
statement.en: The article states that the word tengri is generally assumed to have originally meant "sky".

claims.quote: Tengri was the national god of the Göktürks, described as the "god of the Turks" (Türük Tängrisi). The Göktürk khans based their power on a mandate from Tengri.

statement.id: Menurut artikel ini, Tengri adalah dewa nasional bangsa Göktürk, disebut "dewa bangsa Turk" (Türük Tängrisi), dan para khan Göktürk mendasarkan kekuasaan mereka pada mandat dari Tengri.
statement.en: According to this article, Tengri was the national god of the Göktürks, described as the "god of the Turks" (Türük Tängrisi), and the Göktürk khans based their power on a mandate from Tengri.

claims.quote: The inscription dedicated to Kul Tigin includes the passages (in the translation provided by the Language Committee of Ministry of Culture and Information of the Republic of Kazakhstan): "When the blue sky [Tengri] above and the brown earth below were created, between them a human being was created.

statement.id: Artikel ini mengutip prasasti untuk Kul Tigin (terjemahan Komite Bahasa Kazakhstan): "Ketika langit biru [Tengri] di atas dan bumi cokelat di bawah diciptakan, di antara keduanya manusia diciptakan."
statement.en: The article quotes the inscription dedicated to Kul Tigin (in the translation provided by the Language Committee of the Republic of Kazakhstan): "When the blue sky [Tengri] above and the brown earth below were created, between them a human being was created."

claims.quote: Orkhon inscriptions in the following way: "I, Tengri-like and Tengri-born Turk Bilge Kaghan, succeeded to the throne at this time"

statement.id: Artikel ini mengutip prasasti Orkhon, tempat Bilge Kagan menyebut dirinya "Turk Bilge Kagan yang seperti Tengri dan lahir dari Tengri" yang naik takhta pada masa itu.
statement.en: The article quotes the Orkhon inscriptions, where Bilge Kaghan calls himself "Tengri-like and Tengri-born Turk Bilge Kaghan" who succeeded to the throne at that time.

short_description.id: Seshat adalah dewi penulisan, kebijaksanaan, dan pengetahuan Mesir.
short_description.en: Seshat is the Egyptian goddess of writing, wisdom and knowledge.

long_description.id:
Seshat adalah dewi penulisan, kebijaksanaan, dan pengetahuan Mesir. Seshat adalah dewi buku, catatan, dan pengukuran dalam sumber pendamping.

Ia digambarkan membantu Khasekhemwy dalam ritual merentangkan tali. Teks Piramida memanggilnya Nyonya Para Pembangun. Seni memperlihatkan lambang berujung tujuh di atas kepalanya. Ia menjadi pelindung perpustakaan umum maupun pribadi.
long_description.en:
Seshat is the Egyptian goddess of writing, wisdom and knowledge. Seshat is the goddess of books, notations and measurements in the accompanying source.

She is depicted helping Khasekhemwy in the stretching-the-cord ritual. The Pyramid Texts call her Lady of Builders. Art shows a seven-pointed emblem above her head. She is patron of public and private libraries.

short_description.id: Serket adalah dewi Mesir pelindung terhadap sengatan dan gigitan kalajengking.
short_description.en: Serket is an Egyptian goddess protecting against scorpion stings and bites.

long_description.id:
Serket adalah dewi Mesir pelindung terhadap sengatan dan gigitan kalajengking. Ia digambarkan dengan kalajengking di kepala, ankh, dan tongkat was.

Ia berhubungan dengan penyembuhan, sihir, dan perlindungan. Ia melindungi tempat pembalseman dan Qebehsenuef penjaga bejana kanopik. Kitab Dua Jalan menempatkannya sebagai penjaga belokan jalan dunia bawah. Patung emas Serket ditemukan dalam makam Tutankhamun.
long_description.en:
Serket is an Egyptian goddess protecting against scorpion stings and bites. She is shown with a scorpion on her head, an ankh and a was-sceptre.

She is associated with healing, magic and protection. She protects embalming tents and Qebehsenuef, a guardian of canopic jars. The Book of Two Ways makes her guardian of a bend in the underworld path. A golden statue of Serket is found in Tutankhamun’s tomb.

short_description.id: Wadjet adalah dewi Mesir yang semula dipuja di Dep atau Buto, Mesir Hilir.
short_description.en: Wadjet is an Egyptian goddess originally worshipped at Dep or Buto in Lower Egypt.

long_description.id:
Wadjet adalah dewi Mesir yang semula dipuja di Dep atau Buto, Mesir Hilir. Ia terkait lambang Mata Ra dan Mata Horus.

Namanya berasal dari istilah papirus sebagai lambang Mesir Hilir. Bersama Nekhbet ia menjadi pelindung seluruh Mesir. Satu mitos menjadikannya pengasuh Horus yang membantu Isis melindunginya. Sumber ini mengisahkan Wadjet menanam papirus pertama dan membantu Isis membesarkan Horus.
long_description.en:
Wadjet is an Egyptian goddess originally worshipped at Dep or Buto in Lower Egypt. She is connected with the Eye of Ra and Eye of Horus symbols.

Her name derives from the term for papyrus as a symbol of Lower Egypt. With Nekhbet she becomes a protector of all Egypt. One myth makes her Horus’s nurse, helping Isis protect him. This source tells of Wadjet planting the first papyrus and helping Isis raise Horus.

short_description.id: Anahita adalah dewi Iran.
short_description.en: Anahita is an Iranian goddess.

long_description.id:
Anahita adalah dewi Iran. Anahita dipuji dalam Aban Yasht yang terdapat di Avesta.

Bahasa Persia Tengah menyebutnya Ardwisur Anahid. Anahita dihubungkan dengan kesuburan, kelahiran, dan kebijaksanaan. Kuil Anahita dibangun di dekat aliran air. Anahita dihubungkan dengan Mithra; merpati dan merak menjadi hewan sucinya.
long_description.en:
Anahita is an Iranian goddess. Anahita is praised in the Aban Yasht of the Avesta.

Middle Persian renders her name Ardwisur Anahid. Anahita is associated with fertility, procreation, and wisdom. Anahita’s temples are built beside streams and watercourses. Anahita is associated with Mithra, with the dove and peacock identified as her sacred animals.

short_description.id: Ennead Agung adalah kelompok sembilan dewa Mesir yang dipuja di Heliopolis.
short_description.en: The Great Ennead is a group of nine Egyptian gods worshipped at Heliopolis.

long_description.id:
Ennead Agung adalah kelompok sembilan dewa Mesir yang dipuja di Heliopolis. Anggotanya mencakup Atum, Shu, Tefnut, Geb, Nut, Osiris, Isis, Set, dan Nephthys.

Ennead Heliopolis merupakan salah satu dari beberapa kelompok sembilan dewa. Kata ennead berasal melalui bahasa Latin dari bahasa Yunani yang berarti sembilan. Teks Piramida menyebut Ennead Agung, Kecil, Ganda, dan Tujuh Ennead. Ennead mengadili sengketa Set dan Horus mengenai takhta.
long_description.en:
The Great Ennead is a group of nine Egyptian gods worshipped at Heliopolis. Its members include Atum, Shu, Tefnut, Geb, Nut, Osiris, Isis, Set and Nephthys.

Heliopolis’s Ennead is one of several groups of nine gods. The word ennead comes through Latin from Greek meaning nine. The Pyramid Texts mention the Great, Lesser, Dual and Seven Enneads. The Ennead judges Set and Horus’s dispute over the throne.

short_description.id: Inari adalah kami Jepang yang berkaitan dengan tanaman padi, biji-bijian, dan kesejahteraan.
short_description.en: Inari is a kami associated with rice, grain, and prosperity in Japan.

long_description.id:
Dalam istilah Shinto, Inari disebut pelindung budidaya padi dan lima jenis biji-bijian. Kitab Shinto juga menyebutnya Uka-no-mitama-no-kami. Kuil Fushimi Inari Taisha menjelaskan bahwa lima tempat pemujaan utamanya mewakili berbagai keutamaan Inari Okami.

Tradisi Inari juga berhubungan dengan rubah. Pemuja Inari di berbagai daerah mengaitkannya dengan kesejahteraan perdagangan dan kebutuhan setempat. Kuil Fushimi Inari menjelaskan nama Inari sebagai bentuk pendek ungkapan lama yang berkaitan dengan panen padi.
long_description.en:
In Shinto terminology, Inari is a tutelary deity of rice cultivation and five grains. Shinto classics also call Inari Uka-no-mitama-no-kami. Fushimi Inari Taisha explains that five main enshrined deities embody different virtues of Inari Okami.

Inari tradition is also associated with foxes. Worshipers in different regions connect Inari with commercial prosperity and local concerns. Fushimi Inari Shrine explains the name Inari as a shortened older expression relating to rice harvests.

short_description.id: Karna adalah tokoh utama wiracarita Hindu Mahabharata dan putra Surya serta Kunti.
short_description.en: Karna is a major character in the Hindu epic Mahabharata and son of Surya and Kunti.

long_description.id:
Karna adalah tokoh utama wiracarita Hindu Mahabharata dan putra Surya serta Kunti. Radha dan Adhiratha menemukan dan membesarkannya setelah ia ditinggalkan dalam keranjang di Gangga.

Ia menjadi sahabat Duryodhana dan diangkat sebagai raja Anga. Ia berperang di pihak Kaurava dan akhirnya dibunuh Arjuna. Menurut penjelasan David Slavitt, nama masa kecilnya Vasusena dan nama Karna dikaitkan dengan anting emas Surya. Mackenzie menceritakan putra Pritha dan dewa matahari disembunyikan dalam keranjang yang dihanyutkan di sungai.
long_description.en:
Karna is a major character in the Hindu epic Mahabharata and son of Surya and Kunti. Radha and Adhiratha find and foster him after he is abandoned in a basket on the Ganges.

He becomes Duryodhana's friend and is appointed king of Anga. He fights on the Kaurava side and is ultimately killed by Arjuna. According to David Slavitt's explanation, his childhood name is Vasusena and the name Karna is linked to Surya's golden earrings. Mackenzie recounts Pritha and the sun god's son being concealed in a basket floated on a river.

In Mahabharata there is a fragment of an old legend

short_description.id: Manat adalah dewi Arab pra-Islam yang dipuja di Jazirah Arab.
short_description.en: Manat is a pre-Islamic Arabian goddess worshipped on the Arabian Peninsula.

long_description.id:
Manat adalah dewi Arab pra-Islam yang dipuja di Jazirah Arab. Manat dihubungkan dengan nasib, keberuntungan, waktu, dan takdir.

Kuil utama Manat yang telah hilang berada di antara Mekah dan Madinah di pesisir Laut Merah. Aws dan Khazraj termasuk suku yang sangat memuja Manat. Para peziarah yang dibahas menganggap perjalanan belum lengkap tanpa mengunjungi arca Manat. Al-Qur’an 53:20 menyebut Manat sebagai dewi ketiga dalam rangkaian tersebut.
long_description.en:
Manat is a pre-Islamic Arabian goddess worshipped on the Arabian Peninsula. Manat is associated with fate, fortune, time, and destiny.

Manat’s lost main shrine stood between Mecca and Medina on the Red Sea coast. The Aws and Khazraj are among Manat’s devoted worshippers. The pilgrims described regard visiting Manat’s idol as necessary to complete their pilgrimage. Quran 53:20 mentions Manat as the third deity in that sequence.

short_description.id: Tammuz atau Dumuzid adalah dewa Mesopotamia dan Syam yang dihubungkan dengan pertanian serta gembala.
short_description.en: Tammuz, or Dumuzid, is a Mesopotamian and Levantine deity associated with farming and shepherds.

long_description.id:
Tammuz atau Dumuzid adalah dewa Mesopotamia dan Syam yang dihubungkan dengan pertanian serta gembala. Geshtinanna disebut sebagai saudari Dumuzid.

Dalam satu puisi, Dumuzid bersaing dengan Enkimdu untuk menikahi Inanna. Tammuz disebut secara langsung dalam Kitab Yehezkiel. Dumuzi menggantikan Inanna di dunia bawah dalam kisah yang diringkas. Dumuzi dan Geshtinanna bergantian tinggal di dunia bawah selama setengah tahun.
long_description.en:
Tammuz, or Dumuzid, is a Mesopotamian and Levantine deity associated with farming and shepherds. Geshtinanna is identified as Dumuzid’s sister.

In one poem, Dumuzid competes with Enkimdu to marry Inanna. Tammuz is named directly in the Book of Ezekiel. Dumuzi replaces Inanna in the underworld in the summarized account. Dumuzi and Geshtinanna alternate half-year stays in the underworld.

short_description.id: Maat adalah dewi Mesir yang mempersonifikasikan kebenaran, keteraturan, dan keadilan.
short_description.en: Maat is an Egyptian goddess personifying truth, order and justice.

long_description.id:
Maat adalah dewi Mesir yang mempersonifikasikan kebenaran, keteraturan, dan keadilan. Ia mengatur bintang, musim, dan tindakan manusia serta dewa. Isfet menjadi lawan konseptualnya, melambangkan kekacauan dan ketidakadilan.

Catatan awal Maat mencakup Teks Piramida Unas. Thoth menjadi pasangan maskulinnya dalam sejumlah kisah. Maat berperan dalam penimbangan hati di Duat. Bulunya menentukan kelayakan jiwa mencapai akhirat yang bahagia. Firaun digambarkan memakai lambangnya untuk menunjukkan penegakan keadilan.

Ia digambarkan sebagai perempuan muda, kadang bersayap atau memakai bulu burung unta. Raja mempunyai tugas menjaga Maat tetap hadir dalam tatanan dunia. Maat tetap hadir bersama jiwa di surga Padang Alang-Alang. Sumber ini menerjemahkan kata ma’at sebagai yang lurus. Prinsip Maat mengaitkan tindakan dengan waktu yang tepat. Menurut sumber ini, keharmonisan Maat menjiwai budaya Mesir. Dalam penafsiran Budge atas satu legenda, Maat membantu Khepera sebagai kebijaksanaan penciptaan.
long_description.en:
Maat is an Egyptian goddess personifying truth, order and justice. She regulates stars, seasons and the actions of mortals and gods. Isfet is her conceptual opposite, representing chaos and injustice.

Early records of Maat include the Pyramid Texts of Unas. Thoth is her masculine counterpart in some accounts. Maat plays a role in weighing the heart in the Duat. Her feather measures whether a soul may reach the blessed afterlife. Pharaohs are depicted with her emblems to express their upholding justice.

She is depicted as a young woman, sometimes winged or wearing an ostrich feather. Kings have a duty to maintain Maat in the world’s order. Maat remains with the soul in the paradise of the Field of Reeds. This source translates ma’at as that which is straight. The principle of Maat connects actions with their appropriate time. According to this source, Maat’s harmony permeates Egyptian culture. In Budge’s interpretation of one legend, Maat assists Khepera as creative wisdom.

long_description.id: Maat adalah dewi Mesir yang mempersonifikasikan kebenaran, keteraturan, dan keadilan. Ia mengatur bintang, musim, dan tindakan manusia serta dewa. Isfet menjadi lawan konseptualnya, melambangkan kekacauan dan ketidakadilan.
long_description.en: Maat is an Egyptian goddess personifying truth, order and justice. She regulates stars, seasons and the actions of mortals and gods. Isfet is her conceptual opposite, representing chaos and injustice.

long_description.id: Catatan awal Maat mencakup Teks Piramida Unas. Thoth menjadi pasangan maskulinnya dalam sejumlah kisah. Maat berperan dalam penimbangan hati di Duat. Bulunya menentukan kelayakan jiwa mencapai akhirat yang bahagia. Firaun digambarkan memakai lambangnya untuk menunjukkan penegakan keadilan.
long_description.en: Early records of Maat include the Pyramid Texts of Unas. Thoth is her masculine counterpart in some accounts. Maat plays a role in weighing the heart in the Duat. Her feather measures whether a soul may reach the blessed afterlife. Pharaohs are depicted with her emblems to express their upholding justice.

long_description.id: Ia digambarkan sebagai perempuan muda, kadang bersayap atau memakai bulu burung unta. Raja mempunyai tugas menjaga Maat tetap hadir dalam tatanan dunia. Maat tetap hadir bersama jiwa di surga Padang Alang-Alang. Sumber ini menerjemahkan kata ma’at sebagai yang lurus. Prinsip Maat mengaitkan tindakan dengan waktu yang tepat. Menurut sumber ini, keharmonisan Maat menjiwai budaya Mesir. Dalam penafsiran Budge atas satu legenda, Maat membantu Khepera sebagai kebijaksanaan penciptaan.
long_description.en: She is depicted as a young woman, sometimes winged or wearing an ostrich feather. Kings have a duty to maintain Maat in the world’s order. Maat remains with the soul in the paradise of the Field of Reeds. This source translates ma’at as that which is straight. The principle of Maat connects actions with their appropriate time. According to this source, Maat’s harmony permeates Egyptian culture. In Budge’s interpretation of one legend, Maat assists Khepera as creative wisdom.

short_description.id: Min adalah dewa Mesir dengan kultus yang berasal dari masa pradinasti.
short_description.en: Min is an Egyptian god whose cult originates in the predynastic period.

long_description.id:
Min adalah dewa Mesir dengan kultus yang berasal dari masa pradinasti. Ia sering digambarkan sebagai laki-laki dengan lingga tegak dan cambuk terangkat. Pusat kultusnya adalah Coptos dan Akhmim di Mesir Hulu.

Ia berhubungan dengan gurun timur dan Horus. Sinkretisme menghasilkannya sebagai Min-Horus dan Min-Amun. Orang Yunani mengidentifikasinya dengan Pan. Selada menjadi unsur khas dalam pemujaannya. Ia dihormati dalam upacara penobatan Kerajaan Baru.

Gambarnya dibawa ke ladang saat awal musim panen. Kulit hitamnya melambangkan tanah subur Nil. Sumber ini menghubungkan Min dengan perlindungan pengelana di gurun timur. Ia juga dikaitkan dengan lumpur subur hitam Delta Mesir. Prasasti awal dapat menjadikan Min suami Isis dan ayah Horus. Hubungan keluarga itu mengaitkannya dengan Osiris dalam uraian sumber ini. Mackenzie mencatat triad Min, Reshep, dan Kadesh di Mesir.
long_description.en:
Min is an Egyptian god whose cult originates in the predynastic period. He is often depicted as a man with an erect phallus and raised flail. His cult centres are Coptos and Akhmim in Upper Egypt.

He is connected with the eastern desert and Horus. Syncretism produces Min-Horus and Min-Amun. The Greeks identify him with Pan. Lettuce is a distinctive element in his worship. He is honoured in New Kingdom coronation rites.

His image is carried to the fields at the start of harvest. His black skin symbolizes the Nile’s fertile soil. This source connects Min with protecting travellers in the eastern desert. He is also connected with the black fertile mud of the Egyptian Delta. Early inscriptions can make Min Isis’s husband and Horus’s father. That family association connects him with Osiris in this source’s account. Mackenzie records an Egyptian triad of Min, Reshep and Kadesh.

short_description.id: Sekhmet adalah dewi prajurit dan penyembuhan dalam mitologi Mesir.
short_description.en: Sekhmet is an Egyptian warrior and healing goddess.

long_description.id:
Sekhmet adalah dewi prajurit dan penyembuhan dalam mitologi Mesir. Sekhmet juga merupakan dewi matahari dengan gelar Mata Ra. Ia sering dikaitkan dengan Hathor dan Bastet.

Sekhmet adalah manifestasi pembalasan Ra yang disebut Mata Ra. Ia dianggap menyebabkan wabah, sekaligus dimohon untuk menyembuhkan. Ra mengirim Hathor dalam bentuk Sekhmet menghukum manusia yang bersekongkol. Para dewa menghentikannya dengan bir merah yang disangka darah. Versi lain mengisahkan Thoth membujuk Sekhmet kembali setelah ia meninggalkan Mesir.

Ia adalah istri Ptah dan ibu Nefertum. Festival mabuk mengulang minum yang meredakan amarahnya dalam mitos. Namanya diartikan Yang Perkasa. Ia menjadi pelindung militer melalui kekuatan penghancuran dan pembalasan. Salah satu gelarnya adalah Penghantam Orang Nubia. Gelar Nyonya Kehidupan berkaitan dengan kemampuannya menyembuhkan wabah. Budge memakai nama Sekhet untuk pasangan feminin Ptah dalam triad bersama Nefertem.
long_description.en:
Sekhmet is an Egyptian warrior and healing goddess. Sekhmet is also a solar deity with the epithet Eye of Ra. She is often associated with Hathor and Bastet.

Sekhmet is a vengeful manifestation of Ra called the Eye of Ra. She is believed to cause plagues and is also invoked for healing. Ra sends Hathor as Sekhmet to punish conspiring mortals. The gods stop her with red beer mistaken for blood. Another version tells of Thoth persuading Sekhmet to return after she leaves Egypt.

She is Ptah’s wife and Nefertum’s mother. A festival of intoxication reenacts the drinking that calms her mythical wrath. Her name is interpreted as the Powerful One. She becomes a military patron through destruction and vengeance. One of her titles is Smiter of the Nubians. The Mistress of Life title relates to her ability to cure plague. Budge uses Sekhet for Ptah’s feminine counterpart in a triad with Nefertem.

short_description.id: Ahura Mazda adalah ilahi tertinggi dalam Zoroastrianism, dipandang sebagai pencipta yang bijak dan pemelihara tatanan kebenaran.
short_description.en: Ahura Mazda is the supreme divinity of Zoroastrianism, regarded as a wise creator and sustainer of truth and order.

long_description.id:
Ahura Mazda berasal dari agama Old Iranian dan ditempatkan oleh Zoroaster sebagai God. Penafsiran nama Mazdā sebagai 'kebijaksanaan' atau 'bijak' masih diperdebatkan; Ahura berarti tuan. Tradisi Zoroastrianism menghubungkannya dengan aša, tatanan dan kebenaran kosmis, serta keadilan.

Dalam uraian Zoroaster yang dibahas Kajian ini, Ahura Mazda tidak diciptakan dan memunculkan enam wujud agung. Manusia diberi pilihan moral; kejahatan berasal dari sumber selain Ahura Mazda. Uraian akademik itu juga mengingatkan bahwa gagasan Zoroaster tentang kuasanya tidak sama dengan konsep kemahakuasaan yang berkembang kemudian.

Prasasti Darius menyebut Ahuramazda sebagai pencipta bumi, langit, manusia, dan kebahagiaan, serta sumber legitimasi kerajaan dan perlindungan. Bentuk nama Ahuramazda, Hormazd, dan Ohrmazd berubah menurut periode. Kajian ini menyatakan belum ada penggambaran Ahuramazda yang tercatat dari masa Achaemenid awal.
long_description.en:
Ahura Mazda comes from ancient Iranian religion and was elevated by Zoroaster as God. Scholars debate whether Mazdā means 'wisdom' or 'wise', while Ahura means lord. Sources on Zoroastrianism link him to aša, cosmic truth and order, and to justice.

In the account of Zoroaster discussed by an academic source, Ahura Mazda is uncreated and emanates six great beings. Humans have moral choice, while evil has a source other than Ahura Mazda. Zoroaster did not conceive of Ahura Mazda as omnipotent.

Darius's inscription calls Ahuramazda creator of earth, sky, people, and happiness, as well as the source of royal legitimacy and protection. The forms Ahuramazda, Hormazd, and Ohrmazd vary by period. An academic source says no depiction of Ahuramazda is recorded for the early Achaemenid period.
