short_description.id: Anuket adalah dewi Mesir bagi katarak Nil dan Nubia Hilir.
short_description.en: Anuket is an Egyptian goddess of the Nile cataracts and Lower Nubia.

long_description.id:
Anuket adalah dewi Mesir bagi katarak Nil dan Nubia Hilir. Ia terutama dipuja di Elephantine dekat katarak pertama. Namanya berarti pemeluk atau perengkuh.

Dalam interpretasi Yunani ia disetarakan dengan Hestia atau Vesta. Salah satu hubungan awal menempatkannya sebagai putri Ra. Ia melindungi perbatasan selatan Mesir dan berhubungan dengan banjir Nil. Hubungannya dengan arus cepat turut menghubungkannya dengan papirus. Ia membentuk triad bersama Khnum dan Satis.

Kuilnya dibangun di Pulau Seheil. Kultus Elephantine mencakup prosesi sungai pada awal Shemu. Sumber sejarah pendamping menghubungkan Anuket dengan kesuburan dan katarak Aswan. Terjemahan Budge menempatkan Anqet dalam daftar dewa Rumah Ilahi Khnum. Festival Anuket dimulai saat banjir tahunan Nil. Peserta mempersembahkan koin, emas, perhiasan, dan hadiah ke sungai. Larangan memakan ikan tertentu dicabut saat festivalnya.
long_description.en:
Anuket is an Egyptian goddess of the Nile cataracts and Lower Nubia. She is especially worshipped at Elephantine near the First Cataract. Her name means Clasper or Embracer.

In Greek interpretation she is equated with Hestia or Vesta. One early association makes her a daughter of Ra. She protects Egypt’s southern border and is connected with the Nile flood. Her association with swift water also connects her with papyrus. She forms a triad with Khnum and Satis.

Her temple is built on Seheil Island. The Elephantine cult includes a river procession at the start of Shemu. The accompanying historical source connects Anuket with fertility and the Aswan cataract. Budge’s translation places Anqet in the list of gods of Khnum’s Divine House. Anuket’s festival begins with the annual Nile flood. Participants offer coins, gold, jewellery and gifts to the river. The taboo on eating certain fish is lifted during her festival.

short_description.id: Ceres adalah dewi panen dan pertanian dalam mitologi Roman, dikenal sebagai padanan Demeter dalam tradisi Greek.
short_description.en: Ceres is the Roman goddess of agriculture and harvest, identified with the Greek Demeter.

long_description.id:
Ceres dikaitkan dengan panen yang subur, tetapi kemurkaan dewi ini juga dikisahkan membawa paceklik. Ia disebut putri Saturn dan Ops serta ibu Proserpina. Dalam penggambaran seni, ia sering tampil sebagai perempuan dewasa dengan mahkota bulir gandum, sabit, dan tanduk kelimpahan.

Kisah Roman menggambarkan penculikan Proserpina dan pencarian Ceres terhadap putrinya. Beberapa versi menyatakan Proserpina harus berada di dunia bawah selama enam bulan. Sebuah patung di museum menggambarkan Ceres membawa obor dan gandum, mengingatkan pada pencarian itu dan hubungannya dengan Demeter.

Dalam puisi Ovid, Ovid mengaitkan Ceres dengan makanan yang lebih baik dan perdamaian. museum juga menyatakan patung kecil Ceres mungkin pernah menjadi benda penghormatan di tempat sembahyang rumah Roman. Keterangan ini merupakan tafsir artefak, bukan kepastian penggunaan patung tersebut.
long_description.en:
Ceres is linked with abundant harvests, but her anger is also said to bring famine. She is named as daughter of Saturn and Ops and mother of Proserpina. Art often depicts her as a mature woman with wheat, a sickle, and a cornucopia.

Roman stories describe Proserpina's abduction and Ceres's search for her daughter. Some versions make Proserpina remain in the underworld for six months. A statue at the museum shows Ceres with torch and wheat, recalling the search and her connection with Demeter.

In Ovid's poem, Ceres is linked with better food and peace. The museum also suggests a small Ceres figurine may have been venerated in a Roman household shrine. That use is an interpretation of an artifact, rather than certain provenance.

short_description.id: Nephthys adalah dewi Mesir anggota Ennead Heliopolis.
short_description.en: Nephthys is an Egyptian goddess belonging to the Heliopolitan Ennead.

long_description.id:
Nephthys adalah dewi Mesir anggota Ennead Heliopolis. Ia putri Nut dan Geb. Isis adalah saudarinya dan pasangan dalam ritual pemakaman.

Ia disebut saudari sekaligus istri Set. Ia dikaitkan dengan perkabungan, malam, dan perlindungan. Namanya lazim diterjemahkan sebagai Nyonya Rumah atau Nyonya Kuil. Bersama Isis ia melambangkan gerbang pylon kuil. Ia dipandang sebagai dewi pelindung yang melambangkan pengalaman kematian.

Sebagian mitos menjadikannya ibu Anubis; kisah lain memberi Anubis ibu berbeda. Ia juga berperan sebagai pengasuh firaun. Ia dikenal sebagai Sahabat Orang Mati. Peratap profesional disebut Layang-Layang Nephthys. Lamentations of Isis and Nephthys dipakai dalam festival, ibadah, dan pemakaman. Dalam teks tersebut ia memanggil jiwa Osiris kembali dari kematian. Budge menyebut tempat Nephthys dalam bahtera matahari saat penciptaan dan kaitannya dengan senja.
long_description.en:
Nephthys is an Egyptian goddess belonging to the Heliopolitan Ennead. She is a daughter of Nut and Geb. Isis is her sister and partner in funerary rites.

She is described as Set’s sister and wife. She is associated with mourning, night and protection. Her name is usually translated as Lady of the House or Lady of the Temple. With Isis she symbolizes a temple’s pylon gateway. She is viewed as a protective goddess symbolizing the death experience.

Some myths make her Anubis’s mother; others give him a different mother. She also acts as a nurse to the pharaoh. She is known as Friend of the Dead. Professional mourners are called the Kites of Nephthys. The Lamentations of Isis and Nephthys is used at festivals, services and funerals. In that text she calls Osiris’s soul back from death. Budge describes Nephthys’s place in the solar boat at creation and her connection with twilight.

short_description.id: Sati adalah dewi Hindu kebahagiaan perkawinan dan umur panjang, serta aspek Shakti.
short_description.en: Sati is the Hindu goddess of marital felicity and longevity and an aspect of Shakti.

long_description.id:
Sati adalah dewi Hindu kebahagiaan perkawinan dan umur panjang, serta aspek Shakti. Ia merupakan istri pertama Shiva; Parvati dipandang sebagai kelahirannya kembali.

Dalam legenda, ia menikahi Shiva bertentangan dengan keinginan ayahnya, Daksha. Bagian tubuh Sati yang jatuh ke bumi dikaitkan dengan tempat suci Shakti pitha. Nama Sati dijelaskan berarti benar, berbudi, atau mulia dalam bahasa Sanskerta. Mackenzie menuturkan Sati terjun ke api pengorbanan setelah ayahnya menghina suaminya.
long_description.en:
Sati is the Hindu goddess of marital felicity and longevity and an aspect of Shakti. She is Shiva's first wife; Parvati is regarded as her reincarnation.

In legend she marries Shiva against her father Daksha's wishes. Sati's body parts falling to earth are associated with sacred Shakti pithas. The name Sati is explained as truthful, virtuous, or noble in Sanskrit. Mackenzie recounts Sati entering the sacrificial fire after her father slighted her husband.

As Sati, Shiva's wife is the ideal of a true and virtuous
Hindu woman. When Sati's husband was slighted by
her father, the Deva-rishi, Daksha, she cast herself on
the sacrificial fire. Widows who died on the funeral
pyres of their husbands were called Sati[184], because in performing
this rite they imitated the faithful goddess.

short_description.id: Adonis adalah dewa keindahan, kekasih Aphrodite yang tewas dalam perburuan babi hutan.
short_description.en: Adonis is a god of beauty, Aphrodite's beloved who dies during a boar hunt.

long_description.id:
Kisah Adonis terkait Aphrodite dan Persephone. Ia lahir dari pohon mur; Aphrodite menitipkannya pada Persephone, yang kemudian juga jatuh cinta kepadanya. Zeus membagi waktunya: empat bulan bersama Persephone, empat bulan bersama Aphrodite, dan empat bulan sesuai pilihannya; bagian terakhir itu ia habiskan bersama Aphrodite.

Adonis tewas setelah diserang babi hutan saat berburu. Dalam salah satu kisah, darahnya dan nektar Aphrodite memunculkan bunga anemon. Lukisan Rubens dalam koleksi museum juga memperlihatkan perpisahan Adonis dan Venus sebelum perburuan maut.

Adonis dipuja dalam ritus di Byblos dan dalam tradisi lain sebagai dewa tanaman biji. Ceritanya menggabungkan kematian dan kembalinya kehidupan, sebab itu sering dikaitkan dengan pergantian musim dan tumbuhan.
long_description.en:
Adonis' story involves Aphrodite and Persephone. He is born from a myrrh tree; Aphrodite entrusts him to Persephone, who also falls in love with him. Zeus divides his time into four months with each goddess and four months of his choice, which he gives to Aphrodite.

Adonis dies after a wild boar attacks him while hunting. In one account his blood and Aphrodite's nectar produce an anemone. A Rubens painting in a museum collection shows Adonis and Venus parting before the fatal hunt.

Adonis was honored in rituals at Byblos and in another tradition as a god of grain crops. His story joins death with a return to life and is often linked to seasonal vegetation.

short_description.id: Amunet adalah dewi primordial dalam agama Mesir kuno.
short_description.en: Amunet is a primordial goddess in ancient Egyptian religion.

long_description.id:
Amunet adalah dewi primordial dalam agama Mesir kuno. Thebes menjadi pusat pemujaannya. Ia berpasangan dengan Amun sebelum penciptaan.

Namanya merupakan kata feminin yang berarti Yang Tersembunyi. Ia anggota Ogdoad Hermopolis yang melambangkan keadaan sebelum penciptaan. Teks Piramida menyebut bayangan Amun dan Amunet. Mut sering menggantikannya sebagai pasangan Amun sejak setidaknya Dinasti Kedua Belas. Ia tetap menjadi pelindung raja dalam ritual penobatan dan festival Sed.

Ia lebih sering tampil bersama Amun daripada bersama anak dewa seperti Khonsu. Kultusnya memiliki sedikit pengikut di luar Thebes. Ensiklopedia pendamping menegaskan keanggotaan Amunet dalam Ogdoad. Kajian Hypostyle Hall mengenali Amunet sebagai dewi bermakhota merah pada jamb selatan. Satu relief menunjukkan Ramses II menyebar gipsum di depan Amun-Re dan Amunet. Kajian itu juga mencatat adegan Seti I di depan Amunet. Teks ucapan Amunet dalam relief memberinya peran menyediakan pangan.
long_description.en:
Amunet is a primordial goddess in ancient Egyptian religion. Thebes is the centre of her worship. She is paired with Amun before creation.

Her name is a feminine noun meaning the Hidden One. She is a member of Hermopolis’s Ogdoad representing existence before creation. The Pyramid Texts mention the shadow of Amun and Amunet. Mut often supersedes her as Amun’s partner from at least the Twelfth Dynasty. She remains a protector of the king in coronation rites and Sed festivals.

She more often appears with Amun than with divine children such as Khonsu. Her cult has relatively few followers outside Thebes. The accompanying encyclopedia confirms Amunet’s membership of the Ogdoad. The Hypostyle Hall study identifies Amunet as a Red-Crowned goddess on the south jamb. One relief shows Ramesses II scattering gypsum before Amun-Re and Amunet. The study also records a scene of Sety I before Amunet. Amunet’s speech in the relief gives her a role of providing food.

The Pyramid Texts mention the shadow of Amun and Amunet. Mut often supersedes her as Amun’s partner from at least the Twelfth Dynasty. She remains a protector of the king in coronation rites and Sed festivals.

long_description.en: She more often appears with Amun than with divine children such as Khonsu. Her cult has relatively few followers outside Thebes. short_description.id: Frigg adalah dewi kesuburan, istri Odin dan ibu Baldr, yang dikenal berkaitan dengan pernikahan serta ramalan.
short_description.en: Frigg is a Norse fertility goddess, Odin's wife and Baldr's mother, associated with marriage and prophecy.

long_description.id:
Frigg adalah dewi kesuburan dan istri Odin. Ia dihubungkan dengan pernikahan, keibuan, kecerdikan dan ramalan; Baldr dan Hodr disebut sebagai putranya. Nama Friday berkaitan dengan namanya. Beberapa nama lainnya adalah Frigga, Frea, dan Fria.

Dalam kisah kematian Baldr, Frigg meminta segala sesuatu berjanji tidak melukainya, tetapi melewatkan mistletoe. Loki memanfaatkan kelalaian itu sehingga Hodr melempar tumbuhan tersebut dan Baldr tewas. Frigg juga dikisahkan tinggal di Fensalir, yang letaknya tidak dijelaskan.

Sebuah tradisi Lombards menyebutnya Freia, istri Odin yang membantu kemenangan mereka. Hubungan asal-usulnya dengan Freyja tetap diperdebatkan; sebuah ensiklopedia lama bahkan mengingatkan agar keduanya tidak diidentifikasi begitu saja. Sumber modern menegaskan Frigg bukan ibu Thor.
long_description.en:
Frigg is a fertility goddess and Odin's wife. She is linked to marriage, motherhood, cleverness and prophecy; Baldr and Hodr are named as her sons. English Friday is named for her. Other names include Frigga, Frea and Fria.

In the death of Baldr, Frigg asks all things to promise not to hurt him but overlooks mistletoe. Loki exploits this omission; Hodr throws the plant and Baldr dies. Frigg is also said to dwell in Fensalir, whose location is unspecified.

A tradition of the Lombards calls her Freia, Odin's wife who helps the Lombards win. Her possible historical connection to Freyja remains speculative, and an older encyclopedia warns against identifying the two outright. A modern source says she is not Thor's mother.

short_description.id: Janus ialah dewa yang menaungi awal, akhir, dan pintu; ia lazim digambarkan dengan dua wajah.
short_description.en: Janus is a Roman god of beginnings, endings and doorways, commonly shown with two faces.

long_description.id:
Janus menjaga awal dan akhir serta setiap pintu masuk dan keluar. Dua wajahnya dipahami melihat dua arah, sementara tongkat penjaga pintu dan kunci adalah lambangnya. Dalam doa, namanya disebut sebelum Jupiter, dan ia dimohon pada awal kegiatan penting.

Awal setiap bulan dianggap suci baginya, dan January mengambil namanya. Koin awal menggambarkan Janus berwajah dua, tetapi gambaran kemudian juga mencakup empat wajah. Museum menjelaskan kaitan Janus dengan bulan pertama dalam kalender.

Janus memiliki beberapa tempat pemujaan di kota itu. Pintu tempat suci utamanya secara tradisional dibuka saat perang dan ditutup saat damai, mencerminkan perannya dalam peralihan keadaan.
long_description.en:
Janus governs beginnings and endings, entrances and departures. His two faces look both ways, while a gatekeeper's staff and keys are his symbols. His name precedes Jupiter in prayer, and he is invoked at the start of important undertakings.

The first day of each month was sacred to him, and January takes his name. Early coins show Janus with two faces, while later depictions also give him four. A museum discusses his link to the Roman calendar's first month.

Janus had several shrines in Rome. The doors of his main shrine were traditionally open in war and closed in peace, reflecting his role in transitions.

short_description.id: Janus ialah dewa yang menaungi awal, akhir, dan pintu; ia lazim digambarkan dengan dua wajah.
short_description.en: Janus is a Roman god of beginnings, endings and doorways, commonly shown with two faces.

long_description.id: Janus menjaga awal dan akhir serta setiap pintu masuk dan keluar. Dua wajahnya dipahami melihat dua arah, sementara tongkat penjaga pintu dan kunci adalah lambangnya. Dalam doa, namanya disebut sebelum Jupiter, dan ia dimohon pada awal kegiatan penting.
long_description.en: Janus governs beginnings and endings, entrances and departures. His two faces look both ways, while a gatekeeper's staff and keys are his symbols. His name precedes Jupiter in prayer, and he is invoked at the start of important undertakings.

long_description.id: Awal setiap bulan dianggap suci baginya, dan January mengambil namanya. Koin awal menggambarkan Janus berwajah dua, tetapi gambaran kemudian juga mencakup empat wajah. Museum menjelaskan kaitan Janus dengan bulan pertama dalam kalender.
long_description.en: The first day of each month was sacred to him, and January takes his name. Early coins show Janus with two faces, while later depictions also give him four. A museum discusses his link to the Roman calendar's first month.

long_description.id: Janus memiliki beberapa tempat pemujaan di kota itu. Pintu tempat suci utamanya secara tradisional dibuka saat perang dan ditutup saat damai, mencerminkan perannya dalam peralihan keadaan.
long_description.en: Janus had several shrines in Rome. The doors of his main shrine were traditionally open in war and closed in peace, reflecting his role in transitions.

short_description.id: Mnemosyne ialah dewi Titan yang mempersonifikasikan ingatan dan menjadi ibu sembilan Muses bersama Zeus.
short_description.en: Mnemosyne is a Titan goddess personifying memory and mother of the nine Muses with Zeus.

long_description.id:
Mnemosyne menguasai ingatan dan dikaitkan dengan bahasa, kata, serta pewarisan kisah sebelum tulisan dikenal. Sebagai putri Ouranos, ia termasuk Titan dan juga dikaitkan dengan waktu. Namanya berarti ingatan.

Bersama Zeus, Mnemosyne menjadi ibu sembilan Muses setelah sembilan malam bersama. Para Muses menaungi seni seperti musik, tari, dan puisi. Sebuah tafsir Hesiod menempatkan kemampuan Muses menghalau kesusahan berpasangan dengan ingatan yang dilambangkan ibu mereka.

Mnemosyne juga dikaitkan dengan orakel Trophonios di Boiotia, yang memiliki sumur suci dan takhta baginya. Sumber kuno menyebut sebuah patung Mnemosyne di Athens. Dalam satu klasifikasi ia juga dinamai sebagai salah satu Muses yang lebih tua.
long_description.en:
Mnemosyne governs memory and is linked to language, words and the preservation of stories before writing. As Ouranos' daughter she is a Titan also associated with time. Her name means memory.

With Zeus, Mnemosyne mothers the nine Muses after nine nights together. The Muses patronize arts such as music, dance and poetry. One reading of Hesiod sets the Muses' relief from troubles beside the memory embodied by their mother.

Mnemosyne is also linked to the oracle of Trophonios in Boiotia, where she had a sacred well and throne. An ancient source mentions her statue in Athens. One classification also names her among the elder Muses.

short_description.id: Mut adalah dewi ibu yang dipuja di Mesir kuno.
short_description.en: Mut is a mother goddess worshipped in ancient Egypt.

long_description.id:
Mut adalah dewi ibu yang dipuja di Mesir kuno. Namanya berarti ibu. Ia berkaitan dengan air primordial Nu.

Sebagian kisah menyebutnya melahirkan dunia tanpa pasangan. Amun-Ra lebih sering disebut sebagai suaminya. Khonsu adalah anak bulan yang terkait dengannya. Mut, Amun-Ra, dan Khonsu membentuk triad Thebes di Karnak. Seni menggambarkannya memakai mahkota ganda Mesir.

Pemujaannya didukung penguasa untuk menegaskan kewenangan mereka. Ia terlibat dalam Festival Opet dan Festival Lembah. Mantra 164 Kitab Orang Mati menggambarkan Mut menyelamatkan jiwa dari setan. Ia adalah pelindung ilahi raja dan negara. Sumber ini menyebutnya membakar pengkhianat dalam anglo api. Ia dikaitkan dengan Bastet dan Sekhmet sebagai dewi pelindung. Mackenzie mencatat bentuk Mut sebagai burung nasar dan singa betina.
long_description.en:
Mut is a mother goddess worshipped in ancient Egypt. Her name means mother. She is connected with Nu’s primordial waters.

Some accounts describe her giving birth to the world without a partner. Amun-Ra is more often named as her husband. Khonsu is the lunar child associated with her. Mut, Amun-Ra and Khonsu form the Theban triad at Karnak. Art depicts her wearing Egypt’s double crown.

Rulers supported her worship to assert their authority. She participates in the Opet Festival and Beautiful Festival of the Valley. Spell 164 of the Book of the Dead portrays Mut saving souls from demons. She is a divine protector of the king and state. This source describes her burning traitors in a flaming brazier. She is linked with Bastet and Sekhmet as a protective goddess. Mackenzie records Mut’s forms as a vulture and a lioness.

short_description.id: Neith adalah dewi Mesir yang berhubungan dengan peperangan dan keibuan.
short_description.en: Neith is an Egyptian goddess associated with warfare and motherhood.

long_description.id:
Neith adalah dewi Mesir yang berhubungan dengan peperangan dan keibuan. Lambang perangnya berupa busur bersilangan. Teks menyebutnya ibu Ra dan Sobek.

Dalam sejumlah mitos ia menjadi pencipta dunia dan Ibu Agung. Ia termasuk empat dewi pelindung peti mati dan organ orang wafat. Pusat utama kultusnya adalah Sais di Delta Nil. Orang Yunani mengidentifikasinya dengan Athena. Ia digambarkan memakai Mahkota Merah Mesir Hilir dan memegang busur serta anak panah.

Ia sering membawa tongkat was dan ankh. Gelar Pembuka Jalan dapat berhubungan dengan perang maupun penuntunan jiwa. Gelar Nyonya Busur menegaskan hubungannya dengan senjata. Ia menengahi sengketa Horus dan Set mengenai pemerintahan Mesir. Patungnya muncul bersama Isis, Nephthys, dan Serket dalam makam Tutankhamun. Ia menjaga Duamutef, salah satu putra Horus pelindung bejana kanopik. Mackenzie mencatat pengakuan terhadap Neith dalam tradisi tentang Mena.
long_description.en:
Neith is an Egyptian goddess associated with warfare and motherhood. Her martial emblem consists of crossed bows. Texts describe her as the mother of Ra and Sobek.

In some myths she becomes creator of the world and Great Mother. She belongs to the four goddesses protecting coffins and the deceased’s internal organs. Her main cult centre is Sais in the Nile Delta. Greek writers identify her with Athena. She is shown with Lower Egypt’s Red Crown and bow and arrows.

She often carries a was-sceptre and an ankh. The Opener of the Ways epithet may relate to warfare and guiding souls. The Mistress of the Bow epithet emphasizes her link with weapons. She mediates Horus and Set’s dispute over ruling Egypt. Her statue occurs with Isis, Nephthys and Serket in Tutankhamun’s tomb. She guards Duamutef, a son of Horus protecting canopic jars. Mackenzie records recognition of Neith in the tradition concerning Mena.

short_description.id: Themis ialah dewi Titan Yunani yang mewujudkan hukum, tatanan, dan keadilan ilahi.
short_description.en: Themis is a Greek Titan goddess embodying divine law, order and justice.

long_description.id:
Menurut Hesiod, Themis anak Gaia dan Uranus. Ia menjadi pasangan dan penasihat Zeus; bersama Zeus ia melahirkan para Horae dan Moirae.

Themis menjaga hukum dan adat ilahi serta berhubungan dengan sidang para dewa dan manusia. Ia juga dikaitkan dengan keramahtamahan, dan seni menampilkannya dengan timbangan serta kornukopia.

Sebagai dewi nubuat, Themis pernah memegang orakel Delphi. Jalur peralihannya berbeda: versi Aeschylus melalui Phoebe sebelum Apollo, sedangkan versi Pausanias langsung kepada Apollo. Tempat sucinya dicatat di Attika.
long_description.en:
In Hesiod's genealogy Themis is a child of Gaia and Uranus. She is Zeus's bride and counsellor, and with him mothers the Horae and Moirae.

Themis governs divine law and custom and is linked with assemblies of gods and people. She is associated with hospitality, and art depicts her with scales and a cornucopia.

As a prophetic goddess, Themis once held the Delphi oracle. Accounts differ: Aeschylus includes Phoebe before Apollo, while Pausanias passes it directly to Apollo. A shrine is recorded in Attica.

short_description.id: Phoenix adalah burung legendaris berbulu merah keemasan dari mitologi Yunani yang memperbarui diri atau terlahir kembali dari pendahulunya, dan dikaitkan dengan Matahari.
short_description.en: The phoenix is a legendary red-and-gold bird of Greek mythology that renews itself or is reborn from its predecessor, and is associated with the Sun.

long_description.id:
Phoenix adalah burung legendaris yang abadi dan terus memperbarui diri atau terlahir kembali; ia berasal dari mitologi Yunani dan punya padanan di banyak budaya. Ia digambarkan berbulu merah keemasan dan memancarkan sinar matahari, hidup lima ratus tahun menurut satu uraian, dan memakan balsam dan kemenyan Arabia. Herodotus menulis bahwa ia hanya pernah melihat gambarnya dan bahwa bulunya sebagian keemasan, sebagian merah, dengan bentuk dan ukuran seperti elang. Philostratus menyebut ia mirip elang, bersinar keemasan, dan bersarang dari rempah di mata air Sungai Nil, sedangkan Claudianus menyebutnya sekaligus ayah dan putranya sendiri.

Kisah tentang pergantian generasinya berbeda-beda. Menurut cerita yang didengar Herodotus, burung baru membawa jasad induknya terbungkus mur dari Arabia ke kuil Matahari di Heliopolis. Ovidius menulis bahwa phoenix membangun sarang di puncak palem dan burung kecil terlahir dari tubuh induknya, lalu membawa sarang itu ke kota Matahari. Dalam versi lain, phoenix yang sangat tua menyerahkan dirinya pada api, atau seekor cacing keluar dari tubuhnya dan tumbuh menjadi phoenix baru oleh panas matahari. Ada pula versi yang menyebut phoenix membangun timbunan rempah, duduk di atasnya, lalu mati dan bangkit kembali. Menurut kisah India dalam Philostratus, phoenix yang terbakar di sarangnya menyanyikan lagu duka bagi dirinya sendiri.

Nama Latin phoenix berasal dari kata Yunani φοῖνιξ. Penyebutan paling awal yang jelas dalam sastra Yunani ada pada fragmen yang dikaitkan dengan Hesiodos, yang menyebut phoenix hidup lebih lama daripada sembilan gagak. Para sarjana mencatat bahwa phoenix sering digambarkan berlingkar cahaya untuk menekankan kaitannya dengan Matahari, bahwa burung matahari Bennu yang dimuliakan di Heliopolis mirip dalam beberapa hal, dan bahwa sumber tidak sepakat soal warna pastinya.

Fenghuang Tiongkok sering diterjemahkan sebagai phoenix, tetapi The Met menyatakan fenghuang adalah spesies mitos tersendiri dengan rangkaian makna berbeda, dan dikatakan muncul hanya pada masa damai dan makmur.
long_description.en:
The phoenix is a legendary immortal bird that cyclically renews itself or is reborn; it originates in Greek mythology and has analogues in many cultures. It is portrayed with red-and-gold feathers that emit rays of sunlight, living five hundred years in one account and feeding on Arabian balsam and frankincense. Herodotus wrote that he had seen it only in pictures and that its plumage is partly golden and partly red, with the shape and size of an eagle. Philostratus likens it to an eagle that shines with gold and nests on spices at the springs of the Nile, while Claudian calls it its own father and son.

Accounts of its renewal differ. In the story Herodotus heard, the new bird carries its parent's body wrapped in myrrh from Arabia to the temple of the Sun at Heliopolis. Ovid wrote that the phoenix builds a nest on a palm and a small bird is reborn from the parent's body, then carries the nest to the Sun's city. In other versions an extremely old phoenix commits itself to the flames, or a worm emerges from its body and is developed into a new phoenix by the sun's heat. Another version has the phoenix build a pyre of spices, settle on it, die and rise again. In the Indian version reported by Philostratus, the phoenix being consumed in its nest sings funeral strains for itself.

The Latin name phoenix comes from the Greek word φοῖνιξ. The earliest clear mention in Greek literature is in a fragment attributed to Hesiod, in which the phoenix outlives nine ravens. Scholars note that the phoenix is often shown with a halo emphasising its link to the Sun, that the solar bird Bennu, venerated at Heliopolis, is similar in some respects, and that sources give no clear consensus on its exact colouring.

The Chinese fenghuang is usually translated as phoenix, but The Met says it is a distinct mythical species with a different set of associations, said to appear only in times of peace and prosperity.

literal_meaning.id: Kata Yunani ini kemungkinan pinjaman dari kata Semit Barat untuk madder, pewarna merah; kata Yunani Mikene po-ni-ke kemungkinan berarti "griffin" atau mungkin "pohon palem".
literal_meaning.en: The Greek word is probably a borrowing from a West Semitic word for madder, a red dye; the Mycenaean Greek po-ni-ke probably meant "griffin" or perhaps "palm tree".

claims_provenance.quote: Herodotus, Histories 2. 73 (trans. Godley) ... I myself have never seen it, only pictures of it; for the bird seldom comes into Aigyptos (Egypt) : once in five hundred years, as the people of Heliopolis say.

claim.id: Dalam kisah Herodotus, phoenix membawa jasad induknya dari Arabia ke kuil matahari dalam balutan mur.
claim.en: In Herodotus's account, the phoenix carries its parent's body from Arabia to a sun temple wrapped in myrrh.

claims_provenance.quote: Herodotus, Histories 2. 73 (trans. Godley) ... Flying from Arabia to the temple of the Helios (the Sun), they say, he conveys his father encased in myrrh and buries him at the temple of Helios [i.e. in the temple of the Egyptian god Ra].

claim.id: Ovid mengisahkan phoenix kecil lahir kembali dari jasad induknya.
claim.en: Ovid says a young phoenix is reborn from its parent's body.

claims_provenance.quote: Ovid, Metamorphoses 15. 385 ff (trans. Melville) ... Then from his father's body is reborn a little Phoenix, so they say, to live the same long years.

claim.id: Menurut kisah yang lebih populer di zaman modern, phoenix yang mencapai usia sangat tua (ada yang menyebut 500 tahun, ada yang 1461 tahun) menyerahkan dirinya ke api.
claim.en: According to a story that has gained more currency in modern times, the phoenix, on reaching a very old age (some say 500 and others 1461 years), committed itself to the flames.

claims_provenance.quote: According to a story which has gained more currency in modern times, Phoenix, when he arrived at a very old age (some say 500 and others 1461 years), committed himself to the flames.

claim.id: Fenghuang Tiongkok sering diterjemahkan 'phoenix', tetapi menurut The Met merupakan makhluk mitos yang berbeda.
claim.en: Chinese fenghuang is often translated 'phoenix' but is a distinct mythical bird.

claims_provenance.quote: Though usually translated as “phoenix” in English, the fenghuang bird is a distinct mythical species with a different set of associations.
claims_provenance.source_citation: The Metropolitan Museum of Art — Panel with five phoenixes in a garden

claim.id: Fenghuang dikisahkan muncul pada masa damai dan makmur, berbeda dari kisah kelahiran ulang phoenix.
claim.en: The fenghuang is said to appear in times of peace and prosperity.

claims_provenance.quote: The fenghuang, most noble of all feathered species, is said to appear only in times of peace and prosperity, so the creature is depicted frequently in works commissioned by imperial courts.
claims_provenance.source_citation: The Metropolitan Museum of Art — Panel with five phoenixes in a garden

claim.id: Menurut Herodotus, jika gambarnya benar, bulu phoenix sebagian keemasan dan sebagian merah, dan bentuk serta ukurannya paling mirip elang.
claim.en: According to Herodotus, if the picture is accurate, the phoenix has partly golden and partly red plumage and is most like an eagle in shape and size.

claims_provenance.quote: Herodotus, Histories 2. 73 (trans. Godley) ... If the picture truly shows his size and appearance, his plumage is partly golden and partly red. He is most like an eagle in shape and size.

claim.id: Menurut Ovidius, hanya satu burung yang memperbarui dan melahirkan dirinya sendiri, yaitu phoenix dari Asyur, yang makan minyak balsam dan air mata kemenyan.
claim.en: According to Ovid, one bird alone renews and re-begets itself, the Phoenix of Assyria, which feeds on balsam oil and the tears of frankincense.

claims_provenance.quote: Ovid, Metamorphoses 15. 385 ff (trans. Melville) ... But one alone, a bird, renews and re-begets itself--the Phoenix of Assyria, which feeds not upon seeds or verdure but the oils of balsam and the tears of frankincense.

claim.id: Dalam uraian Ovidius, phoenix membangun sarang di puncak pohon palem, melapisinya dengan kasia, narwastu, mur, dan serpihan kayu manis, lalu mengakhiri hidupnya di sana.
claim.en: In Ovid's account the phoenix builds a nest high on a palm, lines it with cassia, spikenard, myrrh and cinnamon, and ends its life there.

claims_provenance.quote: Ovid, Metamorphoses 15. 385 ff (trans. Melville) ... builds a nest high on a lofty swaying palm; and lines the nest with cassia and spikenard and golden myrrh and shreds of cinnamon

claim.id: Dalam uraian Ovidius, phoenix muda membawa sarang itu melintasi langit ke kota Matahari (Heliopolis di Mesir) dan meletakkannya di depan pintu kuil Matahari.
claim.en: In Ovid's account the young phoenix carries the nest across the sky to the Sun's city (Heliopolis in Egypt) and lays it before the doors of the Sun's temple.

claims_provenance.quote: Ovid, Metamorphoses 15. 385 ff (trans. Melville) ... carries it across the sky to reach the Sun's great city [i.e. Heliopolis in Egypt], and before the doors of the Sun's holy temple lays it down.

claim.id: Dalam Philostratus, tokoh Iarkhas menyebut phoenix memancarkan sinar matahari, bercahaya keemasan, mirip elang, dan bertengger di sarang dari rempah di mata air Sungai Nil.
claim.en: In Philostratus the sage Iarchas says the phoenix gives out rays of sunlight, shines with gold, resembles an eagle, and sits on a spice nest it makes at the springs of the Nile.

claims_provenance.quote: Philostratus, Life of Apollonius of Tyana 3. 49 (trans. Conybeare) ... he [the Indian sage Iarkhas (Iarchas) C1st A.D.] said ... it is unique in that it gives out rays of sunlight and shines with gold, in size and appearance like an eagle; and it sits upon the nest; which is made by it at the springs of the Nile out of spices.
claims_provenance.locator: Philostratus, Life of Apollonius of Tyana 3.49 (trans. Conybeare)

claim.id: Menurut kisah India dalam Philostratus, phoenix yang terbakar di sarangnya menyanyikan lagu duka bagi dirinya sendiri.
claim.en: In the Indian version reported by Philostratus, the phoenix being consumed in its nest sings funeral strains for itself.

claims_provenance.quote: Philostratus, Life of Apollonius of Tyana 3. 49 (trans. Conybeare) ... The story of the Aigyptoi (Egyptians) about it, that it comes to Aigyptos, is testified to by the Indians also, but the latter add this touch to the story, that the Phoinix which is being consumed in its nest sings funeral strains for itself.
claims_provenance.locator: Philostratus, Life of Apollonius of Tyana 3.49 (trans. Conybeare)

claim.id: Menurut Claudianus, phoenix tidak butuh makanan atau minuman; sinar matahari adalah makanannya dan percikan laut minumannya.
claim.en: According to Claudian, the phoenix needs no food or drink; the sun's beam is its food and the sea's spray its drink.

claims_provenance.quote: Claudian, The Phoenix ... It needs no food to satisfy hunger nor any drink to quench thirst; the sun's clear beam is its food, the sea's rare spray its drink

claim.id: Menurut Claudianus, burung ini tidak pernah dikandung dan tidak berasal dari benih fana; ia sekaligus ayah dan putranya sendiri.
claim.en: According to Claudian, this bird was never conceived and springs from no mortal seed; it is both its own father and son.

claims_provenance.quote: Claudian, The Phoenix ... Never was this bird conceived nor springs it from any mortal seed, itself is alike its own father and son

claim.id: Menurut Aelianus, phoenix mampu menghitung lima ratus tahun tanpa ilmu hitung karena ia murid alam yang mahabijak.
claim.en: According to Aelian, the phoenix can reckon five hundred years without arithmetic, being a pupil of all-wise nature.

claims_provenance.quote: Aelian, On Animals 6. 58 (trans. Scholfield) ... The Phoinix (Phoenix) knows how to reckon five hundred years without the aid of arithmetic, for it is a pupil of all-wise nature

claim.en: In one account the phoenix builds a nest in Arabia and gives it the power of generation, so that a new phoenix rises from it after the bird's death.

claims_provenance.quote: he built a nest for himself in Arabia, to which he imparted the power of generation, so that after his death a new phoenix rose out of it.
claims_provenance.locator: Encyclopedia entry (Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology)

claim.id: Versi lain menyebut hanya satu phoenix hidup pada satu waktu, dan saat ia mati seekor cacing keluar dari tubuhnya lalu menjadi phoenix baru oleh panas matahari.
claim.en: Another version says only one phoenix lived at a time, and when it died a worm crept from its body and was developed into a new phoenix by the sun's heat.

claims_provenance.quote: Others, again, state that only one Phoenix lived at a time, and that when he died a worm crept forth from his body, and was developed into a new Phoenix by the heat of the sun.
claims_provenance.locator: Encyclopedia entry (Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology)

claim.id: Versi lain menyebut phoenix membangun timbunan rempah, duduk di atasnya, lalu mati; dari tubuhnya yang membusuk ia bangkit kembali.
claim.en: Another version says the phoenix built a pyre of spices, settled on it and died, then rose again from the decomposing body.

claims_provenance.quote: he built for himself a funeral pile, consisting of spices, settled upon it, and died. Out of the decomposing body he then rose again
claims_provenance.locator: Encyclopedia entry (Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology)

claim.id: Kisah serupa tentang burung ajaib juga ada di Timur, misalnya burung Simorg di Persia dan burung Semendar di India.
claim.en: Similar stories of marvellous birds occur in the East, such as the bird Simorg in Persia and the bird Semendar in India.

claims_provenance.quote: Similar stories of marvellous birds occur in many parts of the East, as in Persia, the legend of the bird Simorg, and in India of the bird Semendar.

claim.id: Phoenix baru membungkus induknya dalam telur mur dan membawanya ke kuil besar dewa Matahari di Heliopolis, Mesir.
claim.en: The new phoenix encases its parent in an egg of myrrh and conveys it to the great Egyptian temple of the Sun-God at Heliopolis.

claims_provenance.quote: It then encased its parent in an egg of myrrh and conveyed it to the great Egyptian temple of the Sun-God in Heliopolis.

claim.id: Phoenix adalah burung legendaris yang abadi dan secara berulang memperbarui diri atau lahir kembali; berasal dari mitologi Yunani dan memiliki padanan di banyak budaya.
claim.en: The phoenix is a legendary immortal bird that cyclically regenerates or is otherwise born again; it originates in Greek mythology and has analogues in many cultures.

claims_provenance.quote: The phoenix is a legendary immortal bird that cyclically regenerates or is otherwise born again. Originating in Greek mythology, it has analogues in many cultures, such as Egyptian and Persian mythology.

claim.id: Phoenix dikaitkan dengan Matahari dan memperoleh hidup baru dengan bangkit dari abu pendahulunya.

claims_provenance.quote: Associated with the Sun, a phoenix obtains new life by rising from the ashes of its predecessor.

claim.id: Kata Latin phoenix berasal dari kata Yunani φοῖνιξ (phoinix), yang pertama kali tercatat dalam bahasa Yunani Mikene sebagai po-ni-ke, kemungkinan berarti "griffin" atau mungkin "pohon palem".
claim.en: The Latin word comes from Greek φοῖνιξ (phoinix), first attested in Mycenaean Greek as po-ni-ke, which probably meant "griffin" though it might have meant "palm tree".

claims_provenance.quote: The Latin word comes from Greek φοῖνιξ (phoinix). The Greek word is first attested in the Mycenaean Greek po-ni-ke, which probably meant "griffin", though it might have meant "palm tree".

claim.id: Kata Yunani itu kemungkinan pinjaman dari kata Semit Barat untuk madder, pewarna merah dari Rubia tinctorum.

claims_provenance.quote: That word is probably a borrowing from a West Semitic word for madder, a red dye made from Rubia tinctorum.

claim.id: Penyebutan phoenix yang paling awal dan jelas dalam sastra Yunani kuno ada pada fragmen Precepts of Chiron yang dikaitkan dengan penyair Hesiodos dari abad ke-8 SM.
claim.en: The earliest clear mention of the phoenix in ancient Greek literature occurs in a fragment of the Precepts of Chiron, attributed to the 8th-century BC poet Hesiod.

claims_provenance.quote: the earliest clear mention of the phoenix in ancient Greek literature occurs in a fragment of the Precepts of Chiron, attributed to 8th-century BC Greek poet Hesiod.

claim.id: Dalam fragmen itu, phoenix hidup lebih lama daripada sembilan gagak, tetapi para Nimfa putri Zeus hidup lebih lama daripada sepuluh phoenix.
claim.en: In that fragment the phoenix outlives nine ravens, but the Nymphs, daughters of Zeus, outlive ten phoenixes.

claims_provenance.quote: while the phoenix outlives nine ravens, but we, the rich-haired Nymphs daughters of Zeus the aegis-holder, outlive ten phoenixes.

claim.id: Pada abad ke-19 ditemukan bahwa orang Mesir di Heliopolis memuliakan Bennu, burung matahari yang mirip phoenix Yunani dalam beberapa hal, tetapi sumber Mesirnya sering bermasalah dan dapat ditafsirkan beragam.
claim.en: In the 19th century it was found that Egyptians at Heliopolis had venerated the Bennu, a solar bird similar in some respects to the Greek phoenix, though the Egyptian sources are often problematic and open to varied interpretations.

claims_provenance.quote: the discovery that Egyptians in Heliopolis had venerated the Bennu, a solar bird similar in some respects to the Greek phoenix. However, the Egyptian sources regarding the bennu are often problematic and open to a variety of interpretations.

claim.id: Phoenix sering digambarkan dengan lingkaran cahaya dalam sastra kuno dan abad pertengahan serta seni abad pertengahan, menekankan kaitannya dengan Matahari.

claims_provenance.quote: The phoenix is often depicted in ancient and medieval literature and medieval art endowed with a halo, emphasising the bird's connection with the Sun.

claim.id: Phoenix umumnya dipercaya berwarna-warni, tetapi sumber-sumber tidak sepakat soal warna persisnya.

claims_provenance.quote: Although the phoenix was generally believed to be colourful and vibrant, sources provide no clear consensus about its exact colouration.

text.id: Tercatat dalam sastra Yunani sejak fragmen yang dikaitkan dengan Hesiodos (abad ke-8 SM)
text.en: Recorded in Greek literature from a fragment attributed to Hesiod (8th century BC)

short_description.id: Phoenix adalah burung legendaris berbulu merah keemasan dari mitologi Yunani yang memperbarui diri atau terlahir kembali dari pendahulunya, dan dikaitkan dengan Matahari.
short_description.en: The phoenix is a legendary red-and-gold bird of Greek mythology that renews itself or is reborn from its predecessor, and is associated with the Sun.

long_description.id: Phoenix adalah burung legendaris yang abadi dan terus memperbarui diri atau terlahir kembali; ia berasal dari mitologi Yunani dan punya padanan di banyak budaya. Ia digambarkan berbulu merah keemasan dan memancarkan sinar matahari, hidup lima ratus tahun menurut satu uraian, dan memakan balsam dan kemenyan Arabia. Herodotus menulis bahwa ia hanya pernah melihat gambarnya dan bahwa bulunya sebagian keemasan, sebagian merah, dengan bentuk dan ukuran seperti elang. Philostratus menyebut ia mirip elang, bersinar keemasan, dan bersarang dari rempah di mata air Sungai Nil, sedangkan Claudianus menyebutnya sekaligus ayah dan putranya sendiri.
long_description.en: The phoenix is a legendary immortal bird that cyclically renews itself or is reborn; it originates in Greek mythology and has analogues in many cultures. It is portrayed with red-and-gold feathers that emit rays of sunlight, living five hundred years in one account and feeding on Arabian balsam and frankincense. Herodotus wrote that he had seen it only in pictures and that its plumage is partly golden and partly red, with the shape and size of an eagle. Philostratus likens it to an eagle that shines with gold and nests on spices at the springs of the Nile, while Claudian calls it its own father and son.

long_description.id: Kisah tentang pergantian generasinya berbeda-beda. Menurut cerita yang didengar Herodotus, burung baru membawa jasad induknya terbungkus mur dari Arabia ke kuil Matahari di Heliopolis. Ovidius menulis bahwa phoenix membangun sarang di puncak palem dan burung kecil terlahir dari tubuh induknya, lalu membawa sarang itu ke kota Matahari. Dalam versi lain, phoenix yang sangat tua menyerahkan dirinya pada api, atau seekor cacing keluar dari tubuhnya dan tumbuh menjadi phoenix baru oleh panas matahari. Ada pula versi yang menyebut phoenix membangun timbunan rempah, duduk di atasnya, lalu mati dan bangkit kembali. Menurut kisah India dalam Philostratus, phoenix yang terbakar di sarangnya menyanyikan lagu duka bagi dirinya sendiri.
long_description.en: Accounts of its renewal differ. In the story Herodotus heard, the new bird carries its parent's body wrapped in myrrh from Arabia to the temple of the Sun at Heliopolis. Ovid wrote that the phoenix builds a nest on a palm and a small bird is reborn from the parent's body, then carries the nest to the Sun's city. In other versions an extremely old phoenix commits itself to the flames, or a worm emerges from its body and is developed into a new phoenix by the sun's heat. Another version has the phoenix build a pyre of spices, settle on it, die and rise again. In the Indian version reported by Philostratus, the phoenix being consumed in its nest sings funeral strains for itself.

long_description.id: Nama Latin phoenix berasal dari kata Yunani φοῖνιξ. Penyebutan paling awal yang jelas dalam sastra Yunani ada pada fragmen yang dikaitkan dengan Hesiodos, yang menyebut phoenix hidup lebih lama daripada sembilan gagak. Para sarjana mencatat bahwa phoenix sering digambarkan berlingkar cahaya untuk menekankan kaitannya dengan Matahari, bahwa burung matahari Bennu yang dimuliakan di Heliopolis mirip dalam beberapa hal, dan bahwa sumber tidak sepakat soal warna pastinya.
long_description.en: The Latin name phoenix comes from the Greek word φοῖνιξ. The earliest clear mention in Greek literature is in a fragment attributed to Hesiod, in which the phoenix outlives nine ravens. Scholars note that the phoenix is often shown with a halo emphasising its link to the Sun, that the solar bird Bennu, venerated at Heliopolis, is similar in some respects, and that sources give no clear consensus on its exact colouring.

long_description.id: Fenghuang Tiongkok sering diterjemahkan sebagai phoenix, tetapi The Met menyatakan fenghuang adalah spesies mitos tersendiri dengan rangkaian makna berbeda, dan dikatakan muncul hanya pada masa damai dan makmur.
long_description.en: The Chinese fenghuang is usually translated as phoenix, but The Met says it is a distinct mythical species with a different set of associations, said to appear only in times of peace and prosperity.

literal_meaning.id: Kata Yunani ini kemungkinan pinjaman dari kata Semit Barat untuk madder, pewarna merah; kata Yunani Mikene po-ni-ke kemungkinan berarti "griffin" atau mungkin "pohon palem".
literal_meaning.en: The Greek word is probably a borrowing from a West Semitic word for madder, a red dye; the Mycenaean Greek po-ni-ke probably meant "griffin" or perhaps "palm tree".

summary.en: In Ovid the phoenix builds a nest on a palm, ends its life there and is reborn as a small bird that later carries the nest to the Sun's temple.

claims.quote: THE PHOINIX (Phoenix) was a fabulous, red-gold feathered bird whose body emitted rays of pure sunlight.

statement.id: Phoenix adalah burung legendaris berbulu merah keemasan dan bercahaya.
statement.en: The phoenix is a legendary red-and-gold bird that radiates sunlight.

claims.quote: The creature lived for five hundred years and feasted upon Arabian balsalm and frankinsense.

statement.id: Dalam satu uraian phoenix hidup lima ratus tahun dan memakan balsam serta kemenyan Arab.
statement.en: One account gives the phoenix a five-hundred-year life and a diet of Arabian balsam and frankincense.

claims.quote: When it died a new Phoinix emerged fully-grown from its body.

statement.id: Saat phoenix mati, phoenix baru muncul dari tubuhnya.
statement.en: When a phoenix dies, a new one emerges from its body.

claims.quote: Herodotus, Histories 2. 73 (trans. Godley) ... I myself have never seen it, only pictures of it; for the bird seldom comes into Aigyptos (Egypt) : once in five hundred years, as the people of Heliopolis say.

statement.id: Herodotus menulis bahwa ia tidak pernah melihat phoenix dan hanya mengenalnya dari gambar.
statement.en: Herodotus said he had never seen a phoenix, only pictures of it.

claims.quote: Herodotus, Histories 2. 73 (trans. Godley) ... Flying from Arabia to the temple of the Helios (the Sun), they say, he conveys his father encased in myrrh and buries him at the temple of Helios [i.e. in the temple of the Egyptian god Ra].

statement.id: Dalam kisah Herodotus, phoenix membawa jasad induknya dari Arabia ke kuil matahari dalam balutan mur.
statement.en: In Herodotus's account, the phoenix carries its parent's body from Arabia to a sun temple wrapped in myrrh.

claims.quote: Ovid, Metamorphoses 15. 385 ff (trans. Melville) ... Then from his father's body is reborn a little Phoenix, so they say, to live the same long years.

statement.id: Ovid mengisahkan phoenix kecil lahir kembali dari jasad induknya.
statement.en: Ovid says a young phoenix is reborn from its parent's body.

claims.quote: According to a story which has gained more currency in modern times, Phoenix, when he arrived at a very old age (some say 500 and others 1461 years), committed himself to the flames.

statement.id: Menurut kisah yang lebih populer di zaman modern, phoenix yang mencapai usia sangat tua (ada yang menyebut 500 tahun, ada yang 1461 tahun) menyerahkan dirinya ke api.
statement.en: According to a story that has gained more currency in modern times, the phoenix, on reaching a very old age (some say 500 and others 1461 years), committed itself to the flames.

claims.quote: Though usually translated as “phoenix” in English, the fenghuang bird is a distinct mythical species with a different set of associations.

statement.id: Fenghuang Tiongkok sering diterjemahkan 'phoenix', tetapi menurut The Met merupakan makhluk mitos yang berbeda.
statement.en: Chinese fenghuang is often translated 'phoenix' but is a distinct mythical bird.

claims.quote: The fenghuang, most noble of all feathered species, is said to appear only in times of peace and prosperity, so the creature is depicted frequently in works commissioned by imperial courts.

statement.id: Fenghuang dikisahkan muncul pada masa damai dan makmur, berbeda dari kisah kelahiran ulang phoenix.
statement.en: The fenghuang is said to appear in times of peace and prosperity.

claims.quote: Herodotus, Histories 2. 73 (trans. Godley) ... If the picture truly shows his size and appearance, his plumage is partly golden and partly red. He is most like an eagle in shape and size.

statement.id: Menurut Herodotus, jika gambarnya benar, bulu phoenix sebagian keemasan dan sebagian merah, dan bentuk serta ukurannya paling mirip elang.
statement.en: According to Herodotus, if the picture is accurate, the phoenix has partly golden and partly red plumage and is most like an eagle in shape and size.

claims.quote: Ovid, Metamorphoses 15. 385 ff (trans. Melville) ... But one alone, a bird, renews and re-begets itself--the Phoenix of Assyria, which feeds not upon seeds or verdure but the oils of balsam and the tears of frankincense.

statement.id: Menurut Ovidius, hanya satu burung yang memperbarui dan melahirkan dirinya sendiri, yaitu phoenix dari Asyur, yang makan minyak balsam dan air mata kemenyan.
statement.en: According to Ovid, one bird alone renews and re-begets itself, the Phoenix of Assyria, which feeds on balsam oil and the tears of frankincense.

claims.quote: Ovid, Metamorphoses 15. 385 ff (trans. Melville) ... builds a nest high on a lofty swaying palm; and lines the nest with cassia and spikenard and golden myrrh and shreds of cinnamon

statement.id: Dalam uraian Ovidius, phoenix membangun sarang di puncak pohon palem, melapisinya dengan kasia, narwastu, mur, dan serpihan kayu manis, lalu mengakhiri hidupnya di sana.
statement.en: In Ovid's account the phoenix builds a nest high on a palm, lines it with cassia, spikenard, myrrh and cinnamon, and ends its life there.

claims.quote: Ovid, Metamorphoses 15. 385 ff (trans. Melville) ... carries it across the sky to reach the Sun's great city [i.e. Heliopolis in Egypt], and before the doors of the Sun's holy temple lays it down.

statement.id: Dalam uraian Ovidius, phoenix muda membawa sarang itu melintasi langit ke kota Matahari (Heliopolis di Mesir) dan meletakkannya di depan pintu kuil Matahari.
statement.en: In Ovid's account the young phoenix carries the nest across the sky to the Sun's city (Heliopolis in Egypt) and lays it before the doors of the Sun's temple.

claims.quote: Philostratus, Life of Apollonius of Tyana 3. 49 (trans. Conybeare) ... he [the Indian sage Iarkhas (Iarchas) C1st A.D.] said ... it is unique in that it gives out rays of sunlight and shines with gold, in size and appearance like an eagle; and it sits upon the nest; which is made by it at the springs of the Nile out of spices.

statement.id: Dalam Philostratus, tokoh Iarkhas menyebut phoenix memancarkan sinar matahari, bercahaya keemasan, mirip elang, dan bertengger di sarang dari rempah di mata air Sungai Nil.
statement.en: In Philostratus the sage Iarchas says the phoenix gives out rays of sunlight, shines with gold, resembles an eagle, and sits on a spice nest it makes at the springs of the Nile.

claims.quote: Philostratus, Life of Apollonius of Tyana 3. 49 (trans. Conybeare) ... The story of the Aigyptoi (Egyptians) about it, that it comes to Aigyptos, is testified to by the Indians also, but the latter add this touch to the story, that the Phoinix which is being consumed in its nest sings funeral strains for itself.
claims.locator: Philostratus, Life of Apollonius of Tyana 3.49 (trans. Conybeare)

statement.id: Menurut kisah India dalam Philostratus, phoenix yang terbakar di sarangnya menyanyikan lagu duka bagi dirinya sendiri.
statement.en: In the Indian version reported by Philostratus, the phoenix being consumed in its nest sings funeral strains for itself.

claims.quote: Claudian, The Phoenix ... It needs no food to satisfy hunger nor any drink to quench thirst; the sun's clear beam is its food, the sea's rare spray its drink

statement.id: Menurut Claudianus, phoenix tidak butuh makanan atau minuman; sinar matahari adalah makanannya dan percikan laut minumannya.
statement.en: According to Claudian, the phoenix needs no food or drink; the sun's beam is its food and the sea's spray its drink.

claims.quote: Claudian, The Phoenix ... Never was this bird conceived nor springs it from any mortal seed, itself is alike its own father and son

statement.id: Menurut Claudianus, burung ini tidak pernah dikandung dan tidak berasal dari benih fana; ia sekaligus ayah dan putranya sendiri.
statement.en: According to Claudian, this bird was never conceived and springs from no mortal seed; it is both its own father and son.

alternate_names.name: He Who is in the Place of Embalming

short_description.id: Anubis adalah dewa Mesir kuno untuk mumifikasi, ritus pemakaman, dan penjagaan makam, serta pemandu jiwa ke alam baka; ia digambarkan sebagai kanid hitam atau pria berkepala jakal.
short_description.en: Anubis is the ancient Egyptian god of mummification, funerary rites, and the guarding of tombs, and a guide of souls to the afterlife; he is depicted as a black canine or a jackal-headed man.

long_description.id:
Anubis (juga dikenal sebagai Inpu, Inpw, dan Anpu) adalah dewa Mesir untuk mumifikasi, ritus pemakaman, penjaga makam, dan pemandu ke alam baka, sekaligus dewa pelindung jiwa tersesat dan orang tak berdaya. Namanya adalah bentuk Yunani dari Anpu atau Inpu, yang berarti "membusuk". Ia salah satu dewa tertua Mesir dan kemungkinan berkembang dari dewa jakal Wepwawet, yang sering tertukar dengannya.

Anubis digambarkan sebagai kanid hitam, persilangan jakal dan anjing bertelinga runcing, atau pria berotot berkepala jakal. Warna hitam dipilih karena maknanya, melambangkan pembusukan tubuh sekaligus tanah subur Nil. Sebuah arca memperlihatkannya sepenuhnya sebagai jakal, dan gambaran populernya adalah pria berkepala jakal yang memegang timbangan emas untuk menimbang hati terhadap bulu kebenaran. Salima Ikram menduga ia digambarkan sebagai "super-kanid", bukan sekadar jakal atau anjing.

Sebelum Osiris bangkit pada Kerajaan Tengah, Anubis dikenal sebagai "Yang Pertama di antara Orang Barat", raja orang mati, dan pada Periode Dinasti Awal serta Kerajaan Lama ia satu-satunya Penguasa Orang Mati. Seiring mitos Osiris makin populer, Osiris mengambil semakin banyak atributnya, dan Anubis menjadi pelindung serta "tangan kanan" Osiris yang menjaga jasadnya, mengawasi mumifikasi, dan membantu penghakiman jiwa. Pada adegan penghakiman ia menimbang hati terhadap sosok dewi Ma'at, dan ia disebut membantu menghakimi orang mati serta menghukum pelanggar makam bersama pasukan utusannya.

Dalam kisah yang tercatat pada milenium pertama SM, Set menyamar sebagai macan tutul untuk mendekati jasad Osiris, lalu ditangkap Anubis dan dicap dengan besi panas; Anubis kemudian menguliti Set dan mengenakan kulitnya sebagai peringatan. Anubis juga diseru untuk perlindungan dan pembalasan, termasuk menegakkan kutukan atau menangkal kutukan. Putrinya, Qebhet, membawa air sejuk bagi jiwa orang mati di Balai Kebenaran.

Pada masa awal Anubis dianggap putra Ra dan Hesat, tetapi setelah diserap ke dalam mitos Osiris ia dianggap putra Osiris dan Nephthys. Dalam kisah ini Nephthys hamil dengan Anubis, meninggalkannya setelah lahir karena takut Set mengetahuinya, dan Isis kemudian menemukan serta mengangkatnya sebagai anak. Plutarch mencatat bahwa anak itu menjadi pengawal dan pengikut Isis dan dikabarkan menjaga para dewa seperti anjing menjaga manusia.

Pusat kultus Anubis berada di Cynopolis, "kota anjing", di Mesir Hulu, dan para pendetanya sering memakai topeng kayu sang dewa dalam ritual. Ia menjadi dewa pelindung para pembalsem, yang kadang mengenakan topeng berbentuk kepalanya. Orang Yunani mengaitkannya dengan Hermes, dan Plutarch menilai kekuasaannya mirip dengan Hecate. Sumber menyebut bahwa meski banyak tampil dalam seni, Anubis tidak berperan besar dalam banyak mitos.
long_description.en:
Anubis (known also as Inpu, Inpw, and Anpu) is the Egyptian deity of mummification and funerary rites. He guards tombs, guides the dead into the afterlife, and is also the patron of lost souls and the helpless. His name is the Greek form of Anpu or Inpu, which meant "to decay". He is one of the oldest Egyptian gods and most likely developed from the jackal god Wepwawet, with whom he is often confused.

Anubis is portrayed as a black canine, as a hybrid of jackal and dog with pointed ears, or as a muscular man whose head is that of a jackal. The color black was chosen for its meaning, symbolizing the decay of the body and the fertile soil of the Nile. One statue shows him wholly as a jackal, and his popular image is a jackal-headed man holding golden scales to weigh a heart against the feather of truth. Salima Ikram suggests he is represented as a "super-canid" rather than merely a jackal or a dog.

Before the rise of Osiris in the Middle Kingdom, Anubis was known as "First of the Westerners", king of the dead, and in the Early Dynastic Period and Old Kingdom he was the sole Lord of the Dead. As the Osiris myth grew more popular, Osiris took on more of his attributes, and Anubis became Osiris' protector and "right-hand man", guarding his body, overseeing the mummification, and assisting in the judgement of souls. In judgment scenes he weighs the heart against a figure of the goddess Ma'at, and he is said to help judge the dead and to punish violators of tombs with his army of messengers.

In a story recorded in the first millennium BCE, Set disguises himself as a leopard to approach the body of Osiris and is seized by Anubis and branded with a hot iron; Anubis then flays Set and wears his skin as a warning. Anubis was also called upon for protection and vengeance, including enforcing curses or defending against them. His daughter, Qebhet, offers cool water to the souls of the dead gathered in the Hall of Truth.

At an earlier stage Anubis was regarded as the child of Ra and Hesat, but once he was absorbed into the Osiris myth he was held to be the child of Osiris and Nephthys. In this story Nephthys becomes pregnant with Anubis and abandons him after his birth for fear that Set will find out; Isis later finds and adopts him. Plutarch records that the child became Isis's guard and follower and is reported to guard the gods as dogs do men.

The cult center of Anubis was at Cynopolis, "the city of the dog", in Upper Egypt, and his priests often wore wooden masks of the god in rituals. He became the patron god of embalmers, who sometimes wore masks shaped like his head. The Greeks associated him with Hermes, and Plutarch judges his power to be much like that of Hecate. The source notes that although he appears widely in art, Anubis does not play a major role in many myths.

alternate_names.name: He Who is in the Place of Embalming

text.id: Gambarnya terlihat pada makam kerajaan sejak Dinasti Pertama Mesir (sekitar 3150–2890 SM); ia diperkirakan muncul pada Periode Pradinasti (sekitar 6000–3150 SM).
text.en: His image is seen on royal tombs from the First Dynasty of Egypt (c. 3150-2890 BCE); he is thought to have developed in the Predynastic Period (c. 6000-3150 BCE).

short_description.id: Anubis adalah dewa Mesir kuno untuk mumifikasi, ritus pemakaman, dan penjagaan makam, serta pemandu jiwa ke alam baka; ia digambarkan sebagai kanid hitam atau pria berkepala jakal.
short_description.en: Anubis is the ancient Egyptian god of mummification, funerary rites, and the guarding of tombs, and a guide of souls to the afterlife; he is depicted as a black canine or a jackal-headed man.

long_description.id: Anubis (juga dikenal sebagai Inpu, Inpw, dan Anpu) adalah dewa Mesir untuk mumifikasi, ritus pemakaman, penjaga makam, dan pemandu ke alam baka, sekaligus dewa pelindung jiwa tersesat dan orang tak berdaya. Namanya adalah bentuk Yunani dari Anpu atau Inpu, yang berarti "membusuk". Ia salah satu dewa tertua Mesir dan kemungkinan berkembang dari dewa jakal Wepwawet, yang sering tertukar dengannya.
long_description.en: Anubis (known also as Inpu, Inpw, and Anpu) is the Egyptian deity of mummification and funerary rites. He guards tombs, guides the dead into the afterlife, and is also the patron of lost souls and the helpless. His name is the Greek form of Anpu or Inpu, which meant "to decay". He is one of the oldest Egyptian gods and most likely developed from the jackal god Wepwawet, with whom he is often confused.

long_description.id: Anubis digambarkan sebagai kanid hitam, persilangan jakal dan anjing bertelinga runcing, atau pria berotot berkepala jakal. Warna hitam dipilih karena maknanya, melambangkan pembusukan tubuh sekaligus tanah subur Nil. Sebuah arca memperlihatkannya sepenuhnya sebagai jakal, dan gambaran populernya adalah pria berkepala jakal yang memegang timbangan emas untuk menimbang hati terhadap bulu kebenaran. Salima Ikram menduga ia digambarkan sebagai "super-kanid", bukan sekadar jakal atau anjing.
long_description.en: Anubis is portrayed as a black canine, as a hybrid of jackal and dog with pointed ears, or as a muscular man whose head is that of a jackal. The color black was chosen for its meaning, symbolizing the decay of the body and the fertile soil of the Nile. One statue shows him wholly as a jackal, and his popular image is a jackal-headed man holding golden scales to weigh a heart against the feather of truth. Salima Ikram suggests he is represented as a "super-canid" rather than merely a jackal or a dog.

long_description.id: Sebelum Osiris bangkit pada Kerajaan Tengah, Anubis dikenal sebagai "Yang Pertama di antara Orang Barat", raja orang mati, dan pada Periode Dinasti Awal serta Kerajaan Lama ia satu-satunya Penguasa Orang Mati. Seiring mitos Osiris makin populer, Osiris mengambil semakin banyak atributnya, dan Anubis menjadi pelindung serta "tangan kanan" Osiris yang menjaga jasadnya, mengawasi mumifikasi, dan membantu penghakiman jiwa. Pada adegan penghakiman ia menimbang hati terhadap sosok dewi Ma'at, dan ia disebut membantu menghakimi orang mati serta menghukum pelanggar makam bersama pasukan utusannya.
long_description.en: Before the rise of Osiris in the Middle Kingdom, Anubis was known as "First of the Westerners", king of the dead, and in the Early Dynastic Period and Old Kingdom he was the sole Lord of the Dead. As the Osiris myth grew more popular, Osiris took on more of his attributes, and Anubis became Osiris' protector and "right-hand man", guarding his body, overseeing the mummification, and assisting in the judgement of souls. In judgment scenes he weighs the heart against a figure of the goddess Ma'at, and he is said to help judge the dead and to punish violators of tombs with his army of messengers.

long_description.id: Dalam kisah yang tercatat pada milenium pertama SM, Set menyamar sebagai macan tutul untuk mendekati jasad Osiris, lalu ditangkap Anubis dan dicap dengan besi panas; Anubis kemudian menguliti Set dan mengenakan kulitnya sebagai peringatan. Anubis juga diseru untuk perlindungan dan pembalasan, termasuk menegakkan kutukan atau menangkal kutukan. Putrinya, Qebhet, membawa air sejuk bagi jiwa orang mati di Balai Kebenaran.
long_description.en: In a story recorded in the first millennium BCE, Set disguises himself as a leopard to approach the body of Osiris and is seized by Anubis and branded with a hot iron; Anubis then flays Set and wears his skin as a warning. Anubis was also called upon for protection and vengeance, including enforcing curses or defending against them. His daughter, Qebhet, offers cool water to the souls of the dead gathered in the Hall of Truth.

long_description.id: Pada masa awal Anubis dianggap putra Ra dan Hesat, tetapi setelah diserap ke dalam mitos Osiris ia dianggap putra Osiris dan Nephthys. Dalam kisah ini Nephthys hamil dengan Anubis, meninggalkannya setelah lahir karena takut Set mengetahuinya, dan Isis kemudian menemukan serta mengangkatnya sebagai anak. Plutarch mencatat bahwa anak itu menjadi pengawal dan pengikut Isis dan dikabarkan menjaga para dewa seperti anjing menjaga manusia.
long_description.en: At an earlier stage Anubis was regarded as the child of Ra and Hesat, but once he was absorbed into the Osiris myth he was held to be the child of Osiris and Nephthys. In this story Nephthys becomes pregnant with Anubis and abandons him after his birth for fear that Set will find out; Isis later finds and adopts him. Plutarch records that the child became Isis's guard and follower and is reported to guard the gods as dogs do men.

long_description.id: Pusat kultus Anubis berada di Cynopolis, "kota anjing", di Mesir Hulu, dan para pendetanya sering memakai topeng kayu sang dewa dalam ritual. Ia menjadi dewa pelindung para pembalsem, yang kadang mengenakan topeng berbentuk kepalanya. Orang Yunani mengaitkannya dengan Hermes, dan Plutarch menilai kekuasaannya mirip dengan Hecate. Sumber menyebut bahwa meski banyak tampil dalam seni, Anubis tidak berperan besar dalam banyak mitos.
long_description.en: The cult center of Anubis was at Cynopolis, "the city of the dog", in Upper Egypt, and his priests often wore wooden masks of the god in rituals. He became the patron god of embalmers, who sometimes wore masks shaped like his head. The Greeks associated him with Hermes, and Plutarch judges his power to be much like that of Hecate. The source notes that although he appears widely in art, Anubis does not play a major role in many myths.

cultural_context.id: Menurut sumber, "super-kanid" Anubis memberi orang jaminan bahwa tubuh mereka akan dihormati saat mati, jiwa mereka dilindungi di alam baka, dan mereka akan menerima penghakiman yang adil.
cultural_context.en: According to the source, the "super-canid" Anubis gave people confidence that their bodies would be respected in death, their souls shielded in the afterlife, and their lives fairly judged.

literal_meaning.en: "to decay" (signifying his early association with death)

note.id: Anubis dikaitkan dengan Charon pada periode Yunani-Romawi.
note.en: Anubis became associated with Charon in the Graeco-Roman period.

learning_questions.id: Mengapa orang Mesir memilih kanid hitam sebagai wujud pelindung orang mati?
learning_questions.en: Why did the Egyptians choose a black canine as the form of the protector of the dead?

learning_questions.id: Bagaimana peran Anubis berubah ketika ia diserap ke dalam mitos Osiris?
learning_questions.en: How did the role of Anubis change when he was assimilated into the Osiris myth?
