claims.quote: Anubis (also known as Inpu, Inpw, Anpu) is the Egyptian god of mummification, funerary rites, guardian of tombs, and guide to the afterlife as well as the patron god of lost souls and the helpless.

statement.id: Anubis adalah dewa pembalseman, upacara pemakaman, penjaga makam, dan penuntun ke alam baka.
statement.en: Anubis is the Egyptian god of embalming, funerary rites, tomb protection, and guidance to the afterlife.

claims.quote: He is depicted as a black canine, a jackal-dog hybrid with pointed ears, or as a muscular man with the head of a jackal.

statement.id: Anubis digambarkan sebagai kanid hitam atau manusia berkepala jakal.
statement.en: Anubis is depicted as a black canine or a jackal-headed man.

claims.quote: The name "Anubis" is the Greek form of the Egyptian Anpu (or Inpu) which meant "to decay" signifying his early association with death.

statement.id: Nama Anubis adalah bentuk Yunani dari Anpu atau Inpu.
statement.en: Anubis is the Greek form of Egyptian Anpu or Inpu.

claims.quote: In earlier times, Anubis was considered the son of Ra and Hesat (associated with Hathor), but after his assimilation into the Osiris myth he was held to be the son of Osiris and his sister-in-law Nephthys.

statement.id: Sumber menyebut dua silsilah Anubis: putra Ra dan Hesat, atau putra Osiris dan Nephthys.
statement.en: The source gives two lineages for Anubis: son of Ra and Hesat or son of Osiris and Nephthys.

claims.quote: At the culmination of this ceremony, the heart, seen as the center of intelligence and emotion, was weighed against a squatting figure of the goddess Ma’at by the jackal-headed god of embalming, Anubis.

statement.id: Dalam adegan pengadilan, Anubis berkepala jakal menimbang hati.
statement.en: In a judgment scene, jackal-headed Anubis weighs the heart.

claims.quote: Artists represented the Egyptian god of mummification, named Anubis, with a jackal’s head. This statue shows Anubis completely in animal form, as a jackal.

statement.id: Seniman menggambarkan Anubis berkepala jakal, dan sebuah arca menampilkannya sebagai jakal sepenuhnya.
statement.en: Artists showed Anubis with a jackal's head, and one statue shows him entirely as a jackal.

claims.quote: The priests who embalmed bodies sometimes wore masks shaped like the head of Anubis.

statement.id: Para imam pembalsem kadang mengenakan topeng berbentuk kepala Anubis.
statement.en: Embalming priests sometimes wore Anubis-head masks.

claims.quote: He is the earliest Egyptian deity depicted on tomb walls and invoked for protection of the dead and is usually shown tending to the corpse of the king, presiding over mummification rituals and funerals, or standing with Osiris, Thoth, or other gods at the Weighing of the Heart of the Soul in the Hall of Truth in the afterlife.

statement.id: Anubis dimohon untuk melindungi orang mati dan digambarkan dalam penimbangan hati.
statement.en: Anubis was invoked to protect the dead and shown at the weighing of the heart.

claims.quote: He is one of the oldest gods of Egypt, most likely developed from the earlier jackal god Wepwawet with whom he is often confused.

statement.id: Ia salah satu dewa tertua Mesir, kemungkinan besar berkembang dari dewa jakal yang lebih awal, Wepwawet, yang sering tertukar dengannya.
statement.en: He is one of the oldest gods of Egypt, most likely developed from the earlier jackal god Wepwawet, with whom he is often confused.

claims.quote: Anubis' image is seen on royal tombs from the First Dynasty of Egypt (c. 3150-2890 BCE) but it is certain he had already developed a cult following prior to this period in order to be invoked on the tomb's walls for protection.

statement.id: Gambar Anubis terlihat pada makam kerajaan sejak Dinasti Pertama Mesir (sekitar 3150–2890 SM), tetapi dipastikan ia sudah memiliki pengikut kultus sebelumnya sehingga diseru di dinding makam untuk perlindungan.
statement.en: Anubis' image is seen on royal tombs from the First Dynasty of Egypt (c. 3150-2890 BCE), but he certainly already had a cult following before then, in order to be invoked on the tomb walls for protection.

claims.quote: He is thought to have developed in response to wild dogs and jackals digging up newly buried corpses at some point in the Predynastic Period in Egypt (c. 6000-3150 BCE) as the Egyptians believed a powerful canine god was the best protection against wild canines.

statement.id: Ia diperkirakan muncul sebagai tanggapan atas anjing liar dan jakal yang menggali jenazah yang baru dikubur pada suatu waktu dalam Periode Pradinasti Mesir (sekitar 6000–3150 SM), karena orang Mesir yakin dewa kanid yang kuat adalah perlindungan terbaik terhadap kanid liar.
statement.en: He is thought to have developed in response to wild dogs and jackals digging up newly buried corpses at some point in the Predynastic Period in Egypt (c. 6000-3150 BCE), since the Egyptians believed a powerful canine god was the best protection against wild canines.

claims.quote: The color black was chosen for its symbolism, not because Egyptian dogs or jackals were black. Black symbolized the decay of the body as well as the fertile soil of the Nile River Valley which represented regeneration and life.

statement.id: Warna hitam dipilih karena maknanya, bukan karena anjing atau jakal Mesir berwarna hitam; hitam melambangkan pembusukan tubuh sekaligus tanah subur Lembah Sungai Nil yang mewakili pembaruan dan kehidupan.
statement.en: The color black was chosen for its symbolism, not because Egyptian dogs or jackals were black; black symbolized the decay of the body as well as the fertile soil of the Nile River Valley, which represented regeneration and life.

claims.quote: The powerful black canine, then, was the protector of the dead who made sure they received their due rights in burial and stood by them in the life after death to assist their resurrection.

statement.id: Kanid hitam yang perkasa itu adalah pelindung orang mati yang memastikan mereka menerima hak penguburan dan mendampingi mereka dalam kehidupan setelah mati untuk membantu kebangkitan mereka.
statement.en: The powerful black canine was the protector of the dead, who made sure they received their due rites in burial and stood by them in the afterlife to assist their resurrection.

claims.quote: He was known as "First of the Westerners" prior to the rise of Osiris in the Middle Kingdom (2040-1782 BCE) which meant he was king of the dead

statement.id: Ia dikenal sebagai "Yang Pertama di antara Orang Barat" sebelum bangkitnya Osiris pada Kerajaan Tengah (2040–1782 SM), yang berarti ia adalah raja orang mati.
statement.en: He was known as "First of the Westerners" before the rise of Osiris in the Middle Kingdom (2040-1782 BCE), which meant he was king of the dead.

claims.quote: A popular image of Anubis is the standing or kneeling man with the jackal's head holding the golden scales on which the heart of the soul was weighed against the white feather of truth.

statement.id: Gambaran Anubis yang populer adalah pria berkepala jakal yang berdiri atau berlutut memegang timbangan emas tempat hati sang jiwa ditimbang terhadap bulu putih kebenaran.
statement.en: A popular image of Anubis is the standing or kneeling man with the jackal's head holding the golden scales on which the heart of the soul was weighed against the white feather of truth.

claims.quote: His daughter is Qebhet (also known as Kabechet) who brings cool water to the souls of the dead in the Hall of Truth and comforts the newly deceased.

statement.id: Putrinya adalah Qebhet (juga dikenal sebagai Kabechet) yang membawa air sejuk bagi jiwa orang mati di Balai Kebenaran dan menghibur mereka yang baru meninggal.
statement.en: His daughter is Qebhet (also known as Kabechet), who brings cool water to the souls of the dead in the Hall of Truth and comforts the newly deceased.

claims.quote: He had many epithets besides "First of the Westerners" and was also known as "Lord of the Sacred Land" (referencing the area of the desert where necropoleis were located)

statement.id: Ia memiliki banyak gelar selain "Yang Pertama di antara Orang Barat", antara lain "Penguasa Tanah Suci" (merujuk wilayah gurun tempat nekropolis berada).
statement.en: He had many epithets besides "First of the Westerners", including "Lord of the Sacred Land" (referring to the area of the desert where necropoleis were located).

claims.quote: "Master of Secrets" (since he knew what waited beyond death), "He Who is in the Place of Embalming" (indicating his role in the mummification process)

statement.id: Gelar lainnya mencakup "Penguasa Rahasia" (karena ia tahu apa yang menanti setelah kematian) dan "Dia yang Berada di Tempat Pembalseman" (menunjukkan perannya dalam proses mumifikasi).
statement.en: Other epithets include "Master of Secrets" (since he knew what waited beyond death) and "He Who is in the Place of Embalming" (indicating his role in the mummification process).

claims.quote: As his various epithets make clear, Anubis was central to every aspect of an individual's death experience in the role of protector and even stood with the soul after death as a just judge and guide.

statement.id: Seperti terlihat dari berbagai gelarnya, Anubis berperan sentral dalam setiap aspek pengalaman kematian seseorang sebagai pelindung, dan bahkan mendampingi jiwa setelah mati sebagai hakim yang adil dan pemandu.
statement.en: As his various epithets make clear, Anubis was central to every aspect of an individual's death experience as protector, and even stood with the soul after death as a just judge and guide.

claims.quote: Anubis helped to judge the dead and he and his army of messengers were charged with punishing those who violated tombs or offended the gods

statement.id: Menurut Geraldine Pinch yang dikutip sumber ini, Anubis membantu menghakimi orang mati, dan ia bersama pasukan utusannya ditugasi menghukum orang yang melanggar makam atau menyinggung para dewa.
statement.en: According to Geraldine Pinch, quoted by the source, Anubis helped to judge the dead, and he and his army of messengers were charged with punishing those who violated tombs or offended the gods.

claims.quote: A story recorded in the first millenium BCE tells how the wicked god Set disguised himself as a leopard to approach the body of Osiris. He was seized by Anubis and branded all over with a hot iron. This, according to Egyptian myth, is how the leopard got its spots.

statement.id: Sebuah kisah yang tercatat pada milenium pertama SM menceritakan bahwa dewa jahat Set menyamar sebagai macan tutul untuk mendekati jasad Osiris, lalu ditangkap Anubis dan dicap di sekujur tubuh dengan besi panas; menurut mitos Mesir, begitulah macan tutul mendapat bintik-bintiknya.
statement.en: A story recorded in the first millennium BCE tells how the wicked god Set disguised himself as a leopard to approach the body of Osiris, was seized by Anubis, and was branded all over with a hot iron; according to Egyptian myth, this is how the leopard got its spots.

claims.quote: Anubis then flayed Set and wore his bloody skin as a warning to evildoers. By this era, Anubis was said to command an army of demon messengers who inflicted suffering and death.

statement.id: Anubis kemudian menguliti Set dan mengenakan kulitnya yang berdarah sebagai peringatan bagi para pelaku kejahatan; pada masa itu Anubis dikatakan memimpin pasukan utusan-iblis yang menimpakan penderitaan dan kematian.
statement.en: Anubis then flayed Set and wore his bloody skin as a warning to evildoers; by this era Anubis was said to command an army of demon messengers who inflicted suffering and death.

claims.quote: In the Early Dynastic Period (c. 3150-2613 BCE) and Old Kingdom (c. 2613-2181 BCE) Anubis was the sole Lord of the Dead and righteous judge of the soul, but as the Osiris myth became more popular, the latter god took on more and more of Anubis' attributes.

statement.id: Pada Periode Dinasti Awal (sekitar 3150–2613 SM) dan Kerajaan Lama (sekitar 2613–2181 SM), Anubis adalah satu-satunya Penguasa Orang Mati dan hakim jiwa yang adil, tetapi seiring mitos Osiris makin populer, Osiris mengambil semakin banyak atribut Anubis.
statement.en: In the Early Dynastic Period (c. 3150-2613 BCE) and Old Kingdom (c. 2613-2181 BCE) Anubis was the sole Lord of the Dead and righteous judge of the soul, but as the Osiris myth grew more popular, Osiris took on more and more of Anubis' attributes.

claims.quote: Anubis remained a very popular god, however, and so was assimilated into the Osiris myth by discarding his earlier parentage and history and making him the son of Osiris and Nephthys born of their affair.

statement.id: Anubis tetap sangat populer sehingga ia diserap ke dalam mitos Osiris dengan membuang silsilah dan riwayat awalnya dan menjadikannya putra Osiris dan Nephthys yang lahir dari hubungan gelap mereka.
statement.en: Anubis nevertheless remained very popular and so was assimilated into the Osiris myth by discarding his earlier parentage and history and making him the son of Osiris and Nephthys, born of their affair.

claims.quote: After his assimilation into the Osiris myth, Anubis was regularly seen as Osiris' protector and "right-hand man" who guarded the god's body after death, oversaw the mummification, and assisted Osiris in the judgment of the souls of the dead.

statement.id: Setelah diserap ke dalam mitos Osiris, Anubis lazim dipandang sebagai pelindung dan "tangan kanan" Osiris yang menjaga jasad sang dewa setelah mati, mengawasi mumifikasi, dan membantu Osiris menghakimi jiwa orang mati.
statement.en: After his assimilation into the Osiris myth, Anubis was regularly seen as Osiris' protector and "right-hand man", who guarded the god's body after death, oversaw the mummification, and assisted Osiris in judging the souls of the dead.

claims.quote: Anubis was regularly called upon (as attested to from amulets, tomb paintings, and in written works) for protection and vengeance; especially as a powerful ally in enforcing curses placed on others or defending one's self from such curses.

statement.id: Anubis lazim diseru (dibuktikan dari jimat, lukisan makam, dan karya tulis) untuk perlindungan dan pembalasan, terutama sebagai sekutu kuat dalam menegakkan kutukan atas orang lain atau membela diri dari kutukan semacam itu.
statement.en: Anubis was regularly called upon (as attested by amulets, tomb paintings, and written works) for protection and vengeance, especially as a powerful ally in enforcing curses placed on others or defending oneself from such curses.

claims.quote: As the protector of the dead, who invented mummification and so the preservation of the human body

statement.id: Sebagai pelindung orang mati, Anubis disebut penemu mumifikasi dan dengan demikian pengawetan tubuh manusia.
statement.en: As the protector of the dead, Anubis is described as having invented mummification and so the preservation of the human body.

claims.quote: Osiris slept with Nephthys and she became pregnant with Anubis but abandoned him shortly after his birth in fear that the affair would be discovered by Set.

statement.id: Osiris tidur dengan Nephthys dan ia hamil dengan Anubis, tetapi meninggalkannya tak lama setelah lahir karena takut hubungan itu diketahui Set.
statement.en: Osiris slept with Nephthys and she became pregnant with Anubis but abandoned him shortly after his birth for fear that Set would discover the affair.

claims.quote: Isis found out about the affair and went searching for the infant and, when she found him, adopted him as her own.

statement.id: Isis mengetahui hubungan itu, mencari sang bayi, dan setelah menemukannya mengangkatnya sebagai anaknya sendiri.
statement.en: Isis found out about the affair, went searching for the infant, and, when she found him, adopted him as her own.

claims.quote: The priests of Anubis were male and often wore masks of the god made of wood in performing rituals. The god's cult center was in Upper Egypt at Cynopolis ("the city of the dog"), but there were shrines to him throughout the land and he was universally venerated in every part of the country.

statement.id: Para pendeta Anubis adalah laki-laki dan sering mengenakan topeng sang dewa dari kayu saat melakukan ritual. Pusat kultusnya berada di Mesir Hulu di Cynopolis ("kota anjing"), tetapi ada kuil-kuil baginya di seluruh negeri dan ia dihormati di segala penjuru.
statement.en: The priests of Anubis were male and often wore wooden masks of the god in performing rituals. His cult center was in Upper Egypt at Cynopolis ("the city of the dog"), but there were shrines to him throughout the land and he was universally venerated in every part of the country.

claims.quote: Because he was said to have prepared the mummy of Osiris, Anubis became the patron god of embalmers and in the Memphite necropolis an area associated with the embalmers seems to have become something of a focal point for the cult of Anubis in the Late Period and Ptolemaic times

statement.id: Karena dikatakan menyiapkan mumi Osiris, Anubis menjadi dewa pelindung para pembalsem, dan di nekropolis Memphis sebuah kawasan yang berkaitan dengan para pembalsem tampaknya menjadi pusat kultus Anubis pada Periode Akhir dan masa Ptolemeus.
statement.en: Because he was said to have prepared the mummy of Osiris, Anubis became the patron god of embalmers, and in the Memphite necropolis an area associated with the embalmers seems to have become a focal point of the cult of Anubis in the Late Period and Ptolemaic times.

claims.quote: The Greeks associated him with their god Hermes who guided the dead to the afterlife

statement.id: Orang Yunani mengaitkannya dengan dewa mereka, Hermes, yang memandu orang mati ke alam baka.
statement.en: The Greeks associated him with their god Hermes, who guided the dead to the afterlife.

claims.quote: became associated with Charon in the Graeco-Roman period and St. Christopher in the early Christian period

statement.id: Menurut kutipan Salima Ikram dalam sumber ini, Anubis dikaitkan dengan Charon pada periode Yunani-Romawi dan dengan Santo Christopher pada masa Kristen awal.
statement.en: According to Salima Ikram, quoted in the source, Anubis became associated with Charon in the Graeco-Roman period and with St. Christopher in the early Christian period.

claims.quote: It is probable that Anubis is represented as a super-canid, combining the most salient attributes of serveral types of canids, rather than being just a jackal or a dog.

statement.id: Menurut kutipan Salima Ikram, kemungkinan Anubis digambarkan sebagai "super-kanid" yang menggabungkan ciri paling menonjol dari beberapa jenis kanid, bukan sekadar jakal atau anjing.
statement.en: According to Salima Ikram, it is probable that Anubis is represented as a super-canid combining the most salient attributes of several types of canids, rather than being just a jackal or a dog.

claims.quote: This "super-canid" offered people the assurance that their body would be respected at death, that their soul would be protected in the afterlife, and that they would receive fair judgment for their life's work.

statement.id: "Super-kanid" ini memberi orang jaminan bahwa tubuh mereka akan dihormati saat mati, jiwa mereka dilindungi di alam baka, dan mereka akan menerima penghakiman yang adil atas jerih payah hidupnya.
statement.en: This "super-canid" offered people the assurance that their body would be respected at death, that their soul would be protected in the afterlife, and that they would receive fair judgment for their life's work.

claims.quote: Although Anubis is very well represented in artwork throughout Egyptian history he does not play a major role in many myths.

statement.id: Meski Anubis sangat banyak muncul dalam karya seni sepanjang sejarah Mesir, ia tidak berperan besar dalam banyak mitos.
statement.en: Although Anubis is very well represented in artwork throughout Egyptian history, he does not play a major role in many myths.

claims.quote: he afterwards became her guardsman and follower, being named Anubis, and reported to guard the Gods as dogs do men.

statement.id: Dalam Plutarch, anak itu kemudian menjadi pengawal dan pengikut Isis, dinamai Anubis, dan dikabarkan menjaga para dewa seperti anjing menjaga manusia.
statement.en: In Plutarch, the child afterwards became Isis's guard and follower, named Anubis, and is reported to guard the Gods as dogs do men.

claims.quote: Which made them say that Isis had a lawful son called Horus, and Nephthys a bastard called Anubis.

statement.id: Dalam Plutarch, dikatakan bahwa Isis memiliki putra sah bernama Horus dan Nephthys memiliki anak haram bernama Anubis.
statement.en: In Plutarch, it is said that Isis had a lawful son called Horus and Nephthys a bastard called Anubis.

claims.quote: that which touches upon both these, and is called the horizon (or bounding circle) and is common to them both, is called Anubis, and resembles in shape the dog, because the dog makes use of his sight by night as well as by day.

statement.id: Dalam tafsir Plutarch, apa yang menyentuh keduanya dan disebut cakrawala (atau lingkaran pembatas) dinamai Anubis dan berbentuk seperti anjing, karena anjing menggunakan penglihatannya pada malam maupun siang.
statement.en: In Plutarch's interpretation, that which touches upon both and is called the horizon (or bounding circle) is called Anubis and resembles the dog in shape, because the dog uses his sight by night as well as by day.

claims.quote: Anubis seems to me to have a power among the Egyptians much like to that of Hecate among the Grecians, he being as well terrestrial as Olympic.

statement.id: Plutarch menilai kekuasaan Anubis di antara orang Mesir mirip dengan kekuasaan Hecate di antara orang Yunani, karena ia bersifat bumi sekaligus Olimpia.
statement.en: Plutarch judges that Anubis has a power among the Egyptians much like that of Hecate among the Greeks, being as much terrestrial as Olympic.

summary.id: Dalam tradisi lebih awal, putra Ra dan Hesat.
summary.en: In an earlier tradition, son of Ra and Hesat.

summary.id: Dalam kisah Osiris, putra Osiris dan Nephthys; silsilah awalnya dibuang saat ia diserap ke mitos itu.
summary.en: In the Osiris myth, son of Osiris and Nephthys; his earlier parentage was discarded when he was assimilated into that myth.

summary.id: Digambarkan sebagai kanid hitam, persilangan jakal-anjing, atau pria berkepala jakal.
summary.en: Depicted as a black canine, a jackal-dog hybrid, or a man with a jackal's head.

summary.id: Salima Ikram menduga ia "super-kanid" yang menggabungkan ciri beberapa kanid, bukan sekadar jakal atau anjing.
summary.en: Salima Ikram suggests a "super-canid" combining attributes of several canids, rather than just a jackal or a dog.

summary.id: Plutarch menyebut Anubis berbentuk seperti anjing.
summary.en: Plutarch says Anubis resembles the dog in shape.

short_description.id: Thor adalah dewa pembawa palu dalam mitologi Nordik yang dikaitkan dengan guntur, badai, kekuatan, dan perlindungan.
short_description.en: Thor is a hammer-wielding god of Norse mythology associated with thunder, storms, strength, and protection.

long_description.id:
Thor, yang bernama Þórr dalam bahasa Nordik, adalah dewa pembawa palu dalam mitologi Nordik. Ia dikaitkan dengan guntur, badai, kekuatan, perlindungan, kesuburan, dan petani. Ia putra Odin dan Jord serta suami Sif, dan berkembang dari dewa Germanik yang lebih awal, Donar. Namanya hidup dalam kata Thursday dan Donnerstag.

Thor berfungsi terutama sebagai dewa pelindung. World History Encyclopedia menyebutnya pembela Asgard dan Midgard yang melindungi lewat perbuatan menumpas raksasa, dan Museum Nasional Denmark juga menyatakan bahwa ia melindungi Midgard, dunia manusia, dengan Mjöllnir. Ia memiliki palu Mjölnir, sabuk Megingjörð yang melipatgandakan kekuatannya, dan sarung tangan besi, serta berkendara dengan kereta yang ditarik dua kambing yang dapat dihidupkan kembali.

Sebagian besar kisah Thor menempatkannya melawan raksasa atau Ular Midgard. Ia memancing ular itu bersama raksasa Hymir, tetapi Hymir memotong tali pancing, dan dalam kisah lain ia dikelabui Utgarda-Loki, yang mengatur agar Thor meminum laut sehingga menciptakan pasang surut. Thor digambarkan tidak berlicik dan berangasan, dan pada Ragnarök ia membunuh ular itu lalu gugur karena bisanya.

Pemujaan Thor memuncak pada Zaman Viking, ketika ia dianggap saingan terbesar Kristus. Banyak jimat palu Thor berasal dari masa persaingan itu, dan Museum Nasional Denmark mencatat temuan palu Thor sebagai bukti kepercayaan awal Viking. Pada abad ke-12 pemujaannya berangsur digantikan agama baru, dan World History Encyclopedia menyebutnya dewa orang biasa yang dapat diandalkan.

Sumber modern menekankan jarak antara Thor dalam tradisi dan citra populer masa kini. World History Encyclopedia menyebut Thor tradisional umumnya digambarkan berambut merah panjang dan berjanggut, sedangkan komik Marvel tahun 1962 menampilkannya klimis dan berambut pirang. Ia juga muncul dalam novel dan serial televisi yang lebih baru.
long_description.en:
Thor, called Þórr in Norse, is a hammer-bearing god of Norse myth. He is associated with thunder, storms, strength, protection, fertility, and farmers. He is the son of Odin and Jord and the husband of Sif, and developed from the earlier Germanic god Donar. His name lives on in the words Thursday and Donnerstag.

Thor functioned primarily as a protector god. World History Encyclopedia describes him as defender of Asgard and Midgard who protects through slaying giants, and the National Museum of Denmark likewise says he protected Midgard, the human world, with Mjöllnir. He has the hammer Mjölnir, the belt Megingjörð that doubles his strength, and iron gloves, and rides a chariot drawn by two goats that can be brought back to life.

Most stories of Thor set him against giants or the Midgard Serpent. He goes fishing for the serpent with the giant Hymir, but Hymir cuts the line, and in another tale he is deceived by Utgarda-Loki, whose trick has Thor drink from the sea and so create tides. Thor is portrayed as without guile and quick-tempered, and at Ragnarök he kills the serpent and then falls to its poison.

Thor's cult peaked in the Viking Age, when he was considered the greatest rival to Christ. Many amulets of Thor's hammer date from that period of contention, and the National Museum of Denmark notes finds of Thor's hammers as evidence of early Viking beliefs. By the 12th century his cult had gradually been replaced by the new religion, and World History Encyclopedia calls him the god of the everyman, someone people could depend on.

Modern sources stress the gap between Thor in tradition and the popular image of today. World History Encyclopedia says the traditional Thor is almost always shown with long red hair and a great beard, while the Marvel comics of 1962 present him clean-shaven and blonde. He also appears in more recent novels and television series.

short_description.id: Thor adalah dewa pembawa palu dalam mitologi Nordik yang dikaitkan dengan guntur, badai, kekuatan, dan perlindungan.
short_description.en: Thor is a hammer-wielding god of Norse mythology associated with thunder, storms, strength, and protection.

long_description.id: Thor, yang bernama Þórr dalam bahasa Nordik, adalah dewa pembawa palu dalam mitologi Nordik. Ia dikaitkan dengan guntur, badai, kekuatan, perlindungan, kesuburan, dan petani. Ia putra Odin dan Jord serta suami Sif, dan berkembang dari dewa Germanik yang lebih awal, Donar. Namanya hidup dalam kata Thursday dan Donnerstag.
long_description.en: Thor, called Þórr in Norse, is a hammer-bearing god of Norse myth. He is associated with thunder, storms, strength, protection, fertility, and farmers. He is the son of Odin and Jord and the husband of Sif, and developed from the earlier Germanic god Donar. His name lives on in the words Thursday and Donnerstag.

long_description.id: Thor berfungsi terutama sebagai dewa pelindung. World History Encyclopedia menyebutnya pembela Asgard dan Midgard yang melindungi lewat perbuatan menumpas raksasa, dan Museum Nasional Denmark juga menyatakan bahwa ia melindungi Midgard, dunia manusia, dengan Mjöllnir. Ia memiliki palu Mjölnir, sabuk Megingjörð yang melipatgandakan kekuatannya, dan sarung tangan besi, serta berkendara dengan kereta yang ditarik dua kambing yang dapat dihidupkan kembali.
long_description.en: Thor functioned primarily as a protector god. World History Encyclopedia describes him as defender of Asgard and Midgard who protects through slaying giants, and the National Museum of Denmark likewise says he protected Midgard, the human world, with Mjöllnir. He has the hammer Mjölnir, the belt Megingjörð that doubles his strength, and iron gloves, and rides a chariot drawn by two goats that can be brought back to life.

long_description.id: Sebagian besar kisah Thor menempatkannya melawan raksasa atau Ular Midgard. Ia memancing ular itu bersama raksasa Hymir, tetapi Hymir memotong tali pancing, dan dalam kisah lain ia dikelabui Utgarda-Loki, yang mengatur agar Thor meminum laut sehingga menciptakan pasang surut. Thor digambarkan tidak berlicik dan berangasan, dan pada Ragnarök ia membunuh ular itu lalu gugur karena bisanya.
long_description.en: Most stories of Thor set him against giants or the Midgard Serpent. He goes fishing for the serpent with the giant Hymir, but Hymir cuts the line, and in another tale he is deceived by Utgarda-Loki, whose trick has Thor drink from the sea and so create tides. Thor is portrayed as without guile and quick-tempered, and at Ragnarök he kills the serpent and then falls to its poison.

long_description.id: Pemujaan Thor memuncak pada Zaman Viking, ketika ia dianggap saingan terbesar Kristus. Banyak jimat palu Thor berasal dari masa persaingan itu, dan Museum Nasional Denmark mencatat temuan palu Thor sebagai bukti kepercayaan awal Viking. Pada abad ke-12 pemujaannya berangsur digantikan agama baru, dan World History Encyclopedia menyebutnya dewa orang biasa yang dapat diandalkan.
long_description.en: Thor's cult peaked in the Viking Age, when he was considered the greatest rival to Christ. Many amulets of Thor's hammer date from that period of contention, and the National Museum of Denmark notes finds of Thor's hammers as evidence of early Viking beliefs. By the 12th century his cult had gradually been replaced by the new religion, and World History Encyclopedia calls him the god of the everyman, someone people could depend on.

long_description.id: Sumber modern menekankan jarak antara Thor dalam tradisi dan citra populer masa kini. World History Encyclopedia menyebut Thor tradisional umumnya digambarkan berambut merah panjang dan berjanggut, sedangkan komik Marvel tahun 1962 menampilkannya klimis dan berambut pirang. Ia juga muncul dalam novel dan serial televisi yang lebih baru.
long_description.en: Modern sources stress the gap between Thor in tradition and the popular image of today. World History Encyclopedia says the traditional Thor is almost always shown with long red hair and a great beard, while the Marvel comics of 1962 present him clean-shaven and blonde. He also appears in more recent novels and television series.

cultural_context.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, kekuatan Thor dan caranya menanggapi masalah secara langsung menarik bagi semua lapisan masyarakat Zaman Viking, sehingga ia menjadi dewa orang biasa.
cultural_context.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, Thor's strength and direct response to problems appealed across the social classes of the Viking Age, making him the god of the everyman.

claims.quote: Thor (from Old Norse: Þórr) is a prominent god in Germanic paganism. In Norse mythology, he is a hammer-wielding god associated with thunder, storms, strength, protection, fertility, and farmers.

statement.id: Thor atau Þórr adalah dewa pembawa palu dalam tradisi Jermanik dan mitologi Nordik, terkait guntur, badai, kekuatan, perlindungan, kesuburan, dan petani.
statement.en: Thor or Þórr is a hammer-bearing Germanic and Norse god linked to thunder, storms, strength, protection, fertility, and farmers.

claims.quote: Thor wields the hammer Mjölnir, wears the belt Megingjörð and the iron gloves Járngreipr

statement.id: Thor menggunakan palu Mjölnir, sabuk Megingjörð, dan sarung tangan Járngreipr.
statement.en: Thor wields Mjölnir and wears Megingjörð and Járngreipr.

claims.quote: Thor was the defender of Asgard, realm of the gods, and Midgard, the human realm, and is primarily associated with protection through great feats of arms in slaying giants.

statement.id: Thor digambarkan sebagai pembela Asgard dan Midgard, terutama dengan melawan para raksasa.
statement.en: Thor is described as defender of Asgard and Midgard, especially through fighting giants.

claims.quote: Thor was the god of thunder and he protected Midgard – the world of humans – using his hammer Mjöllnir.

statement.id: Menurut Museum Nasional Denmark, Thor dewa guntur yang melindungi Midgard, dunia manusia, menggunakan Mjöllnir.
statement.en: According to the National Museum of Denmark, Thor was the thunder god who protected Midgard with Mjöllnir.

claims.quote: Apart from these sources, some archaeological objects have also been found, which tell us about the Vikings’ early beliefs and the pantheon of Norse gods. Thor’s hammers are a good example of this.

statement.id: Museum menyebut temuan benda berbentuk palu Thor sebagai bukti arkeologis kepercayaan awal Viking.
statement.en: The museum cites finds of Thor's hammers as archaeological evidence for early Viking beliefs.

claims.quote: Thor (Old Norse: Þórr) is the Norse god of thunder, the sky, and agriculture.

statement.id: World History Encyclopedia menyebut Thor dewa guntur, langit, dan pertanian Nordik.
statement.en: World History Encyclopedia calls Thor the Norse god of thunder, sky, and agriculture.

claims.quote: He is the son of Odin, chief of the gods, and Odin's consort Jord (Earth) and husband of the fertility goddess Sif, who is the mother of his son Modi and daughter Thrud; his other son, Magni, may be from a union with the giantess Jarnsaxa.

statement.id: Thor adalah putra Odin, pemimpin para dewa, dan Jord (Bumi), selir Odin, serta suami dewi kesuburan Sif, ibu putranya Modi dan putrinya Thrud; putranya yang lain, Magni, mungkin lahir dari hubungan dengan raksasi Jarnsaxa.
statement.en: Thor is the son of Odin, chief of the gods, and Odin's consort Jord (Earth), and husband of the fertility goddess Sif, mother of his son Modi and daughter Thrud; his other son, Magni, may be from a union with the giantess Jarnsaxa.

claims.quote: The majority of the tales featuring Thor, in fact, put him in conflict with a giant or with his nemesis the Midgard Serpent (Jörmungandr, the "huge monster"), a monstrous snake who coils and twists itself around the world.

statement.id: Sebagian besar kisah tentang Thor menempatkannya berhadapan dengan raksasa atau dengan musuh bebuyutannya, Ular Midgard (Jörmungandr, "monster besar"), ular raksasa yang melilit dunia.
statement.en: Most tales featuring Thor put him in conflict with a giant or with his nemesis the Midgard Serpent (Jörmungandr, the "huge monster"), a monstrous snake that coils around the world.

claims.quote: Like almost all of the Norse gods, Thor is doomed to die at Ragnarök, the end of the world and twilight of the gods, but falls only after killing the great serpent with his powerful hammer Mjollnir, dying to its poison

statement.id: Seperti hampir semua dewa Nordik, Thor ditakdirkan tewas pada Ragnarök, akhir dunia dan senja para dewa, tetapi ia gugur hanya setelah membunuh ular raksasa dengan palunya Mjollnir dan mati karena bisanya.
statement.en: Like almost all Norse gods, Thor is doomed to die at Ragnarök, the end of the world and twilight of the gods, but falls only after killing the great serpent with his hammer Mjollnir, dying to its poison.

claims.quote: He developed from the earlier Germanic god Donar and became the most popular deity of the Norse pantheon.

statement.id: Thor berkembang dari dewa Germanik yang lebih awal, Donar, dan menjadi dewa paling populer dalam panteon Nordik.
statement.en: Thor developed from the earlier Germanic god Donar and became the most popular deity of the Norse pantheon.

claims.quote: the modern English and German words for the fifth day of the week - Thursday and Donnerstag - both allude to Thor/Donar ("Thor's Day"/"Donar's Day").

statement.id: Kata bahasa Inggris dan Jerman modern untuk hari kelima dalam sepekan, Thursday dan Donnerstag, sama-sama merujuk kepada Thor/Donar ("Hari Thor"/"Hari Donar").
statement.en: The modern English and German words for the fifth day of the week, Thursday and Donnerstag, both allude to Thor/Donar ("Thor's Day"/"Donar's Day").

claims.quote: He was thought to have ruled the sky from his land of Þrúðvangr ("Power-Field" or "Plains of Strength") where he built his great hall of Bilskírnir, a palace of 540 rooms.

statement.id: Thor dipercaya memerintah langit dari tanahnya, Þrúðvangr ("Ladang Kuasa" atau "Dataran Kekuatan"), tempat ia membangun aula besarnya, Bilskírnir, istana berkamar 540.
statement.en: Thor was thought to have ruled the sky from his land of Þrúðvangr ("Power-Field" or "Plains of Strength"), where he built his great hall Bilskírnir, a palace of 540 rooms.

claims.quote: He was said to burst forth from his great hall in his chariot, drawn by two male goats - Tanngnjóstr (Tooth Gnasher) and Tanngrísnir (Snarl Tooth) - who could be killed and eaten by the god and then brought back to life the next day as long as their bones remained unbroken.

statement.id: Thor dikisahkan keluar dari aula besarnya dengan kereta yang ditarik dua kambing jantan, Tanngnjóstr (Penggertak Gigi) dan Tanngrísnir (Gigi Menggeram), yang dapat dibunuh dan dimakan lalu dihidupkan kembali keesokan harinya selama tulangnya tidak patah.
statement.en: Thor was said to burst forth from his hall in a chariot drawn by two male goats, Tanngnjóstr (Tooth Gnasher) and Tanngrísnir (Snarl Tooth), which he could kill and eat and bring back to life the next day as long as their bones stayed unbroken.

claims.quote: The roar of thunder was the rumble of Thor's chariot's wheels across the vault of the heavens and, in another story, he is credited with creating tides.

statement.id: Gemuruh guntur adalah deru roda kereta Thor di kubah langit, dan dalam kisah lain ia dianggap menciptakan pasang surut.
statement.en: The roar of thunder was the rumble of Thor's chariot wheels across the vault of the heavens, and in another story he is credited with creating tides.

claims.quote: Thor's popularity reached its height during the Viking Age (c. 790-1100) at which time he was considered the greatest rival to Christ when, roughly from the 10th century onwards, Christianity was introduced to Scandinavia.

statement.id: Popularitas Thor mencapai puncaknya pada Zaman Viking (sekitar 790-1100), ketika ia dianggap saingan terbesar Kristus saat agama Kristen mulai diperkenalkan ke Skandinavia kira-kira dari abad ke-10.
statement.en: Thor's popularity reached its height in the Viking Age (c. 790-1100), when he was considered the greatest rival to Christ as Christianity was introduced to Scandinavia from roughly the 10th century.

claims.quote: More amulets and charms of Thor's hammer date from the period when Christianity and the Norse religion were in contention than from any other.

statement.id: Lebih banyak jimat palu Thor berasal dari masa ketika agama Kristen dan agama Nordik bersaing daripada dari masa lain mana pun.
statement.en: More amulets and charms of Thor's hammer date from the period when Christianity and the Norse religion were in contention than from any other.

claims.quote: He had three magical items which helped him defend Asgard and Midgard: his hammer Mjollnir, his belt of strength Megingjörð (which doubled his strength when he wore it), and his great iron gloves which he needed to wield his hammer.

statement.id: Thor memiliki tiga benda ajaib yang membantunya membela Asgard dan Midgard: palu Mjollnir, sabuk kekuatan Megingjörð (yang melipatgandakan kekuatannya saat dikenakan), dan sarung tangan besi besar yang diperlukan untuk memegang palunya.
statement.en: Thor had three magical items that helped him defend Asgard and Midgard: his hammer Mjollnir, his belt of strength Megingjörð (which doubled his strength when worn), and the great iron gloves he needed to wield the hammer.

claims.quote: Thor was invoked to seal business contracts and consecrate marriages, for agricultural abundance, for protection during voyages (especially at sea) and for victory in battle, but he seems to have been called upon whenever any need arose.

statement.id: Thor diseru untuk mengesahkan kontrak dagang dan memberkati pernikahan, demi kelimpahan pertanian, perlindungan dalam pelayaran (terutama di laut), dan kemenangan perang, tetapi tampaknya ia dipanggil kapan pun kebutuhan muncul.
statement.en: Thor was invoked to seal business contracts and consecrate marriages, for agricultural abundance, for protection on voyages (especially at sea) and for victory in battle, and seems to have been called upon whenever any need arose.

claims.quote: These items embellish Thor's great strength, which is his main feature, and Thor also has a quick temper and shows impatience for following others' rules.

statement.id: Benda-benda itu menambah kekuatan besar Thor, yang menjadi ciri utamanya; Thor juga cepat naik darah dan tidak sabar mengikuti aturan orang lain.
statement.en: These items embellish Thor's great strength, his main feature, and Thor also has a quick temper and shows impatience with following others' rules.

claims.quote: Thor is completely without guile or the capacity to deceive and so cannot recognize these qualities in others; as a result, he is often tricked by magical spells or shape-shifting entities which cause things to appear other than they are.

statement.id: Thor sama sekali tidak berlicik dan tidak mampu menipu sehingga tak dapat mengenali sifat itu pada orang lain; akibatnya ia sering dikelabui mantra atau makhluk pengubah wujud yang membuat segala sesuatu tampak lain dari kenyataan.
statement.en: Thor is completely without guile or the capacity to deceive and so cannot recognize these qualities in others; as a result he is often tricked by magical spells or shape-shifting entities that make things appear other than they are.

claims.quote: he was not the brother of Loki and is never depicted as clean-shaven or blonde-haired except in chapter 3 of the Prose Edda (composed c. 1220), a mythography of earlier Norse myths reworked by the Icelander Snorri Sturluson into one structured account, written from a Christian context.

statement.id: Berbeda dari citra populer masa kini dari komik dan film Marvel, Thor bukan saudara Loki dan tidak pernah digambarkan klimis atau berambut pirang kecuali dalam bab 3 Prose Edda (disusun sekitar 1220), karya yang ditulis dari konteks Kristen oleh Snorri Sturluson dari Islandia.
statement.en: Contrary to the popular present-day image from Marvel comics and films, Thor was not Loki's brother and is never depicted as clean-shaven or blonde except in chapter 3 of the Prose Edda (composed c. 1220), written from a Christian context by the Icelander Snorri Sturluson.

claims.quote: Elsewhere, and in almost every image, Thor is always shown with long red hair and a great beard, often as not leaping into battle against giants or killing dwarves without pausing to consider alternatives to violence.

statement.id: Di tempat lain dan dalam hampir setiap gambar, Thor selalu ditampilkan berambut merah panjang dan berjanggut lebat, sering melompat ke pertempuran melawan raksasa atau membunuh kurcaci tanpa mempertimbangkan alternatif selain kekerasan.
statement.en: Elsewhere, and in almost every image, Thor is shown with long red hair and a great beard, often leaping into battle against giants or killing dwarves without considering alternatives to violence.

claims.quote: He first tells them that he was Skrýmir in the forest and that he deceived Thor each time Thor struck him; Thor was actually striking at mountains whose tops were now leveled from each blow.

statement.id: Utgarda-Loki mengungkapkan bahwa ia adalah Skrýmir di hutan dan telah mengelabui Thor setiap kali Thor memukulnya; Thor sebenarnya memukul gunung-gunung yang puncaknya kini rata oleh tiap pukulan.
statement.en: Utgarda-Loki reveals that he was Skrýmir in the forest and deceived Thor each time Thor struck him; Thor was actually striking mountains whose tops were leveled by each blow.

claims.quote: In the case of Thor's contest, Utgarda-Loki explains, the bottom of the drinking horn was in the sea so that, no matter how much Thor drank, he would never have been able to empty it. He did manage to drink so much, however, that the sea level had dropped and Thor had now created tides.

statement.id: Utgarda-Loki menjelaskan bahwa dasar tanduk minum itu berada di laut sehingga Thor tak akan pernah bisa mengosongkannya, tetapi Thor meminum sedemikian banyak hingga permukaan laut turun dan ia menciptakan pasang surut.
statement.en: Utgarda-Loki explains that the bottom of the drinking horn was in the sea, so Thor could never have emptied it, but he drank so much that the sea level dropped and Thor created tides.

claims.quote: In another popular tale, Thor's hammer is stolen by the giants and he must disguise himself as the goddess Freyja and pretend to be the giant's bride in order to get it back.

statement.id: Dalam kisah populer lain, palu Thor dicuri para raksasa dan ia harus menyamar sebagai dewi Freyja dan berpura-pura menjadi pengantin sang raksasa untuk mendapatkannya kembali.
statement.en: In another popular tale, Thor's hammer is stolen by the giants and he must disguise himself as the goddess Freyja and pretend to be the giant's bride to get it back.

claims.quote: Shortly afterwards, he goes fishing with the giant Hymir and catches the serpent but Hymir, fearful of drowning since Thor's fight with the beast is threatening their boat, cuts the line.

statement.id: Tak lama kemudian Thor memancing bersama raksasa Hymir dan menangkap ular itu, tetapi Hymir, takut tenggelam karena pertarungan Thor mengancam perahu mereka, memotong tali pancing.
statement.en: Shortly afterwards Thor goes fishing with the giant Hymir and catches the serpent, but Hymir, fearful of drowning because the fight threatens their boat, cuts the line.

claims.quote: was master of thunder and lightning, storm and rain, fair weather and crops, and the pagans sacrificed to him when threatened by hunger or disease

statement.id: Sarjana Preben Meulengracht Sørensen, yang dikutip World History Encyclopedia, menyebut Thor penguasa guntur dan kilat, badai dan hujan, cuaca cerah dan panen, dan bahwa kaum pagan berkurban kepadanya saat terancam kelaparan atau penyakit.
statement.en: The scholar Preben Meulengracht Sørensen, quoted by World History Encyclopedia, says Thor was master of thunder and lightning, storm and rain, fair weather and crops, and the pagans sacrificed to him when threatened by hunger or disease.

claims.quote: Christianity finally prevailed and the cult of Thor was gradually replaced by the new religion by the 12th century.

statement.id: Agama Kristen akhirnya menang dan pemujaan Thor berangsur digantikan agama baru itu pada abad ke-12.
statement.en: Christianity finally prevailed and the cult of Thor was gradually replaced by the new religion by the 12th century.

claims.quote: He is closely associated with water in many of the myths and is depicted rowing out further into the sea than others have gone and also crossing dangerous rivers

statement.id: Thor dikaitkan erat dengan air dalam banyak mitos dan digambarkan mendayung ke laut lebih jauh daripada yang lain serta menyeberangi sungai berbahaya.
statement.en: Thor is closely associated with water in many myths and is depicted rowing out further into the sea than others and crossing dangerous rivers.

claims.quote: Thor functioned primarily as a protector-god, although stories concerning him also explained natural phenomena

statement.id: Thor terutama berfungsi sebagai dewa pelindung, meski kisah-kisah tentangnya juga menjelaskan gejala alam.
statement.en: Thor functioned primarily as a protector-god, although stories about him also explained natural phenomena.

claims.quote: He is the strongest of all gods and men, and rules over the realm which is called Thrudvang. His hall is called Bilskirner.

statement.id: Dalam Prose Edda, Har menyebut Thor yang terkuat di antara semua dewa dan manusia; ia memerintah wilayah bernama Thrudvang dan aulanya bernama Bilskirner.
statement.en: In the Prose Edda, Har says Thor is the strongest of all gods and men and rules the realm called Thrudvang; his hall is called Bilskirner.

claims.quote: Thor has two goats, by name Tangnjost and Tangrisner, and a chariot, wherein he drives. The goats draw the chariot

statement.id: Dalam Prose Edda, Thor memiliki dua kambing bernama Tangnjost dan Tangrisner serta sebuah kereta; kambing-kambing itu menarik keretanya.
statement.en: In the Prose Edda, Thor has two goats named Tangnjost and Tangrisner and a chariot, and the goats draw the chariot.

claims.quote: One of them is the hammer Mjolner, which the frost-giants and mountain-giants well know when it is raised; and this is not to be wondered at, for with it he has split many a skull of their fathers or friends.

statement.id: Dalam Prose Edda, palu Mjolner dikenal baik oleh raksasa es dan raksasa gunung ketika diangkat, karena dengannya Thor telah membelah banyak tengkorak ayah atau kawan mereka.
statement.en: In the Prose Edda, the hammer Mjolner is well known to the frost-giants and mountain-giants when raised, for with it Thor has split many a skull of their fathers or friends.

claims.quote: The second treasure he possesses is Megingjarder (belt of strength); when he girds himself with it his strength is doubled. His third treasure that is of so great value is his iron gloves; these he cannot do without when he lays hold of the hammer's haft.

statement.id: Dalam Prose Edda, harta kedua Thor adalah Megingjarder (sabuk kekuatan) yang melipatgandakan kekuatannya saat dikenakan, dan harta ketiganya sarung tangan besi yang tak dapat ia tinggalkan saat menggenggam gagang palu.
statement.en: In the Prose Edda, Thor's second treasure is Megingjarder (belt of strength), which doubles his strength when worn, and his third is his iron gloves, which he cannot do without when he grips the hammer's haft.

claims.quote: Then Thor turned away to where he saw a herd of oxen, that belonged to Hymer. He took the largest ox, which was called Himinbrjot, twisted his head off and brought it down to the sea-strand.
claims.locator: Gylfaginning (The Deluding of Gylfi), Thor and Hymer

statement.id: Dalam Prose Edda, Thor mengambil lembu terbesar milik Hymer, bernama Himinbrjot, memelintir kepalanya hingga putus, dan membawanya ke pantai.
statement.en: In the Prose Edda, Thor takes the largest of Hymer's oxen, called Himinbrjot, twists its head off, and brings it down to the sea-strand.

claims.quote: He pulled the serpent up to the gunwale; and in truth no one has ever seen a more terrible sight than when Thor whet his eyes on the serpent, and the latter stared at him and spouted venom.
claims.locator: Gylfaginning (The Deluding of Gylfi), Thor and Hymer

statement.id: Dalam Prose Edda, Thor menarik ular itu hingga ke tepi perahu, dan tak pernah ada pemandangan lebih mengerikan daripada saat Thor menatap ular itu dan ular itu menatapnya sambil menyemburkan bisa.
statement.en: In the Prose Edda, Thor pulls the serpent up to the gunwale, and no one has ever seen a more terrible sight than Thor fixing his eyes on the serpent as it stared back and spouted venom.

claims.quote: Thor threw the hammer after it, and it is even said that he struck off his head at the bottom, but I think the truth is that the Midgard-serpent still lives and lies in the ocean.
claims.locator: Gylfaginning (The Deluding of Gylfi), Thor and Hymer

statement.id: Dalam Prose Edda, Thor melempar palunya mengejar ular itu dan konon memenggal kepalanya di dasar laut, tetapi sang pencerita berpendapat kebenarannya ialah Ular Midgard masih hidup dan berbaring di samudra.
statement.en: In the Prose Edda, Thor threw the hammer after the serpent and it is even said that he struck off its head at the bottom, but the narrator thinks the truth is that the Midgard-serpent still lives and lies in the ocean.

claims.quote: Thor gets great renown by slaying the Midgard-serpent, but retreats only nine paces when he falls to the earth dead, poisoned by the venom that the serpent blows on him.

statement.id: Dalam Prose Edda, Thor mendapat nama besar karena membunuh Ular Midgard, tetapi hanya mundur sembilan langkah sebelum jatuh mati, diracuni bisa yang disemburkan ular itu.
statement.en: In the Prose Edda, Thor gains great renown by slaying the Midgard-serpent but retreats only nine paces before falling dead, poisoned by the venom the serpent blows on him.

claims.quote: He is called Asa-Thor, or Oku-Thor.

statement.id: Dalam Prose Edda, Thor disebut Asa-Thor atau Oku-Thor.
statement.en: In the Prose Edda, Thor is called Asa-Thor or Oku-Thor.

claims.quote: Besides Old Norse Þórr, the deity occurs in Old English as Thunor, in Old Frisian as Thuner, in Old Saxon as Thunar, and in Old High German as Donar, all ultimately stemming from the Proto-Germanic theonym *Þun(a)raz, meaning 'Thunder'.

statement.id: Selain Þórr dalam bahasa Nordik Kuno, dewa ini muncul dalam bahasa Inggris Kuno sebagai Thunor, Frisia Kuno sebagai Thuner, Saksen Kuno sebagai Thunar, dan Jerman Tinggi Kuno sebagai Donar, semuanya berasal dari nama dewa Proto-Germanik *Þun(a)raz yang berarti 'Guntur'.
statement.en: Besides Old Norse Þórr, the deity occurs in Old English as Thunor, Old Frisian as Thuner, Old Saxon as Thunar, and Old High German as Donar, all ultimately from the Proto-Germanic theonym *Þun(a)raz, meaning 'Thunder'.

claims.quote: In 1962, American comic book artist Jack Kirby, Marvel Comics editor Stan Lee, and his brother Larry Lieber created a feature in the comic book Journey Into Mystery, a series featuring Thor as a superhero. This version of Thor is portrayed as a clean-shaven blonde, instead of red-haired and bearded.

statement.id: Pada 1962, Jack Kirby, Stan Lee, dan saudaranya Larry Lieber menciptakan fitur dalam komik Journey Into Mystery yang menampilkan Thor sebagai pahlawan super; Thor versi ini digambarkan klimis dan berambut pirang, bukan berambut merah dan berjanggut.
statement.en: In 1962 Jack Kirby, Stan Lee, and his brother Larry Lieber created a feature in the comic Journey Into Mystery presenting Thor as a superhero; this version is portrayed as a clean-shaven blonde instead of red-haired and bearded.

claims.quote: From 2015 to 2017, a fictionalised version of Thor was a supporting character in Magnus Chase and the Gods of Asgard, a trilogy of fantasy novels written by American author Rick Riordan

statement.id: Dari 2015 hingga 2017, versi fiksi Thor menjadi tokoh pendukung dalam Magnus Chase and the Gods of Asgard, trilogi novel fantasi karya Rick Riordan.
statement.en: From 2015 to 2017 a fictionalised Thor was a supporting character in Magnus Chase and the Gods of Asgard, a fantasy trilogy by Rick Riordan.

claims.quote: In January 2020, the streaming service Netflix produced Ragnarok. In the show, a high school student, Magne Seier, receives Thor's powers and abilities to fight the giants that are polluting Norway and murdering people.

statement.id: Pada Januari 2020 Netflix memproduksi Ragnarok; dalam serial itu seorang siswa SMA, Magne Seier, menerima kekuatan dan kemampuan Thor untuk melawan raksasa yang mencemari Norwegia dan membunuh orang.
statement.en: In January 2020 Netflix produced Ragnarok, in which a high school student, Magne Seier, receives Thor's powers and abilities to fight the giants polluting Norway and murdering people.

claims.quote: Thor therefore became the Norse god of the everyman; the common-sense, no-nonsense deity anyone could relate to and everyone could depend on.

statement.id: Karena itu Thor menjadi dewa Nordik bagi orang biasa: dewa yang bernalar sederhana dan tanpa basa-basi, yang dapat dipahami siapa pun dan diandalkan semua orang.
statement.en: Thor therefore became the Norse god of the everyman, a common-sense, no-nonsense deity anyone could relate to and everyone could depend on.

summary.id: Hanya dalam bab 3 Prose Edda Thor disebut klimis atau berambut pirang.
summary.en: Only in chapter 3 of the Prose Edda is Thor described as clean-shaven or blonde.

summary.id: Di tempat lain dan di hampir semua gambar Thor berambut merah panjang dan berjanggut lebat.
summary.en: Elsewhere and in almost every image Thor has long red hair and a great beard.

topic.en: The fate of the Midgard Serpent at the fishing trip

summary.id: Konon Thor memenggal kepala ular itu di dasar laut.
summary.en: It is said Thor struck off the serpent's head at the bottom of the sea.

summary.id: Sang pencerita Prose Edda berpendapat ular itu masih hidup di samudra.
summary.en: The Prose Edda's narrator thinks the serpent still lives in the ocean.

gaps.searched: Tidak menambah gambar; instruksi agen utama melarang menambah atau mengubah gambar.

sacred-texts.com (Poetic Edda dan Prose Edda) dicoba tetapi memblokir pengunduh otomatis (halaman verifikasi Cloudflare); Prose Edda terjemahan Anderson di Gutenberg dipakai sebagai teks primer, sedangkan Poetic Edda belum dikutip langsung.
Tidak ada kutipan yang menyebut negara modern secara langsung; nama Þórr sudah ada pada entri awal.
Sumber yang dibuka hanya menyebut langit sebagai wilayah kekuasaan Thor.

short_description.id: Kali adalah dewi Hindu kematian, waktu, dan akhir zaman yang dalam seni tampil menakutkan, tetapi juga dipuja sebagai sosok ibu.
short_description.en: Kali is the Hindu goddess of death, time, and doomsday, fearsome in art but also worshipped as a mother figure.

long_description.id:
Kali adalah dewi Hindu kematian, waktu, dan akhir zaman. Ia sering dikaitkan dengan seksualitas dan kekerasan, tetapi juga dipandang sebagai sosok ibu yang kuat dan lambang kasih keibuan. Kali mewujudkan shakti, energi feminin, kreativitas, dan kesuburan, dan merupakan inkarnasi Parvati, istri Shiva. Ia terutama dipuja di Bengal sebagai dewi utama aliran sakta, disebut juga Kalika, dan dianggap yang paling terkenal di antara banyak dewi Hindu. Ia juga yang pertama dari sepuluh Mahavidya, dewi pemberi pengetahuan yang membebaskan, dan dewa terkemuka dalam tradisi tantrik Hindu.

Kali diceritakan lahir dalam beberapa versi. Dalam Devi Mahatmya, teks sekitar abad ke-6 M, ia muncul dari dahi atau amarah Durga atau Kaushiki saat sang dewi bertempur melawan iblis seperti Chanda dan Munda, lalu menerima nama Chamunda. Dalam versi lain ia lahir ketika Parvati melepas kulit gelapnya, atau ketika Parvati bersatu dengan racun di kerongkongan Shiva untuk membunuh Daruka, atau dari gabungan shakti para dewa untuk menghancurkan Raktabija.

Kisah Kali yang paling terkenal adalah kematian Raktabija, iblis yang melahirkan iblis baru dari tiap tetes darahnya yang jatuh ke tanah. Kali memenggal kepalanya dengan pedang dan meminum seluruh darahnya agar tak ada lagi yang jatuh ke tanah. Dalam kisah lain, setelah lahir Kali mengamuk dan memakan semua iblis yang ditemuinya; Shiva menghentikannya dengan berbaring di jalannya, dan ketika Kali menyadari siapa yang diinjaknya, ia tenang. Dari kisah itu dijelaskan kaitan Kali dengan medan pertempuran dan tempat kremasi.

Dalam seni, Kali paling sering digambarkan sebagai sosok petarung yang menakutkan, berkulit biru atau hitam, dengan kalung kepala, rok lengan, lidah terjulur, dan pisau yang meneteskan darah. Ia berlengan banyak dan memegang pedang, trisula, cawan, dan senjata lain; pose paling umum menampilkannya berdiri atau menari dengan satu kaki di atas Shiva yang roboh. Di Tamil Nadu dan Kerala ia juga digambarkan dalam wujud yang menyenangkan sebagai dewi ibu, dan di Bengal sejak Abad Pertengahan ia dipuja sebagai Kali Ma, ibu yang baik hati.
long_description.en:
Kali is the Hindu goddess of death, time, and doomsday. Though often linked with sexuality and violence, she is also regarded as a powerful mother figure and a symbol of a mother's love. Kali embodies shakti, the energy of the feminine, of creativity and of fertility, and is regarded as an incarnation of Parvati, Shiva's wife. She is particularly worshipped in Bengal as the premier goddess of the sakta cult, is also called Kalika, and is held to be the most famous of the many Hindu goddesses. She is also the first of the ten Mahavidyas, goddesses who provide liberating knowledge, and the preeminent deity in Hindu tantric traditions.

Kali's birth is told in several versions. In the Devi Mahatmya, a text from around the sixth century CE, she emerges from the brow or anger of Durga or Kaushiki as the goddess fights demons such as Chanda and Munda, and then receives the name Chamunda. In other versions she is born when Parvati sheds her dark skin, or when Parvati combines with the poison in Shiva's throat to kill Daruka, or from the combined shakti of the gods to destroy Raktabija.

Kali's most famous story is the death of Raktabija, the demon from whose every drop of blood that touched the ground a new demon arose. Kali lopped off his head with a sword and drank all his blood so that none fell to the ground. In another story, once born Kali went wild and ate every demon she met; Shiva stopped her by lying down in her path, and when Kali realised who she was standing on, she calmed down. That story explains Kali's association with battlegrounds and cremation grounds.

In art Kali is most often shown as a fearsome fighting figure with blue or black skin, a necklace of heads, a skirt of arms, a lolling tongue, and a knife dripping with blood. She has many arms holding a sword, trident, cup, and other weapons; the most common pose shows her standing or dancing with one foot on a collapsed Shiva. In Tamil Nadu and Kerala she also appears in a "pleasing" form as a kindly mother goddess, and in Bengal since the medieval period she has been worshipped as Kali Ma, the benevolent mother.

origin.id: Ia dikenal dalam tradisi Hindu, dengan rujukan awal dalam Devi Mahatmya abad ke-6 M, dan terutama dipuja di Bengal.
origin.en: She belongs to the Hindu tradition, with an early reference in the sixth-century CE Devi Mahatmya, and is particularly worshipped in Bengal.

role.id: Ia membunuh iblis seperti Raktabija dan dipandang sebagai perwujudan shakti, sekaligus sosok ibu.
role.en: She slays demons such as Raktabija and is seen as an embodiment of shakti and also a mother figure.

famous_for.id: Kali paling dikenal karena kematian Raktabija dan karena penggambarannya yang menakutkan dengan Shiva di bawah kakinya.
famous_for.en: Kali is best known for the death of Raktabija and for her fearsome depiction with Shiva beneath her feet.

did_you_know.id: Sejak abad ketujuh belas, Kali Puja menjadi perayaan Hindu besar bagi sang dewi, dirayakan pada malam bulan baru bulan Kartik dan sering bertepatan dengan Diwali.
did_you_know.en: Since the seventeenth century Kali Puja has been a major Hindu festival for the goddess, celebrated on the new moon night of Kartik and often coinciding with Diwali.

cultural_context.id: Sebuah himne Tantrik, Karpuradistotra, menggambarkan Kali sebagai sumber kekayaan dan kesuburan serta penolakan duniawi dan kematian. Menurut Encyclopedia.com, Kali mempersonifikasikan ambivalensi dewa dalam tradisi Hindu, dalam siklus kehidupan dan kematian: penciptaan, penghancuran, dan pembaruan. Kali Puja, perayaan besar bagi sang dewi sejak abad ketujuh belas, jatuh pada malam bulan baru bulan Kartik dan sering bertepatan dengan Diwali. Gerakan nasionalis Bengal juga memakainya sebagai simbol India, dan di masa modern ia menjadi simbol penting bagi perempuan.
cultural_context.en: A Tantric hymn, the Karpuradistotra, describes Kali as the source of wealth and fertility but also of renunciation and death. According to Encyclopedia.com, Kali personifies the ambivalence of deity in the Hindu tradition, in the cycle of life and death: creation, destruction, and regeneration. Kali Puja, a major festival for the goddess since the 17th century, falls on the new moon night of Kartik and often coincides with Diwali. The Bengali nationalist movement also used her as a symbol of India, and in modern times she has become a significant symbol for women.

description.id: Kali membunuh iblis: ia menelan Raktabija dan para iblisnya, memenggal Raktabija dan meminum darahnya, serta membunuh Daruka dan, menurut Devi Mahatmya, mengalahkan Chanda dan Munda.
description.en: Kali destroys demons: she swallows Raktabija and his demons, beheads Raktabija and drinks his blood, kills Daruka, and, according to the Devi Mahatmya-based accounts, defeats Chanda and Munda.

description.id: Kali mewujudkan shakti, energi feminin, kreativitas, dan kesuburan; dalam satu kisah ia dihasilkan dari gabungan shakti para dewa untuk menghancurkan Raktabija.
description.en: Kali embodies shakti, feminine energy, creativity and fertility; in one story she is produced from the combined shakti of the gods to destroy Raktabija.

description.id: Sebagai perwujudan waktu, Kali melahap segala sesuatu; ia mewakili waktu yang menghancurkan dan melahap segalanya.
description.en: As an embodiment of time, Kali devours all things; she represents time, which is all-destroying and all-devouring.

description.id: Kali dinyatakan melindungi dan menganugerahkan pembebasan (moksha) kepada pemuja yang mendekatinya seperti anak kepada ibu; karena melampaui rasa takut dan ketidaktahuan, ia dapat melindungi dan mencerahkan yang memanggilnya.
description.en: Kali is stated to protect and bestow liberation (moksha) on devotees who approach her as a child toward a mother; being beyond fear and ignorance, she can protect and enlighten those who invoke her.

description.id: Dalam seni Kali berlengan banyak yang memegang pedang, belati, trisula, cawan, genderang, cakra, kuncup teratai, cambuk, jerat, lonceng, atau perisai; dalam kisah Raktabija ia diberi semua senjata ilahi para dewa.
description.en: In art Kali has many arms holding a sword, dagger, trident, cup, drum, chakra, lotus bud, whip, noose, bell, or shield; in the Raktabija story she is given all the divine weapons of the gods.

description.id: Menurut salah satu sumber, Shiva menghentikan amukan Kali dengan berbaring di jalannya; dalam kisah Linga Purana, Kali tenang ketika menyusui Shiva yang menjelma bayi.
description.en: According to one source, Shiva stopped Kali's rampage by lying down in her path; in the Linga Purana account Kali calmed as she suckled Shiva appearing as a baby.

description.id: Wujud Kali yang membawa keberuntungan, dengan kepala dikelilingi lingkaran api dan memegang trisula.
description.en: The auspicious form of Kali, with her head encircled by a halo of flames and wielding the trident.

description.id: Wujud Kali sebagai ibu yang baik hati, dipuja para pemuja Bengal sejak Abad Pertengahan.
description.en: Kali as the benevolent mother, worshipped by devotees in Bengal since the medieval period.

description.id: Di Tamil Nadu dan Kerala Kali juga digambarkan dalam wujud "menyenangkan" sebagai dewi ibu yang baik hati.
description.en: In Tamil Nadu and Kerala Kali has also been depicted in a "pleasing" form as a benevolent mother goddess.

description.id: Dewi yang paling sering dikaitkan dengan India selatan dan dikenali sebagai salah satu aspek Kali, seperti beberapa dewi lain dari Tamil Nadu.
description.en: A goddess most often associated with south India who is recognized as an aspect of Kali, as are several other goddesses from Tamil Nadu.

description.id: Nama majemuk yang diterima Kali setelah peristiwa Chanda dan Munda.
description.en: The compound name Kali receives after the episode of Chanda and Munda.

title.id: Kelahiran dari amarah Durga atau Kaushiki
title.en: Birth from the anger of Durga or Kaushiki

role.en: The embodiment of the goddess's wrath

summary.id: Dalam Devimahatmya, Kali muncul dari dahi atau amarah Durga (dalam versi Wikipedia, Kaushiki) saat sang dewi menyerang iblis Chanda dan Munda; Kali langsung mengalahkan keduanya dan menerima nama Chamunda. Versi lain menyebut amarah Durga menyembur dari dahinya sebagai Kali.
summary.en: In the Devimahatmya Kali emerges from the brow or anger of Durga (Kaushiki in the Wikipedia version) as the goddess attacks the demons Chanda and Munda; Kali defeats both and receives the name Chamunda. Another version says Durga became so enraged that her anger burst from her forehead as Kali.

summary.id: Raktabija dapat melahirkan iblis baru dari tiap tetes darahnya yang jatuh ke tanah. Kali menelan para iblisnya, memenggal Raktabija dengan pedang, dan meminum seluruh darahnya agar tak ada lagi yang jatuh ke tanah.
summary.en: Raktabija could produce new demons from every drop of his blood that fell to the ground. Kali swallowed his demons, beheaded Raktabija with a sword, and drank all his blood so none fell to the ground.

role.en: The goddess who rampages and then calms

summary.id: Setelah lahir, Kali mengamuk dan memakan semua iblis yang ditemuinya. Shiva menghentikannya dengan berbaring di jalannya, dan Kali tenang ketika menyadari siapa yang diinjaknya. Dalam kisah Linga Purana, ia tenang ketika menyusui Shiva yang menjelma bayi.
summary.en: Once born, Kali went wild and ate every demon she met. Shiva stopped her by lying down in her path, and Kali calmed when she realised who she was standing on. In the Linga Purana account she calmed as she suckled Shiva appearing as a baby.

summary.id: Daruka hanya dapat dibunuh oleh perempuan, sehingga Parvati melompat ke kerongkongan Shiva dan, bersatu dengan racun di sana, berubah menjadi Kali, yang lalu membunuh Daruka dengan cepat. Dalam versi lain Kali muncul ketika Parvati melepas kulit gelapnya.
summary.en: Daruka could only be killed by a woman, so Parvati jumped down Shiva's throat and, combining with the poison there, was transformed into Kali, who swiftly despatched Daruka. In another version Kali appeared when Parvati shed her dark skin.

role.en: The goddess who defends the monk

summary.id: Sekawanan pencuri hendak mempersembahkan korban manusia, seorang biksu Brahmana, di depan patung Kali ketika patung itu tiba-tiba hidup. Murka, sang dewi memenggal seluruh gerombolan itu sementara sang Brahmana melarikan diri.
summary.en: A band of thieves prepared to sacrifice a Brahmin monk in front of the statue of Kali when the statue suddenly came to life. Outraged, the goddess decapitated the whole gang while the Brahmin escaped.

description.en: The word Kālī appears as early as the Atharva Veda, but its first use as a proper name is in the Kathaka Grhya Sutra (19.7).

description.en: This Bengali devotee introduced a less ritualistic form of worship and approached Kali as a child would its mother.
