claim.en: Snorri explains that Odin's poetic skill comes from stealing the mead of the skalds (poets) after sleeping for three nights with the giantess Gunnlǫð, the mead's guardian.

claims_provenance.quote: Snorri explains that Odin's superb poetic skills are due to him stealing the mead of the skalds (i.e. poets) by sleeping with the giantess Gunnlǫð, guardian of the mead, for three nights.

claim.id: Borr dan raksasa perempuan Bestla menjadi orang tua Odin dan saudara-saudaranya, yang biasanya bernama Vili dan Vé.
claim.en: Borr and the giantess Bestla sired Odin and his brothers, usually named Vili and Vé.

claims_provenance.quote: his son Borr and the giant-daughter Bestla sired Odin and his brothers (usually named Vili and Vé)

claim.id: Odin bersaudara membunuh raksasa purba Ymir dan memakai dagingnya untuk bumi, tengkoraknya untuk langit, tulangnya untuk gunung, dan darahnya untuk laut.
claim.en: Odin and his brothers slew the proto-giant Ymir and made the earth from his flesh, the sky from his skull, the mountains from his bones, and the sea from his blood.

claims_provenance.quote: The brothers then slew the proto-giant Ymir and used his flesh to create the earth, his skull to form the sky, his bones for the mountains, and his blood to make the sea.

claim.id: Hubungan Odin dengan perang berlanjut ke hubungannya dengan orang mati, antara lain sebagai pemimpin Perburuan Liar (Wild Hunt), pasukan orang mati yang menunggang badai.
claim.en: Odin's link with war extends to a link with the dead, shown in his role as leader of the Wild Hunt, an army of the dead who ride on the storms.

claims_provenance.quote: Odin's connection with war flows naturally into a connection with the dead, which is further illustrated by Odin as the leader of the so-called Wild Hunt - a widespread and old Germanic cult centred around a myth of an army of the dead who ride on the storms.

claim.id: Para Valkyrie, perempuan prajurit gaib, membawa jasad prajurit yang gugur ke Valhalla; mereka dikenal sebagai Einherjar dan menjadi pasukan Odin melawan kekuatan dunia bawah saat Ragnarök.
claim.en: Odin's Valkyries, supernatural warrior women, bring fighters slain in battle to Valhalla; these fighters, the Einherjar, become Odin's strike-force against the powers of the Underworld at Ragnarök.

claims_provenance.quote: Odin has his Valkyries - supernatural warrior women - bringing the bodies of fighters slain in battle to his special warrior paradise Valhalla; these fighters are known as the Einherjar and become Odin's strike-force against the encroaching powers of the Underworld during the Ragnarök.

claim.id: Dalam sumber Jermanik selatan dan barat, Odin yang menentukan kemenangan pertempuran atau prajurit tertentu.
claim.en: In southern and western Germanic sources, Odin decided whether battles or individual warriors would be victorious.

claims_provenance.quote: In southern and western Germanic sources, it was Odin who decided whether battles or individual warriors would be victorious or end in slightly less fortunate ways.

claim.id: Odin digambarkan jatuh ke dalam trans, meninggalkan tubuhnya dan mengembara dalam wujud roh hewan, serta beberapa kali mendapat penglihatan kebijaksanaan lewat berbagai cobaan.
claim.en: Odin is described as falling into trances, leaving his body to travel in the spirit-form of an animal, and several times having visions of wisdom provoked by ordeals.

claims_provenance.quote: He [Odin] is described as falling into trances, as leaving his body behind and travelling abroad in the spirit-form of an animal, and several times as having visions of wisdom provoked by various kinds of ordeal.

claim.id: Pada 1070 M, Adam dari Bremen menulis bahwa di kuil Uppsala kuno patung Thor berdiri di tengah, Odin dan Freyr di sisinya, dan persembahan untuk Odin dibuat pada masa perang.
claim.en: In 1070 CE Adam of Bremen wrote that at the Old Uppsala temple a statue of Thor stood in the centre with Odin and Freyr at the sides, and that sacrifices were made to Odin in times of war.

claims_provenance.quote: in the great pagan temple of Old Uppsala in Sweden, too; in 1070 CE Adam of Bremen wrote of his visit to this place that a statue of Thor stood prominently in the centre of the hall, with Odin and Freyr to the side, and that sacrifices were made to Thor in case of famine, to Odin in times of war

claim.id: Beberapa nama dan gelar Odin berasal dari nama dewa Proto-Jermanik hasil rekonstruksi, Wōðanaz, yang berarti "penguasa kegilaan" atau "pemimpin orang yang kerasukan".
claim.en: Several of Odin's names and titles stem from the reconstructed Proto-Germanic theonym Wōðanaz, meaning "lord of frenzy" or "leader of the possessed".

claims_provenance.quote: Several of these stem from the reconstructed Proto-Germanic theonym Wōðanaz, meaning "lord of frenzy" or "leader of the possessed"

claim.id: Odin juga dikenal dalam mitologi Jermanik sebagai Woden (Inggris Kuno), Wodan (Franka Kuno), serta Wutan atau Wuotan (Jerman Kuno Tinggi).
claim.en: Odin also exists in Germanic mythology as Woden (Old English), Wodan (Old Franconian), and Wutan or Wuotan (Old High German).

claims_provenance.quote: He also exists in Germanic mythology as Woden (in Old English), Wodan (in Old Franconian), and Wutan or Wuotan (in Old High German).

claim.id: Menurut Edda Prosa, sang dewa tertinggi disebut Alfather, dan di Asgard lama ia memiliki dua belas nama.
claim.en: According to the Prose Edda, the highest god is called Alfather, and in old Asgard he had twelve names.

claims_provenance.quote: Alfather he is called in our tongue, but in Asgard of old he had twelve names.

claim.en: In the Prose Edda, Odin rides first, with golden helmet, resplendent byrnie, and his spear Gungner, and advances against the Fenris-wolf.

claims_provenance.quote: Odin rides first; with his golden helmet, resplendent byrnie, and his spear Gungner, he advances against the Fenris-wolf.

claim.en: Odin was adapted in Neil Gaiman's 2001 novel American Gods as Mr. Wednesday, a con artist revealed to be an incarnation of Odin.

claims_provenance.quote: He was also adapted in Neil Gaiman's 2001 novel American Gods as Mr. Wednesday, a con artist revealed to be an incarnation of Odin.

claim.id: Odin diadaptasi sebagai tokoh oleh Marvel Comics dan pertama muncul dalam seri Journey into Mystery pada 1962.
claim.en: Odin was adapted as a character by Marvel Comics, first appearing in the Journey into Mystery series in 1962.

claims_provenance.quote: Odin was adapted as a character by Marvel Comics, first appearing in the Journey into Mystery series in 1962.

claim.id: Sihir Odin membuatnya sering dipandang sebagai syaman, dan pandangan ini diperkuat oleh fungsinya sebagai dewa penyembuhan.
claim.en: The nature of Odin's magic often leads him to be seen as a shaman, an aspect reinforced by his function as a god of healing.

claims_provenance.quote: The nature of Odin's magic moreover often causes him to be seen as a shaman, an aspect which is further bolstered by his function as a god of healing.

claim.id: Sumber yang lebih luas menggambarkan Odin sebagai putra Bestla dan Borr, saudara Vili dan Vé, serta suami dewi Frigg, yang melahirkan Baldr; ia juga ayah Thor dari dewi bumi Jörð.
claim.en: Wider sources depict Odin as son of Bestla and Borr, brother of Vili and Vé, and husband of the goddess Frigg, with whom he fathered Baldr; he also fathered Thor with the earth-goddess Jörð.

claims_provenance.quote: Wider sources depict Odin as the son of Bestla and Borr; brother to Vili and Vé; and husband to the goddess Frigg, with whom he fathered Baldr. Odin has many other sons, including Thor, whom he sired with the earth-goddess Jörð.

claim.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, peran Odin sebagai Allfather lebih merupakan tema sastra dari sumber yang lebih muda, tampaknya dipengaruhi sebutan Kristen untuk Tuhan, ketimbang cerminan kedudukannya di masyarakat Zaman Viking.
claim.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, Odin's role as Allfather is more a literary theme from later sources, seemingly influenced by Christian names for God, than a reflection of his status in Viking Age societies.

claims_provenance.quote: Odin's role of 'Allfather' or father of the gods is more of a literary theme from later sources - seemingly influenced by Christian names for God - than an actual reflection of his status in Viking Age societies.

claim.id: Menurut Edda Prosa, Odin disebut Alfather karena ia bapak semua dewa dan manusia serta segala yang dibuat olehnya.
claim.en: According to the Prose Edda, Odin is called Alfather because he is the father of all gods and men and of all things made by him and his might.

claims_provenance.quote: And for this reason Odin is called Alfather, that he is the father of all gods and men, and of all things that were made by him and by his might.
claims_provenance.source_citation: Project Gutenberg — The Younger Edda; Also called Snorre's Edda, or The Prose Edda

claim.id: Odin terutama memakai sihir untuk melihat sekilas masa depan.

claims_provenance.quote: Odin used mainly magic to catch glimpses of the future.

claim.id: Dalam kisah mead puisi, Odin diizinkan tiga tegukan tetapi menghabiskan seluruh wadahnya, lalu berubah wujud menjadi elang dan kabur.
claim.en: In the story of the mead of poetry, Odin is allowed three sips but drains the containers, shape-shifts into an eagle and flees.

claims_provenance.quote: Because of this cosying up to her, he is allowed three sips, but he simply chugs and drains the containers, shape-shifts into an eagle and legs it (well, wings it) out of there.

claim.id: Odin tinggal di Asgard, benteng dan kediaman para dewa.
claim.en: Odin resides in Asgard, the stronghold and home of the gods.

claims_provenance.quote: resides in Asgard (the stronghold and home of the gods)

claim.id: Ukiran batu Swedia dari Zaman Perunggu menampilkan sosok dewa bertombak yang mungkin dikaitkan dengan Odin, dan paling lambat sekitar 500 M ia jelas muncul pada berbagai hiasan bersama burung dan prajurit.
claim.en: Bronze Age Swedish rock carvings show figures of a god holding a spear who might be linked to Odin, and by at least 500 CE he clearly appears on ornaments alongside birds and warriors.

claims_provenance.quote: Already in the Bronze Age do Swedish rock carvings depict figures of a god holding a spear, who with some imagination might be linked to Odin, and by at least 500 CE he clearly shows up on a range of ornaments alongside birds and warriors.

claim.id: Para pemuja utama Odin sebagian besar adalah kalangan elite, yaitu raja, kepala suku, dan penyair, serta juga prajurit.
claim.en: Odin's main group of worshippers mostly consisted of the elite, namely kings, chieftains and poets, but also included warriors.

claims_provenance.quote: Odin's main group of worshippers mostly consisted of the elite - kings, chieftains & poets - but also included warriors.

claim.id: Puisi skaldik menyebut Baldr, Thor, dan Vali sebagai putra Odin, sedangkan Snorri Sturluson pada abad ke-13 M menambahkan Heimdall, Týr, Bragi, Vidarr, dan Hodr.
claim.en: Skaldic poetry names Baldr, Thor and Vali as Odin's sons, whereas the 13th-century CE author Snorri Sturluson adds Heimdall, Týr, Bragi, Vidarr and Hodr.

claims_provenance.quote: Skaldic poetry (Viking Age, pre-Christian poetry mainly heard at courts by kings and their retinues), for instance, names Baldr, Thor, and Vali as Odin's sons, whereas later on the 13th-century CE Icelandic author Snorri Sturluson also adds Heimdall, Týr, Bragi, Vidarr, and Hodr to the list.

claim.id: Dalam Vafþrúðnismál Odin memulai adu kecerdasan dengan raksasa Vafþrúðnir dan mengalahkannya; dalam Grímnismál Odin yang menyamar disiksa dan akhirnya membuka pengetahuannya kepada Raja Geirroðr.
claim.en: In Vafþrúðnismál Odin starts a battle of wits with the giant Vafþrúðnir and beats him; in Grímnismál a disguised Odin is tortured and ends up revealing his mythical knowledge to King Geirroðr.

claims_provenance.quote: in the Vafþrúðnismál Odin initiates a battle of wits with the giant Vafþrúðnir and beats him, while in the Grímnismál a disguised Odin is tortured and ends up revealing his extensive mythical knowledge to King Geirroðr.

claim.id: Nama hari Wednesday dalam bahasa Inggris modern berasal dari "hari Woden" (wōdnesdæg dalam bahasa Inggris Kuno), dan masih terlihat pada nama Belanda woensdag.
claim.en: The modern English weekday name Wednesday traces its origin to "day of Woden" (wōdnesdæg in Old English), still seen in the Dutch name woensdag.

claims_provenance.quote: The modern English weekday name Wednesday traces its origins to "day of Woden", wōdnesdæg in Old English, and is still seen in the Dutch name woensdag.

short_description.id: Odin adalah dewa utama dalam mitologi Nordik yang digambarkan bijak dan bermata satu, dan terkait dengan perang, puisi, orang mati, rune, dan sihir.
short_description.en: Odin is the main god of Norse mythology, depicted as wise and one-eyed and associated with war, poetry, the dead, runes, and magic.

long_description.id: Odin adalah dewa utama dalam mitologi Nordik. Ia digambarkan sebagai lelaki tua yang sangat bijak dan bermata satu, dikenali dari topi dan jubahnya, janggut panjang, serta tombak Gungnir. Menurut sumber, ia tinggal di Asgard, benteng para dewa. Cincin Draupnir dan kuda berkaki delapan Sleipnir juga termasuk atributnya, dan dua gagaknya, Huginn dan Muninn, terbang berkeliling dunia mengumpulkan kabar lalu membisikkannya ke telinganya.
long_description.en: Odin is the main god of Norse mythology. He is depicted as an immensely wise, one-eyed old man, recognised by his hat and cloak, long beard, and spear Gungnir. According to the sources he resides in Asgard, the stronghold of the gods. The ring Draupnir and the eight-legged horse Sleipnir are also among his attributes, and his two ravens, Huginn and Muninn, fly around the world gathering news and whisper it into his ear.

long_description.id: Ranah Odin mencakup puisi, orang mati, rune, dan sihir, serta perang: dalam sumber Jermanik selatan dan barat, Odin yang menentukan apakah pertempuran atau prajurit tertentu menang. Para Valkyrie membawa prajurit yang gugur ke Valhalla; mereka dikenal sebagai Einherjar dan menjadi pasukan Odin melawan kekuatan dunia bawah saat Ragnarök. Odin juga digambarkan sebagai pemimpin Wild Hunt, pasukan orang mati yang menunggang badai. Sihirnya membuatnya sering dipandang sebagai syaman, dan ia juga memiliki fungsi sebagai dewa penyembuhan, dan ia memakai sihir untuk melihat sekilas masa depan.
long_description.en: Odin's domain covers poetry, the dead, runes, and magic, as well as war: in southern and western Germanic sources it is Odin who decides whether battles or individual warriors are victorious. The Valkyries bring slain fighters to Valhalla; these fighters, known as the Einherjar, become Odin's strike-force against the powers of the Underworld at Ragnarök. Odin is also portrayed as the leader of the Wild Hunt, an army of the dead who ride on the storms. His magic often leads him to be seen as a shaman and a god of healing, and he uses magic to catch glimpses of the future.

long_description.id: Kisah-kisah Odin banyak berkisah tentang pencarian pengetahuan. Menurut Edda Prosa, ia baru boleh minum dari sumur Mimer setelah meninggalkan salah satu matanya sebagai jaminan. Ia juga menggantung sembilan malam di Yggdrasil dengan luka tombak sebelum rune terungkap kepadanya, dan mencuri mead para skald lalu kabur dalam wujud elang. Dalam kisah penciptaan, Odin dan saudara-saudaranya Vili dan Vé membunuh raksasa purba Ymir dan membentuk bumi, langit, gunung, dan laut dari tubuhnya.
long_description.en: Many of Odin's stories concern the search for knowledge. According to the Prose Edda, he was allowed to drink from Mimer's well only after leaving one of his eyes there as a pledge. He also hangs for nine nights on Yggdrasil with a spear wound before the runes are revealed to him, and he steals the mead of the skalds and escapes in the shape of an eagle. In the creation story, Odin and his brothers Vili and Vé slay the proto-giant Ymir and make the earth, sky, mountains, and sea from his body.

long_description.id: Pada Ragnarök, Odin maju paling depan dengan helm emas, zirah gemerlap, dan tombak Gungner melawan serigala Fenris, dan ia terbunuh oleh Fenrir. Para pemuja utamanya sebagian besar kalangan elite, yaitu raja, kepala suku, dan penyair, serta prajurit. Adam dari Bremen menulis pada 1070 M bahwa di kuil Uppsala kuno persembahan untuk Odin dibuat pada masa perang. Kisah Odin dikenal antara lain dari Edda dan saga Islandia yang ditulis pada Abad Pertengahan.
long_description.en: At Ragnarök, Odin rides first with his golden helmet, resplendent byrnie, and spear Gungner against the Fenris-wolf, and he is killed by Fenrir. His main worshippers were mostly the elite, namely kings, chieftains, and poets, along with warriors. Adam of Bremen wrote in 1070 CE that at the Old Uppsala temple sacrifices were made to Odin in times of war. The tales of Odin are known from Edda writings and Icelandic sagas recorded in the Middle Ages.

learning_questions.id: Mengapa para penulis kemudian mungkin menggambarkan Odin sebagai Allfather meskipun kedudukannya di masyarakat Zaman Viking berbeda?

learning_questions.id: Pengorbanan apa saja yang dilakukan Odin untuk mendapatkan pengetahuan, dan apa yang diperolehnya?
learning_questions.en: What sacrifices does Odin make to gain knowledge, and what does he obtain?

learning_questions.id: Bagaimana atribut seperti gagak dan tombak membantu kita mengenali Odin dalam kisah dan hiasan?
learning_questions.en: How do attributes such as the ravens and the spear help us recognise Odin in stories and ornaments?

sources.title: Odin, Tor and the other Norse Gods
The Younger Edda; Also called Snorre's Edda, or The Prose Edda
sources.author: Snorri Sturluson (translated by Rasmus B. Anderson)

claims.quote: Odin (Old Norse: Óðinn) is the main god in Norse mythology. Described as an immensely wise, one-eyed old man

statement.id: Odin adalah dewa utama mitologi Nordik yang digambarkan bijak dan bermata satu.
statement.en: Odin is a leading Norse god depicted as wise and one-eyed.

claims.quote: the god of poetry, of the dead, of runes, and of magic.

statement.id: Odin terkait dengan puisi, orang mati, rune, dan sihir.
statement.en: Odin is associated with poetry, the dead, runes, and magic.

claims.quote: Odin's two ravens, Huginn ('thought') and Muninn ('wisdom') are very old mythical elements

statement.id: Dua gagak Odin bernama Huginn dan Muninn.
statement.en: Odin's two ravens are Huginn and Muninn.

claims.quote: In the mythic future, Odin leads the einherjar at Ragnarök, where he is killed by the monstrous wolf Fenrir.

statement.id: Dalam Ragnarök Odin dibunuh oleh Fenrir.
statement.en: Odin is killed by Fenrir at Ragnarök.

claims.quote: From written sources such as Snorri's Edda, other Edda poems and the Icelandic sagas, which was written down in the Middle Ages, we know the stories of Odin, Thor and the other Norse gods.

statement.id: Kisah Odin antara lain dikenal dari Edda dan saga Islandia yang ditulis pada Abad Pertengahan.
statement.en: Odin's tales survive in Edda writings and Icelandic sagas recorded in the Middle Ages.

claims.quote: gathers slain warriors around him in Valhalla ('hall of the slain')

statement.id: Odin mengumpulkan pejuang gugur di Valhalla.
statement.en: Odin gathers fallen warriors in Valhalla.

claims.quote: They fly around the world gathering news, and when they return, they sit on Odin's shoulder and whisper their tidings into his ear.

statement.id: Huginn dan Muninn terbang mencari kabar bagi Odin.
statement.en: The ravens fly to gather news for Odin.

claims.quote: Odin can be recognised by his hat and cloak, long beard, and only one eye

statement.id: Odin dikenali dari topi dan jubahnya, janggut panjang, dan hanya satu mata.
statement.en: Odin is recognised by his hat and cloak, long beard, and only one eye.

claims.quote: His spear Gungnir is one of his main attributes

statement.id: Tombak Gungnir adalah salah satu atribut utama Odin.
statement.en: His spear Gungnir is one of his main attributes.

claims.quote: Some other attributes are the ring Draupnir, which drips to form eight new rings every nine nights, and the horse Sleipnir, which is mentioned early on in Old Norse literature and is set apart by the somehow efficient total of eight legs.

statement.id: Atribut Odin lainnya adalah cincin Draupnir, yang meneteskan delapan cincin baru setiap sembilan malam, dan kuda Sleipnir yang berkaki delapan.
statement.en: Other attributes of Odin are the ring Draupnir, which drips eight new rings every nine nights, and the eight-legged horse Sleipnir.

claims.quote: Odin's immense knowledge is courtesy of Mímir's head (or else due to drinking from Mímir's well).

statement.id: Pengetahuan Odin yang luas disebut berasal dari kepala Mímir, atau dari minum air sumur Mímir.
statement.en: Odin's immense knowledge is said to come from Mímir's head, or else from drinking from Mímir's well.

claims.quote: The owner of the well hight Mimer. He is full of wisdom, for he drinks from the well with the Gjallar-horn. Alfather once came there and asked for a drink from the well, but he did not get it before he left one of his eyes as a pledge.

statement.id: Menurut Edda Prosa, Alfather tidak mendapat minum dari sumur Mimer sebelum meninggalkan salah satu matanya sebagai jaminan.
statement.en: According to the Prose Edda, Alfather received a drink from Mimer's well only after leaving one of his eyes there as a pledge.

claims.quote: nine nights of swinging from a branch of Yggdrasil, the World Tree, with a spear wound that put him close to death, and only then are the runes revealed to him.

statement.id: Odin menggantung sembilan malam di dahan Yggdrasil, pohon dunia, dengan luka tombak yang nyaris membunuhnya, dan baru setelah itu rune terungkap kepadanya.
statement.en: Odin hangs for nine nights from a branch of Yggdrasil, the World Tree, with a spear wound that brings him close to death, and only then are the runes revealed to him.

claims.quote: Snorri explains that Odin's superb poetic skills are due to him stealing the mead of the skalds (i.e. poets) by sleeping with the giantess Gunnlǫð, guardian of the mead, for three nights.

statement.id: Snorri menjelaskan bahwa kemahiran puisi Odin berasal dari pencurian mead para skald (penyair) setelah ia tidur tiga malam dengan raksasa perempuan Gunnlǫð, penjaga mead itu.
statement.en: Snorri explains that Odin's poetic skill comes from stealing the mead of the skalds (poets) after sleeping for three nights with the giantess Gunnlǫð, the mead's guardian.

claims.quote: his son Borr and the giant-daughter Bestla sired Odin and his brothers (usually named Vili and Vé)

statement.id: Borr dan raksasa perempuan Bestla menjadi orang tua Odin dan saudara-saudaranya, yang biasanya bernama Vili dan Vé.
statement.en: Borr and the giantess Bestla sired Odin and his brothers, usually named Vili and Vé.

claims.quote: The brothers then slew the proto-giant Ymir and used his flesh to create the earth, his skull to form the sky, his bones for the mountains, and his blood to make the sea.

statement.id: Odin bersaudara membunuh raksasa purba Ymir dan memakai dagingnya untuk bumi, tengkoraknya untuk langit, tulangnya untuk gunung, dan darahnya untuk laut.
statement.en: Odin and his brothers slew the proto-giant Ymir and made the earth from his flesh, the sky from his skull, the mountains from his bones, and the sea from his blood.

claims.quote: Odin's connection with war flows naturally into a connection with the dead, which is further illustrated by Odin as the leader of the so-called Wild Hunt - a widespread and old Germanic cult centred around a myth of an army of the dead who ride on the storms.

statement.id: Hubungan Odin dengan perang berlanjut ke hubungannya dengan orang mati, antara lain sebagai pemimpin Perburuan Liar (Wild Hunt), pasukan orang mati yang menunggang badai.
statement.en: Odin's link with war extends to a link with the dead, shown in his role as leader of the Wild Hunt, an army of the dead who ride on the storms.

claims.quote: Odin has his Valkyries - supernatural warrior women - bringing the bodies of fighters slain in battle to his special warrior paradise Valhalla; these fighters are known as the Einherjar and become Odin's strike-force against the encroaching powers of the Underworld during the Ragnarök.

statement.id: Para Valkyrie, perempuan prajurit gaib, membawa jasad prajurit yang gugur ke Valhalla; mereka dikenal sebagai Einherjar dan menjadi pasukan Odin melawan kekuatan dunia bawah saat Ragnarök.
statement.en: Odin's Valkyries, supernatural warrior women, bring fighters slain in battle to Valhalla; these fighters, the Einherjar, become Odin's strike-force against the powers of the Underworld at Ragnarök.

claims.quote: In southern and western Germanic sources, it was Odin who decided whether battles or individual warriors would be victorious or end in slightly less fortunate ways.

statement.id: Dalam sumber Jermanik selatan dan barat, Odin yang menentukan kemenangan pertempuran atau prajurit tertentu.
statement.en: In southern and western Germanic sources, Odin decided whether battles or individual warriors would be victorious.

claims.quote: He [Odin] is described as falling into trances, as leaving his body behind and travelling abroad in the spirit-form of an animal, and several times as having visions of wisdom provoked by various kinds of ordeal.

statement.id: Odin digambarkan jatuh ke dalam trans, meninggalkan tubuhnya dan mengembara dalam wujud roh hewan, serta beberapa kali mendapat penglihatan kebijaksanaan lewat berbagai cobaan.
statement.en: Odin is described as falling into trances, leaving his body to travel in the spirit-form of an animal, and several times having visions of wisdom provoked by ordeals.

claims.quote: in the great pagan temple of Old Uppsala in Sweden, too; in 1070 CE Adam of Bremen wrote of his visit to this place that a statue of Thor stood prominently in the centre of the hall, with Odin and Freyr to the side, and that sacrifices were made to Thor in case of famine, to Odin in times of war

statement.id: Pada 1070 M, Adam dari Bremen menulis bahwa di kuil Uppsala kuno patung Thor berdiri di tengah, Odin dan Freyr di sisinya, dan persembahan untuk Odin dibuat pada masa perang.
statement.en: In 1070 CE Adam of Bremen wrote that at the Old Uppsala temple a statue of Thor stood in the centre with Odin and Freyr at the sides, and that sacrifices were made to Odin in times of war.

claims.quote: Several of these stem from the reconstructed Proto-Germanic theonym Wōðanaz, meaning "lord of frenzy" or "leader of the possessed"

statement.id: Beberapa nama dan gelar Odin berasal dari nama dewa Proto-Jermanik hasil rekonstruksi, Wōðanaz, yang berarti "penguasa kegilaan" atau "pemimpin orang yang kerasukan".
statement.en: Several of Odin's names and titles stem from the reconstructed Proto-Germanic theonym Wōðanaz, meaning "lord of frenzy" or "leader of the possessed".

claims.quote: He also exists in Germanic mythology as Woden (in Old English), Wodan (in Old Franconian), and Wutan or Wuotan (in Old High German).

statement.id: Odin juga dikenal dalam mitologi Jermanik sebagai Woden (Inggris Kuno), Wodan (Franka Kuno), serta Wutan atau Wuotan (Jerman Kuno Tinggi).
statement.en: Odin also exists in Germanic mythology as Woden (Old English), Wodan (Old Franconian), and Wutan or Wuotan (Old High German).

claims.quote: Alfather he is called in our tongue, but in Asgard of old he had twelve names.

statement.id: Menurut Edda Prosa, sang dewa tertinggi disebut Alfather, dan di Asgard lama ia memiliki dua belas nama.
statement.en: According to the Prose Edda, the highest god is called Alfather, and in old Asgard he had twelve names.

claims.quote: Odin rides first; with his golden helmet, resplendent byrnie, and his spear Gungner, he advances against the Fenris-wolf.

statement.id: Dalam Edda Prosa, Odin maju paling depan dengan helm emas, baju zirah gemerlap, dan tombak Gungner melawan serigala Fenris.
statement.en: In the Prose Edda, Odin rides first, with golden helmet, resplendent byrnie, and his spear Gungner, and advances against the Fenris-wolf.

claims.quote: He was also adapted in Neil Gaiman's 2001 novel American Gods as Mr. Wednesday, a con artist revealed to be an incarnation of Odin.

statement.id: Odin diadaptasi dalam novel American Gods karya Neil Gaiman (2001) sebagai Mr. Wednesday, penipu yang ternyata adalah inkarnasi Odin.
statement.en: Odin was adapted in Neil Gaiman's 2001 novel American Gods as Mr. Wednesday, a con artist revealed to be an incarnation of Odin.

claims.quote: Odin was adapted as a character by Marvel Comics, first appearing in the Journey into Mystery series in 1962.

statement.id: Odin diadaptasi sebagai tokoh oleh Marvel Comics dan pertama muncul dalam seri Journey into Mystery pada 1962.
statement.en: Odin was adapted as a character by Marvel Comics, first appearing in the Journey into Mystery series in 1962.

claims.quote: The nature of Odin's magic moreover often causes him to be seen as a shaman, an aspect which is further bolstered by his function as a god of healing.

statement.id: Sihir Odin membuatnya sering dipandang sebagai syaman, dan pandangan ini diperkuat oleh fungsinya sebagai dewa penyembuhan.
statement.en: The nature of Odin's magic often leads him to be seen as a shaman, an aspect reinforced by his function as a god of healing.

claims.quote: Wider sources depict Odin as the son of Bestla and Borr; brother to Vili and Vé; and husband to the goddess Frigg, with whom he fathered Baldr. Odin has many other sons, including Thor, whom he sired with the earth-goddess Jörð.

statement.id: Sumber yang lebih luas menggambarkan Odin sebagai putra Bestla dan Borr, saudara Vili dan Vé, serta suami dewi Frigg, yang melahirkan Baldr; ia juga ayah Thor dari dewi bumi Jörð.
statement.en: Wider sources depict Odin as son of Bestla and Borr, brother of Vili and Vé, and husband of the goddess Frigg, with whom he fathered Baldr; he also fathered Thor with the earth-goddess Jörð.

claims.quote: Odin's role of 'Allfather' or father of the gods is more of a literary theme from later sources - seemingly influenced by Christian names for God - than an actual reflection of his status in Viking Age societies.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, peran Odin sebagai Allfather lebih merupakan tema sastra dari sumber yang lebih muda, tampaknya dipengaruhi sebutan Kristen untuk Tuhan, ketimbang cerminan kedudukannya di masyarakat Zaman Viking.
statement.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, Odin's role as Allfather is more a literary theme from later sources, seemingly influenced by Christian names for God, than a reflection of his status in Viking Age societies.

claims.quote: And for this reason Odin is called Alfather, that he is the father of all gods and men, and of all things that were made by him and by his might.

statement.id: Menurut Edda Prosa, Odin disebut Alfather karena ia bapak semua dewa dan manusia serta segala yang dibuat olehnya.
statement.en: According to the Prose Edda, Odin is called Alfather because he is the father of all gods and men and of all things made by him and his might.

claims.quote: Odin used mainly magic to catch glimpses of the future.

statement.id: Odin terutama memakai sihir untuk melihat sekilas masa depan.
statement.en: Odin mainly used magic to catch glimpses of the future.

claims.quote: Because of this cosying up to her, he is allowed three sips, but he simply chugs and drains the containers, shape-shifts into an eagle and legs it (well, wings it) out of there.

statement.id: Dalam kisah mead puisi, Odin diizinkan tiga tegukan tetapi menghabiskan seluruh wadahnya, lalu berubah wujud menjadi elang dan kabur.
statement.en: In the story of the mead of poetry, Odin is allowed three sips but drains the containers, shape-shifts into an eagle and flees.

claims.quote: resides in Asgard (the stronghold and home of the gods)

statement.id: Odin tinggal di Asgard, benteng dan kediaman para dewa.
statement.en: Odin resides in Asgard, the stronghold and home of the gods.

claims.quote: Already in the Bronze Age do Swedish rock carvings depict figures of a god holding a spear, who with some imagination might be linked to Odin, and by at least 500 CE he clearly shows up on a range of ornaments alongside birds and warriors.

statement.id: Ukiran batu Swedia dari Zaman Perunggu menampilkan sosok dewa bertombak yang mungkin dikaitkan dengan Odin, dan paling lambat sekitar 500 M ia jelas muncul pada berbagai hiasan bersama burung dan prajurit.
statement.en: Bronze Age Swedish rock carvings show figures of a god holding a spear who might be linked to Odin, and by at least 500 CE he clearly appears on ornaments alongside birds and warriors.

claims.quote: Odin's main group of worshippers mostly consisted of the elite - kings, chieftains & poets - but also included warriors.

statement.id: Para pemuja utama Odin sebagian besar adalah kalangan elite, yaitu raja, kepala suku, dan penyair, serta juga prajurit.
statement.en: Odin's main group of worshippers mostly consisted of the elite, namely kings, chieftains and poets, but also included warriors.

claims.quote: Skaldic poetry (Viking Age, pre-Christian poetry mainly heard at courts by kings and their retinues), for instance, names Baldr, Thor, and Vali as Odin's sons, whereas later on the 13th-century CE Icelandic author Snorri Sturluson also adds Heimdall, Týr, Bragi, Vidarr, and Hodr to the list.

statement.id: Puisi skaldik menyebut Baldr, Thor, dan Vali sebagai putra Odin, sedangkan Snorri Sturluson pada abad ke-13 M menambahkan Heimdall, Týr, Bragi, Vidarr, dan Hodr.
statement.en: Skaldic poetry names Baldr, Thor and Vali as Odin's sons, whereas the 13th-century CE author Snorri Sturluson adds Heimdall, Týr, Bragi, Vidarr and Hodr.

claims.quote: in the Vafþrúðnismál Odin initiates a battle of wits with the giant Vafþrúðnir and beats him, while in the Grímnismál a disguised Odin is tortured and ends up revealing his extensive mythical knowledge to King Geirroðr.

statement.id: Dalam Vafþrúðnismál Odin memulai adu kecerdasan dengan raksasa Vafþrúðnir dan mengalahkannya; dalam Grímnismál Odin yang menyamar disiksa dan akhirnya membuka pengetahuannya kepada Raja Geirroðr.
statement.en: In Vafþrúðnismál Odin starts a battle of wits with the giant Vafþrúðnir and beats him; in Grímnismál a disguised Odin is tortured and ends up revealing his mythical knowledge to King Geirroðr.

claims.quote: The modern English weekday name Wednesday traces its origins to "day of Woden", wōdnesdæg in Old English, and is still seen in the Dutch name woensdag.

statement.id: Nama hari Wednesday dalam bahasa Inggris modern berasal dari "hari Woden" (wōdnesdæg dalam bahasa Inggris Kuno), dan masih terlihat pada nama Belanda woensdag.
statement.en: The modern English weekday name Wednesday traces its origin to "day of Woden" (wōdnesdæg in Old English), still seen in the Dutch name woensdag.

summary.id: Edda Prosa menyatakan Odin disebut Alfather karena ia bapak semua dewa dan manusia.
summary.en: The Prose Edda says Odin is called Alfather because he is the father of all gods and men.

summary.id: World History Encyclopedia menyebut peran Allfather lebih merupakan tema sastra dari sumber yang lebih muda, tampaknya dipengaruhi sebutan Kristen untuk Tuhan.
summary.en: World History Encyclopedia calls the Allfather role more a literary theme from later sources, seemingly influenced by Christian names for God.

summary.id: Puisi skaldik menyebut Baldr, Thor, dan Vali sebagai putra Odin; Snorri menambahkan Heimdall, Týr, Bragi, Vidarr, dan Hodr.
summary.en: Skaldic poetry names Baldr, Thor and Vali as Odin's sons; Snorri adds Heimdall, Týr, Bragi, Vidarr and Hodr.

summary.id: Pengetahuan Odin berasal dari kepala Mímir, atau dari minum air sumur Mímir.
summary.en: Odin's knowledge comes from Mímir's head, or else from drinking from Mímir's well.

short_description.id: Osiris adalah dewa Mesir kuno, penguasa dunia bawah dan hakim orang mati, suami Isis yang dibunuh Set lalu dihidupkan kembali oleh Isis.
short_description.en: Osiris is the ancient Egyptian god who rules the underworld and judges the dead, husband of Isis, murdered by Set and revived by Isis.

long_description.id:
Dalam kepercayaan Mesir kuno, Osiris adalah Penguasa Dunia Bawah dan Hakim Orang Mati, suami sekaligus saudara Isis, dan salah satu dewa terpenting. Ia putra sulung Geb (bumi) dan Nut (langit). Namanya, Osiris, adalah bentuk Latin dari Usir yang ditafsirkan sebagai "perkasa", meskipun etimologinya disebut tidak pasti. Ia juga dikenal sebagai Wennefer, "Sang Indah", dan Khentiamenti, "Yang Terdepan di antara Orang Barat".

Menurut mitos utamanya, Osiris sebagai putra sulung memerintah sebagai Penguasa Bumi dengan Isis sebagai ratunya, dan memberi rakyat Mesir hukum, budaya, ajaran agama, dan pertanian. Saudaranya, Set, membuat peti mati seukuran tubuhnya; ketika Osiris berbaring di dalamnya, Set menutup dan menguncinya lalu melemparkannya ke Sungai Nil. Set kemudian mencincang jasadnya, tetapi Isis menghidupkannya kembali dan mengandung Horus. Osiris yang tidak utuh tak lagi dapat memerintah orang hidup dan mundur ke alam baka sebagai Penguasa dan Hakim Orang Mati. Horus kemudian bertempur melawan Set.

Osiris sering digambarkan dalam wujud mumi atau dibungkus kain kafan dengan hanya kepala dan tangan terlihat, memegang tongkat gembala dan cambuk, lambang kekuasaan raja; kedua benda itu mula-mula adalah lambang Osiris sebelum identik dengan firaun. Sebagai dewa hidup ia tampil sebagai pria tampan berpakaian kerajaan dengan mahkota atef. Kulitnya sering hitam atau hijau, melambangkan lumpur subur Nil dan pembaruan, dan ia dikaitkan dengan lambang djed serta burung Bennu. Dalam wujud mumi, ia turun ke dunia bawah dan, menurut keterangan museum, bergabung dengan dewa matahari Re setiap malam agar matahari terlahir kembali.

Abydos adalah pusat pemujaan Osiris, dan orang ingin dimakamkan sedekat mungkin dengannya. Festival Surutnya Nil memperingati kematiannya dan Festival Pilar Djed merayakan kebangkitannya; biji-bijian yang tumbuh dari kebun Osiris melambangkan kebangkitan itu. Raja-raja Mesir mengidentifikasi diri dengan Osiris setelah mati, dan ia dianggap hakim orang mati yang pengasih, pemaaf, dan adil. Ia dianggap menegakkan kerajaan serta tatanan alam dan hukum kehidupan. Pemujaannya berlangsung dari sesaat sebelum Periode Dinasti Awal hingga Dinasti Ptolemeus, dan kultus misterinya menyebar sebagai Kultus Isis.

Plutarch menulis versi Yunani kisah ini: Osiris lahir pada hari pertama dari hari-hari tambahan, dan sebagai raja ia mengajar rakyat menggunakan biji-bijian dan membuat hukum bagi mereka. Dalam versinya, Typhon menyusun persekongkolan dengan tujuh puluh dua sekutu, lalu mencabik jasad Osiris menjadi empat belas bagian. Osiris kemudian keluar dari dunia bawah untuk melatih Horus berperang. Plutarch juga menyamakan Osiris dengan Bacchus dan menyebut Sungai Nil sebagai pancaran Osiris.
long_description.en:
In ancient Egyptian religion Osiris is the Lord of the Underworld and Judge of the Dead, brother-husband of Isis, and one of the most important gods. He is the firstborn of Geb (earth) and Nut (sky). His name, Osiris, is the Latinized form of Usir, interpreted as "powerful" or "mighty", although its etymology is also described as uncertain. He was also known as Wennefer, "The Beautiful One", and Khentiamenti, "The Foremost of the Westerners".

In his central myth, Osiris, as firstborn, rules as Lord of the Earth with Isis as his queen and gives the people of Egypt laws, culture, religious instruction, and agriculture. His brother Set has a coffin made to his measure; when Osiris lies down in it, Set shuts and fastens the lid and throws it into the Nile. Set later hacks the body to pieces, but Isis revives him and conceives Horus. Incomplete, Osiris can no longer rule the living and withdraws into the afterlife as Lord and Judge of the Dead. Horus later battles Set.

Osiris is often shown as a mummy, wrapped in a shroud from which only the head and hands emerge, holding the crook and flail, symbols of kingship that were first Osiris' symbols before becoming synonymous with pharaohs. As a living god he appears as a handsome man in royal dress wearing the atef crown. His skin is often black or green, symbolizing the fertile mud of the Nile and regeneration, and he is associated with the djed symbol and the Bennu bird. In mummy form he descends to the underworld and, according to the museum account, merges with the sun god Re each night so that the sun can be reborn.

Abydos was the cult center of Osiris, and people wanted to be buried as close to him as possible. The festival of the Fall of the Nile commemorated his death and the Djed Pillar Festival celebrated his resurrection; the grain sprouting from an Osiris garden symbolized that rising. Egypt's kings identified with Osiris in death, and he was regarded as a merciful, forgiving, and just judge of the dead. He was credited with establishing kingship and the natural order and law of life. His worship ran from shortly before the Early Dynastic Period to the Ptolemaic Dynasty, and his mystery cult spread as the Cult of Isis.

Plutarch records a Greek version of the story: Osiris is born on the first of the added days, and as king teaches the people the use of grain and makes laws for them. In his account Typhon plots with seventy-two accomplices and then tears Osiris's body into fourteen parts. Osiris later comes out of the underworld to train Horus for war. Plutarch also equates Osiris with Bacchus and calls the Nile the efflux of Osiris.

origin.en: Firstborn of the gods Geb (earth) and Nut (sky) in ancient Egyptian belief.

role.id: Raja awal Mesir yang dibunuh saudaranya, Set, dihidupkan kembali oleh Isis, dan menjadi penguasa alam baka.
role.en: Early king of Egypt who was murdered by his brother Set, revived by Isis, and became ruler of the afterlife.

famous_for.id: Dikenal karena kisah kematian dan kebangkitannya serta perannya sebagai hakim orang mati.
famous_for.en: Known for the story of his death and revival and for his role as judge of the dead.

did_you_know.id: Plutarch menjelaskan keberadaan banyak makam Osiris di Mesir lewat kisah bahwa Isis mengadakan pemakaman tersendiri bagi tiap anggota tubuhnya yang ia temukan.
did_you_know.en: Plutarch explains the many sepulchres of Osiris in Egypt through the story that Isis held a separate funeral for each part of his body as she found it.

cultural_context.id: Menurut sumber, mitos Osiris mewujudkan sebagian nilai terpenting budaya Mesir: keselarasan, ketertiban, hidup abadi, dan rasa syukur.
cultural_context.en: According to the source, the Osiris myth carried several central cultural values of Egypt: harmony, order, eternal life, and gratitude.

description.id: Osiris adalah Hakim Orang Mati dan hakim yang pengasih, pemaaf, dan adil yang mengawasi kehidupan seseorang di bumi dan di alam baka.
description.en: Osiris is Judge of the Dead, a merciful, forgiving, and just judge who oversaw one's life on earth and in the afterlife.

name.en: Renewing the earth and restoring life

description.id: Sungai Nil dianggap lambang kekuatan Osiris memberi kehidupan dan melambangkan kemampuannya memperbarui bumi dan memulihkan kehidupan bagi bangsa itu.
description.en: The Nile was considered a symbol of Osiris' life-giving power and represented his capacity to renew the earth and restore life to the nation.

description.id: Sebagai penguasa alam baka, Osiris menyatu dengan dewa matahari Re setiap malam agar matahari terlahir kembali dan ia sendiri tetap hidup abadi.
description.en: As lord of the afterlife, Osiris merges with the sun god Re each night to enable the sun's rebirth and his own eternal survival.

description.id: Dalam sebagian kecil penggambaran, Osiris tampil sebagai sosok menakutkan yang mengutus utusan-iblis untuk menyeret orang hidup ke alam orang mati.
description.en: In a minority of depictions Osiris appears as a terrifying figure who dispatches demon-messengers to drag the living into the realm of the dead.

description.id: Pria tampan berpakaian kerajaan dengan mahkota atef, membawa tongkat gembala dan cambuk.
description.en: A handsome man in royal dress wearing the atef crown, carrying the crook and flail.

description.id: Osiris sering ditampilkan sebagai mumi atau setengah termumifikasi, terbungkus kain kafan dengan hanya kepala dan tangan terlihat.
description.en: Osiris is often shown as a mummy or partially mummified, wrapped in a shroud with only the head and hands visible.

description.id: Plutarch mencatat versi kisah dengan Typhon sebagai musuh Osiris, jasad yang dicabik menjadi empat belas bagian, dan penyamaan Osiris dengan Bacchus.
description.en: Plutarch records a version of the story in which Typhon is the enemy of Osiris, the body is torn into fourteen parts, and Osiris is equated with Bacchus.

title.en: The murder and revival of Osiris

role.id: Osiris adalah korban pembunuhan yang dihidupkan kembali dan menjadi penguasa alam baka.
role.en: Osiris is the murdered king who is revived and becomes ruler of the afterlife.

summary.id: Set membuat peti mati seukuran tubuh Osiris dan menjebaknya di dalamnya, lalu melemparkan peti itu ke Sungai Nil. Peti itu tersangkut pada pohon dekat Byblos. Set kemudian mencincang jasad Osiris, tetapi Isis menghidupkannya kembali dan mengandung Horus. Osiris mundur ke alam baka sebagai Penguasa dan Hakim Orang Mati.
summary.en: Set has a coffin made to Osiris' measure and traps him in it, then throws it into the Nile. The coffin lodges in a tree near Byblos. Set later hacks the body to pieces, but Isis revives Osiris and conceives Horus. Osiris withdraws into the afterlife as Lord and Judge of the Dead.

title.id: Osiris sebagai raja pertama dan pemberi peradaban
title.en: Osiris as first king and giver of civilization

role.id: Osiris memerintah Mesir dan memberinya hukum dan pertanian.
role.en: Osiris rules Egypt and gives it laws and agriculture.

summary.id: Osiris memerintah sebagai Penguasa Bumi dengan Isis sebagai ratunya dan memberi rakyat hukum, budaya, ajaran agama, dan pertanian. Ia dianggap raja pertama Mesir yang menetapkan nilai-nilai budaya bagi para raja berikutnya. Plutarch menyebut ia juga menunjukkan kegunaan biji-bijian dan membuat hukum bagi rakyat.
summary.en: Osiris rules as Lord of the Earth with Isis as his queen and gives the people laws, culture, religious instruction, and agriculture. He was considered the first king of Egypt, setting the cultural values for later kings. Plutarch adds that he showed the people the use of grain and made laws for them.

role.id: Osiris adalah ayah Horus, yang membalas kematiannya.
role.en: Osiris is the father of Horus, who contends with Set.

summary.id: Horus tampil sebagai prajurit perkasa dan bertempur melawan Set untuk menguasai dunia; dalam sebagian versi Set dibunuh, dalam kebanyakan versi ia dikalahkan dan diusir. Dalam Plutarch, Osiris keluar dari dunia bawah untuk melatih Horus berperang.
summary.en: Horus emerges as a mighty warrior and battles Set for control of the world; in some versions Set is killed, in most he is defeated and driven out. In Plutarch, Osiris comes out of the underworld to train Horus for war.

description.en: The cult center of Osiris; its necropolis became the most sought-after burial ground.

description.en: Osiris' rebirth was associated with the Nile, regarded as a symbol of his life-giving power.

description.en: The mysteries of Osiris were celebrated at Abydos beginning in the Twelfth Dynasty and may be the origin of the mystery cult of Isis.

claim.id: Isis mampu menghidupkan Osiris kembali; ia berubah menjadi layang-layang (kite), mengitarinya, menarik benih dari tubuhnya, dan mengandung putra bernama Horus. Meski hidup lagi, Osiris tidak utuh dan tak dapat lagi memerintah negeri orang hidup; ia mundur ke alam baka dan menjadi Penguasa dan Hakim Orang Mati.
claim.en: Isis was able to revive Osiris; she took the form of a kite, flew around him, drew the seed from his body into her own, and became pregnant with a son, Horus. Though alive again, Osiris was incomplete and could no longer rule the land of the living; he withdrew into the afterlife, where he became Lord and Judge of the Dead.

claims_provenance.quote: Isis was able to revive Osiris and, once he was alive, she assumed the form of a kite and flew around him, drew the seed from his body into her own, and became pregnant with a son, Horus. Even though Osiris now lived, he was incomplete and could no longer rule the land of the living. He withdrew into the afterlife where he became Lord and Judge of the Dead.

claim.id: Horus tampil sebagai prajurit perkasa dan bertempur melawan Set untuk menguasai dunia. Dalam sebagian versi Set dibunuh, tetapi dalam kebanyakan versi ia dikalahkan dan diusir dari negeri itu.
claim.en: Horus emerged as a mighty warrior and battled Set for control of the world. In some versions Set is killed, but in most he is defeated and driven from the land.

claims_provenance.quote: Horus emerged as a mighty warrior and battled Set for control of the world. In some versions of the story, Set is killed but, in most, he is defeated and driven from the land.

claim.id: Kota Abydos adalah pusat pemujaannya, dan nekropolis di sana menjadi pemakaman paling diincar karena orang ingin dimakamkan sedekat mungkin dengan sang dewa.
claim.en: The city of Abydos was his cult center, and its necropolis became the most sought-after burial ground because people wanted to be buried as close to the god as possible.

claims_provenance.quote: The city of Abydos was his cult center and the necropolis there became the most sought-after burial ground as people wanted to be buried as close to the god as they could get.

claim.id: Kelahiran kembali Osiris dikaitkan dengan Sungai Nil, yang dianggap lambang kekuatannya memberi kehidupan.
claim.en: Osiris' rebirth was associated with the Nile River, which was considered a symbol of his life-giving power.

claims_provenance.quote: Osiris' rebirth was associated with the Nile River, which was considered a symbol of his life-giving power.

claim.id: Sungai Nil melambangkan kemampuan Osiris memperbarui bumi dan memulihkan kehidupan bagi bangsa itu.
claim.en: The Nile represented Osiris' capacity to renew the earth and to restore life to the nation.

claims_provenance.quote: The Nile represented Osiris' capacity to renew the earth and to restore life to the nation.

claim.id: Festival Surutnya Nil memperingati kematiannya, sedangkan Festival Pilar Djed merayakan kebangkitan Osiris.
claim.en: The festival of the Fall of the Nile commemorated his death, while the Djed Pillar Festival celebrated Osiris' resurrection.

claims_provenance.quote: The festival of the Fall of the Nile commemorated his death while the Djed Pillar Festival celebrated Osiris' resurrection.

claim.id: Biji-bijian yang kemudian tumbuh melambangkan Osiris bangkit dari kematian sekaligus janji hidup abadi bagi orang yang merawat kebun itu.
claim.en: The grains that later grew symbolized Osiris rising from the dead and also the promise of eternal life for the one who tended the garden.

claims_provenance.quote: The grains which would later grow symbolized Osiris rising from the dead and also the promise of eternal life for the one who tended the garden.

claim.id: Meski tak ada yang tahu ritual apa saja dalam kultus misteri Isis, ritual itu mungkin berkembang dari misteri Osiris yang lebih awal, dirayakan di Abydos sejak Dinasti Kedua Belas (1991–1802 SM).
claim.en: Although no one knows what rituals were involved in the mystery cult of Isis, they may have developed from Osiris' earlier mysteries celebrated at Abydos beginning in the Twelfth Dynasty (1991-1802 BCE).

claims_provenance.quote: Although no one knows what rituals were involved in the mystery cult of Isis, they may have developed from Osiris' earlier mysteries celebrated at Abydos beginning in the Twelfth Dynasty (1991-1802 BCE).

claim.id: Identifikasi Osiris dengan hidup abadi, dengan kehidupan dari kematian, melahirkan kultus misterinya yang kemudian menyebar melampaui Mesir sebagai Kultus Isis.
claim.en: Osiris' identification with eternal life, with life from death, gave rise to his mystery cult, which would travel beyond Egypt as the Cult of Isis.

claims_provenance.quote: Osiris' identification with eternal life, with life from death, gave rise to his mystery cult which would travel beyond the boundaries of Egypt as the Cult of Isis.

claim.id: Osiris dianggap raja pertama Mesir yang menetapkan nilai-nilai budaya yang wajib dijunjung semua raja sesudahnya.
claim.en: Osiris was considered the first king of Egypt, who established the cultural values all later kings were sworn to uphold.

claims_provenance.quote: Osiris was considered the first king of Egypt who established the cultural values all later kings were sworn to uphold.

claim.id: Raja-raja Mesir mengidentifikasi diri dengan Horus semasa hidup dan dengan Osiris setelah mati.
claim.en: The kings of Egypt identified with Horus during life and with Osiris in death.

claims_provenance.quote: The kings of Egypt identified with Horus during life (they each had a personal name and a 'Horus Name' they took at the beginning of their reign) and with Osiris in death.

claim.id: Cambuk dan tongkat gembala yang terkenal, identik dengan firaun Mesir, mula-mula adalah lambang Osiris: cambuk mewakili kesuburan negerinya dan tongkat gembala melambangkan wibawa kekuasaannya.
claim.en: The famous flail and shepherd's staff, synonymous with Egyptian pharaohs, were first Osiris' symbols: the flail represented the fertility of his land and the crook symbolized the authority of his rule.

claims_provenance.quote: the famous flail and shepherd's staff, synonymous with Egyptian pharaohs, were first Osiris' symbols as the flail represented the fertility of his land while the crook symbolized the authority of his rule.

claim.id: Osiris dianggap menegakkan baik kerajaan maupun tatanan alam dan hukum kehidupan, sehingga dengan berperan dalam komunitas dan menjalankan ritual, orang mengikuti pedoman Osiris.
claim.en: Osiris was credited with establishing both kingship and the natural order and law of life, so that through participation in one's community and observance of rituals one was following Osiris' guidelines.

claims_provenance.quote: Osiris was credited with establishing both the kingship and the natural order and law of life and so, through one's participation in one's community and observance of rituals, one was following Osiris' guidelines.

claim.id: Osiris adalah hakim orang mati yang maha pengasih, pemaaf, dan adil, yang mengawasi kehidupan seseorang di bumi dan di alam baka.
claim.en: Osiris was the all-merciful, the forgiving, and the just judge of the dead, who oversaw one's life on earth and in the afterlife.

claims_provenance.quote: Osiris was the all-merciful, the forgiving, and the just judge of the dead who oversaw one's life on earth and in the afterlife.

claim.id: Dalam Plutarch, pada hari pertama dari hari-hari tambahan (Epagomenae), Osiris lahir, dan sebuah suara datang ke dunia bersamanya, berkata bahwa Penguasa segala sesuatu kini telah lahir.
claim.en: In Plutarch, on the first of the added days (the Epagomenae) Osiris was born, and a voice came into the world with him, saying that the Lord of all things was now born.

claims_provenance.quote: Upon the first of these, as they say, Osiris was born, and a voice came into the world with him, saying, The Lord of all things is now born.
claims_provenance.source_citation: Project Gutenberg — Plutarch's Essays and Miscellanies, Vol. 4 (of 5): Of Isis and Osiris, or of the Ancient Religion and Philosophy of Egypt

claim.id: Dalam Plutarch, dikatakan Osiris dan Arueris dilahirkan oleh Matahari, Isis oleh Hermes, serta Typhon dan Nephthys oleh Saturnus.
claim.en: In Plutarch, Osiris and Arueris are said to have been begotten by the Sun, Isis by Hermes, and Typhon and Nephthys by Saturn.

claims_provenance.quote: Of these they say Osiris and Arueris were begot by the Sun, Isis by Hermes, and Typhon and Nephthys by Saturn.
claims_provenance.source_citation: Project Gutenberg — Plutarch's Essays and Miscellanies, Vol. 4 (of 5): Of Isis and Osiris, or of the Ancient Religion and Philosophy of Egypt

claim.id: Dalam Plutarch, Osiris ketika menjadi raja Mesir menarik rakyat dari cara hidup melarat dan kebinatangan dengan menunjukkan kegunaan biji-bijian, membuat hukum, dan mengajar mereka menghormati para dewa.
claim.en: In Plutarch, Osiris as king of Egypt drew the people off from a beggarly and bestial way of living by showing them the use of grain, making them laws, and teaching them to honor the Gods.

claims_provenance.quote: And they say that Osiris, when he was king of Egypt, drew them off from a beggarly and bestial way of living, by showing them the use of grain, and by making them laws, and teaching them to honor the Gods
claims_provenance.source_citation: Project Gutenberg — Plutarch's Essays and Miscellanies, Vol. 4 (of 5): Of Isis and Osiris, or of the Ancient Religion and Philosophy of Egypt

claim.id: Dalam Plutarch, Typhon, saudara Osiris dalam kisah itu, menyusun persekongkolan dengan tujuh puluh dua orang sekutu dan dibantu seorang ratu Etiopia bernama Aso.
claim.en: In Plutarch, Typhon, the antagonist of the story, formed a plot with seventy-two men as accomplices, abetted by a certain Queen of Ethiopia named Aso.

claims_provenance.quote: he formed a plot against him, taking seventy-two men for accomplices of his conspiracy, and being also abetted by a certain Queen of Ethiopia, whose name they say was Aso.
claims_provenance.source_citation: Project Gutenberg — Plutarch's Essays and Miscellanies, Vol. 4 (of 5): Of Isis and Osiris, or of the Ancient Religion and Philosophy of Egypt

claim.id: Dalam Plutarch, Typhon yang berburu di bawah cahaya bulan kebetulan menemukan peti itu, mengenali jasad itu, lalu mencabiknya menjadi empat belas bagian dan melemparkannya ke segala arah.
claim.en: In Plutarch, Typhon, hunting by moonlight, chanced upon the chest, recognized the body, tore it into fourteen parts, and threw them all about.

claims_provenance.quote: Typhon, as he was hunting by moonshine, by chance lighted upon it, and knowing the body again, tore it into fourteen parts, and threw them all about.
claims_provenance.source_citation: Project Gutenberg — Plutarch's Essays and Miscellanies, Vol. 4 (of 5): Of Isis and Osiris, or of the Ancient Religion and Philosophy of Egypt

claim.id: Dalam Plutarch, laporan bahwa ada banyak makam Osiris di Mesir dijelaskan oleh kisah bahwa Isis mengadakan pemakaman tersendiri bagi tiap anggota tubuh yang ia temukan.
claim.en: In Plutarch, the report that there are many sepulchres of Osiris in Egypt is explained by the story that Isis held a separate funeral for each member of the body as she found them.

claims_provenance.quote: there are many sepulchres of Osiris in Egypt, because she made a particular funeral for each member as she found them.
claims_provenance.source_citation: Project Gutenberg — Plutarch's Essays and Miscellanies, Vol. 4 (of 5): Of Isis and Osiris, or of the Ancient Religion and Philosophy of Egypt

claim.id: Dalam Plutarch, Osiris keluar dari dunia bawah untuk membantu putranya, Horus, dan mula-mula melatihnya dalam disiplin perang.
claim.en: In Plutarch, Osiris comes out of the underworld to assist his son Horus and first trains him in the discipline of war.

claims_provenance.quote: Osiris coming out of hell to assist his son Horus, first labored and trained him up in the discipline of war
claims_provenance.source_citation: Project Gutenberg — Plutarch's Essays and Miscellanies, Vol. 4 (of 5): Of Isis and Osiris, or of the Ancient Religion and Philosophy of Egypt

claim.id: Plutarch menyimpulkan lebih baik menyamakan Osiris dengan Bacchus, dan Serapis kembali dengan Osiris.
claim.en: Plutarch concludes it is better to make Osiris the same as Bacchus, and Serapis again the same as Osiris.

claims_provenance.quote: It is therefore better to make Osiris to be the same with Bacchus, and Serapis again with Osiris
claims_provenance.source_citation: Project Gutenberg — Plutarch's Essays and Miscellanies, Vol. 4 (of 5): Of Isis and Osiris, or of the Ancient Religion and Philosophy of Egypt

claim.id: Menurut Plutarch, mereka menyebut Sungai Nil sebagai pancaran Osiris, sebagaimana bumi dianggap tubuh Isis.
claim.en: According to Plutarch, they call the Nile the efflux of Osiris, just as they hold the earth to be the body of Isis.

claims_provenance.quote: And as they term the Nile the efflux of Osiris, so they hold and esteem the earth for the body of Isis
claims_provenance.source_citation: Project Gutenberg — Plutarch's Essays and Miscellanies, Vol. 4 (of 5): Of Isis and Osiris, or of the Ancient Religion and Philosophy of Egypt

claim.id: Mitos itu mewujudkan sebagian nilai terpenting budaya Mesir: keselarasan, ketertiban, hidup abadi, dan rasa syukur.
claim.en: The myth embodied some of the most important values of Egyptian culture: harmony, order, eternal life, and gratitude.

claims_provenance.quote: The myth embodied some of the most important values of Egyptian culture: harmony, order, eternal life, and gratitude.
