claims.quote: in those poems Dionysus does not appear as one of the great divinities, and the story of his birth by Zeus and the Bacchic orgies are not alluded to in any way : Dionysus is there simply described as the god who teaches man the preparation of wine

statement.id: Dalam puisi-puisi Homeros, Dionysus tidak tampil sebagai salah satu dewa besar, dan ceritanya hanya digambarkan sebagai dewa yang mengajarkan manusia membuat anggur.
statement.en: In the Homeric poems Dionysus does not appear as one of the great divinities, but is simply described as the god who teaches man the preparation of wine.

claims.quote: The god gave Ikarios, a noble citizen of Ikaria in Attica, the vine tree.

statement.id: Sang dewa memberikan pohon anggur kepada Ikarios, warga terhormat Ikaria di Attika.
statement.en: The god gave Ikarios, a noble citizen of Ikaria in Attica, the vine tree.

claims.quote: In gratitude, the god granted Midas a wish. The king requested that everything he touched would turn to gold but alas this included food and water, so the king almost died of starvation and thirst until Dionysos reversed the gift by telling Midas to wash in the Pactolus river.

statement.id: Sebagai balas budi, sang dewa mengabulkan satu permintaan Midas; raja meminta semua yang disentuhnya menjadi emas, hingga hampir mati kelaparan dan kehausan, sampai Dionysos membatalkan pemberian itu dengan menyuruhnya mandi di sungai Pactolus.
statement.en: In gratitude, the god granted Midas a wish; the king asked that everything he touched turn to gold, and almost died of starvation and thirst until Dionysos reversed the gift by telling him to wash in the Pactolus river.

claims.quote: The god transformed the ship's mast into a huge vine, the sails dripped with wine, and a heavenly choir filled the air with music. Dionysos transformed himself into a lion and, assisted by a bear, he dispatched the pirate captain.

statement.id: Sang dewa mengubah tiang kapal menjadi pohon anggur raksasa, layar meneteskan anggur, dan paduan suara surgawi memenuhi udara; Dionysos berubah menjadi singa dan, dibantu seekor beruang, menghabisi kapten bajak laut.
statement.en: The god transformed the ship's mast into a huge vine, the sails dripped with wine, and a heavenly choir filled the air with music; Dionysos transformed himself into a lion and, assisted by a bear, dispatched the pirate captain.

claims.quote: falling in love with and marrying Ariadne when Theseus stopped off on his return from killing the Minotaur.

statement.id: Di Naxos, Dionysos jatuh cinta dan menikahi Ariadne ketika Theseus singgah dalam perjalanan pulang setelah membunuh Minotaur.
statement.en: At Naxos, Dionysos fell in love with and married Ariadne when Theseus stopped off on his return from killing the Minotaur.

claims.quote: Hera in her gratitude ensured that Dionysos, actually only a demigod, became a full Olympian god with permission to reside on Mt. Olympus for all time.

statement.id: Dalam rasa terima kasih, Hera memastikan Dionysos, yang sebenarnya hanya setengah dewa, menjadi dewa Olimpus penuh dengan izin tinggal di Gunung Olimpus selamanya.
statement.en: In her gratitude Hera ensured that Dionysos, actually only a demigod, became a full Olympian god with permission to reside on Mt. Olympus for all time.

claims.quote: Lycurgus, King of Thrace, and Pentheus, King of Thebes, both suffered Dionysos' wrath when they prudishly tried to stop the excesses of the god's festivals. The former was driven mad and the latter was ripped to pieces by a maddened group of female worshippers after he had disguised himself as a woman to spy on their debauchery.

statement.id: Lycurgus, raja Thrace, dan Pentheus, raja Thebes, sama-sama menanggung murka Dionysos ketika mencoba menghentikan perayaannya; yang pertama menjadi gila dan yang kedua dicabik oleh para pemuja perempuan yang kalap.
statement.en: Lycurgus, King of Thrace, and Pentheus, King of Thebes, both suffered Dionysos' wrath when they tried to stop the excesses of his festivals; the former was driven mad and the latter was ripped to pieces by a maddened group of female worshippers.

claims.quote: The cult of Dionysos became a significant part of the Greek religion in Athens from the 6th century BCE and the Dionysia festival of Athens and other cities would later evolve into the Bacchanalia of Rome.

statement.id: Kultus Dionysos menjadi bagian penting agama Yunani di Athena sejak abad ke-6 SM, dan festival Dionysia kemudian berkembang menjadi Bacchanalia di Roma.
statement.en: The cult of Dionysos became a significant part of Greek religion in Athens from the 6th century BCE, and the Dionysia festival would later evolve into the Bacchanalia of Rome.

claims.quote: The island of Naxos was a particularly important sanctuary to the god. There is evidence of a cult to Dionysos dating from the Mycenaean period (14th century BCE)

statement.id: Pulau Naxos adalah tempat suci yang sangat penting bagi sang dewa; ada bukti kultus Dionysos sejak masa Mikenai (abad ke-14 SM).
statement.en: The island of Naxos was a particularly important sanctuary to the god; there is evidence of a cult of Dionysos dating from the Mycenaean period (14th century BCE).

claims.quote: He is often identified through his association with the vine, thyrsos - a sacred rod topped with ivy and vine leaves and sometimes a pinecone, a kantharos - drinking vessel for wine - or a drinking-horn, and on occasion, he wears a wreath of ivy or the pelt of a panther.
claims.locator: How is Dionysos Represented in Art?

statement.id: Dionysos sering dikenali dari kaitannya dengan pohon anggur, thyrsos, kantharos atau tanduk minum, dan kadang karangan ivy atau kulit macan tutul.
statement.en: Dionysos is often identified through his association with the vine, thyrsos, a kantharos or drinking-horn, and on occasion a wreath of ivy or the pelt of a panther.

claims.quote: is often depicted with his thiasos or troupe of satyrs (half-men, half-goat) and nymphs, who from the late 6th century BCE were replaced by maenads, daemonic creatures, who when overtaken by Dionysian frenzy, hunted the forests for victims and ate their raw flesh.
claims.locator: How is Dionysos Represented in Art?

statement.id: Dalam seni Arkais dan Klasik, Dionysos sering digambarkan bersama thiasos, rombongan satir dan nimfa, yang sejak akhir abad ke-6 SM digantikan para maenad, makhluk daimonik yang saat dilanda kegilaan Dionysian memburu korban di hutan dan memakan dagingnya mentah.
statement.en: In Archaic and Classical Greek art, Dionysos is often depicted with his thiasos or troupe of satyrs and nymphs, who from the late 6th century BCE were replaced by maenads, daemonic creatures who in Dionysian frenzy hunted the forests for victims and ate their raw flesh.

claims.quote: It is believed that theatre sprang from this activity as, like Dionysos' worshippers, actors strive to leave behind their own persona and become one with the character they are playing. Indeed, priests of Dionysos were given seats of honour in Greek theatres.

statement.id: Diyakini teater bermula dari kegiatan ritual ini karena para aktor, seperti pemuja Dionysos, berusaha meninggalkan pribadi mereka dan menyatu dengan tokoh yang dimainkan; para imam Dionysos mendapat tempat duduk kehormatan di teater Yunani.
statement.en: It is believed that theatre sprang from this activity as actors, like Dionysos' worshippers, strive to leave behind their own persona and become one with the character they play; priests of Dionysos were given seats of honour in Greek theatres.

claims.quote: Most accounts then attribute the satyrs and nymphs as the carers of Dionysos in his childhood and the wise Silenus as his chief educator on Mt. Nysa, far from Hera's wrath.

statement.id: Sebagian besar kisah menyebut para satir dan nimfa sebagai pengasuh Dionysos di masa kecil, dan Silenus yang bijak sebagai pendidik utamanya di Gunung Nysa, jauh dari murka Hera.
statement.en: Most accounts attribute the satyrs and nymphs as the carers of Dionysos in his childhood and the wise Silenus as his chief educator on Mt. Nysa, far from Hera's wrath.

claims.quote: the bonds would not hold him, and the withes fell far away from his hands and feet

statement.id: Dalam Himne Homerik VII, ikatan para bajak laut tidak dapat menahannya dan lepas dari tangan dan kakinya.
statement.en: In Homeric Hymn 7, the pirates' bonds would not hold him and fell away from his hands and feet.

claims.quote: But soon strange things were seen among them. First of all sweet, fragrant wine ran streaming throughout all the black ship and a heavenly smell arose

statement.id: Dalam Himne Homerik VII, anggur yang manis dan harum mengalir di seluruh kapal dan aroma surgawi menyebar.
statement.en: In Homeric Hymn 7, sweet, fragrant wine ran streaming throughout the ship and a heavenly smell arose.

claims.quote: But the god changed into a dreadful lion there on the ship, in the bows, and roared loudly ... and were changed into dolphins.

statement.id: Dalam Himne Homerik VII, sang dewa berubah menjadi singa yang mengerikan di kapal; para pelaut melompat ke laut dan berubah menjadi lumba-lumba.
statement.en: In Homeric Hymn 7, the god changed into a dreadful lion on the ship; the sailors leapt overboard and were changed into dolphins.

claims.quote: The rich-haired Nymphs received him in their bosoms from the lord his father and fostered and nurtured him carefully in the dells of Nysa

statement.id: Dalam Himne Homerik XXVI, para Nimfa berambut indah menerimanya dari ayahnya dan merawatnya dengan cermat di lembah Nysa.
statement.en: In Homeric Hymn 26, the rich-haired Nymphs received him from his father and nurtured him carefully in the dells of Nysa.

summary.en: Son of Zeus and Semele in the common tradition.

summary.en: Son of Zeus by Demeter, Io, Dione, or Arge according to others.

summary.en: Thebes in the common tradition.

summary.en: India, Libya, Crete, Dracanum in Samos, Naxos, Elis, Eleutherae, or Teos in other traditions.

short_description.id: Durga adalah dewi utama dalam Hinduisme yang digambarkan menunggang singa atau harimau dengan banyak lengan bersenjata, dan paling dikenal karena membunuh iblis kerbau Mahisha.
short_description.en: Durga is a principal Hindu goddess, depicted riding a lion or tiger with many armed hands, and best known for slaying the buffalo demon Mahisha.

long_description.id:
Durga adalah salah satu dewi utama dalam Hinduisme dan perwujudan Devi sebagai pejuang yang menakutkan. Namanya dalam bahasa Sanskerta berarti "yang tak terjangkau" atau "yang tak dapat dilewati", dan berkaitan dengan kata durg yang berarti benteng. Sumber lain menyebut nama itu dipakai untuk semua dewi yang berwujud garang dan bersikap bertempur. Ia juga dikenal dengan julukan seperti Mahishasura-mardini dan Vindhyavasini.

Dalam ikonografi, Durga digambarkan menunggang singa atau harimau dan memegang banyak senjata; jumlah lengannya berbeda-beda menurut sumber, mulai dari empat hingga delapan belas. Senjata itu secara tradisional diberikan oleh para dewa laki-laki, antara lain cakra, trisula, busur, pedang, perisai, dan gada. Singa disebut sebagai tunggangan ilahinya, dan dalam salah satu kisah singa itu dihadiahkan oleh Himavan. Ia juga digambarkan mampu memunculkan dewi pejuang lain seperti Kali dan para Matrika untuk membantunya bertempur.

Kisah Durga yang paling terkenal adalah pertempurannya melawan Mahisha atau Mahishasura, iblis berkepala kerbau. Para dewa memberinya senjata, dan dalam salah satu versi Durga lahir dari energi para dewa yang menyatu. Mahisha berganti rupa berkali-kali menjadi kerbau, manusia, singa, dan gajah, hingga Durga menusuknya dengan trisula dan memenggal kepalanya. Tradisi Waisnawa memiliki kisah lain: Durga sebagai Yoganidra lahir sebagai putri Yashoda dan Nanda agar dapat ditukar dengan Krishna.

Durga dipuja dalam perayaan Navaratri sembilan malam di India dan Nepal, dan Dusshera dirayakan pada akhir Navaratri. Para sarjana memperkirakan ia berasal dari dewi kuno penduduk pegunungan yang kemudian mapan dalam panteon Hindu; prasasti abad ke-6 M sudah menyebut kemenangannya atas Mahishasura, dan penggambaran Durga membunuh Mahisha menjadi subjek populer dalam seni Hindu.
long_description.en:
Durga is one of the principal goddesses of Hinduism and the manifestation of Devi as a fearsome warrior. Her Sanskrit name means "the inaccessible" or "the impassable" and is related to the word durg, meaning fortress. Another source notes that the name is applied to all goddesses of terrible appearance who stand in a fighting attitude. She is also known by epithets such as Mahishasura-mardini and Vindhyavasini.

In iconography Durga rides a lion or a tiger and carries many weapons; the number of her arms differs by source, from four to eighteen. The weapons are traditionally given by male gods and include the discus, trident, bow, sword, shield and mace. The lion is called her divine mount, and in one account it was a gift from Himavan. She is also said to manifest other warrior goddesses such as Kali and the Matrikas to aid her in battle.

Durga's most famous story is her battle with Mahisha, or Mahishasura, the buffalo-headed demon. The gods gave her weapons, and in one version Durga was formed from the gods' combined energy. Mahisha changed shape repeatedly into a buffalo, a man, a lion and an elephant, until Durga stabbed him with her trident and cut off his head. Vaishnava tradition has another story: Durga as Yoganidra is born as the daughter of Yashoda and Nanda so that she can be swapped with Krishna.

Durga is worshipped in the nine-night festival of Navaratri in India and Nepal, and Dusshera is celebrated at the end of Navaratri. Scholars believe she originated as an ancient goddess of mountain-dwellers who was later established in the Hindu pantheon; sixth-century CE inscriptions already mention her victory over Mahishasura, and depictions of Durga slaying Mahisha became a popular subject in Hindu art.

era: Believed to be established in the main Hindu pantheon by the 4th century CE

literal_meaning.id: "tak terjangkau", "tak dapat dilewati"; juga "tak tertembus, tak terkalahkan"

who.id: Durga adalah dewi pejuang dalam Hinduisme, perwujudan Devi yang membunuh iblis.
who.en: Durga is a warrior goddess in Hinduism, a manifestation of Devi who slays demons.

origin.id: Ia dipercaya berasal dari dewi kuno penduduk pegunungan di anak benua India dan mapan dalam panteon Hindu pada abad ke-4 M.
origin.en: She is believed to have originated as an ancient goddess of mountain-dwellers in the Indian subcontinent and to have been established in the Hindu pantheon by the 4th century CE.

role.id: Kisahnya berpusat pada perlawanan terhadap kejahatan dan kekuatan iblis yang mengancam dharma dan tatanan kosmis.
role.en: Her legends center on combating evil and demonic forces that threaten dharma and cosmic order.

famous_for.id: Ia paling dikenal karena membunuh Mahisha, iblis kerbau.
famous_for.en: She is best known for slaying Mahisha, the buffalo demon.

did_you_know.id: Ikonografi Durga lentur: sebagian cendekiawan meletakkan pena atau alat tulis di tangannya karena menganggap pena mereka sebagai senjata.
did_you_know.en: Durga iconography is flexible: some intellectuals place a pen or other writing implement in her hand because they regard their stylus as their weapon.

cultural_context.id: Dalam Hinduisme, kisah Durga berpusat pada perlawanan terhadap kejahatan dan kekuatan iblis yang mengancam perdamaian, dharma, dan tatanan kosmis, sehingga ia melambangkan kemenangan kebaikan atas kejahatan. Ia juga merupakan sisi Devi yang paling sering dipuja.
cultural_context.en: In Hinduism, Durga's stories center on combating evil and demonic forces that threaten peace, dharma and cosmic order, so she represents the power of good over evil. She is also the side of Devi that is most frequently worshipped.

description.id: Durga secara tradisional memegang senjata para dewa laki-laki, antara lain cakra, trisula, busur, anak panah, pedang, lembing, perisai, gada, dan jerat; menurut Devi Mahatmya para dewa tidak sanggup mengalahkan iblis itu sendiri-sendiri.
description.en: Durga traditionally holds the weapons of the male gods, including the discus, trident, bow, arrow, sword, javelin, shield, mace and noose; according to the Devi Mahatmya, the gods could not defeat the demon singly.

description.id: Dalam kisah Mahisha, Durga menanggapi lamaran menikah dari iblis itu dengan mengubah dirinya menjadi api.
description.en: In the Mahisha story, Durga responds to the demon's proposal by transforming herself into fire.

description.id: Dalam pertempuran melawan iblis Shumbha dan Nishumbha, Durga memunculkan Kali dan para Matrika untuk membantunya.
description.en: In her battles with the demons Shumbha and Nishumbha, Durga manifests Kali and the Matrikas to aid her.

description.id: Singa adalah tunggangan ilahi (vahana) Durga yang tampil dalam penggambaran pertempurannya melawan Mahisha.
description.en: The lion is Durga's divine mount (vahana) shown in imagery of her battle with Mahisha.

description.id: Dalam Shaktisme Durga punya sembilan sebutan (Navadurga): Shailaputri, Brahmacharini, Chandraghanta, Kushmanda, Skandamata, Katyayini, Kalaratri, Mahagauri, dan Siddhidatri.
description.en: In Shaktism Durga has nine appellations (Navadurga): Shailaputri, Brahmacharini, Chandraghanta, Kushmanda, Skandamata, Katyayini, Kalaratri, Mahagauri and Siddhidatri.

description.id: Saivagama menguraikan sembilan ragam Durga yang semuanya berlengan dua tetapi bersenjata berbeda.
description.en: The Saivagama describes nine varieties of Durga, all with two arms but different weapons.

description.id: Dalam konteks Waisnawa, Durga dihormati sebagai Yoganidra, adik perempuan sekaligus versi perempuan Wisnu.
description.en: In Vaishnava contexts, Durga is revered as Yoganidra, the younger sister and a female version of Vishnu.

role.id: Tokoh utama yang mengalahkan iblis kerbau.
role.en: The central figure who defeats the buffalo demon.

summary.id: Mahisha, iblis berkepala kerbau, mengusir para dewa dari surga. Durga menerima senjata dari para dewa, menolak lamaran Mahisha, lalu bertempur dengannya. Mahisha berganti rupa dari kerbau menjadi manusia, singa, dan gajah, dan akhirnya Durga menusuknya dengan trisula serta memenggal kepalanya.
summary.en: Mahisha, a demon with a buffalo's head, drove most gods out of heaven. Durga received weapons from the gods, spurned Mahisha's proposal and fought him. Mahisha changed from a buffalo to a man, a lion and an elephant, and in the end Durga stabbed him with her trident and cut off his head.

title.en: Durga and the birth of Krishna

role.id: Dalam tradisi Waisnawa, Durga lahir sebagai bayi perempuan yang ditukar dengan Krishna.
role.en: In Vaishnava tradition, Durga is born as the infant girl swapped with Krishna.

summary.id: Wisnu menugaskan Durga memindahkan anak ketujuh Devaki ke rahim Rohini dan lahir sebagai putri Yashoda dan Nanda agar dapat ditukar dengan Krishna.
summary.en: Vishnu gives Durga the task of moving Devaki's seventh child into Rohini's womb and being born as the daughter of Yashoda and Nanda so that she can be swapped with Krishna.

description.id: Dinding utara gua granit di Mamallapuram, Tamil Nadu, memuat relief besar Durga membunuh Mahisasura yang diukir sekitar 630-674 M.
description.en: The north wall of a granite cave at Mamallapuram, Tamil Nadu, bears a large relief of Durga slaying Mahisasura, carved around 630-674 CE.

description.id: Kuil Kailasanatha di Ellora (pertengahan abad ke-8 M) termasuk penggambaran paling awal Durga membunuh Mahisa.
description.en: The Kailasanatha temple at Ellora (mid-8th century CE) is among the earliest representations of Durga slaying Mahisa.

description.id: Prasasti abad ke-6 M di gua bukit Nagarjuni pada masa Maukhari sudah menyebut kisah kemenangan Durga atas Mahishasura.
description.en: Sixth-century CE inscriptions at the Nagarjuni hill cave from the Maukhari era already mention the legend of Durga's victory over Mahishasura.

title.en: Established in the main Hindu pantheon

description.id: Durga dipercaya telah mapan dalam panteon utama Hindu pada abad ke-4 M, setelah bermula sebagai dewi kuno penduduk pegunungan.
description.en: Durga is believed to have been established in the main Hindu pantheon by the 4th century CE, after originating as an ancient goddess of mountain-dwellers.

description.id: Para sarjana memperkirakan Devi Mahatmya disusun antara 400 dan 600 M; Durga sebagai dewi pembunuh iblis kemungkinan sudah mapan saat itu.
description.en: Scholars estimate the Devi Mahatmya was composed between 400 and 600 CE; Durga as a demon-slaying goddess was likely well established by then.

description.id: Prasasti beraksara Siddhamatrika awal sudah menyebut kisah kemenangannya atas Mahishasura.
description.en: Inscriptions in early Siddhamatrika script already mention the legend of her victory over Mahishasura.

description.id: Relief besar Durga membunuh Mahisasura diukir di gua granit Mamallapuram.
description.en: A large relief of Durga slaying Mahisasura was carved in the granite cave at Mamallapuram.

note.en: Durga is a warrior manifestation of Devi.

note.en: Uma is the benevolent side of Devi, in contrast to the terrible Durga.

note.id: Dalam pertempuran melawan Shumbha dan Nishumbha, Durga memunculkan Kali untuk membantunya.
note.en: In the battles with Shumbha and Nishumbha, Durga manifests Kali to aid her.

note.id: Para Matrika dimunculkan Durga dalam pertempuran melawan iblis.
note.en: The Matrikas are manifested by Durga in battle against demons.

note.id: Iblis-iblis yang dilawan Durga bersama dewi-dewi pejuang yang ia munculkan.
note.en: Demons Durga fights with the warrior goddesses she manifests.

note.id: Pada satu titik dalam sejarahnya Durga dikaitkan dengan Siwa sebagai istrinya.
note.en: At a certain point in her history Durga becomes associated with Shiva as his wife.

note.id: Sebagai istri Siwa, Durga sering diidentifikasi dengan dewi Parwati.
note.en: As Shiva's wife, Durga is often identified with the goddess Parvati.

note.id: Dalam konteks Waisnawa, Durga adalah adik perempuan sekaligus versi perempuan Wisnu.
note.en: In Vaishnava contexts Durga is Vishnu's younger sister and a female version of him.

note.id: Dalam versi lain Devi adalah putri Himavat, dewa personifikasi Himalaya.
note.en: In another version Devi is the daughter of Himavat, the personified deity of the Himalayas.

summary.id: Energi para dewa yang menyatu membentuk Durga.
summary.en: The combined energy of the gods formed Durga.

summary.id: Devi sudah lama ada sebagai putri Himavat dan para dewa hanya memberinya senjata.
summary.en: Devi long existed as the daughter of Himavat and the gods only gave her weapons.

summary.id: Sepuluh lengan menurut satu sumber.
summary.en: Ten arms according to one source.

summary.id: Antara delapan dan delapan belas tangan menurut sumber lain.
summary.en: Between eight and eighteen hands according to another source.

summary.id: Empat lengan menurut Kasyapa-Silpa, dan delapan lengan pada arca Mahabalipuram menurut sumber ketiga.
summary.en: Four arms according to the Kasyapa-Silpa, and eight arms on the Mahabalipuram figure according to a third source.

questions.en: Why is Durga shown holding weapons from many different gods?

claim.id: Durga digambarkan berlengan sepuluh, bersenjata, dan menunggangi singa atau harimau.
claim.en: Durga is depicted with ten arms and weapons, riding a lion or tiger.

claims_provenance.quote: Devi's dark side is represented as the terrible Durga (the Inaccessible) who has ten arms, an impressive armoury of weapons, and who rides a magnificent lion or tiger.
claims_provenance.locator: The Two Sides of Devi: Uma & Durga

claim.id: Durga mengalahkan Mahisha, iblis kerbau yang melambangkan kejahatan.
claim.en: Durga defeats Mahisha, a buffalo demon representing evil.

claims_provenance.quote: Durga slaying Mahisha (Mahishamardini) is here represented in her multi-armed form, manifesting her supreme power as the dispeller of evil, personified in the buffalo demon (asura) Mahisha, seen slumped at her feet.
claims_provenance.source_citation: The Metropolitan Museum of Art — Goddess Durga Slaying the Demon Mahisha

claim.id: Menurut Devi Mahatmya, para dewa meminjamkan senjata kepada Durga untuk mengalahkan iblis.
claim.en: In the Devi Mahatmya, gods lend Durga weapons to defeat the demon.

claims_provenance.quote: Following the Devi Mahatmya text, she wields the mighty weapons lent to her by the assembly of male gods who singly could not defeat the demon.
claims_provenance.source_citation: The Metropolitan Museum of Art — Goddess Durga Slaying the Demon Mahisha

claim.id: Durga dipuja dalam perayaan Navaratri di India dan Nepal.
claim.en: Durga is worshipped during Navaratri in India and Nepal.

claims_provenance.quote: Durga is also worshipped in the nine-night festival Navaratri which is celebrated across India and Nepal.

claim.id: Dusshera dirayakan pada akhir Navaratri.
claim.en: Dusshera is celebrated at the end of Navaratri.

claims_provenance.quote: The festival of Dusshera is celebrated at the end of Navaratri by Hindus wherever they live.
claims_provenance.source_citation: National Museums Scotland — The Hindu Goddess Durga

claim.id: Singa adalah tunggangan ilahi Durga yang tampil dalam seni pertempurannya melawan Mahisha.
claim.en: The lion is Durga's divine mount in battle imagery against Mahisha.

claims_provenance.quote: The lion, Durga’s divine mount (vahana) on which she is shown riding majestically into battle in manuscript illustrations, is here seen emerging from behind the goddess, mauling the demon-buffalo’s hind quarters.
claims_provenance.source_citation: The Metropolitan Museum of Art — Goddess Durga Slaying the Demon Mahisha

claim.id: Salah satu kisah paling terkenal Devi adalah pembunuhan Mahisa, iblis bertubuh manusia berkepala kerbau, seperti dikisahkan dalam puisi epik Candipat (Candi-mahatmya), bagian dari Skanda Purana.
claim.en: One of Devi's most famous episodes is her slaying of Mahisa, a demon with a man's body and a buffalo's head, as told in the epic poem Candipat (Candi-mahatmya), part of the Skanda Purana.

claims_provenance.quote: One of Devi's most famous mythological escapades is her slaying of Mahisa, the demon who had the body of a man and the head of a buffalo, as told in the epic poem the Candipat (or Candi-mahatmya), which is part of the Skanda Purana.

claim.id: Dalam salah satu versi, energi dahsyat para dewa menyatu menjadi satu massa dan membentuk Durga; sumber menyebut ini hanya satu versi kelahirannya.
claim.en: In one version, the tremendous energy of the gods condensed into a single mass and formed Durga; the source notes this is only one version of her birth.

claims_provenance.quote: Swirling around heaven, this tremendous energy condensed into a single mass and formed the terrible goddess Durga. As with many Hindu tales, this is but one version of Durga's birth.

claim.id: Dalam versi lain, Devi sudah lama ada sebagai putri Himavat, dewa personifikasi Himalaya, dan para dewa yang murka hanya memberinya senjata: cakram, trisula, busur, pedang, belati, tombak, dan jerat.
claim.en: In other versions Devi has long existed as the daughter of Himavat, the personified deity of the Himalayas, and the angered gods only give her weapons: a discus, trident, bow, sword, dagger, harpoon, and noose.

claims_provenance.quote: In other versions, Devi has already long existed as the daughter of Himavat, the personified deity of the Himalaya Mountains, and in this episode she is only given weapons by the angered gods. These arms include a discus, trident, bow, sword, dagger, harpoon, and a noose

claim.id: Setiap kali Devi hendak menghantam Mahisa dengan pukulan mematikan, Mahisa berubah menjadi makhluk lain: kerbau, manusia, singa, gajah, lalu kerbau lagi.
claim.en: Whenever Devi tried to deliver a fatal blow, Mahisa changed into another creature: a buffalo, a man, a lion, an elephant, and then a buffalo again.

claims_provenance.quote: The problem for Devi was that whenever she tried to strike Mahisa with a fatal blow he transformed into another creature - from a buffalo to a man to a lion, then to an elephant and back to a buffalo.

claim.id: Devi menerkam, menunggangi makhluk itu, dan menusuk lehernya dengan trisula; ketika roh Mahisa keluar dari mulut kerbau yang sekarat, Durga membunuhnya dengan memenggal kepalanya.
claim.en: The goddess pounced, straddled the creature and stabbed its neck with her trident; when Mahisa's spirit came out of the dying buffalo's mouth, Durga killed him by cutting off his head.

claims_provenance.quote: At this moment, the goddess pounced and, straddling the creature, stabbed him in the neck with her trident. At this, the spirit of Mahisa came out of the mouth of the dying buffalo and Durga finally killed him by lopping off his head.

claim.id: Durga membunuh Mahisa adalah subjek populer dalam seni Hindu; salah satu penggambaran paling awal ada di kuil gua dekat Mallapuram (abad ke-7 atau ke-8 M) dan di Kuil Kailasanatha di Ellora (pertengahan abad ke-8 M).
claim.en: Durga slaying Mahisa is a popular subject in Hindu art; one of the earliest representations is in a cave temple near Mallapuram (7th or 8th century CE) and on the Kailasanatha temple at Ellora (mid-8th century CE).

claims_provenance.quote: Durga slaying Mahisa is a popular subject in Hindu art. One of the earliest representations is in a cave temple near Mallapuram dating to the 7th or 8th century CE and on the mid-8th century CE Kailasanatha temple at Ellora.

claim.id: Watak Devi punya dua sisi yang berlawanan: Uma yang lembut dan Durga yang menakutkan; sisi yang lebih garang inilah yang paling sering dipuja.
claim.en: Devi's character has two opposing sides: Uma, the benevolent, and Durga, the terrible; it is the fiercer side that is most frequently worshipped.

claims_provenance.quote: Devi's character has two opposing sides represented by various separate female deities: as Uma, the benevolent, and as Durga, the terrible. It is as the latter, more fierce personification that she is most frequently worshipped.

claim.id: Mahisa menyingkap dirinya dan membual tentang kekayaan serta kekuasaannya agar Durga mau menikah dengannya; Durga menanggapi lamaran itu dengan acuh dan mengubah dirinya menjadi api.
claim.en: Mahisa revealed himself and boasted of his wealth and power so that Durga would marry him; Durga responded dismissively to the proposal by transforming herself into fire.

claims_provenance.quote: Mahisa then revealed himself and boasted of his tremendous wealth and power so that Durga might be persuaded to marry him. Durga's somewhat dismissive response to this proposal was to transform herself into fire.

claim.id: Durga dipercaya berasal dari dewi kuno yang dipuja penduduk pegunungan asli anak benua India, sebelum mapan dalam panteon utama Hindu pada abad ke-4 M.
claim.en: Durga is believed to have originated as an ancient goddess worshipped by indigenous mountain-dwellers of the Indian subcontinent, before being established in the main Hindu pantheon by the 4th century CE.

claims_provenance.quote: Durga is believed to have originated as an ancient goddess worshipped by indigenous mountain-dwellers of the Indian subcontinent, before being established in the main Hindu pantheon by the 4th century CE.

claim.id: Durga paling dikenal sebagai Mahishasura-mardini karena membunuh Mahishasura, iblis kerbau; dalam pertempuran melawan Shumbha dan Nishumbha ia memunculkan dewi-dewi pejuang lain, yaitu para Matrika dan Kali, untuk membantunya.
claim.en: She is best known as Mahishasura-mardini for slaying the buffalo demon Mahishasura; in her battles with Shumbha and Nishumbha she manifests other warrior goddesses, the Matrikas and Kali, to aid her.

claims_provenance.quote: She is best known as Mahishasura-mardini; for slaying Mahishasura—the buffalo demon. In accounts of her battles with other demons such as Shumbha and Nishumbha, Durga manifests other warrior goddesses, the Matrikas, and Kali, to aid in combat.

claim.id: Durga dikaitkan dengan perlindungan, kekuatan, keibuan, kehancuran, dan perang; kisahnya berpusat pada perlawanan terhadap kejahatan dan kekuatan iblis yang mengancam perdamaian, dharma, dan tatanan kosmis, melambangkan kemenangan kebaikan atas kejahatan.
claim.en: She is associated with protection, strength, motherhood, destruction and war; her legends center on combating evil and demonic forces that threaten peace, dharma and cosmic order, representing the power of good over evil.

claims_provenance.quote: She is associated with protection, strength, motherhood, destruction, and wars; her legends center around combating evils and demonic forces that threaten peace, dharma and cosmic order, representing the power of good over evil.

claim.id: Durga secara tradisional memegang senjata berbagai dewa laki-laki yang mereka berikan agar ia melawan kejahatan karena mereka memandangnya sebagai shakti (energi, daya); di antaranya cakra, kerang, busur, anak panah, pedang, lembing, trisula, perisai, gada, bunga teratai merah muda, dan jerat.
claim.en: Durga traditionally holds the weapons of various male gods, given to her to fight evil because they regard her as shakti (energy, power); these include the discus, conch, bow, arrow, sword, javelin, trident, shield, mace, pink lotus and noose.

claims_provenance.quote: Durga traditionally holds the weapons of various male gods of Hindu mythology, which they give her to fight the evil forces because they feel that she is shakti (energy, power). These include the chakra (divine discus), conch, bow, arrow, sword, javelin, trishula trident, shield, mace, pink lotus flower, and noose.

claim.id: Kata Durga secara harfiah berarti "tak dapat dilewati", "tak terkalahkan, tak tertembus", dan berkaitan dengan kata durg yang berarti "benteng, sesuatu yang sulit dikalahkan atau dilewati".
claim.en: The word Durga literally means "impassable", "invincible, unassailable"; it is related to durg, meaning "fortress, something difficult to defeat or pass".

claims_provenance.quote: The word Durga (दुर्गा) literally means "impassable", "invincible, unassailable". It is related to the word Durg (दुर्ग) which means "fortress, something difficult to defeat or pass".

claim.id: Dalam konteks Waisnawa, Durga dihormati sebagai Yoganidra, tidur ilahi, adik perempuan sekaligus versi perempuan Wisnu.
claim.en: In Vaishnava contexts, Durga is revered as Yoganidra, the divine slumber, younger sister and a female version of Vishnu.

claims_provenance.quote: In Vaishnava contexts, Durga is revered as Yoganidrā, the divine slumber, younger sister and a female version of Vishnu.

claim.id: Menurut tradisi Waisnawa, Wisnu menugaskan Durga memindahkan anak ketujuh Devaki ke rahim Rohini dan lahir sebagai bayi perempuan Yashoda dan Nanda agar dapat ditukar dengan Krishna.
claim.en: In Vaishnava tradition, Vishnu gives Durga the task of moving Devaki's seventh child into Rohini's womb and of being born as the infant daughter of Yashoda and Nanda so she could be swapped with Krishna.

claims_provenance.quote: Vishnu offers Durga the task of transferring the seventh child of Devaki into the womb of Rohini, as well as being born on earth as the infant daughter of Yashoda and Nanda, so that she could be swapped with Krishna.

claim.id: Dalam Shaktisme Durga punya banyak julukan, dan sembilan sebutannya (Navadurga) adalah Shailaputri, Brahmacharini, Chandraghanta, Kushmanda, Skandamata, Katyayini, Kalaratri, Mahagauri, dan Siddhidatri.
claim.en: In Shaktism Durga has many epithets, and her nine appellations (Navadurga) are Shailaputri, Brahmacharini, Chandraghanta, Kushmanda, Skandamata, Katyayini, Kalaratri, Mahagauri and Siddhidatri.

claims_provenance.quote: There are many epithets for Durga in Shaktism and her nine appellations are (Navadurga): Shailaputri, Brahmacharini, Chandraghanta, Kushmanda, Skandamata, Katyayini, Kalaratri, Mahagauri and Siddhidatri.

claim.id: Di dinding utara sebuah gua granit di Mamallapuram, Tamil Nadu, terdapat relief besar Durga membunuh Mahisasura yang diukir sekitar 630-674 M.
claim.en: On the north wall of a granite cave in Mamallapuram, Tamil Nadu, there is a large relief of Durga slaying Mahisasura, carved around 630-674 CE.

claims_provenance.quote: In the north wall of a granite cave in Mamallapuram, Tamil Nadu there is a large relief of Durga slaying Mahisasura, carved around 630–674 CE.

claim.id: Prasasti abad ke-6 M beraksara Siddhamatrika awal, misalnya di gua bukit Nagarjuni pada masa Maukhari, sudah menyebut kisah kemenangannya atas Mahishasura.
claim.en: Sixth-century CE inscriptions in early Siddhamatrika script, such as at the Nagarjuni hill cave in the Maukhari era, already mention the legend of her victory over Mahishasura.

claims_provenance.quote: The 6th-century CE inscriptions in early Siddhamatrika script, such as at the Nagarjuni hill cave during the Maukhari era, already mention the legend of her victory over Mahishasura

claim.id: Durga sebagai dewi pembunuh iblis kemungkinan sudah mapan ketika teks klasik Devi Mahatmya disusun, yang oleh para sarjana diperkirakan antara 400 dan 600 M.
claim.en: Durga as a demon-slaying goddess was likely well established when the classic text Devi Mahatmya was composed, which scholars variously date to between 400 and 600 CE.

claims_provenance.quote: Durga as a demon-slaying goddess was likely well established by the time the classic Hindu text called Devi Mahatmya was composed, which scholars variously estimate to between 400 and 600 CE.

claim.id: Ikonografinya biasanya menampilkan Durga menunggangi singa atau harimau dengan delapan sampai delapan belas tangan yang masing-masing memegang senjata.
claim.en: Her iconography typically shows her riding a lion or a tiger, with between eight and eighteen hands, each holding a weapon.

claims_provenance.quote: Her iconography typically resonates with these attributes, where she rides a lion or a tiger, has between eight and eighteen hands, each holding a weapon to destroy and create.

claim.id: Ikonografi Durga lentur dalam tradisi Hindu; misalnya sebagian cendekiawan meletakkan pena atau alat tulis di tangannya karena menganggap penanya sebagai senjata.
claim.en: Durga iconography has been flexible in Hindu traditions; for example some intellectuals place a pen or other writing implement in her hand because they consider their stylus their weapon.

claims_provenance.quote: Durga iconography has been flexible in the Hindu traditions, where for example some intellectuals place a pen or other writing implements in her hand since they consider their stylus as their weapon.

claim.id: Dalam kisah ini, Himavan, personifikasi Himalaya, menghadiahkan seekor singa sebagai tunggangannya.
claim.en: In this account Himavan, the personification of the Himalayas, gifted a lion as her mount.

claims_provenance.quote: Himavan, the personification of the Himalayas, gifted a lion as her mount.

claim.id: Durga memiliki banyak pengikut di seluruh Nepal, India, Bangladesh, dan banyak negara lain.
claim.en: Durga has a significant following all over Nepal, India, Bangladesh and many other countries.

claims_provenance.quote: Durga has a significant following all over Nepal, India, Bangladesh and many other countries.

claim.id: Durga umumnya digambarkan sebagai dewi pejuang yang selibat, tetapi pada suatu titik dalam sejarahnya ia dikaitkan dengan Dewa Siwa sebagai istrinya.
claim.en: Durga is typically portrayed as a celibate warrior goddess, but at a certain point in her history she becomes associated with the god Shiva as his wife.

claims_provenance.quote: Durga is typically portrayed as a celibate warrior goddess. However, at a certain point in her history, she becomes associated with the god Śiva as his wife.

claim.id: Durga adalah dewi yang sangat populer; nama itu dipakai tanpa pembedaan untuk semua dewi berwujud menakutkan dan bersikap bertempur.
claim.en: Durga is a very popular deity; the name is applied indifferently to all goddesses with a terrible appearance and in a fighting attitude.

claims_provenance.quote: Durgā is a very popular deity. The name is indifferently applied to all goddesses with a terrible appearance and in a fighting attitude.
claims_provenance.source_citation: Wikisource — South-Indian Images of Gods and Goddesses, Chapter 5: Sakti-Goddesses

claim.id: Saivagama secara khusus menguraikan sembilan ragam Durga, semuanya bertangan dua tetapi bersenjata berbeda.
claim.en: The Saivagama specifically describes nine varieties of Durga, all with two arms but different weapons.

claims_provenance.quote: The Saivāgama specifically describes nine varieties of Durgā, all of which have two arms but different weapons
claims_provenance.source_citation: Wikisource — South-Indian Images of Gods and Goddesses, Chapter 5: Sakti-Goddesses

claim.id: Dalam peran sebagai istri Siwa, Durga mengambil sifat rumah tangga dan sering diidentifikasi dengan dewi Parwati.
claim.en: In this role as Shiva's wife, Durga assumes domestic characteristics and is often identified with the goddess Parvati.

claims_provenance.quote: In this role, Durgā assumes domestic characteristics and is often identified with the goddess Parvati.

claim.id: Uraian umum tentang Durga dalam Kasyapa-Silpa menggambarkannya berlengan empat dan bermata dua.
claim.en: The general description of Durga in the Kasyapa-Silpa shows her with four arms and two eyes.

claims_provenance.quote: The general description of Durgā given in the Kāsyapa-Silpa represents her as having four arms, two eyes
claims_provenance.source_citation: Wikisource — South-Indian Images of Gods and Goddesses, Chapter 5: Sakti-Goddesses

claim.id: Sebuah arca Durga dari Mahabalipuram berdiri di atas kepala kerbau dan berlengan delapan; di tangan teratasnya terdapat cakram dan kerang.
claim.en: A figure of Durga from Mahabalipuram stands on the buffalo's head and has eight arms; the discus and the conch are in the uppermost ones.

claims_provenance.quote: From Mahābalipuram comes the figure of a Durgā (fig. 124) who stands on the buffalo's head. She has eight arms, in the uppermost of which are found the discus and the conch.
claims_provenance.source_citation: Wikisource — South-Indian Images of Gods and Goddesses, Chapter 5: Sakti-Goddesses

claim.id: Durga lazim disebut Mahishasura-mardini karena membunuh iblis setengah kerbau Mahishasura, dan juga dikenal sebagai Vindhyavasini (ia yang tinggal di Pegunungan Vindhya).
claim.en: Durga is commonly known as Mahishasura-mardini for slaying the half-buffalo demon Mahishasura, and also as Vindhyavasini (she who dwells in the Vindhya Mountains).

claims_provenance.quote: Durga is commonly known as Mahishasura-mardini for slaying the half-buffalo demon Mahishasura. She is also known as Vindhyavasini (she who dwells in the Vindhya Mountains).

claim.id: Durga juga dikenal sebagai Durgati Nashini, yang berarti ia yang melenyapkan penderitaan.
claim.en: Durga is also known as Durgati Nashini, meaning one who eliminates suffering.

claims_provenance.quote: Durga is also known as Durgati Nashini, meaning one who eliminates suffering.

claim.id: Mahisa berhasil mengusir sebagian besar dewa dari surga sehingga mereka berkelana di bumi sebagai manusia biasa.
claim.en: Mahisa managed to drive most of the gods out of heaven, forcing them to wander the earth as mere men.

claims_provenance.quote: Doing rather well, Mahisa managed to kick most of the gods out of heaven, forcing them to wander the earth as mere men.

short_description.id: Durga adalah dewi utama dalam Hinduisme yang digambarkan menunggang singa atau harimau dengan banyak lengan bersenjata, dan paling dikenal karena membunuh iblis kerbau Mahisha.
short_description.en: Durga is a principal Hindu goddess, depicted riding a lion or tiger with many armed hands, and best known for slaying the buffalo demon Mahisha.

long_description.id: Durga adalah salah satu dewi utama dalam Hinduisme dan perwujudan Devi sebagai pejuang yang menakutkan. Namanya dalam bahasa Sanskerta berarti "yang tak terjangkau" atau "yang tak dapat dilewati", dan berkaitan dengan kata durg yang berarti benteng. Sumber lain menyebut nama itu dipakai untuk semua dewi yang berwujud garang dan bersikap bertempur. Ia juga dikenal dengan julukan seperti Mahishasura-mardini dan Vindhyavasini.
long_description.en: Durga is one of the principal goddesses of Hinduism and the manifestation of Devi as a fearsome warrior. Her Sanskrit name means "the inaccessible" or "the impassable" and is related to the word durg, meaning fortress. Another source notes that the name is applied to all goddesses of terrible appearance who stand in a fighting attitude. She is also known by epithets such as Mahishasura-mardini and Vindhyavasini.

long_description.id: Dalam ikonografi, Durga digambarkan menunggang singa atau harimau dan memegang banyak senjata; jumlah lengannya berbeda-beda menurut sumber, mulai dari empat hingga delapan belas. Senjata itu secara tradisional diberikan oleh para dewa laki-laki, antara lain cakra, trisula, busur, pedang, perisai, dan gada. Singa disebut sebagai tunggangan ilahinya, dan dalam salah satu kisah singa itu dihadiahkan oleh Himavan. Ia juga digambarkan mampu memunculkan dewi pejuang lain seperti Kali dan para Matrika untuk membantunya bertempur.
long_description.en: In iconography Durga rides a lion or a tiger and carries many weapons; the number of her arms differs by source, from four to eighteen. The weapons are traditionally given by male gods and include the discus, trident, bow, sword, shield and mace. The lion is called her divine mount, and in one account it was a gift from Himavan. She is also said to manifest other warrior goddesses such as Kali and the Matrikas to aid her in battle.

long_description.id: Kisah Durga yang paling terkenal adalah pertempurannya melawan Mahisha atau Mahishasura, iblis berkepala kerbau. Para dewa memberinya senjata, dan dalam salah satu versi Durga lahir dari energi para dewa yang menyatu. Mahisha berganti rupa berkali-kali menjadi kerbau, manusia, singa, dan gajah, hingga Durga menusuknya dengan trisula dan memenggal kepalanya. Tradisi Waisnawa memiliki kisah lain: Durga sebagai Yoganidra lahir sebagai putri Yashoda dan Nanda agar dapat ditukar dengan Krishna.
long_description.en: Durga's most famous story is her battle with Mahisha, or Mahishasura, the buffalo-headed demon. The gods gave her weapons, and in one version Durga was formed from the gods' combined energy. Mahisha changed shape repeatedly into a buffalo, a man, a lion and an elephant, until Durga stabbed him with her trident and cut off his head. Vaishnava tradition has another story: Durga as Yoganidra is born as the daughter of Yashoda and Nanda so that she can be swapped with Krishna.

long_description.id: Durga dipuja dalam perayaan Navaratri sembilan malam di India dan Nepal, dan Dusshera dirayakan pada akhir Navaratri. Para sarjana memperkirakan ia berasal dari dewi kuno penduduk pegunungan yang kemudian mapan dalam panteon Hindu; prasasti abad ke-6 M sudah menyebut kemenangannya atas Mahishasura, dan penggambaran Durga membunuh Mahisha menjadi subjek populer dalam seni Hindu.
long_description.en: Durga is worshipped in the nine-night festival of Navaratri in India and Nepal, and Dusshera is celebrated at the end of Navaratri. Scholars believe she originated as an ancient goddess of mountain-dwellers who was later established in the Hindu pantheon; sixth-century CE inscriptions already mention her victory over Mahishasura, and depictions of Durga slaying Mahisha became a popular subject in Hindu art.

cultural_context.id: Dalam Hinduisme, kisah Durga berpusat pada perlawanan terhadap kejahatan dan kekuatan iblis yang mengancam perdamaian, dharma, dan tatanan kosmis, sehingga ia melambangkan kemenangan kebaikan atas kejahatan. Ia juga merupakan sisi Devi yang paling sering dipuja.
cultural_context.en: In Hinduism, Durga's stories center on combating evil and demonic forces that threaten peace, dharma and cosmic order, so she represents the power of good over evil. She is also the side of Devi that is most frequently worshipped.

literal_meaning.id: "tak terjangkau", "tak dapat dilewati"; juga "tak tertembus, tak terkalahkan"

who.id: Durga adalah dewi pejuang dalam Hinduisme, perwujudan Devi yang membunuh iblis.
who.en: Durga is a warrior goddess in Hinduism, a manifestation of Devi who slays demons.

origin.id: Ia dipercaya berasal dari dewi kuno penduduk pegunungan di anak benua India dan mapan dalam panteon Hindu pada abad ke-4 M.
origin.en: She is believed to have originated as an ancient goddess of mountain-dwellers in the Indian subcontinent and to have been established in the Hindu pantheon by the 4th century CE.

role.id: Kisahnya berpusat pada perlawanan terhadap kejahatan dan kekuatan iblis yang mengancam dharma dan tatanan kosmis.
role.en: Her legends center on combating evil and demonic forces that threaten dharma and cosmic order.

famous_for.id: Ia paling dikenal karena membunuh Mahisha, iblis kerbau.
famous_for.en: She is best known for slaying Mahisha, the buffalo demon.

did_you_know.id: Ikonografi Durga lentur: sebagian cendekiawan meletakkan pena atau alat tulis di tangannya karena menganggap pena mereka sebagai senjata.
did_you_know.en: Durga iconography is flexible: some intellectuals place a pen or other writing implement in her hand because they regard their stylus as their weapon.

description.id: Durga secara tradisional memegang senjata para dewa laki-laki, antara lain cakra, trisula, busur, anak panah, pedang, lembing, perisai, gada, dan jerat; menurut Devi Mahatmya para dewa tidak sanggup mengalahkan iblis itu sendiri-sendiri.
description.en: Durga traditionally holds the weapons of the male gods, including the discus, trident, bow, arrow, sword, javelin, shield, mace and noose; according to the Devi Mahatmya, the gods could not defeat the demon singly.

description.id: Dalam kisah Mahisha, Durga menanggapi lamaran menikah dari iblis itu dengan mengubah dirinya menjadi api.
description.en: In the Mahisha story, Durga responds to the demon's proposal by transforming herself into fire.

description.id: Dalam pertempuran melawan iblis Shumbha dan Nishumbha, Durga memunculkan Kali dan para Matrika untuk membantunya.
description.en: In her battles with the demons Shumbha and Nishumbha, Durga manifests Kali and the Matrikas to aid her.

description.id: Singa adalah tunggangan ilahi (vahana) Durga yang tampil dalam penggambaran pertempurannya melawan Mahisha.
description.en: The lion is Durga's divine mount (vahana) shown in imagery of her battle with Mahisha.

description.id: Dalam Shaktisme Durga punya sembilan sebutan (Navadurga): Shailaputri, Brahmacharini, Chandraghanta, Kushmanda, Skandamata, Katyayini, Kalaratri, Mahagauri, dan Siddhidatri.
description.en: In Shaktism Durga has nine appellations (Navadurga): Shailaputri, Brahmacharini, Chandraghanta, Kushmanda, Skandamata, Katyayini, Kalaratri, Mahagauri and Siddhidatri.

description.id: Saivagama menguraikan sembilan ragam Durga yang semuanya berlengan dua tetapi bersenjata berbeda.
description.en: The Saivagama describes nine varieties of Durga, all with two arms but different weapons.

description.id: Dalam konteks Waisnawa, Durga dihormati sebagai Yoganidra, adik perempuan sekaligus versi perempuan Wisnu.
description.en: In Vaishnava contexts, Durga is revered as Yoganidra, the younger sister and a female version of Vishnu.

role.id: Tokoh utama yang mengalahkan iblis kerbau.
role.en: The central figure who defeats the buffalo demon.

summary.id: Mahisha, iblis berkepala kerbau, mengusir para dewa dari surga. Durga menerima senjata dari para dewa, menolak lamaran Mahisha, lalu bertempur dengannya. Mahisha berganti rupa dari kerbau menjadi manusia, singa, dan gajah, dan akhirnya Durga menusuknya dengan trisula serta memenggal kepalanya.
summary.en: Mahisha, a demon with a buffalo's head, drove most gods out of heaven. Durga received weapons from the gods, spurned Mahisha's proposal and fought him. Mahisha changed from a buffalo to a man, a lion and an elephant, and in the end Durga stabbed him with her trident and cut off his head.

title.en: Durga and the birth of Krishna

role.id: Dalam tradisi Waisnawa, Durga lahir sebagai bayi perempuan yang ditukar dengan Krishna.
role.en: In Vaishnava tradition, Durga is born as the infant girl swapped with Krishna.

summary.id: Wisnu menugaskan Durga memindahkan anak ketujuh Devaki ke rahim Rohini dan lahir sebagai putri Yashoda dan Nanda agar dapat ditukar dengan Krishna.
summary.en: Vishnu gives Durga the task of moving Devaki's seventh child into Rohini's womb and being born as the daughter of Yashoda and Nanda so that she can be swapped with Krishna.

description.id: Dinding utara gua granit di Mamallapuram, Tamil Nadu, memuat relief besar Durga membunuh Mahisasura yang diukir sekitar 630-674 M.
description.en: The north wall of a granite cave at Mamallapuram, Tamil Nadu, bears a large relief of Durga slaying Mahisasura, carved around 630-674 CE.

description.id: Kuil Kailasanatha di Ellora (pertengahan abad ke-8 M) termasuk penggambaran paling awal Durga membunuh Mahisa.
description.en: The Kailasanatha temple at Ellora (mid-8th century CE) is among the earliest representations of Durga slaying Mahisa.

description.id: Prasasti abad ke-6 M di gua bukit Nagarjuni pada masa Maukhari sudah menyebut kisah kemenangan Durga atas Mahishasura.
description.en: Sixth-century CE inscriptions at the Nagarjuni hill cave from the Maukhari era already mention the legend of Durga's victory over Mahishasura.

title.en: Established in the main Hindu pantheon

description.id: Durga dipercaya telah mapan dalam panteon utama Hindu pada abad ke-4 M, setelah bermula sebagai dewi kuno penduduk pegunungan.
description.en: Durga is believed to have been established in the main Hindu pantheon by the 4th century CE, after originating as an ancient goddess of mountain-dwellers.

description.id: Para sarjana memperkirakan Devi Mahatmya disusun antara 400 dan 600 M; Durga sebagai dewi pembunuh iblis kemungkinan sudah mapan saat itu.
description.en: Scholars estimate the Devi Mahatmya was composed between 400 and 600 CE; Durga as a demon-slaying goddess was likely well established by then.

description.id: Prasasti beraksara Siddhamatrika awal sudah menyebut kisah kemenangannya atas Mahishasura.
description.en: Inscriptions in early Siddhamatrika script already mention the legend of her victory over Mahishasura.

description.id: Relief besar Durga membunuh Mahisasura diukir di gua granit Mamallapuram.
description.en: A large relief of Durga slaying Mahisasura was carved in the granite cave at Mamallapuram.

note.id: Iblis kerbau yang dibunuh Durga.
note.en: The buffalo demon slain by Durga.

note.id: Durga adalah perwujudan Devi sebagai pejuang.
note.en: Durga is a warrior manifestation of Devi.

note.id: Uma adalah sisi Devi yang lembut, berlawanan dengan Durga yang menakutkan.
note.en: Uma is the benevolent side of Devi, in contrast to the terrible Durga.

note.id: Dalam pertempuran melawan Shumbha dan Nishumbha, Durga memunculkan Kali untuk membantunya.
note.en: In the battles with Shumbha and Nishumbha, Durga manifests Kali to aid her.

note.id: Para Matrika dimunculkan Durga dalam pertempuran melawan iblis.
note.en: The Matrikas are manifested by Durga in battle against demons.

note.id: Iblis-iblis yang dilawan Durga bersama dewi-dewi pejuang yang ia munculkan.
note.en: Demons Durga fights with the warrior goddesses she manifests.

note.id: Pada satu titik dalam sejarahnya Durga dikaitkan dengan Siwa sebagai istrinya.
note.en: At a certain point in her history Durga becomes associated with Shiva as his wife.

note.id: Sebagai istri Siwa, Durga sering diidentifikasi dengan dewi Parwati.
note.en: As Shiva's wife, Durga is often identified with the goddess Parvati.

note.id: Dalam konteks Waisnawa, Durga adalah adik perempuan sekaligus versi perempuan Wisnu.
note.en: In Vaishnava contexts Durga is Vishnu's younger sister and a female version of him.

note.id: Dalam versi lain Devi adalah putri Himavat, dewa personifikasi Himalaya.
note.en: In another version Devi is the daughter of Himavat, the personified deity of the Himalayas.

learning_questions.id: Mengapa Durga digambarkan memegang senjata dari banyak dewa berbeda?
learning_questions.en: Why is Durga shown holding weapons from many different gods?

learning_questions.id: Apa persamaan dan perbedaan Durga dalam kisah Mahisha dan dalam tradisi Waisnawa?
learning_questions.en: How does Durga differ between the Mahisha story and Vaishnava tradition?

sources.title: Goddess Durga Slaying the Demon Mahisha
South-Indian Images of Gods and Goddesses, Chapter 5: Sakti-Goddesses
sources.author: Hosakote Krishna Sastri

claims.quote: This very elegant bronze figure of Devi (goddess) Durga is an attractive and prominent figure and a principal deity in Hinduism.

statement.id: Durga adalah dewi penting dalam Hinduisme.
statement.en: Durga is a principal goddess in Hinduism.

claims.quote: In Sanskrit, Durga means the inaccessible or impassable.

statement.id: Nama Durga berarti tidak terjangkau atau tidak dapat dilewati dalam Sanskerta.
statement.en: Durga means inaccessible or impassable in Sanskrit.

claims.quote: Devi is most often manifested as the fearsome female warriors Durga and Kali, both of whom famously killed a number of terrible demons in Hindu mythology.

statement.id: Durga adalah perwujudan Devi sebagai pejuang yang mengalahkan iblis.
statement.en: Durga is a warrior manifestation of Devi who defeats demons.

claims.quote: Devi's dark side is represented as the terrible Durga (the Inaccessible) who has ten arms, an impressive armoury of weapons, and who rides a magnificent lion or tiger.
claims.locator: The Two Sides of Devi: Uma & Durga

statement.id: Durga digambarkan berlengan sepuluh, bersenjata, dan menunggangi singa atau harimau.
statement.en: Durga is depicted with ten arms and weapons, riding a lion or tiger.

claims.quote: Durga slaying Mahisha (Mahishamardini) is here represented in her multi-armed form, manifesting her supreme power as the dispeller of evil, personified in the buffalo demon (asura) Mahisha, seen slumped at her feet.

statement.id: Durga mengalahkan Mahisha, iblis kerbau yang melambangkan kejahatan.
statement.en: Durga defeats Mahisha, a buffalo demon representing evil.

claims.quote: Following the Devi Mahatmya text, she wields the mighty weapons lent to her by the assembly of male gods who singly could not defeat the demon.

statement.id: Menurut Devi Mahatmya, para dewa meminjamkan senjata kepada Durga untuk mengalahkan iblis.
statement.en: In the Devi Mahatmya, gods lend Durga weapons to defeat the demon.

claims.quote: Durga is also worshipped in the nine-night festival Navaratri which is celebrated across India and Nepal.

statement.id: Durga dipuja dalam perayaan Navaratri di India dan Nepal.
statement.en: Durga is worshipped during Navaratri in India and Nepal.

claims.quote: The festival of Dusshera is celebrated at the end of Navaratri by Hindus wherever they live.

statement.id: Dusshera dirayakan pada akhir Navaratri.
statement.en: Dusshera is celebrated at the end of Navaratri.

claims.quote: The lion, Durga’s divine mount (vahana) on which she is shown riding majestically into battle in manuscript illustrations, is here seen emerging from behind the goddess, mauling the demon-buffalo’s hind quarters.

statement.id: Singa adalah tunggangan ilahi Durga yang tampil dalam seni pertempurannya melawan Mahisha.
statement.en: The lion is Durga's divine mount in battle imagery against Mahisha.

claims.quote: One of Devi's most famous mythological escapades is her slaying of Mahisa, the demon who had the body of a man and the head of a buffalo, as told in the epic poem the Candipat (or Candi-mahatmya), which is part of the Skanda Purana.

statement.id: Salah satu kisah paling terkenal Devi adalah pembunuhan Mahisa, iblis bertubuh manusia berkepala kerbau, seperti dikisahkan dalam puisi epik Candipat (Candi-mahatmya), bagian dari Skanda Purana.
statement.en: One of Devi's most famous episodes is her slaying of Mahisa, a demon with a man's body and a buffalo's head, as told in the epic poem Candipat (Candi-mahatmya), part of the Skanda Purana.

claims.quote: Swirling around heaven, this tremendous energy condensed into a single mass and formed the terrible goddess Durga. As with many Hindu tales, this is but one version of Durga's birth.

statement.id: Dalam salah satu versi, energi dahsyat para dewa menyatu menjadi satu massa dan membentuk Durga; sumber menyebut ini hanya satu versi kelahirannya.
statement.en: In one version, the tremendous energy of the gods condensed into a single mass and formed Durga; the source notes this is only one version of her birth.

claims.quote: In other versions, Devi has already long existed as the daughter of Himavat, the personified deity of the Himalaya Mountains, and in this episode she is only given weapons by the angered gods. These arms include a discus, trident, bow, sword, dagger, harpoon, and a noose

statement.id: Dalam versi lain, Devi sudah lama ada sebagai putri Himavat, dewa personifikasi Himalaya, dan para dewa yang murka hanya memberinya senjata: cakram, trisula, busur, pedang, belati, tombak, dan jerat.
statement.en: In other versions Devi has long existed as the daughter of Himavat, the personified deity of the Himalayas, and the angered gods only give her weapons: a discus, trident, bow, sword, dagger, harpoon, and noose.

claims.quote: The problem for Devi was that whenever she tried to strike Mahisa with a fatal blow he transformed into another creature - from a buffalo to a man to a lion, then to an elephant and back to a buffalo.

statement.id: Setiap kali Devi hendak menghantam Mahisa dengan pukulan mematikan, Mahisa berubah menjadi makhluk lain: kerbau, manusia, singa, gajah, lalu kerbau lagi.
statement.en: Whenever Devi tried to deliver a fatal blow, Mahisa changed into another creature: a buffalo, a man, a lion, an elephant, and then a buffalo again.

claims.quote: At this moment, the goddess pounced and, straddling the creature, stabbed him in the neck with her trident. At this, the spirit of Mahisa came out of the mouth of the dying buffalo and Durga finally killed him by lopping off his head.

statement.id: Devi menerkam, menunggangi makhluk itu, dan menusuk lehernya dengan trisula; ketika roh Mahisa keluar dari mulut kerbau yang sekarat, Durga membunuhnya dengan memenggal kepalanya.
statement.en: The goddess pounced, straddled the creature and stabbed its neck with her trident; when Mahisa's spirit came out of the dying buffalo's mouth, Durga killed him by cutting off his head.

claims.quote: Durga slaying Mahisa is a popular subject in Hindu art. One of the earliest representations is in a cave temple near Mallapuram dating to the 7th or 8th century CE and on the mid-8th century CE Kailasanatha temple at Ellora.

statement.id: Durga membunuh Mahisa adalah subjek populer dalam seni Hindu; salah satu penggambaran paling awal ada di kuil gua dekat Mallapuram (abad ke-7 atau ke-8 M) dan di Kuil Kailasanatha di Ellora (pertengahan abad ke-8 M).
statement.en: Durga slaying Mahisa is a popular subject in Hindu art; one of the earliest representations is in a cave temple near Mallapuram (7th or 8th century CE) and on the Kailasanatha temple at Ellora (mid-8th century CE).

claims.quote: Devi's character has two opposing sides represented by various separate female deities: as Uma, the benevolent, and as Durga, the terrible. It is as the latter, more fierce personification that she is most frequently worshipped.

statement.id: Watak Devi punya dua sisi yang berlawanan: Uma yang lembut dan Durga yang menakutkan; sisi yang lebih garang inilah yang paling sering dipuja.
statement.en: Devi's character has two opposing sides: Uma, the benevolent, and Durga, the terrible; it is the fiercer side that is most frequently worshipped.

claims.quote: Mahisa then revealed himself and boasted of his tremendous wealth and power so that Durga might be persuaded to marry him. Durga's somewhat dismissive response to this proposal was to transform herself into fire.

statement.id: Mahisa menyingkap dirinya dan membual tentang kekayaan serta kekuasaannya agar Durga mau menikah dengannya; Durga menanggapi lamaran itu dengan acuh dan mengubah dirinya menjadi api.
statement.en: Mahisa revealed himself and boasted of his wealth and power so that Durga would marry him; Durga responded dismissively to the proposal by transforming herself into fire.

claims.quote: Durga is believed to have originated as an ancient goddess worshipped by indigenous mountain-dwellers of the Indian subcontinent, before being established in the main Hindu pantheon by the 4th century CE.

statement.id: Durga dipercaya berasal dari dewi kuno yang dipuja penduduk pegunungan asli anak benua India, sebelum mapan dalam panteon utama Hindu pada abad ke-4 M.
statement.en: Durga is believed to have originated as an ancient goddess worshipped by indigenous mountain-dwellers of the Indian subcontinent, before being established in the main Hindu pantheon by the 4th century CE.

claims.quote: She is best known as Mahishasura-mardini; for slaying Mahishasura—the buffalo demon. In accounts of her battles with other demons such as Shumbha and Nishumbha, Durga manifests other warrior goddesses, the Matrikas, and Kali, to aid in combat.

statement.id: Durga paling dikenal sebagai Mahishasura-mardini karena membunuh Mahishasura, iblis kerbau; dalam pertempuran melawan Shumbha dan Nishumbha ia memunculkan dewi-dewi pejuang lain, yaitu para Matrika dan Kali, untuk membantunya.
statement.en: She is best known as Mahishasura-mardini for slaying the buffalo demon Mahishasura; in her battles with Shumbha and Nishumbha she manifests other warrior goddesses, the Matrikas and Kali, to aid her.

claims.quote: She is associated with protection, strength, motherhood, destruction, and wars; her legends center around combating evils and demonic forces that threaten peace, dharma and cosmic order, representing the power of good over evil.

statement.id: Durga dikaitkan dengan perlindungan, kekuatan, keibuan, kehancuran, dan perang; kisahnya berpusat pada perlawanan terhadap kejahatan dan kekuatan iblis yang mengancam perdamaian, dharma, dan tatanan kosmis, melambangkan kemenangan kebaikan atas kejahatan.
statement.en: She is associated with protection, strength, motherhood, destruction and war; her legends center on combating evil and demonic forces that threaten peace, dharma and cosmic order, representing the power of good over evil.

claims.quote: Durga traditionally holds the weapons of various male gods of Hindu mythology, which they give her to fight the evil forces because they feel that she is shakti (energy, power). These include the chakra (divine discus), conch, bow, arrow, sword, javelin, trishula trident, shield, mace, pink lotus flower, and noose.

statement.id: Durga secara tradisional memegang senjata berbagai dewa laki-laki yang mereka berikan agar ia melawan kejahatan karena mereka memandangnya sebagai shakti (energi, daya); di antaranya cakra, kerang, busur, anak panah, pedang, lembing, trisula, perisai, gada, bunga teratai merah muda, dan jerat.
statement.en: Durga traditionally holds the weapons of various male gods, given to her to fight evil because they regard her as shakti (energy, power); these include the discus, conch, bow, arrow, sword, javelin, trident, shield, mace, pink lotus and noose.

claims.quote: The word Durga (दुर्गा) literally means "impassable", "invincible, unassailable". It is related to the word Durg (दुर्ग) which means "fortress, something difficult to defeat or pass".

statement.id: Kata Durga secara harfiah berarti "tak dapat dilewati", "tak terkalahkan, tak tertembus", dan berkaitan dengan kata durg yang berarti "benteng, sesuatu yang sulit dikalahkan atau dilewati".
statement.en: The word Durga literally means "impassable", "invincible, unassailable"; it is related to durg, meaning "fortress, something difficult to defeat or pass".

claims.quote: In Vaishnava contexts, Durga is revered as Yoganidrā, the divine slumber, younger sister and a female version of Vishnu.

statement.id: Dalam konteks Waisnawa, Durga dihormati sebagai Yoganidra, tidur ilahi, adik perempuan sekaligus versi perempuan Wisnu.
statement.en: In Vaishnava contexts, Durga is revered as Yoganidra, the divine slumber, younger sister and a female version of Vishnu.

claims.quote: Vishnu offers Durga the task of transferring the seventh child of Devaki into the womb of Rohini, as well as being born on earth as the infant daughter of Yashoda and Nanda, so that she could be swapped with Krishna.

statement.id: Menurut tradisi Waisnawa, Wisnu menugaskan Durga memindahkan anak ketujuh Devaki ke rahim Rohini dan lahir sebagai bayi perempuan Yashoda dan Nanda agar dapat ditukar dengan Krishna.
statement.en: In Vaishnava tradition, Vishnu gives Durga the task of moving Devaki's seventh child into Rohini's womb and of being born as the infant daughter of Yashoda and Nanda so she could be swapped with Krishna.

claims.quote: There are many epithets for Durga in Shaktism and her nine appellations are (Navadurga): Shailaputri, Brahmacharini, Chandraghanta, Kushmanda, Skandamata, Katyayini, Kalaratri, Mahagauri and Siddhidatri.

statement.id: Dalam Shaktisme Durga punya banyak julukan, dan sembilan sebutannya (Navadurga) adalah Shailaputri, Brahmacharini, Chandraghanta, Kushmanda, Skandamata, Katyayini, Kalaratri, Mahagauri, dan Siddhidatri.
statement.en: In Shaktism Durga has many epithets, and her nine appellations (Navadurga) are Shailaputri, Brahmacharini, Chandraghanta, Kushmanda, Skandamata, Katyayini, Kalaratri, Mahagauri and Siddhidatri.

claims.quote: In the north wall of a granite cave in Mamallapuram, Tamil Nadu there is a large relief of Durga slaying Mahisasura, carved around 630–674 CE.

statement.id: Di dinding utara sebuah gua granit di Mamallapuram, Tamil Nadu, terdapat relief besar Durga membunuh Mahisasura yang diukir sekitar 630-674 M.
statement.en: On the north wall of a granite cave in Mamallapuram, Tamil Nadu, there is a large relief of Durga slaying Mahisasura, carved around 630-674 CE.

claims.quote: The 6th-century CE inscriptions in early Siddhamatrika script, such as at the Nagarjuni hill cave during the Maukhari era, already mention the legend of her victory over Mahishasura

statement.id: Prasasti abad ke-6 M beraksara Siddhamatrika awal, misalnya di gua bukit Nagarjuni pada masa Maukhari, sudah menyebut kisah kemenangannya atas Mahishasura.
statement.en: Sixth-century CE inscriptions in early Siddhamatrika script, such as at the Nagarjuni hill cave in the Maukhari era, already mention the legend of her victory over Mahishasura.

claims.quote: Durga as a demon-slaying goddess was likely well established by the time the classic Hindu text called Devi Mahatmya was composed, which scholars variously estimate to between 400 and 600 CE.

statement.id: Durga sebagai dewi pembunuh iblis kemungkinan sudah mapan ketika teks klasik Devi Mahatmya disusun, yang oleh para sarjana diperkirakan antara 400 dan 600 M.
statement.en: Durga as a demon-slaying goddess was likely well established when the classic text Devi Mahatmya was composed, which scholars variously date to between 400 and 600 CE.

claims.quote: Her iconography typically resonates with these attributes, where she rides a lion or a tiger, has between eight and eighteen hands, each holding a weapon to destroy and create.

statement.id: Ikonografinya biasanya menampilkan Durga menunggangi singa atau harimau dengan delapan sampai delapan belas tangan yang masing-masing memegang senjata.
statement.en: Her iconography typically shows her riding a lion or a tiger, with between eight and eighteen hands, each holding a weapon.

claims.quote: Durga iconography has been flexible in the Hindu traditions, where for example some intellectuals place a pen or other writing implements in her hand since they consider their stylus as their weapon.

statement.id: Ikonografi Durga lentur dalam tradisi Hindu; misalnya sebagian cendekiawan meletakkan pena atau alat tulis di tangannya karena menganggap penanya sebagai senjata.
statement.en: Durga iconography has been flexible in Hindu traditions; for example some intellectuals place a pen or other writing implement in her hand because they consider their stylus their weapon.

claims.quote: Himavan, the personification of the Himalayas, gifted a lion as her mount.

statement.id: Dalam kisah ini, Himavan, personifikasi Himalaya, menghadiahkan seekor singa sebagai tunggangannya.
statement.en: In this account Himavan, the personification of the Himalayas, gifted a lion as her mount.

claims.quote: Durga has a significant following all over Nepal, India, Bangladesh and many other countries.

statement.id: Durga memiliki banyak pengikut di seluruh Nepal, India, Bangladesh, dan banyak negara lain.
statement.en: Durga has a significant following all over Nepal, India, Bangladesh and many other countries.

claims.quote: Durga is typically portrayed as a celibate warrior goddess. However, at a certain point in her history, she becomes associated with the god Śiva as his wife.

statement.id: Durga umumnya digambarkan sebagai dewi pejuang yang selibat, tetapi pada suatu titik dalam sejarahnya ia dikaitkan dengan Dewa Siwa sebagai istrinya.
statement.en: Durga is typically portrayed as a celibate warrior goddess, but at a certain point in her history she becomes associated with the god Shiva as his wife.

claims.quote: Durgā is a very popular deity. The name is indifferently applied to all goddesses with a terrible appearance and in a fighting attitude.

statement.id: Durga adalah dewi yang sangat populer; nama itu dipakai tanpa pembedaan untuk semua dewi berwujud menakutkan dan bersikap bertempur.
statement.en: Durga is a very popular deity; the name is applied indifferently to all goddesses with a terrible appearance and in a fighting attitude.

claims.quote: The Saivāgama specifically describes nine varieties of Durgā, all of which have two arms but different weapons

statement.id: Saivagama secara khusus menguraikan sembilan ragam Durga, semuanya bertangan dua tetapi bersenjata berbeda.
statement.en: The Saivagama specifically describes nine varieties of Durga, all with two arms but different weapons.

claims.quote: In this role, Durgā assumes domestic characteristics and is often identified with the goddess Parvati.

statement.id: Dalam peran sebagai istri Siwa, Durga mengambil sifat rumah tangga dan sering diidentifikasi dengan dewi Parwati.
statement.en: In this role as Shiva's wife, Durga assumes domestic characteristics and is often identified with the goddess Parvati.

claims.quote: The general description of Durgā given in the Kāsyapa-Silpa represents her as having four arms, two eyes

statement.id: Uraian umum tentang Durga dalam Kasyapa-Silpa menggambarkannya berlengan empat dan bermata dua.
statement.en: The general description of Durga in the Kasyapa-Silpa shows her with four arms and two eyes.

claims.quote: From Mahābalipuram comes the figure of a Durgā (fig. 124) who stands on the buffalo's head. She has eight arms, in the uppermost of which are found the discus and the conch.

statement.id: Sebuah arca Durga dari Mahabalipuram berdiri di atas kepala kerbau dan berlengan delapan; di tangan teratasnya terdapat cakram dan kerang.
statement.en: A figure of Durga from Mahabalipuram stands on the buffalo's head and has eight arms; the discus and the conch are in the uppermost ones.

claims.quote: Durga is commonly known as Mahishasura-mardini for slaying the half-buffalo demon Mahishasura. She is also known as Vindhyavasini (she who dwells in the Vindhya Mountains).
