short_description.id: Mars adalah dewa perang Romawi, kedua sesudah Jupiter, sekaligus pelindung Roma dan pertanian. Ia dikenal sebagai ayah Romulus dan Remus, dan serigala serta burung pelatuk suci baginya.
short_description.en: Mars is the Roman god of war, second only to Jupiter, and a guardian of Rome and agriculture. He is known as father of Romulus and Remus, and the wolf and woodpecker were sacred to him.

long_description.id:
Mars adalah dewa perang Romawi, kedua sesudah Jupiter dalam jajaran dewa Romawi. Sebagian besar mitosnya dipinjam dari Ares Yunani, tetapi ia dipandang lebih tenang dan lebih berbudi luhur oleh orang Romawi. Berbeda dengan Ares yang dianggap pengacau, Mars melambangkan kekuatan militer sebagai cara mengamankan perdamaian. Ia juga pelindung pertanian, perpaduan yang khas Roma awal, dan putra Jupiter dan Juno. Ciri hakiki Mars adalah kejantanan, yang dipahami sebagai daya hidup (vis) atau keutamaan (virtus).

Mars dipandang sebagai pelindung Roma dan cara hidup Romawi, yang membela batas dan perbatasan kota. Dalam perang, sebuah tombak diguncang di Regia dan ia dipanggil untuk menjaga rakyat Romawi; panglima yang hendak berangkat mengguncang tombak sucinya. Persaudaraan Arval memanggilnya untuk melindungi para pemohon dari malapetaka, dan sebagai pelindung pertanian ia mengarahkan tenaganya agar tanaman tumbuh. Pada abad ke-3 M ia terutama disembah legiun Romawi.

Dalam mitos pendirian Roma, Mars dianggap ayah Romulus dan Remus, kembar pendiri Roma yang mitis. Livy mencatat bahwa sang Perawan Vesta menyebut Mars sebagai ayah mereka, entah karena sungguh percaya atau agar kesalahannya tampak lebih ringan. Serigala betina menyusui bayi-bayi itu; serigala dan burung pelatuk adalah hewan liar paling suci bagi Mars. Dalam asal-usul Roma menurut Virgil, Mars adalah leluhur Romulus. Di wilayah bangsa Aequi, Mars memiliki orakel kuno tempat ramalan konon diucapkan seekor burung pelatuk. Mars juga dikaitkan dengan Venus, dengan pasangan Nerio, dan dalam kisah khas Romawi dengan pernikahannya yang licik dengan Anna Perenna.

Bulan Martius dinamai menurut Mars. Festival untuknya digelar pada Maret dan Oktober, sering terkait persiapan dan penutupan kampanye militer, dan dilaksanakan antara lain oleh imam khusus flamen Martialis. Pada Maret para imam Salii menyanyikan himne dengan baju zirah zaman perunggu, dan Tubilustrium membersihkan terompet. Di antaranya Equus October, perlombaan kuda di Campus Martius, dan Armilustrium, penyucian senjata sebelum disimpan. Kurban khasnya adalah suovetaurilia dan Kuda Oktober. Kuil dan altar didirikan baginya di Roma dan seluruh kekaisaran, dan relief menampilkannya sebagai pria berjanggut dengan helm Korintus.
long_description.en:
Mars is the Roman god of war, second only to Jupiter in the Roman pantheon. Most of his myths were borrowed from Greek Ares, but the Romans saw him as more level-headed and more virtuous. Unlike Ares, seen as a disruptive force, Mars represented military power as a way to secure peace. He was also an agricultural guardian, a combination characteristic of early Rome, and a son of Jupiter and Juno. Mars is characterised above all by virility, understood as vital force (vis) or manly virtue (virtus).

Mars was seen as a protector of Rome and the Roman way of life, defending city borders and frontiers. In wartime a spear was shaken in the Regia and he was called on to watch over the Roman people, and the departing commander shook his sacred spears. The Arval Brotherhood invoked him to protect suppliants from ill, and as agricultural guardian he directs his energies toward making crops grow. By the 3rd century CE he was mainly worshipped by Roman legions.

In the myth of Rome's founding, Mars is considered father of Romulus and Remus, the mythical twin founders of Rome. Livy records that the Vestal named Mars as their father, either because she believed it or to make the fault seem lighter. A she-wolf suckled the infants; the wolf and woodpecker were the wild animals most sacred to Mars. In Virgil's account of Rome's origin, Mars is the ancestor of Romulus. Among the Aequi, Mars had an ancient oracle where a woodpecker was said to speak the prophecies. Mars is also linked to Venus, to his consort Nerio, and in a uniquely Roman story to his tricked marriage to Anna Perenna.

The month Martius was named after Mars. Festivals for him were held in March and October, often tied to preparing for and closing military campaigns, and were carried out by his dedicated priests, the flamen Martialis. In March the Salii priests sang hymns in bronze-age armour, and the Tubilustrium cleansed trumpets. They included the Equus October, a horse race in the Campus Martius, and the Armilustrium, the purification of weapons before storage. His distinctive sacrifices were the suovetaurilia and the October Horse. Temples and altars were dedicated to him in Rome and throughout the Empire, and relief art shows him as a bearded man in a Corinthian helmet.

short_description.id: Mars adalah dewa perang Romawi, kedua sesudah Jupiter, sekaligus pelindung Roma dan pertanian. Ia dikenal sebagai ayah Romulus dan Remus, dan serigala serta burung pelatuk suci baginya.
short_description.en: Mars is the Roman god of war, second only to Jupiter, and a guardian of Rome and agriculture. He is known as father of Romulus and Remus, and the wolf and woodpecker were sacred to him.

long_description.id: Mars adalah dewa perang Romawi, kedua sesudah Jupiter dalam jajaran dewa Romawi. Sebagian besar mitosnya dipinjam dari Ares Yunani, tetapi ia dipandang lebih tenang dan lebih berbudi luhur oleh orang Romawi. Berbeda dengan Ares yang dianggap pengacau, Mars melambangkan kekuatan militer sebagai cara mengamankan perdamaian. Ia juga pelindung pertanian, perpaduan yang khas Roma awal, dan putra Jupiter dan Juno. Ciri hakiki Mars adalah kejantanan, yang dipahami sebagai daya hidup (vis) atau keutamaan (virtus).
long_description.en: Mars is the Roman god of war, second only to Jupiter in the Roman pantheon. Most of his myths were borrowed from Greek Ares, but the Romans saw him as more level-headed and more virtuous. Unlike Ares, seen as a disruptive force, Mars represented military power as a way to secure peace. He was also an agricultural guardian, a combination characteristic of early Rome, and a son of Jupiter and Juno. Mars is characterised above all by virility, understood as vital force (vis) or manly virtue (virtus).

long_description.id: Mars dipandang sebagai pelindung Roma dan cara hidup Romawi, yang membela batas dan perbatasan kota. Dalam perang, sebuah tombak diguncang di Regia dan ia dipanggil untuk menjaga rakyat Romawi; panglima yang hendak berangkat mengguncang tombak sucinya. Persaudaraan Arval memanggilnya untuk melindungi para pemohon dari malapetaka, dan sebagai pelindung pertanian ia mengarahkan tenaganya agar tanaman tumbuh. Pada abad ke-3 M ia terutama disembah legiun Romawi.
long_description.en: Mars was seen as a protector of Rome and the Roman way of life, defending city borders and frontiers. In wartime a spear was shaken in the Regia and he was called on to watch over the Roman people, and the departing commander shook his sacred spears. The Arval Brotherhood invoked him to protect suppliants from ill, and as agricultural guardian he directs his energies toward making crops grow. By the 3rd century CE he was mainly worshipped by Roman legions.

long_description.id: Dalam mitos pendirian Roma, Mars dianggap ayah Romulus dan Remus, kembar pendiri Roma yang mitis. Livy mencatat bahwa sang Perawan Vesta menyebut Mars sebagai ayah mereka, entah karena sungguh percaya atau agar kesalahannya tampak lebih ringan. Serigala betina menyusui bayi-bayi itu; serigala dan burung pelatuk adalah hewan liar paling suci bagi Mars. Dalam asal-usul Roma menurut Virgil, Mars adalah leluhur Romulus. Di wilayah bangsa Aequi, Mars memiliki orakel kuno tempat ramalan konon diucapkan seekor burung pelatuk. Mars juga dikaitkan dengan Venus, dengan pasangan Nerio, dan dalam kisah khas Romawi dengan pernikahannya yang licik dengan Anna Perenna.
long_description.en: In the myth of Rome's founding, Mars is considered father of Romulus and Remus, the mythical twin founders of Rome. Livy records that the Vestal named Mars as their father, either because she believed it or to make the fault seem lighter. A she-wolf suckled the infants; the wolf and woodpecker were the wild animals most sacred to Mars. In Virgil's account of Rome's origin, Mars is the ancestor of Romulus. Among the Aequi, Mars had an ancient oracle where a woodpecker was said to speak the prophecies. Mars is also linked to Venus, to his consort Nerio, and in a uniquely Roman story to his tricked marriage to Anna Perenna.

long_description.id: Bulan Martius dinamai menurut Mars. Festival untuknya digelar pada Maret dan Oktober, sering terkait persiapan dan penutupan kampanye militer, dan dilaksanakan antara lain oleh imam khusus flamen Martialis. Pada Maret para imam Salii menyanyikan himne dengan baju zirah zaman perunggu, dan Tubilustrium membersihkan terompet. Di antaranya Equus October, perlombaan kuda di Campus Martius, dan Armilustrium, penyucian senjata sebelum disimpan. Kurban khasnya adalah suovetaurilia dan Kuda Oktober. Kuil dan altar didirikan baginya di Roma dan seluruh kekaisaran, dan relief menampilkannya sebagai pria berjanggut dengan helm Korintus.
long_description.en: The month Martius was named after Mars. Festivals for him were held in March and October, often tied to preparing for and closing military campaigns, and were carried out by his dedicated priests, the flamen Martialis. In March the Salii priests sang hymns in bronze-age armour, and the Tubilustrium cleansed trumpets. They included the Equus October, a horse race in the Campus Martius, and the Armilustrium, the purification of weapons before storage. His distinctive sacrifices were the suovetaurilia and the October Horse. Temples and altars were dedicated to him in Rome and throughout the Empire, and relief art shows him as a bearded man in a Corinthian helmet.

statement.en: Some Mars rites may have agricultural links, but his agricultural role is debated.

claims.quote: the god was also closely associated with the wolf and woodpecker.

statement.id: Serigala dan burung pelatuk berkaitan erat dengan Mars.
statement.en: The wolf and woodpecker were associated with Mars.

claims.quote: Numerous temples, shrines, and altars were dedicated to him in Rome and throughout the Empire.

statement.id: Kuil dan altar Mars didirikan di Roma dan seluruh kekaisaran.
statement.en: Temples and altars to Mars stood in Rome and across the empire.

claims.quote: Mars is represented in the canonical guise of an older, bearded man wearing a Corinthian helmet tipped back on his head.

statement.id: Relief Romawi di The Met menggambarkan Mars sebagai pria tua berjanggut dengan helm Korintus.
statement.en: A Roman relief at The Met portrays Mars as an older bearded man wearing a Corinthian helmet.

claims.quote: Important festivals and ceremonies, usually connected to the preparation and closure of military campaigns, were held in honour of the god in March and October

statement.id: Festival Mars berlangsung pada Maret dan Oktober, terkait awal dan akhir musim kampanye militer.
statement.en: Mars festivals in March and October marked military campaign preparations and closure.

claims.quote: is the god of war and also an agricultural guardian, a combination characteristic of early Rome. He is the son of Jupiter and Juno, and was pre-eminent among the Roman army's military gods.

statement.id: Mars adalah dewa perang sekaligus pelindung pertanian, perpaduan yang khas Roma awal; ia putra Jupiter dan Juno dan terkemuka di antara dewa-dewa militer tentara Romawi.
statement.en: Mars is the god of war and also an agricultural guardian, a combination characteristic of early Rome; he is the son of Jupiter and Juno and was pre-eminent among the Roman army's military gods.

claims.quote: Unlike Ares, who was viewed primarily as a destructive and destabilizing force, Mars represented military power as a way to secure peace, and was a father (pater) of the Roman people.

statement.id: Berbeda dengan Ares yang dipandang terutama sebagai kekuatan perusak dan pengacau, Mars melambangkan kekuatan militer sebagai cara mengamankan perdamaian dan menjadi bapak (pater) bangsa Romawi.
statement.en: Unlike Ares, who was seen mainly as a destructive and destabilizing force, Mars represented military power as a way to secure peace and was a father (pater) of the Roman people.

claims.quote: Mars's altar in the Campus Martius, the area of Rome that took its name from him, was supposed to have been dedicated by Numa, the peace-loving semi-legendary second king of Rome

statement.id: Altar Mars di Campus Martius, kawasan Roma yang dinamai menurut namanya, konon didedikasikan oleh Numa, raja kedua Roma yang cinta damai dan setengah legendaris.
statement.en: Mars's altar in the Campus Martius, the area of Rome named after him, was supposed to have been dedicated by Numa, the peace-loving semi-legendary second king of Rome.

claims.quote: Augustus shifted the focus of Mars's cult to within the pomerium (Rome's ritual boundary), and built a temple to Mars Ultor as a key religious feature of his new forum.

statement.id: Augustus memindahkan pusat kultus Mars ke dalam pomerium (batas ritual Roma) dan membangun kuil bagi Mars Ultor sebagai ciri keagamaan utama forum barunya.
statement.en: Augustus shifted the focus of Mars's cult inside the pomerium (Rome's ritual boundary) and built a temple to Mars Ultor as a key religious feature of his new forum.

claims.quote: Mars's association with the wolf is familiar from what may be the most famous of Roman myths, the story of how a she-wolf (lupa) suckled his infant sons when they were exposed by order of King Amulius

statement.id: Kaitan Mars dengan serigala dikenal dari kisah paling terkenal mitos Romawi: seekor serigala betina (lupa) menyusui putra-putranya yang masih bayi ketika mereka dibuang atas perintah Raja Amulius.
statement.en: Mars's association with the wolf is familiar from what may be the most famous Roman myth: a she-wolf (lupa) suckled his infant sons when they were exposed on the order of King Amulius.

claims.quote: The wild animals most sacred to Mars were the woodpecker and the wolf, which in the natural lore of the Romans were said always to inhabit the same foothills and woodlands.

statement.id: Hewan liar yang paling suci bagi Mars adalah burung pelatuk dan serigala, yang menurut pengetahuan alam Romawi selalu menghuni kaki bukit dan hutan yang sama.
statement.en: The wild animals most sacred to Mars were the woodpecker and the wolf, said in Roman natural lore always to inhabit the same foothills and woodlands.

claims.quote: As the beak of the picus Martius contained the god's power to ward off harm, it was carried as a magic charm to prevent bee stings and leech bites.

statement.id: Karena paruh picus Martius mengandung kekuatan sang dewa untuk menangkal bahaya, paruh itu dibawa sebagai jimat untuk mencegah sengatan lebah dan gigitan lintah.
statement.en: Because the beak of the picus Martius held the god's power to ward off harm, it was carried as a magic charm to prevent bee stings and leech bites.

claims.quote: In the territory of the Aequi, another Italic people, Mars had an oracle of great antiquity where the prophecies were supposed to be spoken by a woodpecker perched on a wooden column.

statement.id: Di wilayah bangsa Aequi, Mars memiliki orakel yang sangat kuno, tempat ramalan konon diucapkan oleh burung pelatuk yang bertengger di tiang kayu.
statement.en: In the territory of the Aequi, Mars had an oracle of great antiquity where prophecies were supposed to be spoken by a woodpecker perched on a wooden column.

claims.quote: At the Battle of Sentinum in 295 BCE, the appearance of the wolf of Mars (Martius lupus) was a sign that Roman victory was to come.

statement.id: Pada Pertempuran Sentinum tahun 295 SM, munculnya serigala Mars (Martius lupus) menjadi tanda bahwa kemenangan Romawi akan datang.
statement.en: At the Battle of Sentinum in 295 BCE, the appearance of the wolf of Mars (Martius lupus) was a sign that Roman victory was to come.

claims.quote: In Roman Gaul, the goose was associated with the Celtic forms of Mars, and archaeologists have found geese buried alongside warriors in graves.

statement.id: Di Gaul Romawi, angsa dikaitkan dengan bentuk-bentuk Mars versi Kelt, dan arkeolog menemukan angsa dikubur bersama prajurit di makam.
statement.en: In Roman Gaul the goose was associated with the Celtic forms of Mars, and archaeologists have found geese buried alongside warriors in graves.

claims.quote: The two most distinctive animal sacrifices made to Mars were the suovetaurilia, a triple offering of a pig (sus), ram (ovis) and bull (taurus), and the October Horse, the only horse sacrifice known to have been carried out in ancient Rome

statement.id: Dua kurban hewan yang paling khas bagi Mars adalah suovetaurilia, persembahan tiga hewan (babi, domba jantan, banteng), dan Kuda Oktober, satu-satunya kurban kuda yang diketahui di Roma kuno.
statement.en: The two most distinctive animal sacrifices to Mars were the suovetaurilia, a triple offering of pig, ram and bull, and the October Horse, the only horse sacrifice known in ancient Rome.

claims.quote: Cato the Elder invokes Mars Silvanus for a ritual to be carried out in silva

statement.id: Cato yang Tua memanggil Mars Silvanus untuk sebuah ritual yang dilaksanakan di silva, yaitu di hutan.
statement.en: Cato the Elder invokes Mars Silvanus for a ritual to be carried out in silva, in the woods.

claims.quote: As an agricultural guardian, Mars directs his energies toward creating conditions that allow crops to grow, which may include warding off hostile forces of nature.

statement.id: Sebagai pelindung pertanian, Mars mengarahkan tenaganya untuk menciptakan kondisi agar tanaman tumbuh, yang mungkin mencakup menangkal kekuatan alam yang bermusuhan.
statement.en: As an agricultural guardian, Mars directs his energies toward creating conditions for crops to grow, which may include warding off hostile forces of nature.

claims.quote: the god Mars is invoked by the Arval Brotherhood specifically to protect and defend the suppliants from ill.

statement.id: Mars dipanggil oleh Persaudaraan Arval khusus untuk melindungi dan membela para pemohon dari malapetaka.
statement.en: Mars is invoked by the Arval Brotherhood specifically to protect and defend the suppliants from ill.

claims.quote: Mars may have originated as a god of the wild, who dwelt beyond the boundaries set by humans.

statement.id: Mars mungkin berasal sebagai dewa alam liar yang bermukim di luar batas yang dibuat manusia.
statement.en: Mars may have originated as a god of the wild who dwelt beyond the boundaries set by humans.

claims.quote: Virility as a kind of life force (vis ) or virtue (virtus ) is an essential characteristic of Mars.

statement.id: Kejantanan sebagai semacam daya hidup (vis) atau keutamaan (virtus) merupakan ciri hakiki Mars.
statement.en: Virility as a kind of life force (vis) or virtue (virtus) is an essential characteristic of Mars.

claims.quote: By the 3rd-century CE, Mars was primarily worshipped by Roman military legions.

statement.id: Pada abad ke-3 M, Mars terutama disembah oleh legiun militer Romawi.
statement.en: By the 3rd century CE, Mars was primarily worshipped by Roman military legions.

claims.quote: According to the 4th-century author Servius the Grammarian, during wartime, a spear was shaken in the Regia and Mars was called upon to watch over the Roman people with the words

statement.id: Menurut Servius, pada masa perang sebuah tombak diguncang di Regia dan Mars dipanggil untuk menjaga rakyat Romawi dengan ucapan tertentu.
statement.en: According to Servius, in wartime a spear was shaken in the Regia and Mars was called upon to watch over the Roman people with a set formula.

claims.quote: Like Ares who was the son of Zeus and Hera, Mars is usually considered to be the son of Jupiter and Juno. In Ovid's version of Mars's origin, he was the son of Juno alone.

statement.id: Seperti Ares yang putra Zeus dan Hera, Mars biasanya dianggap putra Jupiter dan Juno; dalam versi Ovidius, ia putra Juno seorang diri.
statement.en: Like Ares, son of Zeus and Hera, Mars is usually considered the son of Jupiter and Juno; in Ovid's version he was the son of Juno alone.

claims.quote: Flora obtained a magic flower (Latin flos, plural flores, a masculine word) and tested it on a heifer who became fecund at once. Flora ritually plucked a flower, using her thumb, touched Juno's belly, and impregnated her. ... Ovid tells this story in the Fasti, his long-form poetic work on the Roman calendar.

statement.id: Dalam versi Ovidius, Flora memperoleh bunga ajaib, mengujinya pada anak sapi betina yang langsung subur, lalu menyentuh perut Juno dengan bunga itu dan membuatnya hamil.
statement.en: In Ovid's version Flora obtained a magic flower, tested it on a heifer that became fecund at once, and touched Juno's belly with it, impregnating her.

claims.quote: Ovid is the only source for the story.

statement.id: Ovidius adalah satu-satunya sumber untuk kisah itu.
statement.en: Ovid is the only source for the story.

claims.quote: The consort of Mars was Nerio or Neriene, meaning "Valor".

statement.id: Pasangan Mars adalah Nerio atau Neriene, yang berarti "Keberanian".
statement.en: The consort of Mars was Nerio or Neriene, meaning "Valor".

claims.quote: In the early 3rd century BCE, the comic playwright Plautus has a reference to Mars greeting Nerio, his wife.

statement.id: Pada awal abad ke-3 SM, penulis komedi Plautus menyinggung Mars menyapa Nerio, istrinya.
statement.en: In the early 3rd century BCE, the comic playwright Plautus refers to Mars greeting Nerio, his wife.

claims.quote: Although not originally part of the Roman tradition, in 217 BCE Venus and Mars were presented as a complementary pair in the lectisternium

statement.id: Meski semula bukan bagian tradisi Romawi, pada 217 SM Venus dan Mars ditampilkan sebagai pasangan yang saling melengkapi dalam lectisternium.
statement.en: Although not originally part of the Roman tradition, in 217 BCE Venus and Mars were presented as a complementary pair in the lectisternium.

claims.quote: The oldest recorded Latin form, Mamart-, is likely of foreign origin. It has been explained as deriving from Maris, the name of an Etruscan child-god, though this is not universally agreed upon.

statement.id: Bentuk Latin tertua yang tercatat, Mamart-, mungkin berasal dari luar; ada penjelasan yang menurunkannya dari Maris, nama dewa anak Etruria, meski tidak disepakati semua orang.
statement.en: The oldest recorded Latin form, Mamart-, is likely of foreign origin; it has been explained as deriving from Maris, an Etruscan child-god, though this is not universally agreed.

claims.quote: In older literature, the god Mars was equated with the Vedic storm deities known as the Maruts ... However, this etymology is now rejected in more modern Indo-Europeanist scholarship.

statement.id: Etimologi yang menyamakan Mars dengan Marut Weda kini ditolak dalam kajian Indo-Eropa yang lebih modern.
statement.en: The older etymology equating Mars with the Vedic Maruts is now rejected in more modern Indo-Europeanist scholarship.

claims.quote: In older literature, the god Mars was equated with the Vedic storm deities known as the Maruts

statement.id: Dalam literatur lama, Mars disamakan dengan dewa-dewa badai Weda yang disebut Marut.
statement.en: In older literature, Mars was equated with the Vedic storm deities known as the Maruts.

claims.quote: Latin adjectives from the name of Mars are ... meaning "of Mars" or "warlike" from which derive the English term "martial"

statement.id: Kata sifat Latin turunan nama Mars berarti "milik Mars" atau "suka perang", yang melahirkan kata Inggris "martial".
statement.en: Latin adjectives from the name of Mars mean "of Mars" or "warlike", from which the English term "martial" derives.

claims.quote: Within the mythological origin of Rome outlined by the 1st-century BCE poet Virgil, Mars was cast as the ancestor of Romulus and Venus as the ancestor of Aeneas

statement.id: Dalam asal-usul mitologis Roma yang diuraikan penyair Virgil abad ke-1 SM, Mars adalah leluhur Romulus dan Venus leluhur Aeneas.
statement.en: In the mythological origin of Rome outlined by the 1st-century BCE poet Virgil, Mars was cast as the ancestor of Romulus and Venus as the ancestor of Aeneas.

claims.quote: Mars is considered more level-headed than the impulsive and disruptive Ares. Mars is also a more virtuous figure to the more martial-oriented Romans.

statement.id: Mars dianggap lebih tenang daripada Ares Yunani yang impulsif dan pengacau, dan lebih berbudi luhur bagi orang Romawi yang berorientasi militer.
statement.en: Mars is considered more level-headed than the impulsive and disruptive Ares, and more virtuous to the martially minded Romans.

claims.quote: According to the story, their mother, the Vestal Virgin Rhea Silvia, was raped by Mars while she slept, and in her dreams she had a vision where she dropped a hairpin to the ground, and from which there sprang two twin trees.

statement.id: Menurut kisahnya, ibu mereka, Perawan Vesta Rhea Silvia, diperkosa Mars saat tidur, dan dalam mimpinya ia melihat jepit rambut yang dijatuhkannya menumbuhkan dua pohon kembar.
statement.en: In the story their mother, the Vestal Virgin Rhea Silvia, was raped by Mars while she slept, and in a dream she dropped a hairpin that sprang up as two twin trees.

claims.quote: However, Anna Perenna quite fancied the handsome war god for herself, and so she double-crossed Mars by disguising herself as Minerva and, wearing a veil, she tricked the god into marrying her.

statement.id: Anna Perenna menyukai sang dewa perang untuk dirinya sendiri, lalu menipu Mars dengan menyamar sebagai Minerva dan berkerudung sehingga Mars menikahinya.
statement.en: Anna Perenna fancied the war god for herself and double-crossed Mars by disguising herself as Minerva, veiled, tricking him into marrying her.

claims.quote: Another myth concerning the god of war, this one uniquely Roman, was his marriage to Anna Perenna. The story is re-told in Ovid's Fasti and begins with Mars falling in love with no less a figure than Minerva

statement.id: Mitos khas Romawi lainnya adalah pernikahan Mars dengan Anna Perenna; kisah yang diceritakan ulang dalam Fasti karya Ovidius ini bermula ketika Mars jatuh cinta kepada Minerva.
statement.en: Another uniquely Roman myth is Mars's marriage to Anna Perenna; the story, retold in Ovid's Fasti, begins with Mars falling in love with Minerva.

claims.quote: Mars again took centre stage during the Equus October, held on the 15th of that month. This was when a great horse race was held in the Campus Martius of Rome.

statement.id: Mars kembali menjadi pusat perhatian pada Equus October, 15 Oktober, ketika perlombaan kuda besar diadakan di Campus Martius, Roma.
statement.en: Mars again took centre stage at the Equus October on 15 October, when a great horse race was held in the Campus Martius of Rome.

claims.quote: Finally, there was the Armilustrium festival on the 19th of October, held on the Aventine and which involved the purification of weapons before they were stored away for the winter.

statement.id: Terakhir ada festival Armilustrium pada 19 Oktober di Aventine, berupa penyucian senjata sebelum disimpan selama musim dingin.
statement.en: Finally the Armilustrium festival on 19 October, held on the Aventine, involved the purification of weapons before they were stored away for the winter.

claims.quote: The Tubilustrium involved a series of rites to cleanse and favour trumpets, whilst the Equirria was to ensure all would be well with the horses when on campaign.

statement.id: Tubilustrium berupa rangkaian ritus membersihkan dan memberkati terompet, sedangkan Equirria memastikan kuda-kuda baik-baik saja saat berkampanye.
statement.en: The Tubilustrium involved rites to cleanse and favour trumpets, while the Equirria ensured all would be well with the horses on campaign.

claims.quote: Another important ritual was performed by the commander of the army about to depart who shook the sacred spears of the god which were kept in the Regia.

statement.id: Ritus penting lain dilakukan panglima pasukan yang hendak berangkat dengan mengguncang tombak suci sang dewa yang disimpan di Regia.
statement.en: Another important ritual was performed by the commander of the departing army, who shook the god's sacred spears kept in the Regia.

claims.quote: On the 1st, 9th and 23rd of March, the priests of this sacred trio, the Salii, sang hymns and dressed themselves in bronze-age armour which included the ancient ancilia figure-of-eight shields.

statement.id: Pada 1, 9, dan 23 Maret, para imam Salii menyanyikan himne dan mengenakan baju zirah zaman perunggu termasuk perisai ancilia berbentuk angka delapan.
statement.en: On 1, 9 and 23 March the priests called the Salii sang hymns and dressed in bronze-age armour including the ancient figure-of-eight ancilia shields.

claims.quote: he was also involved with ceremonies relating to the ancient triad of gods which included himself, Jupiter, and Quirinus.

statement.id: Mars juga terlibat dalam upacara untuk triad dewa kuno yang terdiri dari dirinya, Jupiter, dan Quirinus.
statement.en: Mars was also involved in ceremonies for the ancient triad of gods that included himself, Jupiter and Quirinus.

claims.quote: were held in honour of the god in March and October and carried out by Mars' specially dedicated priests, the flamen Martialis.

statement.id: Upacara itu dilaksanakan oleh imam khusus Mars, flamen Martialis.
statement.en: The ceremonies were carried out by Mars' specially dedicated priests, the flamen Martialis.

claims.quote: The Vestal was forcibly violated and gave birth to twins. She named Mars as their father, either because she really believed it, or because the fault might appear less heinous if a deity were the cause of it.

statement.id: Dalam Livy, Perawan Vesta itu dinodai dengan paksa dan melahirkan anak kembar; ia menyebut Mars sebagai ayah mereka, entah karena sungguh percaya atau agar kesalahannya tampak lebih ringan jika seorang dewa penyebabnya.
statement.en: In Livy the Vestal was forcibly violated and gave birth to twins; she named Mars as their father, either because she believed it or because the fault might seem less heinous if a deity were the cause.

claims.quote: a thirsty she-wolf from the surrounding hills, attracted by the crying of the children, came to them, gave them her teats to suck and was so gentle towards them that the king's flock-master found her licking the boys with her tongue.

statement.id: Dalam Livy, seekor serigala betina yang haus dari bukit sekitar datang karena tangisan anak-anak itu, menyusui mereka, dan begitu lembut hingga gembala raja mendapatinya menjilati anak-anak itu.
statement.en: In Livy a thirsty she-wolf from the surrounding hills, drawn by the children's crying, came and suckled them and was so gentle that the king's flock-master found her licking the boys.

short_description.id: Herakles adalah pahlawan mitologi Yunani yang termasyhur karena kekuatannya, dua belas tugasnya, dan kenaikannya menjadi dewa.
short_description.en: Heracles is a Greek mythic hero famed for his strength, his twelve labors, and his rise to godhood.

long_description.id:
Herakles adalah pahlawan mitologi Yunani yang terkenal karena kekuatan dan daya tahannya. Menurut mitos, Zeus adalah ayahnya dan Alkmene ibunya. Hera, yang cemburu, mengirim dua ular kepada Herakles bayi, tetapi bayi itu mencekik keduanya.

Hera juga membuat Herakles gila hingga ia membunuh istri dan anak-anaknya. Peramal Delphi lalu memerintahkannya menjalani dua belas tugas untuk Eurystheus. Dalam tugas-tugas itu ia mencekik Singa Nemea dan mengenakan kulitnya, membunuh Hydra dengan bantuan Iolaos, dan membawa Kerberos dari dunia bawah tanpa senjata. Diodorus mencatat janji keabadian setelah tugas-tugas itu selesai.

Di luar kedua belas tugas itu, Herakles membebaskan Prometheus dengan menembak jatuh elang yang menyiksanya. Ia juga mengalahkan raksasa Antaeus dan Thanatos, dewa kematian, dalam adu gulat. Menurut Apollodorus, ia menerima pedang dari Hermes, busur dan anak panah dari Apollo, baju zirah emas dari Hephaestus, dan jubah dari Athena, sedangkan gadanya ia potong sendiri di Nemea.

Kisah hidupnya berakhir ketika jubah berlumur darah Nessos, yang dikirim Deianeira, membakar kulitnya. Athena kemudian membawanya dari api ke Gunung Olympus, tempat ia menikahi Hebe dan diizinkan tinggal bersama para dewa. Herakles dipuja sebagai dewa di Yunani pada zaman klasik, dan ia dianggap sekaligus pahlawan dan dewa.
long_description.en:
Heracles is a Greek mythic hero famed for strength and endurance. In myth, Zeus is his father and Alkmene his mother. Hera, who was jealous, sent two snakes to the infant Heracles, but the baby strangled them.

Hera also drove Heracles insane so that he killed his wife and children. The Delphic Oracle then ordered him to perform twelve labors for Eurystheus. In them he strangled the Nemean Lion and wore its pelt, killed the Hydra with the help of Iolaos, and brought Kerberos from the underworld without weapons. Diodorus records a promise of immortality once the labors were done.

Beyond the twelve labors, Heracles freed Prometheus by shooting down the eagle that tormented him. He also defeated the giant Antaeus and Thanatos, the god of death, in wrestling. According to Apollodorus, he received a sword from Hermes, a bow and arrows from Apollo, a golden breastplate from Hephaestus, and a robe from Athena, while he cut his club himself at Nemea.

His life ends when the cloak stained with the blood of Nessos, sent by Deianeira, burns his skin. Athena then takes him from the flames to Mount Olympus, where he marries Hebe and is allowed to live with the gods. Heracles was worshipped as a god in classical Greece, and he was thought to be both a hero and a god.

who.id: Pahlawan Yunani yang kuat, putra Zeus menurut mitos, yang kemudian dipuja sebagai dewa.
who.en: A mighty Greek hero, son of Zeus in myth, who was later worshipped as a god.

origin.id: Mitologi Yunani; kisahnya menyebut Mycenae, Nemea, dan Gunung Olympus.
origin.en: Greek mythology; his stories mention Mycenae, Nemea, and Mount Olympus.

role.id: Menjalani dua belas tugas atas perintah Eurystheus setelah petunjuk Peramal Delphi.
role.en: Performs twelve labors for Eurystheus on the instruction of the Delphic Oracle.

famous_for.id: Kekuatan besarnya dan dua belas tugas yang menjadikannya sekutu para dewa.
famous_for.en: His great strength and the twelve labors that won him a place among the gods.

did_you_know.id: Tiang-tiang Herkules di Selat Gades konon bermula dari penanda yang dipasang Herakles dalam perjalanannya ke sebuah pulau di samudra barat.
did_you_know.en: According to the myth, the Pillars of Hercules in the Strait of Gades began as markers Heracles set on his journey to an island in the western ocean.

cultural_context.id: Dalam masyarakat Yunani kuno, Herakles dipuja sebagai dewa pada zaman klasik dan sebagai pelindung kaum muda dan gimnasium. Pada sebagian festival, ia lebih dulu menerima persembahan sebagai pahlawan, kemudian sebagai dewa.

claim.id: Herakles adalah pahlawan mitologi Yunani yang terkenal karena kekuatan dan daya tahannya.
claim.en: Heracles is a Greek mythic hero renowned for strength and endurance.

claims_provenance.quote: Hercules (Herakles) was a hero of Greek mythology famous for his great strength and endurance.

claim.id: Zeus disebut sebagai ayah Herakles dan Alkmene sebagai ibunya.
claim.en: Zeus is named as Heracles's father and Alkmene as his mother.

claims_provenance.quote: In mythology, though, it was Zeus who lay with Alkmene and so fathered Hercules, explaining the origin of Hercules' great strength.

claim.id: Hera mengirim dua ular kepada Herakles bayi, tetapi ia mencekiknya.
claim.en: Hera sent two snakes to the infant Heracles, who strangled them.

claims_provenance.quote: Hera also sent two snakes to kill the new-born Hercules, but the baby easily strangled them.

claim.id: Peramal Delphi memerintahkannya menjalani dua belas tugas untuk Raja Eurystheus.
claim.en: The Delphic Oracle ordered Heracles to perform twelve labors for Eurystheus.

claims_provenance.quote: Heracles was commanded by the Delphic Oracle to perform twelve labors for King Eurystheus of Mycenae.

claim.id: Menurut Diodorus, Herakles menjalani dua belas tugas atas perintah Eurystheus dan dijanjikan keabadian setelah selesai.
claim.en: Diodorus says Heracles was commanded to complete twelve labors and promised immortality afterward.

claims_provenance.quote: Heracles journeyed to Delphi, and on inquiring of the god regarding the matter he received a reply which stated that the gods had decided that he should perform twelve Labours at the command of Eurystheus and that upon their conclusion he should receive the gift of immortality.
claims_provenance.source_citation: Theoi Classical Texts Library — Diodorus Siculus, Library of History Book 4.1-18

claim.id: Herakles mencekik Singa Nemea dan mengenakan kulitnya.
claim.en: Heracles strangled the Nemean Lion and wore its pelt.

claims_provenance.quote: Hercules strangled the lion with his bare hands and forever after wore its pelt as a protective cloak.

claim.id: Herakles juga dipuja sebagai dewa di Yunani pada zaman klasik.
claim.en: Heracles was worshipped as a god throughout classical Greece.

claims_provenance.quote: Heracles was worshipped throughout Greece in the classical age as a god.

claim.id: Hera membuat Herakles gila sehingga ia membunuh istri dan anak-anaknya.
claim.en: Hera drove Heracles insane so that he killed his wife and children.

claims_provenance.quote: Hera once more interfered and drove Hercules insane so that he killed his wife and children.

claim.id: Dibantu keponakannya Iolaos yang memakai api agar kepala Hydra tidak tumbuh lagi, Herakles membunuh Hydra dan mencelupkan anak panahnya ke darah beracunnya.
claim.en: With the help of his nephew Iolaos, who used fire to stop the heads regrowing, Heracles killed the Hydra and dipped his arrows in its poisonous blood.

claims_provenance.quote: Helped by his faithful companion and nephew Iolaos, who used fire to stop the heads re-growing, Hercules eventually killed the Hydra and dipped his arrows in its poisonous blood.

claim.id: Dalam perjalanannya ke Hades, Herakles membujuk dewa Hades agar mengizinkannya membawa Kerberos asalkan tanpa senjata.
claim.en: On his journey in Hades, Heracles persuades the god Hades to let him take Kerberos provided he does so without weapons.

claims_provenance.quote: On his journey in Hades, the hero encounters many souls and persuades the god Hades to allow him to take Kerberos provided he does so without weapons.

claim.id: Herakles menembak jatuh elang itu dengan anak panah dan membebaskan Prometheus.
claim.en: Heracles shot down the eagle with one of his arrows and freed Prometheus.

claims_provenance.quote: Hercules shot down the eagle with one of his arrows and freed Prometheus

claim.id: Athena membawa Herakles dari api ke Gunung Olympus, tempat ia menikahi dewi Hebe, diberi masa muda abadi, dan diizinkan tinggal bersama para dewa selamanya.
claim.en: Athena took Heracles from the flames to Mount Olympus, where he married the goddess Hebe, received eternal youth, and was allowed to live with the gods forever.

claims_provenance.quote: Immortality was assured, though, when Athena descended in her chariot and took Hercules from the flames to Mount Olympus where he married the goddess Hebe, was given the gift of eternal youth, and permitted to reside with the gods for all time.

claim.id: Dalam seni tembikar Yunani Arkais dan Klasik, Herakles sering digambarkan membawa gada berbuku, wadah anak panah, dan mengenakan kulit singa, kadang dengan helm berkepala singa.
claim.en: In Archaic and Classical Greek pottery, Heracles is often shown carrying a knotted club and a quiver of arrows and wearing a lion pelt, sometimes with a lion-head helmet.

claims_provenance.quote: In ancient Greek Archaic and Classical pottery art Hercules is often depicted carrying a knotted club, a quiver full of arrows, and wearing a lion's pelt with sometimes also a lion's head helmet.

claim.id: Dalam perjalanannya ke pulau di samudra barat itu, ia memasang penanda di Selat Gades yang kemudian dikenal sebagai Tiang-tiang Herkules.
claim.en: On his journey to that island in the western ocean, he set markers in the Strait of Gades that became known as the Pillars of Hercules.

claims_provenance.quote: It was on his journey to this island in the western ocean that he set markers in the Strait of Gades which thereafter became known as the Pillars of Hercules.

claim.id: Menurut Apollodorus, Herakles menerima pedang dari Hermes, busur dan anak panah dari Apollo, baju zirah emas dari Hephaestus, dan jubah dari Athena; gadanya ia potong sendiri di Nemea.
claim.en: According to Apollodorus, Heracles received a sword from Hermes, a bow and arrows from Apollo, a golden breastplate from Hephaestus, and a robe from Athena; he had cut his club himself at Nemea.

claims_provenance.quote: Hercules received a sword from Hermes, a bow and arrows from Apollo ... a golden breastplate from Hephaestus, and a robe from Athena; for he had himself cut a club at Nemea.
claims_provenance.source_citation: Theoi Classical Texts Library — Apollodorus, The Library, Book 2

claim.id: Antaeus, raksasa Libya yang menarik kekuatan dari bumi, mengajak Herakles bergulat sampai mati, tetapi kalah ketika Herakles mengangkatnya dari tanah dan meremukkannya.
claim.en: Antaeus, a Libyan giant who drew strength from the earth, challenged Heracles to a deadly wrestling match but was defeated when Heracles lifted him from the earth and crushed him.

claims_provenance.quote: A Libyan giant who drew his strength directly from the earth. He challenged Heracles to a wrestling death match but was defeated when the hero lifted him from the earth and crushed him.
claims_provenance.locator: A Selection of Characters & Creatures: Antaeus

claim.id: Herakles mengalahkan Thanatos, dewa kematian, dalam adu gulat ketika Thanatos datang menjemput Alcestis ke dunia bawah.
claim.en: Heracles defeated Thanatos, the god of death, in a wrestling match when he came to fetch Alcestis to the Underworld.

claims_provenance.quote: The god of death. Heracles defeated him in a wrestling match when he came to fetch Alcestis to the Underworld.
claims_provenance.locator: A Selection of Characters & Creatures: Thanatus

claim.id: Nama Yunani Ἡρακλῆς secara harfiah berarti "kemuliaan/ketenaran Hera".
claim.en: The Greek name Ἡρακλῆς literally means "glory/fame of Hera".

claims_provenance.quote: Ancient Greek: Ἡρακλῆς, lit. 'glory/fame of Hera'

claim.id: Herakles dianggap sekaligus pahlawan dan dewa, memiliki kekuatan manusia super; tidak ada makam yang pernah dipastikan sebagai miliknya, dan pada sebagian festival kurban dipersembahkan kepadanya lebih dulu sebagai pahlawan lalu sebagai dewa.
claim.en: Heracles was thought to be both hero and god, possessing superhuman strength; no tomb was ever identified as his, and at some festivals sacrifice was offered to him first as a hero and then as a god.

claims_provenance.quote: He was thought to be both a hero and a god, possessing superhuman strength. No tomb was ever identified as his, and at some festivals sacrifice was offered to him first as a hero and then as a god.

claim.id: Deianeira melumuri jubah dengan darah Nessos dan mengirimkannya kepada Herakles; ketika dipakai, jubah itu membuat kulitnya terbakar hebat.
claim.en: Deianeira smeared a cloak with the blood of Nessos and sent it to Heracles; when he wore it, the cloak burned his skin terribly.

claims_provenance.quote: Deianeira decided to use the blood of Nessos, covered a cloak in it and gave it to a messenger to take to Hercules. The hero wore it but the impregnated cloak caused his skin to burn terribly.

claim.id: Penggambaran lengkap tertua kedua belas tugas Herakles dalam seni pahat kuno ada pada metope Kuil Zeus di Olimpia (selesai 457 SM).
claim.en: The earliest complete depiction of Heracles's twelve labours in ancient sculpture is on the metopes of the Temple of Zeus at Olympia (completed 457 BCE).

claims_provenance.quote: The earliest complete depiction of Hercules' twelve labours in ancient sculpture is from the metopes of the Temple of Zeus at Olympia (completed in 457 BCE).

claim.id: Herakles dipuja luas sebagai pelindung kaum muda dan gimnasium.
claim.en: Heracles was widely worshipped as a patron of young men and gymnasia.

claims_provenance.quote: He was widely worshipped as a patron of young men and gymnasia.

claim.id: Kerberos, anjing Hades penjaga pintu masuk dunia bawah; Herakles diutus membawanya sebagai salah satu dari dua belas tugasnya dan menangkapnya dengan persetujuan dewi Persephone.
claim.en: Cerberus, the hound of Hades who guarded the entrance to the underworld; Heracles was sent to fetch him as one of his twelve labours and captured him with the approval of the goddess Persephone.

claims_provenance.quote: CERBERUS (Kerberos) The hound of Hades who guarded the entrance to the underworld. Heracles was sent to fetch the beast as one of his twelve labours, and captured it with the approval of the goddess Persephone.
claims_provenance.locator: A Selection of Characters & Creatures: Cerberus

short_description.id: Herakles adalah pahlawan mitologi Yunani yang termasyhur karena kekuatannya, dua belas tugasnya, dan kenaikannya menjadi dewa.
short_description.en: Heracles is a Greek mythic hero famed for his strength, his twelve labors, and his rise to godhood.

long_description.id: Herakles adalah pahlawan mitologi Yunani yang terkenal karena kekuatan dan daya tahannya. Menurut mitos, Zeus adalah ayahnya dan Alkmene ibunya. Hera, yang cemburu, mengirim dua ular kepada Herakles bayi, tetapi bayi itu mencekik keduanya.
long_description.en: Heracles is a Greek mythic hero famed for strength and endurance. In myth, Zeus is his father and Alkmene his mother. Hera, who was jealous, sent two snakes to the infant Heracles, but the baby strangled them.

long_description.id: Hera juga membuat Herakles gila hingga ia membunuh istri dan anak-anaknya. Peramal Delphi lalu memerintahkannya menjalani dua belas tugas untuk Eurystheus. Dalam tugas-tugas itu ia mencekik Singa Nemea dan mengenakan kulitnya, membunuh Hydra dengan bantuan Iolaos, dan membawa Kerberos dari dunia bawah tanpa senjata. Diodorus mencatat janji keabadian setelah tugas-tugas itu selesai.
long_description.en: Hera also drove Heracles insane so that he killed his wife and children. The Delphic Oracle then ordered him to perform twelve labors for Eurystheus. In them he strangled the Nemean Lion and wore its pelt, killed the Hydra with the help of Iolaos, and brought Kerberos from the underworld without weapons. Diodorus records a promise of immortality once the labors were done.

long_description.id: Di luar kedua belas tugas itu, Herakles membebaskan Prometheus dengan menembak jatuh elang yang menyiksanya. Ia juga mengalahkan raksasa Antaeus dan Thanatos, dewa kematian, dalam adu gulat. Menurut Apollodorus, ia menerima pedang dari Hermes, busur dan anak panah dari Apollo, baju zirah emas dari Hephaestus, dan jubah dari Athena, sedangkan gadanya ia potong sendiri di Nemea.
long_description.en: Beyond the twelve labors, Heracles freed Prometheus by shooting down the eagle that tormented him. He also defeated the giant Antaeus and Thanatos, the god of death, in wrestling. According to Apollodorus, he received a sword from Hermes, a bow and arrows from Apollo, a golden breastplate from Hephaestus, and a robe from Athena, while he cut his club himself at Nemea.

long_description.id: Kisah hidupnya berakhir ketika jubah berlumur darah Nessos, yang dikirim Deianeira, membakar kulitnya. Athena kemudian membawanya dari api ke Gunung Olympus, tempat ia menikahi Hebe dan diizinkan tinggal bersama para dewa. Herakles dipuja sebagai dewa di Yunani pada zaman klasik, dan ia dianggap sekaligus pahlawan dan dewa.
long_description.en: His life ends when the cloak stained with the blood of Nessos, sent by Deianeira, burns his skin. Athena then takes him from the flames to Mount Olympus, where he marries Hebe and is allowed to live with the gods. Heracles was worshipped as a god in classical Greece, and he was thought to be both a hero and a god.

sources.title: Diodorus Siculus, Library of History Book 4.1-18
sources.author: Diodorus Siculus

claims.quote: Hercules (Herakles) was a hero of Greek mythology famous for his great strength and endurance.

statement.id: Herakles adalah pahlawan mitologi Yunani yang terkenal karena kekuatan dan daya tahannya.
statement.en: Heracles is a Greek mythic hero renowned for strength and endurance.

claims.quote: In mythology, though, it was Zeus who lay with Alkmene and so fathered Hercules, explaining the origin of Hercules' great strength.

statement.id: Zeus disebut sebagai ayah Herakles dan Alkmene sebagai ibunya.
statement.en: Zeus is named as Heracles's father and Alkmene as his mother.

claims.quote: Hera also sent two snakes to kill the new-born Hercules, but the baby easily strangled them.

statement.id: Hera mengirim dua ular kepada Herakles bayi, tetapi ia mencekiknya.
statement.en: Hera sent two snakes to the infant Heracles, who strangled them.

claims.quote: Heracles was commanded by the Delphic Oracle to perform twelve labors for King Eurystheus of Mycenae.

statement.id: Peramal Delphi memerintahkannya menjalani dua belas tugas untuk Raja Eurystheus.
statement.en: The Delphic Oracle ordered Heracles to perform twelve labors for Eurystheus.

claims.quote: Heracles journeyed to Delphi, and on inquiring of the god regarding the matter he received a reply which stated that the gods had decided that he should perform twelve Labours at the command of Eurystheus and that upon their conclusion he should receive the gift of immortality.

statement.id: Menurut Diodorus, Herakles menjalani dua belas tugas atas perintah Eurystheus dan dijanjikan keabadian setelah selesai.
statement.en: Diodorus says Heracles was commanded to complete twelve labors and promised immortality afterward.

claims.quote: Hercules strangled the lion with his bare hands and forever after wore its pelt as a protective cloak.

statement.id: Herakles mencekik Singa Nemea dan mengenakan kulitnya.
statement.en: Heracles strangled the Nemean Lion and wore its pelt.

claims.quote: Heracles was worshipped throughout Greece in the classical age as a god.

statement.id: Herakles juga dipuja sebagai dewa di Yunani pada zaman klasik.
statement.en: Heracles was worshipped as a god throughout classical Greece.

claims.quote: Hera once more interfered and drove Hercules insane so that he killed his wife and children.

statement.id: Hera membuat Herakles gila sehingga ia membunuh istri dan anak-anaknya.
statement.en: Hera drove Heracles insane so that he killed his wife and children.

claims.quote: Helped by his faithful companion and nephew Iolaos, who used fire to stop the heads re-growing, Hercules eventually killed the Hydra and dipped his arrows in its poisonous blood.

statement.id: Dibantu keponakannya Iolaos yang memakai api agar kepala Hydra tidak tumbuh lagi, Herakles membunuh Hydra dan mencelupkan anak panahnya ke darah beracunnya.
statement.en: With the help of his nephew Iolaos, who used fire to stop the heads regrowing, Heracles killed the Hydra and dipped his arrows in its poisonous blood.

claims.quote: On his journey in Hades, the hero encounters many souls and persuades the god Hades to allow him to take Kerberos provided he does so without weapons.

statement.id: Dalam perjalanannya ke Hades, Herakles membujuk dewa Hades agar mengizinkannya membawa Kerberos asalkan tanpa senjata.
statement.en: On his journey in Hades, Heracles persuades the god Hades to let him take Kerberos provided he does so without weapons.

claims.quote: Hercules shot down the eagle with one of his arrows and freed Prometheus

statement.id: Herakles menembak jatuh elang itu dengan anak panah dan membebaskan Prometheus.
statement.en: Heracles shot down the eagle with one of his arrows and freed Prometheus.

claims.quote: Immortality was assured, though, when Athena descended in her chariot and took Hercules from the flames to Mount Olympus where he married the goddess Hebe, was given the gift of eternal youth, and permitted to reside with the gods for all time.

statement.id: Athena membawa Herakles dari api ke Gunung Olympus, tempat ia menikahi dewi Hebe, diberi masa muda abadi, dan diizinkan tinggal bersama para dewa selamanya.
statement.en: Athena took Heracles from the flames to Mount Olympus, where he married the goddess Hebe, received eternal youth, and was allowed to live with the gods forever.

claims.quote: In ancient Greek Archaic and Classical pottery art Hercules is often depicted carrying a knotted club, a quiver full of arrows, and wearing a lion's pelt with sometimes also a lion's head helmet.

statement.id: Dalam seni tembikar Yunani Arkais dan Klasik, Herakles sering digambarkan membawa gada berbuku, wadah anak panah, dan mengenakan kulit singa, kadang dengan helm berkepala singa.
statement.en: In Archaic and Classical Greek pottery, Heracles is often shown carrying a knotted club and a quiver of arrows and wearing a lion pelt, sometimes with a lion-head helmet.

claims.quote: It was on his journey to this island in the western ocean that he set markers in the Strait of Gades which thereafter became known as the Pillars of Hercules.

statement.id: Dalam perjalanannya ke pulau di samudra barat itu, ia memasang penanda di Selat Gades yang kemudian dikenal sebagai Tiang-tiang Herkules.
statement.en: On his journey to that island in the western ocean, he set markers in the Strait of Gades that became known as the Pillars of Hercules.

claims.quote: Hercules received a sword from Hermes, a bow and arrows from Apollo ... a golden breastplate from Hephaestus, and a robe from Athena; for he had himself cut a club at Nemea.

statement.id: Menurut Apollodorus, Herakles menerima pedang dari Hermes, busur dan anak panah dari Apollo, baju zirah emas dari Hephaestus, dan jubah dari Athena; gadanya ia potong sendiri di Nemea.
statement.en: According to Apollodorus, Heracles received a sword from Hermes, a bow and arrows from Apollo, a golden breastplate from Hephaestus, and a robe from Athena; he had cut his club himself at Nemea.

claims.quote: A Libyan giant who drew his strength directly from the earth. He challenged Heracles to a wrestling death match but was defeated when the hero lifted him from the earth and crushed him.
claims.locator: A Selection of Characters & Creatures: Antaeus

statement.id: Antaeus, raksasa Libya yang menarik kekuatan dari bumi, mengajak Herakles bergulat sampai mati, tetapi kalah ketika Herakles mengangkatnya dari tanah dan meremukkannya.
statement.en: Antaeus, a Libyan giant who drew strength from the earth, challenged Heracles to a deadly wrestling match but was defeated when Heracles lifted him from the earth and crushed him.

claims.quote: The god of death. Heracles defeated him in a wrestling match when he came to fetch Alcestis to the Underworld.
claims.locator: A Selection of Characters & Creatures: Thanatus

statement.id: Herakles mengalahkan Thanatos, dewa kematian, dalam adu gulat ketika Thanatos datang menjemput Alcestis ke dunia bawah.
statement.en: Heracles defeated Thanatos, the god of death, in a wrestling match when he came to fetch Alcestis to the Underworld.

claims.quote: Ancient Greek: Ἡρακλῆς, lit. 'glory/fame of Hera'

statement.id: Nama Yunani Ἡρακλῆς secara harfiah berarti "kemuliaan/ketenaran Hera".
statement.en: The Greek name Ἡρακλῆς literally means "glory/fame of Hera".

claims.quote: He was thought to be both a hero and a god, possessing superhuman strength. No tomb was ever identified as his, and at some festivals sacrifice was offered to him first as a hero and then as a god.

statement.id: Herakles dianggap sekaligus pahlawan dan dewa, memiliki kekuatan manusia super; tidak ada makam yang pernah dipastikan sebagai miliknya, dan pada sebagian festival kurban dipersembahkan kepadanya lebih dulu sebagai pahlawan lalu sebagai dewa.
statement.en: Heracles was thought to be both hero and god, possessing superhuman strength; no tomb was ever identified as his, and at some festivals sacrifice was offered to him first as a hero and then as a god.

claims.quote: Deianeira decided to use the blood of Nessos, covered a cloak in it and gave it to a messenger to take to Hercules. The hero wore it but the impregnated cloak caused his skin to burn terribly.

statement.id: Deianeira melumuri jubah dengan darah Nessos dan mengirimkannya kepada Herakles; ketika dipakai, jubah itu membuat kulitnya terbakar hebat.
statement.en: Deianeira smeared a cloak with the blood of Nessos and sent it to Heracles; when he wore it, the cloak burned his skin terribly.

claims.quote: The earliest complete depiction of Hercules' twelve labours in ancient sculpture is from the metopes of the Temple of Zeus at Olympia (completed in 457 BCE).

statement.id: Penggambaran lengkap tertua kedua belas tugas Herakles dalam seni pahat kuno ada pada metope Kuil Zeus di Olimpia (selesai 457 SM).
statement.en: The earliest complete depiction of Heracles's twelve labours in ancient sculpture is on the metopes of the Temple of Zeus at Olympia (completed 457 BCE).

claims.quote: He was widely worshipped as a patron of young men and gymnasia.

statement.id: Herakles dipuja luas sebagai pelindung kaum muda dan gimnasium.
statement.en: Heracles was widely worshipped as a patron of young men and gymnasia.

claims.quote: CERBERUS (Kerberos) The hound of Hades who guarded the entrance to the underworld. Heracles was sent to fetch the beast as one of his twelve labours, and captured it with the approval of the goddess Persephone.
claims.locator: A Selection of Characters & Creatures: Cerberus

statement.id: Kerberos, anjing Hades penjaga pintu masuk dunia bawah; Herakles diutus membawanya sebagai salah satu dari dua belas tugasnya dan menangkapnya dengan persetujuan dewi Persephone.
statement.en: Cerberus, the hound of Hades who guarded the entrance to the underworld; Heracles was sent to fetch him as one of his twelve labours and captured him with the approval of the goddess Persephone.

short_description.id: Hermes adalah dewa Olimpus dalam mitologi Yunani, juru warta para dewa, pelindung pelancong dan pedagang, serta penuntun jiwa ke alam kematian.
short_description.en: Hermes is an Olympian god of Greek myth, herald of the gods, protector of travelers and merchants, and guide of souls to the afterlife.

long_description.id:
Hermes adalah dewa Olimpus dalam agama dan mitologi Yunani kuno, dikenal sebagai juru warta dan pembawa pesan para dewa. Ia dipandang pula sebagai pelindung juru warta, pelancong, pencuri, pedagang, dan orator, serta penuntun jiwa menuju alam kematian. Theoi mengaitkannya dengan kawanan ternak, jalan, perdagangan, dan diplomasi. Orang Yunani percaya ia putra Zeus dan nimfa Maia yang lahir di Gunung Cyllene di Arkadia, dan bangsa Romawi mengenalnya sebagai Mercury.

Sebagai bayi, Hermes mencuri ternak Apollo dan membuat lira dari tempurung kura-kura. Setelah sidang di hadapan Zeus dan para dewa, ia boleh menyimpan ternak itu dengan memberikan lira kepada Apollo, dan Zeus yang terhibur memberinya tempat di antara dua belas dewa Olimpus. Ia dikreditkan menciptakan lira, alfabet, dan dadu serta menjadi pelindung gembala, dan Apollo memberinya tongkat gembala emas sementara Zeus menjadikannya juru warta. Ia juga dikenal sebagai penipu cerdik yang mencuri trisula Poseidon, panah Artemis, dan ikat pinggang Aphrodite.

Dalam kisah-kisah pahlawan, Hermes membunuh monster Argos atas perintah Zeus untuk membebaskan Io, memberi Perseus pedang adamantin dan menuntunnya kepada para Graiai, serta memberi Odiseus penawar mantra Kirke. Ia juga menuntun jiwa ke Sungai Styx, tempat Charon membawa mereka ke Hades. Himne Homerik 4 menyebutnya satu-satunya utusan yang ditunjuk ke Hades.

Dalam seni Yunani Arkais dan Klasik, Hermes digambarkan membawa tongkat kerykeion atau kaduseus, bersandal bersayap, dan kadang bertopi bersayap atau membawa lira. Atribut khasnya adalah tongkat juru warta, dan hewan sucinya adalah domba jantan dan kelinci. Tugu batu hermai dipasang di tepi jalan sebagai penunjuk bagi pelancong, dan kurban baginya berupa kemenyan, madu, kue, babi, serta terutama domba dan anak kambing.

Pemujaan Hermes sudah tercatat dalam lempeng Linear B Mykenai, dan Athena memiliki salah satu pemujaan tertuanya dengan festival Hermaia. Pada periode Helenistik ia sering dikaitkan dengan gimnasium. Nama Hermes sejak lama dikaitkan dengan kata herma, tetapi hal itu diperdebatkan, dan satu teori menyebut Hermes berasal dari bentuk dewa Pan.
long_description.en:
Hermes is an Olympian deity in ancient Greek religion and myth, known as the herald and messenger of the gods. He is also regarded as protector of heralds, travelers, thieves, merchants, and orators, and as a guide of souls into the afterlife. Theoi links him with herds, roads, trade, and diplomacy. The Greeks believed him the son of Zeus and the nymph Maia, born on Mt. Cyllene in Arcadia, and the Romans knew him as Mercury.

As a baby, Hermes stole Apollo's cattle and made a lyre from a tortoise-shell. After a hearing before Zeus and the gods he was allowed to keep the cattle by giving Apollo the lyre, and an amused Zeus gave him a place among the twelve Olympian gods. He is credited with inventing the lyre, the alphabet, and dice and is patron of shepherds, and Apollo gave him a golden shepherd's staff while Zeus made him his herald. He is also known as a trickster who stole Poseidon's trident, Artemis' arrows, and Aphrodite's girdle.

In hero stories Hermes kills the monster Argos on Zeus's orders to free Io, gives Perseus an adamantine sword and guides him to the Graeae, and gives Odysseus an antidote to Circe's spells. He also leads souls to the river Styx, where Charon takes them to Hades. Homeric Hymn 4 calls him the only appointed messenger to Hades.

In Archaic and Classical Greek art Hermes is shown with the kerykeion or caduceus staff, winged sandals, and sometimes a winged cap or a lyre. His most distinctive attribute is the herald's wand, and his sacred animals are the ram and the hare. Stone hermae were set up along roads as guides for travellers, and offerings to him included incense, honey, cakes, pigs, and especially lambs and young goats.

Hermes already appears in Mycenaean Linear B tablets, and Athens had one of his oldest cults with the Hermaia festival. In the Hellenistic period he was often associated with gymnasia. His name has long been linked to the word herma, though this is disputed, and one theory holds that Hermes originated as a form of the god Pan.

era: Attested in Mycenaean Linear B tablets (15th to 13th century BCE)

literal_meaning.id: Nama itu sejak lama diturunkan dari herma ('timbunan batu'), tetapi dugaan ini diperdebatkan.
literal_meaning.en: The name has long been derived from herma ('stone heap, cairn'), but this is disputed.

who.id: Dewa Olimpus, juru warta para dewa.
who.en: An Olympian god, herald of the gods.

origin.id: Agama dan mitologi Yunani kuno; lahir di Gunung Cyllene di Arkadia menurut tradisi Yunani.
origin.en: Ancient Greek religion and mythology; born on Mt. Cyllene in Arcadia according to Greek tradition.

role.id: Penuntun jiwa menuju alam kematian dan pemandu antara alam dewa dan manusia.
role.en: Guide of souls to the afterlife and of travel between the realms of gods and humanity.

famous_for.id: Mencuri ternak Apollo saat masih bayi dan menciptakan lira.
famous_for.en: Stealing Apollo's cattle as a baby and creating the lyre.

did_you_know.id: Kata hermeneutika, yaitu kajian dan penafsiran teks, membawa nama Hermes.
did_you_know.en: The word hermeneutics, the study and interpretation of texts, carries Hermes's name.

cultural_context.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, dalam perannya sebagai pemandu antara alam dewa dan manusia Hermes menjadi lambang penyeberangan batas; para orator dan juru bahasa pun menganggapnya pelindung mereka.
cultural_context.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, in his role as a guide between the realms of gods and humanity Hermes came to symbolise the crossing of boundaries, and orators and interpreters regarded him as their patron.

description.id: Ia menuntun jiwa ke Sungai Styx, tempat Charon membawa mereka ke Hades.
description.en: He leads souls to the river Styx, where Charon takes them to Hades.

description.id: Menurut satu sumber, puisi Homerik menyebut tongkatnya sebagai tongkat ajaib yang dapat menutup dan membuka mata manusia.
description.en: According to one source, the Homeric poems mention his staff as a magic staff that closes and opens the eyes of mortals.

description.id: Ia digambarkan berkuasa mengirim tidur yang menyegarkan atau mencabutnya.
description.en: He is described as having the power to send refreshing sleep or take it away.

description.id: Ia mencuri ternak Apollo saat bayi serta trisula Poseidon, panah Artemis, dan ikat pinggang Aphrodite.
description.en: He stole Apollo's cattle as a baby, and Poseidon's trident, Artemis' arrows, and Aphrodite's girdle.

role.id: Bayi yang mencuri dan membuat lira.
role.en: The infant who steals the cattle and crafts the lyre.

summary.id: Saat masih bayi Hermes mencuri 50 ternak suci Apollo dan menyamarkan jejaknya. Setelah sidang di hadapan Zeus ia boleh menyimpan ternak itu dengan memberikan lira kepada Apollo.
summary.en: As a baby Hermes steals Apollo's 50 sacred cattle and disguises their tracks. After a hearing before Zeus he may keep them if he gives Apollo the lyre.

role.en: The god who punishes the informer.

summary.id: Hermes mengubah gembala Battos menjadi batu karena melaporkan pencurian ternak Apollon.
summary.en: Hermes turns the herdsman Battos into stone for reporting the theft of Apollon's cattle.

role.en: Slayer of the monster on Zeus's orders.

summary.id: Atas perintah Zeus Hermes membunuh monster bermata banyak Argos untuk membebaskan Io.
summary.en: On Zeus's orders Hermes kills the many-eyed monster Argos to free Io.

role.en: Helper and guide of the hero.

summary.id: Hermes memberi Perseus pedang atau sabit adamantin dan menuntunnya ke tiga Graiai yang akan menunjukkan lokasi Medusa.
summary.en: Hermes gives Perseus an adamantine sword or sickle and guides him to the three Graeae who will reveal Medusa's location.

role.en: Helper of Odysseus on the voyage home.

summary.id: Dalam Odyssey Hermes menolong Odiseus, antara lain dengan memberinya penawar mantra Kirke.
summary.en: In the Odyssey Hermes helps Odysseus, among other things by giving him an antidote to Circe's spells.

summary.id: Hermes membebaskan Ares dari penahanan setahun dalam kuali oleh raksasa kembar Otus dan Ephialtes.
summary.en: Hermes rescues Ares after the twin Giants Otus and Ephialtes kept him locked in a cauldron for a year.

description.id: Menurut tradisi Yunani, tempat kelahiran Hermes di Arkadia.
description.en: According to Greek tradition, Hermes's birthplace in Arcadia.

description.id: Memiliki salah satu pemujaan tertua bagi Hermes dengan festival Hermaia tahunan.
description.en: Home of one of the oldest cults of Hermes, with the annual Hermaia festival.

description.id: Tempat patung Hermes karya Praxiteles dahulu berdiri di kuil Hera dan kini berada di museum arkeologi situs itu.
description.en: Where Praxiteles's statue of Hermes once stood in the temple of Hera and now resides in the site's archaeological museum.

description.id: Hermes disebut dalam lempeng Linear B peradaban Mykenai di Pylos, Thebes, dan Knossos.
description.en: Hermes is mentioned in Linear B tablets of the Mycenaean civilization, found at Pylos, Thebes, and Knossos.

description.id: Patung Hermes karya Praxiteles, mungkin penggambaran Hermes paling termasyhur dalam seni Yunani.
description.en: The statue of Hermes by Praxiteles, perhaps the most celebrated depiction of Hermes in Greek art.

description.id: Hermes sering dikaitkan dengan gimnasium dan dipandang sebagai pelindung kaum muda.
description.en: Hermes was often associated with gymnasia and seen as protector of youths.

summary.en: Other accounts place the theft at a more advanced period of his life.

claim.en: Hermes is a Greek Olympian herald of the gods and protector of travelers and merchants.

claims_provenance.quote: is an Olympian deity in ancient Greek religion and mythology considered the herald of the gods. He is also widely considered the protector of human heralds, travelers, thieves, merchants, and orators.

claim.id: Hermes berperan sebagai pembimbing jiwa menuju alam kematian.
claim.en: Hermes serves as a guide of souls to the afterlife.

claims_provenance.quote: Hermes plays the role of the psychopomp or "soul guide"—a conductor of souls into the afterlife.

claim.id: Theoi menyebut Hermes dewa ternak, pelancong, jalan, perdagangan, kecerdikan, pembawa pesan, dan diplomasi.
claim.en: Theoi identifies Hermes with flocks, travelers, roads, trade, cunning, heralds, and diplomacy.

claim.en: Hermes is shown as a beardless youth or older bearded man with winged boots and a herald's wand.

claims_provenance.quote: Hermes was depicted as either a handsome and athletic, beardless youth or as an older, bearded man, with winged boots and a herald's wand.

claim.id: World History Encyclopedia menyebut Hermes pembawa pesan dewa-dewa Olimpus.
claim.en: World History Encyclopedia calls Hermes the Olympian gods' herald and messenger.

claims_provenance.quote: One of the cleverest and most mischievous of the 12 Olympian gods, Hermes was their herald and messenger.
