short_description.id: Isis adalah dewi Mesir kuno, istri Osiris dan ibu Horus, yang dikenal karena kuasa sihirnya dan perlindungannya, dan pemujaannya menyebar ke dunia Yunani-Romawi.
short_description.en: Isis is an ancient Egyptian goddess, wife of Osiris and mother of Horus, known for her magical power and protection, whose worship spread throughout the Greco-Roman world.

long_description.id:
Isis adalah dewi Mesir kuno yang menjadi paling populer dan paling lestari di antara dewa-dewa Mesir. Ia istri Osiris dan ibu Horus, sehingga secara simbolis menjadi ibu bagi firaun. Namanya pertama tercatat dalam Teks Piramida dari Dinasti Kelima. Kultusnya bermula di Delta Nil, dengan tempat suci terpenting di Behbeit El-Hagar, lalu menyebar ke seluruh Mesir.

Dalam mitos Osiris, Set iri kepada saudaranya dan membuat peti mati seukuran tubuh Osiris. Isis mencari suaminya ke seluruh Mesir, membawa jasadnya kembali, lalu menghidupkannya; dalam wujud kite, sejenis elang, ia terbang mengelilinginya dan mengandung Horus. Osiris kemudian mundur ke alam baka sebagai Penguasa dan Hakim Orang Mati, sementara Isis menyembunyikan Horus di rawa-rawa sampai dewasa. Horus kemudian melawan Set demi menguasai dunia.

Isis dikenal karena sihirnya. Kuasa sihirnya konon melampaui semua dewa lain, dan ia dikatakan mengatur alam serta berkuasa atas takdir; ia juga disebut Weret-Kekau, "Sihir Agung". Dalam sebuah mantra ia membuat Ra sakit dengan gigitan ular dan menawarkan penyembuhan jika Ra mengungkapkan nama rahasianya. Dalam kisah Isis dan Tujuh Kalajengking, ia menyembuhkan seorang anak dengan memanggil nama rahasia para kalajengking dan melafalkan mantra sihir agung. Bantuan keibuannya juga dipanggil dalam mantra penyembuhan bagi orang biasa.

Ketika Aleksander Agung menaklukkan Mesir pada 331 SM, pasukannya mengaitkan Isis dengan Demeter. Di Roma pemujaannya dikukuhkan pada masa Caligula, dan kuil Isis ditemukan antara lain di Pompeii dan Londinium. Dalam karya Apuleius (terjemahan Adlington), sang dewi menyebut dirinya ibu alami segala sesuatu dan Ratu Langit, dan menyatakan bahwa orang Mesir menyebutnya Ratu Isis. Kuil Isis di Philae tetap menjadi tempat ziarah hingga ditutup oleh kaisar Justinian pada 529 M.

Seiring waktu Isis menjadi begitu populer sehingga semua dewa dianggap sekadar aspek Isis, dan ia satu-satunya dewa Mesir yang dipuja semua orang. Bersama suami dan putranya ia menggantikan Triad Thebes yang berisi Amon, Mut, dan Khons. Kultusnya tumbuh menjadi agama misteri yang menjanjikan rahasia hidup dan mati kepada para peserta inisiasi, ia dikaitkan dengan laut sebagai pelindung pelaut dan pedagang, dan orang Yunani serta Romawi memuliakannya sebagai dewa tertinggi pencipta dunia.
long_description.en:
Isis is an ancient Egyptian goddess who rose to be the most popular and long-lasting of the Egyptian deities. She is the wife of Osiris and the mother of Horus, and so symbolically the mother of the pharaoh. Her name is first attested in the Pyramid Texts of the Fifth Dynasty. Her cult began in the Nile Delta, with its most important sanctuary at Behbeit El-Hagar, and spread to all parts of Egypt.

In the myth of Osiris, Set was jealous of his brother and had a coffin made to Osiris's exact height. Isis searched all through Egypt for her husband, brought his body back, and revived him; in the form of a kite, a kind of falcon, she flew around him and became pregnant with Horus. Osiris then withdrew to the afterlife as Lord and Judge of the Dead, while Isis hid Horus in the swamps until he was grown. Horus then battled Set for control of the world.

Isis was known for her magic. Her magic was reputed to surpass that of every other god, and she was said to rule the natural world and hold sway over fate; she was also called Weret-Kekau, "the Great Magic". In one spell she makes Ra ill with a snake's bite and offers to cure him if he reveals his secret name. In the story of Isis and the Seven Scorpions she heals a child by calling the scorpions by their secret names and reciting spells of great magic. Her maternal aid was also invoked in healing spells for ordinary people.

When Alexander the Great conquered Egypt in 331 BCE his troops associated Isis with Demeter. In Rome her worship was firmly established under Caligula, and temples of Isis have been found at Pompeii and Londinium, among other places. In Apuleius's work (Adlington's translation) the goddess calls herself the natural mother of all things and Queen of heaven, and says the Egyptians call her Queen Isis. Her temple at Philae remained a pilgrimage site until the emperor Justinian closed it in 529 CE.

Over time Isis grew so popular that all gods were regarded as mere aspects of her, and she was the one Egyptian deity worshipped by everyone. With her husband and son she replaced the Theban Triad of Amon, Mut, and Khons. Her cult developed into a mystery cult that offered initiates knowledge of life and death, she became linked with the sea as protector of sailors and merchants, and Greeks and Romans honoured her as the supreme deity who created the world.

era: Her name is first attested in the Fifth Dynasty (c. 2494-2345 BCE); her worship continued until Philae was closed in 529 CE

literal_meaning.id: "tempat duduk" (merujuk pada kestabilan dan takhta Mesir)
literal_meaning.en: "the seat" (referring to stability and the throne of Egypt)

who.id: Isis adalah dewi Mesir kuno, istri Osiris dan ibu Horus.
who.en: Isis is an ancient Egyptian goddess, wife of Osiris and mother of Horus.

origin.id: Kultusnya bermula di Delta Nil dan namanya pertama tercatat dalam Teks Piramida Dinasti Kelima.
origin.en: Her cult began in the Nile Delta and her name is first attested in the Fifth Dynasty Pyramid Texts.

role.id: Ia menghidupkan kembali Osiris, melindungi Horus dari Set, dan dipandang sebagai pemberi kehidupan dan pelindung.
role.en: She revived Osiris, protected Horus from Set, and is seen as a life-giver and protector.

famous_for.id: Isis paling dikenal karena sihirnya dan kesetiaannya mencari dan menghidupkan Osiris, serta karena pemujaannya yang menyebar sampai dunia Romawi.
famous_for.en: Isis is best known for her magic and her devotion in searching for and reviving Osiris, and for a worship that spread into the Roman world.

did_you_know.id: Kuil Isis di Philae tetap menjadi tempat ziarah aktif selama ribuan tahun sampai ditutup pada abad ke-6 M oleh kaisar Kristen Justinian.
did_you_know.en: Isis's temple at Philae remained an active pilgrimage site for thousands of years until the Christian emperor Justinian closed it in the 6th century CE.

cultural_context.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Isis menjadi dewi seluruh rakyat Mesir, laki-laki dan perempuan, bangsawan dan rakyat biasa, dan ia biasanya digambarkan sebagai ibu, istri, dan pelindung yang mengutamakan kepentingan orang lain. Dalam sebuah patung kecil, ia tampil menyusui Horus, dan patung-patung seperti itu menonjolkan perannya sebagai pemberi kehidupan dan pelindung.
cultural_context.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, Isis was embraced as goddess by every Egyptian, men and women, royal and ordinary, and is regularly portrayed as a mother, wife, and protectress who puts others' interests first. A statuette shows her nursing Horus, and such statuettes emphasize her role as life-giver and protector.

description.id: Kekuatan sihir Isis konon lebih besar daripada semua dewa lain; ia dijuluki Weret-Kekau, "Sihir Agung", dan dikatakan berkuasa atas alam dan takdir.
description.en: Isis's reputed magical power was greater than that of all other gods; she was called Weret-Kekau, "the Great Magic", and said to govern the natural world and wield power over fate.

description.id: Dalam sebuah mantra Isis menawarkan menyembuhkan Ra jika ia mengungkapkan nama rahasianya, dan dalam kisah Tujuh Kalajengking ia memanggil kalajengking dengan nama rahasia mereka sehingga menundukkan mereka.
description.en: In one spell Isis offers to cure Ra if he tells her his secret name, and in the Seven Scorpions story she calls the scorpions by their secret names, dominating them.

description.id: Bantuan keibuan Isis dipanggil dalam mantra penyembuhan, dan ia menyembuhkan anak yang tersengat kalajengking dengan sihirnya.
description.en: Isis's maternal aid was invoked in healing spells, and she healed a child stung by a scorpion with her magic.

description.id: Isis mengambil wujud kite untuk menghidupkan Osiris, dan dalam teks-teks kemudian memakai kekuatan perubahan wujudnya untuk melawan Set dan pengikutnya.
description.en: Isis assumed the form of a kite to revive Osiris and, in later texts, uses her powers of transformation to fight Set and his followers.

description.id: Isis berhasil menghidupkan kembali Osiris setelah dibunuh Set, dan ia dipercaya membantu orang mati memasuki alam baka.
description.en: Isis was able to revive Osiris after Set killed him, and was believed to help the dead enter the afterlife.

name.en: Power over the elements, according to Apuleius

description.id: Dalam terjemahan Adlington atas Apuleius, sang dewi menyatakan bahwa atas kehendaknya planet-planet langit, angin laut, dan kesunyian neraka diatur, dan menyebut dirinya penguasa semua unsur.
description.en: In Adlington's translation of Apuleius, the goddess declares that at her will the planets of the air, the winds of the seas, and the silences of hell are disposed, and calls herself mistress of all the elements.

description.id: Lambangnya adalah kalajengking, kite, takhta kosong, dan sistrum; dalam penglihatan Apuleius ia memegang rebana kuningan dan cawan emas dengan ular aspis.
description.en: Her symbols are the scorpion, the kite, the empty throne, and the sistrum; in Apuleius's vision she holds a brass timbrel and a golden cup with an asp.

description.id: Pemuja Yunani mengaitkan Isis dengan Demeter dan menyematkan sifat dewa Yunani padanya, seperti penemuan pernikahan dan perlindungan kapal; di Roma ia dikenal dan dipuja luas.
description.en: Greek devotees associated Isis with Demeter and ascribed to her traits of Greek deities, such as the invention of marriage and the protection of ships; in Rome she was widely known and worshipped.

description.id: Sebagai pembawa banjir tahunan Nil ia disebut Sati, dan sebagai pencipta serta pemelihara kehidupan ia disebut Ankhet.
description.en: As bringer of the yearly Nile inundation she was Sati, and as creator and preserver of life she was Ankhet.

role.id: Istri yang mencari dan menghidupkan kembali Osiris
role.en: The wife who searches for and revives Osiris

summary.id: Set iri kepada Osiris dan membuat peti mati seukuran tinggi Osiris. Isis mencari suaminya ke seluruh Mesir, mengeluarkannya dari pohon di tepi laut, dan menyembunyikan jasadnya di Delta Nil. Ia menghidupkan Osiris kembali dan mengandung Horus, sementara Osiris menjadi Penguasa dan Hakim Orang Mati.
summary.en: Set, jealous of Osiris, had a coffin made to Osiris's exact height. Isis searched all through Egypt for her husband, cut him from the tree, and hid his body in the Nile Delta. She revived Osiris and became pregnant with Horus, while Osiris became Lord and Judge of the Dead.

summary.id: Karena takut akan perbuatan Set, Isis menyembunyikan Horus di rawa-rawa Mesir sampai dewasa. Ia membesarkan dan melindunginya dari Set dan bahaya lain, dan Horus kemudian muncul sebagai prajurit perkasa yang melawan Set.
summary.en: Fearing Set, Isis hid Horus in the swamps of Egypt until he was grown. She nurtured and protected him from Set and other dangers, and Horus then emerged as a mighty warrior who battled Set.

role.en: The goddess who heals and forgives

summary.id: Saat menyembunyikan Horus di rawa, Isis ditemani tujuh kalajengking yang menjadi pengawalnya. Ia menyembuhkan seorang anak yang tersengat dengan memanggil kalajengking dengan nama rahasianya dan melafalkan mantra sihir agung.
summary.en: While hiding Horus in the swamp, Isis was accompanied by seven scorpions that served as her bodyguard. She healed a stung child by calling the scorpions by their secret names and reciting spells of great magic.

summary.id: Dalam salah satu mantra, Isis menciptakan ular yang menggigit Ra dan membuatnya sakit, lalu menawarkan menyembuhkannya jika Ra menyebut nama rahasianya yang sejati.
summary.en: In one spell Isis creates a snake that bites Ra and makes him ill, then offers to cure him if he tells her his true, secret name.

title.id: Sang dewi menampakkan diri (karya sastra Apuleius)

role.id: Dewi yang menampakkan diri dan menyebut dirinya Ratu Isis
role.en: The goddess who appears and calls herself Queen Isis

summary.id: Dalam terjemahan Adlington atas karya Apuleius, sang dewi menampakkan diri dengan rebana kuningan dan cawan emas, menyebut dirinya ibu alami segala sesuatu, dan menyatakan bahwa ia dipuja dengan banyak nama, tetapi orang Mesir menyebutnya Ratu Isis.
summary.en: In Adlington's translation of Apuleius, the goddess appears with a brass timbrel and a golden cup, calls herself the natural mother of all things, and says she is worshipped under many names, but that the Egyptians call her Queen Isis.

description.id: Tempat suci terpenting Isis di Delta Nil, tempat kultusnya bermula.
description.en: Isis's most important sanctuary, in the Nile Delta, where her cult began.

description.id: Kuil Isis di pulau Philae di Mesir Hulu, tempat ziarah selama ribuan tahun hingga ditutup Justinian pada 529 M.
description.en: Isis's temple on the island of Philae in Upper Egypt, a pilgrimage site for thousands of years until Justinian closed it in 529 CE.

description.id: Wilayah tempat kultus Isis bermula dan tempat ia menyembunyikan jasad Osiris dari Set.
description.en: The region where Isis's cult began and where she hid Osiris's body from Set.

description.id: Kota tempat ditemukan kuil Isis.
description.en: A city where a temple of Isis has been found.

description.id: Situs Romawi di Britania Raya tempat ditemukan kuil Isis.
description.en: A Roman site in Great Britain where a temple of Isis has been found.

description.id: Nama Isis pertama tercatat dalam Teks Piramida; sebelum Dinasti Kelima ia dan Osiris tidak disebut namanya.
description.en: Isis's name is first attested in the Pyramid Texts; neither she nor Osiris is mentioned by name before the Fifth Dynasty.

description.id: Isis mengambil sifat yang semula milik Hathor, dewi terkemuka masa sebelumnya.
description.en: Isis took on traits that originally belonged to Hathor, the preeminent goddess of an earlier time.

description.id: Pasukan Aleksander mengaitkan Isis dengan dewi Yunani Demeter.
description.en: Alexander's troops associated Isis with the Greek goddess Demeter.

description.id: Pada masa Caligula pemujaan Isis di Roma dikukuhkan lewat Festival Isiak.
description.en: Under Caligula the worship of Isis in Rome was firmly established through the Isiac Festival.

description.id: Kaisar Justinian menutup Philae, situs penting bagi Isis.
description.en: The emperor Justinian closed Philae, a vital site dedicated to Isis.

note.id: Suami dan saudara Isis; Isis menghidupkannya kembali setelah dibunuh Set.
note.en: Isis's husband and brother; Isis revived him after Set killed him.

note.id: Putra Isis dan Osiris, yang dilindunginya dari Set.
note.en: Isis's son with Osiris, whom she protected from Set.

note.id: Saudara yang membunuh Osiris dan mengancam Horus.
note.en: The brother who killed Osiris and threatened Horus.

note.id: Saudari Isis, anak Nut dan Geb, yang melambangkan kematian bagi kehidupan Isis.
note.en: Isis's sister, child of Nut and Geb, associated with death as Isis was with life.

note.id: Ayah Isis.
note.en: Isis's father.

note.id: Ibu Isis.
note.en: Isis's mother.

note.id: Isis menekan Ra agar menyebut nama rahasianya dalam sebuah mantra.
note.en: Isis presses Ra to tell his secret name in one spell.

note.id: Isis mengambil sifat yang semula milik Hathor pada Kerajaan Baru.
note.en: Isis took on traits that originally belonged to Hathor in the New Kingdom.

note.id: Dewi Yunani yang dikaitkan pasukan Aleksander dengan Isis.
note.en: The Greek goddess whom Alexander's troops associated with Isis.

traditional_summary.id: Dalam tradisi Mesir kuno, Isis adalah istri Osiris dan ibu Horus yang menghidupkan suaminya dan melindungi putranya.
traditional_summary.en: In ancient Egyptian tradition Isis is the wife of Osiris and mother of Horus who revived her husband and protected her son.

modern_depiction.id: Menurut Wikipedia, Isis masih muncul dalam budaya Barat, terutama dalam esoterisme dan paganisme modern, sering sebagai personifikasi alam atau sisi feminin keilahian.
modern_depiction.en: According to Wikipedia, Isis still appears in Western culture, especially in esotericism and modern paganism, often as a personification of nature or the feminine aspect of divinity.

summary.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, namanya berasal dari Eset, "tempat duduk", yang merujuk pada kestabilan dan takhta Mesir.
summary.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, her name comes from Eset, "the seat", referring to stability and the throne of Egypt.

summary.id: Egiptolog Kurt Sethe mengusulkan Isis semula personifikasi takhta.
summary.en: The Egyptologist Kurt Sethe suggested Isis was originally a personification of thrones.

summary.id: Jürgen Osing dan Klaus P. Kuhlmann menolak tafsir itu karena perbedaan nama dan kata takhta serta kurangnya bukti takhta pernah diilahikan.
summary.en: Jürgen Osing and Klaus P. Kuhlmann dispute it because of dissimilarities between the name and the word for throne and a lack of evidence that the throne was deified.

summary.id: World History Encyclopedia menyebut agama Kristen meminjam citra Isis dan Horus untuk penggambaran Madonna dengan bayi Kristus.
summary.en: World History Encyclopedia says Christianity drew on the image of Isis and Horus for the Madonna with the Christ child.

summary.id: Wikipedia menyebut pengaruhnya mungkin ada, tetapi buktinya tidak jelas dan sering diperdebatkan.
summary.en: Wikipedia says influence is possible, but the evidence is ambiguous and often controversial.

questions.id: Mengapa kisah Isis mencari Osiris dan melindungi Horus begitu berpengaruh bagi orang Mesir kuno?
questions.en: Why was the story of Isis searching for Osiris and protecting Horus so influential for the ancient Egyptians?

questions.id: Apa yang membuat dewi Mesir ini dapat dipuja di Yunani dan Roma?
questions.en: What allowed this Egyptian goddess to be worshipped in Greece and Rome?

questions.id: Bagaimana kita membedakan apa yang dikatakan tradisi Mesir dari apa yang dikatakan karya sastra Romawi tentang Isis?
questions.en: How can we tell what Egyptian tradition says about Isis apart from what a Roman literary work says?

caption.en: Isis — AI artistic interpretation based on features in folklore sources.

claim.id: Isis adalah dewi Mesir kuno.
claim.en: Isis is an ancient Egyptian goddess.

claims_provenance.quote: Isis is an ancient Egyptian goddess who became the most popular and enduring of all the Egyptian deities.

claim.id: Nama Isis pertama kali tercatat dalam Teks Piramida dari dinasti kelima.
claim.en: Isis's name is first attested in the Fifth Dynasty Pyramid Texts.

claims_provenance.quote: Isis’ name is first attested in the fifth dynasty in the Pyramid texts.
claims_provenance.source_citation: The Metropolitan Museum of Art — Isis and Horus

claim.id: Isis adalah istri Osiris dan ibu Horus.
claim.en: Isis is the wife of Osiris and mother of Horus.

claims_provenance.quote: She was the wife of Osiris and the mother of Horus, and thus was symbolically mother to the pharaoh.
claims_provenance.source_citation: The Metropolitan Museum of Art — Isis and Horus

claim.id: Menurut mitos, Isis menghidupkan kembali Osiris setelah dibunuh Seth.
claim.en: According to the myth, Isis revived Osiris after Seth killed him.

claims_provenance.quote: According to this myth Isis was able to revive Osiris after he had been killed by his brother Seth and she became pregnant with their son Horus.
claims_provenance.source_citation: The Metropolitan Museum of Art — Statuette of Isis with the infant Horus

claim.id: Isis membesarkan Horus dan melindunginya dari Seth.
claim.en: Isis nurtured Horus and protected him from Seth.

claims_provenance.quote: After Horus’ birth, Isis nurtured her child and protected him from Seth and other dangers.
claims_provenance.source_citation: The Metropolitan Museum of Art — Statuette of Isis with the infant Horus

claim.id: Sebuah patung kecil menunjukkan Isis menyusui putranya Horus.
claim.en: A statuette shows Isis nursing Horus.

claims_provenance.quote: This statuette shows the goddess in her most beloved pose, nursing her son Horus (known also as the lactans pose).
claims_provenance.source_citation: The Metropolitan Museum of Art — Isis and Horus

claim.id: Kultus Isis bermula di Delta Nil dan akhirnya menyebar ke seluruh Mesir.
claim.en: Isis's cult began in the Nile Delta and spread throughout Egypt.

claims_provenance.quote: Her cult began in the Nile Delta and her most important sanctuary was there at the shrine of Behbeit El-Hagar, but worship of Isis eventually spread to all parts of Egypt.

claim.id: Patung-patung Isis bersama Horus menonjolkan perannya sebagai pemberi kehidupan dan pelindung.
claim.en: Statuettes of Isis and Horus emphasize her role as life-giver and protector.

claims_provenance.quote: The abundance of statuettes in this particular pose demonstrate some of the qualities for which Isis was most valued in the first millennium BC: her role as a life-giver and protector.
claims_provenance.source_citation: The Metropolitan Museum of Art — Isis and Horus

claim.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, namanya berasal dari kata Mesir Eset ("tempat duduk"), yang merujuk pada kestabilannya dan juga takhta Mesir, karena ia dianggap ibu setiap firaun lewat kaitan raja dengan Horus, putranya.
claim.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, her name comes from the Egyptian Eset ("the seat"), referring to her stability and also the throne of Egypt, as she was considered the mother of every pharaoh through the king's association with Horus, her son.

claims_provenance.quote: Her name comes from the Egyptian Eset, ("the seat") which referred to her stability and also the throne of Egypt as she was considered the mother of every pharaoh through the king's association with Horus, Isis' son.

claim.id: Lambang Isis adalah kalajengking (yang menjaganya saat bersembunyi), kite (sejenis elang yang wujudnya ia ambil untuk menghidupkan suaminya), takhta kosong, dan sistrum.
claim.en: Isis's symbols are the scorpion (who kept her safe in hiding), the kite (a kind of falcon whose shape she assumed in bringing her husband back to life), the empty throne, and the sistrum.

claims_provenance.quote: Her symbols are the scorpion (who kept her safe when she was in hiding), the kite (a kind of falcon whose shape she assumed in bringing her husband back to life), the empty throne, and the sistrum.

claim.id: Isis juga dikenal sebagai Weret-Kekau ("Sihir Agung") karena kekuatannya dan Mut-Netjer, "Ibu Para Dewa", serta punya banyak nama menurut peran yang sedang dijalankannya.
claim.en: Isis was also known as Weret-Kekau ("the Great Magic") for her power and Mut-Netjer, "Mother of the Gods", and had many names depending on the role she was fulfilling.

claims_provenance.quote: She was also known as Weret-Kekau ("the Great Magic") for her power and Mut-Netjer, "Mother of the Gods" but was known by many names depending on which role she was fulfilling at the moment.

claim.id: Lama-kelamaan Isis begitu populer sehingga semua dewa dianggap sekadar aspek Isis dan ia satu-satunya dewa Mesir yang dipuja semua orang di negeri itu.
claim.en: In time Isis became so popular that all gods were considered mere aspects of her and she was the only Egyptian deity worshiped by everyone in the country.

claims_provenance.quote: In time, she became so popular that all gods were considered mere aspects of Isis and she was the only Egyptian deity worshiped by everyone in the country.

claim.id: Seperti Misteri Eleusis, kultus Isis tumbuh menjadi agama misteri yang menjanjikan rahasia hidup dan mati kepada para peserta inisiasi, yang disumpah merahasiakannya.
claim.en: Like the Eleusinian Mysteries, the cult of Isis grew into a mystery religion promising the secrets of life and death to initiates, who were sworn to secrecy.

claims_provenance.quote: Like the Eleusinian Mysteries, the Cult of Isis grew into a Mystery Religion promising the secrets of life and death to initiates, who were then sworn to secrecy.

claim.id: Kuil Isis di pulau Philae di Mesir Hulu tetap menjadi tempat ziarah selama ribuan tahun hingga ditutup pada abad ke-6 M oleh kaisar Kristen Justinian.
claim.en: Her temple on the island of Philae in Upper Egypt remained an active pilgrimage site for thousands of years until closed in the 6th century CE by the Christian emperor Justinian.

claims_provenance.quote: Her temple on the island of Philae in Upper Egypt would remain an active pilgrimage site for thousands of years until closed in the 6th century CE by the Christian emperor Justinian.

claim.id: Isis akhirnya dikaitkan dengan laut dan menjadi pelindung pelaut dan pedagang yang memakai jimat untuknya dan memohon bantuannya saat bahaya.
claim.en: Isis eventually became associated with the sea and was protectress of sailors and merchants who wore talismans honoring her and invoked her aid in times of trouble.

claims_provenance.quote: Eventually, she became associated with the sea and was a protectress of sailors and merchants who wore talismans honoring her and invoked her aid in times of trouble (attested to by archaeological evidence).

claim.id: Berbeda dari dewa Mesir lainnya, Isis melampaui batas negara dan dipuja orang Yunani dan Romawi yang meyakininya sebagai dewa tertinggi pencipta dunia.
claim.en: Unlike other Egyptian gods, Isis transcended national borders and was worshiped by Greeks and Romans, who believed in her as the supreme deity who created the world.

claims_provenance.quote: Unlike the other gods of Egypt, Isis transcended national borders and was worshiped by the Greeks and the Romans who believed in her as the supreme deity who created the world.

claim.id: Set iri pada kekuasaan dan gengsi saudaranya dan merencanakan menyingkirkannya, dengan membuat peti mati indah seukuran tinggi Osiris.
claim.en: Set was jealous of his brother's power and prestige and plotted to get rid of him, having a beautiful coffin made to Osiris's exact height.

claims_provenance.quote: Set was jealous of his brother's power and prestige, however, and so conceived a plan to get rid of him. He had a beautiful coffin made to Osiris' exact height

claim.id: Isis sangat bersedih ketika suaminya hilang dan mencarinya ke seluruh Mesir tanpa hasil.
claim.en: Isis was distraught when her husband went missing and searched all through Egypt without success.

claims_provenance.quote: Isis was distraught when she found her husband was missing and went searching for him all through Egypt without success.

claim.id: Isis mengeluarkan Osiris dari pohon dan membawa jasadnya kembali ke Mesir, menyembunyikannya dari Set di rawa-rawa Delta Nil.
claim.en: Isis cut Osiris from the tree and carried his body back to Egypt, hiding him from Set in the swampy region of the Nile Delta.

claims_provenance.quote: After leaving the court, Isis cut Osiris from the tree and carried his body back to Egypt where she hid him from Set in the swampy region of the Nile Delta.

claim.id: Isis berhasil menghidupkan kembali Osiris, mengambil wujud kite (sejenis elang), terbang mengelilinginya, dan mengandung putra, Horus.
claim.en: Isis was still able to revive Osiris and, in the form of a kite, flew around him and became pregnant with a son, Horus.

claims_provenance.quote: Isis still was able to revive Osiris and, once he was alive, she assumed the form of a kite and flew around him, drew the seed from his body into her own, and became pregnant with a son, Horus

claim.id: Meski hidup lagi, Osiris tidak lengkap dan tak bisa lagi memerintah dunia orang hidup; ia mundur ke alam baka dan menjadi Penguasa dan Hakim Orang Mati.
claim.en: Though alive again, Osiris was incomplete and could no longer rule the living; he withdrew into the afterlife where he became Lord and Judge of the Dead.

claims_provenance.quote: Even though Osiris now lived, he was incomplete and could no longer rule the land of the living. He withdrew into the afterlife where he became Lord and Judge of the Dead.

claim.id: Karena takut akan perbuatan Set, Isis menyembunyikan Horus di rawa-rawa Mesir sampai dewasa; Horus lalu muncul sebagai prajurit perkasa dan melawan Set demi menguasai dunia.
claim.en: Fearing what Set might do, Isis hid Horus in the swamps of Egypt until he was grown; Horus then emerged as a mighty warrior and battled Set for control of the world.

claims_provenance.quote: Isis, fearing what Set might do to her son, hid Horus among the swamps of Egypt until he was grown. At that point, Horus emerged as a mighty warrior and battled Set for control of the world.

claim.id: Dalam kisah Isis dan Tujuh Kalajengking, Isis memanggil tiap kalajengking dengan nama rahasianya sehingga menundukkan mereka, melafalkan mantra sihir agung, dan racun lenyap dari tubuh anak itu sehingga ia sadar kembali.
claim.en: In the story of Isis and the Seven Scorpions, Isis called each scorpion by its secret name, dominating them, and recited spells of great magic; the poison left the child's body and he revived.

claims_provenance.quote: Isis took the child in her arms and called each of the scorpions by their secret name, thereby dominating them and neutralizing their power, and recited spells of great magic. The poison evaporated, leaving the child's body, and he revived.

claim.id: Ketika Horus masih bayi dan Isis menyembunyikannya di rawa dari Set, tujuh kalajengking menemaninya dan membentuk semacam pengawal di sekelilingnya saat ia keluar mencari makan pada malam hari.
claim.en: When Horus was an infant and Isis was hiding him in the swamp from Set, seven scorpions kept her company and formed a kind of bodyguard around her when she went out for food in the evenings.

claims_provenance.quote: The story relates how, when Horus was an infant and Isis was hiding him in the swamp lands from Set, seven scorpions kept her company. She would sometimes go out in the evenings for food, and the scorpions would form a kind of bodyguard around her.

claim.id: Ketika Aleksander Agung menaklukkan Mesir pada 331 SM, pasukannya mengaitkan Isis dengan dewi Yunani Demeter.
claim.en: When Alexander the Great conquered Egypt in 331 BCE his troops associated Isis with the Greek goddess Demeter.

claims_provenance.quote: When Alexander the Great (l. 356-323 BCE) conquered Egypt in 331 BCE his troops associated Isis with the popular Greek goddess Demeter.

claim.id: Pada masa Caligula (37-41 M) pemujaan Isis di Roma dikukuhkan oleh kaisar lewat Festival Isiak.
claim.en: Under Caligula (37-41 CE) the worship of Isis in Rome was firmly established by the emperor through the Isiac Festival in her honor.

claims_provenance.quote: under the reign of Caligula (r. 37-41 CE) the worship of Isis in Rome was firmly established by the emperor through the Isiac Festival in her honor.

claim.id: Kuil Isis ditemukan di Pompeii dan di situs Romawi Londinium (London modern) di Britania Raya.
claim.en: A temple of Isis has been found in Pompeii, and another at the Roman site of Londinium (modern London) in Great Britain.

claims_provenance.quote: A temple of Isis has been found in Pompeii, and another in Great Britain at the Roman site of Londinium (modern London).

claim.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, kultus Isis di Roma adalah saingan terbesar agama Kristen yang masih muda, yang meminjam citra Isis dan Horus kecil untuk penggambaran Madonna dengan bayi Kristus.
claim.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, her cult in Rome was the greatest rival of the young Christian religion, which drew on the image of Isis and the child-god Horus for the Madonna with the Christ child.

claims_provenance.quote: Her cult in Rome was the greatest rival to the young religion of Christianity, which drew upon the image of Isis and the child-god Horus for the depiction of the Madonna with the Christ child.

claim.id: Philae tetap menjadi situs penting bagi Isis hingga kaisar Justinian menutupnya pada 529 M.
claim.en: Philae continued as a vital site dedicated to Isis until the emperor Justinian closed it in 529 CE.

claims_provenance.quote: Philae continued as a vital site dedicated to Isis until the emperor Justinian closed it, along with other important centers of learning and worship in 529 CE.

claim.id: Nephthys tidak pernah digambarkan jahat bagi Isis yang baik, melainkan dikaitkan dengan kematian sedangkan Isis dengan kehidupan, sehingga kedua dewi bersaudari itu melambangkan keseimbangan kosmis.
claim.en: Nephthys was never depicted as evil to Isis's good but was associated with death while Isis was associated with life, so the two sister-deities symbolized cosmic balance.

claims_provenance.quote: Nephthys was never depicted as evil to Isis' good but was associated with death while Isis with life and so these two sister-deities symbolized cosmic balance.

claim.id: Isis bersama suami dan putranya menggantikan Triad Thebes (Amon, Mut, dan Khons), trinitas dewa yang paling populer di Mesir.
claim.en: Isis, her husband, and her son replaced the Theban Triad of Amon, Mut, and Khons, the most popular trinity of gods in Egypt.

claims_provenance.quote: She and her husband and son replaced the Theban Triad of Amon, Mut, and Khons, who had been the most popular trinity of gods in Egypt.

claim.id: Sebagai dewi pembawa banjir tahunan Sungai Nil yang menyuburkan tanah ia disebut Sati, dan sebagai dewi yang menciptakan dan memelihara kehidupan ia disebut Ankhet.
claim.en: As the goddess who brought the yearly Nile inundation that fertilized the land she was Sati, and as the goddess who created and preserved life she was Ankhet.

claims_provenance.quote: As the goddess who brought the yearly inundation of the Nile which fertilized the land she was Sati, for example, and as the goddess who created and preserved life she was Ankhet, and so on.

claim.id: Isis biasanya digambarkan sebagai ibu, istri, dan pelindung yang tanpa pamrih, murah hati, dan mengutamakan kepentingan orang lain.
claim.en: Isis is regularly portrayed as a selfless, giving mother, wife, and protectress who puts others' interests and well-being ahead of her own.

claims_provenance.quote: She is regularly portrayed as the selfless, giving, mother, wife, and protectress, who places other's interests and well-being ahead of her own.

claim.id: Nut melahirkan lima anak dari Geb: Osiris, Isis, Set, Nephthys, dan Horus (Horus yang Tua).
claim.en: Nut gave birth to five children by Geb: Osiris, Isis, Set, Nephthys, and Horus (known as Horus the Elder).

claims_provenance.quote: Nut, however, was already pregnant by Geb and soon gave birth to five children: Osiris, Isis, Set, Nephthys, and Horus (known as Horus the Elder).

claim.id: Osiris menikahi Isis dan, sebagai anak sulung, memerintah sebagai Penguasa Bumi dengan Isis sebagai ratu dan pendampingnya.
claim.en: Osiris married Isis and, as the firstborn, ruled as Lord of the Earth with Isis as his queen and consort.

claims_provenance.quote: Osiris married Isis and, as the first born, assumed rule as Lord of the Earth, with Isis as his queen and consort.

claim.id: Dalam terjemahan Adlington atas karya Apuleius, sang dewi menyebut dirinya ibu alami segala sesuatu, penguasa semua unsur, keturunan awal dunia, pemimpin kuasa ilahi, dan Ratu Langit.
claim.en: In Adlington's translation of Apuleius, the goddess calls herself the natural mother of all things, mistress of all the elements, the initial progeny of worlds, chief of divine powers, and Queen of heaven.

claims_provenance.quote: I am she that is the naturall mother of all things, mistresse and governesse of all the Elements, the initiall progeny of worlds, chiefe of powers divine, Queene of heaven!
claims_provenance.locator: Book 11, the goddess speaks to Lucius
claims_provenance.source_citation: Project Gutenberg — The Golden Asse (Apuleius, translated by William Adlington)

claim.id: Sang dewi dalam karya Apuleius menyatakan bahwa atas kehendaknya planet-planet langit, angin laut yang menyehatkan, dan kesunyian neraka diatur.
claim.en: In Apuleius's work the goddess declares that at her will the planets of the air, the wholesome winds of the seas, and the silences of hell are disposed.

claims_provenance.quote: at my will the planets of the ayre, the wholesome winds of the Seas, and the silences of hell be diposed
claims_provenance.locator: Book 11, the goddess speaks to Lucius
claims_provenance.source_citation: Project Gutenberg — The Golden Asse (Apuleius, translated by William Adlington)

claim.id: Dalam karya Apuleius sang dewi menyebut bahwa ia dipuja dengan banyak nama: bangsa Frigia menyebutnya ibu para dewa, orang Athena Minerva, orang Siprus Venus, dan seterusnya.
claim.en: In Apuleius's work the goddess says she is worshipped under many names: the Phrygians call her mother of the Gods, the Athenians Minerva, the Cyprians Venus, and so on.

claims_provenance.quote: for the Phrygians call me the mother of the Gods: the Athenians, Minerva: the Cyprians, Venus: the Candians, Diana: the Sicilians Proserpina: the Eleusians, Ceres: some Juno, other Bellona, other Hecate
claims_provenance.locator: Book 11, the goddess speaks to Lucius
claims_provenance.source_citation: Project Gutenberg — The Golden Asse (Apuleius, translated by William Adlington)

claim.id: Dalam karya Apuleius, orang Mesir, yang unggul dalam segala ajaran kuno dan memujanya dengan upacara mereka sendiri, menyebutnya Ratu Isis.
claim.en: In Apuleius's work the Egyptians, excellent in all ancient doctrine and worshipping her with their own ceremonies, call her Queen Isis.

claims_provenance.quote: and the Aegyptians which are excellent in all kind of ancient doctrine, and by their proper ceremonies accustome to worship mee, doe call mee Queene Isis.
claims_provenance.locator: Book 11, the goddess speaks to Lucius
claims_provenance.source_citation: Project Gutenberg — The Golden Asse (Apuleius, translated by William Adlington)

claim.id: Dalam penglihatan di karya Apuleius, sang dewi memegang rebana kuningan di tangan kanan dan cawan emas di tangan kiri, dengan ular aspis mengangkat kepala dari mulut cawan.
claim.en: In the vision in Apuleius's work, the goddess holds a brass timbrel in her right hand and a golden cup in her left, from whose mouth a serpent, the asp, lifts its head.

claims_provenance.quote: In her right hand shee had a timbrell of brasse, which gave a pleasant sound, in her left hand shee bare a cup of gold, out of the mouth whereof the serpent Aspis lifted up his head
claims_provenance.locator: Book 11, the vision of the goddess
claims_provenance.source_citation: Project Gutenberg — The Golden Asse (Apuleius, translated by William Adlington)

claim.id: Isis adalah dewi utama dalam agama Mesir kuno yang pemujaannya menyebar ke seluruh dunia Yunani-Romawi.
claim.en: Isis was a major goddess in ancient Egyptian religion whose worship spread throughout the Greco-Roman world.

claims_provenance.quote: Isis was a major goddess in ancient Egyptian religion whose worship spread throughout the Greco-Roman world.

short_description.id: Isis adalah dewi Mesir kuno, istri Osiris dan ibu Horus, yang dikenal karena kuasa sihirnya dan perlindungannya, dan pemujaannya menyebar ke dunia Yunani-Romawi.
short_description.en: Isis is an ancient Egyptian goddess, wife of Osiris and mother of Horus, known for her magical power and protection, whose worship spread throughout the Greco-Roman world.

long_description.id: Isis adalah dewi Mesir kuno yang menjadi paling populer dan paling lestari di antara dewa-dewa Mesir. Ia istri Osiris dan ibu Horus, sehingga secara simbolis menjadi ibu bagi firaun. Namanya pertama tercatat dalam Teks Piramida dari Dinasti Kelima. Kultusnya bermula di Delta Nil, dengan tempat suci terpenting di Behbeit El-Hagar, lalu menyebar ke seluruh Mesir.
long_description.en: Isis is an ancient Egyptian goddess who rose to be the most popular and long-lasting of the Egyptian deities. She is the wife of Osiris and the mother of Horus, and so symbolically the mother of the pharaoh. Her name is first attested in the Pyramid Texts of the Fifth Dynasty. Her cult began in the Nile Delta, with its most important sanctuary at Behbeit El-Hagar, and spread to all parts of Egypt.

long_description.id: Dalam mitos Osiris, Set iri kepada saudaranya dan membuat peti mati seukuran tubuh Osiris. Isis mencari suaminya ke seluruh Mesir, membawa jasadnya kembali, lalu menghidupkannya; dalam wujud kite, sejenis elang, ia terbang mengelilinginya dan mengandung Horus. Osiris kemudian mundur ke alam baka sebagai Penguasa dan Hakim Orang Mati, sementara Isis menyembunyikan Horus di rawa-rawa sampai dewasa. Horus kemudian melawan Set demi menguasai dunia.
long_description.en: In the myth of Osiris, Set was jealous of his brother and had a coffin made to Osiris's exact height. Isis searched all through Egypt for her husband, brought his body back, and revived him; in the form of a kite, a kind of falcon, she flew around him and became pregnant with Horus. Osiris then withdrew to the afterlife as Lord and Judge of the Dead, while Isis hid Horus in the swamps until he was grown. Horus then battled Set for control of the world.

long_description.id: Isis dikenal karena sihirnya. Kuasa sihirnya konon melampaui semua dewa lain, dan ia dikatakan mengatur alam serta berkuasa atas takdir; ia juga disebut Weret-Kekau, "Sihir Agung". Dalam sebuah mantra ia membuat Ra sakit dengan gigitan ular dan menawarkan penyembuhan jika Ra mengungkapkan nama rahasianya. Dalam kisah Isis dan Tujuh Kalajengking, ia menyembuhkan seorang anak dengan memanggil nama rahasia para kalajengking dan melafalkan mantra sihir agung. Bantuan keibuannya juga dipanggil dalam mantra penyembuhan bagi orang biasa.
long_description.en: Isis was known for her magic. Her magic was reputed to surpass that of every other god, and she was said to rule the natural world and hold sway over fate; she was also called Weret-Kekau, "the Great Magic". In one spell she makes Ra ill with a snake's bite and offers to cure him if he reveals his secret name. In the story of Isis and the Seven Scorpions she heals a child by calling the scorpions by their secret names and reciting spells of great magic. Her maternal aid was also invoked in healing spells for ordinary people.

long_description.id: Ketika Aleksander Agung menaklukkan Mesir pada 331 SM, pasukannya mengaitkan Isis dengan Demeter. Di Roma pemujaannya dikukuhkan pada masa Caligula, dan kuil Isis ditemukan antara lain di Pompeii dan Londinium. Dalam karya Apuleius (terjemahan Adlington), sang dewi menyebut dirinya ibu alami segala sesuatu dan Ratu Langit, dan menyatakan bahwa orang Mesir menyebutnya Ratu Isis. Kuil Isis di Philae tetap menjadi tempat ziarah hingga ditutup oleh kaisar Justinian pada 529 M.
long_description.en: When Alexander the Great conquered Egypt in 331 BCE his troops associated Isis with Demeter. In Rome her worship was firmly established under Caligula, and temples of Isis have been found at Pompeii and Londinium, among other places. In Apuleius's work (Adlington's translation) the goddess calls herself the natural mother of all things and Queen of heaven, and says the Egyptians call her Queen Isis. Her temple at Philae remained a pilgrimage site until the emperor Justinian closed it in 529 CE.

long_description.id: Seiring waktu Isis menjadi begitu populer sehingga semua dewa dianggap sekadar aspek Isis, dan ia satu-satunya dewa Mesir yang dipuja semua orang. Bersama suami dan putranya ia menggantikan Triad Thebes yang berisi Amon, Mut, dan Khons. Kultusnya tumbuh menjadi agama misteri yang menjanjikan rahasia hidup dan mati kepada para peserta inisiasi, ia dikaitkan dengan laut sebagai pelindung pelaut dan pedagang, dan orang Yunani serta Romawi memuliakannya sebagai dewa tertinggi pencipta dunia.
long_description.en: Over time Isis grew so popular that all gods were regarded as mere aspects of her, and she was the one Egyptian deity worshipped by everyone. With her husband and son she replaced the Theban Triad of Amon, Mut, and Khons. Her cult developed into a mystery cult that offered initiates knowledge of life and death, she became linked with the sea as protector of sailors and merchants, and Greeks and Romans honoured her as the supreme deity who created the world.

cultural_context.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Isis menjadi dewi seluruh rakyat Mesir, laki-laki dan perempuan, bangsawan dan rakyat biasa, dan ia biasanya digambarkan sebagai ibu, istri, dan pelindung yang mengutamakan kepentingan orang lain. Dalam sebuah patung kecil, ia tampil menyusui Horus, dan patung-patung seperti itu menonjolkan perannya sebagai pemberi kehidupan dan pelindung.
cultural_context.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, Isis was embraced as goddess by every Egyptian, men and women, royal and ordinary, and is regularly portrayed as a mother, wife, and protectress who puts others' interests first. A statuette shows her nursing Horus, and such statuettes emphasize her role as life-giver and protector.

description.en: In Adlington's translation of Apuleius, the goddess declares that at her will the planets of the air, the winds of the seas, and the silences of hell are disposed, and calls herself mistress of all the elements.

description.en: Greek devotees associated Isis with Demeter and ascribed to her traits of Greek deities, such as the invention of marriage and the protection of ships; in Rome she was widely known and worshipped.

Isis mencari suaminya ke seluruh Mesir, mengeluarkannya dari pohon di tepi laut, dan menyembunyikan jasadnya di Delta Nil. Ia menghidupkan Osiris kembali dan mengandung Horus, sementara Osiris menjadi Penguasa dan Hakim Orang Mati.
summary.en: Set, jealous of Osiris, had a coffin made to Osiris's exact height. Isis searched all through Egypt for her husband, cut him from the tree, and hid his body in the Nile Delta. She revived Osiris and became pregnant with Horus, while Osiris became Lord and Judge of the Dead.

summary.en: Fearing Set, Isis hid Horus in the swamps of Egypt until he was grown. She nurtured and protected him from Set and other dangers, and Horus then emerged as a mighty warrior who battled Set.
