short_description.id: Eros adalah dewa cinta dan hasrat dalam mitologi Yunani, digambarkan sebagai dewa purba penciptaan atau sebagai putra Aphrodite yang bersenjata busur dan panah.
short_description.en: Eros is the Greek god of love and desire, portrayed either as a primordial god of creation or as Aphrodite's son armed with bow and arrows.

long_description.id:
Eros adalah dewa cinta Yunani, lebih tepatnya hasrat yang bergairah dan jasmani. Menurut Hesiod ia salah satu dewa purba yang bersama Chaos dan Gaia bertanggung jawab atas penciptaan; sumber lain menyebutnya dewa purba prokreasi yang muncul dengan sendirinya, dan kaum Orfik menamainya Phanes. Dalam tradisi lain ia lahir dari telur: kosmogoni Orfik menyebutnya hermafrodit dari telur yang diletakkan Chronos, dan Aristophanes memakai gagasan serupa dengan telur perak yang dikeluarkan Nyx dan Aither.

Eros yang lebih muda adalah putra Aphrodite, anak nakal yang bersenjata busur dan panah; dalam satu silsilah ayahnya adalah Ares. Tradisi lain memberinya orang tua berbeda, misalnya Iris dan Zephyros, atau Aphrodite dan Ouranos. Ia sering digambarkan sebagai anak Aphrodite yang tidak penurut tetapi sangat setia, dan dalam beberapa tradisi ia punya adik bernama Anteros, sosok lebih gelap yang membalas cinta tak berbalas.

Eros memilih sasarannya tanpa peringatan dan menyerang hati mereka, membawa kebingungan dan perasaan yang tak tertahankan. Panah Eros dikisahkan membuat manusia, pahlawan, dan dewa jatuh cinta, dan tak seorang pun kebal. Dalam satu kisah ia memiliki dua panah berlawanan: ujung emas membangkitkan cinta, ujung timbal yang tumpul menolaknya. Ia membuat Apollo jatuh cinta pada Daphne dan Medea pada Jason. Ia sendiri tidak kebal: ia jatuh cinta dan menikahi Psyche meski ditentang Aphrodite. Satu sumber menyebutnya menjinakkan singa dan harimau, mematahkan petir Zeus, dan merampas senjata Heracles; dalam kisah lain ia dan Aphrodite berubah menjadi ikan untuk lolos dari Typhon.

Eros menerima pemujaan di Thespiae (dengan festival Erotidia), Athena, Megara, Philadelphia, Leuctra, Velia, dan Parium, dan altarnya ada di Akademi Athena serta gimnasium Elis. Dalam seni Yunani ia paling sering digambarkan sebagai pemuda tampan yang riang, bermahkota bunga, terutama mawar. Sejak abad ke-6 SM ia biasanya remaja bersayap yang sering membawa karangan bunga kemenangan, dan kadang muncul berdua atau bertiga sebagai Erotes, lambang berbagai bentuk cinta; ia baru sering membawa busur sejak abad ke-4 SM. Seni klasik menampilkannya sebagai pemuda bersayap, seni Helenistik juga sebagai bayi, dan dalam seni Romawi kemudian, dengan nama Cupid, sebagai bayi montok. Praxiteles dikatakan menyempurnakan citranya sebagai pemuda dewasa yang sangat rupawan.

Mitos Yunani mengaitkan Eros terutama dengan kesuburan, hasrat, dan cinta seksual, dan karena gairah itu sulit dikendalikan, ia dianggap semacam penipu yang licik: kadang jahil tanpa bahaya, kadang kejam dengan serangan mendadak. Ia tidak pernah dianggap salah satu dari 12 dewa Olimpus, dan dianggap pelindung khusus cinta sesama jenis. Dalam salah satu dialog filsafat Yunani, seorang pembicara menyebut Cinta sebagai dewa tertua. Hal-hal yang suci baginya dan sering menyertainya dalam seni mencakup mawar, binatang buas yang dijinakkan, kelinci, ayam jantan, dan domba jantan. Padanannya dalam tradisi Romawi adalah Cupid.
long_description.en:
Eros was the Greek god of love, specifically the kind of desire that is passionate and bodily. According to Hesiod he was one of the primeval gods who, with Chaos and Gaia, was responsible for the Creation; another source calls him the primordial god of procreation who emerged self-formed, and the Orphics named him Phanes. In other traditions he is born from an egg: the Orphic cosmogonies make him a hermaphrodite from an egg put by Chronos, and Aristophanes uses a similar idea with a silver egg laid by Nyx and Aither.

The younger Eros is the son of Aphrodite, a mischievous godling armed with bow and arrows; in one genealogy his father is Ares. Other traditions give him different parents, such as Iris and Zephyros, or Aphrodite and Ouranos. He is often portrayed as Aphrodite's disobedient but fiercely loyal child, and in some traditions he has a younger brother, Anteros, a darker figure who avenges unrequited love.

Eros picks his targets without warning and strikes at their hearts, bringing confusion and irrepressible feelings. Eros's arrows were said to make humans, heroes, and gods fall in love, and no one was immune. In one tale he holds two opposing arrows: a gold point rouses love and a blunt point of lead routs it. He made Apollo fall in love with Daphne and Medea with Jason. He was not himself immune: he fell for and married Psyche against Aphrodite's wishes. One source says he tames lions and tigers, breaks Zeus's thunderbolts, and deprives Heracles of his arms; in another tale he and Aphrodite turned into fishes to escape Typhon.

Eros received cult worship at Thespiae (with its Erotidia festival), Athens, Megara, Philadelphia, Leuctra, Velia, and Parium, and had altars at the Academy of Athens and the gymnasium at Elis. In Greek art he is most often a carefree, beautiful youth crowned with flowers, especially roses. From the 6th century BCE he is usually a winged adolescent often carrying a victory wreath, and he sometimes appears in twos or threes as Erotes, symbolizing the different forms of love; he is shown with a bow with any frequency only from the 4th century BCE. Classical art shows him as a winged youth, Hellenistic art also as a baby, and later Roman art, under the name Cupid, as a chubby baby. Praxiteles is said to have perfected his image as a full-grown youth of great beauty.

Myths tied Eros chiefly to fertility, desire and sexual love, and since such passions were hard to master he was seen as something of a cunning trickster: sometimes harmlessly mischievous, sometimes cruel in his surprise attacks. He was never counted among the 12 Olympian gods, and was seen as the particular protector of homosexual love. One speaker in a Greek philosophical dialogue calls Love the most ancient of the gods. Things sacred to him that often accompany him in art include the rose, tamed wild beasts, the hare, the cock, and the ram. His Roman counterpart is Cupid.

era: Hesiod is the earliest author to mention him; in Greek art he is depicted from the 6th century BCE.

who.id: Dewa cinta dan hasrat Yunani, bersenjata busur dan panah.
who.en: The Greek god of love and desire, armed with bow and arrows.

origin.id: Berasal dari mitologi Yunani, sebagai dewa purba penciptaan atau putra Aphrodite.
origin.en: From Greek mythology, as a primordial god of creation or Aphrodite's son.

role.id: Memicu cinta pada hati manusia, pahlawan, dan dewa dengan panahnya.
role.en: Kindles love in the hearts of humans, heroes, and gods with his arrows.

famous_for.id: Paling dikenal karena panah cintanya dan kisah cintanya dengan Psyche.
famous_for.en: Best known for his love-arrows and his love for Psyche.

did_you_know.id: Dalam satu kisah, Eros dan ibunya Aphrodite berubah menjadi ikan dan terjun ke Sungai Efrat untuk lolos dari Typhon.
did_you_know.en: In one tale Eros and his mother Aphrodite turned into fishes and plunged into the Euphrates to escape Typhon.

cultural_context.id: Menurut sumbernya, kurangnya disiplin dan ketidakandalan Eros mungkin menjelaskan mengapa ia tak pernah dianggap salah satu dari 12 dewa Olimpus; ia juga dianggap pelindung khusus cinta sesama jenis.
cultural_context.en: According to the source, Eros's lack of discipline and unreliability may explain why he was never counted among the 12 Olympian gods; he was also considered the specific protector of homosexual love.

description.id: Panah Eros membuat manusia, pahlawan, dan dewa jatuh cinta; ia digambarkan menaklukkan pikiran dan nasihat bijak semua dewa dan manusia.
description.en: Eros's arrows make humans, heroes, and gods fall in love; he is described as overcoming the mind and wise counsels of all gods and all men.

description.id: Dalam satu kisah Eros memiliki panah berujung emas yang membangkitkan cinta dan panah berujung timbal yang menolaknya.
description.en: In one tale Eros has a gold-tipped arrow that rouses love and a lead-tipped arrow that routs it.

description.id: Eros dikatakan menjinakkan singa dan harimau, mematahkan petir Zeus, dan merampas senjata Heracles.
description.en: Eros is said to tame lions and tigers, break Zeus's thunderbolts, and deprive Heracles of his arms.

description.id: Dalam kisah Hyginus, Eros dan Aphrodite berubah wujud menjadi ikan untuk lolos dari bahaya.
description.en: In Hyginus's tale, Eros and Aphrodite changed their forms into fishes to escape danger.

description.id: Eros purba adalah daya pendorong lahirnya kehidupan baru di kosmos.
description.en: The primordial Eros was the driving force behind the generation of new life in the cosmos.

description.id: Eros sendiri tidak kebal terhadap kuasa cinta; ia jatuh cinta dan menikahi Psyche.
description.en: Eros himself was not immune to the power of love; he fell for and married Psyche.

description.id: Ketika Typhoeus mengepung Olimpus, Eros yang berani lari panik dan meninggalkan panah-panahnya.
description.en: When Typhoeus besieged Olympos, bold Eros fled in panic, leaving his arrows behind.

name.en: Some are untouched by his arrows

description.id: Dalam satu teks, Athena menyatakan bahwa ia tak pernah merasakan panah sang Anak (Eros).
description.en: In one text Athena says she has never felt the arrows of the Boy (Eros).

description.id: Dewa purba prokreasi yang muncul dengan sendirinya saat penciptaan; kaum Orfik menamainya Phanes, makhluk purba yang menetas dari telur dunia.
description.en: The primordial god of procreation who emerged self-formed at creation; the Orphics named him Phanes, a primal being hatched from the world-egg.

description.id: Anak nakal bersenjata busur dan panah, putra Aphrodite, yang menurut kebanyakan orang adalah dewa termuda.
description.en: A mischievous godling armed with bow and arrows, son of Aphrodite, whom most men consider the youngest of the gods.

description.id: Padanan Romawi Eros; dalam seni Romawi kemudian ia lazim digambarkan sebagai bayi montok dan jahil.
description.en: The Roman counterpart of Eros; in later Roman art he is commonly portrayed as a chubby, mischievous baby.

role.en: The archer who answers a taunt

summary.id: Apollo mengejek kemampuan Eros memanah, lalu Eros menembakkan panah sehingga Apollo jatuh cinta pada nimfa Daphne. Dalam versi Ovid, panah berujung emas mengenai Apollo dan panah berujung timbal mengenai Daphne, yang menolak cinta.
summary.en: Apollo ridiculed Eros's archery, and Eros shot him so that he fell in love with the nymph Daphne. In Ovid's version a gold-tipped arrow strikes Apollo and a lead-tipped one strikes Daphne, who flees love.

summary.id: Eros membuat Medea jatuh cinta pada Jason, pahlawan pengambil Bulu Domba Emas.
summary.en: Eros made Medea fall in love with Jason, the hero who seized the Golden Fleece.

summary.id: Eros jatuh cinta dan menikahi Psyche meski ditentang ibunya, Aphrodite; Theoi mencatat Hedone sebagai anak mereka menurut Apuleius.
summary.en: Eros fell in love with and married Psyche against his mother Aphrodite's wishes; Theoi lists Hedone as their child, citing Apuleius.

summary.id: Saat Eros mencium ibunya, sebuah panah dari tabungnya tanpa sengaja menggores dada Aphrodite.
summary.en: As Eros kissed his mother, an arrow from his quiver unknowingly grazed Aphrodite's breast.

summary.id: Ketika Typhon muncul di tepi Efrat, Aphrodite dan Eros terjun ke sungai dan berubah menjadi ikan. Dalam teks lain, ketika Typhoeus mengepung Olimpus, Eros lari panik dan meninggalkan panahnya.
summary.en: When Typhon appeared at the Euphrates, Aphrodite and Eros plunged into the river and became fishes. In another text, when Typhoeus besieged Olympos, Eros fled in panic, leaving his arrows behind.

summary.id: Dalam Theogony, Eros dan Himeros mengikuti Aphrodite sejak kelahirannya dan ketika ia memasuki majelis para dewa; adegan ini populer dalam seni kuno.
summary.en: In Hesiod's Theogony Eros and Himeros followed Aphrodite at her birth and as she entered the assembly of the gods; the scene was popular in ancient art.

description.en: Homer does not mention Eros; Hesiod is the earliest author to mention him, as the cosmogonic Eros.

sources.title: Eros (Theoi Project: Eros God of Love)
sources.author: Aaron J. Atsma

claim.id: Eros adalah dewa Yunani yang berkaitan dengan cinta dan hasrat.
claim.en: Eros is the Greek god of love and passionate desire.

claims_provenance.quote: Eros was the Greek god of love, or more precisely, passionate and physical desire.

claim.id: Satu tradisi menggambarkan Eros sebagai dewa purba yang muncul pada awal penciptaan.
claim.en: One tradition describes Eros as a primordial god emerging at creation.

claims_provenance.quote: EROS was the primordial god (protogenos) of procreation who emerged self-formed at the dawn of creation.

claim.id: Dalam tradisi lain, Eros muda adalah putra Aphrodite yang membawa busur dan panah.
claim.en: In another tradition, the younger Eros is Aphrodite's son carrying bow and arrows.

claims_provenance.quote: The younger Eros, a mischievous godling armed with bow and arrows, was a son of the goddess Aphrodite.

claim.id: Salah satu silsilah menyebut Eros putra Aphrodite dan Ares.
claim.en: One genealogy makes Eros the son of Aphrodite and Ares.

claims_provenance.quote: He was also sometimes regarded as the child of Aphrodite, with Ares, the god of war, as his father

claim.id: Panah Eros dikisahkan membuat manusia, pahlawan, dan dewa jatuh cinta.
claim.en: Eros's arrows were said to make humans, heroes, and gods fall in love.

claims_provenance.quote: It was thought that Eros' arrows, often randomly aimed, made people, heroes, and gods fall in love - no one was immune.

claim.id: Eros jatuh cinta dan menikahi Psyche meskipun Aphrodite menentangnya.
claim.en: Eros fell in love with and married Psyche despite Aphrodite's opposition.

claims_provenance.quote: Eros was not himself immune to the powers of love, and he famously fell for and married Psyche against the wishes of his mother Aphrodite.

claim.id: Eros dipuja antara lain di Thespiae, Athena, dan Megara.
claim.en: Eros received cult worship at Thespiae, Athens, Megara, and other places.

claims_provenance.quote: In Greek religion, Eros was the subject of cult worship in Thespiae (with its sporting and artistic festival, the Erotidia) and at Athens, Megara, Philadelphia, Leuctra, Velia, and Parium.

claim.id: Dalam seni Yunani klasik, Eros lazim digambarkan sebagai pemuda bersayap.
claim.en: Classical art usually portrays Eros as a winged youth.

claims_provenance.quote: In Classical art he is usually represented as a beautiful winged youth.
claims_provenance.source_citation: The Metropolitan Museum of Art — Sleeping Eros

claim.id: Pada zaman Helenistik, gambaran Eros sebagai bayi mulai menonjol.
claim.en: In the Hellenistic period, depiction of Eros as a baby became common.

claims_provenance.quote: During the Hellenistic period (323–31 B.C.) a new image of the god as a baby took hold.
claims_provenance.source_citation: The Metropolitan Museum of Art — Sleeping Eros

claim.id: Cupid adalah padanan Romawi Eros.
claim.en: Cupid is the Roman counterpart of Eros.

claims_provenance.quote: Eros is the Greek god of love and Cupid is his Roman equivalent.

claim.id: Tanpa peringatan Eros memilih sasarannya dan menyerang hati mereka dengan keras, membawa kebingungan dan perasaan yang tak tertahankan.
claim.en: Eros picks his targets without warning and strikes their hearts, causing confusion and overwhelming feelings.

claims_provenance.quote: Without warning Eros selects his targets and forcefully strikes at their hearts, bringing confusion and irrepressible feelings.

claim.id: Dalam seni Yunani Eros paling sering digambarkan sebagai pemuda tampan yang riang, bermahkota bunga, terutama mawar yang erat dikaitkan dengan sang dewa.
claim.en: In Greek art Eros is most often shown as a carefree, beautiful youth crowned with flowers, especially roses, which were closely associated with him.

claims_provenance.quote: Eros is most often represented in Greek art as a carefree and beautiful youth, crowned with flowers, especially of roses which were closely associated with the god.

claim.id: Menurut Hesiod dalam Theogony, Eros adalah salah satu dewa purba yang bersama Chaos dan Gaia (Bumi) bertanggung jawab atas penciptaan.
claim.en: According to Hesiod's Theogony, Eros was one of the primeval gods who, with Chaos and Gaia (Earth), was responsible for the Creation.

claims_provenance.quote: According to Hesiod in his Theogony, Eros was one of the primaeval gods who, along with Chaos and Gaia (Earth), was responsible for the Creation.

claim.id: Dalam tradisi lain seperti kosmogoni Orfik, Eros lahir sebagai hermafrodit dari telur yang diletakkan Titan Chronos (Waktu) ke dalam rahim Chaos.
claim.en: In other traditions such as the Orphic cosmogonies, Eros is born a hermaphrodite from an egg put by the Titan Chronos (Time) into the womb of Chaos.

claims_provenance.quote: In other traditions, such as the Orphic cosmogonies, Eros is born a hermaphrodite from an egg which was put by the Titan Chronos (who represents Time) into the womb of Chaos.

claim.id: Penulis komedi Yunani Aristophanes (sekitar 460-380 SM) memakai gagasan serupa tetapi membuat Eros menetas dari telur perak yang dikeluarkan Nyx (Malam) dan Aither (Angin).
claim.en: The comic playwright Aristophanes (c. 460-c. 380 BCE) uses the same idea but has Eros hatch from a silver egg laid by Nyx (Night) and Aither (Wind).

claims_provenance.quote: The Greek comic playwright Aristophanes (c. 460 - c. 380 BCE) uses the same idea but has Eros hatch out from a silver egg laid by Nyx (Night) and Aither (Wind).

claim.id: Dalam beberapa tradisi, Eros punya adik bernama Anteros, sosok yang jauh lebih gelap dan pembalas cinta yang tak berbalas.
claim.en: In some traditions Eros had a younger brother, Anteros, a much darker figure and an avenger of unrequited love.

claims_provenance.quote: In some traditions, Eros also had a younger brother - Anteros - who was a much darker figure and an avenger of unrequited love.

claim.id: Dalam mitos Yunani, Eros terutama dikaitkan dengan kesuburan, hasrat, dan cinta seksual; karena gairah itu sulit dikendalikan, sang dewa dianggap semacam penipu yang licik.
claim.en: In Greek myth Eros was associated above all with fertility, desire and sexual love, and because such passions were hard to control he was considered something of a cunning trickster.

claims_provenance.quote: In the Greek myths, Eros was associated above all with fertility, desire and sexual love, and because such passions could prove very difficult to control, the god was considered something of a cunning trickster.

claim.id: Kadang sang dewa bermain-main dan jahil tanpa bahaya, tetapi di waktu lain ia kejam dengan serangan mendadak yang hanya membawa nafsu gegabah dan kebingungan.
claim.en: Sometimes the god is playful and harmlessly mischievous, but at other times cruel with surprise attacks that bring only reckless passion and confusion.

claims_provenance.quote: Sometimes the god is playful and harmlessly mischievous but at other times he is cruel with his surprise attacks that bring only reckless passion and confusion

claim.id: Menurut penulis sumber ini, kurangnya disiplin dan ketidakandalan Eros mungkin menjelaskan mengapa ia tak pernah dianggap salah satu dari 12 dewa Olimpus.
claim.en: According to the source, Eros's lack of discipline and general unreliability may explain why he was never counted among the 12 Olympian gods.

claims_provenance.quote: The lack of discipline and general unreliability of Eros may explain why he was never considered one of the 12 Olympian Gods.

claim.id: Eros juga dianggap pelindung khusus cinta sesama jenis.
claim.en: Eros was also considered the specific protector of homosexual love.

claims_provenance.quote: Finally, Eros was considered the specific protector of homosexual love.

claim.id: Salah satu kisah terkenal: Apollo mengejek kemampuan Eros memanah, lalu Eros menembakkan panah ke dewa besar itu sehingga ia jatuh cinta pada nimfa Daphne.
claim.en: In one famous episode Apollo ridiculed Eros's skill as an archer, and Eros shot one of his arrows at the great god, making him fall in love with the nymph Daphne.

claims_provenance.quote: One of the most famous episodes involving this trick was when Apollo ridiculed the skills of Eros as an archer and the latter fired one of his arrows at the great god, making him fall in love with the nymph Daphne.

claim.id: Contoh lain: Eros membuat Medea jatuh cinta pada pahlawan besar Jason, pengambil Bulu Domba Emas.
claim.en: Another instance: Eros made Medea fall in love with the great hero Jason, who seized the Golden Fleece.

claims_provenance.quote: Another such instance of Eros using his love-carrying arrows was when he made Medea fall in love with the great hero Jason, he who grabbed the Golden Fleece.

claim.id: Altar bagi Eros didirikan di Akademi Athena dan di gimnasium Elis.
claim.en: Altars to Eros were placed at the Academy of Athens and at the gymnasium at Elis.

claims_provenance.quote: Altars to Eros were placed at both the Academy of Athens and the gymnasium at Elis

claim.id: Dalam seni Yunani kuno sejak abad ke-6 SM, Eros biasanya digambarkan sebagai remaja bersayap yang sering membawa karangan bunga kemenangan.
claim.en: In ancient Greek art from the 6th century BCE Eros is usually depicted as a winged adolescent who often carries a victory wreath.

claims_provenance.quote: In ancient Greek art from the 6th century BCE, Eros is usually depicted as an adolescent with wings and he often carries a wreath of victory.
claims_provenance.locator: How is Eros Represented in Art?

claim.id: Eros baru sering digambarkan membawa busur sejak abad ke-4 SM, meski rujukan sastra pertamanya jauh lebih awal, dalam Iphigenia in Aulis karya Euripides (sekitar 406 SM).
claim.en: Eros is shown carrying a bow with any frequency only from the 4th century BCE, though the first literary reference is much earlier, in Euripides' Iphigenia in Aulis (c. 406 BCE).

claims_provenance.quote: Surprisingly, he is only depicted carrying a bow with any great frequency from the 4th century BCE, although the first literary reference is much earlier and found in the tragedian Euripides' Iphigenia in Aulis (c. 406 BCE).
claims_provenance.locator: How is Eros Represented in Art?

claim.id: Sosok Eros juga dapat muncul berdua atau bertiga, disebut Erotes, yang melambangkan berbagai bentuk cinta.
claim.en: Figures of Eros can also appear in twos or threes, called Erotes, symbolizing the different forms love can take.

claims_provenance.quote: Figures of Eros can also appear in twos or threes, when they are referred to as Erotes, symbolic of the different forms love can take.
claims_provenance.locator: How is Eros Represented in Art?

claim.id: Baru dalam seni Romawi kemudian Eros, dengan nama barunya Cupid, lazim digambarkan sebagai bayi montok dan jahil.
claim.en: Only in later Roman art is Eros, under his new name Cupid, commonly portrayed as a chubby, mischievous baby.

claims_provenance.quote: It is only in later Roman art that Eros, under his new name Cupid, is commonly portrayed rather unflatteringly as a chubby and mischievous baby.
claims_provenance.locator: How is Eros Represented in Art?

claim.id: Dalam Symposium karya Plato, tokoh yang berbicara menyebut Cinta sebagai dewa tertua, paling dihormati, dan paling berkuasa dalam membantu manusia meraih keutamaan dan kebahagiaan.
claim.en: In Plato's Symposium a speaker calls Love the most ancient of the gods, the most honoured, and the most powerful in helping men gain virtue and blessedness.

claims_provenance.quote: Therefore I say Love is the most ancient of the gods, the most honoured, and the most powerful in helping men gain virtue and blessedness.

claim.id: Eros juga hadir pada friso timur Parthenon, digambarkan sebagai anak di samping Aphrodite.
claim.en: Eros is also present on the east frieze of the Parthenon, shown as a child next to Aphrodite.

claims_provenance.quote: he is present, too, on the east frieze of the Parthenon, shown as a child next to Aphrodite.
claims_provenance.locator: How is Eros Represented in Art?

claim.id: Eros adalah daya pendorong lahirnya kehidupan baru di kosmos; kaum Orfik menamainya Phanes, makhluk purba yang menetas dari telur dunia.
claim.en: Eros was the driving force behind the generation of new life in the cosmos; the Orphics named him Phanes, a primal being hatched from the world-egg.

claims_provenance.quote: He was the driving force behind the generation of new life in the cosmos. The Orphics named him Phanes, a primal being hatched from the world-egg.

claim.id: Dalam Theogony, Eros adalah yang tertampan di antara para dewa abadi, yang melemahkan anggota tubuh dan menaklukkan pikiran serta nasihat bijak semua dewa dan manusia.
claim.en: In Hesiod's Theogony Eros is fairest among the deathless gods, who unnerves the limbs and overcomes the mind and wise counsels of all gods and all men.

claims_provenance.quote: and Eros (Love) [Procreation], fairest among the deathless gods, who unnerves the limbs and overcomes the mind and wise counsels of all gods and all men within them.
claims_provenance.locator: Eros & the Birth of the Cosmos

claim.id: Dalam Birds karya Aristophanes, Nyx bersayap hitam bertelur dalam kedalaman Erebos, dan setelah zaman-zaman panjang lahirlah Eros yang anggun dengan sayap emas berkilau.
claim.en: In Aristophanes' Birds black-winged Nyx lays an egg in the deeps of Erebos, and after long ages the graceful Eros springs from it with glittering golden wings.

claims_provenance.quote: Firstly, black-winged Nyx (Night) laid a germless egg in the bosom of the infinite deeps of Erebos (Darkness), and from this, after the revolution of long ages, sprang the graceful Eros [the primordial Eros] with his glittering golden wings
claims_provenance.locator: Eros & the Birth of the Cosmos

claim.id: Theoi mengartikan nama Eros sebagai "hasrat seksual".
claim.en: Theoi translates the name Eros as "sexual desire".

claims_provenance.quote: Translation Sexual Desire (eros)

claim.id: Dialah yang menyalakan api cinta di hati para dewa dan manusia, bersenjatakan busur dan panah atau obor menyala.
claim.en: It was he who lit the flame of love in the hearts of gods and men, armed with either a bow and arrows or a flaming torch.

claims_provenance.quote: It was he who lit the flame of love in the hearts of the gods and men, armed with either a bow and arrows or a flaming torch.
claims_provenance.source_citation: Theoi Project — Eros (Theoi Project: Eros God of Love)

claim.id: Eros sering digambarkan sebagai anak Aphrodite yang tidak penurut tetapi sangat setia.
claim.en: Eros was often portrayed as the disobedient but fiercely loyal child of Aphrodite.

claims_provenance.quote: Eros was often portrayed as the disobedient but fiercely loyal child of Aphrodite.
claims_provenance.source_citation: Theoi Project — Eros (Theoi Project: Eros God of Love)

claim.id: Dalam Metamorphoses karya Ovid, Eros memiliki dua panah berlawanan: satu membangkitkan cinta dengan ujung emas runcing, satu lagi mengusirnya dengan ujung timbal yang tumpul.
claim.en: In Ovid's Metamorphoses Eros has two opposing arrows: one rouses love with a piercing gold point, the other routs it with a blunt tip of lead.

claims_provenance.quote: one shaft that rouses love and one that routs it. The first gleams bright with piercing point of gold; the other, cull and blunt is tipped with lead.
claims_provenance.locator: Eros & the Loves of the Gods
claims_provenance.source_citation: Theoi Project — Eros (Theoi Project: Eros God of Love)

claim.id: Menurut Pausanias, kebanyakan orang menganggap Eros dewa termuda dan putra Aphrodite.
claim.en: According to Pausanias, most men consider Eros the youngest of the gods and the son of Aphrodite.

claims_provenance.quote: Most men consider Eros to be the youngest of the gods and the son of Aphrodite.
claims_provenance.source_citation: Theoi Project — Eros (Theoi Project: Eros God of Love)

claim.id: Menurut sebuah scholion, Alkaios menyebut Eros anak Iris dan Zephyros, sedangkan Sappho menjadikannya anak Aphrodite dan Ouranos.
claim.en: According to a scholion, Alcaeus said Eros was the child of Iris and Zephyros, while Sappho made him the child of Aphrodite and Ouranos.

claims_provenance.quote: Alkaios (Alcaeus) [Greek poet C6th B.C.] said Eros was the child of Iris (Rainbow) and Zephyros (West Wind); Sappho [Greek poet C6th B.C.] made him the child of Aphrodite and Ouranos (Uranus, Heaven).
claims_provenance.source_citation: Theoi Project — Eros (Theoi Project: Eros God of Love)

claim.id: Dalam Symposium, Eros dikandung (oleh Penia) dan, karena mencintai keindahan serta lahir pada hari ulang tahun Aphrodite, ia menjadi pengikut dan pelayannya.
claim.en: In the Symposium Eros is conceived (by Penia) and, being a lover of beauty and born on Aphrodite's birthday, becomes her follower and attendant.

claims_provenance.quote: conceived Eros (Love), who partly because he is naturally a lover of the beautiful, and because Aphrodite is herself beautiful, and also because he was born on her birthday, is her follower and attendant.
claims_provenance.source_citation: Theoi Project — Eros (Theoi Project: Eros God of Love)

claim.id: Menurut Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology, Eros menjinakkan singa dan harimau, mematahkan petir Zeus, merampas senjata Heracles, dan bermain dengan monster laut.
claim.en: According to the Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology, Eros tames lions and tigers, breaks Zeus's thunderbolts, deprives Heracles of his arms, and sports with sea monsters.

claims_provenance.quote: he tames lions and tigers, breaks the thunderbolts of Zeus, deprives Heracles of his arms, and carries on his sport with the monsters of the sea.
claims_provenance.source_citation: Theoi Project — Eros (Theoi Project: Eros God of Love)

claim.id: Hal-hal yang suci bagi Eros dan sering menyertainya dalam karya seni mencakup mawar, binatang buas yang ia jinakkan, kelinci, ayam jantan, dan domba jantan.
claim.en: Things sacred to Eros that often accompany him in art include the rose, wild beasts he tames, the hare, the cock, and the ram.

claims_provenance.quote: Among the things sacred to Eros, and which frequently appear with him in works of art, we may mention the rose, wild beasts which are tamed by him, the hare, the cock, and the ram.
claims_provenance.source_citation: Theoi Project — Eros (Theoi Project: Eros God of Love)

claim.id: Eros adalah subjek favorit para pematung kuno, dan penggambarannya tampaknya disempurnakan oleh Praxiteles, yang membayangkannya sebagai pemuda dewasa berparas paling sempurna.
claim.en: Eros was a favourite subject of ancient sculptors, and his image seems to have been perfected by Praxiteles, who conceived him as a full-grown youth of perfect beauty.

claims_provenance.quote: Eros was a favourite subject with the ancient statuaries, but his representation seems to have been brought to perfection by Praxiteles, who conceived him as a full-grown youth of the most perfect beauty.
claims_provenance.source_citation: Theoi Project — Eros (Theoi Project: Eros God of Love)

claim.id: Homer tidak menyebut Eros; Hesiod, penulis paling awal yang menyebutnya, menggambarkannya sebagai Eros kosmogonik.
claim.en: Homer does not mention Eros; Hesiod, the earliest author to mention him, describes him as the cosmogonic Eros.

claims_provenance.quote: Homer does not mention Eros, and Hesiod, the earliest author that mentions him, describes him as the cosmogonic Eros.

text.id: Hesiod adalah penulis paling awal yang menyebutnya; dalam seni Yunani ia digambarkan sejak abad ke-6 SM.
text.en: Hesiod is the earliest author to mention him; in Greek art he is depicted from the 6th century BCE.

short_description.id: Eros adalah dewa cinta dan hasrat dalam mitologi Yunani, digambarkan sebagai dewa purba penciptaan atau sebagai putra Aphrodite yang bersenjata busur dan panah.
short_description.en: Eros is the Greek god of love and desire, portrayed either as a primordial god of creation or as Aphrodite's son armed with bow and arrows.

long_description.id: Eros adalah dewa cinta Yunani, lebih tepatnya hasrat yang bergairah dan jasmani. Menurut Hesiod ia salah satu dewa purba yang bersama Chaos dan Gaia bertanggung jawab atas penciptaan; sumber lain menyebutnya dewa purba prokreasi yang muncul dengan sendirinya, dan kaum Orfik menamainya Phanes. Dalam tradisi lain ia lahir dari telur: kosmogoni Orfik menyebutnya hermafrodit dari telur yang diletakkan Chronos, dan Aristophanes memakai gagasan serupa dengan telur perak yang dikeluarkan Nyx dan Aither.
long_description.en: Eros was the Greek god of love, specifically the kind of desire that is passionate and bodily. According to Hesiod he was one of the primeval gods who, with Chaos and Gaia, was responsible for the Creation; another source calls him the primordial god of procreation who emerged self-formed, and the Orphics named him Phanes. In other traditions he is born from an egg: the Orphic cosmogonies make him a hermaphrodite from an egg put by Chronos, and Aristophanes uses a similar idea with a silver egg laid by Nyx and Aither.

long_description.id: Eros yang lebih muda adalah putra Aphrodite, anak nakal yang bersenjata busur dan panah; dalam satu silsilah ayahnya adalah Ares. Tradisi lain memberinya orang tua berbeda, misalnya Iris dan Zephyros, atau Aphrodite dan Ouranos. Ia sering digambarkan sebagai anak Aphrodite yang tidak penurut tetapi sangat setia, dan dalam beberapa tradisi ia punya adik bernama Anteros, sosok lebih gelap yang membalas cinta tak berbalas.
long_description.en: The younger Eros is the son of Aphrodite, a mischievous godling armed with bow and arrows; in one genealogy his father is Ares. Other traditions give him different parents, such as Iris and Zephyros, or Aphrodite and Ouranos. He is often portrayed as Aphrodite's disobedient but fiercely loyal child, and in some traditions he has a younger brother, Anteros, a darker figure who avenges unrequited love.

long_description.id: Eros memilih sasarannya tanpa peringatan dan menyerang hati mereka, membawa kebingungan dan perasaan yang tak tertahankan. Panah Eros dikisahkan membuat manusia, pahlawan, dan dewa jatuh cinta, dan tak seorang pun kebal. Dalam satu kisah ia memiliki dua panah berlawanan: ujung emas membangkitkan cinta, ujung timbal yang tumpul menolaknya. Ia membuat Apollo jatuh cinta pada Daphne dan Medea pada Jason. Ia sendiri tidak kebal: ia jatuh cinta dan menikahi Psyche meski ditentang Aphrodite. Satu sumber menyebutnya menjinakkan singa dan harimau, mematahkan petir Zeus, dan merampas senjata Heracles; dalam kisah lain ia dan Aphrodite berubah menjadi ikan untuk lolos dari Typhon.
long_description.en: Eros picks his targets without warning and strikes at their hearts, bringing confusion and irrepressible feelings. Eros's arrows were said to make humans, heroes, and gods fall in love, and no one was immune. In one tale he holds two opposing arrows: a gold point rouses love and a blunt point of lead routs it. He made Apollo fall in love with Daphne and Medea with Jason. He was not himself immune: he fell for and married Psyche against Aphrodite's wishes. One source says he tames lions and tigers, breaks Zeus's thunderbolts, and deprives Heracles of his arms; in another tale he and Aphrodite turned into fishes to escape Typhon.

long_description.id: Eros menerima pemujaan di Thespiae (dengan festival Erotidia), Athena, Megara, Philadelphia, Leuctra, Velia, dan Parium, dan altarnya ada di Akademi Athena serta gimnasium Elis. Dalam seni Yunani ia paling sering digambarkan sebagai pemuda tampan yang riang, bermahkota bunga, terutama mawar. Sejak abad ke-6 SM ia biasanya remaja bersayap yang sering membawa karangan bunga kemenangan, dan kadang muncul berdua atau bertiga sebagai Erotes, lambang berbagai bentuk cinta; ia baru sering membawa busur sejak abad ke-4 SM. Seni klasik menampilkannya sebagai pemuda bersayap, seni Helenistik juga sebagai bayi, dan dalam seni Romawi kemudian, dengan nama Cupid, sebagai bayi montok. Praxiteles dikatakan menyempurnakan citranya sebagai pemuda dewasa yang sangat rupawan.
long_description.en: Eros received cult worship at Thespiae (with its Erotidia festival), Athens, Megara, Philadelphia, Leuctra, Velia, and Parium, and had altars at the Academy of Athens and the gymnasium at Elis. In Greek art he is most often a carefree, beautiful youth crowned with flowers, especially roses. From the 6th century BCE he is usually a winged adolescent often carrying a victory wreath, and he sometimes appears in twos or threes as Erotes, symbolizing the different forms of love; he is shown with a bow with any frequency only from the 4th century BCE. Classical art shows him as a winged youth, Hellenistic art also as a baby, and later Roman art, under the name Cupid, as a chubby baby. Praxiteles is said to have perfected his image as a full-grown youth of great beauty.

long_description.id: Mitos Yunani mengaitkan Eros terutama dengan kesuburan, hasrat, dan cinta seksual, dan karena gairah itu sulit dikendalikan, ia dianggap semacam penipu yang licik: kadang jahil tanpa bahaya, kadang kejam dengan serangan mendadak. Ia tidak pernah dianggap salah satu dari 12 dewa Olimpus, dan dianggap pelindung khusus cinta sesama jenis. Dalam salah satu dialog filsafat Yunani, seorang pembicara menyebut Cinta sebagai dewa tertua. Hal-hal yang suci baginya dan sering menyertainya dalam seni mencakup mawar, binatang buas yang dijinakkan, kelinci, ayam jantan, dan domba jantan. Padanannya dalam tradisi Romawi adalah Cupid.
long_description.en: Myths tied Eros chiefly to fertility, desire and sexual love, and since such passions were hard to master he was seen as something of a cunning trickster: sometimes harmlessly mischievous, sometimes cruel in his surprise attacks. He was never counted among the 12 Olympian gods, and was seen as the particular protector of homosexual love. One speaker in a Greek philosophical dialogue calls Love the most ancient of the gods. Things sacred to him that often accompany him in art include the rose, tamed wild beasts, the hare, the cock, and the ram. His Roman counterpart is Cupid.

cultural_context.id: Menurut sumbernya, kurangnya disiplin dan ketidakandalan Eros mungkin menjelaskan mengapa ia tak pernah dianggap salah satu dari 12 dewa Olimpus; ia juga dianggap pelindung khusus cinta sesama jenis.
cultural_context.en: According to the source, Eros's lack of discipline and unreliability may explain why he was never counted among the 12 Olympian gods; he was also considered the specific protector of homosexual love.

claims.quote: The Greek comic playwright Aristophanes (c. 460 - c. 380 BCE) uses the same idea but has Eros hatch out from a silver egg laid by Nyx (Night) and Aither (Wind).

statement.id: Penulis komedi Yunani Aristophanes (sekitar 460-380 SM) memakai gagasan serupa tetapi membuat Eros menetas dari telur perak yang dikeluarkan Nyx (Malam) dan Aither (Angin).
statement.en: The comic playwright Aristophanes (c. 460-c. 380 BCE) uses the same idea but has Eros hatch from a silver egg laid by Nyx (Night) and Aither (Wind).

claims.quote: In some traditions, Eros also had a younger brother - Anteros - who was a much darker figure and an avenger of unrequited love.

statement.id: Dalam beberapa tradisi, Eros punya adik bernama Anteros, sosok yang jauh lebih gelap dan pembalas cinta yang tak berbalas.
statement.en: In some traditions Eros had a younger brother, Anteros, a much darker figure and an avenger of unrequited love.

claims.quote: In the Greek myths, Eros was associated above all with fertility, desire and sexual love, and because such passions could prove very difficult to control, the god was considered something of a cunning trickster.

statement.id: Dalam mitos Yunani, Eros terutama dikaitkan dengan kesuburan, hasrat, dan cinta seksual; karena gairah itu sulit dikendalikan, sang dewa dianggap semacam penipu yang licik.
statement.en: In Greek myth Eros was associated above all with fertility, desire and sexual love, and because such passions were hard to control he was considered something of a cunning trickster.

claims.quote: Sometimes the god is playful and harmlessly mischievous but at other times he is cruel with his surprise attacks that bring only reckless passion and confusion

statement.id: Kadang sang dewa bermain-main dan jahil tanpa bahaya, tetapi di waktu lain ia kejam dengan serangan mendadak yang hanya membawa nafsu gegabah dan kebingungan.
statement.en: Sometimes the god is playful and harmlessly mischievous, but at other times cruel with surprise attacks that bring only reckless passion and confusion.

claims.quote: The lack of discipline and general unreliability of Eros may explain why he was never considered one of the 12 Olympian Gods.

statement.id: Menurut penulis sumber ini, kurangnya disiplin dan ketidakandalan Eros mungkin menjelaskan mengapa ia tak pernah dianggap salah satu dari 12 dewa Olimpus.
statement.en: According to the source, Eros's lack of discipline and general unreliability may explain why he was never counted among the 12 Olympian gods.

claims.quote: Finally, Eros was considered the specific protector of homosexual love.

statement.id: Eros juga dianggap pelindung khusus cinta sesama jenis.
statement.en: Eros was also considered the specific protector of homosexual love.

claims.quote: One of the most famous episodes involving this trick was when Apollo ridiculed the skills of Eros as an archer and the latter fired one of his arrows at the great god, making him fall in love with the nymph Daphne.

statement.id: Salah satu kisah terkenal: Apollo mengejek kemampuan Eros memanah, lalu Eros menembakkan panah ke dewa besar itu sehingga ia jatuh cinta pada nimfa Daphne.
statement.en: In one famous episode Apollo ridiculed Eros's skill as an archer, and Eros shot one of his arrows at the great god, making him fall in love with the nymph Daphne.

claims.quote: Another such instance of Eros using his love-carrying arrows was when he made Medea fall in love with the great hero Jason, he who grabbed the Golden Fleece.

statement.id: Contoh lain: Eros membuat Medea jatuh cinta pada pahlawan besar Jason, pengambil Bulu Domba Emas.
statement.en: Another instance: Eros made Medea fall in love with the great hero Jason, who seized the Golden Fleece.

claims.quote: Altars to Eros were placed at both the Academy of Athens and the gymnasium at Elis

statement.id: Altar bagi Eros didirikan di Akademi Athena dan di gimnasium Elis.
statement.en: Altars to Eros were placed at the Academy of Athens and at the gymnasium at Elis.

claims.quote: In ancient Greek art from the 6th century BCE, Eros is usually depicted as an adolescent with wings and he often carries a wreath of victory.
claims.locator: How is Eros Represented in Art?

statement.id: Dalam seni Yunani kuno sejak abad ke-6 SM, Eros biasanya digambarkan sebagai remaja bersayap yang sering membawa karangan bunga kemenangan.
statement.en: In ancient Greek art from the 6th century BCE Eros is usually depicted as a winged adolescent who often carries a victory wreath.

claims.quote: Surprisingly, he is only depicted carrying a bow with any great frequency from the 4th century BCE, although the first literary reference is much earlier and found in the tragedian Euripides' Iphigenia in Aulis (c. 406 BCE).
claims.locator: How is Eros Represented in Art?

statement.id: Eros baru sering digambarkan membawa busur sejak abad ke-4 SM, meski rujukan sastra pertamanya jauh lebih awal, dalam Iphigenia in Aulis karya Euripides (sekitar 406 SM).
statement.en: Eros is shown carrying a bow with any frequency only from the 4th century BCE, though the first literary reference is much earlier, in Euripides' Iphigenia in Aulis (c. 406 BCE).

claims.quote: Figures of Eros can also appear in twos or threes, when they are referred to as Erotes, symbolic of the different forms love can take.
claims.locator: How is Eros Represented in Art?

statement.id: Sosok Eros juga dapat muncul berdua atau bertiga, disebut Erotes, yang melambangkan berbagai bentuk cinta.
statement.en: Figures of Eros can also appear in twos or threes, called Erotes, symbolizing the different forms love can take.

claims.quote: It is only in later Roman art that Eros, under his new name Cupid, is commonly portrayed rather unflatteringly as a chubby and mischievous baby.
claims.locator: How is Eros Represented in Art?

statement.id: Baru dalam seni Romawi kemudian Eros, dengan nama barunya Cupid, lazim digambarkan sebagai bayi montok dan jahil.
statement.en: Only in later Roman art is Eros, under his new name Cupid, commonly portrayed as a chubby, mischievous baby.

claims.quote: Therefore I say Love is the most ancient of the gods, the most honoured, and the most powerful in helping men gain virtue and blessedness.

statement.id: Dalam Symposium karya Plato, tokoh yang berbicara menyebut Cinta sebagai dewa tertua, paling dihormati, dan paling berkuasa dalam membantu manusia meraih keutamaan dan kebahagiaan.
statement.en: In Plato's Symposium a speaker calls Love the most ancient of the gods, the most honoured, and the most powerful in helping men gain virtue and blessedness.

claims.quote: he is present, too, on the east frieze of the Parthenon, shown as a child next to Aphrodite.
claims.locator: How is Eros Represented in Art?

statement.id: Eros juga hadir pada friso timur Parthenon, digambarkan sebagai anak di samping Aphrodite.
statement.en: Eros is also present on the east frieze of the Parthenon, shown as a child next to Aphrodite.

claims.quote: He was the driving force behind the generation of new life in the cosmos. The Orphics named him Phanes, a primal being hatched from the world-egg.

statement.id: Eros adalah daya pendorong lahirnya kehidupan baru di kosmos; kaum Orfik menamainya Phanes, makhluk purba yang menetas dari telur dunia.
statement.en: Eros was the driving force behind the generation of new life in the cosmos; the Orphics named him Phanes, a primal being hatched from the world-egg.

claims.quote: and Eros (Love) [Procreation], fairest among the deathless gods, who unnerves the limbs and overcomes the mind and wise counsels of all gods and all men within them.
claims.locator: Eros & the Birth of the Cosmos

statement.id: Dalam Theogony, Eros adalah yang tertampan di antara para dewa abadi, yang melemahkan anggota tubuh dan menaklukkan pikiran serta nasihat bijak semua dewa dan manusia.
statement.en: In Hesiod's Theogony Eros is fairest among the deathless gods, who unnerves the limbs and overcomes the mind and wise counsels of all gods and all men.

claims.quote: Firstly, black-winged Nyx (Night) laid a germless egg in the bosom of the infinite deeps of Erebos (Darkness), and from this, after the revolution of long ages, sprang the graceful Eros [the primordial Eros] with his glittering golden wings
claims.locator: Eros & the Birth of the Cosmos

statement.id: Dalam Birds karya Aristophanes, Nyx bersayap hitam bertelur dalam kedalaman Erebos, dan setelah zaman-zaman panjang lahirlah Eros yang anggun dengan sayap emas berkilau.
statement.en: In Aristophanes' Birds black-winged Nyx lays an egg in the deeps of Erebos, and after long ages the graceful Eros springs from it with glittering golden wings.

claims.quote: Translation Sexual Desire (eros)

statement.id: Theoi mengartikan nama Eros sebagai "hasrat seksual".
statement.en: Theoi translates the name Eros as "sexual desire".

claims.quote: It was he who lit the flame of love in the hearts of the gods and men, armed with either a bow and arrows or a flaming torch.

statement.id: Dialah yang menyalakan api cinta di hati para dewa dan manusia, bersenjatakan busur dan panah atau obor menyala.
statement.en: It was he who lit the flame of love in the hearts of gods and men, armed with either a bow and arrows or a flaming torch.

claims.quote: Eros was often portrayed as the disobedient but fiercely loyal child of Aphrodite.

statement.id: Eros sering digambarkan sebagai anak Aphrodite yang tidak penurut tetapi sangat setia.
statement.en: Eros was often portrayed as the disobedient but fiercely loyal child of Aphrodite.

claims.quote: one shaft that rouses love and one that routs it. The first gleams bright with piercing point of gold; the other, cull and blunt is tipped with lead.
claims.locator: Eros & the Loves of the Gods

statement.id: Dalam Metamorphoses karya Ovid, Eros memiliki dua panah berlawanan: satu membangkitkan cinta dengan ujung emas runcing, satu lagi mengusirnya dengan ujung timbal yang tumpul.
statement.en: In Ovid's Metamorphoses Eros has two opposing arrows: one rouses love with a piercing gold point, the other routs it with a blunt tip of lead.

claims.quote: Most men consider Eros to be the youngest of the gods and the son of Aphrodite.

statement.id: Menurut Pausanias, kebanyakan orang menganggap Eros dewa termuda dan putra Aphrodite.
statement.en: According to Pausanias, most men consider Eros the youngest of the gods and the son of Aphrodite.

claims.quote: Alkaios (Alcaeus) [Greek poet C6th B.C.] said Eros was the child of Iris (Rainbow) and Zephyros (West Wind); Sappho [Greek poet C6th B.C.] made him the child of Aphrodite and Ouranos (Uranus, Heaven).

statement.id: Menurut sebuah scholion, Alkaios menyebut Eros anak Iris dan Zephyros, sedangkan Sappho menjadikannya anak Aphrodite dan Ouranos.
statement.en: According to a scholion, Alcaeus said Eros was the child of Iris and Zephyros, while Sappho made him the child of Aphrodite and Ouranos.

claims.quote: conceived Eros (Love), who partly because he is naturally a lover of the beautiful, and because Aphrodite is herself beautiful, and also because he was born on her birthday, is her follower and attendant.

statement.id: Dalam Symposium, Eros dikandung (oleh Penia) dan, karena mencintai keindahan serta lahir pada hari ulang tahun Aphrodite, ia menjadi pengikut dan pelayannya.
statement.en: In the Symposium Eros is conceived (by Penia) and, being a lover of beauty and born on Aphrodite's birthday, becomes her follower and attendant.

claims.quote: he tames lions and tigers, breaks the thunderbolts of Zeus, deprives Heracles of his arms, and carries on his sport with the monsters of the sea.

statement.id: Menurut Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology, Eros menjinakkan singa dan harimau, mematahkan petir Zeus, merampas senjata Heracles, dan bermain dengan monster laut.
statement.en: According to the Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology, Eros tames lions and tigers, breaks Zeus's thunderbolts, deprives Heracles of his arms, and sports with sea monsters.

claims.quote: Among the things sacred to Eros, and which frequently appear with him in works of art, we may mention the rose, wild beasts which are tamed by him, the hare, the cock, and the ram.

statement.id: Hal-hal yang suci bagi Eros dan sering menyertainya dalam karya seni mencakup mawar, binatang buas yang ia jinakkan, kelinci, ayam jantan, dan domba jantan.
statement.en: Things sacred to Eros that often accompany him in art include the rose, wild beasts he tames, the hare, the cock, and the ram.

claims.quote: Eros was a favourite subject with the ancient statuaries, but his representation seems to have been brought to perfection by Praxiteles, who conceived him as a full-grown youth of the most perfect beauty.

statement.id: Eros adalah subjek favorit para pematung kuno, dan penggambarannya tampaknya disempurnakan oleh Praxiteles, yang membayangkannya sebagai pemuda dewasa berparas paling sempurna.
statement.en: Eros was a favourite subject of ancient sculptors, and his image seems to have been perfected by Praxiteles, who conceived him as a full-grown youth of perfect beauty.

claims.quote: Homer does not mention Eros, and Hesiod, the earliest author that mentions him, describes him as the cosmogonic Eros.

statement.id: Homer tidak menyebut Eros; Hesiod, penulis paling awal yang menyebutnya, menggambarkannya sebagai Eros kosmogonik.
statement.en: Homer does not mention Eros; Hesiod, the earliest author to mention him, describes him as the cosmogonic Eros.

claims.quote: once Venus [Aphrodite] and her son Cupid [Eros] came in Syria to the river Euphrates. There Typhon [Typhoeus], of whom we have already spoken, suddenly appeared. Venus [Aphrodite] and her son threw themselves into the river and there changed their forms to fishes, and by so doing this escaped danger.

statement.id: Dalam kisah Hyginus, ketika Typhon muncul di tepi Efrat, Venus (Aphrodite) dan putranya Cupid (Eros) terjun ke sungai dan berubah wujud menjadi ikan sehingga selamat.
statement.en: In Hyginus's tale, when Typhon appeared at the Euphrates, Venus (Aphrodite) and her son Cupid (Eros) threw themselves into the river and changed into fishes, escaping danger.

claims.quote: Once, when Venus' [Aphrodite's] son [Eros] was kissing her, his quiver dangling down, a jutting arrow, unbeknown, had grazed her breast.
claims.locator: Eros & the Loves of the Gods

statement.id: Dalam Metamorphoses karya Ovid, ketika Eros mencium ibunya, sebuah panah dari tabungnya tanpa sengaja menggores dada Aphrodite.
statement.en: In Ovid's Metamorphoses, as Eros kissed his mother, an arrow from his quiver unknowingly grazed Aphrodite's breast.

claims.quote: Eros (Love), and comely Himeros (Desire) followed her [Aphrodite] at her birth at the first and as she went into the assembly of the gods.

statement.id: Dalam Theogony, Eros dan Himeros (Hasrat) mengikuti Aphrodite sejak kelahirannya dan ketika ia memasuki majelis para dewa.
statement.en: In Hesiod's Theogony Eros and comely Himeros (Desire) followed Aphrodite at her birth and as she went into the assembly of the gods.

claims.quote: [When the monster Typhoeus besieged Olympos :] ... for bold Eros has flown in panic, leaving behind his generative arrows

statement.id: Dalam Dionysiaca karya Nonnus, ketika Typhoeus mengepung Olimpus, Eros yang berani lari panik dengan meninggalkan panah-panahnya.
statement.en: In Nonnus's Dionysiaca, when Typhoeus besieged Olympos, bold Eros fled in panic, leaving his arrows behind.

claims.quote: Sprung as I am from Zeus, I have never felt the arrows of the Boy [i.e. Eros], and of love-charms I know nothing.
claims.locator: Eros & the Loves of the Gods

statement.id: Dalam Argonautica karya Apollonius, Athena menyatakan bahwa ia, yang lahir dari Zeus, tak pernah merasakan panah sang Anak (Eros).
statement.en: In Apollonius's Argonautica, Athena says that, sprung from Zeus, she has never felt the arrows of the Boy (Eros).

claims.quote: OFFSPRING [1.1] HEDONE (by Psykhe) (Apuleius 6.24)

statement.id: Theoi mencatat Hedone sebagai anak Eros dan Psyche menurut Apuleius.
statement.en: Theoi lists Hedone as Eros's offspring by Psyche, citing Apuleius.

claims.quote: The scene was particular popular in ancient art where the godlings flutter about the goddess as she reclines inside a conch-shell.

statement.id: Adegan Eros dan Himeros mengiringi Aphrodite sangat populer dalam seni kuno; para dewa kecil itu beterbangan di sekitar sang dewi yang bersandar dalam cangkang kerang.
statement.en: The scene of Eros and Himeros accompanying Aphrodite was particularly popular in ancient art, the godlings fluttering about the goddess reclining in a conch-shell.

summary.id: Eros muncul pada awal penciptaan.
summary.en: Eros emerged at the dawn of creation.

summary.id: Eros muda adalah putra Aphrodite.
summary.en: The younger Eros is Aphrodite's son.

summary.id: Dalam kosmogoni Orfik, Eros lahir sebagai hermafrodit dari telur yang diletakkan Chronos.
summary.en: In the Orphic cosmogonies Eros is born a hermaphrodite from an egg put by Chronos.

summary.id: Putra Aphrodite dan Ares.
summary.en: Son of Aphrodite and Ares.

summary.id: Anak Iris dan Zephyros menurut Alkaios.
summary.en: Child of Iris and Zephyros according to Alcaeus.

summary.id: Anak Aphrodite dan Ouranos menurut Sappho.
summary.en: Child of Aphrodite and Ouranos according to Sappho.

summary.id: Dalam Symposium, dikandung oleh Penia dan lahir pada hari ulang tahun Aphrodite.
summary.en: In the Symposium, conceived by Penia and born on Aphrodite's birthday.

summary.id: Satu sumber: Eros menetas dari telur perak yang dikeluarkan Nyx dan Aither.
summary.en: One source: Eros hatches from a silver egg laid by Nyx and Aither.

summary.id: Teks Birds yang dikutip sumber lain: Nyx bertelur di kedalaman Erebos dan dari telur itu lahir Eros.
summary.en: The text of Birds quoted by another source: Nyx lays an egg in the deeps of Erebos and Eros springs from it.

short_description.id: Hanuman adalah dewa berwujud kera dalam mitologi India, pendamping setia Rama yang terkenal karena kekuatan, kecepatan, kemampuan mengubah wujud, dan baktinya.
short_description.en: Hanuman is a monkey-bodied deity of Indian mythology, Rama's devoted companion known for strength, speed, shape-changing and devotion.

long_description.id:
Hanuman adalah satu-satunya tokoh berwujud hewan sepenuhnya yang dipuja sebagai dewa di India masa kini. Teks mitos menyebutnya anak kera Dewa Angin yang sangat kuat, cerdas, dan menguasai Weda; ia pengikut Rama yang tak ragu dan dapat mengambil rupa apa pun. Dari ayahnya ia mewarisi kekuatan dan kecepatan, dan ia dapat membesar atau mengecil sesuka hati. Epos menggambarkannya berwajah menyenangkan, berbicara santun, dan menguasai tiga Weda.

Dalam Ramayana, Hanuman terbang melintasi samudra, menemukan tempat Sita ditawan, dan menyampaikannya kepada Rama. Di benteng Rahwana ia membakar seluruh tempat itu dan memperingatkan Rahwana. Dalam pertempuran, ia membunuh beberapa jenderal iblis, menghidupkan kembali saudara Rama, dan karena tak mengenali ramuan yang diminta, ia mencabut seluruh gunung dan membawanya ke medan perang. Pasukan kera itu membantu Rama membangun jembatan menyeberangi laut dan menyerbu benteng iblis. Terjemahan Griffith memuat bayangannya yang meluncur di atas samudra seperti kapal diterpa angin saat ia melompat.

Menurut Purana, Hanuman adalah anak Dewa Angin dan putri Anjana, lahir dari aspek Shiva melalui perantaraan Dewa Angin. Saat bayi ia menyangka matahari buah matang dan melompat untuk menyambarnya; petir sang raja dewa mengenai dagunya, dan dari sinilah namanya berasal. Dalam terjemahan Griffith, Dewa Angin berjanji bahwa anaknya akan kuat, berani, dan bijak. Surya mengajarinya Weda. Dalam Mahabharata, Bhima tak sanggup menggeser ekor seekor kera tua yang ternyata Hanuman, yang kemudian setuju tinggal di bendera kereta Arjuna.

Hanuman dihormati di seluruh India karena kerendahan hati dan kesetiaannya, dan pemujanya percaya memuja Hanuman memberi tenaga fisik, keberanian, dan pencerahan batin. Jimat bergambar Hanuman dipercaya melindungi pemakainya. Kuil kecil Hanuman umum ditemukan di kantor polisi dan klub gulat; ia paling sering digambarkan dengan gada, dan dikenal pula di Indonesia, Thailand, dan Malaysia. Hanuman Chalisa karya Tulsidas masih dilantunkan ribuan orang dan memuliakan kekuatan, bakti, selibat, dan kebenaran.
long_description.en:
Hanuman is the only wholly animal figure revered as a god in India today. Mythic texts describe him as the very strong, keen-minded monkey child of the Wind God, learned in the Vedas; he is Rama's unquestioning devotee and can take on any form. From his father he inherits might and speed, and he can grow or shrink at will. The epic describes him as pleasant of face, courteous in speech and learned in the three Vedas.

In the Ramayana, Hanuman flies across the ocean, finds where Sita is imprisoned and brings word to Rama. Inside Ravana's fort he sets the whole place on fire and warns Ravana. In the battle he kills several demon generals, brings Rama's brother back to life, and, unable to identify the herbs required, uproots a whole mountain and carries it to the battlefield. The monkey army helped Rama build a bridge across the sea and storm the demon stronghold. Griffith's translation describes his shadow flying over the ocean like a ship before the gale as he leaps.

The Puranas make Hanuman the offspring of the Wind God and the princess Anjana, born from an aspect of Shiva through the Wind God's agency. As an infant he mistook the sun for a ripe fruit and leapt to grab it; the thunderbolt of the king of the gods struck his chin, and his name comes from this. In Griffith's translation the Wind God promises that his child will be strong, brave and wise. Surya taught him the Vedas. In the Mahabharata, Bhima cannot move the tail of an old monkey who proves to be Hanuman, who later agrees to reside on Arjuna's chariot flag.

Hanuman is venerated across India for his humility and loyalty, and devotees believe that worshipping him brings physical energy, fearlessness and mental enlightenment. Amulets bearing his image are believed to protect the wearer. Small shrines to him are common in police stations and wrestling clubs; he is most often depicted with a mace, and is also known in Indonesia, Thailand and Malaysia. Tulsidas's Hanuman Chalisa is still recited by thousands and celebrates strength, devotion, celibacy and righteousness.

literal_meaning.id: Menurut satu kisah, hanu berarti "dagu" dan man berarti "memiliki"; Hanuman berarti "yang berdagu [patah]".
literal_meaning.en: According to one story, hanu means "chin" and man "having"; Hanuman means "he of the [broken] chin".

who.id: Hanuman adalah dewa berwujud kera yang dipuja di India.
who.en: Hanuman is a monkey-formed deity revered in India.

origin.id: Ia berasal dari mitologi India; Purana menyebutnya anak Dewa Angin dan Anjana.
origin.en: He comes from Indian mythology; the Puranas call him the child of the Wind God and Anjana.

role.id: Ia pengikut setia Rama dalam Ramayana yang mencari Sita dan ikut berperang melawan Rahwana.
role.en: He is Rama's devoted follower in the Ramayana, who searches for Sita and fights Ravana.

famous_for.id: Ia terkenal karena bakti, kekuatan, dan lompatannya melintasi samudra untuk menemukan Sita.
famous_for.en: He is famous for devotion, strength and his flight across the ocean to find Sita.

did_you_know.id: Menurut Purana, Hanuman mengira matahari adalah buah matang dan melompat untuk menyambarnya.
did_you_know.en: According to the Puranas, Hanuman mistook the sun for a ripe fruit and leapt up to grab it.

description.id: Hanuman terbang melintasi samudra untuk menemukan Sita dan terbang ke utara dengan kecepatan kilat ke Himalaya.
description.en: Hanuman flies across the ocean to find Sita and flies north at lightning speed to the Himalayas.

description.id: Hanuman dapat mengambil rupa apa pun dan memperbesar atau memperkecil tubuhnya sesuka hati; dalam terjemahan Griffith ia berdiri dengan ukuran raksasa di depan mata mereka.
description.en: Hanuman can take any form and increase or decrease his body size at will; in Griffith's translation he stands dilated in gigantic size before their eyes.

description.id: Hanuman memiliki kekuatan sangat besar dan mewarisi tenaga serta kecepatan dari Dewa Angin; ia mencabut seluruh gunung dan Bhima tak mampu menggeser ekornya.
description.en: Hanuman has enormous strength and inherits might and speed from the Wind God; he uproots a whole mountain and Bhima cannot move his tail.

description.id: Dalam terjemahan Griffith, Brahmá menganugerahkan bahwa tak seorang pun boleh membunuh putra Dewa Angin dengan baja dalam pertempuran, dan Indra bersumpah petirnya tak akan melukainya.
description.en: In Griffith's translation Brahmá grants that none should slay the Wind-God's son with steel in battle, and Indra swears his bolt shall never injure him.

description.id: Dalam pidatonya Hanumán mengaku dapat mengelilingi Meru seribu kali dengan lompatan dan melesat lebih cepat daripada Raja Burung.
description.en: In his speech Hanumán claims he can circle Meru a thousand times with leaps and spring faster than the feathered King.

summary.id: Hanuman terbang melintasi samudra untuk menemukan tempat Sita ditawan dan menyampaikannya kepada Rama; dalam terjemahan Griffith bayangannya meluncur seperti kapal diterpa angin.
summary.en: Hanuman flies across the ocean to find where Sita is held and brings word to Rama; in Griffith's translation his shadow flies like a ship before the gale.

summary.id: Hanuman membakar seluruh benteng iblis dan memperingatkan Rahwana tentang serangan jika Sita tidak dikembalikan.
summary.en: Hanuman sets the whole demon fort on fire and warns Ravana of an attack unless Sita is returned.

summary.id: Karena tak mengenali empat ramuan yang diminta tabib, Hanuman mencabut seluruh gunung dan membawanya ke medan perang; saudara Rama pun hidup kembali.

summary.en: The infant Hanuman mistook the sun for a ripe fruit and leapt to grab it; the king of the gods' thunderbolt struck his chin and he came to be called Hanuman.
