statement.en: The temple fell into disrepair and was rebuilt during the reign of Emperor Augustus.

claims.quote: His festival, the Saturnalia, was celebrated in December from the 17th to the 23rd and was connected to the winter grain sowing.

statement.id: Saturnalia dirayakan pada Desember dari tanggal 17 sampai 23 dan dikaitkan dengan penaburan biji-bijian musim dingin.
statement.en: The Saturnalia was celebrated in December from the 17th to the 23rd and was connected to the winter grain sowing.

claims.quote: His festival, the Saturnalia, was celebrated in December from the 17th to the 23rd ... As part of the calendar of Numa, the second king of Rome, the festival immediately preceded the festival of Ops, Saturn's partner or consort and the goddess of the harvest - she became associated with the Greek goddess Rhea.

statement.id: Saturnalia langsung mendahului perayaan Ops, pasangan Saturnus dan dewi panen, yang dikaitkan dengan dewi Yunani Rhea.
statement.en: The Saturnalia immediately preceded the festival of Ops, Saturn's partner or consort and the goddess of the harvest, who became associated with the Greek goddess Rhea.

claims.quote: Presiding over the festival was a mock king, the King of Misrule, or Saturnalicius princeps.

statement.id: Perayaan dipimpin oleh raja tiruan, 'Raja Kekacauan' atau Saturnalicius princeps.
statement.en: The festival was presided over by a mock king, the King of Misrule or Saturnalicius princeps.

claims.quote: The festival would endure into the Christian era when it would assume a new identity and name - Brumalia.

statement.id: Perayaan itu bertahan hingga era Kristen dan memperoleh identitas serta nama baru, Brumalia.
statement.en: The festival survived into the Christian era, taking on a new identity and the name Brumalia.

claims.quote: Saturn was also linked to another ancient Italian deity, Lua.

statement.id: Saturnus juga dikaitkan dengan dewa Italia kuno lain, Lua.
statement.en: Saturn was also linked to another ancient Italian deity, Lua.

claims.quote: We remember Saturn in two ways, for one he ends our busy work week - Saturday. And, as we look to the sky, on occasion, we can see the sixth planet from the sun - Saturn.

statement.id: Saturnus dikenang lewat hari Sabtu (Saturday) dan lewat planet keenam dari Matahari yang menyandang namanya.
statement.en: Saturn is remembered through Saturday and through the sixth planet from the sun, which bears his name.

claims.quote: His temple, built around 498 BCE, was located at the foot of Capitoline Hill and housed the Roman treasury as well as the records and decrees of the Roman Senate.

statement.id: Kuilnya, dibangun sekitar 498 SM, berada di kaki Bukit Capitoline dan menyimpan kas negara serta catatan dan keputusan Senat.
statement.en: His temple, built around 498 BCE, stood at the foot of Capitoline Hill and housed the Roman treasury and the records and decrees of the Senate.

claims.quote: Saturn, himself, was identified with Kronos, and sacrificed to according to Greek ritual, with the head uncovered.

statement.id: Saturnus diidentifikasi dengan Kronos dan dipersembahi kurban menurut ritus Yunani, dengan kepala tidak ditutup.
statement.en: Saturn was identified with Kronos and received sacrifice according to Greek ritual, with the head uncovered.

claims.quote: The Temple of Saturn, the oldest temple recorded by the pontiffs, had been dedicated on the Saturnalia, and the woolen bonds which fettered the feet of the ivory cult statue within were loosened on that day to symbolize the liberation of the god.

statement.id: Kuil Saturnus, kuil tertua yang dicatat para pontifeks, didedikasikan pada hari Saturnalia, dan ikatan wol pada kaki arca gadingnya dilonggarkan pada hari itu sebagai lambang pembebasan sang dewa.
statement.en: The Temple of Saturn, the oldest temple recorded by the pontiffs, was dedicated on the Saturnalia, and the woolen bonds on the feet of its ivory cult statue were loosened that day to symbolize the god's liberation.

claims.quote: After sacrifice at the temple, there was a public banquet, as well as a lectisternium (in which an image of the god was placed as if in attendance), which Livy says was introduced in 217 BC.

statement.id: Setelah kurban di kuil ada perjamuan umum dan lectisternium (citra sang dewa diletakkan seolah menghadiri jamuan), yang menurut Livy diperkenalkan pada 217 SM.
statement.en: After the sacrifice at the temple there was a public banquet and a lectisternium (an image of the god placed as if in attendance), which Livy says was introduced in 217 BC.

claims.quote: The original day was given over to the Opalia, honoring Ops, who personified abundance and the fruits of the earth, and was the consort of Saturn.

statement.id: Hari asli perayaan itu diperuntukkan bagi Opalia, yang menghormati Ops, personifikasi kelimpahan dan hasil bumi serta pasangan Saturnus.
statement.en: The original day was given over to the Opalia, honoring Ops, who personified abundance and the fruits of the earth and was Saturn's consort.

claims.quote: Augustus limited the holiday to three days, so the civil courts would not have to be closed any longer than necessary

statement.id: Augustus membatasi perayaan itu menjadi tiga hari agar pengadilan sipil tidak ditutup lebih lama dari yang perlu.
statement.en: Augustus limited the holiday to three days so that the civil courts would not have to be closed longer than necessary.

claims.quote: The Saturnalia was the most popular holiday of the Roman year.

statement.id: Saturnalia adalah hari libur paling populer dalam tahun Romawi.
statement.en: The Saturnalia was the most popular holiday of the Roman year.

claims.quote: He was described as a god of time, generation, dissolution, abundance, wealth, agriculture, periodic renewal and liberation.

statement.id: Saturnus digambarkan sebagai dewa waktu, generasi, peluruhan, kelimpahan, kekayaan, pertanian, pembaruan berkala, dan pembebasan.
statement.en: Saturn was described as a god of time, generation, dissolution, abundance, wealth, agriculture, periodic renewal and liberation.

claims.quote: Saturn's consort was his sister Ops, with whom he fathered Jupiter, Neptune, Pluto, Juno, Ceres and Vesta.

statement.id: Pasangan Saturnus adalah saudarinya, Ops, dan dari Ops ia menjadi ayah Jupiter, Neptune, Pluto, Juno, Ceres, dan Vesta.
statement.en: Saturn's consort was his sister Ops, with whom he fathered Jupiter, Neptune, Pluto, Juno, Ceres and Vesta.

claims.quote: The Temple of Saturn in the Roman Forum housed the state treasury and archives (aerarium) of the Roman Republic and the early Roman Empire.

statement.id: Kuil Saturnus di Forum Romawi menyimpan kas negara dan arsip (aerarium) Republik Romawi dan Kekaisaran Romawi awal.
statement.en: The Temple of Saturn in the Roman Forum housed the state treasury and archives (aerarium) of the Roman Republic and early Roman Empire.

claims.quote: According to Varro, Saturn's name was derived from satus, meaning  "sowing".

statement.id: Menurut Varro, nama Saturnus diturunkan dari satus, 'penaburan'.
statement.en: According to Varro, Saturn's name derives from satus, meaning 'sowing'.

claims.quote: Perhaps a more probable etymology connects the name with the Etruscan god Satre and placenames such as Satria, an ancient town of Latium, and Saturae palus, a marsh also in Latium.

statement.id: Etimologi yang mungkin lebih masuk akal menghubungkan nama itu dengan dewa Etruria Satre dan nama tempat seperti Satria, kota kuno di Latium, dan Saturae palus, rawa di Latium.
statement.en: A perhaps more probable etymology links the name with the Etruscan god Satre and place names such as Satria, an ancient town of Latium, and Saturae palus, a marsh in Latium.

claims.quote: Saturn for his part got his name because he was "sated" with years

statement.id: Menurut satu tafsiran, Saturnus mendapat namanya karena ia 'kenyang' oleh tahun-tahun.
statement.en: One interpretation holds that Saturn got his name because he was 'sated' with years.

claims.quote: Saturn himself, however, was represented as veiled (involutus), as for example in a wall painting from Pompeii that shows him holding a sickle and covered with a white veil.

statement.id: Saturnus sendiri digambarkan berkerudung (involutus), misalnya pada lukisan dinding dari Pompeii yang menunjukkannya memegang sabit dan berselubung kerudung putih.
statement.en: Saturn himself was represented as veiled (involutus), for example in a wall painting from Pompeii showing him holding a sickle and covered with a white veil.

claims.quote: In Roman and Etruscan reckoning Saturn is a wielder of lightning; no other agricultural god (in the sense of specialized human activity) is one.

statement.id: Dalam perhitungan Romawi dan Etruria, Saturnus adalah pemegang petir; tidak ada dewa pertanian lain yang demikian.
statement.en: In Roman and Etruscan reckoning Saturn is a wielder of lightning; no other agricultural god is one.

claims.quote: The identification with Ba'al Hammon later gave rise to the African Saturn, a cult that enjoyed great popularity until the 4th century.

statement.id: Identifikasi dengan Ba'al Hammon kemudian melahirkan 'Saturnus Afrika', sebuah kultus yang sangat populer sampai abad ke-4.
statement.en: The identification with Ba'al Hammon later gave rise to the African Saturn, a cult that enjoyed great popularity until the 4th century.

claims.quote: The figure of Saturn, kept during the year with its legs bound in wool, was released from its bindings for the period of the festival.

statement.id: Arca Saturnus, yang sepanjang tahun kakinya diikat wol, dilepaskan dari ikatannya selama perayaan.
statement.en: The figure of Saturn, kept bound in wool during the year, was released from its bindings for the festival.

claims.quote: At the same time, there was a tradition that Saturn had been an immigrant god, received by Janus after he was usurped by his son Jupiter and expelled from Greece.

statement.id: Ada pula tradisi bahwa Saturnus adalah dewa pendatang yang diterima Janus setelah ia digulingkan putranya, Jupiter, dan diusir dari Yunani.
statement.en: There was also a tradition that Saturn was an immigrant god received by Janus after he was usurped by his son Jupiter and expelled from Greece.

claims.quote: In the myth Saturn was the original and autochthonous ruler of the Capitolium, which had thus been called the Mons Saturnius in older times and on which once stood the town of Saturnia.

statement.id: Dalam mitos itu Saturnus adalah penguasa asli dan pribumi Capitolium, yang karenanya dahulu disebut Mons Saturnius dan pernah menjadi tempat berdirinya kota Saturnia.
statement.en: In the myth Saturn was the original, autochthonous ruler of the Capitolium, hence called the Mons Saturnius in older times, where the town of Saturnia once stood.

claims.quote: But Saturn also had a less benevolent aspect, as indicated by the blood shed in his honor during gladiatorial munera.

statement.id: Namun Saturnus juga punya sisi yang kurang bajik, seperti ditunjukkan oleh darah yang tertumpah untuk menghormatinya dalam munera gladiator.
statement.en: But Saturn also had a less benevolent aspect, as indicated by the blood shed in his honor during gladiatorial munera.

claims.quote: In the view of H. S. Versnel, inconsistencies such as being a foreigner with one of Rome's oldest sanctuaries, or a god of liberation who is kept in fetters most of the year, indicate Saturn's capacity for confounding social distinctions.

statement.id: Menurut H. S. Versnel, ketidakkonsistenan seperti menjadi pendatang tetapi memiliki salah satu tempat suci tertua Roma, atau menjadi dewa pembebasan yang dibelenggu sepanjang tahun, menunjukkan kemampuan Saturnus mengaburkan pembedaan sosial.
statement.en: H. S. Versnel reads contradictions in the god, being a foreigner yet holding one of Rome's oldest sanctuaries and being a god of liberation kept in fetters for most of the year, as signs of his capacity to blur social distinctions.

claims.quote: The position of Saturn's festival in the Roman calendar led to his association with concepts of time, especially the temporal transition of the New Year.

statement.id: Posisi perayaan Saturnus dalam kalender Romawi mengaitkannya dengan konsep waktu, terutama peralihan Tahun Baru.
statement.en: The position of Saturn's festival in the Roman calendar led to his association with concepts of time, especially the transition of the New Year.

claims.quote: The temple was consecrated in 497 BC but the area Saturni was built by king Tullus Hostilius as confirmed by archaeological studies conducted by E. Gjerstad.

statement.id: Menurut Wikipedia, kuil itu ditahbiskan pada 497 SM, sedangkan area Saturni dibangun oleh raja Tullus Hostilius, sebagaimana dipastikan studi arkeologi E. Gjerstad.
statement.en: According to Wikipedia, the temple was consecrated in 497 BC, while the area Saturni was built by king Tullus Hostilius, as confirmed by E. Gjerstad's archaeological studies.

claims.quote: As early as Andronicus (3rd century BC), Jupiter was called the son of Saturn.

statement.id: Sejak masa Andronicus (abad ke-3 SM), Jupiter sudah disebut putra Saturnus.
statement.en: As early as Andronicus (3rd century BC), Jupiter was called the son of Saturn.

claims.quote: others are certainly later and arrived after 217 BCE, the year in which the Greek customs of the Kronia were introduced into the Saturnalia.

statement.id: Sebagian ciri dewa itu jelas lebih belakangan dan datang setelah 217 SM, tahun ketika adat Kronia dari Yunani dimasukkan ke dalam Saturnalia.
statement.en: Some features of the god are certainly later and arrived after 217 BCE, the year in which the Greek customs of the Kronia were introduced into the Saturnalia.

claims.quote: Then Saturn came, who fled the pow’r of Jove, Robb’d of his realms, and banish’d from above.

statement.id: Dalam Aeneid Virgil (terjemahan Dryden), Saturnus datang setelah melarikan diri dari kuasa Jove, dirampas kerajaannya dan dibuang dari atas.
statement.en: In Virgil's Aeneid (Dryden's translation), Saturn came, having fled the power of Jove, robbed of his realms and banished from above.

claims.quote: The men, dispers’d on hills, to towns he brought, And laws ordain’d, and civil customs taught, And Latium call’d the land where safe he lay From his unduteous son, and his usurping sway.

statement.id: Saturnus menghimpun orang-orang yang tersebar di bukit ke dalam kota, menetapkan hukum, mengajarkan adat sipil, dan menamai tanah tempatnya bersembunyi dari putranya Latium.
statement.en: Saturn brought the men dispersed on the hills into towns, ordained laws, taught civil customs, and called the land where he lay safe from his son Latium.

claims.quote: With his mild empire, peace and plenty came; And hence the golden times deriv’d their name.

statement.id: Dengan pemerintahannya yang lembut datanglah damai dan kelimpahan, dan dari sanalah zaman keemasan mendapat namanya.
statement.en: With his mild empire came peace and plenty, and hence the golden times derived their name.

claims.quote: Plac’d in their ranks, their godlike grandsires stood; Old Saturn, with his crooked scythe, on high; And Italus, that led the colony; And ancient Janus, with his double face,
claims.locator: Book VII, the palace of Picus

statement.id: Dalam penggambaran Virgil, para leluhur yang menyerupai dewa ditempatkan berbaris; di antara mereka Saturnus tua dengan sabit bengkoknya di tempat tinggi, Italus, dan Janus tua berwajah ganda.
statement.en: In Virgil's description, godlike ancestors are placed in ranks; among them old Saturn with his crooked scythe on high, Italus, and ancient Janus with his double face.

short_description.id: Ares adalah dewa perang dan keberanian Yunani, putra Zeus dan Hera, yang mewakili sisi perang yang brutal dan sering dikalahkan dalam mitos.
short_description.en: Ares is the Greek god of war and courage, son of Zeus and Hera, who stands for the brutal side of war and is often defeated in myth.

long_description.id:
Ares adalah dewa perang dan keberanian Yunani, salah satu dari Dua Belas Dewa Olimpus dan putra Zeus dan Hera. Ia mewujudkan keberanian fisik yang diperlukan untuk menang perang, tetapi juga dapat melambangkan kebrutalan dan nafsu darah, berbeda dengan saudarinya Athena yang berfungsi pada strategi. Banyak orang Yunani bersikap mendua terhadapnya, dan salah satu sumber menyebutnya mungkin dewa Olimpus yang paling tidak populer.

Dalam seni Yunani kuno ia digambarkan sebagai prajurit dewasa berjanggut atau pemuda tanpa janggut dengan ketopong dan tombak, dengan zirah, perisai, dan kadang pedang. Ketopong adalah atribut utamanya, dan ia sulit dibedakan dari prajurit lain dalam seni. Hewan sucinya adalah ular, dan Naga Kolkhis penjaga Bulu Domba Emas disebut sebagai hewan Ares; ia juga dikaitkan dengan burung nasar dan beberapa burung hantu. Kisah-kisah paling terkenal tentangnya sering menampilkannya dikalahkan atau dipermalukan.

Hephaistos menjebak Ares dan Aphrodite dalam jaring emas; dari Aphrodite Ares memiliki Deimos, Phobos, dan Harmonia. Dalam Iliad ia memihak Troya, dilukai Diomedes yang dibantu Athena, dan meraung sekeras sembilan atau sepuluh ribu prajurit. Dalam kisah lain raksasa kembar mengurungnya dalam bejana perunggu sampai Hermes membebaskannya, dan Hercules, yang dilindungi Athena, melukainya dalam kisah Kyknos. Ia pernah diadili di Areiopagos di Athena atas pembunuhan Halirrhothius dan dibebaskan.

Orang Romawi mengidentifikasi Mars dengan Ares; Mars diberi kedudukan lebih penting sebagai pelindung leluhur bangsa Romawi dan disebut ayah Romulus dan Remus. Ares dipuja di Thrakia dan Asia Kecil, tempat ia menjadi dewa orakel di beberapa daerah, dan beberapa kota mengikat arcanya sebagai pelindung. Di Sparta ia diberi sapi atau ayam jantan sebagai kurban setelah pertempuran. Kultusnya di Aksum disebut lewat Maḥrem, yang dalam prasasti Yunani disebut Ares.
long_description.en:
Ares is the Greek god of war and courage, one of the Twelve Olympians and a son of Zeus and Hera. He embodies the physical valor needed for success in war but can also personify brutality and bloodlust, in contrast to his sister Athena, whose functions lie in strategy. Many Greeks were ambivalent toward him, and one source calls him perhaps the most unpopular Olympian.

In ancient Greek art he is depicted as a mature bearded warrior or a beardless youth with helmet and spear, with armor, shield, and sometimes a sword. The helm is his main attribute, and he is hard to tell apart from other warriors in art. His sacred animal is the serpent, the Colchian Dragon guarding the Golden Fleece is named among his animals, and he is also associated with vultures and a few species of owl. The most famous stories about him often show him defeated or humiliated.

Hephaistos trapped Ares and Aphrodite in a golden net; by Aphrodite Ares had Deimos, Phobos, and Harmonia. In the Iliad he sides with Troy, is wounded by Diomedes helped by Athena, and bellows as loudly as nine or ten thousand warriors. In other tales twin giants confine him in a bronze jar until Hermes frees him, and Hercules, protected by Athena, wounds him in the Kyknos story. He was tried at the Areopagus in Athens for killing Halirrhothius and acquitted.

The Romans identified Mars with Ares; Mars was given a more important place as ancestral protector of the Roman people and is named father of Romulus and Remus. Ares was worshipped in Thrace and Asia Minor, where he was an oracular deity in some regions, and some cities bound his statue as their protector. In Sparta he received an ox or a rooster as sacrifice after battle. In Aksum Maḥrem was invoked as Ares in Greek inscriptions.

era: name of Mycenaean origin; one of the Twelve Olympians in the archaic tradition

literal_meaning.en: traditionally connected with ἀρή, "bane, ruin, curse, imprecation"

who.id: Ares adalah dewa perang dan keberanian Yunani, salah satu dari Dua Belas Dewa Olimpus dan putra Zeus dan Hera.
who.en: Ares is the Greek god of war and courage, one of the Twelve Olympians and a son of Zeus and Hera.

origin.id: Ia berasal dari tradisi Yunani; namanya menunjukkan asal-usul Mikenai, dan sebagian orang menganggap ia berasal dari dewa Thrakia.
origin.en: He comes from Greek tradition; his name shows Mycenaean origins, and some think he originated as a Thracian deity.

role.id: Ia mewakili sisi perang yang brutal dan penuh nafsu darah, berbeda dengan Athena yang mewakili strategi.
role.en: He stands for the brutal, bloodthirsty side of war, in contrast to Athena, who stands for strategy.

famous_for.id: Ia terkenal karena perselingkuhannya dengan Aphrodite yang terbongkar oleh jaring emas Hephaistos dan karena sering dikalahkan atau dipermalukan dalam mitos.
famous_for.en: He is famous for his affair with Aphrodite exposed by Hephaistos's golden net and for being often defeated or humiliated in myth.

did_you_know.id: Areiopagos di Athena disebut sebagai "bukit Ares" dan konon tempat Ares diadili atas pembunuhan Halirrhothius.
did_you_know.en: The Areopagus in Athens is called the "mount of Ares" and was supposedly where Ares was tried for killing Halirrhothius.

cultural_context.id: Banyak orang Yunani bersikap mendua terhadap Ares: ia mewujudkan keberanian fisik yang diperlukan untuk menang perang, tetapi juga kebrutalan dan nafsu darah. Keterkaitan dengannya memberi tempat dan benda sifat buas atau militeristik. Pemujaannya di Yunani tidak lazim, kuilnya biasanya dibangun di luar kota, dan beberapa kota mengikat arcanya sebagai pelindung.
cultural_context.en: Many Greeks were ambivalent toward Ares: he embodies the physical valor needed in war but also brutality and bloodlust. An association with him gives places and objects a savage or militarized quality. His worship in Greece was not common, his temples were usually built outside the towns, and some cities bound his statue as their protector.

description.id: Dalam kisah Adonis, Ares menjelma babi hutan.
description.en: In the story of Adonis, Ares transforms himself into a boar.

description.id: Ares mengubah putrinya Harmonia dan suaminya Kadmos menjadi ular dan membawa mereka ke Pulau-Pulau Orang Terberkati.
description.en: Ares transformed his daughter Harmonia and her husband Kadmos into serpents and had them carried to the Islands of the Blessed.

name.id: Kekuatan dan keberanian di medan perang

description.id: Ares dipandang mewujudkan keberanian fisik dan kekuatan berani dalam perang; Himne Homerik 8 menyapanya luar biasa kuat dan perkasa dengan tombak, dan raungannya di Iliad sekeras teriakan sembilan atau sepuluh ribu prajurit.
description.en: Ares is seen as embodying physical valor and bold force in war; Homeric Hymn 8 calls him exceeding in strength and mighty with the spear, and his bellow in the Iliad is as loud as nine or ten thousand warriors.

description.id: Ares memakai ketopong, perisai, tombak, dan kadang pedang, dan kadang digambarkan menaiki kereta yang ditarik kuda penyembur api.
description.en: Ares bears a helm, shield, spear, and sometimes a sword, and is sometimes shown riding a chariot pulled by fire-breathing horses.

name.en: Can be wounded by heroes aided by other gods

description.id: Dalam Iliad Diomedes melukai Ares dengan bantuan Athena, dan Hercules, dilindungi Athena, berhasil melukainya dalam kisah Kyknos.
description.en: In the Iliad Diomedes wounds Ares with Athene's help, and in the Kyknos story Hercules, protected by Athena, manages to wound him.

name.en: Can be bound and held captive

description.id: Raksasa kembar mengurung Ares dalam bejana perunggu sampai Hermes membebaskannya, dan beberapa kota mengikat arcanya dalam belenggu sebagai pelindung.
description.en: Twin giants confined Ares in a bronze jar until Hermes freed him, and some cities bound his statue in chains as their protector.

description.id: Dalam Iliad, Athena membela bangsa Akhaia dan menjatuhkan Ares dengan batu besar; ia sering dipermalukan dalam mitos.
description.en: In the Iliad Athena, supporting the Achaeans, knocks Ares out with a large rock; he is often humiliated in myth.

description.id: Enyalios kadang disamakan dengan Ares dan kadang dibedakan sebagai dewa perang lain dengan kultus tersendiri.
description.en: Enyalios was sometimes identified with Ares and sometimes distinguished from him as another war god with his own cult.

description.id: Maḥrem, dewa utama para raja Aksum sebelum abad ke-4 M, disebut sebagai Ares dalam prasasti Yunani.
description.en: Maḥrem, principal god of the kings of Aksum before the 4th century AD, was invoked as Ares in Greek inscriptions.

description.id: Bangsa Skithia dikatakan membunuh satu dari setiap seratus tawanan perang sebagai persembahan bagi padanan Ares mereka.
description.en: The Scythians were said to ritually kill one in a hundred prisoners of war as an offering to their equivalent of Ares.

variants.name: Ares dewa orakel di Asia Kecil

description.id: Di sebagian Asia Kecil Ares menjadi dewa orakel, dan kultusnya tercatat di 29 lokasi sejak abad ke-5 SM.
description.en: In parts of Asia Minor Ares was an oracular deity, with cults attested at 29 sites from the 5th century BC.

role.en: Aphrodite's lover caught in the trap

summary.id: Ares berselingkuh dengan Aphrodite, tetapi suaminya Hephaistos menjebak keduanya dalam jaring emas dan mempermalukan mereka dengan memanggil para dewa lain menjadi saksi. Dalam Buku 8 Odyssey kisah ini diceritakan cukup rinci, dan hukuman bagi Ares adalah pengusiran sementara dari Gunung Olimpus.
summary.en: Ares was Aphrodite's lover, but her husband Hephaistos caught the two of them in a golden net and shamed them before the other gods, whom he summoned as witnesses. The tale is told in some detail in Book 8 of the Odyssey, and Ares' punishment was temporary banishment from Mount Olympus.

title.en: Ares imprisoned in a bronze jar

role.en: The god taken captive by giants

summary.id: Raksasa kembar Otus dan Ephialtes mengurung Ares dalam bejana perunggu sampai Hermes membebaskannya. Iliad menyebut ia terikat tiga belas bulan, sedangkan sumber lain menyebut satu tahun.
summary.en: The twin giants Otus and Ephialtes confined Ares in a bronze jar until Hermes freed him. The Iliad says he lay bound for thirteen months, while another source says one year.

summary.id: Ketika Aphrodite jatuh cinta pada Adonis, Ares cemburu, menjelma babi hutan, dan membunuh pemuda itu saat berburu.
summary.en: When Aphrodite fell in love with Adonis, Ares grew jealous, transformed himself into a boar, and killed the youth while he was hunting.

role.en: The father who transformed his daughter

summary.id: Ares mengubah putrinya Harmonia dan suaminya Kadmos dari Thebai menjadi ular dan membawa mereka ke Pulau-Pulau Orang Terberkati.
summary.en: Ares transformed his daughter Harmonia and her husband Kadmos of Thebes into serpents and had them carried to the Islands of the Blessed.

title.en: The trial of Ares at the Areiopagos

summary.id: Ares membunuh Hallirhothios, putra Poseidon, untuk membalas pemerkosaan putrinya Alkippe. Ia diadili di Areiopagos di Athena dan dibebaskan dari tuduhan pembunuhan.
summary.en: Ares killed Hallirhothios, son of Poseidon, in revenge for the rape of his daughter Alkippe. The Areiopagos court in Athens tried him and cleared him of murder.

title.en: The battle with Herakles over Kyknos

role.id: Ayah yang membela putranya dan kalah
role.en: The father who defended his son and lost

summary.id: Kyknos, putra Ares, menghadang peziarah menuju Delphi sehingga Apollo mengirim Hercules. Hercules membunuh Kyknos, Ares yang murka melawannya, tetapi dilukai sang pahlawan dan terpaksa kembali ke Olimpos.
summary.en: Kyknos, a son of Ares, waylaid pilgrims on their way to Delphi, so Apollo sent Hercules. Hercules killed Kyknos, and a furious Ares fought him but was wounded by the hero and forced back to Olympos.

summary.id: Dalam Iliad Ares mendukung bangsa Troya. Diomedes, dibantu Athena, melukainya dengan tombak sehingga ia meraung sekeras sembilan atau sepuluh ribu prajurit dan terbang kembali ke Olimpos. Dalam kisah lain Athena menjatuhkannya dengan batu besar, dan Zeus mengabaikan keluhannya tetapi menyuruh Paieon menyembuhkannya.
summary.en: In the Iliad Ares supports the Trojans. Diomedes, helped by Athene, wounds him with a spear so that he bellows as loudly as nine or ten thousand warriors and flies back to Olympos. Elsewhere Athena knocks him down with a large rock, and Zeus ignores his complaints but has Paieon heal him.

description.en: A natural rock outcrop in Athens some distance from the Acropolis, supposedly where Ares was tried and acquitted for killing Halirrhothius.

description.en: Considered Ares's birthplace and refuge after the mockery of his affair; Ares also had a cult there.

description.en: Cults of Ares are attested at 29 sites there from the 5th century BC into the Roman Imperial era.

description.en: Cults of Ares in southern Asia Minor are attested from this time.

claim.id: Ares adalah dewa perang dan keberanian Yunani, salah satu dewa Olimpus dan putra Zeus serta Hera.
claim.en: Ares is a Greek god of war and courage, an Olympian and son of Zeus and Hera.

claims_provenance.quote: is the Greek god of war and courage. He is one of the Twelve Olympians, and the son of Zeus and Hera.

claim.id: Ares adalah dewa Olimpus yang berkaitan dengan perang dan keberanian.
claim.en: Ares is an Olympian deity associated with war and courage.

claims_provenance.quote: ARES was the Olympian god of war, battlelust, courage and civil order.

claim.id: Ares digambarkan memakai zirah dan ketopong serta membawa perisai dan tombak.
claim.en: Ancient art shows Ares armored with helmet, shield, and spear.

claims_provenance.quote: In ancient Greek Archaic and Classical art, Ares is most often depicted wearing full armour and helmet and carrying a shield and spear.
claims_provenance.locator: How is Ares Represented in Art?

claim.id: Hephaistos menjebak Ares dan Aphrodite dalam jaring emas.
claim.en: Hephaistos trapped Ares and Aphrodite in a golden net.

claims_provenance.quote: Ares had an adulterous affair with the goddess Aphrodite but her husband Hephaistos trapped the pair in a golden net

claim.id: Raksasa kembar mengurung Ares di bejana perunggu sampai Hermes membebaskannya.
claim.en: Twin giants confined Ares in a bronze vessel until Hermes freed him.

claims_provenance.quote: They imprisoned the god in a bronze jar (or cauldron) for one year and he was only freed through the intervention of Hermes.

claim.id: Orang Romawi menyamakan Mars dengan Ares.
claim.en: Romans identified Mars with Ares.

claims_provenance.quote: The Romans identified their god Mars with the Greek Ares.

claim.id: Penggambaran kuno Ares dapat berupa prajurit dewasa berjanggut atau pemuda berketopong dan tombak.
claim.en: Ancient depictions show Ares as a bearded warrior or a helmeted youth with spear.

claims_provenance.quote: In ancient Greek art he was depicted as either a mature, bearded warrior armed for battle, or a nude, beardless youth with a helm and spear.

claim.id: Etimologi nama Ares secara tradisional dikaitkan dengan kata Yunani ἀρή (arē), bentuk Ionia dari ἀρά (ara) Doria, yang berarti "bencana, kehancuran, kutukan".
claim.en: The etymology of the name Ares is traditionally connected with the Greek word ἀρή (arē), the Ionic form of Doric ἀρά (ara), "bane, ruin, curse, imprecation".

claims_provenance.quote: The etymology of the name Ares is traditionally connected with the Greek word ἀρή (arē), the Ionic form of the Doric ἀρά (ara), "bane, ruin, curse, imprecation".

claim.id: Nama Ares menunjukkan asal-usul Mikenai, tetapi reputasinya yang buas oleh sebagian orang dianggap mencerminkan asalnya sebagai dewa Thrakia.
claim.en: Ares's name shows Mycenaean origins, but his reputation for savagery was thought by some to reflect his likely origins as a Thracian deity.

claims_provenance.quote: Although Ares's name shows his origins as Mycenaean, his reputation for savagery was thought by some to reflect his likely origins as a Thracian deity.

claim.id: Banyak orang Yunani bersikap mendua terhadap Ares: ia mewujudkan keberanian fisik yang diperlukan untuk menang perang, tetapi juga dapat melambangkan kebrutalan dan nafsu darah, berbeda dengan saudarinya Athena yang berfungsi pada strategi dan kepemimpinan militer.
claim.en: Many Greeks were ambivalent toward Ares: he embodies the physical valor needed for success in war but can also personify sheer brutality and bloodlust, in contrast to his sister Athena, whose martial functions include strategy and generalship.

claims_provenance.quote: Many Greeks were ambivalent towards him. He embodies the physical valor necessary for success in war but can also personify sheer brutality and bloodlust, in contrast to his sister Athena, whose martial functions include military strategy and generalship.

claim.id: Keterkaitan dengan Ares memberi tempat, benda, dan dewa lain sifat buas, berbahaya, atau militeristik.
claim.en: An association with Ares endows places, objects, and other deities with a savage, dangerous, or militarized quality.

claims_provenance.quote: An association with Ares endows places, objects, and other deities with a savage, dangerous, or militarized quality.

claim.id: Meski banyak sindiran sastra tentang asmara dan anak-anak Ares, perannya dalam mitologi Yunani terbatas, dan bila muncul ia sering dipermalukan.
claim.en: Although there are many literary allusions to Ares's love affairs and children, he has a limited role in Greek mythology, and when he appears he is often humiliated.

claims_provenance.quote: Although there are many literary allusions to Ares's love affairs and children, he has a limited role in Greek mythology. When he does appear, he is often humiliated.

claim.id: Enyalios kadang disamakan dengan Ares dan kadang dibedakan sebagai dewa perang lain dengan kultus tersendiri, bahkan di kota yang sama.
claim.en: Enyalios was sometimes identified with Ares and sometimes differentiated from him as another war god with a separate cult, even in the same town.

claims_provenance.quote: Enyalios was sometimes identified with Ares and sometimes differentiated from him as another war god with separate cult, even in the same town

claim.id: Ada arca arkais Ares dalam belenggu di kuil Enyalios di Sparta, yang menurut Pausanias berarti semangat perang dan kemenangan harus ditahan di kota itu.
claim.en: There was an archaic Spartan statue of Ares in chains in the temple of Enyalios, which Pausanias claimed meant the spirit of war and victory was to be kept in the city.

claims_provenance.quote: There was an archaic Spartan statue of Ares in chains in the temple of Enyalios (sometimes regarded as the son of Ares, sometimes as Ares himself), which Pausanias claimed meant that the spirit of war and victory was to be kept in the city.

claim.id: Beberapa kota di Yunani dan beberapa di Asia Kecil mengadakan festival tahunan untuk mengikat dan menahan Ares sebagai pelindung mereka; di sebagian Asia Kecil ia menjadi dewa orakel.
claim.en: Some cities in Greece and several in Asia Minor held annual festivals to bind and detain him as their protector, and in parts of Asia Minor he was an oracular deity.

claims_provenance.quote: Some cities in Greece and several in Asia Minor held annual festivals to bind and detain him as their protector. In parts of Asia Minor, he was an oracular deity.

claim.id: Lebih jauh dari Yunani, bangsa Skithia dikatakan membunuh satu dari setiap seratus tawanan perang secara ritual sebagai persembahan bagi padanan Ares mereka.
claim.en: Further from Greece, the Scythians were said to ritually kill one in a hundred prisoners of war as an offering to their equivalent of Ares.

claims_provenance.quote: Still further away from Greece, the Scythians were said to ritually kill one in a hundred prisoners of war as an offering to their equivalent of Ares.

claim.id: Kepercayaan belakangan bahwa orang Sparta kuno mengurbankan manusia kepada Ares mungkin lebih berasal dari prasejarah mitis, salah paham, dan reputasi daripada kenyataan.
claim.en: The later belief that ancient Spartans offered human sacrifice to Ares may owe more to mythical prehistory, misunderstandings, and reputation than to reality.

claims_provenance.quote: The later belief that ancient Spartans had offered human sacrifice to Ares may owe more to mythical prehistory, misunderstandings, and reputation than to reality.

claim.id: Dalam Perang Troya, Aphrodite, pelindung Troya, membujuk Ares memihak bangsa Troya; Troya kalah sementara Athena, saudari Ares, membantu bangsa Yunani menang.
claim.en: In the Trojan War, Aphrodite, protector of Troy, persuades Ares to take the Trojans' side; the Trojans lose while Athena, Ares's sister, helps the Greeks to victory.

claims_provenance.quote: In the Trojan War, Aphrodite, protector of Troy, persuades Ares to take the Trojans' side. The Trojans lose, while Ares's sister Athena helps the Greeks to victory.

claim.id: Padanan terdekat Ares dalam agama Romawi adalah Mars, yang diberi kedudukan lebih penting dan terhormat sebagai pelindung leluhur bangsa dan negara Romawi.
claim.en: Ares's nearest counterpart in Roman religion is Mars, who was given a more important and dignified place as ancestral protector of the Roman people and state.

claims_provenance.quote: Ares's nearest counterpart in Roman religion is Mars, who was given a more important and dignified place in ancient Roman religion as ancestral protector of the Roman people and state.

claim.id: Di Afrika, Maḥrem, dewa utama para raja Aksum sebelum abad ke-4 M, disebut sebagai Ares dalam prasasti Yunani.
claim.en: In Africa, Maḥrem, the principal god of the kings of Aksum before the 4th century AD, was invoked as Ares in Greek inscriptions.

claims_provenance.quote: In Africa, Maḥrem, the principal god of the kings of Aksum prior to the 4th century AD, was invoked as Ares in Greek inscriptions.

claim.id: Thrakia dianggap tempat kelahiran Ares dan tempat ia berlindung setelah perselingkuhannya dengan Aphrodite menjadi bahan ejekan para dewa lain.
claim.en: Thrace was considered Ares's birthplace and his refuge after the affair with Aphrodite was exposed to the mockery of the other gods.

claims_provenance.quote: Thrace was considered to be Ares's birthplace and his refuge after the affair with Aphrodite was exposed to the general mockery of the other gods.

claim.id: Seperti kebanyakan dewa Yunani, Ares menerima kurban hewan; di Sparta, setelah pertempuran ia diberi seekor sapi untuk kemenangan lewat siasat atau seekor ayam jantan untuk kemenangan lewat serbuan.
claim.en: Like most Greek deities, Ares received animal sacrifice; in Sparta after battle he was given an ox for a victory by stratagem or a rooster for victory through onslaught.

claims_provenance.quote: Like most Greek deities, Ares was given animal sacrifice; in Sparta, after battle, he was given an ox for a victory by stratagem, or a rooster for victory through onslaught.

claim.id: Dalam karya sastra masa Renaisans dan Neoklasik, Ares digantikan Mars dari Romawi, lambang romantis keberanian jantan, bukan dewa Yunani yang kejam dan haus darah.
claim.en: In Renaissance and Neoclassical literary works Ares is replaced by the Roman Mars, a romantic emblem of manly valor rather than the cruel and blood-thirsty god of Greek mythology.

claims_provenance.quote: In literary works of these eras, Ares is replaced by the Roman Mars, a romantic emblem of manly valor rather than the cruel and blood-thirsty god of Greek mythology.

claim.id: Kultus Ares di Asia Kecil selatan tercatat sejak abad ke-5 SM hingga masa Kekaisaran Romawi, di 29 lokasi dan lebih dari 70 penerbitan koin lokal.
claim.en: His cults in southern Asia Minor are attested from the 5th century BC well into the Roman Imperial era, at 29 sites and on over 70 local coin issues.

claims_provenance.quote: His cults in southern Asia Minor are attested from the 5th century BC and well into the later Roman Imperial era, at 29 different sites, and on over 70 local coin issues.

claim.id: Areopagus ("bukit Ares"), singkapan batu alami di Athena yang agak jauh dari Akropolis, konon tempat Ares diadili dan dibebaskan para dewa atas pembunuhan balas dendamnya terhadap Halirrhothius, putra Poseidon, yang memerkosa Alcippe, putri Ares.
claim.en: The Areopagus ("mount of Ares"), a natural rock outcrop in Athens some distance from the Acropolis, was supposedly where Ares was tried and acquitted by the gods for the revenge-killing of Poseidon's son Halirrhothius, who had raped Ares's daughter Alcippe.

claims_provenance.quote: The Areopagus ("mount of Ares"), a natural rock outcrop in Athens, some distance from the Acropolis, was supposedly where Ares was tried and acquitted by the gods for his revenge-killing of Poseidon's son, Halirrhothius, who had raped Ares's daughter Alcippe.

claim.id: Atribut utama Ares adalah ketopong prajurit berpuncak, bahkan dalam adegan rumah tangga seperti pesta para dewa; atribut lainnya perisai, tombak, dan kadang pedang bersarung.
claim.en: Ares' main attribute was a peaked warrior's helm, even in domestic scenes such as feasts of the gods; his other attributes included a shield, a spear, and sometimes a sheathed sword.

claims_provenance.quote: Ares' main attribute was a peaked warrior's helm. Even in domestic scenes, such as feasts of the gods, he was depicted either wearing or holding his helm. The god's other attributes included a shield, a spear and sometimes a sheathed sword.

claim.id: Ares cukup sulit dikenali dalam seni Yunani kuno karena hanya sedikit yang membedakannya dari tokoh prajurit lain.
claim.en: Ares can be quite difficult to identify in ancient Greek art because little distinguishes him from other warrior figures.

claims_provenance.quote: Ares can be quite difficult to identify in ancient Greek art as there is little to distinguish him from other warrior figures.

claim.id: Hewan suci Ares adalah ular; ia juga dikaitkan dengan burung tertentu seperti burung nasar dan beberapa jenis burung hantu, yang menurut augury kuno menjadi pertanda perang, hasutan, dan nasib buruk.
claim.en: Ares' sacred animal was the serpent; he was also associated with certain birds such as the vulture and a few species of owl, which ancient augury identified as portents of war, sedition, and ill-fortune.

claims_provenance.quote: Ares' sacred animal was the serpent. He was also associated with certain birds, such as the vulture and a few species of owl, which ancient augury identified as portents of war, sedition and ill-fortune.

claim.id: Hewan Ares yang paling terkenal dalam mitos adalah Naga Kolkhis, ular yang ia tempatkan untuk menjaga Bulu Domba Emas, dan Naga Ismenia, ular raksasa penjaga mata air sucinya dekat Thebai.
claim.en: The most famous of the god's animals in myth were the Colchian Dragon, a serpent set by Ares to guard the Golden Fleece, and the Ismenian Dragon, a giant snake guarding his sacred spring near Thebes.

claims_provenance.quote: The most famous of the god's animals in myth were the Colchian Dragon, a serpent set by Ares to guard the Golden Fleece, and the Ismenian Dragon, a giant snake which guarded his sacred spring near Thebes.

claim.id: Ares adalah putra Zeus dan Hera, raja dan ratu para dewa, serta saudara dewi Eileithyia dan Hebe.
claim.en: Ares was a son of Zeus and Hera, King and Queen of the Gods, and brother of the goddesses Eileithyia and Hebe.

claims_provenance.quote: Ares was a son of Zeus and Hera, King and Queen of the Gods, and brother of the goddesses Eileithyia and Hebe.

claim.id: Ares memiliki tiga anak dengan Aphrodite: Deimos (Ketakutan), Phobos (Kengerian), dan Harmonia (Keselarasan).
claim.en: Ares had three children by Aphrodite named Deimos (Fear), Phobos (Terror), and Harmonia (Harmony).

claims_provenance.quote: Ares had three children by the goddess Aphrodite named Deimos (Fear), Phobos (Terror), and Harmonia (Harmony).

claim.id: Ketika Aphrodite jatuh cinta pada pemuda tampan Adonis, Ares cemburu, menjelma babi hutan, dan membunuh pemuda itu saat berburu.
claim.en: When Aphrodite fell in love with the handsome youth Adonis, Ares grew jealous, transformed himself into a boar, and gored the boy to death while he was hunting.

claims_provenance.quote: When Aphrodite fell in love with the handsome youth Adonis, the god grew jealous, transformed himself into a boar, and gorged the boy to death as he was out hunting.

claim.id: Ares mengubah putrinya Harmonia dan suaminya Kadmos dari Thebai menjadi ular dan membawa mereka ke Pulau-Pulau Orang Terberkati.
claim.en: Ares transformed his daughter Harmonia and her husband Kadmos of Thebes into serpents and had them carried away to the Islands of the Blessed.

claims_provenance.quote: Ares transformed his daughter Harmonia and her husband Kadmos (Cadmus) of Thebes into serpents and had them carried away to the Islands of the Blessed.

claim.id: Ares membunuh Hallirhothios untuk membalas pemerkosaan putrinya, Alkippe; ia diadili di pengadilan Areiopagos di Athena tetapi dibebaskan dari tuduhan pembunuhan.
claim.en: Ares slew Hallirhothios to avenge the rape of his daughter Alkippe; he was tried at the court of the Areiopagos in Athens but acquitted of murder.

claims_provenance.quote: The god slew Hallirhothios to avenge the rape of his daughter Alkippe. He was tried at the court of the Areiopagos in Athens but acquitted of murder.

claim.id: Dalam pertempuran antara Herakles dan Kyknos yang jahat, putra Ares, sang dewa ikut campur tetapi dilukai sang pahlawan dan terpaksa kembali ke Olimpos.
claim.en: In the battle between Herakles and Ares' villainous son Kyknos, the god intervened but was wounded by the hero and forced to flee back to Olympos.

claims_provenance.quote: During the battle between Herakles and Ares' villianous Kyknos (Cycnus), the god intervened but was wounded by the hero and forced to flee back to Olympos.

claim.id: Ares aktif mendukung putri-putrinya yang menjadi ratu Amazon dalam banyak perang; yang paling terkenal adalah Penthesileia yang ikut dalam Perang Troya.
claim.en: Ares actively supported his Amazon-queen daughters in their many wars and battles; the most celebrated was Penthesileia, who joined the Trojan War.

claims_provenance.quote: Ares actively supported his Amazon-queen daughters in their many wars and battles. The most celebrated of these was Penthesileia who joined the Trojan War.

claim.id: Dalam Perang Troya, Ares yang memihak Troya dilukai pahlawan Yunani Diomedes yang menusukkan tombak ke sisinya, sehingga ia terbang kembali ke Olimpos sambil meraung kesakitan.
claim.en: During the Trojan War, Ares, who had sided with the Trojans, was wounded by the Greek hero Diomedes, who drove a spear into his side, sending him flying back to Olympos bellowing in pain.

claims_provenance.quote: During the course of the Trojan War, Ares, who had sided with the Trojans, was wounded by the Greek hero Diomedes who drove a spear into his side, sending him flying back to Olympos bellowing in pain.

claim.id: Menurut kamus ini, Ares hanyalah personifikasi kekuatan yang berani, dan lebih sebagai dewa kegaduhan, kekacauan, dan kengerian perang; Eris menyulut perang, Zeus mengarahkannya, tetapi Ares mencintai perang demi perang itu sendiri.
claim.en: According to this dictionary, Ares is nothing but the personification of bold force and strength, less the god of war than of its tumult, confusion, and horrors; Eris calls forth war, Zeus directs its course, but Ares loves war for its own sake.

claims_provenance.quote: Ares, on the other hand, is nothing but the personification of bold force and strength, and not so much the god of war as of its tumult, confusion, and horrors. His sister Eris calls forth war, Zeus directs its course, but Ares loves war for its own sake

claim.en: The warlike character of the Thracian tribes led to the belief that the god's residence was in that country, and there and in Scythia were the principal seats of his worship.

Hercules killed Kyknos, and a furious Ares engaged the hero in a fight. However, Hercules was protected from harm by Athena and even managed to wound Ares.

short_description.id: Ares adalah dewa perang dan keberanian Yunani, putra Zeus dan Hera, yang mewakili sisi perang yang brutal dan sering dikalahkan dalam mitos.
short_description.en: Ares is the Greek god of war and courage, son of Zeus and Hera, who stands for the brutal side of war and is often defeated in myth.

long_description.id: Ares adalah dewa perang dan keberanian Yunani, salah satu dari Dua Belas Dewa Olimpus dan putra Zeus dan Hera. Ia mewujudkan keberanian fisik yang diperlukan untuk menang perang, tetapi juga dapat melambangkan kebrutalan dan nafsu darah, berbeda dengan saudarinya Athena yang berfungsi pada strategi. Banyak orang Yunani bersikap mendua terhadapnya, dan salah satu sumber menyebutnya mungkin dewa Olimpus yang paling tidak populer.
long_description.en: Ares is the Greek god of war and courage, one of the Twelve Olympians and a son of Zeus and Hera. He embodies the physical valor needed for success in war but can also personify brutality and bloodlust, in contrast to his sister Athena, whose functions lie in strategy. Many Greeks were ambivalent toward him, and one source calls him perhaps the most unpopular Olympian.

long_description.id: Dalam seni Yunani kuno ia digambarkan sebagai prajurit dewasa berjanggut atau pemuda tanpa janggut dengan ketopong dan tombak, dengan zirah, perisai, dan kadang pedang. Ketopong adalah atribut utamanya, dan ia sulit dibedakan dari prajurit lain dalam seni. Hewan sucinya adalah ular, dan Naga Kolkhis penjaga Bulu Domba Emas disebut sebagai hewan Ares; ia juga dikaitkan dengan burung nasar dan beberapa burung hantu. Kisah-kisah paling terkenal tentangnya sering menampilkannya dikalahkan atau dipermalukan.
long_description.en: In ancient Greek art he is depicted as a mature bearded warrior or a beardless youth with helmet and spear, with armor, shield, and sometimes a sword. The helm is his main attribute, and he is hard to tell apart from other warriors in art. His sacred animal is the serpent, the Colchian Dragon guarding the Golden Fleece is named among his animals, and he is also associated with vultures and a few species of owl. The most famous stories about him often show him defeated or humiliated.

long_description.id: Hephaistos menjebak Ares dan Aphrodite dalam jaring emas; dari Aphrodite Ares memiliki Deimos, Phobos, dan Harmonia. Dalam Iliad ia memihak Troya, dilukai Diomedes yang dibantu Athena, dan meraung sekeras sembilan atau sepuluh ribu prajurit. Dalam kisah lain raksasa kembar mengurungnya dalam bejana perunggu sampai Hermes membebaskannya, dan Hercules, yang dilindungi Athena, melukainya dalam kisah Kyknos. Ia pernah diadili di Areiopagos di Athena atas pembunuhan Halirrhothius dan dibebaskan.
long_description.en: Hephaistos trapped Ares and Aphrodite in a golden net; by Aphrodite Ares had Deimos, Phobos, and Harmonia. In the Iliad he sides with Troy, is wounded by Diomedes helped by Athena, and bellows as loudly as nine or ten thousand warriors. In other tales twin giants confine him in a bronze jar until Hermes frees him, and Hercules, protected by Athena, wounds him in the Kyknos story. He was tried at the Areopagus in Athens for killing Halirrhothius and acquitted.

long_description.id: Orang Romawi mengidentifikasi Mars dengan Ares; Mars diberi kedudukan lebih penting sebagai pelindung leluhur bangsa Romawi dan disebut ayah Romulus dan Remus. Ares dipuja di Thrakia dan Asia Kecil, tempat ia menjadi dewa orakel di beberapa daerah, dan beberapa kota mengikat arcanya sebagai pelindung. Di Sparta ia diberi sapi atau ayam jantan sebagai kurban setelah pertempuran. Kultusnya di Aksum disebut lewat Maḥrem, yang dalam prasasti Yunani disebut Ares.
long_description.en: The Romans identified Mars with Ares; Mars was given a more important place as ancestral protector of the Roman people and is named father of Romulus and Remus. Ares was worshipped in Thrace and Asia Minor, where he was an oracular deity in some regions, and some cities bound his statue as their protector. In Sparta he received an ox or a rooster as sacrifice after battle. In Aksum Maḥrem was invoked as Ares in Greek inscriptions.

cultural_context.id: Banyak orang Yunani bersikap mendua terhadap Ares: ia mewujudkan keberanian fisik yang diperlukan untuk menang perang, tetapi juga kebrutalan dan nafsu darah. Keterkaitan dengannya memberi tempat dan benda sifat buas atau militeristik. Pemujaannya di Yunani tidak lazim, kuilnya biasanya dibangun di luar kota, dan beberapa kota mengikat arcanya sebagai pelindung.
cultural_context.en: Many Greeks were ambivalent toward Ares: he embodies the physical valor needed in war but also brutality and bloodlust. An association with him gives places and objects a savage or militarized quality. His worship in Greece was not common, his temples were usually built outside the towns, and some cities bound his statue as their protector.

literal_meaning.en: traditionally connected with ἀρή, "bane, ruin, curse, imprecation"

who.id: Ares adalah dewa perang dan keberanian Yunani, salah satu dari Dua Belas Dewa Olimpus dan putra Zeus dan Hera.
who.en: Ares is the Greek god of war and courage, one of the Twelve Olympians and a son of Zeus and Hera.

origin.id: Ia berasal dari tradisi Yunani; namanya menunjukkan asal-usul Mikenai, dan sebagian orang menganggap ia berasal dari dewa Thrakia.
origin.en: He comes from Greek tradition; his name shows Mycenaean origins, and some think he originated as a Thracian deity.

role.id: Ia mewakili sisi perang yang brutal dan penuh nafsu darah, berbeda dengan Athena yang mewakili strategi.
role.en: He stands for the brutal, bloodthirsty side of war, in contrast to Athena, who stands for strategy.

famous_for.id: Ia terkenal karena perselingkuhannya dengan Aphrodite yang terbongkar oleh jaring emas Hephaistos dan karena sering dikalahkan atau dipermalukan dalam mitos.
famous_for.en: He is famous for his affair with Aphrodite exposed by Hephaistos's golden net and for being often defeated or humiliated in myth.

did_you_know.id: Areiopagos di Athena disebut sebagai "bukit Ares" dan konon tempat Ares diadili atas pembunuhan Halirrhothius.
did_you_know.en: The Areopagus in Athens is called the "mount of Ares" and was supposedly where Ares was tried for killing Halirrhothius.

description.en: In parts of Asia Minor Ares was an oracular deity, with cults attested at 29 sites from the 5th century BC.

role.en: Aphrodite's lover caught in the trap

summary.id: Ares berselingkuh dengan Aphrodite, tetapi suaminya Hephaistos menjebak keduanya dalam jaring emas dan mempermalukan mereka dengan memanggil para dewa lain menjadi saksi. Dalam Buku 8 Odyssey kisah ini diceritakan cukup rinci, dan hukuman bagi Ares adalah pengusiran sementara dari Gunung Olimpus.
summary.en: Ares was Aphrodite's lover, but her husband Hephaistos caught the two of them in a golden net and shamed them before the other gods, whom he summoned as witnesses. The tale is told in some detail in Book 8 of the Odyssey, and Ares' punishment was temporary banishment from Mount Olympus.

title.en: Ares imprisoned in a bronze jar

role.en: The god taken captive by giants

summary.id: Raksasa kembar Otus dan Ephialtes mengurung Ares dalam bejana perunggu sampai Hermes membebaskannya. Iliad menyebut ia terikat tiga belas bulan, sedangkan sumber lain menyebut satu tahun.
summary.en: The twin giants Otus and Ephialtes confined Ares in a bronze jar until Hermes freed him. The Iliad says he lay bound for thirteen months, while another source says one year.

summary.id: Ketika Aphrodite jatuh cinta pada Adonis, Ares cemburu, menjelma babi hutan, dan membunuh pemuda itu saat berburu.
summary.en: When Aphrodite fell in love with Adonis, Ares grew jealous, transformed himself into a boar, and killed the youth while he was hunting.

role.en: The father who transformed his daughter

summary.id: Ares mengubah putrinya Harmonia dan suaminya Kadmos dari Thebai menjadi ular dan membawa mereka ke Pulau-Pulau Orang Terberkati.
summary.en: Ares transformed his daughter Harmonia and her husband Kadmos of Thebes into serpents and had them carried to the Islands of the Blessed.

title.en: The trial of Ares at the Areiopagos

summary.id: Ares membunuh Hallirhothios, putra Poseidon, untuk membalas pemerkosaan putrinya Alkippe. Ia diadili di Areiopagos di Athena dan dibebaskan dari tuduhan pembunuhan.
summary.en: Ares killed Hallirhothios, son of Poseidon, in revenge for the rape of his daughter Alkippe. The Areiopagos court in Athens tried him and cleared him of murder.

title.en: The battle with Herakles over Kyknos

role.id: Ayah yang membela putranya dan kalah
role.en: The father who defended his son and lost

summary.id: Kyknos, putra Ares, menghadang peziarah menuju Delphi sehingga Apollo mengirim Hercules. Hercules membunuh Kyknos, Ares yang murka melawannya, tetapi dilukai sang pahlawan dan terpaksa kembali ke Olimpos.
summary.en: Kyknos, a son of Ares, waylaid pilgrims on their way to Delphi, so Apollo sent Hercules. Hercules killed Kyknos, and a furious Ares fought him but was wounded by the hero and forced back to Olympos.

summary.id: Dalam Iliad Ares mendukung bangsa Troya. Diomedes, dibantu Athena, melukainya dengan tombak sehingga ia meraung sekeras sembilan atau sepuluh ribu prajurit dan terbang kembali ke Olimpos. Dalam kisah lain Athena menjatuhkannya dengan batu besar, dan Zeus mengabaikan keluhannya tetapi menyuruh Paieon menyembuhkannya.
summary.en: In the Iliad Ares supports the Trojans. Diomedes, helped by Athene, wounds him with a spear so that he bellows as loudly as nine or ten thousand warriors and flies back to Olympos. Elsewhere Athena knocks him down with a large rock, and Zeus ignores his complaints but has Paieon heal him.

description.id: Singkapan batu alami di Athena yang agak jauh dari Akropolis; konon tempat Ares diadili dan dibebaskan atas pembunuhan Halirrhothius.
description.en: A natural rock outcrop in Athens some distance from the Acropolis, supposedly where Ares was tried and acquitted for killing Halirrhothius.

description.id: Dianggap tempat kelahiran Ares dan tempat ia berlindung setelah ejekan atas perselingkuhannya; Ares juga punya kultus di sana.
description.en: Considered Ares's birthplace and refuge after the mockery of his affair; Ares also had a cult there.

description.id: Kultus Ares tercatat di 29 lokasi di sana sejak abad ke-5 SM hingga masa Kekaisaran Romawi.
description.en: Cults of Ares are attested at 29 sites there from the 5th century BC into the Roman Imperial era.

description.id: Nama Ares menunjukkan asal-usul Mikenai.
description.en: The name Ares shows Mycenaean origins.

title.id: Pertempuran dengan Hercules di vas Attika
title.en: The battle with Hercules on Attic vases

description.id: Mitos pertempuran Ares dengan Hercules menjadi subjek populer vas Attika.
description.en: The myth of Ares' battle with Hercules was a popular subject for Attic vases.

description.id: Kultus Ares di Asia Kecil selatan tercatat sejak masa ini.
description.en: Cults of Ares in southern Asia Minor are attested from this time.

note.id: Ayah Ares.
note.en: Ares's father.

note.id: Ibu Ares.
note.en: Ares's mother.

note.id: Kekasih Ares; keduanya terperangkap jaring emas dan memiliki tiga anak.
note.en: Ares's lover; the pair were caught in the golden net and had three children.

note.id: Suami Aphrodite yang menjebak Ares dan Aphrodite dalam jaring emas.
note.en: Aphrodite's husband, who trapped Ares and Aphrodite in the golden net.

note.id: Saudari Ares yang mewakili strategi perang; dalam Iliad ia menjatuhkan Ares dengan batu besar.
note.en: Ares's sister, who stands for strategy in war; in the Iliad she knocks him out with a large rock.

note.id: Saudari Ares.
note.en: Ares's sister.

note.id: Saudari Ares.
note.en: Ares's sister.

note.id: Saudari Ares yang menyulut perang.
note.en: Ares's sister, who calls forth war.

note.en: Child of Ares and Aphrodite.

note.id: Putra Ares dan Aphrodite.

note.en: Daughter of Ares and Aphrodite.

note.en: One of Ares's Amazon-queen daughters.

traditional.id: Dalam mitologi Yunani Ares adalah dewa yang kejam dan haus darah.
traditional.en: In Greek mythology Ares is a cruel and blood-thirsty god.

modern.id: Dalam karya sastra Renaisans dan Neoklasik, ia digantikan Mars, lambang romantis keberanian jantan.
modern.en: In Renaissance and Neoclassical literary works he is replaced by Mars, a romantic emblem of manly valor.

learning_questions.id: Mengapa orang Yunani bersikap mendua terhadap Ares, padahal ia dewa perang?
learning_questions.en: Why were the Greeks ambivalent toward Ares even though he was a god of war?

learning_questions.id: Apa perbedaan Ares dan Athena dalam cara mereka mewakili perang?
learning_questions.en: How do Ares and Athena differ in the way they represent war?

learning_questions.id: Mengapa Ares begitu sering dikalahkan atau dipermalukan dalam mitos?
learning_questions.en: Why is Ares so often defeated or humiliated in myth?
