claim.id: Ouranos tidak muncul dalam seni Yunani awal, tetapi penggambaran Mesir tentang dewi langit Nut menunjukkan bagaimana ia dibayangkan: pria raksasa bertabur bintang berlengan dan berkaki panjang yang bertumpu pada keempat anggota badan.
claim.en: Ouranos does not appear in early Greek art, but Egyptian depictions of the sky-goddess Nut show how he was imagined: a gigantic, star-spangled man with long limbs, resting on all fours.

claims_provenance.quote: Ouranos does not appear in early Greek art but Egyptian depictions of their sky-goddess Nut demonstrate how he was imagined--as a gigantic, star-spangled man with long arms and legs, resting on all fours

short_description.id: Uranus atau Ouranos adalah dewa purba dan personifikasi langit dalam mitologi Yunani. Menurut Hesiod ia ayah para Titan, Cyclopes, dan Hecatoncheires, hingga dikebiri oleh putranya Cronus.
short_description.en: Uranus or Ouranos is the primordial god and personification of the sky in Greek mythology. In Hesiod he fathers the Titans, Cyclopes and Hecatoncheires until his son Cronus castrates him.

long_description.id: Uranus adalah personifikasi langit dan salah satu dewa purba Yunani. Orang Yunani membayangkan langit sebagai kubah perunggu bertabur bintang, dan Ouranos adalah langit itu sendiri, sebagaimana Gaia adalah bumi. Menurut Hesiod, Gaia melahirkan Langit sebagai pasangan yang setara dengannya, lalu berbaring bersamanya dan melahirkan dua belas Titan, tiga Cyclopes, dan tiga Hecatoncheires.
long_description.en: Uranus personifies the sky and counts among the earliest Greek gods. The Greeks imagined the sky as a starry brass dome, and Ouranos was the literal sky just as Gaia was the earth. According to Hesiod, Gaia bore Heaven as an equal for herself, then lay with him and bore the twelve Titans, three Cyclopes and three Hecatoncheires.

long_description.id: Menurut satu sumber, Uranus dan Gaia memiliki dua belas putra dan enam putri. Uranus membenci anak-anaknya dan menyembunyikan mereka di dalam bumi. Gaia membuat sabit dari batu api dan menyuruh Cronus menyergap ayahnya; saat Uranus datang berbaring bersama Gaia, Cronus mengebirinya. Dari darah yang jatuh lahirlah Erinyes, para Raksasa, dan Meliae, sedangkan dari buih laut tempat bagian tubuhnya jatuh lahirlah Aphrodite. Dengan kesal Uranus menjuluki putra-putranya Titan dan berkata bahwa pembalasan akan datang.
long_description.en: One source says Uranus and Gaia had twelve sons and six daughters. Uranus hated his children and hid them within the earth. Gaia made a flint sickle and had Cronus ambush his father; when Uranus came to lie with Gaia, Cronus castrated him. From the blood that fell were born the Erinyes, the Giants and the Meliae, and from the sea foam around the severed parts Aphrodite was born. In reproach Uranus called his sons Titans and said that vengeance would come afterwards.

long_description.id: Setelah dikebiri, peran Uranus surut ke latar belakang, tetapi ia dan Gaia memperingatkan Cronus bahwa ia akan digulingkan putranya, membantu Rhea melarikan diri ke Kreta tempat Zeus lahir, dan memperingatkan Zeus tentang putra Metis. Uranus bersama Gaia dan Styx sering menjadi saksi sumpah para dewa. Menurut salah satu sumber, ia menubuatkan kejatuhan para Titan, yang digenapi ketika Zeus menggulingkan mereka.
long_description.en: After his castration Uranus recedes into the background, yet he and Gaia warned Cronus that his son would overthrow him, helped Rhea flee to Crete where Zeus was born, and warned Zeus about Metis's son. Gaia, Styx and Uranus were frequently called on to witness divine oaths. According to one source, he prophesied the fall of the Titans, fulfilled when Zeus deposed them.

long_description.id: Tidak ada kultus yang ditujukan langsung kepada Uranus yang bertahan hingga masa klasik, dan ia tidak termasuk tema lazim keramik lukis Yunani, meski ada satu himne Orfik untuknya. Ia diidentifikasi pada relief Gigantomachy di Altar Pergamon, berjenggot dan bersayap, serta pada masa Romawi sering digambarkan sebagai Aion. Menurut salah satu sumber, ia tidak muncul dalam seni Yunani awal, dan penggambaran Mesir tentang dewi langit Nut menunjukkan bagaimana ia dibayangkan. Caelus adalah padanan Uranus dalam tradisi Romawi.
long_description.en: No cult addressed directly to Uranus survived into classical times and he is not among the usual themes of Greek painted pottery, though one Orphic hymn is dedicated to him. He is identified on the Gigantomachy frieze of the Pergamon Altar, bearded and winged, and in the Roman era he was often depicted as Aion. According to one source, he does not appear in early Greek art, and Egyptian depictions of the sky-goddess Nut show how he was imagined. His Roman counterpart is Caelus.

literal_meaning.id: Kebanyakan ahli bahasa menelusuri nama ini ke bentuk Proto-Yunani *Worsanós dengan akar Indo-Eropa "menghujani"; ini menjadikan Ouranos "pembuat hujan" atau "penguasa hujan".
literal_meaning.en: Most linguists trace the name to a Proto-Greek form *Worsanós from an Indo-European root meaning "to rain", making Ouranos the "rain-maker" or "lord of rain".

summary.en: Gaia, Styx and Uranus were frequently called on to witness divine oaths.

description.id: Wilayah neraka yang jaraknya dari Bumi sama dengan jarak Bumi dari langit (Uranus) menurut Theogony.
description.en: The infernal region, as far below Earth as the heavens (Uranus) are above it, according to the Theogony.

description.id: Tempat Aphrodite lahir dari buih di sekitar bagian tubuh Uranus dalam versi ini.
description.en: Where Aphrodite was born from the foam around Uranus's severed parts in this account.

description.id: Tempat Zeus lahir setelah Uranus dan Gaia membantu Rhea melarikan diri ke sana.
description.en: Where Zeus was born after Uranus and Gaia helped Rhea flee there.

description.id: Hesiod (700 SM) menulis bahwa Gaia melahirkan Uranus bersama Pontus dan Ourea.
description.en: Hesiod (700 BCE) writes that Gaia bore Uranus along with Pontus and Ourea.

description.id: Orfisme, yang menyebut Uranus lahir dari Nyx dan Phanes, menonjol pada abad ke-6 SM.
description.en: Orphism, which has Uranus born of Nyx and Phanes, rose to prominence in the 6th century BCE.

note.id: Pasangan Uranus dalam kisah Hesiod; juga ibunya.
note.en: Uranus's consort in Hesiod's story; also his mother.

note.id: Putra yang menggulingkan Uranus.
note.en: Son who overthrew Uranus.

note.id: Dua belas anak Uranus dan Gaia.
note.en: Twelve children of Uranus and Gaia.

note.id: Tiga Cyclopes, anak Uranus dan Gaia.
note.en: Three Cyclopes, children of Uranus and Gaia.

note.id: Tiga Hecatoncheires, anak Uranus dan Gaia.
note.en: Three Hecatoncheires, children of Uranus and Gaia.

note.id: Lahir dari darah Uranus yang jatuh ke Gaia.
note.en: Born from Uranus's blood falling on Gaia.

note.id: Dalam versi ini lahir dari buih di sekitar bagian tubuh Uranus.
note.en: In this account born from the foam around Uranus's severed parts.

note.id: Padanan Romawi Uranus.
note.en: Roman counterpart of Uranus.

note.id: Raja Langit dalam mitos Het yang dapat dikenali sebagai Uranus menurut World History Encyclopedia.
note.en: King of Heaven in the Hittite myth, who can be identified as Uranus according to World History Encyclopedia.

note.id: Uranus memperingatkannya tentang putra Metis; Zeus kemudian menggulingkan para Titan.
note.en: Uranus warned him about Metis's son; Zeus later deposed the Titans.

note.id: Ayah Ouranos menurut penulis War of the Titans.
note.en: Father of Ouranos according to the writer of the War of the Titans.

claims.quote: Uranus (also spelt Ouranos) is the personification of heaven and the sky in Greek mythology.

statement.id: Uranus atau Ouranos adalah personifikasi langit dalam mitologi Yunani.
statement.en: Uranus or Ouranos is the personification of the sky in Greek mythology.

claims.quote: OURANOS (Uranus) was the primordial god (protogenos) of the sky.

statement.id: Uranus digolongkan sebagai dewa purba langit.
statement.en: Uranus is a primordial sky god.

claims.quote: Gaia (Earth) gave birth to Uranus and chose him to be her equal.

statement.id: Menurut Hesiod, Gaia melahirkan Uranus dan menjadikannya pasangannya.
statement.en: Gaia gave birth to Uranus and chose him as her equal.

claims.quote: She lay with him, resulting in the birth of the twelve Titans, the three Cyclopes and the three Hecatoncheires.

statement.id: Gaia dan Uranus melahirkan para Titan, Cyclopes, dan Hecatoncheires.
statement.en: Gaia and Uranus parented the Titans, Cyclopes, and Hecatoncheires.

claims.quote: Uranus hated his and Gaia's children and hid them deep beneath the earth so that they would stay out of his sight.

statement.id: Uranus menyembunyikan anak-anaknya di dalam bumi.
statement.en: Uranus hid his children within the earth.

claims.quote: Gaia made a sickle out of grey adamant, gave it to Cronus, and hid him in her bed chamber.

statement.id: Gaia memberikan sabit kepada Cronus untuk melawan Uranus.
statement.en: Gaia gave Cronus a sickle to confront Uranus.

claims.quote: Cronus took his chance and struck out with the sickle, castrating Uranus' genitals.

statement.id: Cronus mengebiri Uranus dengan sabit.
statement.en: Cronus castrated Uranus with the sickle.

claims.quote: As the blood fell, it impregnated Gaia, who gave birth to the Erinyes (the Furies), the Giants and the Meliae (tree nymphs).

statement.id: Darah Uranus yang jatuh ke Gaia melahirkan Erinyes, para raksasa, dan Meliae.
statement.en: Uranus's blood falling on Gaia led to the birth of Erinyes, Giants, and Meliae.

claims.quote: White foam surrounded it, and from it, the goddess Aphrodite was born in Cythera (Kythira).

statement.id: Dalam kisah itu, Aphrodite lahir dari buih di laut.
statement.en: In this account, Aphrodite was born from sea foam.

claims.quote: His Roman counterpart is Caelus.

statement.id: Caelus adalah padanan Romawi Uranus.
statement.en: Caelus is Uranus's Roman counterpart.

claims.quote: The Greeks imagined the sky as a solid dome of brass, decorated with stars, whose edges descended to rest upon the outermost limits of the flat earth. Ouranos was the literal sky, just as his consort Gaia (Gaea) was the earth.

statement.id: Orang Yunani membayangkan langit sebagai kubah perunggu padat bertabur bintang yang tepinya bertumpu pada batas terjauh bumi yang datar; Ouranos adalah langit itu sendiri, sebagaimana pasangannya Gaia adalah bumi.
statement.en: The Greeks imagined the sky as a solid brass dome decorated with stars, its edges resting on the outermost limits of the flat earth; Ouranos was the literal sky, as his consort Gaia was the earth.

claims.quote: Ouranos and Gaia had twelve sons and six daughters. He locked the eldest of these--the giant Kyklopes (Cyclopes) and Hekatonkheires (Hecatoncheires)--away inside the belly of Earth.

statement.id: Ouranos dan Gaia memiliki dua belas putra dan enam putri; ia mengurung anak tertua, para Kyklopes dan Hekatonkheires yang raksasa, di dalam perut Bumi.
statement.en: Ouranos and Gaia had twelve sons and six daughters; he locked the eldest, the giant Cyclopes and Hecatoncheires, away inside the belly of Earth.

claims.quote: Four of these positioned themselves at the corners of the world, ready to grasp their father as he descended to lie with Earth, while the fifth, Kronos (Cronus), took his place in the centre and there castrated Ouranos with an adamantine sickle.

statement.id: Menurut uraian ini, empat dari anak-anak itu berjaga di sudut dunia untuk menangkap ayah mereka, sementara Kronos di tengah mengebiri Ouranos dengan sabit adamantin.
statement.en: In this account four of the children took positions at the corners of the world to seize their father while Kronos, in the centre, castrated Ouranos with an adamantine sickle.

claims.quote: Ouranos prophesied the fall of the Titanes and the punishments they would suffer for their crimes--a prophecy brought to fruition by Zeus who deposed the five brothers and cast them into the pit of Tartaros.

statement.id: Ouranos menubuatkan kejatuhan para Titan dan hukuman atas kejahatan mereka; Zeus menggenapi nubuat itu dengan menggulingkan lima bersaudara dan melemparkan mereka ke jurang Tartaros.
statement.en: Ouranos prophesied the fall of the Titans and their punishment for their crimes, a prophecy fulfilled when Zeus deposed the five brothers and cast them into the pit of Tartaros.

claims.quote: Ouranos does not appear in early Greek art but Egyptian depictions of their sky-goddess Nut demonstrate how he was imagined--as a gigantic, star-spangled man with long arms and legs, resting on all fours

statement.id: Ouranos tidak muncul dalam seni Yunani awal, tetapi penggambaran Mesir tentang dewi langit Nut menunjukkan bagaimana ia dibayangkan: pria raksasa bertabur bintang berlengan dan berkaki panjang yang bertumpu pada keempat anggota badan.
statement.en: Ouranos does not appear in early Greek art, but Egyptian depictions of the sky-goddess Nut show how he was imagined: a gigantic, star-spangled man with long limbs, resting on all fours.

claims.quote: In the Roman era he was often depicted as Aion, god of eternal time, in the form of a man holding the zodiac-wheel, standing above the reclining Gaia (Earth).

statement.id: Pada masa Romawi ia sering digambarkan sebagai Aion, dewa waktu abadi, berwujud pria yang memegang roda zodiak dan berdiri di atas Gaia yang berbaring.
statement.en: In the Roman era he was often depicted as Aion, god of eternal time, as a man holding the zodiac-wheel and standing above the reclining Gaia.

claims.quote: According to the writer of the War of the Titans Ouranos (Uranus) was the son of Aither (Aether).
claims.locator: Classical literature quotes: cosmogony of Eumelus

statement.id: Menurut penulis War of the Titans, Ouranos adalah putra Aither.
statement.en: According to the writer of the War of the Titans, Ouranos was the son of Aither.

claims.quote: In Orphism, the world began with Chronos (Time). ... Phanes gave birth to Nyx (Night), then Nyx bore Gaia and Uranus with Phanes.
claims.locator: The Creation of the World According to Orphism

statement.id: Dalam Orfisme, Phanes melahirkan Nyx (Malam), lalu Nyx melahirkan Gaia dan Uranus bersama Phanes.
statement.en: In Orphism, Phanes gave birth to Nyx (Night), and then Nyx bore Gaia and Uranus with Phanes.

claims.quote: Although there is barely any surviving evidence of worship to Uranus, he does have an Orphic hymn dedicated to him.

statement.id: Meski nyaris tidak ada bukti ibadah kepada Uranus yang bertahan, ia memiliki satu himne Orfik yang dipersembahkan untuknya.
statement.en: Although there is barely any surviving evidence of worship of Uranus, one Orphic hymn is dedicated to him.

claims.quote: Uranus, along with Gaia and Styx, was often the witness to the oaths of the gods.
claims.locator: Witness to the Oaths of the Gods

statement.id: Uranus bersama Gaia dan Styx sering menjadi saksi sumpah para dewa.
statement.en: Uranus, along with Gaia and Styx, was often the witness to the oaths of the gods.

claims.quote: According to the Theogony, there is an equal distance between Tartarus (the infernal regions), Earth (Gaia), and the heavens (Uranus). Therefore, an anvil falling from Uranus would take nine days and nights to reach Gaia

statement.id: Menurut Theogony, jarak antara Tartarus, Bumi (Gaia), dan langit (Uranus) sama; sebuah landasan yang jatuh dari Uranus butuh sembilan hari sembilan malam untuk mencapai Gaia.
statement.en: According to the Theogony, Tartarus, Earth and the heavens are equally far apart; an anvil falling from Uranus would take nine days and nights to reach Gaia.

claims.quote: Uranus lost power to Cronus but warned him that he, too, would face being overthrown by his son.

statement.id: Uranus kehilangan kekuasaan kepada Cronus tetapi memperingatkannya bahwa ia pun akan digulingkan oleh putranya.
statement.en: Uranus lost power to Cronus but warned him that he too would be overthrown by his son.

claims.quote: A desperate Rhea approached Uranus and Gaia for help, and they helped her run away to Crete, where Zeus was born.

statement.id: Rhea yang putus asa meminta bantuan Uranus dan Gaia, dan mereka membantunya melarikan diri ke Kreta, tempat Zeus lahir.
statement.en: A desperate Rhea asked Uranus and Gaia for help, and they helped her flee to Crete, where Zeus was born.

claims.quote: After Zeus married his first wife, Metis, Uranus and Gaia informed him that Metis would have a daughter who was strong and wise like her father and a son who would overthrow his father to become king of the gods and men.

statement.id: Uranus dan Gaia memberi tahu Zeus bahwa Metis akan melahirkan seorang putri yang kuat dan bijak serta seorang putra yang akan menggulingkan ayahnya menjadi raja para dewa dan manusia.
statement.en: Uranus and Gaia told Zeus that Metis would have a strong, wise daughter and a son who would overthrow his father to become king of gods and men.

claims.quote: The myth closely follows the Uranus-Cronus-Zeus succession myth found in Hesiod's Theogony. Anu, the king of Heaven, can clearly be identified as Uranus.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, mitos itu sangat mirip dengan mitos suksesi Uranus-Cronus-Zeus dalam Theogony Hesiod, dan Anu, raja Langit, dapat jelas dikenali sebagai Uranus.
statement.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, the myth closely follows the Uranus-Cronus-Zeus succession myth in Hesiod's Theogony, and Anu, king of Heaven, can clearly be identified as Uranus.

claims.quote: During the 20th-century excavations in the village of Boĝazköy (Turkey), a set of tablets were discovered that recounted the Hittite story of the storm god Teššub's rise to power and the attempts to overthrow him.

statement.id: Tablet yang ditemukan dalam penggalian di desa Boĝazköy menceritakan kisah Het tentang kebangkitan dewa badai Teššub dan upaya menggulingkannya.
statement.en: Tablets found in excavations at the village of Boĝazköy recount the Hittite story of the storm god Teššub's rise to power and the attempts to overthrow him.

claims.quote: What is considered a Phoenician version of the succession myth is recorded by Herennius Philo (aka Philo of Byblos, l. 1st or 2nd century CE).

statement.id: Versi mitos suksesi yang dianggap versi Fenisia dicatat oleh Herennius Philo (Philo dari Byblos, abad ke-1 atau ke-2 M).
statement.en: What is considered a Phoenician version of the succession myth is recorded by Herennius Philo (Philo of Byblos, 1st or 2nd century CE).

claims.quote: Together they have a son named Epigeios, who would later be named Uranus, and a daughter called Ge (Gaia). After his father's death, Epigeios (Uranus) replaced him as king and married his sister, Ge.

statement.id: Dalam versi suksesi ini, Epigeios, yang kemudian dinamai Uranus, menggantikan ayahnya sebagai raja dan menikahi saudarinya, Ge (Gaia).
statement.en: In this succession version, Epigeios, later named Uranus, replaced his father as king and married his sister Ge (Gaia).

claims.quote: During the 32nd year of his reign, Cronus emasculated Uranus.

statement.id: Dalam versi itu, pada tahun ke-32 pemerintahannya Cronus mengebiri Uranus.
statement.en: In that version, Cronus emasculated Uranus in the 32nd year of his reign.

claims.quote: it was fellow astronomer Johann Elert Bode (1747-1826) who suggested that it be called Uranus in honour of the primordial deity

statement.id: Astronom Johann Elert Bode mengusulkan agar planet itu dinamai Uranus untuk menghormati dewa purba tersebut.
statement.en: The astronomer Johann Elert Bode suggested that the planet be called Uranus in honour of the primordial deity.

claims.quote: Uranus is the seventh planet from the Sun and the third largest of the planets. It was discovered in 1781 by the British-German astronomer William Herschel (1738-1822)

statement.id: Planet Uranus ditemukan pada 1781 oleh astronom Inggris-Jerman William Herschel.
statement.en: The planet Uranus was discovered in 1781 by the British-German astronomer William Herschel.

claims.quote: In his Theogony, Hesiod (700 BCE) writes that Gaia, the personification of Earth, gave birth to Uranus (Heaven), along with Pontus (the Sea) and Ourea (the Mountains).

statement.id: Dalam Theogony-nya, Hesiod (700 SM) menulis bahwa Gaia melahirkan Uranus (Langit) bersama Pontus (Laut) dan Ourea (Pegunungan).
statement.en: In his Theogony, Hesiod (700 BCE) writes that Gaia bore Uranus (Heaven) along with Pontus (the Sea) and Ourea (the Mountains).

claims.quote: Orphism was a religious movement that rose to prominence during the 6th century BCE.
claims.locator: The Creation of the World According to Orphism

statement.id: Orfisme adalah gerakan keagamaan yang menonjol pada abad ke-6 SM.
statement.en: Orphism was a religious movement that rose to prominence during the 6th century BCE.

claims.quote: And Earth first bore starry Heaven, equal to herself, to cover her on every side, and to be an ever-sure abiding-place for the blessed gods.

statement.id: Menurut Hesiod, Bumi pertama-tama melahirkan Langit berbintang, setara dengannya, untuk menutupinya di semua sisi dan menjadi tempat tinggal yang selalu aman bagi para dewa yang diberkati.
statement.en: According to Hesiod, Earth first bore starry Heaven, equal to herself, to cover her on every side and be an ever-sure abiding place for the blessed gods.

claims.quote: But afterwards she lay with Heaven and bore deep-swirling Oceanus, Coeus and Crius and Hyperion and Iapetus, [135] Theia and Rhea, Themis and Mnemosyne and gold-crowned Phoebe and lovely Tethys.

statement.id: Hesiod menulis bahwa Gaia kemudian berbaring bersama Langit dan melahirkan Oceanus, Coeus, Crius, Hyperion, Iapetus, Theia, Rhea, Themis, Mnemosyne, Phoebe, dan Tethys.
statement.en: Hesiod writes that Earth afterwards lay with Heaven and bore Oceanus, Coeus, Crius, Hyperion, Iapetus, Theia, Rhea, Themis, Mnemosyne, Phoebe and Tethys.

claims.quote: For of all the children that were born of Earth and Heaven, [155] these were the most terrible, and they were hated by their own father from the first. And he used to hide them all away in a secret place of Earth so soon as each was born, and would not suffer them to come up into the light: and Heaven rejoiced in his evil doing.

statement.id: Menurut Hesiod, anak-anak terdahsyat Bumi dan Langit dibenci ayah mereka sejak awal; setiap kali seorang lahir ia menyembunyikannya di tempat rahasia di Bumi dan melarangnya naik ke terang, dan Langit bersukacita atas perbuatan jahatnya.
statement.en: According to Hesiod, the most terrible children of Earth and Heaven were hated by their father from the first; as each was born he hid it in a secret place of Earth and would not let it come up into the light, and Heaven rejoiced in his evil doing.

claims.quote: Forthwith she made the element of grey flint and shaped a great sickle, and told her plan to her dear sons.

statement.id: Menurut Hesiod, Bumi membentuk sabit besar dari unsur batu api kelabu dan menyampaikan rencananya kepada putra-putranya.
statement.en: According to Hesiod, Earth made the element of grey flint into a great sickle and told her plan to her sons.

claims.quote: And Heaven came, bringing on night and longing for love, and he lay about Earth spreading himself full upon her. ... Then the son from his ambush stretched forth his left hand and in his right took the great long sickle [180] with jagged teeth, and swiftly lopped off his own father's members and cast them away to fall behind him.

statement.id: Dalam Hesiod, Langit datang membawa malam dan merindukan cinta lalu merebahkan diri di atas Bumi; putranya dari penyergapan memotong anggota tubuh ayahnya dengan sabit panjang bergerigi dan melemparkannya ke belakang.
statement.en: In Hesiod, Heaven came bringing night and longing for love and spread himself upon Earth; his son from his ambush lopped off his father's members with the long jagged sickle and cast them behind him.

claims.quote: for all the bloody drops that gushed forth Earth received, and as the seasons moved round [185] she bore the strong Erinyes and the great Giants with gleaming armour, holding long spears in their hands and the Nymphs whom they call Meliae

statement.id: Menurut Hesiod, Bumi menerima semua tetes darah itu dan seiring musim ia melahirkan Erinyes yang kuat, para Raksasa berbaju zirah gemerlap bertombak panjang, dan Nimfa yang disebut Meliae.
statement.en: According to Hesiod, Earth received all the bloody drops and as the seasons turned bore the strong Erinyes, the Giants in gleaming armour with long spears, and the Nymphs called Meliae.

claims.quote: But these sons whom he begot himself great Heaven used to call Titans (Strainers) in reproach, for he said that they strained and did presumptuously [210] a fearful deed, and that vengeance for it would come afterwards.

statement.id: Menurut Hesiod, Langit yang agung menjuluki putra-putranya "Titan" (Para Penegang) sebagai celaan, karena mereka berbuat lancang suatu perbuatan mengerikan, dan ia berkata bahwa pembalasan akan datang kemudian.
statement.en: According to Hesiod, great Heaven called his sons Titans (Strainers) in reproach, saying they strained and did presumptuously a fearful deed, and that vengeance for it would come afterwards.

claims.quote: However, no cult addressed directly to Uranus survived into classical times, and Uranus does not appear among the usual themes of Greek painted pottery.

statement.id: Tidak ada kultus yang ditujukan langsung kepada Uranus yang bertahan hingga masa klasik, dan Uranus tidak termasuk tema lazim keramik lukis Yunani.
statement.en: No cult addressed directly to Uranus survived into classical times, and Uranus is not among the usual themes of Greek painted pottery.

claims.quote: is the personification of the sky and one of the Greek primordial deities. According to Hesiod, Uranus was the son and husband of Gaia (Earth), with whom he fathered the first generation of Titans.

statement.id: Uranus adalah personifikasi langit dan salah satu dewa purba Yunani; menurut Hesiod ia putra sekaligus suami Gaia, yang bersamanya menurunkan generasi pertama Titan.
statement.en: Uranus is the personification of the sky and one of the Greek primordial deities; according to Hesiod he was the son and husband of Gaia, with whom he fathered the first generation of Titans.

claims.quote: Most linguists trace the etymology of the name Οὐρανός to a Proto-Greek form *Worsanós

statement.id: Kebanyakan ahli bahasa menelusuri etimologi nama Οὐρανός ke bentuk Proto-Yunani *Worsanós.
statement.en: Most linguists trace the etymology of the name Οὐρανός to a Proto-Greek form *Worsanós.

claims.quote: making Ouranos the "rain-maker", or the "lord of rain".

statement.id: Akar kata Indo-Eropa dasarnya menjadikan Ouranos "pembuat hujan" atau "penguasa hujan".
statement.en: The basic Indo-European root makes Ouranos the "rain-maker" or the "lord of rain".

claims.quote: Of some importance in the comparative study of Indo-European mythology is the contested identification by Georges Dumézil (1934) of Uranus with the Vedic deity Váruṇa (Mitanni Aruna), god of the sky and waters, but the etymological equation is now considered untenable.

statement.id: Georges Dumézil (1934) mengidentifikasi Uranus dengan dewa Weda Váruṇa, tetapi persamaan etimologis itu kini dianggap tidak dapat dipertahankan.
statement.en: Georges Dumézil (1934) identified Uranus with the Vedic deity Váruṇa, but the etymological equation is now considered untenable.

claims.quote: He is, however, identified on the Gigantomachy frieze on the Pergamon Altar, bearded and winged, fighting against the Giants with a sword

statement.id: Uranus diidentifikasi pada relief Gigantomachy di Altar Pergamon, berjenggot dan bersayap, melawan para Raksasa dengan pedang.
statement.en: Uranus is identified on the Gigantomachy frieze of the Pergamon Altar, bearded and winged, fighting the Giants with a sword.

claims.quote: After his castration, Uranus recedes into the background.

statement.id: Setelah dikebiri, peran Uranus surut ke latar belakang.
statement.en: After his castration, Uranus recedes into the background.

summary.id: Hesiod: Gaia melahirkan Langit dari dirinya sendiri; Uranus juga menjadi suaminya.
summary.en: Hesiod: Gaia bore Heaven; Uranus also became her husband.

summary.id: Penulis War of the Titans: Ouranos putra Aither.
summary.en: The writer of the War of the Titans: Ouranos was the son of Aither.

summary.id: Orfisme: Nyx melahirkan Gaia dan Uranus bersama Phanes.
summary.en: Orphism: Nyx bore Gaia and Uranus with Phanes.

summary.id: Versi yang dianggap versi Fenisia: Epigeios, yang kemudian dinamai Uranus, menggantikan ayahnya sebagai raja dan menikahi saudarinya.
summary.en: Version considered Phoenician: Epigeios, later named Uranus, replaced his father as king and married his sister.

topic.en: Name etymology and the Váruṇa identification

summary.id: Kebanyakan ahli bahasa menelusuri nama ke bentuk Proto-Yunani *Worsanós ("pembuat hujan").
summary.en: Most linguists trace the name to Proto-Greek *Worsanós ("rain-maker").

summary.id: Dumézil menyamakan Uranus dengan Váruṇa, tetapi persamaan etimologis itu kini dianggap tidak dapat dipertahankan.
summary.en: Dumézil equated Uranus with Váruṇa, but the etymological equation is now considered untenable.

Tidak ada sumber yang menyatakan fungsi kultural secara eksplisit selain bahwa tidak ada kultus langsung yang bertahan.

short_description.id: Saraswati adalah dewi Hindu yang dikaitkan dengan ilmu, kebijaksanaan, musik, dan seni; ia juga dewi ujaran dan, pada awalnya, sungai suci.
short_description.en: Saraswati is a Hindu goddess associated with learning, wisdom, music, and the arts; she is also the goddess of speech and, originally, a sacred river.

long_description.id:
Saraswati (juga ditulis Sarasvati) dikenal dalam tradisi Hindu sebagai dewi ilmu, kebijaksanaan, musik, dan estetika. Sebagai Vac, ia adalah dewi ujaran. Ia dikenal pula dengan nama seperti Bharati, Vedamata ("ibu para Veda"), dan Vagisvari. Ia juga pelindung seni dan ilmu pengetahuan, dan dipuja sebagai dewi ilmu dalam Jainisme serta oleh beberapa sekte Buddha.

Namanya pertama muncul dalam Rigveda, dan dalam teks keagamaan yang lebih belakangan ia disebut penemu bahasa Sanskerta serta pemberi pena dan tinta kepada Ganesha. Nama Saraswati berarti "anggun", "mengalir", dan "berair". Mula-mula ia dikaitkan dengan sungai kuno yang bernama sama, dan sungai itu kemudian berkembang menjadi dewi yang dipersonifikasikan. Seiring waktu ia semakin dirayakan sebagai dewi segala perairan.

Himne Rigveda dalam terjemahan Griffith memuji Sarasvati sebagai sungai dahsyat yang menjebol punggung bukit dengan ombaknya dan menemukan sungai bagi suku-suku manusia. Ia juga digambarkan menjatuhkan mereka yang menghina para dewa, bersaudara tujuh, dan berasal dari tiga sumber.

Dalam mitologi Hindu, Saraswati adalah istri Brahma, tetapi sebagian tradisi menyebutnya mula-mula istri Vishnu. Menurut satu kisah, Brahma menunggu istrinya untuk memulai upacara penting lalu para dewa menciptakan istri baru baginya, Gayatri. Saraswati yang tiba kemudian mengutuk Brahma agar tidak dipuja manusia. Putranya adalah resi Sarasvata, yang selamat dari Kekeringan Besar sebagai penyimpan kitab Veda.

Saraswati Puja dirayakan pada hari pertama musim semi: pemuja mengenakan pakaian kuning, arca sang dewi dibalut sutra kuning, dan anak-anak diajari menulis untuk pertama kalinya. Musisi berdoa kepadanya sebelum konser dan pelajar sebelum ujian. Ia juga dipuja dalam perayaan Navaratri.

Dalam seni Hindu ia biasanya digambarkan sebagai remaja anggun berkulit putih dengan sari putih bertepi biru, sering berlengan empat dengan manuskrip, teratai putih, dan vina, serta dapat menunggang angsa atau soang. Ia lazim ditemani angsa, meskipun sebuah cetakan menampilkan merak di sisinya.
long_description.en:
In Hindu tradition Saraswati (also written Sarasvati) is the goddess of learning, wisdom, music, and aesthetics. As Vac she presides over speech. She also bears names such as Bharati, Vedamata ("mother of the Vedas"), and Vagisvari. She is a patron of the arts and sciences too, and is revered as a goddess of learning in Jainism and among some Buddhist sects.

Her earliest appearance is in the Rigveda, and later religious texts name her as the inventor of Sanskrit and the giver of pen and ink to Ganesha. Her name means "elegant", "flowing", and "watery". She was originally linked with an ancient river of the same name, which later developed into a personified deity. Over time she came to be celebrated as the goddess of all waters.

A Rigveda hymn in Griffith's translation praises Sarasvati as a mighty river that bursts the ridges of the hills with her waves and discovers rivers for the tribes of men. She is also described as casting down those who scorned the gods, as seven-sistered, and as sprung from a threefold source.

In Hindu mythology Saraswati is Brahma's wife, though some traditions call her first the wife of Vishnu. In one tale, Brahma waited for his wife to begin an important ceremony, so the gods created a new wife for him, Gayatri. When Saraswati arrived later, she cursed Brahma never to be worshipped by humanity. Her son is the rishi Sarasvata, who survived the Great Drought as a keeper of the Vedas.

The Saraswati Puja is held on the first day of spring: worshippers wear yellow, statues of the goddess are draped in yellow silk, and children are taught to write for the first time. Musicians pray to her before concerts and students before examinations. She is also worshipped at Navaratri.

In Hindu art she is usually shown as a graceful white-skinned youth in a white sari with a blue border, often four-armed with a manuscript, a white lotus, and a vina, and may ride a swan or goose. A swan conventionally accompanies her, though one print shows a peacock beside her.

She also bears names such as Bharati, Vedamata ("mother of the Vedas"), and Vagisvari. She is a patron of the arts and sciences too, and is revered as a goddess of learning in Jainism and among some Buddhist sects.

long_description.id: Namanya pertama muncul dalam Rigveda, dan dalam teks keagamaan yang lebih belakangan ia disebut penemu bahasa Sanskerta serta pemberi pena dan tinta kepada Ganesha. Nama Saraswati berarti "anggun", "mengalir", dan "berair". Mula-mula ia dikaitkan dengan sungai kuno yang bernama sama, dan sungai itu kemudian berkembang menjadi dewi yang dipersonifikasikan. Seiring waktu ia semakin dirayakan sebagai dewi segala perairan.
long_description.en: Her earliest appearance is in the Rigveda, and later religious texts name her as the inventor of Sanskrit and the giver of pen and ink to Ganesha. Her name means "elegant", "flowing", and "watery". She was originally linked with an ancient river of the same name, which later developed into a personified deity. Over time she came to be celebrated as the goddess of all waters.

long_description.id: Himne Rigveda dalam terjemahan Griffith memuji Sarasvati sebagai sungai dahsyat yang menjebol punggung bukit dengan ombaknya dan menemukan sungai bagi suku-suku manusia. Ia juga digambarkan menjatuhkan mereka yang menghina para dewa, bersaudara tujuh, dan berasal dari tiga sumber.
long_description.en: A Rigveda hymn in Griffith's translation praises Sarasvati as a mighty river that bursts the ridges of the hills with her waves and discovers rivers for the tribes of men. She is also described as casting down those who scorned the gods, as seven-sistered, and as sprung from a threefold source.

long_description.id: Dalam mitologi Hindu, Saraswati adalah istri Brahma, tetapi sebagian tradisi menyebutnya mula-mula istri Vishnu. Menurut satu kisah, Brahma menunggu istrinya untuk memulai upacara penting lalu para dewa menciptakan istri baru baginya, Gayatri. Saraswati yang tiba kemudian mengutuk Brahma agar tidak dipuja manusia. Putranya adalah resi Sarasvata, yang selamat dari Kekeringan Besar sebagai penyimpan kitab Veda.
long_description.en: In Hindu mythology Saraswati is Brahma's wife, though some traditions call her first the wife of Vishnu. In one tale, Brahma waited for his wife to begin an important ceremony, so the gods created a new wife for him, Gayatri. When Saraswati arrived later, she cursed Brahma never to be worshipped by humanity. Her son is the rishi Sarasvata, who survived the Great Drought as a keeper of the Vedas.

long_description.id: Saraswati Puja dirayakan pada hari pertama musim semi: pemuja mengenakan pakaian kuning, arca sang dewi dibalut sutra kuning, dan anak-anak diajari menulis untuk pertama kalinya. Musisi berdoa kepadanya sebelum konser dan pelajar sebelum ujian. Ia juga dipuja dalam perayaan Navaratri.
long_description.en: The Saraswati Puja is held on the first day of spring: worshippers wear yellow, statues of the goddess are draped in yellow silk, and children are taught to write for the first time. Musicians pray to her before concerts and students before examinations. She is also worshipped at Navaratri.

long_description.id: Dalam seni Hindu ia biasanya digambarkan sebagai remaja anggun berkulit putih dengan sari putih bertepi biru, sering berlengan empat dengan manuskrip, teratai putih, dan vina, serta dapat menunggang angsa atau soang. Ia lazim ditemani angsa, meskipun sebuah cetakan menampilkan merak di sisinya.
long_description.en: In Hindu art she is usually shown as a graceful white-skinned youth in a white sari with a blue border, often four-armed with a manuscript, a white lotus, and a vina, and may ride a swan or goose. A swan conventionally accompanies her, though one print shows a peacock beside her.

cultural_context.id: Menurut keterangan koleksi museum, atribut Saraswati (vina, manuskrip seukuran telapak tangan, dan tasbih) menandai perannya sebagai dewi pengetahuan.
cultural_context.en: According to the museum catalog entry, Saraswati's attributes (the vina, a palm-sized manuscript, and a rosary) denote her role as a goddess of knowledge.

claims.quote: Saraswati (also Sarasvati) is the Hindu goddess of learning, wisdom, music, and aesthetics.

statement.id: Saraswati adalah dewi pembelajaran, kebijaksanaan, musik, dan estetika Hindu.
statement.en: Saraswati is the Hindu goddess of learning, wisdom, music, and aesthetics.

claims.quote: As Vac, she is the goddess of speech.

statement.id: Sebagai Vac, ia dipandang sebagai dewi ujaran.
statement.en: As Vac, she is the goddess of speech.

claims.quote: Saraswati first appears in the Rigveda and, in later religious texts, she is identified as the inventor of Sanskrit and, appropriately, gives Ganesha the gifts of pen and inks.

statement.en: Saraswati first appears in the Rigveda; in later religious texts she is identified as the inventor of Sanskrit and gives Ganesha the gifts of pen and ink.

claims.quote: The goddess has her own festivals, notably the Saraswati Puja, held on the first day of spring.

statement.id: Saraswati Puja dirayakan pada hari pertama musim semi.
statement.en: Saraswati Puja is held on the first day of spring.

claims.quote: Another object commonly seen in Saraswati's hands is the vina (the Hindu classical music instrument) which reminds of her gift of music to humanity.

statement.id: Vina sering digambarkan berada di tangan Saraswati.
statement.en: Saraswati is often depicted holding a vina.

claims.quote: Her attributes—the vina (a symbol of music and the arts), palm-sized manuscript (a symbol of learning), and rosary (a symbol of religious rites)—denote her role as a goddess of knowledge.

statement.id: Vina, manuskrip, dan tasbih menjadi atributnya yang melambangkan musik, pembelajaran, dan ritus.
statement.en: Her vina, manuscript, and rosary symbolize music, learning, and ritual.

claims.quote: Saraswati is conventionally accompanied by a swan, but a peacock stands beside her here, enchanted by the divine music she creates.

statement.id: Saraswati secara konvensional ditemani angsa, sementara satu cetakan menampilkan merak.
statement.en: Saraswati is conventionally accompanied by a swan, though this print shows a peacock.

claims.quote: Originally associated with an ancient lost river that bore her name, Saraswati increasingly came to be celebrated as the goddess of all waters and their life-giving and purifying powers.

statement.id: Saraswati awalnya terkait sungai kuno senama, lalu dipuja sebagai dewi seluruh perairan.

statement.en: As the patron of music she is frequently prayed to by musicians before concerts, and as a goddess of intellectual pursuits by students before examinations.

statement.en: In Hindu mythology Saraswati is the wife of the great god Brahma, but according to some traditions she was first the wife of Vishnu.

claims.quote: One day, when, awaiting his wife to begin an important religious ceremony and so unable to start the ritual punctually, Brahma asked the gods' advice. They responded by creating a new wife for him, Gayatri, so that the ceremony could go ahead at the precise time.

short_description.id: Aten adalah dewa matahari Mesir kuno berwujud cakram matahari dengan sinar berujung tangan, dipuja sebagai dewa utama pada masa Akhenaten.
short_description.en: Aten is an ancient Egyptian sun god shown as a sun disk with rays ending in hands, worshipped as the principal deity under Akhenaten.

long_description.id:
Aten adalah dewa matahari Mesir kuno yang digambarkan sebagai cakram matahari, dengan sinar yang berujung tangan dan menawarkan kehidupan kepada raja serta perempuan terdekatnya. Kata aten sendiri berarti "cakram", dan pada mulanya Aten merupakan salah satu aspek Ra. Pada masa Amenhotep III ia dipuja luas, tetapi sumber berbeda menilai kedudukannya sebelum Akhenaten, sebagai dewa matahari yang lebih kecil atau sebagai dewa pencipta terkemuka.

Pada masa Akhenaten, Aten disembah sebagai dewa utama dan Akhenaten mendirikan Amarna sebagai pusat keyakinannya. Pembaruan ini mengecualikan kultus dewa lain, dan himne masa Amarna berbeda secara radikal karena menyingkirkan dewa-dewa lain secara sistematis. Himne Agung kepada Aten menjadi sumber utama untuk memahami perubahan itu. Dalam himne itu Aten dipuji sebagai pemberi kehidupan yang menumbuhkan benih, menyingkirkan kegelapan, dan membuat musim serta banjir.

Kuil Aten di Amarna terbuka dan tidak beratap, dengan ruang luas serta altar persembahan. Dalam prasasti, Aten memelihara rakyat melalui Akhenaten, sehingga keluarga kerajaan menjadi perantara pemujaannya. Sarjana berbeda pendapat apakah agama ini monoteisme, monolatri, atau henoteisme.

Setelah Akhenaten wafat, Tutankhamun memindahkan ibu kota dari Akhetaten, membuka kembali kuil-kuil bagi dewa lain, dan mulai memulihkan praktik keagamaan terdahulu.
long_description.en:
Aten is an ancient Egyptian sun god shown as a sun disk, with rays ending in hands that offer life to the king and the women nearest to him. The word aten itself means "disc", and Aten was originally an aspect of Ra. He was widely worshipped under Amenhotep III, although sources differ on his standing before Akhenaten, calling him either a minor solar deity or a preeminent creator deity.

Under Akhenaten, Aten was worshipped as the principal deity and Akhenaten founded Amarna as a center for his beliefs. The reform excluded the cult of other deities, and the Amarna hymn is radically different in systematically excluding other gods. The Great Hymn to the Aten is the principal source for understanding the change. In that hymn Aten is praised as the giver of life who makes seed grow, removes the darkness, and makes the seasons and floods.

The temples of Aten at Amarna were open and unroofed, with vast spaces and altars for offerings. In inscriptions Aten cares for the people through Akhenaten, making the royal family intermediaries for his worship. Scholars disagree on whether the religion was monotheism, monolatry, or henotheism.

After Akhenaten died, Tutankhamun moved the capital away from Akhetaten, reopened the temples to other gods, and began restoring the earlier religious practices.

short_description.id: Aten adalah dewa matahari Mesir kuno berwujud cakram matahari dengan sinar berujung tangan, dipuja sebagai dewa utama pada masa Akhenaten.
short_description.en: Aten is an ancient Egyptian sun god shown as a sun disk with rays ending in hands, worshipped as the principal deity under Akhenaten.

long_description.id: Aten adalah dewa matahari Mesir kuno yang digambarkan sebagai cakram matahari, dengan sinar yang berujung tangan dan menawarkan kehidupan kepada raja serta perempuan terdekatnya. Kata aten sendiri berarti "cakram", dan pada mulanya Aten merupakan salah satu aspek Ra. Pada masa Amenhotep III ia dipuja luas, tetapi sumber berbeda menilai kedudukannya sebelum Akhenaten, sebagai dewa matahari yang lebih kecil atau sebagai dewa pencipta terkemuka.
long_description.en: Aten is an ancient Egyptian sun god shown as a sun disk, with rays ending in hands that offer life to the king and the women nearest to him. The word aten itself means "disc", and Aten was originally an aspect of Ra. He was widely worshipped under Amenhotep III, although sources differ on his standing before Akhenaten, calling him either a minor solar deity or a preeminent creator deity.

long_description.id: Pada masa Akhenaten, Aten disembah sebagai dewa utama dan Akhenaten mendirikan Amarna sebagai pusat keyakinannya. Pembaruan ini mengecualikan kultus dewa lain, dan himne masa Amarna berbeda secara radikal karena menyingkirkan dewa-dewa lain secara sistematis. Himne Agung kepada Aten menjadi sumber utama untuk memahami perubahan itu. Dalam himne itu Aten dipuji sebagai pemberi kehidupan yang menumbuhkan benih, menyingkirkan kegelapan, dan membuat musim serta banjir.
long_description.en: Under Akhenaten, Aten was worshipped as the principal deity and Akhenaten founded Amarna as a center for his beliefs. The reform excluded the cult of other deities, and the Amarna hymn is radically different in systematically excluding other gods. The Great Hymn to the Aten is the principal source for understanding the change. In that hymn Aten is praised as the giver of life who makes seed grow, removes the darkness, and makes the seasons and floods.

long_description.id: Kuil Aten di Amarna terbuka dan tidak beratap, dengan ruang luas serta altar persembahan. Dalam prasasti, Aten memelihara rakyat melalui Akhenaten, sehingga keluarga kerajaan menjadi perantara pemujaannya. Sarjana berbeda pendapat apakah agama ini monoteisme, monolatri, atau henoteisme.
long_description.en: The temples of Aten at Amarna were open and unroofed, with vast spaces and altars for offerings. In inscriptions Aten cares for the people through Akhenaten, making the royal family intermediaries for his worship. Scholars disagree on whether the religion was monotheism, monolatry, or henotheism.

long_description.id: Setelah Akhenaten wafat, Tutankhamun memindahkan ibu kota dari Akhetaten, membuka kembali kuil-kuil bagi dewa lain, dan mulai memulihkan praktik keagamaan terdahulu.
long_description.en: After Akhenaten died, Tutankhamun moved the capital away from Akhetaten, reopened the temples to other gods, and began restoring the earlier religious practices.

cultural_context.id: Dalam prasasti masa Amarna, Aten digambarkan memelihara rakyat melalui Akhenaten, sehingga keluarga kerajaan berperan sebagai perantara pemujaan Aten.
cultural_context.en: In Amarna-period inscriptions the Aten is shown caring for the people through Akhenaten, so that the royal family act as intermediaries for the Aten's worship.

origin.id: Aten berasal dari agama Mesir kuno dan pada mulanya merupakan salah satu aspek dewa matahari Ra.
origin.en: Aten comes from ancient Egyptian religion and was originally an aspect of the sun god Ra.

role.id: Pada masa Akhenaten, Aten menjadi dewa utama yang dipuja di pusat keyakinan sang raja di Amarna.

description.id: Sinarnya berujung tangan yang menawarkan kehidupan, dan Himne Agung memujinya sebagai pemberi napas bagi semua ciptaannya. Menurut himne itu, makhluk hidup ketika ia bersinar dan mati ketika ia beristirahat.
description.en: His rays end in hands offering life, and the Great Hymn praises him as the one who gives breath to all he made. According to the hymn, beings live when he shines and die when he rests.

name.en: Creator and moulder of the earth

description.en: Atenism holds that Aten created all countries and people, and the Great Hymn says he moulds the earth to his wish alone.

name.en: Sending floods and making the seasons

description.en: According to the Great Hymn, Aten provides a Flood in the sky for foreigners and a Flood from the underworld for Egypt, and makes the seasons.

description.en: Under Amenhotep III Aten was depicted as a falcon-headed god like Ra, unlike the sun disk with hand-ended rays of the Amarna period.

title.en: The Great Hymn to the Aten

summary.id: Himne ini memuji Aten yang terbit dari cakrawala, jauh namun sinarnya ada di bumi, menyingkirkan kegelapan, memberi kehidupan, dan menyediakan banjir bagi negeri-negeri. Prasastinya tertulis di dinding makam Ay di Amarna dan menjadi sumber utama tentang pembaruan agama masa Akhenaten.
summary.en: The hymn praises Aten rising from the horizon, distant yet with rays on earth, removing the darkness, giving life, and providing floods for the lands. Its inscription is on a wall of the courtier Ay at Amarna and is the principal source on the religious reform of Akhenaten's reign.

short_description.id: Cronus atau Kronos adalah Titan dalam mitologi Yunani, raja para Titan dan dewa waktu yang menggulingkan ayahnya, menelan anak-anaknya, lalu digulingkan Zeus.
short_description.en: Cronus or Kronos is a Titan of Greek mythology, king of the Titans and a god of time, who deposed his father, swallowed his children, and was overthrown by Zeus.

long_description.id:
Cronus atau Kronos adalah Titan, putra bungsu Uranus dan Gaia. Menurut Hesiodos, ia anak yang terakhir lahir dan paling mengerikan, dan ia membenci ayahnya. Dengan sabit, ia menggulingkan Uranus dan menjadi raja pertama dunia; Theoi menyebutnya raja para Titan dan dewa waktu, terutama waktu sebagai kekuatan yang menghancurkan dan melahap segalanya. Ia biasanya digambarkan membawa harpe, arit, atau sabit.

Pemerintahan Cronus dianggap Zaman Keemasan, masa tanpa penyakit, kelaparan, atau kesulitan, dan ia juga memerintah Kepulauan Orang Berbahagia. Ia menikahi Rhea dan mempunyai enam anak: Hestia, Demeter, Hera, Hades, Poseidon, dan Zeus. Karena takut digulingkan anaknya, Cronus menelan setiap anak yang lahir; Hesiodos mencatat bahwa ia mengetahui takdir itu dari Bumi dan Langit.

Rhea menyelamatkan Zeus dengan menyembunyikannya di Kreta dan memberi Cronus batu terbungkus kain untuk ditelan. Zeus kemudian memaksa Cronus memuntahkan saudara-saudaranya; Hesiodos menyebut Cronus terperdaya saran Bumi, sedangkan sumber lain menyebut ramuan yang dibawa Zeus. Perang sepuluh tahun pun dimulai antara para Titan dari Gunung Othrys dan para dewa dari Gunung Olympus.

Nasib Cronus setelah kekalahan berbeda-beda menurut kisah: satu versi menyebutnya mengembara sendirian untuk mengukur keabadian, versi lain menyebut ia dikirim ke Tartarus, dan versi lain lagi menyebut Zeus membebaskannya dan menjadikannya raja Kepulauan Orang Berbahagia. Ia dipuja antara lain di Bukit Cronus di Olympia dan melalui festival Kronia, dan dikaitkan dengan Saturnus, Geb, Ēl, dan Kumarbi.
long_description.en:
Cronus or Kronos is a Titan, the youngest son of Uranus and Gaia. According to Hesiod, he was the last born and most terrible of the children, and he hated his father. With a sickle he deposed Uranus and became the world's first king; Theoi calls him king of the Titans and a god of time, especially time as a destructive, all-devouring force. He is usually depicted with a harpe, scythe, or sickle.

Cronus's rule was regarded as the Golden Age, a time without disease, hunger, or hardship, and he also ruled the Isles of the Blessed. He married Rhea and had six children: Hestia, Demeter, Hera, Hades, Poseidon, and Zeus. Fearing overthrow by his children, Cronus swallowed each child as it was born; Hesiod records that he learned this fate from Earth and Heaven.

Rhea saved Zeus by hiding him on Crete and giving Cronus a swaddled stone to swallow. Zeus later forced Cronus to disgorge his siblings; Hesiod says Cronus was beguiled by Earth's suggestions, while another source describes a mixture Zeus brought him. A ten-year war then began between the Titans from Mount Othrys and the gods from Mount Olympus.

Accounts of Cronus's fate after defeat differ: one has him wander the world alone measuring out eternity, another has him sent to Tartarus, and another has Zeus free him and make him king of the Isles of the Blessed. He was worshipped at, among other places, the Hill of Cronus at Olympia and through the festival of the Kronia, and is linked with the Roman god Saturn, Geb, Ēl, and Kumarbi.

cultural_context.id: Cronus menerima persembahan di Bukit Cronus di Olympia, memiliki kuil di Gadir dan Athena, dan dihormati dalam festival Kronia. Cronus kemungkinan semula dewa panen, dan bulan panen di banyak daerah Yunani dinamai Cronion menurut namanya. Bangsa Romawi memadukannya dengan Saturnus dan memandangnya secara lebih positif.
cultural_context.en: Cronus received offerings at the Hill of Cronus in Olympia, had temples at Gadir and Athens, and was honoured in the Kronia festival. He was likely originally a harvest god, and the harvest month in many parts of Greece was named Cronion after him. The Romans conflated him with Saturn and took a more positive view of him.

short_description.id: Cronus atau Kronos adalah Titan dalam mitologi Yunani, raja para Titan dan dewa waktu yang menggulingkan ayahnya, menelan anak-anaknya, lalu digulingkan Zeus.
short_description.en: Cronus or Kronos is a Titan of Greek mythology, king of the Titans and a god of time, who deposed his father, swallowed his children, and was overthrown by Zeus.

long_description.id: Cronus atau Kronos adalah Titan, putra bungsu Uranus dan Gaia. Menurut Hesiodos, ia anak yang terakhir lahir dan paling mengerikan, dan ia membenci ayahnya. Dengan sabit, ia menggulingkan Uranus dan menjadi raja pertama dunia; Theoi menyebutnya raja para Titan dan dewa waktu, terutama waktu sebagai kekuatan yang menghancurkan dan melahap segalanya. Ia biasanya digambarkan membawa harpe, arit, atau sabit.
long_description.en: Cronus or Kronos is a Titan, the youngest son of Uranus and Gaia. According to Hesiod, he was the last born and most terrible of the children, and he hated his father. With a sickle he deposed Uranus and became the world's first king; Theoi calls him king of the Titans and a god of time, especially time as a destructive, all-devouring force. He is usually depicted with a harpe, scythe, or sickle.

long_description.id: Pemerintahan Cronus dianggap Zaman Keemasan, masa tanpa penyakit, kelaparan, atau kesulitan, dan ia juga memerintah Kepulauan Orang Berbahagia. Ia menikahi Rhea dan mempunyai enam anak: Hestia, Demeter, Hera, Hades, Poseidon, dan Zeus. Karena takut digulingkan anaknya, Cronus menelan setiap anak yang lahir; Hesiodos mencatat bahwa ia mengetahui takdir itu dari Bumi dan Langit.
long_description.en: Cronus's rule was regarded as the Golden Age, a time without disease, hunger, or hardship, and he also ruled the Isles of the Blessed. He married Rhea and had six children: Hestia, Demeter, Hera, Hades, Poseidon, and Zeus. Fearing overthrow by his children, Cronus swallowed each child as it was born; Hesiod records that he learned this fate from Earth and Heaven.

long_description.id: Rhea menyelamatkan Zeus dengan menyembunyikannya di Kreta dan memberi Cronus batu terbungkus kain untuk ditelan. Zeus kemudian memaksa Cronus memuntahkan saudara-saudaranya; Hesiodos menyebut Cronus terperdaya saran Bumi, sedangkan sumber lain menyebut ramuan yang dibawa Zeus. Perang sepuluh tahun pun dimulai antara para Titan dari Gunung Othrys dan para dewa dari Gunung Olympus.
long_description.en: Rhea saved Zeus by hiding him on Crete and giving Cronus a swaddled stone to swallow. Zeus later forced Cronus to disgorge his siblings; Hesiod says Cronus was beguiled by Earth's suggestions, while another source describes a mixture Zeus brought him. A ten-year war then began between the Titans from Mount Othrys and the gods from Mount Olympus.

long_description.id: Nasib Cronus setelah kekalahan berbeda-beda menurut kisah: satu versi menyebutnya mengembara sendirian untuk mengukur keabadian, versi lain menyebut ia dikirim ke Tartarus, dan versi lain lagi menyebut Zeus membebaskannya dan menjadikannya raja Kepulauan Orang Berbahagia. Ia dipuja antara lain di Bukit Cronus di Olympia dan melalui festival Kronia, dan dikaitkan dengan Saturnus, Geb, Ēl, dan Kumarbi.
long_description.en: Accounts of Cronus's fate after defeat differ: one has him wander the world alone measuring out eternity, another has him sent to Tartarus, and another has Zeus free him and make him king of the Isles of the Blessed. He was worshipped at, among other places, the Hill of Cronus at Olympia and through the festival of the Kronia, and is linked with the Roman god Saturn, Geb, Ēl, and Kumarbi.

cultural_context.id: Cronus menerima persembahan di Bukit Cronus di Olympia, memiliki kuil di Gadir dan Athena, dan dihormati dalam festival Kronia. Cronus kemungkinan semula dewa panen, dan bulan panen di banyak daerah Yunani dinamai Cronion menurut namanya. Bangsa Romawi memadukannya dengan Saturnus dan memandangnya secara lebih positif.
cultural_context.en: Cronus received offerings at the Hill of Cronus in Olympia, had temples at Gadir and Athens, and was honoured in the Kronia festival. He was likely originally a harvest god, and the harvest month in many parts of Greece was named Cronion after him. The Romans conflated him with Saturn and took a more positive view of him.

summary.id: Atas dorongan ibunya, Cronus bersembunyi dengan sabit dan memotong alat kelamin ayahnya, Uranus, lalu menjadi raja pertama dunia. Menurut Hesiodos, Langit menyebut putra-putranya "Titan" dengan nada celaan karena perbuatan lancang itu.
summary.en: At his mother's urging, Cronus hid with a sickle and cut off his father Uranus's genitals, then became the world's first king. According to Hesiod, Heaven called his sons Titans in reproach for the presumptuous deed.

summary.id: Karena takut dikalahkan putranya, Cronus menelan setiap anak yang dilahirkan Rhea; Rhea memberinya batu terbungkus kain sebagai ganti Zeus.
summary.en: Fearing defeat by his son, Cronus swallowed each child Rhea bore; Rhea gave him a swaddled stone in place of Zeus.

summary.id: Zeus memaksa Cronus memuntahkan anak-anaknya; menurut Hesiodos batu dimuntahkan lebih dulu.
summary.en: Zeus forced Cronus to disgorge his children; according to Hesiod the stone came up first.

summary.id: Perang sepuluh tahun antara para Titan dan dewa-dewa Olimpus berakhir dengan para Titan terdorong ke Tartarus. Hesiodos menempatkan para Titan di Othyrs dan para dewa di Olympus.
summary.en: A ten-year war between the Titans and the Olympian gods ended with the Titans driven into Tartarus. Hesiod places the Titans on Othyrs and the gods on Olympus.

summary.id: Cronus berubah menjadi kuda jantan ketika Rhea memergokinya bersama Philyra; Philyra kemudian melahirkan centaur Cheiron.

claims.quote: In Greek mythology, Cronus (also spelt Kronos) is a Titan and the youngest son of Uranus (Heaven/Sky) and Gaia (Earth).

statement.id: Dalam mitologi Yunani, Cronus atau Kronos adalah Titan, putra bungsu Uranus dan Gaia.
statement.en: In Greek mythology, Cronus or Kronos is a Titan and the youngest son of Uranus and Gaia.

claims.quote: KRONOS (Cronus) was the King of the Titanes and the god of time, in particular time when viewed as a destructive, all-devouring force.

statement.id: Theoi menyebut Kronos raja para Titan dan dewa waktu yang melahap segala.
statement.en: Theoi calls Kronos the king of the Titans and a god of all-devouring time.

claims.quote: He dethroned Uranus and became the world's first king, ruling over his siblings and fellow Titans. Cronus married his sister Rhea and was eventually overthrown by his son Zeus.

statement.id: Cronus menurunkan Uranus dari takhta, menjadi raja, menikahi Rhea, lalu digulingkan Zeus.
statement.en: Cronus dethroned Uranus, became king, married Rhea, and was later overthrown by Zeus.

claims.quote: Cronus married his sister Rhea, and they had six children: Hestia, Demeter, Hera, Hades, Poseidon, and Zeus, father of gods and men.

statement.id: Rhea dan Cronus mempunyai enam anak: Hestia, Demeter, Hera, Hades, Poseidon, dan Zeus.
statement.en: Rhea and Cronus had six children: Hestia, Demeter, Hera, Hades, Poseidon, and Zeus.

claims.quote: With this warning present in his mind, Cronus swallowed each child as soon as Rhea gave birth.

statement.id: Karena takut digulingkan anaknya, Cronus menelan anak-anak Rhea segera setelah lahir.
statement.en: Fearing overthrow by his children, Cronus swallowed Rhea's children at birth.

claims.quote: In reality, the baby was the special stone that she had swaddled in blankets. Cronus swallowed this stone without hesitation, not even suspecting that his wife would trick him.

statement.id: Rhea memperdaya Cronus dengan batu yang dibungkus seperti bayi, dan Cronus menelannya.
statement.en: Rhea deceived Cronus with a swaddled stone, which he swallowed.

claims.quote: The god grew up, forced Kronos to disgorge his swallowed offspring, and led the Olympians in a ten year war against the Titanes (Titans), driving them in defeat into the pit of Tartaros (Tartarus).

statement.id: Zeus yang telah dewasa memaksa Cronus memuntahkan saudara-saudaranya dan memimpin para Olympian menang melawan Titan dalam perang sepuluh tahun.
statement.en: The grown Zeus forced Cronus to disgorge his siblings and led the Olympians to victory in a ten-year war with the Titans.

claims.quote: Cronus' rule was regarded as the Golden Age, a time when there was no disease, hunger, or hardship.
claims.locator: Cronus as King of the World

statement.id: Masa pemerintahan Cronus disebut Zaman Keemasan tanpa penyakit, kelaparan, atau kesulitan.
statement.en: Cronus's reign was considered a Golden Age without disease, hunger, or hardship.

claims.quote: Cronus was cursed to travel the world and measure out eternity all alone.

statement.id: Salah satu versi mengatakan Cronus dikutuk mengembara sendirian di dunia selamanya.
statement.en: One version says Cronus was cursed to wander the world alone forever.

claims.quote: According to some, Kronos (Cronus), the former king of the Golden Age, was released by Zeus from Tartaros (Tartarus) and made king of the islands of the Blessed, where the heroes were sent to dwell in paradise after death.
claims.locator: Cronus King of the Islands of the Blessed

statement.id: Versi lain mengatakan Zeus membebaskan Cronus dari Tartarus dan menjadikannya penguasa Kepulauan Orang Berbahagia.
statement.en: Another version says Zeus freed Cronus from Tartarus and made him king of the Isles of the Blessed.

claims.quote: He is linked to the Roman god Saturn, the Egyptian god Geb, the Phoenician Ēl, and the Hittite/Hurrian god Kumarbi.

statement.id: Cronus dihubungkan dengan dewa Romawi Saturnus.
statement.en: Cronus is linked to the Roman god Saturn.

claims.quote: After them was born Cronos the wily, youngest and most terrible of her children, and he hated his lusty sire.

statement.id: Menurut Hesiodos, setelah para Titan lain lahir, lahirlah Cronos yang licik, anak bungsu dan paling mengerikan, dan ia membenci ayahnya yang penuh nafsu.
statement.en: According to Hesiod, after the other Titans came Cronos the wily, youngest and most terrible of her children, and he hated his lusty sire.

claims.quote: Then the son from his ambush stretched forth his left hand and in his right took the great long sickle with jagged teeth, and swiftly lopped off his own father's members and cast them away to fall behind him.

statement.id: Menurut Hesiodos, Cronos keluar dari persembunyiannya, mengambil sabit besar bergerigi dengan tangan kanan, dan dengan cepat memotong anggota tubuh ayahnya lalu membuangnya ke belakang.
statement.en: According to Hesiod, Cronos reached from his ambush, took the great jagged sickle in his right hand, swiftly lopped off his father's members, and cast them behind him.

claims.quote: For he learned from Earth and starry Heaven that he was destined to be overcome by his own son, strong though he was

statement.id: Menurut Hesiodos, Cronos mengetahui dari Bumi dan Langit berbintang bahwa ia ditakdirkan dikalahkan oleh putranya sendiri, sekuat apa pun dirinya.
statement.en: According to Hesiod, Cronos learned from Earth and starry Heaven that he was destined to be overcome by his own son, strong though he was.

claims.quote: great Cronos the wily was beguiled by the deep suggestions of Earth, and brought up again his offspring, vanquished by the arts and might of his own son, and he vomited up first the stone which he had swallowed last.

statement.id: Menurut Hesiodos, Cronos terperdaya oleh saran-saran licik Bumi, memuntahkan kembali anak-anaknya yang dikalahkan oleh siasat dan kekuatan putranya, dan lebih dulu memuntahkan batu yang ditelannya paling akhir.
statement.en: According to Hesiod, Cronos was beguiled by the deep suggestions of Earth and brought up his offspring, vanquished by the arts and might of his son, vomiting up first the stone he had swallowed last.

claims.quote: For the Titan gods and as many as sprang from Cronos had long been fighting together in stubborn war with heart-grieving toil, the lordly Titans from high Othyrs, but the gods, givers of good, whom rich-haired Rhea bare in union with Cronos, from Olympus.

statement.id: Menurut Hesiodos, para dewa Titan dan keturunan Cronos lama berperang sengit; para Titan dari Gunung Othyrs yang tinggi, para dewa yang dilahirkan Rhea dari Cronos dari Olympus.
statement.en: According to Hesiod, the Titan gods and those sprung from Cronos had long fought a stubborn war, the Titans from high Othyrs and the gods whom Rhea bore to Cronos from Olympus.

claims.quote: for he said that they strained and did presumptuously a fearful deed, and that vengeance for it would come afterwards.

statement.id: Menurut Hesiodos, Langit menyebut putra-putranya "Titan" dengan nada celaan karena mereka bertindak lancang dengan perbuatan mengerikan, dan ia berkata pembalasan akan datang kemudian.
statement.en: According to Hesiod, Heaven called his sons Titans in reproach because they presumptuously did a fearful deed, and said vengeance would come afterwards.

claims.quote: Cronus hid, holding the sickle and ready to carry out his mother's plan. As a lustful Uranus attempted to make love to Gaia, Chronus struck, slicing off his father's genitals.

statement.id: Cronus bersembunyi sambil memegang sabit; ketika Uranus hendak bercinta dengan Gaia, Cronus menyerang dan memotong alat kelamin ayahnya.
statement.en: Cronus hid holding the sickle; as Uranus tried to lie with Gaia, Cronus struck and sliced off his father's genitals.

claims.quote: Cronus imprisoned his father deep in Tartarus (the infernal region) along with the Cyclopes and Hecatonchires in caves.
claims.locator: Cronus as King of the World

statement.id: Cronus memenjarakan ayahnya jauh di Tartarus bersama para Cyclops dan Hecatonchires dalam gua-gua.
statement.en: Cronus imprisoned his father deep in Tartarus together with the Cyclopes and Hecatonchires in caves.

claims.quote: Cronus would not simply allow his children to overthrow him without a fight, and so began the Titanomachy, a ten-year-long battle between the Titans and the Olympian gods. The Titans fought from Mount Othrys, while the gods fought from Mount Olympus.

statement.id: Cronus tidak mau digulingkan anak-anaknya tanpa perlawanan, sehingga dimulailah Titanomakhia, pertempuran sepuluh tahun antara para Titan dari Gunung Othrys dan para dewa Olimpus dari Gunung Olympus.
statement.en: Cronus would not let his children overthrow him without a fight, so began the Titanomachy, a ten-year battle between the Titans from Mount Othrys and the Olympian gods from Mount Olympus.

claims.quote: One day, as Cronus lay with Philyra, he was interrupted by Rhea and, in a panic, turned himself into a stallion and fled. Philyra became pregnant and gave birth to the centaur Cheiron.

statement.id: Ketika Cronus bersama Philyra dan didatangi Rhea, ia panik, mengubah dirinya menjadi kuda jantan, lalu kabur; Philyra hamil dan melahirkan centaur Cheiron.
statement.en: When Rhea interrupted Cronus with Philyra, he panicked, turned himself into a stallion, and fled; Philyra became pregnant and gave birth to the centaur Cheiron.

claims.quote: Although there is no etymological link between Cronus and Chronus, the Stoics believed that the definition of a word was also the meaning of a myth.

statement.id: Walau tidak ada kaitan etimologis antara Cronus dan Chronus (waktu), kaum Stoik percaya bahwa arti sebuah kata juga merupakan makna sebuah mitos.
statement.en: Although there is no etymological link between Cronus and Chronus, the Stoics believed the definition of a word was also the meaning of a myth.

claims.quote: The Hill of Cronus was located above the sanctuary of Zeus in Olympia. It was sacred to Cronus, who received offerings there.

statement.id: Bukit Cronus terletak di atas tempat suci Zeus di Olympia; bukit itu suci bagi Cronus, yang menerima persembahan di sana.
statement.en: The Hill of Cronus lay above the sanctuary of Zeus in Olympia; it was sacred to Cronus, who received offerings there.

claims.quote: A festival called the Kronia was also believed to have been held in honour of Cronus. ... It was an agricultural festival held in Athens, Samos and Kolophon at the end of the year when slaves were temporarily freed.

statement.id: Festival Kronia diyakini diadakan untuk menghormati Cronus; itu festival pertanian di Athena, Samos, dan Kolophon pada akhir tahun ketika budak dibebaskan sementara.
statement.en: A festival called the Kronia was believed to have been held in honour of Cronus; it was an agricultural festival in Athens, Samos, and Kolophon at year's end when slaves were temporarily freed.

claims.quote: Some heroes chose not to die but were instead transported to the Isles of the Blessed at the end of the world, which Cronus also ruled.
claims.locator: Cronus as King of the World

statement.id: Sebagian pahlawan memilih tidak mati dan dipindahkan ke Kepulauan Orang Berbahagia di ujung dunia, yang juga diperintah Cronus.
statement.en: Some heroes chose not to die and were instead transported to the Isles of the Blessed at the end of the world, which Cronus also ruled.

claims.quote: Zeus took this mixture to Cronus, and as soon as he started drinking it, he threw up his children one by one.

statement.id: Zeus membawa ramuan itu kepada Cronus, dan begitu Cronus meminumnya, ia memuntahkan anak-anaknya satu per satu.
statement.en: Zeus took the mixture to Cronus, and as soon as he began drinking it, Cronus threw up his children one by one.

claims.quote: Cronus was usually depicted with a harpe, scythe, or sickle, which was the instrument he used to castrate and depose Uranus, his father.

statement.id: Cronus biasanya digambarkan membawa harpe, arit, atau sabit, alat yang ia pakai untuk mengebiri dan menggulingkan ayahnya, Uranus.
statement.en: Cronus was usually depicted with a harpe, scythe, or sickle, the instrument he used to castrate and depose his father Uranus.

claims.quote: Cronus was likely originally a harvest god, which is why in many regions of Greece the month of the harvest was named Cronion after him.

statement.id: Cronus kemungkinan semula dewa panen, sehingga di banyak daerah Yunani bulan panen dinamai Cronion menurut namanya.
statement.en: Cronus was likely originally a harvest god, which is why in many regions of Greece the month of the harvest was named Cronion after him.

claims.quote: observed that attempts to give the name Κρόνος a Greek etymology had failed. Recently, Janda (2010) offers a genuinely Indo-European etymology of "the cutter", from the root *(s)ker- "to cut"

statement.id: Upaya memberi nama Κρόνος etimologi Yunani dilaporkan gagal; Janda (2010) mengajukan etimologi Indo-Eropa "sang pemotong" dari akar *(s)ker- "memotong".
statement.en: Attempts to give the name Κρόνος a Greek etymology are reported to have failed; Janda (2010) offers an Indo-European etymology, "the cutter", from the root *(s)ker- "to cut".

claims.quote: the Romans took a more positive and innocuous view of the deity, by conflating their indigenous deity Saturn with Cronus.

statement.id: Bangsa Romawi memandang dewa ini secara lebih positif dan tidak berbahaya dengan memadukan dewa asli mereka, Saturnus, dengan Cronus.
statement.en: The Romans took a more positive and innocuous view of the deity by conflating their native deity Saturn with Cronus.

claims.quote: An alternate genealogy is presented by Plato, who wrote that Cronus, Phorcys, and Rhea were the children of Oceanus and Tethys.

statement.id: Plato menyajikan silsilah alternatif: Cronus, Phorcys, dan Rhea adalah anak Oceanus dan Tethys.
statement.en: Plato presents an alternate genealogy in which Cronus, Phorcys, and Rhea were children of Oceanus and Tethys.

claims.quote: During antiquity, Cronus was occasionally interpreted as Chronos, the personification of time.

statement.id: Pada zaman kuno, Cronus kadang ditafsirkan sebagai Chronos, personifikasi waktu.
statement.en: In antiquity, Cronus was occasionally interpreted as Chronos, the personification of time.

claims.quote: Kronos was essentially the same as Khronos (Chronos), the primordial god of time in the Orphic Theogonies.

statement.id: Theoi menyatakan Kronos pada dasarnya sama dengan Khronos (Chronos), dewa waktu purba dalam Teogoni Orfik.
statement.en: Theoi states that Kronos was essentially the same as Khronos (Chronos), the primordial god of time in the Orphic Theogonies.

claims.quote: At the instigation of his mother, Cronus unmanned his father for having thrown the Cyclopes, who were likewise his children by Ge, into Tartarus.

statement.id: Atas dorongan ibunya, Cronus mengebiri ayahnya karena ayahnya melemparkan para Cyclops, yang juga anak-anaknya dari Ge, ke Tartarus.
statement.en: At his mother's instigation, Cronus unmanned his father for having thrown the Cyclopes, also his children by Ge, into Tartarus.

claims.quote: Rhea managed to save the youngest, Zeus, by hiding him away on the island of Krete (Crete), and fed Kronos a stone wrapped in swaddling clothes.

statement.id: Rhea berhasil menyelamatkan si bungsu, Zeus, dengan menyembunyikannya di pulau Kreta, dan memberi Kronos batu terbungkus kain.
statement.en: Rhea managed to save the youngest, Zeus, by hiding him on the island of Crete, and fed Kronos a stone wrapped in swaddling clothes.

claims.quote: A temple dedicated to Cronus was located on the island of Gadir (modern-day Cádiz, Spain), founded by the Phoenicians. Another temple in Athens, built by Peisistratos, was dedicated to Cronus and Rhea.

statement.id: Sebuah kuil untuk Cronus berada di pulau Gadir (Cádiz modern, Spanyol), didirikan bangsa Fenisia; kuil lain di Athena, dibangun Peisistratos, didedikasikan untuk Cronus dan Rhea.
statement.en: A temple to Cronus stood on the island of Gadir (modern Cádiz, Spain), founded by the Phoenicians; another temple in Athens, built by Peisistratos, was dedicated to Cronus and Rhea.

claims.quote: Cronus' origin story is most famously told in Hesiod's (c. 700 BCE) Theogony.

statement.id: Kisah asal-usul Cronus paling terkenal dituturkan dalam Theogony karya Hesiodos (sekitar 700 SM).
statement.en: Cronus's origin story is most famously told in Hesiod's Theogony (c. 700 BCE).

claims.quote: In Athens, on the twelfth day of the Attic month of Hekatombaion, a festival called Kronia was held in honour of Cronus to celebrate the harvest

statement.id: Di Athena, pada hari ke-12 bulan Hekatombaion menurut penanggalan Attika, festival Kronia diadakan untuk menghormati Cronus dan merayakan panen.
statement.en: In Athens, on the twelfth day of the Attic month of Hekatombaion, the festival Kronia was held in honour of Cronus to celebrate the harvest.

claims.quote: Other sources state that the Kronia was a dark festival with human sacrifices being made to Cronus.

statement.id: Sumber lain menyatakan Kronia adalah festival kelam dengan persembahan manusia kepada Cronus.
statement.en: Other sources state the Kronia was a dark festival with human sacrifices made to Cronus.

claims.quote: In other traditions, Cronus was sent to Tartarus with the rest of his siblings. Other myths state that he was allowed to live out the rest of his days on the Isles of the Blessed.

statement.id: Dalam tradisi lain, Cronus dikirim ke Tartarus bersama saudara-saudaranya; mitos lain menyatakan ia dibiarkan menjalani sisa hidupnya di Kepulauan Orang Berbahagia.
statement.en: In other traditions Cronus was sent to Tartarus with his siblings; other myths say he was allowed to live out his days on the Isles of the Blessed.

claims.quote: In 2017, a star known as HD 240430 was given the nickname Kronus after it was observed eating the planets surrounding it.

statement.en: In 2017, a star known as HD 240430 was nicknamed Kronus after it was observed eating the planets around it.
