sources.title: HESTIA - Greek Goddess of Hearth & Home

claim.id: Hestia adalah dewi perapian, rumah, dan keramahtamahan Yunani.
claim.en: Hestia is the Greek goddess of the hearth, home, and hospitality.

claims_provenance.quote: Hestia was the Greek virgin goddess of the hearth, home, and hospitality.

claim.id: Hestia adalah putri sulung Cronus dan Rhea.
claim.en: Hestia is the eldest daughter of Cronus and Rhea.

claims_provenance.quote: In Greek mythology, she is the eldest daughter of Cronus and Rhea.

claim.id: Bangsa Romawi mengenalnya sebagai Vesta.
claim.en: The Romans knew her as Vesta.

claims_provenance.quote: To the Romans, the goddess was known as Vesta.

claim.id: Hestia tetap perawan dan tidak menikah meskipun didekati Apollo, Poseidon, dan Priapus.
claim.en: Hestia remained unmarried despite the interest of Apollo, Poseidon, and Priapus.

claims_provenance.quote: Hestia never married and remained a virgin, despite the amorous attentions of Apollo, Poseidon, and Priapus, the fertility god.

claim.id: Hestia dipandang sebagai personifikasi perapian dan menerima persembahan di kuil para dewa.
claim.en: Hestia personified the hearth and received offerings in temples.

claims_provenance.quote: The goddess was the personification of the hearth and so she received sacrifices in all the temples of the gods as each one had its own hearth.

claim.id: Hestia terkait api kurban dan mendapat bagian dari setiap persembahan kepada para dewa.
claim.en: Hestia governed the sacrificial flame and received a share of each offering.

claims_provenance.quote: Hestia was also the goddess of the sacrificial flame and received a share of every sacrifice to the gods.
claims_provenance.source_citation: Theoi Greek Mythology — HESTIA - Greek Goddess of Hearth & Home

claim.id: Lukisan vas Athena menggambarkan Hestia sebagai perempuan berkerudung, kadang memegang dahan berbunga.
claim.en: Athenian vase paintings show Hestia veiled and sometimes holding a flowering branch.

claims_provenance.quote: Hestia was depicted in Athenian vase painting as a modestly veiled woman sometimes holding a flowered branch (perhaps a chaste-tree).
claims_provenance.source_citation: Theoi Greek Mythology — HESTIA - Greek Goddess of Hearth & Home

claim.id: Sebagai pelindung keluarga dan komunitas politik, persembahan secara rutin dibuat bagi Hestia di perapian setiap rumah dan di perapian umum kota.
claim.en: As protector of the family and political community, offerings were regularly made to Hestia at the hearth in each private home and at the town or city's public hearth.

claims_provenance.quote: In her role as a protector of the family and political community, sacrifices and offerings were regularly made to Hestia at the hearth within each private home and at the town or city's public hearth.

claim.id: Orang tua Hestia adalah Cronus dan Rhea; adik-adiknya Zeus, Hera, Demeter, Poseidon, dan Hades. Cronus, yang takut ditumbangkan anaknya, menelan mereka semua.
claim.en: Hestia's parents were Cronus and Rhea; her younger siblings were Zeus, Hera, Demeter, Poseidon, and Hades. Cronus, fearing overthrow by his children, swallowed them all.

claims_provenance.quote: In the Greek myths, Hestia's parents were Cronus and Rhea and so her younger siblings were Zeus, Hera, Demeter, Poseidon, and Hades. Cronus, paranoid that one of his own children would overthrow his rule, swallowed them all.

claim.id: Dalam sebagian daftar Hestia termasuk 12 dewa Olimpus, tetapi lebih umum tempatnya diisi Dionysos.
claim.en: In some lists Hestia is one of the 12 Olympian gods, but more commonly her place is taken by Dionysos.

claims_provenance.quote: In some lists, Hestia is one of the 12 Olympian gods but more commonly her place is taken by Dionysos.

claim.id: Dalam sebagian mitos Hestia melepaskan tempatnya di Gunung Olimpus dan bertukar dengan Dionysos karena lebih suka menjauh dari urusan para dewa dan yakin disambut hangat di kota manusia mana pun.
claim.en: In some myths Hestia voluntarily gives up her place on Mount Olympus, swapping with Dionysos because she prefers to withdraw from godly affairs and is sure of a warm welcome in any mortal city.

claims_provenance.quote: In some myths the goddess voluntarily relinquishes her place amongst the gods on Mount Olympus, swapping with Dionysos because she prefers to withdraw from godly affairs and is sure of a fond welcome in any mortal city she chooses.

claim.id: Menurut tradisi, Hestia menerima kurban lebih dulu daripada dewa lain, mendapat persembahan anggur pertama dan terakhir pada setiap pesta, dan biasanya disebut pertama dalam doa dan sumpah.
claim.en: By tradition Hestia received sacrifices before the other gods, received the first and last libations of wine at any feast, and was usually mentioned first in prayers and oaths.

claims_provenance.quote: By tradition, Hestia received any sacrifices before the other gods, even at such places as Olympia where Zeus was honoured. Hestia also received the first and last libations of wine offering at any feast and was usually mentioned first in any prayers and oaths.

claim.id: Dalam mitologi, kehormatan menerima kurban pertama diberikan Zeus ketika Hestia bersumpah akan selalu perawan.
claim.en: In mythology Zeus gave Hestia the honour of the first sacrifice when she swore she would always remain a virgin.

claims_provenance.quote: In mythology, the honour of receiving the first sacrifice was given by Zeus when Hestia swore that she would always remain a virgin.

claim.id: Di rumah Yunani, perapian biasanya berupa tungku portabel, tetapi melambangkan jantung dan jiwa rumah tangga dan menjadi pusatnya.
claim.en: In a Greek house the hearth was usually a portable brazier but symbolised the heart and soul of the household and came to represent its centre.

claims_provenance.quote: Within a Greek house, the hearth was usually a portable brazier but it symbolised the heart and soul of the household and came to represent its centre.

claim.id: Personifikasi Hestia sebagai perapian juga mengaitkannya dengan keramahtamahan, perlindungan tamu, dan penemu pembangunan rumah yang baik.
claim.en: Hestia's personification as the hearth also linked her to hospitality, the protection of guests, and the inventor of good housebuilding.

claims_provenance.quote: The goddesses personification as the hearth also linked her to ideas of hospitality, the protection of guests, and the inventor of good housebuilding.

claim.id: Selain rumah pribadi, Hestia terutama dikaitkan dengan prytaneion dan bouleuterion, pusat simbolis kota tempat urusan pemerintahan setempat dijalankan.
claim.en: Besides individual homes, Hestia was particularly associated with the prytaneion and bouleuterion, the symbolic centre of a town where local government business was carried out.

claims_provenance.quote: Besides individual homes, Hestia was particularly associated with the prytaneion and bouleuterion, the symbolic centre of a town or city where civic functions were held and the business of local government was carried out.

claim.id: Pemujaan umum Hestia terutama marak di Attica dengan kultus penting di Piraeus, Eleusis, Halimos, dan Krokonidai.
claim.en: Public worship of Hestia was especially prevalent in Attica, with notable cults at Piraeus, Eleusis, Halimos, and Krokonidai.

claims_provenance.quote: Public worship of Hestia was especially prevalent in Attica with notable cults at Piraeus, Eleusis, Halimos, and Krokonidai.

claim.id: Hestia adalah satu-satunya dewi yang tidak ikut para dewa Olimpus dalam serangan gagal mereka terhadap Zeus.
claim.en: Hestia was the only goddess who did not join the Olympians in their failed attack on Zeus.

claims_provenance.quote: The Greek goddess was the only one to not join the Olympians in their failed attack on Zeus.

claim.id: Dalam seni Yunani, Hestia biasanya ditampilkan sebagai perempuan muda berpenutup kepala dan berpakaian sederhana.
claim.en: In Greek art Hestia is usually presented as a young woman wearing a head covering and modest clothing.

claims_provenance.quote: Hestia is usually presented in Greek art as a young female wearing a head covering & modest clothing.

claim.id: Karena tidak punya mitologi khusus, Hestia jarang muncul dalam seni Yunani dan sulit dibedakan dari dewi lain.
claim.en: Because she has no particular mythology, Hestia appears rarely in Greek art and can be difficult to distinguish from other goddesses.

claims_provenance.quote: As Hestia has no particular mythology surrounding her, she does not appear very often in Greek art, and when she does, she can be difficult to distinguish from other goddesses

claim.id: Pada masa Romawi, Hestia, yang kini dikenal sebagai Vesta, terus dipuja, misalnya di Ephesus tempat imam besarnya perempuan.
claim.en: In the Roman period Hestia, now known as Vesta, continued to be worshipped, for example at Ephesus where the high priest was a woman.

claims_provenance.quote: In the Roman period, Hestia, now known as Vesta, continued to be worshipped, for example at Ephesus where the high priest was a female.

claim.id: Hestia muncul pada Vas Francois (570-565 SM) dan, kali ini dengan nama, pada friz utara Perbendaharaan Siphnos di Delphi (sekitar 525 SM) menghadapi dua raksasa berbaju prajurit hoplit.
claim.en: Hestia appears on the Francois Vase (570-565 BCE) and, this time named, on the north frieze of the Siphnian Treasury at Delphi (c. 525 BCE), facing two giants in hoplite uniform with an unidentified goddess.

claims_provenance.quote: She appears on the celebrated Francois Vase (570-565 BCE) and, this time named, on the north frieze of the Siphinian Treasury at Delphi (c. 525 BCE) where she and an unidentified goddess face two giants in hoplite uniform.

claim.id: Sebagai dewi perapian keluarga, Hestia juga memimpin pembuatan roti dan penyiapan hidangan keluarga.
claim.en: As goddess of the family hearth, Hestia also presided over the baking of bread and the preparation of the family meal.

claims_provenance.quote: As the goddess of the family hearth she also presided over the cooking of bread and the preparation of the family meal.
claims_provenance.source_citation: Theoi Greek Mythology — HESTIA - Greek Goddess of Hearth & Home

claim.id: Dalam mitos Hestia adalah anak sulung Kronos dan Rhea yang ditelan ayahnya saat lahir; Zeus kemudian memaksa sang Titan memuntahkan Hestia dan saudara-saudaranya.
claim.en: In myth Hestia was the firstborn of Kronos and Rhea, swallowed by her father at birth; Zeus later forced the old Titan to disgorge Hestia and her siblings.

claims_provenance.quote: In myth Hestia was the first born child of Kronos (Cronus) and Rhea who was swallowed by her father at birth. Zeus later forced the old Titan to disgorge Hestia and her siblings.
claims_provenance.source_citation: Theoi Greek Mythology — HESTIA - Greek Goddess of Hearth & Home

claim.id: Karena yang pertama ditelan sekaligus yang terakhir dimuntahkan, Hestia disebut sebagai yang tertua sekaligus termuda dari enam Kronid.
claim.en: Being the first swallowed and last disgorged, Hestia was named both the eldest and youngest of the six Kronides.

claims_provenance.quote: As the first to be swallowed she was also the last to be disgorged, and so was named as both the eldest and youngest of the six Kronides.
claims_provenance.source_citation: Theoi Greek Mythology — HESTIA - Greek Goddess of Hearth & Home

claim.id: Ketika Apollon dan Poseidon melamarnya, Hestia menolak dan meminta Zeus membiarkannya tetap perawan; Zeus setuju dan ia mengambil tempat di perapian kerajaan Zeus.
claim.en: When Apollon and Poseidon sought her hand, Hestia refused and asked Zeus to let her remain an eternal virgin; he agreed and she took her place at his royal hearth.

claims_provenance.quote: When the gods Apollon and Poseidon sought for her hand in marriage, Hestia refused and asked Zeus to let her remain an eternal virgin. He agreed and she took her place at his royal hearth.
claims_provenance.source_citation: Theoi Greek Mythology — HESTIA - Greek Goddess of Hearth & Home

claim.id: Menurut Himne Homerik untuk Aphrodite, Zeus memberinya kehormatan tinggi sebagai ganti pernikahan: tempat di tengah rumah, bagian terkaya, bagian kehormatan di semua kuil, dan kedudukan sebagai dewi utama di antara manusia.
claim.en: According to the Homeric Hymn to Aphrodite, Zeus gave her high honour instead of marriage: a place in the midst of the house, the richest portion, a share of honour in all temples, and the position of chief of the goddesses among mortals.

claims_provenance.quote: So Zeus the Father gave her a high honour instead of marriage, and she has her place in the midst of the house and has the richest portion. In all the temples of the gods she has a share of honour, and among all mortal men she is chief of the goddesses.
claims_provenance.source_citation: Theoi Greek Mythology — HESTIA - Greek Goddess of Hearth & Home

claim.id: Menurut Himne Homerik untuk Hestia, manusia tidak mengadakan pesta tanpa Hestia, karena anggur manis dituangkan baginya lebih dulu dan terakhir.
claim.en: According to the Homeric Hymn to Hestia, mortals hold no banquet without her, since sweet wine is poured in offering to Hestia first and last.

claims_provenance.quote: For without you mortals hold no banquet,--where one does not duly pour sweet wine in offering to Hestia both first and last.
claims_provenance.source_citation: Theoi Greek Mythology — HESTIA - Greek Goddess of Hearth & Home

claim.id: Hestia dipandang memimpin semua kurban dan, sebagai dewi api suci altar, mendapat bagian dalam kurban di semua kuil para dewa.
claim.en: Hestia was regarded as presiding at all sacrifices and, as goddess of the sacred fire of the altar, had a share in the sacrifices in all the temples of the gods.

claims_provenance.quote: Hestia was looked upon as presiding at all sacrifices, and, as the goddess of the sacred fire of the altar, she had a share in the sacrifices in all the temples of the gods.
claims_provenance.locator: Encyclopedia (Smith, Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology)
claims_provenance.source_citation: Theoi Greek Mythology — HESTIA - Greek Goddess of Hearth & Home

claim.id: Karena perapian dipandang pusat suci kehidupan rumah tangga, Hestia dianggap dewi kehidupan rumah tangga dan pemberi segala kebahagiaan dan berkat rumah tangga, serta dipercaya berdiam di bagian dalam setiap rumah.
claim.en: As the hearth was seen as the sacred centre of domestic life, Hestia was the goddess of domestic life and giver of all domestic happiness and blessings, believed to dwell in the inner part of every house.

claims_provenance.quote: As the hearth was looked upon as the sacred centre of domestic life, so Hestia was the goddess of domestic life and the giver of all domestic happiness and blessings, and as such she was believed to dwell in the inner part of every house
claims_provenance.locator: Encyclopedia (Smith, Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology)
claims_provenance.source_citation: Theoi Greek Mythology — HESTIA - Greek Goddess of Hearth & Home

claim.id: Dalam patung klasik Hestia juga berkerudung, dengan ketel sebagai atributnya.
claim.en: In classical sculpture she was also veiled, with a kettle as her attribute.

claims_provenance.quote: In classical sculpture she was also veiled, with a kettle as her attribute.
claims_provenance.source_citation: Theoi Greek Mythology — HESTIA - Greek Goddess of Hearth & Home

claim.id: Sumpah khidmat diucapkan demi dewi perapian, dan perapian sendiri adalah suaka suci tempat pemohon meminta perlindungan penghuni rumah.
claim.en: Solemn oaths were sworn by the goddess of the hearth, and the hearth itself was the sacred asylum where suppliants implored the protection of the household.

claims_provenance.quote: Solemn oaths were sworn by the goddess of the hearth, and the hearth itself was the sacred asylum where suppliants implored the protection of the inhabitants of the house.
claims_provenance.locator: Encyclopedia (Smith, Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology)
claims_provenance.source_citation: Theoi Greek Mythology — HESTIA - Greek Goddess of Hearth & Home

claim.id: Kurban bagi Hestia berupa buah sulung, air, minyak, anggur, dan sapi berumur satu tahun.
claim.en: Sacrifices to Hestia consisted of the first fruits, water, oil, wine, and cows one year old.

claims_provenance.quote: Her sacrifices consisted of the primitiae of fruit, water, oil, wine, and cows of one year old.
claims_provenance.locator: Encyclopedia (Smith, Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology)

short_description.id: Hestia adalah dewi perawan perapian dan rumah dalam mitologi Yunani, putri sulung Cronus dan Rhea, yang menerima bagian pertama dari setiap kurban.
short_description.en: Hestia is the virgin Greek goddess of the hearth and home, eldest daughter of Cronus and Rhea, who received the first share of every sacrifice.

long_description.id: Hestia adalah dewi perawan perapian, rumah, dan keramahtamahan dalam kepercayaan Yunani. Dalam mitos ia putri sulung Cronus dan Rhea, ditelan ayahnya saat lahir lalu dimuntahkan kembali oleh Zeus. Sebagai pelindung keluarga dan komunitas politik, persembahan dibuat bagi Hestia di perapian setiap rumah dan di perapian umum kota. Bangsa Romawi mengenalnya sebagai Vesta.
long_description.en: Hestia is the virgin Greek goddess of the hearth, home, and hospitality. In myth she is the eldest daughter of Cronus and Rhea, swallowed by her father at birth and later disgorged by Zeus. As protector of the family and political community, offerings were made to Hestia at the hearth in every home and at a city's public hearth. The Romans knew her as Vesta.

long_description.id: Hestia menerima kurban lebih dulu daripada dewa lain, juga persembahan anggur pertama dan terakhir pada setiap pesta, dan biasanya disebut pertama dalam doa dan sumpah. Menurut mitos, Zeus memberinya kehormatan itu ketika ia bersumpah tetap perawan, meskipun Apollo, Poseidon, dan Priapus mendekatinya. Perapian melambangkan jantung dan jiwa rumah tangga, dan kaitannya dengan perapian menghubungkan Hestia dengan keramahtamahan serta perlindungan tamu. Di kota, ia terutama dikaitkan dengan prytaneion dan bouleuterion, pusat simbolis pemerintahan setempat.
long_description.en: Hestia received sacrifices before the other gods, as well as the first and last libations of wine at any feast, and was usually mentioned first in prayers and oaths. According to myth, Zeus gave her this honour when she swore to remain a virgin, despite the attentions of Apollo, Poseidon, and Priapus. The hearth symbolised the heart and soul of the household, and her link with the hearth tied Hestia to hospitality and the protection of guests. In the city her special place was the prytaneion and bouleuterion, the symbolic seat of local government.

long_description.id: Hestia tidak punya mitologi yang menonjol: ia digambarkan sebagai dewi senior yang menjauh dari urusan para dewa, dan ia satu-satunya yang tidak ikut serangan gagal para dewa Olimpus terhadap Zeus. Dalam sebagian daftar ia termasuk 12 dewa Olimpus, tetapi lebih umum tempatnya diisi Dionysos; dalam sebagian mitos ia sendiri menyerahkan tempat itu kepada Dionysos. Dalam seni ia biasanya digambarkan sebagai perempuan muda berkerudung dan berpakaian sederhana, sulit dibedakan dari dewi lain.
long_description.en: Hestia has no prominent mythology: she is presented as a senior goddess aloof from the affairs of the other gods, and alone among the goddesses she stayed out of the Olympians' unsuccessful assault on Zeus. Some lists count her among the 12 Olympians, though Dionysos more often fills that seat; some myths have her yield the seat to him herself. In art she is usually shown as a young woman, veiled and modestly dressed, and is hard to tell apart from other goddesses.

long_description.id: Pemujaan umum Hestia sangat marak di Attica, dengan kultus penting di Piraeus, Eleusis, Halimos, dan Krokonidai. Imam dan imam perempuan yang khusus mengabdi kepadanya tampak lazim sejak masa Helenistik, dan pada masa Romawi, ketika ia dikenal sebagai Vesta, ia terus dipuja, misalnya di Ephesus. Setiap kali koloni baru didirikan, nyala api dari perapian umum Hestia di kota induk dibawa ke permukiman baru.
long_description.en: Her public cult flourished above all in Attica, with notable cults at Piraeus, Eleusis, Halimos, and Krokonidai. Priests and priestesses specifically dedicated to her seem to have been common from the Hellenistic period, and in the Roman period, when she was known as Vesta, she continued to be worshipped, for example at Ephesus. Whenever a new colony was founded, a flame from Hestia's public hearth in the mother city was carried to the new settlement.

cultural_context.id: Perapian dipandang sebagai pusat suci kehidupan rumah tangga dan lambang jantung serta jiwa rumah tangga; Hestia dianggap pemberi kebahagiaan dan berkat rumah tangga, dan sumpah serta suaka pemohon dikaitkan dengan perapian. Kurban bagi Hestia berupa buah sulung, air, minyak, anggur, dan sapi berumur satu tahun, dan api perapiannya yang padam tidak boleh dinyalakan kembali dengan api biasa.
cultural_context.en: The hearth was seen as the sacred centre of domestic life and a symbol of the household's heart and soul; Hestia was regarded as the giver of domestic happiness and blessings, and oaths and the asylum of suppliants were tied to the hearth. Offerings to Hestia were first fruits, water, oil, wine, and one-year-old cows, and her hearth fire, if extinguished, could not be relit with ordinary fire.

summary.id: Cronus, yang takut ditumbangkan anaknya, menelan Hestia dan saudara-saudaranya. Zeus kemudian memaksa sang Titan memuntahkan mereka; karena Hestia ditelan pertama dan dimuntahkan terakhir, ia disebut sekaligus yang tertua dan termuda.
summary.en: Cronus, fearing overthrow by his children, swallowed Hestia and her siblings. Zeus later forced the Titan to disgorge them; being swallowed first and disgorged last, Hestia was called both the eldest and the youngest.

summary.id: Ketika Apollon dan Poseidon melamarnya, Hestia menolak dan meminta Zeus membiarkannya tetap perawan. Zeus setuju, memberinya tempat di tengah rumah dan kehormatan menerima kurban pertama, dan ia mengambil tempat di perapian Zeus.
summary.en: When Apollon and Poseidon sought her hand, Hestia refused and asked Zeus to let her remain a virgin. Zeus agreed, gave her a place in the midst of the house and the honour of the first sacrifice, and she took her place at his hearth.

role.en: The goddess who gives up her place

summary.id: Dalam sebagian mitos Hestia melepaskan tempatnya di Gunung Olimpus dan bertukar dengan Dionysos, karena lebih suka menjauh dari urusan para dewa dan yakin disambut hangat di kota manusia mana pun.
summary.en: Some myths say Hestia stepped down from her seat on Mount Olympus in favour of Dionysos, choosing to stay out of divine affairs, confident that any human city would welcome her.

statement.en: Hestia is the Greek goddess of the hearth, home, and hospitality.

claims.quote: In Greek mythology, she is the eldest daughter of Cronus and Rhea.

statement.id: Hestia adalah putri sulung Cronus dan Rhea.
statement.en: Hestia is the eldest daughter of Cronus and Rhea.

claims.quote: To the Romans, the goddess was known as Vesta.

statement.id: Bangsa Romawi mengenalnya sebagai Vesta.
statement.en: The Romans knew her as Vesta.

claims.quote: Hestia never married and remained a virgin, despite the amorous attentions of Apollo, Poseidon, and Priapus, the fertility god.

statement.id: Hestia tetap perawan dan tidak menikah meskipun didekati Apollo, Poseidon, dan Priapus.
statement.en: Hestia remained unmarried despite the interest of Apollo, Poseidon, and Priapus.

claims.quote: The goddess was the personification of the hearth and so she received sacrifices in all the temples of the gods as each one had its own hearth.

statement.id: Hestia dipandang sebagai personifikasi perapian dan menerima persembahan di kuil para dewa.
statement.en: Hestia personified the hearth and received offerings in temples.

claims.quote: Hestia was also the goddess of the sacrificial flame and received a share of every sacrifice to the gods.

statement.id: Hestia terkait api kurban dan mendapat bagian dari setiap persembahan kepada para dewa.
statement.en: Hestia governed the sacrificial flame and received a share of each offering.

claims.quote: Hestia was depicted in Athenian vase painting as a modestly veiled woman sometimes holding a flowered branch (perhaps a chaste-tree).

statement.id: Lukisan vas Athena menggambarkan Hestia sebagai perempuan berkerudung, kadang memegang dahan berbunga.
statement.en: Athenian vase paintings show Hestia veiled and sometimes holding a flowering branch.

claims.quote: In her role as a protector of the family and political community, sacrifices and offerings were regularly made to Hestia at the hearth within each private home and at the town or city's public hearth.

statement.id: Sebagai pelindung keluarga dan komunitas politik, persembahan secara rutin dibuat bagi Hestia di perapian setiap rumah dan di perapian umum kota.
statement.en: As protector of the family and political community, offerings were regularly made to Hestia at the hearth in each private home and at the town or city's public hearth.

claims.quote: In the Greek myths, Hestia's parents were Cronus and Rhea and so her younger siblings were Zeus, Hera, Demeter, Poseidon, and Hades. Cronus, paranoid that one of his own children would overthrow his rule, swallowed them all.

statement.id: Orang tua Hestia adalah Cronus dan Rhea; adik-adiknya Zeus, Hera, Demeter, Poseidon, dan Hades. Cronus, yang takut ditumbangkan anaknya, menelan mereka semua.
statement.en: Hestia's parents were Cronus and Rhea; her younger siblings were Zeus, Hera, Demeter, Poseidon, and Hades. Cronus, fearing overthrow by his children, swallowed them all.

claims.quote: In some lists, Hestia is one of the 12 Olympian gods but more commonly her place is taken by Dionysos.

statement.id: Dalam sebagian daftar Hestia termasuk 12 dewa Olimpus, tetapi lebih umum tempatnya diisi Dionysos.
statement.en: In some lists Hestia is one of the 12 Olympian gods, but more commonly her place is taken by Dionysos.

claims.quote: In some myths the goddess voluntarily relinquishes her place amongst the gods on Mount Olympus, swapping with Dionysos because she prefers to withdraw from godly affairs and is sure of a fond welcome in any mortal city she chooses.

statement.id: Dalam sebagian mitos Hestia melepaskan tempatnya di Gunung Olimpus dan bertukar dengan Dionysos karena lebih suka menjauh dari urusan para dewa dan yakin disambut hangat di kota manusia mana pun.
statement.en: In some myths Hestia voluntarily gives up her place on Mount Olympus, swapping with Dionysos because she prefers to withdraw from godly affairs and is sure of a warm welcome in any mortal city.

claims.quote: By tradition, Hestia received any sacrifices before the other gods, even at such places as Olympia where Zeus was honoured. Hestia also received the first and last libations of wine offering at any feast and was usually mentioned first in any prayers and oaths.

statement.id: Menurut tradisi, Hestia menerima kurban lebih dulu daripada dewa lain, mendapat persembahan anggur pertama dan terakhir pada setiap pesta, dan biasanya disebut pertama dalam doa dan sumpah.
statement.en: By tradition Hestia received sacrifices before the other gods, received the first and last libations of wine at any feast, and was usually mentioned first in prayers and oaths.

claims.quote: In mythology, the honour of receiving the first sacrifice was given by Zeus when Hestia swore that she would always remain a virgin.

statement.id: Dalam mitologi, kehormatan menerima kurban pertama diberikan Zeus ketika Hestia bersumpah akan selalu perawan.
statement.en: In mythology Zeus gave Hestia the honour of the first sacrifice when she swore she would always remain a virgin.

claims.quote: Within a Greek house, the hearth was usually a portable brazier but it symbolised the heart and soul of the household and came to represent its centre.

statement.id: Di rumah Yunani, perapian biasanya berupa tungku portabel, tetapi melambangkan jantung dan jiwa rumah tangga dan menjadi pusatnya.
statement.en: In a Greek house the hearth was usually a portable brazier but symbolised the heart and soul of the household and came to represent its centre.

claims.quote: The goddesses personification as the hearth also linked her to ideas of hospitality, the protection of guests, and the inventor of good housebuilding.

statement.id: Personifikasi Hestia sebagai perapian juga mengaitkannya dengan keramahtamahan, perlindungan tamu, dan penemu pembangunan rumah yang baik.
statement.en: Hestia's personification as the hearth also linked her to hospitality, the protection of guests, and the inventor of good housebuilding.

claims.quote: Besides individual homes, Hestia was particularly associated with the prytaneion and bouleuterion, the symbolic centre of a town or city where civic functions were held and the business of local government was carried out.

statement.id: Selain rumah pribadi, Hestia terutama dikaitkan dengan prytaneion dan bouleuterion, pusat simbolis kota tempat urusan pemerintahan setempat dijalankan.
statement.en: Besides individual homes, Hestia was particularly associated with the prytaneion and bouleuterion, the symbolic centre of a town where local government business was carried out.

claims.quote: Public worship of Hestia was especially prevalent in Attica with notable cults at Piraeus, Eleusis, Halimos, and Krokonidai.

statement.id: Pemujaan umum Hestia terutama marak di Attica dengan kultus penting di Piraeus, Eleusis, Halimos, dan Krokonidai.
statement.en: Public worship of Hestia was especially prevalent in Attica, with notable cults at Piraeus, Eleusis, Halimos, and Krokonidai.

claims.quote: The Greek goddess was the only one to not join the Olympians in their failed attack on Zeus.

statement.id: Hestia adalah satu-satunya dewi yang tidak ikut para dewa Olimpus dalam serangan gagal mereka terhadap Zeus.
statement.en: Hestia was the only goddess who did not join the Olympians in their failed attack on Zeus.

claims.quote: Hestia is usually presented in Greek art as a young female wearing a head covering & modest clothing.

statement.id: Dalam seni Yunani, Hestia biasanya ditampilkan sebagai perempuan muda berpenutup kepala dan berpakaian sederhana.
statement.en: In Greek art Hestia is usually presented as a young woman wearing a head covering and modest clothing.

claims.quote: As Hestia has no particular mythology surrounding her, she does not appear very often in Greek art, and when she does, she can be difficult to distinguish from other goddesses

statement.id: Karena tidak punya mitologi khusus, Hestia jarang muncul dalam seni Yunani dan sulit dibedakan dari dewi lain.
statement.en: Because she has no particular mythology, Hestia appears rarely in Greek art and can be difficult to distinguish from other goddesses.

claims.quote: In the Roman period, Hestia, now known as Vesta, continued to be worshipped, for example at Ephesus where the high priest was a female.

statement.id: Pada masa Romawi, Hestia, yang kini dikenal sebagai Vesta, terus dipuja, misalnya di Ephesus tempat imam besarnya perempuan.
statement.en: In the Roman period Hestia, now known as Vesta, continued to be worshipped, for example at Ephesus where the high priest was a woman.

claims.quote: She appears on the celebrated Francois Vase (570-565 BCE) and, this time named, on the north frieze of the Siphinian Treasury at Delphi (c. 525 BCE) where she and an unidentified goddess face two giants in hoplite uniform.

statement.id: Hestia muncul pada Vas Francois (570-565 SM) dan, kali ini dengan nama, pada friz utara Perbendaharaan Siphnos di Delphi (sekitar 525 SM) menghadapi dua raksasa berbaju prajurit hoplit.
statement.en: Hestia appears on the Francois Vase (570-565 BCE) and, this time named, on the north frieze of the Siphnian Treasury at Delphi (c. 525 BCE), facing two giants in hoplite uniform with an unidentified goddess.

claims.quote: As the goddess of the family hearth she also presided over the cooking of bread and the preparation of the family meal.

statement.id: Sebagai dewi perapian keluarga, Hestia juga memimpin pembuatan roti dan penyiapan hidangan keluarga.
statement.en: As goddess of the family hearth, Hestia also presided over the baking of bread and the preparation of the family meal.

claims.quote: In myth Hestia was the first born child of Kronos (Cronus) and Rhea who was swallowed by her father at birth. Zeus later forced the old Titan to disgorge Hestia and her siblings.

statement.id: Dalam mitos Hestia adalah anak sulung Kronos dan Rhea yang ditelan ayahnya saat lahir; Zeus kemudian memaksa sang Titan memuntahkan Hestia dan saudara-saudaranya.
statement.en: In myth Hestia was the firstborn of Kronos and Rhea, swallowed by her father at birth; Zeus later forced the old Titan to disgorge Hestia and her siblings.

claims.quote: As the first to be swallowed she was also the last to be disgorged, and so was named as both the eldest and youngest of the six Kronides.

statement.id: Karena yang pertama ditelan sekaligus yang terakhir dimuntahkan, Hestia disebut sebagai yang tertua sekaligus termuda dari enam Kronid.
statement.en: Being the first swallowed and last disgorged, Hestia was named both the eldest and youngest of the six Kronides.

claims.quote: When the gods Apollon and Poseidon sought for her hand in marriage, Hestia refused and asked Zeus to let her remain an eternal virgin. He agreed and she took her place at his royal hearth.

statement.id: Ketika Apollon dan Poseidon melamarnya, Hestia menolak dan meminta Zeus membiarkannya tetap perawan; Zeus setuju dan ia mengambil tempat di perapian kerajaan Zeus.
statement.en: When Apollon and Poseidon sought her hand, Hestia refused and asked Zeus to let her remain an eternal virgin; he agreed and she took her place at his royal hearth.

claims.quote: So Zeus the Father gave her a high honour instead of marriage, and she has her place in the midst of the house and has the richest portion. In all the temples of the gods she has a share of honour, and among all mortal men she is chief of the goddesses.

statement.id: Menurut Himne Homerik untuk Aphrodite, Zeus memberinya kehormatan tinggi sebagai ganti pernikahan: tempat di tengah rumah, bagian terkaya, bagian kehormatan di semua kuil, dan kedudukan sebagai dewi utama di antara manusia.
statement.en: According to the Homeric Hymn to Aphrodite, Zeus gave her high honour instead of marriage: a place in the midst of the house, the richest portion, a share of honour in all temples, and the position of chief of the goddesses among mortals.

claims.quote: For without you mortals hold no banquet,--where one does not duly pour sweet wine in offering to Hestia both first and last.

statement.id: Menurut Himne Homerik untuk Hestia, manusia tidak mengadakan pesta tanpa Hestia, karena anggur manis dituangkan baginya lebih dulu dan terakhir.
statement.en: According to the Homeric Hymn to Hestia, mortals hold no banquet without her, since sweet wine is poured in offering to Hestia first and last.

claims.quote: Hestia was looked upon as presiding at all sacrifices, and, as the goddess of the sacred fire of the altar, she had a share in the sacrifices in all the temples of the gods.
claims.locator: Encyclopedia (Smith, Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology)

statement.id: Hestia dipandang memimpin semua kurban dan, sebagai dewi api suci altar, mendapat bagian dalam kurban di semua kuil para dewa.
statement.en: Hestia was regarded as presiding at all sacrifices and, as goddess of the sacred fire of the altar, had a share in the sacrifices in all the temples of the gods.

claims.quote: As the hearth was looked upon as the sacred centre of domestic life, so Hestia was the goddess of domestic life and the giver of all domestic happiness and blessings, and as such she was believed to dwell in the inner part of every house
claims.locator: Encyclopedia (Smith, Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology)

statement.id: Karena perapian dipandang pusat suci kehidupan rumah tangga, Hestia dianggap dewi kehidupan rumah tangga dan pemberi segala kebahagiaan dan berkat rumah tangga, serta dipercaya berdiam di bagian dalam setiap rumah.
statement.en: As the hearth was seen as the sacred centre of domestic life, Hestia was the goddess of domestic life and giver of all domestic happiness and blessings, believed to dwell in the inner part of every house.

claims.quote: In classical sculpture she was also veiled, with a kettle as her attribute.

statement.id: Dalam patung klasik Hestia juga berkerudung, dengan ketel sebagai atributnya.
statement.en: In classical sculpture she was also veiled, with a kettle as her attribute.

claims.quote: Solemn oaths were sworn by the goddess of the hearth, and the hearth itself was the sacred asylum where suppliants implored the protection of the inhabitants of the house.
claims.locator: Encyclopedia (Smith, Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology)

statement.id: Sumpah khidmat diucapkan demi dewi perapian, dan perapian sendiri adalah suaka suci tempat pemohon meminta perlindungan penghuni rumah.
statement.en: Solemn oaths were sworn by the goddess of the hearth, and the hearth itself was the sacred asylum where suppliants implored the protection of the household.

claims.quote: Her sacrifices consisted of the primitiae of fruit, water, oil, wine, and cows of one year old.
claims.locator: Encyclopedia (Smith, Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology)

statement.id: Kurban bagi Hestia berupa buah sulung, air, minyak, anggur, dan sapi berumur satu tahun.
statement.en: Sacrifices to Hestia consisted of the first fruits, water, oil, wine, and cows one year old.

claims.quote: If ever the fire of her hearth became extinct, it was not allowed to be lighted again with ordinary fire, but either by fire produced by friction, or by burning glasses drawing fire from the sun.
claims.locator: Encyclopedia (Smith, Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology)

statement.id: Jika api perapiannya padam, api itu tidak boleh dinyalakan kembali dengan api biasa, melainkan dengan api hasil gesekan atau kaca pembakar yang menarik api dari matahari.
statement.en: If the fire of her hearth went out, it could not be relit with ordinary fire but only by fire made by friction or by burning glasses drawing fire from the sun.

claims.quote: In this respect she appears often together with Hermes, who was likewise a deus penetralis, as protecting the works of man.
claims.locator: Encyclopedia (Smith, Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology)

statement.id: Hestia sering tampil bersama Hermes sebagai pelindung hasil karya manusia.
statement.en: Hestia often appears together with Hermes as protector of the works of man.

claims.quote: The connection between Hestia and Apollo and Poseidon, which is thus alluded to in the legend, appears also in the temple of Delphi, where the three divinities were worshipped in common, and Hestia and Poseidon appeared together also at Olympia.
claims.locator: Encyclopedia (Smith, Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology)

statement.id: Kaitan Hestia dengan Apollo dan Poseidon tampak pula di kuil Delphi, tempat ketiganya dipuja bersama, dan Hestia serta Poseidon juga muncul bersama di Olympia.
statement.en: The link between Hestia and Apollo and Poseidon appears also in the temple at Delphi, where the three were worshipped together, and Hestia and Poseidon appeared together at Olympia.

claims.quote: There was, however, a separate temple of Hestia at Hermione, though it contained no image of her, but only an altar.
claims.locator: Encyclopedia (Smith, Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology)

statement.id: Ada kuil Hestia tersendiri di Hermione, tetapi tanpa arca, hanya altar.
statement.en: There was a separate temple of Hestia at Hermione, but it contained no image of her, only an altar.

claims.quote: Hesiod, Theogony 453 ff (trans. Evelyn-White) (Greek epic C8th or C7th B.C.) : "But Rhea was subject in love to Kronos (Cronus) and bare splendid children, Hestia, Demeter, and gold-shod Hera

statement.id: Dalam Theogony Hesiod (epos Yunani abad ke-8 atau ke-7 SM menurut Theoi), Rhea melahirkan anak-anak Kronos, yaitu Hestia, Demeter, dan Hera.
statement.en: In Hesiod's Theogony (Greek epic of the 8th or 7th century BC according to Theoi), Rhea bore Kronos's children Hestia, Demeter, and Hera.

claims.quote: Vesta [Hestia] lies down and takes a quiet, carefree nap, just as she was, her head pillowed by turf. But the red saviour of gardens [Priapos] prowls for Nymphai and goddesses, and wanders back and forth. He spots Vesta.

statement.id: Dalam Fasti Ovidius, Vesta (Hestia) tertidur pulas saat pesta para dewa, dan Priapus yang berkeliaran mencari nimfa dan dewi melihatnya.
statement.en: In Ovid's Fasti, Vesta (Hestia) takes a carefree nap during the gods' feast, and Priapus, prowling for nymphs and goddesses, spots her.

claims.quote: when it bellowed an untimely bray. The goddess stars up, frightened by the noise. The whole crowd fly to her; the god flees through hostile hands.

statement.id: Dalam kisah itu keledai Silenus meringkik pada saat yang salah; sang dewi terbangun ketakutan, para hadirin berlari menolongnya, dan Priapus lari melewati tangan-tangan yang memusuhinya.
statement.en: In that story a donkey brays at the wrong moment; the goddess wakes frightened, the crowd rushes to her, and Priapus flees through hostile hands.

claims.quote: Hestia's name means "hearth, fireplace, altar".

statement.id: Nama Hestia berarti "perapian, tungku, altar".
statement.en: Hestia's name means "hearth, fireplace, altar".

claims.quote: the anonymous author of the hymn was trying to reconcile the two conflicting birth orders given by Hesiod and Homer; while in the Theogony the firstborn is Hestia, in the Iliad Hera states that she is the eldest child.

statement.id: Menurut Wikipedia, pengarang himne tampaknya mencoba mendamaikan dua urutan kelahiran yang bertentangan: dalam Theogony Hestia anak sulung, dalam Iliad Hera menyatakan dirinya yang tertua.
statement.en: According to Wikipedia, the hymn's author was likely trying to reconcile two conflicting birth orders: in the Theogony Hestia is firstborn, while in the Iliad Hera states that she is the eldest.

claims.quote: Zeus assigned Hestia a duty to feed and maintain the fires of the Olympian hearth with the fatty, combustible portions of animal sacrifices to the gods.

statement.id: Zeus menugaskan Hestia memberi makan dan memelihara api perapian Olimpus dengan bagian lemak kurban hewan yang mudah terbakar.
statement.en: Zeus assigned Hestia the duty of feeding and maintaining the fires of the Olympian hearth with the fatty, combustible portions of animal sacrifices.

claims.quote: Whenever a new colony was established, a flame from Hestia's public hearth in the mother city would be carried to the new settlement.

statement.id: Setiap kali koloni baru didirikan, nyala api dari perapian umum Hestia di kota induk dibawa ke permukiman baru.
statement.en: Whenever a new colony was founded, a flame from Hestia's public hearth in the mother city was carried to the new settlement.

claims.quote: Like Athena and Artemis, Hestia elected never to marry and remained an eternal virgin goddess instead, forever tending to the hearth of Olympus.

statement.id: Seperti Athena dan Artemis, Hestia memilih tidak pernah menikah dan tetap menjadi dewi perawan abadi yang selalu merawat perapian Olimpus.
statement.en: Like Athena and Artemis, Hestia chose never to marry and remained an eternal virgin goddess, forever tending the hearth of Olympus.

claims.quote: Ancient Greek: Ἑστία, lit. 'hearth, fireplace, altar'

statement.id: Dalam bahasa Yunani Kuno namanya ditulis Ἑστία, secara harfiah "perapian, tungku, altar".
statement.en: In Ancient Greek her name is written Ἑστία, literally 'hearth, fireplace, altar'.

claims.quote: Nor yet does the pure maiden Histia (Hestia) love Aphrodite's works.

statement.id: Dalam Himne Homerik untuk Aphrodite namanya ditulis Histia (Hestia).
statement.en: In the Homeric Hymn to Aphrodite her name is written Histia (Hestia).

claims.quote: where the goddess had her especial sanctuary (thalamos), under the name of Prutanitis, with a statue and the sacred hearth.
claims.locator: Encyclopedia (Smith, Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology)

statement.id: Di prytaneum kota, Hestia memiliki tempat suci khusus dengan nama Prutanitis, lengkap dengan arca dan perapian suci.
statement.en: In a town's prytaneum Hestia had her special sanctuary under the name Prutanitis, with a statue and the sacred hearth.

claims.quote: Priests and priestesses specifically dedicated to Hestia seem to have been particularly prevalent from the Hellenistic period.

statement.id: Imam dan imam perempuan yang khusus mengabdi kepada Hestia tampaknya sangat lazim sejak masa Helenistik.
statement.en: Priests and priestesses specifically dedicated to Hestia seem to have been particularly prevalent from the Hellenistic period.

claims.quote: For this reason, there developed a saying 'to begin from Hestia.'

statement.id: Karena Hestia disebut pertama, berkembang ungkapan "mulai dari Hestia".
statement.en: Because Hestia was named first, a saying developed: 'to begin from Hestia.'

claims.quote: sometimes she is pouring a libation, as in a c. 500 BCE red-figure kylix now in the Berlin Staatliche Museen which shows her in the company of Apollo and Hermes as they lead Hercules to Mount Olympus.

statement.id: Hestia kadang digambarkan menuang persembahan, misalnya pada kylix figur merah sekitar 500 SM di Berlin bersama Apollo dan Hermes yang menuntun Hercules ke Gunung Olimpus.
statement.en: Hestia is sometimes shown pouring a libation, as on a c. 500 BCE red-figure kylix in Berlin where she is with Apollo and Hermes as they lead Hercules to Mount Olympus.

summary.id: Theoi dan Theogony menyebut Hestia anak sulung Kronos dan Rhea; karena ditelan pertama dan dimuntahkan terakhir, ia juga disebut termuda.
summary.en: Theoi and the Theogony make Hestia the firstborn of Kronos and Rhea; being swallowed first and disgorged last, she is also called the youngest.

summary.id: Menurut Wikipedia, dalam Iliad Hera menyatakan dirinya yang tertua, dan pengarang himne mungkin mencoba mendamaikan dua urutan itu.
summary.en: According to Wikipedia, in the Iliad Hera states that she is the eldest, and the hymn's author may have been reconciling the two orders.

summary.id: Dalam sebagian daftar Hestia termasuk 12 dewa Olimpus, tetapi lebih umum tempatnya diisi Dionysos.
summary.en: In some lists Hestia is one of the 12 Olympians, but more commonly her place is taken by Dionysos.

summary.id: Dalam sebagian mitos Hestia sendiri melepaskan tempatnya kepada Dionysos.
summary.en: In some myths Hestia herself gives up her place to Dionysos.

summary.id: Satu sumber menyebut Apollo, Poseidon, dan Priapus yang memperhatikannya.
summary.en: One source names Apollo, Poseidon, and Priapus as paying her attention.

summary.id: Sumber lain menyebut Apollon dan Poseidon yang melamarnya.
summary.en: Another source names Apollon and Poseidon as seeking her hand.

short_description.id: Persephone, juga disebut Kore, adalah dewi Yunani pertanian dan tumbuhan, putri Demeter, yang menjadi ratu dunia bawah sebagai istri Hades dan kembali ke permukaan setiap tahun.
short_description.en: Persephone, also called Kore, is a Greek goddess of agriculture and vegetation, daughter of Demeter, who became queen of the underworld as Hades's wife and returns to the surface each year.

long_description.id:
Persephone, atau Kore, adalah dewi Yunani yang terkait dengan pertanian, tumbuhan, dan khususnya biji-bijian. Ia putri Zeus dan Demeter, serta istri Hades, penguasa dunia bawah, sehingga ia dikenal sebagai ratu dunia bawah. Kore berarti "anak perempuan" sekaligus "gadis"; dalam bahasa Latin ia disebut Proserpina. Para sarjana menafsirkan mitosnya sebagai perwujudan musim semi dan tumbuhan, dan julukannya menunjukkan fungsi ganda sebagai dewi bawah tanah dan dewi tumbuhan.

Dalam kisah penculikannya, Persephone sedang memetik bunga di padang rumput bersama kawan-kawannya ketika Hades membawanya ke dunia bawah dengan kereta. Menurut Himne Homerik untuk Demeter, bumi menganga di dataran Nysa dan hanya Hecate dan Helios yang mendengar teriakannya. Demeter berkelana mencarinya hingga Eleusis; kesedihannya menyebabkan gagal panen dan kekeringan hingga Zeus memerintahkan Hades mengembalikannya.

Sebelum melepasnya, Hades memberi Persephone biji delima. Menurut Himne Homerik, Demeter menyatakan bahwa jika ia telah makan, ia harus tinggal di bawah bumi selama sepertiga tahun dan menyertai para dewa selama dua bagian lainnya; sumber lain menyebut sepertiga atau separuh tahun. Ia naik kembali ketika bumi mekar di musim semi, dan sejak itu Hecate menjadi pendampingnya. Kisah ini dapat melambangkan pergantian musim, meski ada tafsiran lain tentang penyimpanan gandum di bawah tanah.

Persephone adalah unsur penting dalam Misteri Eleusis, yang menjanjikan akhirat bahagia, dan dalam festival Thesmophoria; kultusnya kuat di Sisilia dan Italia selatan, dan di Locris ia dewi pernikahan dan kelahiran. Sebagai ratu dunia bawah ia sering dimohon dalam tablet kutukan. Dalam seni Yunani Klasik ia digambarkan berjubah, sering membawa seikat gandum, dan paling sering ditampilkan saat dibawa pergi Hades.
long_description.en:
Persephone, or Kore, is a Greek goddess associated with agriculture, vegetation and especially grain. She is the daughter of Zeus and Demeter and the wife of Hades, ruler of the underworld, so she is known as queen of the underworld. Kore means "daughter" and "maiden" at once; in Latin she is called Proserpina. Scholars interpret her myth as embodying spring and vegetation, and her epithets show a double function as chthonic and vegetation goddess.

In the story of her abduction, Persephone was picking flowers in a meadow with her companions when Hades carried her off to the underworld. According to the Homeric Hymn to Demeter, the earth yawned in the plain of Nysa and only Hecate and Helios heard her cry. Demeter wandered in search of her as far as Eleusis; her grief caused crops to fail and a drought until Zeus ordered Hades to return her.

Before releasing her, Hades gave Persephone pomegranate seed. According to the Homeric Hymn, Demeter declares that if she has eaten she must stay beneath the earth for a third of the year and be with the gods for the other two parts; another source says one-third or one-half of the year. She comes up again when the earth blooms in spring, and from then on Hecate is her companion. The story may symbolize the change of seasons, though another interpretation concerns the storage of grain underground.

Persephone was an important element of the Eleusinian Mysteries, which promised a happy afterlife, and of the Thesmophoria festival; her cult was strong in Sicily and southern Italy, and at Locris she was a goddess of marriage and childbirth. As queen of the underworld she was often appealed to in curse tablets. In Classical Greek art she is shown robed, often carrying a sheaf of grain, and most often being carried off by Hades.

literal_meaning.en: The etymology is obscure; one hypothesis reads it as "she who beats the ears of corn", a folk etymology as "to bring death".

cultural_context.id: Persephone dan Demeter adalah tokoh sentral Misteri Eleusis, yang menjanjikan akhirat bahagia bagi yang diinisiasi, dan kisah mereka dibaca sebagai lambang pergantian musim serta daur hidup dan mati; ada pula tafsiran bahwa mitos itu merujuk pada penyimpanan gandum di bawah tanah. Mitos serupa tentang turun dan kembalinya juga muncul dalam kultus Attis, Adonis, dan Osiris.
cultural_context.en: Persephone and Demeter were central figures of the Eleusinian Mysteries, which promised initiates a happy afterlife, and their story is read as symbolizing the changing seasons and the cycle of life and death; another interpretation is that the myth refers to storing grain underground. Similar myths of descent and return also appear in the cults of Attis, Adonis and Osiris.

description.id: Dalam Himne Homerik, Hades menyatakan Persephone akan memerintah semua yang hidup dan bergerak dan memiliki hak terbesar di antara para dewa; mereka yang menipunya akan dihukum.
description.en: In the Homeric Hymn Hades declares Persephone shall rule all that lives and moves and have the greatest rights among the gods; those who defraud her shall be punished.

description.id: Sebagai ratu dunia bawah ia dipandang sebagai pelindung di alam baka, meski Hesiodos menyebutnya "menakutkan".
description.en: As queen of the underworld she was seen as a protectress in the after-life, though Hesiod calls her "dread".

description.id: Kisah penculikan dan kembalinya mewakili fungsinya sebagai perwujudan musim semi dan personifikasi tumbuhan, terutama biji-bijian.
description.en: The story of her abduction and return represents her functions as embodiment of spring and personification of vegetation, especially grain.

description.id: Dalam beberapa versi, Persephone bisa dibebaskan seandainya tidak makan apa pun di dunia bawah; biji delima yang diberikan Hades membuatnya harus kembali sebagian tahun.
description.en: In some versions Persephone could have been released had she eaten nothing in the underworld; the pomegranate seed Hades gave her obliges her to return for part of the year.

description.id: Nama Latin Persephone; orang Romawi juga mengidentifikasinya sebagai Libera, dewi Italik yang dipadukan dengan Proserpina.
description.en: The Latin name of Persephone; the Romans also identified her as Libera, an Italic goddess conflated with Proserpina.

summary.id: Persephone memetik bunga di padang rumput ketika Hades membawanya dengan kereta ke dunia bawah. Dalam Himne Homerik, bunga narsis ditumbuhkan sebagai jerat baginya, bumi menganga di dataran Nysa, dan hanya Hecate dan Helios yang mendengar teriakannya.
summary.en: Persephone was picking flowers in a meadow when Hades carried her off in his chariot to the underworld. In the Homeric Hymn the narcissus was grown as a snare for her, the earth yawned in the plain of Nysa, and only Hecate and Helios heard her cry.

role.en: The daughter whose loss triggers the drought.

summary.id: Demeter mencari putrinya hingga tiba di Eleusis, lalu menarik diri ke kuilnya dan menciptakan kekeringan besar agar para dewa melepaskan Persephone. Ketika korban bertambah, Zeus mengutus Hermes untuk membujuk Hades.
summary.en: Demeter searched for her daughter until she reached Eleusis, then withdrew into her temple and created a great drought so the gods would release Persephone. As the victims mounted, Zeus sent Hermes to persuade Hades.

role.id: Putri yang dilepas tetapi terikat pada dunia bawah oleh biji delima.
role.en: The daughter released but bound to the underworld by the pomegranate.

summary.id: Hades memberi Persephone biji delima sebelum melepasnya. Sebagai kompromi, ia harus kembali ke dunia bawah selama sepertiga tahun (atau separuh dalam versi lain) dan naik kembali ketika bumi mekar di musim semi.
summary.en: Hades gave Persephone a pomegranate seed before releasing her. As a compromise she must return to the underworld for a third of the year (or a half in other versions) and comes up again when the earth blooms in spring.

short_description.id: Persephone, juga disebut Kore, adalah dewi Yunani pertanian dan tumbuhan, putri Demeter, yang menjadi ratu dunia bawah sebagai istri Hades dan kembali ke permukaan setiap tahun.
short_description.en: Persephone, also called Kore, is a Greek goddess of agriculture and vegetation, daughter of Demeter, who became queen of the underworld as Hades's wife and returns to the surface each year.

long_description.id: Persephone, atau Kore, adalah dewi Yunani yang terkait dengan pertanian, tumbuhan, dan khususnya biji-bijian. Ia putri Zeus dan Demeter, serta istri Hades, penguasa dunia bawah, sehingga ia dikenal sebagai ratu dunia bawah. Kore berarti "anak perempuan" sekaligus "gadis"; dalam bahasa Latin ia disebut Proserpina. Para sarjana menafsirkan mitosnya sebagai perwujudan musim semi dan tumbuhan, dan julukannya menunjukkan fungsi ganda sebagai dewi bawah tanah dan dewi tumbuhan.
long_description.en: Persephone, or Kore, is a Greek goddess associated with agriculture, vegetation and especially grain. She is the daughter of Zeus and Demeter and the wife of Hades, ruler of the underworld, so she is known as queen of the underworld. Kore means "daughter" and "maiden" at once; in Latin she is called Proserpina. Scholars interpret her myth as embodying spring and vegetation, and her epithets show a double function as chthonic and vegetation goddess.

long_description.id: Dalam kisah penculikannya, Persephone sedang memetik bunga di padang rumput bersama kawan-kawannya ketika Hades membawanya ke dunia bawah dengan kereta. Menurut Himne Homerik untuk Demeter, bumi menganga di dataran Nysa dan hanya Hecate dan Helios yang mendengar teriakannya. Demeter berkelana mencarinya hingga Eleusis; kesedihannya menyebabkan gagal panen dan kekeringan hingga Zeus memerintahkan Hades mengembalikannya.
long_description.en: In the story of her abduction, Persephone was picking flowers in a meadow with her companions when Hades carried her off to the underworld. According to the Homeric Hymn to Demeter, the earth yawned in the plain of Nysa and only Hecate and Helios heard her cry. Demeter wandered in search of her as far as Eleusis; her grief caused crops to fail and a drought until Zeus ordered Hades to return her.

long_description.id: Sebelum melepasnya, Hades memberi Persephone biji delima. Menurut Himne Homerik, Demeter menyatakan bahwa jika ia telah makan, ia harus tinggal di bawah bumi selama sepertiga tahun dan menyertai para dewa selama dua bagian lainnya; sumber lain menyebut sepertiga atau separuh tahun. Ia naik kembali ketika bumi mekar di musim semi, dan sejak itu Hecate menjadi pendampingnya. Kisah ini dapat melambangkan pergantian musim, meski ada tafsiran lain tentang penyimpanan gandum di bawah tanah.
long_description.en: Before releasing her, Hades gave Persephone pomegranate seed. According to the Homeric Hymn, Demeter declares that if she has eaten she must stay beneath the earth for a third of the year and be with the gods for the other two parts; another source says one-third or one-half of the year. She comes up again when the earth blooms in spring, and from then on Hecate is her companion. The story may symbolize the change of seasons, though another interpretation concerns the storage of grain underground.

long_description.id: Persephone adalah unsur penting dalam Misteri Eleusis, yang menjanjikan akhirat bahagia, dan dalam festival Thesmophoria; kultusnya kuat di Sisilia dan Italia selatan, dan di Locris ia dewi pernikahan dan kelahiran. Sebagai ratu dunia bawah ia sering dimohon dalam tablet kutukan. Dalam seni Yunani Klasik ia digambarkan berjubah, sering membawa seikat gandum, dan paling sering ditampilkan saat dibawa pergi Hades.
long_description.en: Persephone was an important element of the Eleusinian Mysteries, which promised a happy afterlife, and of the Thesmophoria festival; her cult was strong in Sicily and southern Italy, and at Locris she was a goddess of marriage and childbirth. As queen of the underworld she was often appealed to in curse tablets. In Classical Greek art she is shown robed, often carrying a sheaf of grain, and most often being carried off by Hades.

cultural_context.id: Persephone dan Demeter adalah tokoh sentral Misteri Eleusis, yang menjanjikan akhirat bahagia bagi yang diinisiasi, dan kisah mereka dibaca sebagai lambang pergantian musim serta daur hidup dan mati; ada pula tafsiran bahwa mitos itu merujuk pada penyimpanan gandum di bawah tanah. Mitos serupa tentang turun dan kembalinya juga muncul dalam kultus Attis, Adonis, dan Osiris.
cultural_context.en: Persephone and Demeter were central figures of the Eleusinian Mysteries, which promised initiates a happy afterlife, and their story is read as symbolizing the changing seasons and the cycle of life and death; another interpretation is that the myth refers to storing grain underground. Similar myths of descent and return also appear in the cults of Attis, Adonis and Osiris.

literal_meaning.id: Asal katanya tidak jelas; satu hipotesis memaknainya "ia yang memukul bulir gandum", etimologi rakyat memaknainya "membawa kematian".
literal_meaning.en: The etymology is obscure; one hypothesis reads it as "she who beats the ears of corn", a folk etymology as "to bring death".

description.id: Dalam Himne Homerik, Hades menyatakan Persephone akan memerintah semua yang hidup dan bergerak dan memiliki hak terbesar di antara para dewa; mereka yang menipunya akan dihukum.
description.en: In the Homeric Hymn Hades declares Persephone shall rule all that lives and moves and have the greatest rights among the gods; those who defraud her shall be punished.

description.id: Sebagai ratu dunia bawah ia dipandang sebagai pelindung di alam baka, meski Hesiodos menyebutnya "menakutkan".
description.en: As queen of the underworld she was seen as a protectress in the after-life, though Hesiod calls her "dread".

description.id: Kisah penculikan dan kembalinya mewakili fungsinya sebagai perwujudan musim semi dan personifikasi tumbuhan, terutama biji-bijian.
description.en: The story of her abduction and return represents her functions as embodiment of spring and personification of vegetation, especially grain.

description.id: Dalam beberapa versi, Persephone bisa dibebaskan seandainya tidak makan apa pun di dunia bawah; biji delima yang diberikan Hades membuatnya harus kembali sebagian tahun.
description.en: In some versions Persephone could have been released had she eaten nothing in the underworld; the pomegranate seed Hades gave her obliges her to return for part of the year.

description.id: Nama Latin Persephone; orang Romawi juga mengidentifikasinya sebagai Libera, dewi Italik yang dipadukan dengan Proserpina.
description.en: The Latin name of Persephone; the Romans also identified her as Libera, an Italic goddess conflated with Proserpina.

summary.id: Persephone memetik bunga di padang rumput ketika Hades membawanya dengan kereta ke dunia bawah. Dalam Himne Homerik, bunga narsis ditumbuhkan sebagai jerat baginya, bumi menganga di dataran Nysa, dan hanya Hecate dan Helios yang mendengar teriakannya.
summary.en: Persephone was picking flowers in a meadow when Hades carried her off in his chariot to the underworld. In the Homeric Hymn the narcissus was grown as a snare for her, the earth yawned in the plain of Nysa, and only Hecate and Helios heard her cry.

role.en: The daughter whose loss triggers the drought.

summary.id: Demeter mencari putrinya hingga tiba di Eleusis, lalu menarik diri ke kuilnya dan menciptakan kekeringan besar agar para dewa melepaskan Persephone. Ketika korban bertambah, Zeus mengutus Hermes untuk membujuk Hades.
summary.en: Demeter searched for her daughter until she reached Eleusis, then withdrew into her temple and created a great drought so the gods would release Persephone. As the victims mounted, Zeus sent Hermes to persuade Hades.

role.id: Putri yang dilepas tetapi terikat pada dunia bawah oleh biji delima.
role.en: The daughter released but bound to the underworld by the pomegranate.

summary.id: Hades memberi Persephone biji delima sebelum melepasnya. Sebagai kompromi, ia harus kembali ke dunia bawah selama sepertiga tahun (atau separuh dalam versi lain) dan naik kembali ketika bumi mekar di musim semi.
summary.en: Hades gave Persephone a pomegranate seed before releasing her. As a compromise she must return to the underworld for a third of the year (or a half in other versions) and comes up again when the earth blooms in spring.

summary.id: Dalam mitos lain Persephone bersaing dengan Aphrodite memperebutkan Adonis hingga keduanya sepakat berbagi sang kekasih bergiliran.
summary.en: In another myth Persephone squabbles with Aphrodite over Adonis until the two agree to share him in turns.
