statement.id: Kesedihan Demeter menyebabkan gagal panen sehingga Zeus meminta Hades mengembalikan Persephone.
statement.en: Demeter's grief caused crop failure, prompting Zeus to demand Persephone's return.

claims.quote: He cunningly tricked Persephone into eating some pomegranate seeds before leaving, thus condemning her to spend part of the year in the Underworld as his wife and the rest among the living with Demeter

statement.id: Karena biji delima, Persephone harus menghabiskan sebagian tahun di dunia bawah dan sisanya bersama Demeter.
statement.en: Pomegranate seeds obliged Persephone to spend part of the year below and the rest with Demeter.

claims.quote: The story of Demeter, Hades and Persephone was perhaps symbolic of the changing seasons and the perennial change from life to death, to life once more
claims.locator: What is the Significance of the Hades-Persephone Myth?

statement.id: Kisah ini dapat melambangkan pergantian musim dan daur kehidupan.
statement.en: The story may symbolize seasonal change and life's cycle.

claims.quote: Persephone was an important element of the Eleusinian Mysteries and the Thesmophoria festival and so the goddess was worshipped throughout the Greek world.

statement.id: Persephone terkait dengan Misteri Eleusis dan perayaan Thesmophoria.
statement.en: Persephone was linked to the Eleusinian Mysteries and Thesmophoria.

claims.quote: At the right is Persephone, her daughter and the wife of Hades, the god of the underworld.

statement.id: Relief Eleusis menggambarkan Persephone di sisi kanan sebagai putri Demeter.
statement.en: The Eleusinian relief depicts Persephone on the right as Demeter's daughter.

claims.quote: Hades, god of the Underworld, fell in love with beautiful Persephone when he saw her picking flowers one day in a meadow. The god then carried her off in his chariot to live with him in the dark Underworld.

statement.id: Hades, dewa dunia bawah, jatuh cinta pada Persephone yang cantik ketika melihatnya memetik bunga di padang rumput, lalu membawanya dengan kereta ke dunia bawah yang gelap.
statement.en: Hades, god of the Underworld, fell in love with the beautiful Persephone when he saw her picking flowers in a meadow, then carried her off in his chariot to the dark Underworld.

claims.quote: In some accounts, Zeus had given his consent to the abduction, the location of the crime being traditionally placed in either Sicily (famed for its fertility) or Asia.

statement.id: Dalam sebagian versi Zeus menyetujui penculikan itu, dan lokasinya secara tradisional ditempatkan di Sisilia (termasyhur kesuburannya) atau Asia.
statement.en: In some accounts Zeus had consented to the abduction, and the location is traditionally placed in either Sicily (famed for its fertility) or Asia.

claims.quote: Meanwhile, Demeter searched the earth for her lost divine daughter and though Helios (or Hermes) told her of her daughter's fate, she, nevertheless, continued her wanderings until she finally arrived at Eleusis.

statement.id: Demeter mencari putrinya ke seluruh bumi; meski Helios (atau Hermes) memberitahunya nasib putrinya, ia terus berkelana hingga tiba di Eleusis.
statement.en: Demeter searched the earth for her lost daughter; though Helios (or Hermes) told her her daughter's fate, she kept wandering until she arrived at Eleusis.

claims.quote: Once the temple was completed, Demeter withdrew from the world and lived inside it; at the same time, she created a great drought to convince the other gods to release Persephone from Hades. As the drought claimed ever more victims, Zeus finally sent Hermes to persuade Hades to release his ill-gotten bride.

statement.id: Setelah kuil selesai, Demeter menarik diri dan tinggal di dalamnya sambil menciptakan kekeringan besar agar dewa-dewa lain melepaskan Persephone; ketika korban kekeringan bertambah, Zeus mengutus Hermes membujuk Hades.
statement.en: Once the temple was finished, Demeter withdrew into it and created a great drought to convince the other gods to release Persephone; as the drought claimed more victims, Zeus sent Hermes to persuade Hades to release her.

claims.quote: Before giving her up though, the wily Hades put a pomegranate kernel in the girl's mouth, knowing its divine taste would compel her to return to him.

statement.id: Sebelum melepasnya, Hades yang licik menaruh sebutir biji delima di mulut Persephone karena tahu rasa ilahinya akan memaksanya kembali.
statement.en: Before giving her up, the wily Hades put a pomegranate kernel in her mouth, knowing its divine taste would compel her to return to him.

claims.quote: Finally, as a compromise, it was decided that Persephone would be released but that she would have to return to Hades for one-third of the year (or in other accounts one-half).

statement.id: Sebagai kompromi, diputuskan Persephone dilepas tetapi harus kembali kepada Hades selama sepertiga tahun (atau separuh tahun dalam versi lain).
statement.en: As a compromise, it was decided Persephone would be released but must return to Hades for one-third of the year (or one-half in other accounts).

claims.quote: Another interpretation of the Persephone myth may be that it represents when the Greeks stored their grain underground for part of the year in order to protect it from summer heat.
claims.locator: What is the Significance of the Hades-Persephone Myth?

statement.id: Tafsiran lain: mitos itu mungkin menggambarkan saat orang Yunani menyimpan gandum di bawah tanah selama sebagian tahun untuk melindunginya dari panas musim panas.
statement.en: Another interpretation is that the myth represents the Greeks storing their grain underground for part of the year to protect it from summer heat.

claims.quote: The cult of Persephone in the Greek religion was especially strong in Sicily and southern Italy, and besides the Eleusinian Mysteries at Eleusis there were sanctuaries to the goddess across the Greek world, most notably at Locri Epizephyrii, Mantinea, Megalopolis, and Sparta.

statement.id: Kultus Persephone dalam agama Yunani sangat kuat di Sisilia dan Italia selatan; selain Misteri Eleusis di Eleusis, ada tempat suci untuknya di seluruh dunia Yunani, terutama di Locri Epizephyrii, Mantinea, Megalopolis, dan Sparta.
statement.en: Persephone's cult was especially strong in Sicily and southern Italy; besides the Eleusinian Mysteries at Eleusis there were sanctuaries across the Greek world, notably at Locri Epizephyrii, Mantinea, Megalopolis and Sparta.

claims.quote: The Thesmophoria was a Greek-wide celebration of the goddess and her mother. Exclusive to women, it was held annually before the sowing period when sacrifices were made and putrefied pig's remains were mixed with the seeds.

statement.id: Thesmophoria adalah perayaan seluruh Yunani untuk sang dewi dan ibunya; khusus perempuan, diadakan tiap tahun sebelum masa menabur, dengan kurban dan sisa babi yang membusuk dicampur ke benih.
statement.en: The Thesmophoria was a Greek-wide celebration of the goddess and her mother, exclusive to women and held annually before sowing, when sacrifices were made and putrefied pig remains were mixed with the seeds.

claims.quote: Persephone, in her guise as Queen of the Underworld, was often appealed to in curse tablets and on the inscribed gold leaves buried with the dead followers of Orphism which gave instructions on how to conduct themselves in the after-life.

statement.id: Sebagai Ratu Dunia Bawah, Persephone sering dimohon dalam tablet kutukan dan pada lembaran emas bertulis yang dikubur bersama pengikut Orfisme yang meninggal.
statement.en: As Queen of the Underworld, Persephone was often appealed to in curse tablets and on inscribed gold leaves buried with dead followers of Orphism.

claims.quote: In this guise, she was seen as a protectress in the after-life, although Hesiod repeatedly describes her as 'dread Persephone' in his Theogony.
claims.locator: What are the Different Names of Persephone?

statement.id: Dalam peran itu ia dipandang sebagai pelindung di alam baka, meski Hesiodos berulang kali menyebutnya "Persephone yang menakutkan" dalam Theogony.
statement.en: In that guise she was seen as a protectress in the after-life, although Hesiod repeatedly calls her "dread Persephone" in his Theogony.

claims.quote: Persephone rarely appears in art before the 6th century BCE, and then she is usually shown with Demeter; often both wear crowns and hold a torch, sceptre, or stalks of grain.
claims.locator: How is Persephone Represented in Art?

statement.id: Persephone jarang muncul dalam seni sebelum abad ke-6 SM, dan kemudian biasanya ditampilkan bersama Demeter; keduanya sering bermahkota dan memegang obor, tongkat kerajaan, atau tangkai gandum.
statement.en: Persephone rarely appears in art before the 6th century BCE, then is usually shown with Demeter; both often wear crowns and hold a torch, sceptre or stalks of grain.

claims.quote: In various other myths, Persephone is the mother of Dionysos (with Zeus, who is also her father) - although Semele is the more usual candidate - and squabbles with Aphrodite for the attentions of devilishly handsome Adonis, the two settling to share the famous lover in split shifts.
claims.locator: What are the Different Names of Persephone?

statement.id: Dalam beberapa mitos lain Persephone ibu Dionysos (dengan Zeus, yang juga ayahnya), meski Semele kandidat yang lebih lazim, dan ia bersaing dengan Aphrodite memperebutkan Adonis hingga keduanya sepakat berbagi sang kekasih bergiliran.
statement.en: In various other myths Persephone is the mother of Dionysos (by Zeus, who is also her father), though Semele is the more usual candidate, and she squabbles with Aphrodite over Adonis, the two agreeing to share the lover in turns.

claims.quote: A famous relief slab from Eleusis depicts Demeter and Persephone (holding a torch) either side of Triptolemos; it dates to the 5th century BCE.
claims.locator: How is Persephone Represented in Art?

statement.id: Sebuah lempeng relief terkenal dari Eleusis menampilkan Demeter dan Persephone (memegang obor) di kedua sisi Triptolemos; berasal dari abad ke-5 SM.
statement.en: A famous relief slab from Eleusis shows Demeter and Persephone (holding a torch) on either side of Triptolemos; it dates to the 5th century BCE.

claims.quote: In other versions of the myth, Persephone could have been released if she had not eaten anything in the underworld during her captivity, but at the last moment, Hades gave her a pomegranate seed.

statement.id: Dalam versi lain Persephone bisa dibebaskan seandainya ia tidak makan apa pun di dunia bawah, tetapi pada detik terakhir Hades memberinya sebutir biji delima.
statement.en: In other versions Persephone could have been released had she eaten nothing in the underworld, but at the last moment Hades gave her a pomegranate seed.

claims.quote: and the girl was amazed and reached out with both hands to take the lovely toy; but the wide-pathed earth yawned there in the plain of Nysa, and the lord, Host of Many, with his immortal horses sprang out upon her

statement.id: Menurut Himne Homerik untuk Demeter, gadis itu takjub dan mengulurkan kedua tangan untuk mengambil bunga itu; lalu bumi menganga di dataran Nysa dan Sang Tuan Banyak Tamu melompat keluar dengan kuda-kuda abadinya.
statement.en: In the Homeric Hymn to Demeter the girl was amazed and reached out with both hands for the lovely flower; then the earth yawned in the plain of Nysa and the lord, Host of Many, sprang out with his immortal horses.

claims.quote: which Earth made to grow at the will of Zeus and to please the Host of Many, to be a snare for the bloom-like girl

statement.id: Bunga narsis itu ditumbuhkan Bumi atas kehendak Zeus dan untuk menyenangkan Sang Tuan Banyak Tamu, sebagai jerat bagi gadis yang segar bagai bunga.
statement.en: The narcissus was made to grow by Earth at the will of Zeus and to please the Host of Many, as a snare for the bloom-like girl.

claims.quote: only tender-hearted Hecate, bright-coiffed, the daughter of Persaeus, heard the girl from her cave, and the lord Helios, Hyperion's bright son

statement.id: Hanya Hecate yang berhati lembut, putri Persaeus, mendengar teriakan gadis itu dari guanya, begitu pula tuan Helios, putra Hyperion yang cemerlang.
statement.en: Only tender-hearted Hecate, daughter of Persaeus, heard the girl from her cave, and the lord Helios, Hyperion's bright son.

claims.quote: And while you are here, you shall rule all that lives and moves and shall have the greatest rights among the deathless gods: those who defraud you and do not appease your power with offerings, reverently performing rites and paying fit gifts, shall be punished for evermore.

statement.id: Dalam Himne Homerik, Hades berkata kepada Persephone bahwa selama di sana ia akan memerintah semua yang hidup dan bergerak dan memiliki hak terbesar di antara para dewa; mereka yang menipunya dan tidak menenangkan kuasanya dengan persembahan akan dihukum selamanya.
statement.en: In the Homeric Hymn Hades tells Persephone that while she is there she shall rule all that lives and moves and have the greatest rights among the gods; those who defraud her and do not appease her power with offerings shall be punished for evermore.

claims.quote: But he on his part secretly gave her sweet pomegranate seed to eat, taking care for himself that she might not remain continually with grave, dark-robed Demeter.

statement.id: Hades diam-diam memberinya biji delima manis untuk dimakan agar ia tidak terus-menerus tinggal bersama Demeter.
statement.en: Hades secretly gave her sweet pomegranate seed to eat, taking care that she might not remain continually with Demeter.

claims.quote: if you have tasted food, you must go back again beneath the secret places of the earth, there to dwell a third part of the seasons every year: yet for the two parts you shall be with me and the other deathless gods.

statement.id: Demeter berkata: jika Persephone telah mencicipi makanan, ia harus kembali ke bawah bumi dan tinggal di sana sepertiga musim setiap tahun, sedangkan dua bagian lainnya ia bersama Demeter dan para dewa.
statement.en: Demeter says that if Persephone has tasted food she must go back beneath the earth to dwell a third part of the seasons every year, and for the other two parts be with her and the other gods.

claims.quote: But when the earth shall bloom with the fragrant flowers of spring in every kind, then from the realm of darkness and gloom thou shalt come up once more to be a wonder for gods and mortal men.

statement.id: Ketika bumi mekar dengan bunga-bunga musim semi yang harum, Persephone akan naik lagi dari alam gelap menjadi keajaiban bagi dewa dan manusia.
statement.en: When the earth blooms with the fragrant flowers of spring, Persephone shall come up once more from the realm of darkness to be a wonder for gods and mortals.

claims.quote: from that time the lady Hecate was minister and companion to Persephone.

statement.id: Sejak saat itu Hecate menjadi pelayan dan pendamping Persephone.
statement.en: From that time Hecate was minister and companion to Persephone.

claims.quote: Ancient Greek: Περσεφόνη ) is the daughter of Zeus and Demeter. She became the queen of the underworld after her abduction by her uncle Hades, the king of the underworld, who later took her into marriage.

statement.id: Persephone (Περσεφόνη dalam bahasa Yunani Kuno) adalah putri Zeus dan Demeter; ia menjadi ratu dunia bawah setelah diculik pamannya, Hades, raja dunia bawah, yang kemudian menikahinya.
statement.en: Persephone (Περσεφόνη in Ancient Greek) is the daughter of Zeus and Demeter; she became queen of the underworld after her abduction by her uncle Hades, king of the underworld, who later took her into marriage.

claims.quote: The myth of her abduction, her sojourn in the underworld, and her cyclical return to the surface represents her functions as the embodiment of spring and the personification of vegetation, especially grain crops

statement.id: Mitos penculikan, masa tinggalnya di dunia bawah, dan kembalinya yang berulang ke permukaan mewakili fungsinya sebagai perwujudan musim semi dan personifikasi tumbuhan, terutama tanaman biji-bijian.
statement.en: The myth of her abduction, sojourn in the underworld and cyclical return to the surface represents her functions as embodiment of spring and personification of vegetation, especially grain crops.

claims.quote: In Classical Greek art, Persephone is invariably portrayed robed, often carrying a sheaf of grain. She may appear as a mystical divinity with a sceptre and a little box, but she was mostly represented in the process of being carried off by Hades.

statement.id: Dalam seni Yunani Klasik, Persephone selalu digambarkan berjubah, sering membawa seikat gandum; ia dapat tampil sebagai dewi mistik dengan tongkat dan kotak kecil, tetapi paling sering ditampilkan saat dibawa pergi Hades.
statement.en: In Classical Greek art Persephone is invariably robed, often carrying a sheaf of grain; she may appear as a mystical divinity with a sceptre and a little box, but was mostly shown being carried off by Hades.

claims.quote: Persephone, as a vegetation goddess, and her mother Demeter were the central figures of the Eleusinian Mysteries, which promised the initiated a happy afterlife.

statement.id: Persephone sebagai dewi tumbuhan dan ibunya, Demeter, adalah tokoh sentral Misteri Eleusis yang menjanjikan akhirat bahagia bagi para penganutnya.
statement.en: Persephone as a vegetation goddess and her mother Demeter were the central figures of the Eleusinian Mysteries, which promised initiates a happy afterlife.

claims.quote: She is a goddess of marriage and childbirth in the region of the city of Epizephyrian Locris, in modern Calabria (southern Italy).

statement.id: Di wilayah kota Locris Epizephyria, di Calabria modern (Italia selatan), ia adalah dewi pernikahan dan kelahiran.
statement.en: In the region of the city of Epizephyrian Locris, in modern Calabria (southern Italy), she is a goddess of marriage and childbirth.

claims.quote: In Latin, her name is rendered Proserpina. She was identified by the Romans as Libera, an Italic goddess who was conflated with Proserpina.

statement.id: Dalam bahasa Latin namanya menjadi Proserpina; orang Romawi mengidentifikasinya sebagai Libera, dewi Italik yang dipadukan dengan Proserpina.
statement.en: In Latin her name is rendered Proserpina; the Romans identified her as Libera, an Italic goddess conflated with Proserpina.

claims.quote: The etymology of the word "Persephone" is obscure. ... pherein phonon, "to bring (or cause) death".

statement.id: Asal kata "Persephone" tidak jelas; etimologi rakyat yang populer mengaitkannya dengan pherein phonon, "membawa (atau menyebabkan) kematian".
statement.en: The etymology of "Persephone" is obscure; a popular folk etymology links it to pherein phonon, "to bring (or cause) death".

claims.quote: Günther Zuntz considers "Persephone" and "Kore" as distinct deities and writes that "no farmer prayed for corn to Persephone; no mourner thought of the dead as being with Kore." Ancient Greek writers were, however, not as consistent as Zuntz claims.

statement.id: Günther Zuntz menganggap "Persephone" dan "Kore" dewi yang berbeda ("tak ada petani memohon gandum kepada Persephone; tak ada orang berduka membayangkan yang mati bersama Kore"), tetapi para penulis Yunani kuno tidak sekonsisten klaimnya.
statement.en: Günther Zuntz considers "Persephone" and "Kore" distinct deities ("no farmer prayed for corn to Persephone; no mourner thought of the dead as being with Kore"), but ancient Greek writers were not as consistent as he claims.

claims.quote: Myths similar to Persephone's descent and return to earth also appear in the cults of male gods, including Attis, Adonis, and Osiris, and in Minoan Crete.

statement.id: Mitos serupa turunnya Persephone dan kembalinya ke bumi juga muncul dalam kultus dewa-dewa laki-laki, termasuk Attis, Adonis, dan Osiris, serta di Kreta Minoa.
statement.en: Myths similar to Persephone's descent and return also appear in the cults of male gods, including Attis, Adonis and Osiris, and in Minoan Crete.

claims.quote: The epithets of Persephone reveal her double function as chthonic and vegetation goddess.

statement.id: Julukan Persephone menunjukkan fungsi gandanya sebagai dewi kekuatan bawah tanah (khthonik) dan dewi tumbuhan.
statement.en: Persephone's epithets reveal her double function as chthonic and vegetation goddess.

claims.quote: According to a recent hypothesis advanced by Rudolf Wachter ... The combined sense would therefore be "she who beats the ears of corn", i.e., a "thresher of grain"

statement.id: Menurut hipotesis Rudolf Wachter, makna gabungan namanya adalah "ia yang memukul bulir gandum", yaitu "perontok gandum".
statement.en: According to a hypothesis by Rudolf Wachter, the combined sense of the name would be "she who beats the ears of corn", i.e. a "thresher of grain".

claims.quote: In cult, she was often referred to as Kore

statement.id: Dalam kultus ia sering disebut Kore.
statement.en: In cult she was often referred to as Kore.

short_description.id: Balarama adalah dewa Hindu dan kakak Krishna.
short_description.en: Balarama is a Hindu deity and Krishna's elder brother.

long_description.id:
Balarama adalah dewa Hindu dan kakak Krishna. Ia penting sebagai salah satu tiga dewa dalam tradisi Jagannath.

Nama lainnya mencakup Baladeva, Balabhadra, dan Sankarshana. Epitet Haladhara dan Halayudha berhubungan dengan bajak dan pertanian. Ia biasanya dipandang sebagai inkarnasi Shesha, tetapi sebagian tradisi menempatkannya sebagai avatar Vishnu. Mackenzie menjelaskan Balarama sebagai inkarnasi ular dunia Shesha.

Kisah-kisahnya menunjukkan kekuatan Balarama. Pada masa kecilnya sebagai penggembala ia membunuh asura Dhenuka dan pegulat Pralamba serta Mushtika, lalu panglima Kamsa, Kalavakra. Bajaknya menjadi senjata: dengan bajak itu ia melawan asura, menggali jalan bagi Yamuna, dan menyeret seluruh Hastinapura ke Gangga. Dalam perang Kaurava melawan Pandawa ia tetap netral karena telah mengajari Duryodhana maupun Bhima seni gada.
long_description.en:
Balarama is a Hindu deity and Krishna's elder brother. He is important as one of the three deities in the Jagannath tradition.

His other names include Baladeva, Balabhadra, and Sankarshana. The epithets Haladhara and Halayudha connect him with the plough and farming. He is usually regarded as an incarnation of Shesha, but some traditions count him as an avatar of Vishnu. Mackenzie describes Balarama as an incarnation of the world serpent Shesha.

His tales show Balarama's strength. As a cowherd boy he killed the asura Dhenuka and the wrestlers Pralamba and Mushtika, then Kamsa's commander Kalavakra. His plough is his weapon: with it he fights asuras, digs a channel for the Yamuna and drags all of Hastinapura into the Ganga. In the war of the Kauravas and Pandavas he stays neutral, having taught both Duryodhana and Bhima the art of the mace.

name.en: The plough as a city-scale weapon

description.id: Dengan bajaknya Balarama melawan asura, menggali jalan bagi Yamuna, dan menyeret seluruh Hastinapura ke Gangga.
description.en: With his plough Balarama fights asuras, digs a channel for the Yamuna and drags all of Hastinapura into the Ganga.

name.en: Strength that slays asuras and wrestlers

description.id: Ia membunuh asura Dhenuka, pegulat Pralamba dan Mushtika, serta panglima Kamsa, Kalavakra.
description.en: He kills the asura Dhenuka, the wrestlers Pralamba and Mushtika, and Kamsa's commander Kalavakra.

title.en: Balarama in the war of Kauravas and Pandavas

role.en: Mace teacher of both sides who stays neutral

summary.id: Balarama mengajari Duryodhana dan Bhima bertarung dengan gada; ketika perang pecah antara Kaurava dan Pandawa ia tetap netral karena terikat pada kedua pihak.
summary.en: Balarama taught Duryodhana and Bhima to fight with the mace; when war broke out between Kauravas and Pandavas he stayed neutral, bound to both sides.

claim.en: Balarama is a Hindu deity and Krishna's elder brother.

claims_provenance.quote: Balarama (Sanskrit: बलराम, IAST: Balarāma) is a Hindu god, and the elder brother of Krishna. He is particularly significant in the Jagannath tradition, as one of the triad deities. He is also known as Haladhara, Halayudha, Baladeva, Balabhadra, and Sankarshana.

claim.id: Ia penting sebagai salah satu tiga dewa dalam tradisi Jagannath.

long_description.id: Balarama adalah dewa Hindu dan kakak Krishna. Ia penting sebagai salah satu tiga dewa dalam tradisi Jagannath.
long_description.en: Balarama is a Hindu deity and Krishna's elder brother. He is important as one of the three deities in the Jagannath tradition.

long_description.id: Nama lainnya mencakup Baladeva, Balabhadra, dan Sankarshana. Epitet Haladhara dan Halayudha berhubungan dengan bajak dan pertanian. Ia biasanya dipandang sebagai inkarnasi Shesha, tetapi sebagian tradisi menempatkannya sebagai avatar Vishnu. Mackenzie menjelaskan Balarama sebagai inkarnasi ular dunia Shesha.
long_description.en: His other names include Baladeva, Balabhadra, and Sankarshana. The epithets Haladhara and Halayudha connect him with the plough and farming. He is usually regarded as an incarnation of Shesha, but some traditions count him as an avatar of Vishnu. Mackenzie describes Balarama as an incarnation of the world serpent Shesha.

long_description.id: Kisah-kisahnya menunjukkan kekuatan Balarama. Pada masa kecilnya sebagai penggembala ia membunuh asura Dhenuka dan pegulat Pralamba serta Mushtika, lalu panglima Kamsa, Kalavakra. Bajaknya menjadi senjata: dengan bajak itu ia melawan asura, menggali jalan bagi Yamuna, dan menyeret seluruh Hastinapura ke Gangga. Dalam perang Kaurava melawan Pandawa ia tetap netral karena telah mengajari Duryodhana maupun Bhima seni gada.
long_description.en: His tales show Balarama's strength. As a cowherd boy he killed the asura Dhenuka and the wrestlers Pralamba and Mushtika, then Kamsa's commander Kalavakra. His plough is his weapon: with it he fights asuras, digs a channel for the Yamuna and drags all of Hastinapura into the Ganga. In the war of the Kauravas and Pandavas he stays neutral, having taught both Duryodhana and Bhima the art of the mace.

short_description.id: Chandra adalah dewa Bulan dalam Hindu yang terkait malam dan tumbuhan.
short_description.en: Chandra is the Hindu Moon god associated with night and plants.

long_description.id:
Chandra adalah dewa Bulan dalam Hindu yang terkait malam dan tumbuhan. Ia termasuk Navagraha, sembilan planet dalam tradisi Hindu.

Chandra berarti terang atau berkilau dalam bahasa Sanskerta. Epitetnya mencakup Shashank, yang berarti bertanda kelinci. Waktu pemakaian Soma sebagai nama Bulan diperdebatkan oleh para sarjana. Mackenzie mengidentifikasi dewa Bulan Chandra dengan Soma.
long_description.en:
Chandra is the Hindu Moon god associated with night and plants. He belongs to the Navagraha, nine planets in Hindu tradition.

Chandra means bright or shining in Sanskrit. His epithets include Shashank, meaning hare marked. The time when Soma became a name of the Moon is debated by scholars. Mackenzie identifies the Moon god Chandra with Soma.

cultural_context.id: Penyamaan Soma dengan Bulan memiliki perbedaan penanggalan menurut kajian yang dirangkum.
cultural_context.en: The identification of Soma with the Moon has differing datings in the summarized studies.

name.en: Lord of the Nakshatras and of medicinal plants

description.id: Chandra menikahi 27 Nakshatra, dan ketika ia dikutuk menyusut, tanaman obat serta makhluk yang bergantung pada pengaruh bulan ikut menderita.
description.en: Chandra is married to the 27 Nakshatras, and when he was cursed to waste away the medicinal plants and beings dependent on lunar influence suffered with him.

role.en: Husband of the 27 Nakshatras, cursed to waste away

summary.id: Chandra menikahi 27 putri Daksha tetapi mengistimewakan Rohini; Daksha mengutuknya menderita penyakit susut, yang juga menimpa tanaman obat dan makhluk yang bergantung pada bulan.
summary.en: Chandra married Daksha's 27 daughters but favoured Rohini; Daksha cursed him with a wasting disease that also struck the medicinal plants and beings dependent on the moon.

claims_provenance.quote: Chandra (Sanskrit: चन्द्र, romanized: Chandra, lit. 'shining' or 'moon'), also known as Soma (Sanskrit: सोम), is the Hindu god of the Moon, and is associated with the night, plants and vegetation. He is one of the Navagraha (nine planets of Hinduism).

claim.id: Ia termasuk Navagraha, sembilan planet dalam tradisi Hindu.
claim.en: He belongs to the Navagraha, nine planets in Hindu tradition.

claims_provenance.quote: Chandra (Sanskrit: चन्द्र, romanized: Chandra, lit. 'shining' or 'moon'), also known as Soma (Sanskrit: सोम), is the Hindu god of the Moon, and is associated with the night, plants and vegetation. He is one of the Navagraha (nine planets of Hinduism).

claim.id: Chandra berarti terang atau berkilau dalam bahasa Sanskerta.
claim.en: Chandra means bright or shining in Sanskrit.

claims_provenance.quote: The word "Chandra" literally means "bright, shining or glittering" and is used for the "Moon" in Sanskrit and other Indo-Aryan languages. It is also the name of various other figures in Hindu mythology, including an asura and a Suryavamsha king. It is also a common Indian name and surname.

claim.id: Epitetnya mencakup Shashank, yang berarti bertanda kelinci.
claim.en: His epithets include Shashank, meaning hare marked.

claims_provenance.quote: Some of the epithets of Chandra include Soma (distill), Indu (bright drop), Shashank (hare-marked), Atrisuta (son of Atri), Shashin or Shachin (the essence), Taradhipa (lord of stars), Nishakara (the night maker), Nakshatrapati (lord of the Nakshatra), Oshadhipati (lord of herbs), Uduraj or Udupati (water lord), Kumudanatha (lord of lotuses), and Udupa (boat).

claim.id: Waktu pemakaian Soma sebagai nama Bulan diperdebatkan oleh para sarjana.
claim.en: The time when Soma became a name of the Moon is debated by scholars.

claims_provenance.quote: Soma is one of the most common other names used for the deity; but the earliest use of the word to refer to the Moon is a subject of scholarly debate. Some scholars state that the word Soma is occasionally used for the Moon in the Vedas, while other scholars suggest that such usage emerged only in the post-Vedic literature.

claim.id: Mackenzie mengidentifikasi dewa Bulan Chandra dengan Soma.
claim.en: Mackenzie identifies the Moon god Chandra with Soma.

claims_provenance.quote:
The moon is the god Chandra, who became identified
with Soma.

claim.id: Chandra secara tradisional menikahi 27 putri resi Daksha, yang mempersonifikasikan 27 Nakshatra (rumah bulan).
claim.en: Chandra is traditionally married to the 27 daughters of the sage Daksha, who personify the 27 Nakshatras.

claims_provenance.quote: Chandra is traditionally married to the 27 daughters of the sage Daksha, who personify the 27 Nakshatras (lunar mansions).

claim.id: Karena murka, Daksha mengutuk Chandra menderita Kshayaroga (penyakit susut); penderitaan itu tidak hanya menimpa Chandra tetapi juga tanaman obat dan makhluk hidup lain yang bergantung pada pengaruh bulan.
claim.en: In anger Daksha cursed Chandra to suffer from Kshayaroga (consumption); the affliction struck not only Chandra but also the medicinal plants and other living beings dependent on lunar influence.

claims_provenance.quote: Despite being married to all 27, Chandra showed special affection for Rohini, causing jealousy among his other wives. ... In anger, Daksha cursed Chandra to suffer from Kshayaroga (consumption or tuberculosis). This affliction impacted not just Chandra but also affected the medicinal plants and other living beings dependent on lunar influence.

claim.id: Ikonografinya yang paling umum: dewa berwarna putih yang memegang gada dan mengendarai kereta beroda tiga yang ditarik tiga atau lebih kuda putih (sampai sepuluh).
claim.en: His most common iconography is a white deity holding a mace, riding a three-wheeled chariot drawn by three or more white horses (up to ten).

claims_provenance.quote: The most common is one where he is a white-coloured deity, holding a mace in his hand, riding a chariot with three wheels and three or more white horses (up to ten).

short_description.id: Radha adalah dewi Hindu dan pasangan utama Krishna.
short_description.en: Radha is a Hindu goddess and Krishna's chief consort.

long_description.id:
Radha adalah dewi Hindu dan pasangan utama Krishna. Radhika merupakan nama lain Radha.

Ia dipuja sebagai dewi cinta, kelembutan, kasih sayang, dan bakti. Sejumlah kitab menyebutnya penjelmaan Lakshmi dan daya batin Krishna yang disebut hladini shakti. Nimbarka dan banyak tradisi Waisnawa memujanya sebagai istri abadi Krishna. Tradisi Gaudiya Waisnawa menekankan Radha sebagai kekasih serta pasangan ilahi Krishna. Radha Vallabha dan Haridasi memujanya sebagai sosok tertinggi. Ia disebut pemimpin para gopi Braj dan ratu Goloka serta Braj. Nama Radha dijelaskan bermakna kemakmuran, keberhasilan, kesempurnaan, dan kekayaan. Narada Pancharatra mencatat 1008 namanya dalam Shri Radha Saharsnama Strotam. Pada gerakan Bhakti abad keenam belas, cinta Radha kepada Krishna menjadi lebih menonjol. Gita Govinda karya Jayadeva pada abad kedua belas menjadi salah satu penampilan sastra utamanya. Kajian yang diringkas artikel membedakan Radha sebagai gopi dan sebagai dewi. Kajian Archer menyebut Gita Govinda menuturkan perpisahan, kerinduan, dan pertemuan kembali Radha dengan Krishna. Terjemahan Arnold menggambarkan Radha menanti Krishna di tepi hutan pada musim semi.

Radha tampil di banyak teks. Gatha Saptasati dari sekitar abad pertama atau kedua Masehi sudah menyebutnya, dan berbagai Purana memberinya kedudukan berbeda, dari avatar Lakshmi sampai dewa tertinggi bersama Krishna dalam Brahma Vaivarta Purana. Gita Govinda membukanya dengan Krishna yang dituntun roh Radha menemukan jalan yang benar. Julukannya menyebutnya ratu Raslila dan ratu Vrindavan, dan hari lahirnya dirayakan pada Radhashtami.
long_description.en:
Radha is a Hindu goddess and Krishna's chief consort. Radhika is another name for Radha.

She is revered as a goddess of love, tenderness, compassion, and devotion. Some scriptures call her Lakshmi's incarnation and Krishna's internal potency called hladini shakti. Nimbarka and many Vaishnava traditions worship her as Krishna's eternal wife. Gaudiya Vaishnava tradition emphasises Radha as Krishna's beloved and divine consort. Radha Vallabha and Haridasi venerate her as the supreme being. She is called chief of the Braj gopis and queen of Goloka and Braj. Radha's name is explained as prosperity, success, perfection, and wealth. The Narada Pancharatra records 1008 of her names in the Shri Radha Saharsnama Strotam. In the sixteenth century Bhakti movement, Radha's love for Krishna became more prominent. Jayadeva's twelfth century Gita Govinda is one of her major literary appearances. Scholarship summarised by the article distinguishes Radha as a gopi and as a goddess. Archer's study says the Gita Govinda recounts separation, longing, and reunion between Radha and Krishna. Arnold's translation depicts Radha awaiting Krishna by the wood in spring.

Radha appears across many texts. The Gatha Saptasati of about the first or second century AD already names her, and the Puranas give her differing ranks, from an avatar of Lakshmi to the supreme deity with Krishna in the Brahma Vaivarta Purana. The Gita Govinda opens with Krishna finding the road aright led by Radha's spirit. Her epithets call her queen of the Raslila and of Vrindavan, and her birthday is celebrated at Radhashtami.

short_description.id: Sita adalah dewi Hindu dan tokoh perempuan utama dalam Ramayana.
short_description.en: Sita is a Hindu goddess and the principal female character of the Ramayana.

long_description.id:
Sita adalah dewi Hindu dan tokoh perempuan utama dalam Ramayana. Siya, Janaki, dan Maithili merupakan nama lain Sita.

Ia adalah pasangan Rama dan dipandang sebagai penjelmaan Lakshmi. Sita disebut putri Bhumi dan anak angkat Raja Janaka dari Videha. Ia memilih Rama dari Ayodhya sebagai suami dalam svayamvara. Ia mengikuti pengasingan Rama bersama Lakshmana. Ravana menculiknya dari hutan Dandaka dan menahannya di taman Ashoka Vatika di Lanka. Dalam sebagian versi, Sita membuktikan kesuciannya melalui ujian api Agni Pariksha. Versi lain menyebut Maya Sita menggantikannya saat diculik, sementara Sita asli berlindung dalam api. Sejumlah teks menghubungkan kehidupan terdahulunya dengan Vedavati. Dalam kelanjutan kisah, Sita berlindung di asrama Valmiki dan melahirkan anak kembar Kusha dan Lava. Akhir kisah tersebut menuturkan kembalinya Sita ke bumi, ibunya. Nama Sita berasal dari kata Sanskerta yang berarti alur bajakan. Mackenzie juga menempatkan Sita sebagai penjelmaan manusia Lakshmi dalam Ramayana. Lukisan yang dibahas Museum Carlos menggambarkan Ravana membawa Sita dari pertapaan di hutan.

Kisah Sita berlanjut setelah perang. Hanuman, yang diutus Rama, menemukannya di Lanka dan membawa perhiasannya sebagai tanda. Setelah kembali ke Ayodhya, Rama menyuruh Lakshmana meninggalkannya di hutan; ia melahirkan Lava dan Kusha di pertapaan Valmiki dan, saat diminta membuktikan kesuciannya, memanggil ibunya Bhumi yang membawanya kembali ke bumi. Padma Purana menghubungkan pembuangan itu dengan kutukan masa kecilnya.
long_description.en:
Sita is a Hindu goddess and the principal female character of the Ramayana. Siya, Janaki, and Maithili are other names of Sita.

She is Rama's consort and is regarded as an incarnation of Lakshmi. Sita is described as Bhumi's daughter and King Janaka of Videha's adopted child. She chooses Rama of Ayodhya as her husband in a svayamvara. She accompanies Rama into exile with Lakshmana. Ravana abducts her from the Dandaka forest and holds her in Ashoka Vatika garden in Lanka. In some versions, Sita demonstrates her chastity through the Agni Pariksha fire ordeal. Other versions say Maya Sita replaces her during the abduction while the real Sita shelters in fire. Some texts connect her previous birth with Vedavati. In the continuation, Sita shelters in Valmiki's ashram and gives birth to twins Kusha and Lava. That ending recounts Sita's return to the earth, her mother. The name Sita derives from a Sanskrit word meaning furrow. Mackenzie also places Sita as Lakshmi's human incarnation in the Ramayana. The painting discussed by the Carlos Museum depicts Ravana carrying Sita away from a forest hermitage.

Sita's story continues after the war. Hanuman, sent by Rama, finds her in Lanka and carries her jewellery as a token. Back in Ayodhya, Rama has Lakshmana leave her in the forest; she bears Lava and Kusha at Valmiki's hermitage and, asked to prove her purity, calls on her mother Bhumi, who takes her back into the earth. The Padma Purana links the exile to a curse from her childhood.

role.en: The captive who refuses Ravana and sends a token to Rama

summary.id: Selama setahun ditawan di Lanka, Sita menolak Ravana. Hanuman menemukannya di Ashoka Vatika, dikelilingi raksasi buas, dan Sita memberinya perhiasan untuk Rama; Rama lalu berperang mengalahkan Ravana.
summary.en: During a year of captivity in Lanka Sita refuses Ravana. Hanuman finds her in Ashoka Vatika, surrounded by fierce she-demons, and she gives him her jewellery for Rama; Rama then wages war and defeats Ravana.

summary.id: Rama menyuruh Lakshmana meninggalkan Sita yang hamil di hutan; di pertapaan Valmiki ia melahirkan Lava dan Kusha. Ketika diminta membuktikan kesuciannya di sidang, ia memanggil ibunya Bhumi, yang muncul dan membawanya turun ke bumi. Padma Purana menjelaskan pembuangan itu sebagai akibat kutukan masa kecil.
summary.en: Rama has Lakshmana leave the pregnant Sita in the forest; at Valmiki's hermitage she bears Lava and Kusha. Asked to attest her purity before the assembly, she calls on her mother Bhumi, who rises and takes her down into the earth. The Padma Purana explains the exile as the result of a childhood curse.

claims.quote: Sita (Sanskrit: सीता; IAST: Sītā), also known as Siya, Jānaki and Maithili, is a Hindu goddess and the female protagonist of the Hindu epic Ramayana. Sita is the consort of Rama, the avatar of god Vishnu, and is regarded as an avatar of goddess Lakshmi. She is the chief goddess of the Ramanandi Sampradaya and is the goddess of beauty and devotion.

statement.id: Ia adalah pasangan Rama dan dipandang sebagai penjelmaan Lakshmi.
statement.en: She is Rama's consort and is regarded as an incarnation of Lakshmi.

claims.quote: Described as the daughter of Bhūmi (the earth), Sita is brought up as the adopted daughter of King Janaka of Videha. Sita, in her youth, chooses Rama, the prince of Ayodhya, as her husband in a svayamvara. After the svayamvara, she accompanies her husband to his kingdom but later chooses to accompany him along with her brother-in-law Lakshmana in his exile.

statement.id: Sita disebut putri Bhumi dan anak angkat Raja Janaka dari Videha.
statement.en: Sita is described as Bhumi's daughter and King Janaka of Videha's adopted child.

claims.quote: While in exile, the trio settles in the Dandaka forest from where she is abducted by Ravana, the Rakshasa king of Lanka. She is imprisoned in the garden of Ashoka Vatika in Lanka until she is rescued by Rama, who slays her captor.

statement.id: Ravana menculiknya dari hutan Dandaka dan menahannya di taman Ashoka Vatika di Lanka.
statement.en: Ravana abducts her from the Dandaka forest and holds her in Ashoka Vatika garden in Lanka.

claims.quote: After the war, in some versions of the epic, Rama asks Sita to undergo an Agni Pariksha (an ordeal of fire), by which she proves her chastity, before she is accepted by Rama. Such an episode of trial makes Lakshmana angry at Rama, for the first time.

statement.id: Dalam sebagian versi, Sita membuktikan kesuciannya melalui ujian api Agni Pariksha.
statement.en: In some versions, Sita demonstrates her chastity through the Agni Pariksha fire ordeal.

claims.quote: In some other versions of the epic, Maya Sita, an illusion created by Agni, takes Sita's place and is abducted by Ravana and suffers his captivity, while the real Sita hides in the fire.

statement.id: Versi lain menyebut Maya Sita menggantikannya saat diculik, sementara Sita asli berlindung dalam api.
statement.en: Other versions say Maya Sita replaces her during the abduction while the real Sita shelters in fire.

claims.quote: Some scriptures also mention her previous birth as Vedavati, a woman whom Ravana tries to molest.

statement.id: Sejumlah teks menghubungkan kehidupan terdahulunya dengan Vedavati.
statement.en: Some texts connect her previous birth with Vedavati.

claims.quote: She takes shelter at Sage Valmiki's ashram. She gives birth to twin sons there: Kusha and Lava.

statement.id: Dalam kelanjutan kisah, Sita berlindung di asrama Valmiki dan melahirkan anak kembar Kusha dan Lava.
statement.en: In the continuation, Sita shelters in Valmiki's ashram and gives birth to twins Kusha and Lava.

claims.quote: Years later, Sita reunites her two sons with their father Rama and then returns to the womb of her mother, the earth, as a testimony to her ultimate purity.

statement.id: Akhir kisah tersebut menuturkan kembalinya Sita ke bumi, ibunya.
statement.en: That ending recounts Sita's return to the earth, her mother.

short_description.id: Kurma adalah avatar kedua Wisnu, dewa pemelihara Hindu, dalam wujud kura-kura. Ia paling dikenal dari legenda pengadukan Samudra Susu, ketika ia menopang Gunung Mandara di punggungnya.
short_description.en: Kurma is the tortoise form and second avatar of Vishnu, the Hindu preserver deity. He is best known from the legend of the churning of the Ocean of Milk, when he bore Mount Mandara on his back.

long_description.id:
Kurma (dari kata Sanskerta untuk kura-kura) adalah avatar kedua Wisnu, dewa pemelihara Hindu, dan tercantum sebagai avatar kedua dalam Dashavatara, sepuluh inkarnasi utama Wisnu. Ia dikenal juga sebagai Akupara, kura-kura dunia yang menopang bumi. Dalam penuturan Hindu, ia muncul pada Satya Yuga sebagai kura-kura raksasa untuk menyelamatkan bumi dari kehancuran. Wisnu memiliki sepuluh avatar utama, dan Kurma disebut sebagai kura-kura bersama Matsya (ikan) dan Varaha (babi hutan).

Asal-usul Kurma dilacak ke sastra Weda. Shatapatha Brahmana adalah teks tertua yang menyebutnya, dan di sana Prajapati mengambil wujud Kurma untuk menciptakan semua makhluk. Kurma disamakan dengan resi Kashyapa, yang namanya juga berarti kura-kura. Meski tidak ditemukan dalam Rigveda, Kashyapa muncul dalam himne-himnenya, dan Vajasaneyi Samhita menyebut kura-kura sebagai penguasa perairan.

Dalam sastra pasca-Weda seperti Purana, Kurma erat terkait dengan legenda pengadukan Samudra Susu (Samudra Manthana). Dalam kisah itu para dewa dan asura mengaduk samudra dengan Gunung Mandara sebagai tongkat dan ular Vasuki sebagai tali, tetapi gunung itu mulai tenggelam. Wisnu mengambil wujud Kurma dan menopangnya di punggungnya. Setelah nektar tercipta dan para iblis mencoba merebutnya, Wisnu menjelma sebagai perempuan Maya (Mohini) sehingga para dewa memperoleh keabadian. Menurut Bhagavata Purana, Wisnu juga dikatakan memberi semua dewa lain karunia keabadian. Sebuah sumber menyebut Kurma tercantum dalam Kurma Purana, sedangkan sumber lain menyatakan kisah rincinya tidak ada di sana.

Dalam ikonografi Hindu, Kurma digambarkan sebagai kura-kura atau sebagai manusia berkepala atau bertubuh kura-kura; dalam satu uraian bagian atasnya pria berlengan empat bermahkota seperti Wisnu. Relief Angkor Wat menampilkan Wisnu dan Kurma di tengah pengadukan samudra. Kurma tidak banyak dipuja dalam Hindu modern, tetapi masih memiliki kuil, termasuk Sri Kurmam di Andhra Pradesh.

Tradisi pemujaan dan yoga juga mengenal kura-kura: Taittiriya Samhita menyarankan ritual mengubur kura-kura hidup di dasar altar api kurban, Kurmasana adalah sikap yoga, dan Panikacchapika adalah posisi jari dalam ritual untuk melambangkan Kurma. Aiyangar menduga pengadukan samudra melambangkan pengadukan pikiran lewat meditasi, dan Nanditha Krishna menduga dewa kura-kura suku diserap dengan mengidentifikasikannya sebagai Kurma. Selain Sri Kurmam dan Kurmai, ada kuil di Gavirangapura dan Swarupnarayan.
long_description.en:
Kurma (from the Sanskrit word for tortoise) is the second avatar of Vishnu, the Hindu preserver deity, and is listed as the second of the Dashavatara, the ten principal incarnations of Vishnu. He is also identified with Akupara, the World-Turtle who supports the Earth. The Hindu account has him arrive in the Satya Yuga as an immense turtle to rescue the earth from ruin. Hinduism also counts ten principal avatars, with Kurma named as the tortoise alongside Matsya the fish and Varaha the boar.

Kurma's roots are traced to Vedic literature. The Shatapatha Brahmana is the earliest extant text to name him, and there Prajapati assumes the form of Kurma to create all creatures. Kurma is equated with the sage Kashyapa, whose name also means tortoise. Although Kurma is absent from the Rigveda, Kashyapa appears in its hymns, and the Vajasaneyi Samhita calls the tortoise lord of the waters.

Later literature such as the Puranas ties Kurma tightly to the Samudra Manthana, the story of stirring the Ocean of Milk. In it the gods and asuras churn the ocean with Mount Mandara as the rod and the serpent Vasuki as the rope, but the mountain begins to sink. Vishnu takes the form of Kurma and bears it on his back. After the nectar is made and the demons try to seize it, Vishnu appears as the woman Maya (Mohini) so that the gods gain immortality. The Bhagavata Purana further credits Vishnu with granting every other god immortality. One source places the tale in the Kurma Purana, while another says the detailed version is absent there.

In Hindu iconography Kurma is shown as a tortoise or as a human with a tortoise head or body; in one description the upper half is a four-armed man crowned like Vishnu. The Angkor Wat relief shows Vishnu and Kurma at the centre of the churning of the ocean. Kurma is not widely worshipped in modern Hinduism, yet still has temples, including Sri Kurmam in Andhra Pradesh.

Ritual and yoga traditions also know the tortoise: the Taittiriya Samhita proposes a rite in which a living tortoise is interred beneath the sacrificial fire altar, Kurmasana is a yoga posture, and Panikacchapika is a finger position in worship meant to symbolise Kurma. Aiyangar surmises that the churning symbolises stirring the mind through meditation, and Nanditha Krishna suggests a tribal tortoise god was absorbed by identifying him with Kurma. Besides Sri Kurmam and Kurmai there are temples at Gavirangapura and Swarupnarayan.

claim.id: Kitab Shatapatha Brahmana menyamakan Kurma dengan dewa pencipta Prajapati.
claim.en: The Shatapatha Brahmana equates Kurma with the creator deity Prajapati.

claims_provenance.quote: The Shatapatha Brahmana equates the tortoise - Kurma to the creator of all creatures. The god Prajapati assumes the form of Kurma to create all creatures (praja).

claim.id: Kitab Shatapatha Brahmana juga memuat asal-usul awatara ikan Matsya.
claim.en: The Shatapatha Brahmana also records the origins of Matsya the Fish.

claims_provenance.quote: The Shatapatha Brahmana also has the origins of Matsya, the Fish.

claim.id: Meski nama Kurma tidak ada di Rigveda, resi Kashyapa yang disamakan dengan Kurma disebut dalam himne.
claim.en: Though Kurma is absent in the Rigveda, seer Kashyapa appears in hymns.

claims_provenance.quote: Though Kurma is not found in the oldest Hindu scripture Rigveda, the seer Kashyapa (who is equated with Kurma) appears in hymns in the scripture.

claim.id: Dalam sastra pasca-Weda, termasuk Purana, Kurma terkait erat dengan legenda Samudra Manthana (pengadukan Lautan Susu).
claim.en: In post-Vedic literature, including the Puranas, Kurma is closely tied to the Samudra Manthana legend.

claims_provenance.quote: In post-Vedic literature, including the Puranas, Kurma is inextricably linked with the legend of the churning of the Ocean Of Milk, known as the Samudra Manthana.

claim.id: Ada lima kuil yang dipersembahkan bagi inkarnasi Wisnu ini di India, termasuk Kurmai (Distrik Chittoor, Andhra Pradesh) dan Sri Kurmam (Distrik Srikakulam, Andhra Pradesh).
claim.en: There are five temples dedicated to this incarnation of Vishnu in India, including Kurmai (Chittoor District, Andhra Pradesh) and Sri Kurmam (Srikakulam District, Andhra Pradesh).

claims_provenance.quote: There are five temples dedicated to this incarnation of Vishnu in India: Kurmai (Chittoor District of Andhra Pradesh) Sri Kurmam (Srikakulam District of Andhra Pradesh)

claim.id: Kuil lain bagi inkarnasi ini mencakup Gavirangapura (Distrik Chitradurga, Karnataka) dan Swarupnarayan (desa Goghat, distrik Hooghly, Benggala Barat).
claim.en: Other temples for this incarnation include Gavirangapura (Chitradurga District, Karnataka) and Swarupnarayan (Goghat village, Hooghly district, West Bengal).

claims_provenance.quote: Gavirangapura (Chitradurga District of Karnataka) Swarupnarayan (Goghat village in Hooghly district of West Bengal).

claim.id: Dewa Prajapati mengambil wujud Kurma untuk menciptakan semua makhluk (praja); karena ia "membuat" (kar) segalanya, wujud Prajapati disebut Kurma.
claim.en: The god Prajapati assumes the form of Kurma to create all creatures (praja); since he "made" (kar) all, Prajapati's form was called Kurma.

claims_provenance.quote: The god Prajapati assumes the form of Kurma to create all creatures (praja). Since he "made" (kar) all, Prajapati's form was called Kurma.

claim.id: Kurma disamakan dengan Kashyapa (secara harfiah "kura-kura"), sehingga semua makhluk disebut "anak Kashyapa"; Kurma juga disebut Surya (matahari).
claim.en: Kurma is equated with Kashyapa (literally "tortoise"), so all creatures are called "children of Kashyapa"; Kurma is also called Surya (the sun).

claims_provenance.quote: Kurma is equated with Kashyapa (literally "tortoise"), thus all creatures are called "children of Kashyapa". Kurma is also called Surya (the sun).

claim.id: Taittiriya Samhita menyarankan ritual mengubur kura-kura hidup di dasar altar api kurban; dengan itu pemberi kurban memperoleh pahala mencapai surga.
claim.en: The Taittiriya Samhita suggests a ritual of burying a live tortoise at the base of the sacrificial fire altar; by this act the sacrificer earns the merit of reaching heaven.

claims_provenance.quote: The Taittiriya Samhita suggests a ritual of burying a live tortoise at the base of the sacrificial fire altar (uttar-vedi). By this act, the sacrificer earns the merit of reaching heaven.

claim.id: Vajasaneyi Samhita dari Yajurveda putih menggambarkan kura-kura sebagai "penguasa perairan".
claim.en: The Vajasaneyi Samhita of the white Yajurveda describes the tortoise as the "lord of the waters".

claims_provenance.quote: the Vajasaneyi Samhita of the white Yajurveda describes the tortoise as the "lord of the waters".

claim.id: Dalam kitab Adi Parva epos Mahabharata, dewa Narayana (diidentifikasi dengan Wisnu) menyarankan para dewa dan asura mengaduk samudra untuk memperoleh amrita karena keduanya mendambakan keabadian; para dewa memilih Gunung Mandara sebagai tongkat pengaduk dan ular Vasuki-Ananta sebagai tali.
claim.en: In the Adi Parva book of the Mahabharata, the god Narayana (identified with Vishnu) suggests that the devas and asuras churn the ocean to obtain amrita because both seek immortality; the gods choose Mount Mandara as the churning rod and the serpent Vasuki-Ananta as the rope.

claims_provenance.quote: In the Adi Parva Book of the epic Mahabharata, the god Narayana (identified with Vishnu) suggests the gods (devas) and the demons (asuras) churn the ocean to obtain amrita (ambrosia) as both of them seek immortality. The gods select Mount Mandara as the churning rod and the serpent Vasuki-Ananta as the rope.

claim.id: Mereka lalu mendekati Kurma-raja, raja para kura-kura, agar menopang gunung itu di punggungnya, dan ia menyetujui.
claim.en: They then approach Kurma-raja, the king of tortoises, to support the mount on its back, and it consents.

claims_provenance.quote: Then they approach Kurma-raja, the king of tortoises to support the mount on its back, which it consented.

claim.id: Dalam narasi ini Kurma tidak dikaitkan dengan Wisnu; edisi kritis epos itu tidak menyebut Kurma sebagai avatar Wisnu, meski beberapa sisipan belakangan pada naskah mengaitkannya sebagai pradurbhava (perwujudan) Wisnu.
claim.en: In this narrative Kurma is not related to Vishnu; the critical edition of the epic does not call Kurma an avatar of Vishnu, though some later insertions in manuscripts associate Kurma as a pradurbhava (manifestation) of Vishnu.

claims_provenance.quote: In this narrative, Kurma is not related with Vishnu. Though the critical edition of the epic does not refer to Kurma as an avatar of Vishnu, some latter insertions in manuscripts of the epic associate Kurma as a pradurbhava (manifestation) of Vishnu.

claim.id: Kurma Purana adalah salah satu dari empat Purana yang memakai nama avatar Wisnu.
claim.en: The Kurma Purana is one of four Puranas that bear the names of Vishnu's avatars.

claims_provenance.quote: The Kurma Purana is one of four Puranas that bear the names of Vishnu's avatars.

claim.id: Aiyangar menduga legenda Samudra Manthana melambangkan pengadukan pikiran lewat meditasi untuk mencapai pembebasan (moksha).
claim.en: Aiyangar surmises that the legend of the Samudra Manthana symbolises churning the mind through meditation to achieve liberation (moksha).

claims_provenance.quote: Meditation / Churning the Mind: Aiyangar also surmises that the legend of the Samudra Manthana symbolises churning the mind through Meditation to achieve liberation (Moksha).

claim.id: Kashyapa, yang juga berarti "kura-kura", dianggap leluhur semua makhluk hidup bersama tiga belas istrinya, termasuk tumbuh-tumbuhan.
claim.en: Kashyapa, also meaning 'tortoise', is considered the progenitor of all living beings with his thirteen wives, including vegetation.

claims_provenance.quote: Kashyapa - also meaning 'Tortoise' - is considered the Progenitor of all living beings with his thirteen wives, including vegetation

claim.id: Kura-kura juga disebut a-kupa-ara karena tidak bergerak dalam sumur (karena dangkalnya).
claim.en: A tortoise is also called a-kupa-ara because it does not move in a well (on account of its shallowness).

claims_provenance.quote: A tortoise is also called a-kupa-ara, because it does not move in a well [On account of its shallowness].

claim.id: 'Panikacchapika', yang berarti 'kura-kura tangan', adalah posisi jari khusus dalam ritual pemujaan untuk melambangkan Kurma.
claim.en: 'Panikacchapika', meaning 'Hand Tortoise', is a special positioning of the fingers during worship rituals to symbolise Kurma.

claims_provenance.quote: meaning 'Hand Tortoise', is a special positioning of the fingers during worship rituals to symbolise Kurma.

claim.id: Kotak info Wikipedia mencantumkan afiliasi Waisnawa, tempat tinggal di Bharata Khanda, Vaikuntha, dan Srikurmam, mantra Om Kurmaya Namah, tanpa senjata, perayaan Kurma Jayanti, dan pasangan Lakshmi sebagai Sindhusuta.
claim.en: The article infobox lists Vaishnavism as affiliation, abode in Bharata Khanda, Vaikuntha and Srikurmam, the mantra Om Kurmaya Namah, no weapon, the festival Kurma Jayanti, and Lakshmi as Sindhusuta for consort.

claims_provenance.quote: Affiliation Vaishnavism Abode Bharata Khanda, Vaikuntha, Srikurmam Mantra Om Kurmaya Namah Weapon None Festivals Kurma Jayanti Consort Lakshmi as Sindhusuta

claim.id: Penggambaran terkenal mencakup relief di Angkor Wat dengan Wisnu dan Kurma di tengah serta para dewa dan iblis di kedua sisi mengaduk samudra.
claim.en: Notable depictions include the relief at Angkor Wat with Vishnu and Kurma in the centre and the gods and demons on either side churning the ocean.

claims_provenance.quote: Notable depictions include the relief at Angkor Wat with Vishnu and Kurma in the centre and the gods and demons on either side churning the ocean.

claim.id: Srikurmam semula kuil Siwa yang diubah menjadi kuil Waisnawa oleh santo Waisnawa Ramanuja.
claim.en: Srikurmam was initially a Shiva temple, which was converted into a Vaishnava one by the Vaishnava saint Ramanuja.

claims_provenance.quote: Srikurmam was initially a Shiva temple, which was converted into a Vaishnava one by the Vaishnava saint Ramanuja.

claim.id: Nanditha Krishna menduga bahwa dewa kura-kura suku dapat diserap ke dalam lingkungan Hindu dengan mengidentifikasikannya sebagai Kurma.
claim.en: Nanditha Krishna suggests that a tribal tortoise god could have been assimilated into the Hindu fold by identifying him with Kurma.

claims_provenance.quote: Nanditha Krishna suggests that a tribal tortoise god could have been assimilated in the Hindu fold by identifying him with Kurma.

claim.id: Wisnu memiliki sepuluh avatar atau penampakan duniawi, yang berupa manusia, hewan, atau campuran keduanya.
claim.en: Vishnu has ten avatars or worldly appearances, which are people, animals or a mix of both.

claims_provenance.quote: Vishnu has ten avatars or worldly appearances, which are people, animals or a mix of both.

claim.id: Dalam daftar avatar, Kurma disebut sebagai kura-kura, bersama Matsya (ikan) dan Varaha (babi hutan).
claim.en: In the list of avatars, Kurma is named as the tortoise, alongside Matsya (the fish) and Varaha (the boar).

claims_provenance.quote: Matsya (the fish) Kurma (the tortoise) Varaha (the boar)

claim.id: Dalam Bhagavata Purana, puisi epik yang menghimpun banyak kisah Waisnawa, Wisnu juga dikatakan memberi semua dewa lain karunia keabadian.
claim.en: In the Bhagavata Purana, an epic poem collecting many Vaishnavite stories, Vishnu is also credited with giving all the other gods the gift of immortality.

claims_provenance.quote: In the Bhagavata Purana, an epic poem that collects together many Vaishnavite stories, Vishnu is also credited with giving all the other gods the gift of immortality.

claim.id: Untuk mengaduk samudra mereka memakai Gunung Mandara yang suci dengan ular raksasa Vasuki (atau Ananta) sebagai tali; satu ujung ditarik para iblis dan ujung lain oleh para dewa.
claim.en: To mix the ocean they used the holy Mt. Mandara with the giant serpent Vasuki (or Ananta) as a rope, one end pulled by the demons and the other by the gods.

claims_provenance.quote: To mix the ocean they decided to use the holy Mt. Mandara with the giant serpent Vasuki (or Ananta) as a turning rope; one end to be pulled by Demons and the other by the gods.

claim.id: Namun tak satu pun pihak sanggup menanggung beban itu sehingga mereka memanggil Wisnu untuk menahannya; ia melakukannya dalam wujud Kurma, kura-kura raksasa, menopang gunung di cangkangnya.
claim.en: Neither group could handle such a weight, so they called for Vishnu to hold it; he did so in the form of Kurma, the giant tortoise, supporting the mountain on his shell.

claims_provenance.quote: However, neither group could handle such a weight and they called for Vishnu to hold it. This he did in the form of Kurma, the giant tortoise, supporting the mountain on his shell.

claim.id: Nektar tercipta dari laut berbusa, tetapi para iblis mencoba membawanya kabur; Wisnu turun tangan dalam wujud Maya yang cantik dan, karena para iblis terkecoh, nektar itu diberikan kepada para dewa sehingga mereka berpeluang abadi.
claim.en: The nectar was created from the foaming sea but the demons tried to make off with it; Vishnu intervened as the beautiful Maya and, with the demons distracted, gave the nectar to the gods, allowing them the possibility of immortality.

claims_provenance.quote: The nectar was duly created from the foaming sea but the Demons, true to character, tried to make off with it. Fortunately, Vishnu interceded in the form of the beautiful Maya (the personification of Illusion) and, suitably distracted, the Demons relinquished the nectar which Vishnu graciously gave to the gods, allowing them the possibility of immortality.

claim.id: Dalam agama Hindu, Kurma (Sanskerta: berarti "kura-kura") adalah avatar kedua Wisnu, dewa pemelihara dalam Trimurti Hindu, yang muncul pada Satya Yuga sebagai kura-kura raksasa untuk menyelamatkan bumi dari kehancuran.
claim.en: In Hinduism Kurma (Sanskrit: "Tortoise") is the second avatar of Vishnu, the preserver god in the Hindu Trimurti, who appeared in the Satya Yuga as a giant turtle to save the earth from destruction.

claims_provenance.quote: In the Hindu religion, Kurma (Sanskrit: meaning "Tortoise") is the second avatar of Vishnu, the preserver god in the Hindu Trimurti (trinity), who appeared in the Satya Yuga as a giant turtle to save the earth from destruction.

claim.id: Punggungnya yang besar dikatakan menjadi landasan bagi Gunung Mandara yang mitis, yang dipakai para dewa (dan iblis) sebagai tongkat pengaduk samudra susu purba untuk memperoleh nektar keabadian.
claim.en: His enormous back was said to provide a foundation for the mythical Mount Mandara, used by the gods (and demons) as a churning rod to stir the primordial milk-ocean and obtain the nectar of immortality.

claims_provenance.quote: His enormous back was said to have provided a foundation for the mythical Mount Mandara, which was used by the gods (and demons) as a churning rod to stir the primordial milk-ocean thereby obtaining the purported nectar of immortality.

claim.id: Konon resi kuno Durvasa memberi Indra kalung bunga; Indra menaruhnya pada gajahnya Airavata, yang melemparkan dan menginjaknya; Durvasa yang pemarah mengutuk Indra dan para dewa agar kehilangan kekuatan.
claim.en: It is said that the ancient sage Durvasa gave Indra a garland of flowers; Indra placed it upon his elephant Airavata, who threw it down and trampled it; the short-tempered Durvasa cursed Indra and the devas so that they would lose their strength.

claims_provenance.quote: It is said that Durvasa, an ancient sage, gave a garland of flowers to Indra. Indra placed this garland upon his elephant Airavata, who promptly threw it on the ground and trampled it. Having witnessed this desecration of his gift, the short-tempered Durvasa cursed Indra and all the other devas (benevolent gods) so that they would lose their strength.

claim.id: Seiring pengadukan, Gunung Mandara perlahan tenggelam ke lumpur dasar samudra susu; agar tidak tenggelam lebih dalam, Wisnu mengambil wujud Kurma, sang kura-kura, dan menopang gunung di punggungnya yang lebar.
claim.en: As the churning continued Mt. Mandara began to sink into the mud at the bottom of the milk-ocean; so it would sink no further, Vishnu took the form of Kurma, the tortoise, and supported the mountain upon his broad back.

claims_provenance.quote: As the churning continued, Mt. Mandara began to gradually sink into the mud at the bottom of the milk-ocean. In order to provide support for the mountain so it would not sink any further, Vishnu took the form of Kurma, the tortoise, and supported the mountain upon his broad back.

claim.id: Para asura segera merebut ramuan itu, tetapi berkat tipuan Wisnu yang menjelma sebagai Mohini, para dewa memperoleh ramuan keabadian untuk diri mereka.
claim.en: The asuras promptly commandeered the elixir, but thanks to another trick by Vishnu appearing as Mohini, the devas obtained the elixir of immortality for themselves.

claims_provenance.quote: The asuras promptly commandeered the elixir, however, thanks to another trick on the part of Vishnu in which he appeared as the female Mohini in order to dumbfound the asuras by way of seduction, the devas attained the elixir of immortality for themselves.

claim.id: Dalam ikonografi Hindu, Kurma digambarkan sebagai kura-kura, atau sebagai manusia berkepala atau bertubuh kura-kura; warnanya hitam, meski kadang digambarkan keemasan.
claim.en: In Hindu iconography Kurma is depicted as a tortoise, or as a human being with a tortoise head or body; his colour is black, although sometimes he is shown as golden.

claims_provenance.quote: In Hindu iconography, Kurma is depicted as a tortoise, or else as a human being with a tortoise head or a tortoise body. His colour is black, although sometimes he is depicted as golden in colour.

claim.id: Kurma lazim digambarkan bersama pasangannya Sri dan Bhumi, atau bersama Sri dan pohon Pusti.
claim.en: Kurma is commonly pictured with his consorts Sri and Bhumi, or else with Sri and the Pusti tree.

claims_provenance.quote: Kurma is commonly pictured with his consorts Sri and Bhumi, or else with Sri and the Pusti tree.

claim.id: Meskipun Kurma tidak banyak dipuja dalam Hindu modern, ia tetap diakui sebagai tokoh penting dalam kosmologi Hindu.
claim.en: Although Kurma is not widely worshiped in modern Hinduism, he is still acknowledged as an important figure in Hindu cosmology.

claims_provenance.quote: Although Kurma is not widely worshiped in modern Hinduism, he is still acknowledged as an important figure in Hindu cosmology.

claim.id: Karena Kurma-lah Wisnu bertemu istrinya, Lakshmi yang dicintai.
claim.en: It is because of Kurma that Vishnu met his wife, the beloved Lakshmi.

claims_provenance.quote: it is because of Kurma that Vishnu met his wife, the beloved Lakshmi

claim.id: Kisah Avatar Kurma, yang disebut terdapat dalam Kurma Purana, mencerminkan tergesernya dewa-dewa Weda awal (seperti Indra dan Varuna) oleh dewa-dewa populer Hindu Klasik seperti Trimurti.
claim.en: The story of the Kurma Avatar, said to be found in the Kurma Purana, reflects the usurping of the early Vedic deities (such as Indra and Varuna) by the popular gods of Classical Hinduism such as the Trimurti.

claims_provenance.quote: The story of the Kurma Avatar, found in the Kurma Purana, reflects the usurping of the early Hindu Vedic deities (such as Indra and Varuna) with the popular gods of Classical Hinduism such as the Hindu Trimurti.

claim.id: Kisah rinci Samudra Manthana tidak terdapat dalam Purana ini, yang hanya menyinggung Kurma sebagai penopang Gunung Mandara.
claim.en: The detailed tale of the Samudra Manthana is absent from this Purana, which alludes to Kurma only as the one who supported Mount Mandara.

claims_provenance.quote: The detailed tale of the Samudra Manthana is absent from the Purana and alludes to Kurma as the one who supported Mount Mandara.

claim.id: Dalam bentuk antropomorfik, bagian atasnya menyerupai Wisnu dan mengenakan perhiasan tradisional serta kirita-mukuta, mahkota kerucut tinggi seperti yang dikenakan Wisnu.
claim.en: In the anthropomorphic form the upper half resembles Vishnu and wears the traditional ornaments and the kirita-mukuta (tall conical crown) as worn by Vishnu.

claims_provenance.quote: The upper half resembles Vishnu and wears the traditional ornaments and the kirita-mukuta (tall conical crown) as worn by Vishnu.

claim.en: In the anthropomorphic form, the upper half is that of the four-armed man and the lower half is a fish.

short_description.id: Kurma adalah avatar kedua Wisnu, dewa pemelihara Hindu, dalam wujud kura-kura. Ia paling dikenal dari legenda pengadukan Samudra Susu, ketika ia menopang Gunung Mandara di punggungnya.
short_description.en: Kurma is the tortoise form and second avatar of Vishnu, the Hindu preserver deity. He is best known from the legend of the churning of the Ocean of Milk, when he bore Mount Mandara on his back.

long_description.id: Kurma (dari kata Sanskerta untuk kura-kura) adalah avatar kedua Wisnu, dewa pemelihara Hindu, dan tercantum sebagai avatar kedua dalam Dashavatara, sepuluh inkarnasi utama Wisnu. Ia dikenal juga sebagai Akupara, kura-kura dunia yang menopang bumi. Dalam penuturan Hindu, ia muncul pada Satya Yuga sebagai kura-kura raksasa untuk menyelamatkan bumi dari kehancuran. Wisnu memiliki sepuluh avatar utama, dan Kurma disebut sebagai kura-kura bersama Matsya (ikan) dan Varaha (babi hutan).
long_description.en: Kurma (from the Sanskrit word for tortoise) is the second avatar of Vishnu, the Hindu preserver deity, and is listed as the second of the Dashavatara, the ten principal incarnations of Vishnu. He is also identified with Akupara, the World-Turtle who supports the Earth. The Hindu account has him arrive in the Satya Yuga as an immense turtle to rescue the earth from ruin. Hinduism also counts ten principal avatars, with Kurma named as the tortoise alongside Matsya the fish and Varaha the boar.

long_description.id: Asal-usul Kurma dilacak ke sastra Weda. Shatapatha Brahmana adalah teks tertua yang menyebutnya, dan di sana Prajapati mengambil wujud Kurma untuk menciptakan semua makhluk. Kurma disamakan dengan resi Kashyapa, yang namanya juga berarti kura-kura. Meski tidak ditemukan dalam Rigveda, Kashyapa muncul dalam himne-himnenya, dan Vajasaneyi Samhita menyebut kura-kura sebagai penguasa perairan.
long_description.en: Kurma's roots are traced to Vedic literature. The Shatapatha Brahmana is the earliest extant text to name him, and there Prajapati assumes the form of Kurma to create all creatures. Kurma is equated with the sage Kashyapa, whose name also means tortoise. Although Kurma is absent from the Rigveda, Kashyapa appears in its hymns, and the Vajasaneyi Samhita calls the tortoise lord of the waters.

long_description.id: Dalam sastra pasca-Weda seperti Purana, Kurma erat terkait dengan legenda pengadukan Samudra Susu (Samudra Manthana). Dalam kisah itu para dewa dan asura mengaduk samudra dengan Gunung Mandara sebagai tongkat dan ular Vasuki sebagai tali, tetapi gunung itu mulai tenggelam. Wisnu mengambil wujud Kurma dan menopangnya di punggungnya. Setelah nektar tercipta dan para iblis mencoba merebutnya, Wisnu menjelma sebagai perempuan Maya (Mohini) sehingga para dewa memperoleh keabadian. Menurut Bhagavata Purana, Wisnu juga dikatakan memberi semua dewa lain karunia keabadian. Sebuah sumber menyebut Kurma tercantum dalam Kurma Purana, sedangkan sumber lain menyatakan kisah rincinya tidak ada di sana.
long_description.en: Later literature such as the Puranas ties Kurma tightly to the Samudra Manthana, the story of stirring the Ocean of Milk. In it the gods and asuras churn the ocean with Mount Mandara as the rod and the serpent Vasuki as the rope, but the mountain begins to sink. Vishnu takes the form of Kurma and bears it on his back. After the nectar is made and the demons try to seize it, Vishnu appears as the woman Maya (Mohini) so that the gods gain immortality. The Bhagavata Purana further credits Vishnu with granting every other god immortality. One source places the tale in the Kurma Purana, while another says the detailed version is absent there.

long_description.id: Dalam ikonografi Hindu, Kurma digambarkan sebagai kura-kura atau sebagai manusia berkepala atau bertubuh kura-kura; dalam satu uraian bagian atasnya pria berlengan empat bermahkota seperti Wisnu. Relief Angkor Wat menampilkan Wisnu dan Kurma di tengah pengadukan samudra. Kurma tidak banyak dipuja dalam Hindu modern, tetapi masih memiliki kuil, termasuk Sri Kurmam di Andhra Pradesh.
long_description.en: In Hindu iconography Kurma is shown as a tortoise or as a human with a tortoise head or body; in one description the upper half is a four-armed man crowned like Vishnu. The Angkor Wat relief shows Vishnu and Kurma at the centre of the churning of the ocean. Kurma is not widely worshipped in modern Hinduism, yet still has temples, including Sri Kurmam in Andhra Pradesh.

long_description.id: Tradisi pemujaan dan yoga juga mengenal kura-kura: Taittiriya Samhita menyarankan ritual mengubur kura-kura hidup di dasar altar api kurban, Kurmasana adalah sikap yoga, dan Panikacchapika adalah posisi jari dalam ritual untuk melambangkan Kurma. Aiyangar menduga pengadukan samudra melambangkan pengadukan pikiran lewat meditasi, dan Nanditha Krishna menduga dewa kura-kura suku diserap dengan mengidentifikasikannya sebagai Kurma. Selain Sri Kurmam dan Kurmai, ada kuil di Gavirangapura dan Swarupnarayan.
long_description.en: Ritual and yoga traditions also know the tortoise: the Taittiriya Samhita proposes a rite in which a living tortoise is interred beneath the sacrificial fire altar, Kurmasana is a yoga posture, and Panikacchapika is a finger position in worship meant to symbolise Kurma. Aiyangar surmises that the churning symbolises stirring the mind through meditation, and Nanditha Krishna suggests a tribal tortoise god was absorbed by identifying him with Kurma. Besides Sri Kurmam and Kurmai there are temples at Gavirangapura and Swarupnarayan.

cultural_context.id: Meskipun tidak banyak dipuja dalam Hindu modern, Kurma tetap diakui sebagai tokoh penting dalam kosmologi Hindu, dan karena Kurma-lah Wisnu bertemu Lakshmi.
cultural_context.en: Although not widely worshipped in modern Hinduism, Kurma is still recognised as an important figure in Hindu cosmology, and it was because of Kurma that Vishnu met Lakshmi.

who.id: Avatar kedua Wisnu dalam wujud kura-kura.
who.en: The second avatar of Vishnu in the form of a tortoise.

origin.id: Tradisi Hindu; asalnya dilacak ke sastra Weda seperti Shatapatha Brahmana.
origin.en: Hindu tradition; his origin is traced to Vedic literature such as the Shatapatha Brahmana.
