description.id: Menurut Van Helsing, sang Count dapat menjadi serigala, kelelawar, atau kabut yang ia ciptakan sendiri, dan dapat datang sebagai debu elemental dalam sinar bulan.
description.en: According to Van Helsing, the Count can become a wolf, a bat, or mist that he creates, and can come on moonlight rays as elemental dust.

description.id: Van Helsing memperingatkan bahwa sang Count memiliki kekuatan dua puluh orang.
description.en: Van Helsing warns that the Count has the strength of twenty men.

description.id: Dalam jangkauannya, ia dapat mengarahkan badai, kabut, dan guntur, memerintah tikus, burung hantu, kelelawar, ngengat, rubah, dan serigala, menjadi kecil, serta kadang-kadang lenyap.
description.en: Within his range he can direct the storm, the fog and the thunder, command the rat, the owl, the bat, the moth, the fox and the wolf, become small, and at times vanish.

description.id: Harker melihat sang Count turun dari kastel menyusuri dinding dengan cara yang ia sebut seperti cicak.
description.en: Harker sees the Count go down the castle wall in what he calls lizard fashion.

name.en: Does not die by passing of time

description.id: Menurut Van Helsing, vampir terus hidup dan tidak dapat mati hanya karena berlalunya waktu, dan sang Count bahkan dapat tampak lebih muda.
description.en: According to Van Helsing, the vampire lives on and cannot die by the mere passing of time, and the Count can even grow younger.

description.id: Menurut Van Helsing, mereka yang mati karena dimangsa Un-Dead menjadi Un-Dead juga dan memangsa sesamanya.
description.en: According to Van Helsing, all who die from the preying of the Un-Dead become Un-Dead themselves and prey on their kind.

description.id: Menurut Van Helsing, pada mulanya ia tidak dapat masuk ke mana pun kecuali ada penghuni rumah yang mengundangnya; sesudah itu ia boleh datang sesukanya.
description.en: According to Van Helsing, he may not enter anywhere at first unless someone of the household bids him to come; afterwards he can come as he pleases.

description.id: Kekuatannya berhenti ketika siang datang, dan bila ia tidak berada di tempat tujuannya ia hanya dapat berganti wujud pada tengah hari atau tepat saat matahari terbit atau terbenam.
description.en: His power ceases at the coming of the day, and if he is not at the place he is bound for he can only change himself at noon or at exact sunrise or sunset.

description.id: Menurut Van Helsing, di hadapan benda suci seperti salib sang Count tidak berarti apa-apa dan menyingkir ke tempat jauh dengan diam dan hormat.
description.en: According to Van Helsing, in the presence of sacred things such as the crucifix he is nothing and takes his place far off and silent with respect.

name.en: Ways to hold and end him

description.id: Menurut Van Helsing, cabang mawar liar pada petinya menahannya agar tidak bergerak dari sana, peluru suci yang ditembakkan ke peti membunuhnya, dan pancang atau kepala yang dipenggal memberinya ketenangan.
description.en: According to Van Helsing, a branch of wild rose on his coffin keeps him from moving from it, a sacred bullet fired into the coffin kills him, and a stake or a cut-off head gives him rest.

description.id: Para pemburu mengumpulkan bukti letak peti-peti berisi tanah asalnya agar dapat menguduskannya dengan hosti dan menutup semua tempat istirahatnya.
description.en: The hunters gather evidence of where his coffins of native soil are so that they can consecrate them with a eucharistic wafer and deny him all of his resting places.

summary.id: Sang Count menahan Jonathan Harker di kastelnya, lalu menaiki kapal Demeter dengan membawa peti-peti tanahnya. Para pemburu vampir melacak peti-petinya dengan tujuan menguduskannya, dan mengikutinya kembali ke Transylvania, tempat ia dihancurkan.
summary.en: The Count keeps Jonathan Harker prisoner in his castle, then boards the Demeter taking his boxes of earth. The vampire hunters track his boxes in order to consecrate them and follow him back to Transylvania, where he is destroyed.

description.id: Kediaman sang Count di Pegunungan Karpatia dekat Borgo Pass; Harker menemukan bahwa wilayahnya berada di timur, di perbatasan Transylvania, Moldavia, dan Bukovina.
description.en: The Count's home in the Carpathian Mountains near the Borgo Pass; Harker finds that the district lies in the extreme east, on the borders of Transylvania, Moldavia and Bukovina.

description.id: Kota tempat kapal Demeter kandas dan seekor anjing besar melompat ke pantai lalu menuju pemakaman gereja di tebing.
description.en: The town where the Demeter ran aground and an immense dog leapt ashore and headed for the churchyard on the cliff.

description.id: Tempat di pegunungan di atas Danau Hermanstadt yang, menurut Van Helsing, menjadi tempat keluarga Dracula mempelajari rahasia si Jahat.
description.en: A place amongst the mountains over Lake Hermanstadt where, according to Van Helsing, the Draculas learned the secrets of the Evil One.

description.id: Novel Dracula karya Bram Stoker pertama kali terbit di Britania Raya, memperkenalkan sang Count.
description.en: Bram Stoker's novel Dracula was first published in Great Britain, introducing the Count.

note.id: Wikipedia menyebut Van Helsing sebagai musuh bebuyutan sang Count.
note.en: Wikipedia calls Van Helsing the Count's nemesis.

note.id: Sang Count menahan Harker di kastelnya.
note.en: The Count keeps Harker prisoner in his castle.

note.id: Wikipedia menyebut adanya hubungan penting antara sang Count dan Renfield, pasien rumah sakit jiwa.
note.en: Wikipedia notes a notable link between the Count and Renfield, a patient in an insane asylum.

description.id: Menurut Wikipedia, pada 1922 Max Schreck memerankan Count Orlok, adaptasi Count Dracula, dalam Nosferatu.
description.en: According to Wikipedia, in 1922 Max Schreck starred as Count Orlok, an adaptation of Count Dracula, in Nosferatu.

description.id: Encyclopedia.com menyebut film Dracula 1931 yang dibintangi Bela Lugosi, bersama film lain, telah membayangi novelnya.
description.en: Encyclopedia.com says the 1931 film Dracula starring Bela Lugosi, among other films, has overshadowed the book.

description.id: Wikipedia menyebut Christopher Lee membintangi banyak film Hammer Horror sebagai Dracula, dan menetapkan citra vampir bertaring panjang ganda dalam budaya populer.
description.en: Wikipedia says Christopher Lee starred as Dracula in numerous Hammer Horror films and fixed the image of the vampire with dual elongated fangs in popular culture.

description.id: Menurut Wikipedia, Count Dracula, yang biasa disebut Drac, adalah tokoh utama waralaba Hotel Transylvania.
description.en: According to Wikipedia, Count Dracula, commonly referred to as Drac, is the main character of the Hotel Transylvania franchise.

traditional.id: Menurut Encyclopedia.com, novel Stoker merangkum banyak kisah vampir yang telah ada sejak zaman kuno ke dalam tokoh sang Count.
traditional.en: According to Encyclopedia.com, Stoker's novel synthesized much of the vampire lore that had existed since ancient times into the character of the Count.

modern.id: Encyclopedia.com menyebut banyak orang yang mengenal sang vampir lewat film atau televisi bahkan tidak tahu siapa Stoker, dan film telah membayangi novelnya.
modern.en: Encyclopedia.com says many people first exposed to the vampire through film or television do not even know who Stoker is, and films have overshadowed the book.

learning_questions.id: Mengapa penting membedakan apa yang dikatakan novel Stoker dari apa yang ditampilkan film?
learning_questions.en: Why is it important to distinguish what Stoker's novel says from what films show?

learning_questions.id: Bagaimana sebuah tokoh sastra dapat menjadi acuan bagi banyak karya fiksi sesudahnya?
learning_questions.en: How can a literary character become a reference point for many later works of fiction?

learning_questions.id: Bagaimana kita menimbang pendapat yang berbeda tentang sumber inspirasi sebuah tokoh sastra?
learning_questions.en: How should we weigh differing views about what inspired a literary character?

claims.quote: “Count Dracula?” He bowed in a courtly way as he replied:— “I am Dracula; and I bid you welcome, Mr. Harker, to my house.

statement.id: Dalam novel, ketika Jonathan Harker menyapanya sebagai Count Dracula, sang Count menjawab bahwa ia adalah Dracula dan menyambut Harker di rumahnya.
statement.en: In the novel, when Jonathan Harker addresses him as Count Dracula, the Count replies that he is Dracula and welcomes Harker to his house.

claims.quote: Within, stood a tall old man, clean shaven save for a long white moustache, and clad in black from head to foot, without a single speck of colour about him anywhere.

statement.id: Harker melihat seorang lelaki tua yang tinggi, tercukur bersih kecuali kumis putih panjang, dan berpakaian hitam dari kepala sampai kaki.
statement.en: Harker sees a tall old man, clean shaven except for a long white moustache, clad in black from head to foot.

claims.quote: His face was a strong—a very strong—aquiline, with high bridge of the thin nose and peculiarly arched nostrils ... with peculiarly sharp white teeth; these protruded over the lips ... his ears were pale, and at the tops extremely pointed ... The general effect was one of extraordinary pallor.

statement.id: Harker mencatat wajah sang Count yang sangat berhidung bengkok, gigi putih yang sangat runcing dan menonjol di atas bibir, telinga pucat yang sangat runcing di bagian atas, dan kesan umum berupa kepucatan luar biasa.
statement.en: Harker notes the Count's strongly aquiline face, peculiarly sharp white teeth protruding over the lips, pale ears extremely pointed at the tops, and a general effect of extraordinary pallor.

claims.quote: Strange to say, there were hairs in the centre of the palm. The nails were long and fine, and cut to a sharp point.

statement.id: Harker mencatat ada rambut di tengah telapak tangan sang Count, dan kukunya panjang, halus, dan dipotong runcing.
statement.en: Harker notes hairs in the centre of the Count's palm, and nails that are long and fine and cut to a sharp point.

claims.quote: the howling of many wolves. The Count’s eyes gleamed, and he said:— “Listen to them—the children of the night. What music they make!”

statement.id: Saat serigala melolong, mata sang Count berkilat dan ia berkata agar Harker mendengarkan "anak-anak malam" itu.
statement.en: As wolves howl, the Count's eyes gleam and he tells Harker to listen to "the children of the night".

claims.quote: Even friend Jonathan, who lived with him for weeks, did never see him to eat, never! He throws no shadow; he make in the mirror no reflect, as again Jonathan observe.

statement.id: Menurut Van Helsing, Jonathan tidak pernah melihat sang Count makan, sang Count tidak berbayang, dan tidak tampak pantulannya di cermin.
statement.en: According to Van Helsing, Jonathan never saw the Count eat, and the Count throws no shadow and makes no reflection in the mirror.

claims.quote: He can transform himself to wolf, as we gather from the ship arrival in Whitby, when he tear open the dog; he can be as bat, as Madam Mina saw him on the window at Whitby ... He can come in mist which he create

statement.id: Menurut Van Helsing, sang Count dapat berubah menjadi serigala, kelelawar, dan kabut yang ia ciptakan; ia menarik kesimpulan itu dari kedatangan kapal di Whitby.
statement.en: According to Van Helsing, the Count can transform himself into a wolf, a bat, and a mist that he creates, as he gathers from the ship's arrival in Whitby.

claims.quote: Remember that he has the strength of twenty men, and that, though our necks or our windpipes are of the common kind—and therefore breakable or crushable—his are not amenable to mere strength.

statement.id: Van Helsing mengingatkan bahwa sang Count memiliki kekuatan dua puluh orang dan lehernya tidak dapat dilumpuhkan dengan kekuatan biasa.
statement.en: Van Helsing reminds the others that the Count has the strength of twenty men and that his neck is not amenable to mere strength.

claims.quote: he can, within his range, direct the elements; the storm, the fog, the thunder; he can command all the meaner things: the rat, and the owl, and the bat—the moth, and the fox, and the wolf; he can grow and become small; and he can at times vanish and come unknown.

statement.id: Menurut Van Helsing, dalam jangkauannya sang Count dapat mengarahkan badai, kabut, dan guntur, memerintah tikus, burung hantu, kelelawar, ngengat, rubah, dan serigala, menjadi kecil, dan kadang-kadang lenyap serta datang tanpa diketahui.
statement.en: According to Van Helsing, within his range the Count can direct the storm, the fog and the thunder, command the rat, the owl, the bat, the moth, the fox and the wolf, grow and become small, and at times vanish and come unknown.

claims.quote: He may not enter anywhere at the first, unless there be some one of the household who bid him to come; though afterwards he can come as he please. His power ceases, as does that of all evil things, at the coming of the day.

statement.id: Menurut Van Helsing, pada mulanya sang Count tidak boleh masuk ke mana pun kecuali ada penghuni rumah yang mengundangnya, dan kekuatannya berhenti ketika siang tiba.
statement.en: According to Van Helsing, the Count may not enter anywhere at first unless someone of the household bids him to come, and his power ceases at the coming of the day.

claims.quote: If he be not at the place whither he is bound, he can only change himself at noon or at exact sunrise or sunset.

statement.id: Menurut Van Helsing, jika sang Count tidak berada di tempat tujuannya, ia hanya dapat mengubah dirinya pada tengah hari atau tepat saat matahari terbit atau terbenam.
statement.en: According to Van Helsing, if the Count is not at the place he is bound for, he can only change himself at noon or at exact sunrise or sunset.

claims.quote: The vampire live on, and cannot die by mere passing of the time; he can flourish when that he can fatten on the blood of the living. Even more, we have seen amongst us that he can even grow younger

statement.id: Menurut Van Helsing, vampir terus hidup dan tidak dapat mati hanya karena berlalunya waktu, ia berkembang bila memangsa darah makhluk hidup, dan bahkan dapat menjadi lebih muda.
statement.en: According to Van Helsing, the vampire lives on and cannot die by the mere passing of time, flourishes when he can fatten on the blood of the living, and can even grow younger.

claims.quote: When they become such, there comes with the change the curse of immortality; they cannot die, but must go on age after age adding new victims and multiplying the evils of the world; for all that die from the preying of the Un-Dead becomes themselves Un-Dead, and prey on their kind.

statement.id: Menurut Van Helsing, mereka yang menjadi Un-Dead menerima kutukan keabadian, dan semua yang mati karena dimangsa Un-Dead menjadi Un-Dead juga dan memangsa sesamanya.
statement.en: According to Van Helsing, those who become Un-Dead receive the curse of immortality, and all who die from the preying of the Un-Dead become Un-Dead themselves and prey on their kind.

claims.quote: as for things sacred, as this symbol, my crucifix, that was amongst us even now when we resolve, to them he is nothing, but in their presence he take his place far off and silent with respect.

statement.id: Menurut Van Helsing, terhadap benda suci seperti salib sang Count tidak berarti apa-apa, dan di hadapannya ia menyingkir jauh dengan diam dan hormat.
statement.en: According to Van Helsing, to sacred things such as the crucifix the Count is nothing, and in their presence he takes his place far off and silent with respect.

claims.quote: The branch of wild rose on his coffin keep him that he move not from it; a sacred bullet fired into the coffin kill him so that he be true dead; and as for the stake through him, we know already of its peace; or the cut-off head that giveth rest.

statement.id: Menurut Van Helsing, cabang mawar liar pada peti menahannya agar tidak beranjak dari sana, peluru suci yang ditembakkan ke peti membunuhnya sungguh-sungguh, dan pancang atau kepala yang dipenggal memberinya ketenangan.
statement.en: According to Van Helsing, a branch of wild rose on his coffin keeps him from moving from it, a sacred bullet fired into the coffin kills him so that he is truly dead, and the stake through him or the cut-off head gives rest.

claims.quote: There, in one of the great boxes, of which there were fifty in all, on a pile of newly dug earth, lay the Count! He was either dead or asleep, I could not say which

statement.id: Harker menemukan sang Count terbaring di salah satu dari lima puluh peti besar, di atas tumpukan tanah yang baru digali, dan ia tidak dapat memastikan apakah sang Count mati atau tidur.
statement.en: Harker finds the Count lying in one of fifty great boxes on a pile of newly dug earth, and cannot say whether he is dead or asleep.

claims.quote: It turns out that the schooner is a Russian from Varna, and is called the Demeter. She is almost entirely in ballast of silver sand, with only a small amount of cargo—a number of great wooden boxes filled with mould.

statement.id: Kapal layar Rusia dari Varna bernama Demeter membawa muatan sedikit berupa sejumlah peti kayu besar berisi tanah gembur.
statement.en: The Russian schooner from Varna called the Demeter carries only a small cargo of a number of great wooden boxes filled with mould.

claims.quote: the very instant the shore was touched, an immense dog sprang up on deck from below ... jumped from the bow on the sand. Making straight for the steep cliff, where the churchyard hangs over the laneway to the East Pier

statement.id: Begitu kapal menyentuh pantai, seekor anjing besar melompat naik ke geladak lalu ke pasir, dan berlari lurus menuju tebing curam tempat pemakaman gereja menggantung di atas jalan setapak.
statement.en: The instant the ship touched the shore, an immense dog sprang up on deck and jumped onto the sand, making straight for the steep cliff where the churchyard hangs over the laneway.

claims.quote: Once more have I seen the Count go out in his lizard fashion. He moved downwards in a sidelong way, some hundred feet down, and a good deal to the left.

statement.id: Harker kembali melihat sang Count keluar dengan cara seperti cicak, bergerak ke bawah menyamping sekitar seratus kaki dan agak jauh ke kiri.
statement.en: Harker again sees the Count go out in lizard fashion, moving downwards in a sidelong way some hundred feet down and a good deal to the left.

claims.quote: The Draculas were, says Arminius, a great and noble race, though now and again were scions who were held by their coevals to have had dealings with the Evil One. They learned his secrets in the Scholomance, amongst the mountains over Lake Hermanstadt

statement.id: Menurut Van Helsing, mengutip Arminius, keluarga Dracula adalah bangsa yang agung dan mulia, dan sebagian keturunannya dianggap berurusan dengan si Jahat serta mempelajari rahasianya di Scholomance di pegunungan di atas Danau Hermanstadt.
statement.en: According to Van Helsing, citing Arminius, the Draculas were a great and noble race, some of whose scions were held to have had dealings with the Evil One and learned his secrets in the Scholomance amongst the mountains over Lake Hermanstadt.

claims.quote: He must, indeed, have been that Voivode Dracula who won his name against the Turk, over the great river on the very frontier of Turkey-land.

statement.id: Van Helsing menyimpulkan bahwa sang Count pastilah Voivode Dracula yang memenangkan namanya melawan bangsa Turki di seberang sungai besar di perbatasan negeri Turki.
statement.en: Van Helsing concludes that the Count must have been that Voivode Dracula who won his name against the Turk, over the great river on the very frontier of Turkey-land.

claims.quote: I find that the district he named is in the extreme east of the country, just on the borders of three states, Transylvania, Moldavia and Bukovina, in the midst of the Carpathian mountains; one of the wildest and least known portions of Europe.

statement.id: Harker mendapati bahwa wilayah yang disebut sang Count berada di ujung timur negeri itu, di perbatasan Transylvania, Moldavia, dan Bukovina, di tengah Pegunungan Karpatia, salah satu bagian Eropa yang paling liar dan paling kurang dikenal.
statement.en: Harker finds that the district the Count named lies in the extreme east of the country, on the borders of Transylvania, Moldavia and Bukovina, in the midst of the Carpathian mountains, one of the wildest and least known portions of Europe.

claims.quote: But, on the instant, came the sweep and flash of Jonathan’s great knife. I shrieked as I saw it shear through the throat; whilst at the same moment Mr. Morris’s bowie knife plunged into the heart. It was like a miracle; but before our very eyes, and almost in the drawing of a breath, the whole body crumbled into dust and passed from our sight.

statement.id: Pisau besar Jonathan menebas leher sang Count dan pisau bowie Mr. Morris menembus jantungnya, lalu seluruh tubuhnya hancur menjadi debu dan lenyap dari pandangan.
statement.en: Jonathan's great knife shears through the Count's throat and Mr. Morris's bowie knife plunges into his heart, and the whole body crumbles into dust and passes from sight.

claims.quote: “We Szekelys have a right to be proud, for in our veins flows the blood of many brave races who fought as the lion fights, for lordship.

statement.id: Sang Count berkata kepada Harker bahwa kaum Székely berhak bangga karena dalam urat mereka mengalir darah banyak bangsa pemberani.
statement.en: The Count tells Harker that the Székelys have a right to be proud because in their veins flows the blood of many brave races.

claims.quote: The nosferatu do not die like the bee when he sting once. He is only stronger; and being stronger, have yet more power to work evil.

statement.id: Van Helsing mengatakan bahwa nosferatu tidak mati seperti lebah yang menyengat sekali, melainkan menjadi lebih kuat dan lebih berkuasa untuk berbuat jahat.
statement.en: Van Helsing says the nosferatu do not die like the bee that stings once but only grow stronger, with yet more power to work evil.

claims.quote: Dracula, by Abraham Stoker—who generally published under the abbreviated first name Bram—was first published in Great Britain in 1897.

statement.id: Dracula karya Abraham Stoker, yang biasanya menerbitkan karya dengan nama depan singkat Bram, pertama kali terbit di Britania Raya pada 1897.
statement.en: Dracula, by Abraham Stoker, who generally published under the abbreviated first name Bram, was first published in Great Britain in 1897.

claims.quote: Although myths and legends about vampires had existed since ancient times, Stoker's novel synthesized much of this lore and gave it a palpable feeling in the character of Count Dracula.

statement.id: Meskipun mitos dan legenda tentang vampir sudah ada sejak zaman kuno, novel Stoker merangkum banyak kisah itu dan memberinya wujud nyata dalam tokoh Count Dracula.
statement.en: Although myths and legends about vampires had existed since ancient times, Stoker's novel synthesized much of this lore and gave it a palpable feeling in the character of Count Dracula.

claims.quote: Dracula has limited motion during the day, consumes only human blood, must pass over water in certain ways, has no reflection, must sleep on soil from his own land, has power over certain animals and weather, and has the power to turn others into vampires.

statement.id: Menurut ringkasan tokoh ini, sang Count bergerak terbatas pada siang hari, hanya meminum darah manusia, harus melintasi air dengan cara tertentu, tidak berpantulan, harus tidur di atas tanah dari negerinya sendiri, berkuasa atas hewan dan cuaca tertentu, serta dapat mengubah orang lain menjadi vampir.
statement.en: According to this character summary, Dracula has limited motion during the day, consumes only human blood, must pass over water in certain ways, has no reflection, must sleep on soil from his own land, has power over certain animals and weather, and can turn others into vampires.

claims.quote: However, most critics agree that Dracula was based in part on a historical figure, Vlad the Impaler, a fifteenth-century Romanian ruler known for his indiscriminate brutality

statement.id: Menurut Encyclopedia.com, sebagian besar kritikus sepakat bahwa Dracula sebagian didasarkan pada tokoh sejarah Vlad si Penusuk, penguasa Rumania abad kelima belas yang dikenal karena kekejamannya.
statement.en: According to Encyclopedia.com, most critics agree that Dracula was based in part on a historical figure, Vlad the Impaler, a fifteenth-century Romanian ruler known for his indiscriminate brutality.

claims.quote: While films, most notably the 1931 film Dracula, starring Bela Lugosi, have overshadowed the book, they have also helped to keep the story alive.

statement.id: Film, terutama film Dracula 1931 yang dibintangi Bela Lugosi, telah membayangi novelnya, tetapi juga membantu menjaga kisahnya tetap hidup.
statement.en: Films, most notably the 1931 film Dracula starring Bela Lugosi, have overshadowed the book, but have also helped to keep the story alive.

claims.quote: is a fictional character and title antagonist of Bram Stoker's gothic horror novel Dracula (1897). He is considered the prototypical and archetypal vampire in subsequent works of fiction.

statement.id: Count Dracula adalah tokoh fiksi dan antagonis utama novel horor gotik Dracula (1897) karya Bram Stoker, dan dianggap vampir purwarupa dan arketipal dalam karya fiksi sesudahnya.
statement.en: Count Dracula is a fictional character and the title antagonist of Bram Stoker's gothic horror novel Dracula (1897), considered the prototypical and archetypal vampire in subsequent works of fiction.

claims.quote: Count Dracula is an undead, centuries-old vampire, and a Transylvanian nobleman who claims to be a Székely descended from Attila the Hun. He inhabits a decaying castle in the Carpathian Mountains near the Borgo Pass.

statement.id: Count Dracula adalah vampir mayat hidup berusia berabad-abad dan bangsawan Transylvania yang mengaku Székely keturunan Attila si Hun, dan ia mendiami sebuah kastel yang lapuk di Pegunungan Karpatia dekat Borgo Pass.
statement.en: Count Dracula is an undead, centuries-old vampire and a Transylvanian nobleman who claims to be a Székely descended from Attila the Hun, and he inhabits a decaying castle in the Carpathian Mountains near the Borgo Pass.

claims.quote: Stoker came across the name Dracula in his reading on Romanian history, and chose this to replace the name (Count Wampyr) that he had originally intended to use for his villain.
claims.locator: Modern and postmodern analyses of the character

statement.id: Stoker menemukan nama Dracula dalam bacaannya tentang sejarah Rumania, dan memilihnya untuk menggantikan nama Count Wampyr yang semula hendak ia pakai bagi tokoh penjahatnya.
statement.en: Stoker came across the name Dracula in his reading on Romanian history and chose it to replace the name Count Wampyr that he had originally intended to use for his villain.

claims.quote: was dubbed Dracul ("dragon" or "devil"), thus his son became Dracula ("of the dragon").
claims.locator: Modern and postmodern analyses of the character

statement.id: Wikipedia menjelaskan bahwa nama Dracul berarti "naga" atau "setan", sehingga putranya menjadi Dracula ("dari sang naga"); penjelasan ini berkaitan dengan nama keluarga tokoh sejarah.
statement.en: Wikipedia explains that the name Dracul meant "dragon" or "devil", so the son became Dracula ("of the dragon"); this explanation concerns the family name of a historical figure.

claims.quote: Shakespearean actor and friend of Stoker's Sir Henry Irving is widely considered to be a real-life inspiration for the character of Dracula.
claims.locator: Modern and postmodern analyses of the character

statement.id: Aktor Shakespeare Sir Henry Irving, sahabat Stoker, dianggap luas sebagai inspirasi dunia nyata bagi tokoh Dracula.
statement.en: The Shakespearean actor and friend of Stoker, Sir Henry Irving, is widely considered a real-life inspiration for the character of Dracula.

claims.quote: Some Dracula scholars, led by Elizabeth Miller, have questioned the depth of this connection as early as 1998. They argue that Stoker in fact knew little of the historic Vlad III
claims.locator: Modern and postmodern analyses of the character

statement.id: Sebagian pakar Dracula, yang dipimpin Elizabeth Miller, sejak 1998 meragukan kedalaman hubungan dengan tokoh sejarah Vlad III dan berpendapat bahwa Stoker sebenarnya tahu sedikit tentang dia.
statement.en: Some Dracula scholars, led by Elizabeth Miller, have questioned the depth of the connection with the historic Vlad III since 1998 and argue that Stoker in fact knew little of him.

claims.quote: discovers that Dracula purchased multiple real estate properties throughout London under the alias 'Count De Ville'.

statement.id: Wikipedia menyebut bahwa Dracula membeli beberapa properti di London dengan nama samaran Count De Ville.
statement.en: Wikipedia states that Dracula purchased multiple real estate properties throughout London under the alias Count De Ville.

claims.quote: Christopher Lee starred as Dracula in numerous Hammer Horror films. Shown here is the 1958 film Dracula. Lee fixed the image of the vampire bearing dual elongated fangs in popular culture.
claims.locator: Character development subsequent to the novel

statement.id: Christopher Lee membintangi banyak film Hammer Horror sebagai Dracula, termasuk film Dracula 1958, dan menetapkan citra vampir bertaring panjang ganda dalam budaya populer.
statement.en: Christopher Lee starred as Dracula in numerous Hammer Horror films, including the 1958 film Dracula, and fixed the image of the vampire bearing dual elongated fangs in popular culture.

claims.quote: In 1922, Max Schreck starred as Count Orlok (an adaptation of Count Dracula) in Nosferatu.
claims.locator: Character development subsequent to the novel

statement.id: Pada 1922 Max Schreck memerankan Count Orlok, adaptasi Count Dracula, dalam Nosferatu.
statement.en: In 1922 Max Schreck starred as Count Orlok, an adaptation of Count Dracula, in Nosferatu.

claims.quote: Count Dracula, commonly referred to as "Drac", is the main character of the Hotel Transylvania franchise, voiced by Adam Sandler in the first three movies and by Brian Hull in the fourth movie.
claims.locator: Character development subsequent to the novel

statement.id: Count Dracula, yang biasa disebut Drac, adalah tokoh utama waralaba Hotel Transylvania, disuarakan oleh Adam Sandler dalam tiga film pertama dan Brian Hull dalam film keempat.
statement.en: Count Dracula, commonly referred to as Drac, is the main character of the Hotel Transylvania franchise, voiced by Adam Sandler in the first three movies and by Brian Hull in the fourth.

claims.quote: Count Dracula is an old vampire who keeps Jonathan Harker prisoner in his castle and who ultimately tries to relocate to London and create a race of vampires.

statement.id: Count Dracula adalah vampir tua yang menahan Jonathan Harker di kastelnya dan pada akhirnya berusaha pindah ke London dan menciptakan ras vampir.
statement.en: Count Dracula is an old vampire who keeps Jonathan Harker prisoner in his castle and ultimately tries to relocate to London and create a race of vampires.

claims.quote: the group of hunters slowly gather evidence to show where Dracula's many coffins containing his native soil are located, so that they can consecrate them with a eucharistic wafer and deny Dracula all of his resting places.

statement.id: Kelompok pemburu mengumpulkan bukti letak banyak peti sang Count yang berisi tanah asalnya agar dapat menguduskannya dengan hosti ekaristi dan menutup semua tempat istirahatnya.
statement.en: The group of hunters gathers evidence of where Dracula's many coffins containing his native soil are located so that they can consecrate them with a eucharistic wafer and deny him all of his resting places.

claims.quote: His nemesis Abraham Van Helsing speculates that he and Vlad the Impaler may be one and the same

statement.id: Wikipedia menyebut Abraham Van Helsing sebagai musuh bebuyutan sang Count, yang menduga bahwa sang Count dan Vlad si Penusuk mungkin orang yang sama.
statement.en: Wikipedia calls Abraham Van Helsing the Count's nemesis, who speculates that the Count and Vlad the Impaler may be one and the same.

alternate_names.name: High Priest of the Great Old Ones

short_description.id: Cthulhu adalah entitas kosmik fiktif ciptaan H. P. Lovecraft dalam cerpen "The Call of Cthulhu" (1928), digambarkan sebagai makhluk raksasa berkepala bertentakel yang menunggu sambil bermimpi di R'lyeh.
short_description.en: Cthulhu is a fictional cosmic entity created by H. P. Lovecraft in the short story "The Call of Cthulhu" (1928), depicted as a gigantic being with a tentacled head who waits dreaming in R'lyeh.

long_description.id:
Cthulhu adalah tokoh sastra, bukan makhluk dari cerita rakyat atau agama. Ia diciptakan oleh H. P. Lovecraft dan diperkenalkan dalam cerpen "The Call of Cthulhu", yang terbit di majalah pulp Weird Tales pada 1928. Wikipedia menyebutnya Great Old One dan nama bagi Cthulhu Mythos, sedangkan peneliti Corbacho Carrobles menggolongkan gaya Lovecraft sebagai kengerian kosmik, bukan lagi Gotik, karena teror dalam kisahnya berasal dari entitas asing yang berada di luar pemahaman manusia.

Dalam cerpen itu, patung kecil Cthulhu digambarkan sebagai monster berbentuk samar mirip manusia dengan kepala seperti gurita yang wajahnya berupa gumpalan sulur, tubuh bersisik dan berkesan seperti karet, cakar besar pada kaki depan dan belakang, serta sayap panjang yang sempit di belakang. Narator juga menyebut ukiran yang membuatnya membayangkan gurita, naga, dan karikatur manusia sekaligus, dengan kepala bertentakel yang gembung. Wikipedia menyebut ia digambarkan raksasa, ratusan meter tingginya, dalam wujud humanoid hijau yang memuat unsur gurita dan naga, sedangkan Corbacho Carrobles menyebutnya perpaduan ganjil dari berbagai konsep yang sulit digolongkan.

Menurut cerita, para pemuja menyembah Great Old Ones yang hidup berabad-abad sebelum ada manusia dan datang dari langit. Mereka menyanyikan bahwa di rumahnya di R'lyeh, Cthulhu yang mati menunggu sambil bermimpi. Para Great Old Ones berbaring di rumah-rumah batu di kota R'lyeh, diawetkan oleh mantra Cthulhu yang perkasa sampai saat kebangkitan ketika bintang-bintang kembali tepat. Cthulhu juga disebut sebagai imam agung yang kelak akan bangkit dari rumahnya di kota di bawah air. Menurut Wikipedia, ia adalah makhluk jahat yang tidur di R'lyeh, kota bawah laut di Pasifik Selatan, dan dipuja oleh banyak kultus manusia serta makhluk lain seperti Deep Ones dan Mi-Go. Dalam cerita ditegaskan bahwa tidak ada manusia yang pernah melihat Great Old Ones, dan arca ukiran itu adalah Cthulhu.

Dalam bagian akhir cerpen, Cthulhu terbangun dan, dalam kata-kata narator, "Benda itu tidak dapat dilukiskan" dan "sebuah gunung berjalan atau terhuyung". Setelah vigintillions tahun, ia lepas lagi, lalu meluncur ke air dan mengejar dengan ayunan besar yang menimbulkan gelombang. Johansen memacu kapalnya menabrak langsung makhluk itu; tubuhnya tercerai-berai, tetapi kemudian berkumpul kembali dalam wujud aslinya. Menurut Corbacho Carrobles, bagian ini menyingkap bahwa mimpi sang seniman bermula pada saat gempa dan badai membuat kota makam R'lyeh naik dari kedalaman.

Setelah cerpen pertamanya, Cthulhu dirujuk dalam karya Lovecraft lain, termasuk novela At the Mountains of Madness (1931) yang menyebut "star-spawn of Cthulhu". August Derleth memakai namanya untuk menyebut sistem cerita Cthulhu Mythos dan menyusun kerangka tersendiri yang menempatkan Cthulhu sebagai salah satu Water Elementals yang bermusuhan dengan Hastur; Houellebecq mengkritik Derleth karena mengubah kelanjutan cerita Lovecraft yang sepenuhnya amoral menjadi pertentangan baik dan jahat yang stereotipikal.
long_description.en:
Cthulhu is a literary character, not a figure of folklore or religion. He was created by H. P. Lovecraft and introduced in the short story "The Call of Cthulhu", published in the pulp magazine Weird Tales in 1928. Wikipedia calls him a Great Old One and the namesake of the Cthulhu Mythos, while the researcher Corbacho Carrobles describes Lovecraft's style as cosmic horror rather than Gothic, since the terror in his tales relates to alien entities from beyond human understanding.

In the story, a small statue of Cthulhu is described as a monster of vaguely anthropoid outline with a head like an octopus whose face is a cluster of feelers, a scaly body that looks rubbery, enormous claws on its hind and front feet, and narrow wings at the back. The narrator also describes a carving that made him imagine an octopus, a dragon, and a human caricature at once, with a pulpy, tentacled head. Wikipedia says he is depicted as gigantic, hundreds of meters tall, in a green humanoid form incorporating elements of an octopus and a dragon, while Corbacho Carrobles calls him an odd blend of several concepts that resists easy definition or classification.

According to the story, cultists worship the Great Old Ones, beings who existed ages before humanity and arrived from the sky. They chant that in his house at R'lyeh dead Cthulhu waits dreaming. The Great Old Ones lie in R'lyeh, their great city of stone houses, kept intact by mighty Cthulhu's spells until the stars are right again for a glorious resurrection. Cthulhu is also called the great priest who is to rise from his dark house in the city under the waters. According to Wikipedia, he is a malevolent entity hibernating in R'lyeh, an underwater city in the South Pacific, worshipped by many human cults and by other monsters such as the Deep Ones and the Mi-Go. The story stresses that no man had ever seen the Old Ones, and the carven idol was great Cthulhu.

In the story's final section, Cthulhu awakens and, in the narrator's words, "The Thing can not be described" and "A mountain walked or stumbled". After vigintillions of years he is loose again, then slides into the water and pursues with vast wave-raising strokes. Johansen drives his vessel head on against the creature; its form is scattered but then nebulously recombines in its hateful original form. According to Corbacho Carrobles, this part reveals that the artist's dreams began at the very time earthquakes and storms made the ancient tomb city of R'lyeh arise from the depths.

After his first story, Cthulhu is referred to in other Lovecraft works, including the novella At the Mountains of Madness (1931), which mentions the "star-spawn of Cthulhu". August Derleth used his name to identify the system of lore called the Cthulhu Mythos and proposed a scheme of his own that makes Cthulhu one of the Water Elementals in an age-old rivalry with Hastur; Houellebecq criticizes Derleth for reshaping Lovecraft's strictly amoral continuity into a stereotypical conflict between objective good and evil.

era: A literary character introduced in a short story published in the magazine Weird Tales in 1928.

literal_meaning.id: Nama rekaan Lovecraft pada 1926 yang kemungkinan dipilih untuk menggemakan kata chthonic, dari bahasa Yunani Kuno yang berarti "dari bumi". Menurut Lovecraft, lafal yang ia tuliskan hanyalah yang terdekat yang dapat dicapai alat ucap manusia untuk meniru suku kata bahasa asing.
literal_meaning.en: A name invented by Lovecraft in 1926, probably chosen to echo the word chthonic, from Ancient Greek "of the earth". According to Lovecraft, his transcribed pronunciation is merely the closest the human vocal apparatus can come to reproducing the syllables of an alien language.

who.id: Entitas kosmik fiktif dan Great Old One ciptaan H. P. Lovecraft.
who.en: A fictional cosmic entity and Great Old One created by H. P. Lovecraft.

origin.id: Diperkenalkan dalam cerpen "The Call of Cthulhu" yang terbit di Weird Tales pada 1928.
origin.en: Introduced in the short story "The Call of Cthulhu", published in Weird Tales in 1928.

role.id: Dalam cerita, ia dipuja para pemuja sebagai imam agung Great Old Ones yang menunggu sambil bermimpi di R'lyeh sampai bintang-bintang kembali tepat.
role.en: In the story he is worshipped by cultists as the great priest who waits dreaming in R'lyeh until the stars are right again.

famous_for.id: Gambar siluetnya yang bertentakel menjadi citra utama karya-karya yang terinspirasi Lovecraft, dan namanya dipakai untuk Cthulhu Mythos.
famous_for.en: His tentacled silhouette is the main image of works inspired by Lovecraft, and his name is used for the Cthulhu Mythos.

did_you_know.id: Menurut Wikipedia, beberapa organisme dinamai menurut Cthulhu, termasuk laba-laba California Pimoa cthulhu, ngengat Speiredonia cthulhui dari Papua Nugini, dan Sollasina cthulhu, echinodermata fosil.
did_you_know.en: Wikipedia notes organisms named for Cthulhu, among them a California spider (Pimoa cthulhu), a New Guinea moth (Speiredonia cthulhui), and a fossil echinoderm (Sollasina cthulhu).

cultural_context.id: Menurut Corbacho Carrobles, monster dalam Cthulhu Mythos berasal dari luar waktu dan ruang dan selalu dipakai untuk melambangkan kerapuhan dan ketidakberartian umat manusia.
cultural_context.en: Corbacho Carrobles writes that the Mythos monsters originate outside time and space and always stand for humanity's frailty and insignificance.

description.id: Setelah kapal menabraknya, tubuh makhluk itu tercerai-berai tetapi tampak menyatu kembali dalam wujud aslinya yang dibenci.
description.en: After the ship rams him, the creature's scattered form is seen nebulously recombining in its hateful original form.

description.id: Dalam cerita, para Great Old Ones berbicara kepada orang-orang peka dengan membentuk mimpi mereka; Corbacho Carrobles mencatat bahwa lewat mimpi buruk sang makhluk berhubungan dengan manusia.
description.en: In the story, the Great Old Ones spoke to the sensitive by molding their dreams; Corbacho Carrobles notes that it is through nightmares that the creature gets in touch with people.

description.id: Menurut Wikipedia, usianya digambarkan paling sedikit "vigintillions of years" dan ia disebut melontarkan mantra yang mengawetkan Great Old Ones sampai kebangkitan mereka.
description.en: According to Wikipedia, his age is described as at least "vigintillions of years" and he is said to have cast spells which preserved the Great Old Ones until their reawakening.

role.id: Entitas yang dipuja dan akhirnya terbangun
role.en: The worshipped entity who finally awakens

summary.id: Narator menelusuri patung, mimpi, dan kultus yang berpusat pada Cthulhu. Dalam bagian akhir, kota R'lyeh naik dari laut, Cthulhu terbangun, mengejar kapal para pelaut, dan tubuhnya yang tercerai-berai menyatu kembali setelah ditabrak.
summary.en: The narrator traces statues, dreams, and a cult centred on Cthulhu. In the final section the city of R'lyeh rises from the sea, Cthulhu awakens, pursues the sailors' ship, and his scattered form recombines after being rammed.

summary.en: Per Wikipedia, the novella mentions Cthulhu's "star-spawn", who fought a race called the Elder Things before humans appeared.

claims_provenance.locator: Part II, The Tale of Inspector Legrasse
claims_provenance.source_citation: Wikisource — The Call of Cthulhu (Weird Tales, Vol. 11, No. 2, February 1928)

claim.id: Dalam cerita, para Great Old Ones berbicara kepada orang-orang peka dengan membentuk mimpi mereka, karena hanya begitu bahasa mereka dapat mencapai pikiran berdaging mamalia.
claim.en: In the story, the Great Old Ones spoke to the sensitive among men by molding their dreams, for only thus could their language reach the fleshly minds of mammals.

claims_provenance.quote: the Great Old Ones spoke to the sensitive among them by molding their dreams; for only thus could Their language reach the fleshly minds of mammals.
claims_provenance.locator: Part II, The Tale of Inspector Legrasse
claims_provenance.source_citation: Wikisource — The Call of Cthulhu (Weird Tales, Vol. 11, No. 2, February 1928)

claim.id: Benda dari arca-arca itu, keturunan bintang yang hijau dan lengket, terbangun untuk menuntut miliknya; bintang-bintang kembali tepat dan setelah vigintillions tahun Cthulhu yang agung lepas lagi dan rakus akan kesenangan.
claim.en: The Thing of the idols, the green, sticky spawn of the stars, had awaked to claim his own; the stars were right again and after vigintillions of years great Cthulhu was loose again and ravening for delight.

claims_provenance.quote: The Thing of the idols, the green, sticky spawn of the stars, had awaked to claim his own. The stars were right again ... After vigintillions of years great Cthulhu was loose again, and ravening for delight.
claims_provenance.locator: Part III, The Madness from the Sea
claims_provenance.source_citation: Wikisource — The Call of Cthulhu (Weird Tales, Vol. 11, No. 2, February 1928)

claim.id: Narasi menyatakan bahwa Benda itu tidak dapat dilukiskan karena tidak ada bahasa untuk jurang teriakan dan kegilaan yang demikian, dan sebuah gunung berjalan atau terhuyung.
claim.en: The narration states that the Thing cannot be described, as there is no language for such abysms of shrieking and immemorial lunacy, and that a mountain walked or stumbled.

claims_provenance.quote: The Thing can not be described—there is no language for such abysms of shrieking and immemorial lunacy, such eldritch contradictions of all matter, force, and cosmic order. A mountain walked or stumbled.
claims_provenance.locator: Part III, The Madness from the Sea
claims_provenance.source_citation: Wikisource — The Call of Cthulhu (Weird Tales, Vol. 11, No. 2, February 1928)

claim.id: Cthulhu yang agung meluncur licin ke dalam air dan mulai mengejar dengan ayunan besar yang menimbulkan gelombang dengan daya kosmik.
claim.en: Great Cthulhu slid greasily into the water and began to pursue with vast wave-raising strokes of cosmic potency.

claims_provenance.quote: great Cthulhu slid greasily into the water and began to pursue with vast wave-raising strokes of cosmic potency.
claims_provenance.locator: Part III, The Madness from the Sea
claims_provenance.source_citation: Wikisource — The Call of Cthulhu (Weird Tales, Vol. 11, No. 2, February 1928)

claim.id: Pelaut Norwegia yang gagah berani memacu kapalnya langsung menabrak jeli yang mengejar; kemudian plastisitas yang tercerai-berai dari anak langit tanpa nama itu tampak menyatu kembali secara samar dalam wujud aslinya yang dibenci.
claim.en: The brave Norwegian drove his vessel head on against the pursuing jelly; afterwards the scattered plasticity of that nameless sky-spawn was nebulously recombining in its hateful original form.

claims_provenance.quote: the brave Norwegian drove his vessel head on against the pursuing jelly which rose above the unclean froth like the stern of a demon galleon. ... the scattered plasticity of that nameless sky-spawn was nebulously recombining in its hateful original form
claims_provenance.locator: Part III, The Madness from the Sea
claims_provenance.source_citation: Wikisource — The Call of Cthulhu (Weird Tales, Vol. 11, No. 2, February 1928)

claim.id: Menurut cerita, tidak ada manusia yang pernah melihat Great Old Ones; arca ukiran itu adalah Cthulhu yang agung, tetapi tak seorang pun dapat mengatakan apakah yang lain persis seperti dia.
claim.en: According to the story, no man had ever seen the Old Ones; the carven idol was great Cthulhu, but none might say whether or not the others were precisely like him.

claims_provenance.quote: No man had ever seen the Old Ones. The carven idol was great Cthulhu, but none might say whether or not the others were precisely like him.
claims_provenance.locator: Part II, The Tale of Inspector Legrasse
claims_provenance.source_citation: Wikisource — The Call of Cthulhu (Weird Tales, Vol. 11, No. 2, February 1928)

claim.id: Kultus itu tidak akan mati sampai bintang-bintang kembali tepat, dan para imam rahasia akan mengeluarkan Cthulhu yang agung dari makamnya untuk menghidupkan kembali para pengikutnya dan melanjutkan kekuasaannya atas bumi.
claim.en: That cult would never die till the stars came right again, and the secret priests would take great Cthulhu from his tomb to revive his subjects and resume his rule of earth.

claims_provenance.quote: That cult would never die till the stars came right again, and the secret priests would take great Cthulhu from His tomb to revive His subjects and resume His rule of earth.
claims_provenance.locator: Part II, The Tale of Inspector Legrasse
claims_provenance.source_citation: Wikisource — The Call of Cthulhu (Weird Tales, Vol. 11, No. 2, February 1928)

claim.id: Corbacho Carrobles menyatakan bahwa gaya Lovecraft tidak lagi dianggap Gotik melainkan kengerian kosmik, karena teror dalam kisahnya berkaitan dengan entitas asing dari luar pemahaman manusia, bukan hantu.
claim.en: Corbacho Carrobles states that Lovecraft's style is no longer considered Gothic but cosmic horror, because the terror in his tales relates to alien entities from beyond human understanding rather than to ghosts.

claims_provenance.quote: The style in which Lovecraft writes is no longer considered Gothic, but cosmic horror. The main reasons are mainly that the terror depicted in Lovecraft's tales is not focused on ghosts or that sort of creatures, but rather it is related to alien entities from beyond human understanding.
claims_provenance.source_citation: Universidad Complutense de Madrid (JACLR: Journal of Artistic Creation and Literary Research) — H.P. Lovecraft's The Call Of Cthulhu: an Intermedial Analysis of its Graphic Adaptation

claim.id: Menurut Corbacho Carrobles, monster dalam Cthulhu Mythos datang dari luar waktu dan ruang dan selalu dipakai untuk melambangkan kerapuhan dan ketidakberartian umat manusia.
claim.en: Corbacho Carrobles writes that the Mythos monsters originate outside time and space and always stand for humanity's frailty and insignificance.

claims_provenance.quote: The monsters in the Cthulhu Mythos come from beyond time and space and are always used to represent the feebleness and meaninglessness of mankind.
claims_provenance.source_citation: Universidad Complutense de Madrid (JACLR: Journal of Artistic Creation and Literary Research) — H.P. Lovecraft's The Call Of Cthulhu: an Intermedial Analysis of its Graphic Adaptation

claim.id: Corbacho Carrobles menyebut makhluk-makhluk itu sebagai makhluk campuran, seperti Cthulhu, perpaduan ganjil dari berbagai konsep yang tidak mudah ditakrifkan atau digolongkan dan dirancang untuk menciptakan ambiguitas.
claim.en: Corbacho Carrobles calls these creatures hybrid beings, like Cthulhu, a grotesque amalgam of different concepts, never easy to define or categorize, designed to create ambiguity.

claims_provenance.quote: They are hybrid beings, as Cthulhu, a grotesque amalgam of different concepts, never easy to define or categorize, designed to create ambiguity
claims_provenance.source_citation: Universidad Complutense de Madrid (JACLR: Journal of Artistic Creation and Literary Research) — H.P. Lovecraft's The Call Of Cthulhu: an Intermedial Analysis of its Graphic Adaptation

claim.id: Menurut Corbacho Carrobles, Cthulhu adalah makhluk paling dikenal dari panteon rekaan Lovecraft, dan siluet makhluk raksasa mirip naga berkepala gembung yang bangkit dari kedalaman adalah citra utama dalam segala karya yang terinspirasi Lovecraft.
claim.en: According to Corbacho Carrobles, Cthulhu is the best known creature from Lovecraft's imaginary pantheon, and the silhouette of a gargantuan dragon-like creature with a pulpy head rising from the depths is the main image in anything inspired by Lovecraft's works.

claims_provenance.quote: Cthulhu, being the best known creature from Lovecraft's imaginary pantheon, is almost a coat of arms for anything branded after him. The sinister silhouette of a gargantuan dragon-like creature with a pulpy head rising from the depths is the main image to be found in anything inspired by Lovecraft's works
claims_provenance.source_citation: Universidad Complutense de Madrid (JACLR: Journal of Artistic Creation and Literary Research) — H.P. Lovecraft's The Call Of Cthulhu: an Intermedial Analysis of its Graphic Adaptation

claim.id: Puncak cerita terungkap pada bagian akhir lewat kata-kata mendiang pelaut Gustaf Johansen, yaitu bahwa mimpi sang seniman bermula pada saat yang sama ketika gempa dan badai membuat kota makam kuno Cthulhu, R'lyeh, naik dari kedalaman.
claim.en: The climax of the tale unfolds in its last part through the words of the late sailor Gustaf Johansen, as we learn the artist's dreams began at the very time earthquakes and storms made Cthulhu's ancient tomb city, R'lyeh, arise from the depths.

claims_provenance.quote: The climax of the tale unveils during its last part, with the words of the late Sailor Gustaf Johansen as we learn that the dreams of the artist begin at the very same time as earthquakes and storms made the ancient tomb city of Cthulhu, R'lyeh, arise from the depths.
claims_provenance.source_citation: Universidad Complutense de Madrid (JACLR: Journal of Artistic Creation and Literary Research) — H.P. Lovecraft's The Call Of Cthulhu: an Intermedial Analysis of its Graphic Adaptation

claim.id: Cerita-cerita aneh Cthulhu Mythos telah menjadi poros bukan hanya bagi tak terhitung kisah dari penulis ternama, tetapi juga bagi gim video, film, gim peran, dan novel grafis.
claim.en: The weird tales of the Cthulhu Mythos have become the axis not only for a never-ending number of tales by renowned authors but also for video-games, films, role-playing games, and graphic novels.

claims_provenance.quote: The weird tales of the Cthulhu Mythos have become the axis for, not only a never ending amount of tales from renowned authors, but also for video-games, films, role-playing games, or graphic novels.
claims_provenance.source_citation: Universidad Complutense de Madrid (JACLR: Journal of Artistic Creation and Literary Research) — H.P. Lovecraft's The Call Of Cthulhu: an Intermedial Analysis of its Graphic Adaptation

claim.id: Penelitian ini membahas kisah paling terkenal karya H.P. Lovecraft, The Call of Cthulhu, dan adaptasinya ke dalam komik dan novel grafis kontemporer, khususnya karya penulis dan seniman Swiss Michael Zigerlig.
claim.en: The research concerns H.P. Lovecraft's most renowned tale, The Call of Cthulhu, and its adaptations into contemporary comics and graphic novels, in particular the one by the Swiss writer and artist Michael Zigerlig.

claims_provenance.quote: My research involves the most renowned tale by the master of modern horror H.P. Lovecraft, The call of Cthulhu, and its adaptations into contemporary comics and graphic novels, in particular the one by Swiss writer/artist Michael Zigerlig.
claims_provenance.source_citation: Universidad Complutense de Madrid (JACLR: Journal of Artistic Creation and Literary Research) — H.P. Lovecraft's The Call Of Cthulhu: an Intermedial Analysis of its Graphic Adaptation

claim.id: Corbacho Carrobles mencatat bahwa lewat mimpi buruk sang makhluk berhubungan dengan orang-orang di dunia, seperti yang kita pahami saat membaca kisahnya.
claim.en: Corbacho Carrobles notes that it is through nightmares that the creature gets in touch with the people of the world, as we understand when reading the tale.

claims_provenance.quote: And it is through nightmares that the creature gets in touch with the people of the world as we understand when reading the tale.
claims_provenance.source_citation: Universidad Complutense de Madrid (JACLR: Journal of Artistic Creation and Literary Research) — H.P. Lovecraft's The Call Of Cthulhu: an Intermedial Analysis of its Graphic Adaptation

claim.id: Cthulhu adalah entitas kosmik fiktif ciptaan penulis H. P. Lovecraft, yang diperkenalkan dalam cerpen "The Call of Cthulhu" yang diterbitkan majalah pulp Amerika Weird Tales pada 1928.
claim.en: Cthulhu is a fictional cosmic entity created by writer H. P. Lovecraft, introduced in his short story "The Call of Cthulhu", published by the American pulp magazine Weird Tales in 1928.

claims_provenance.quote: Cthulhu is a fictional cosmic entity created by writer H. P. Lovecraft. The character was introduced in his short story "The Call of Cthulhu", published by the American pulp magazine Weird Tales in 1928.

claim.id: Cthulhu dianggap Great Old One dalam panteon entitas kosmik Lovecraftian, digambarkan sebagai entitas raksasa yang dipuja para pemuja, dalam wujud humanoid hijau yang memuat unsur visual mirip gurita dan naga.
claim.en: Considered a Great Old One within the pantheon of Lovecraftian cosmic entities, Cthulhu is depicted as a gigantic entity worshipped by cultists, in a green humanoid form incorporating visual elements similar to an octopus and dragon.

claims_provenance.quote: Considered a Great Old One within the pantheon of Lovecraftian cosmic entities, he is depicted as a gigantic entity worshipped by cultists, in a green humanoid form incorporating visual elements similar to an octopus and dragon.

claim.id: Nama Cthulhu diciptakan Lovecraft pada 1926 dan kemungkinan dipilih untuk menggemakan kata chthonic (Yunani Kuno "dari bumi").
claim.en: The name Cthulhu was invented by Lovecraft in 1926 and was probably chosen to echo the word chthonic (Ancient Greek "of the earth").

claims_provenance.quote: Invented by Lovecraft in 1926, the name Cthulhu was probably chosen to echo the word chthonic (Ancient Greek "of the earth")

claim.id: Menurut Lovecraft, lafal yang ia tuliskan hanyalah yang terdekat yang dapat dicapai alat ucap manusia untuk meniru suku kata bahasa asing.
claim.en: According to Lovecraft, his transcribed pronunciation is merely the closest that the human vocal apparatus can come to reproducing the syllables of an alien language.

claims_provenance.quote: According to Lovecraft, this is merely the closest that the human vocal apparatus can come to reproducing the syllables of an alien language.

claim.id: Cthulhu disebut setinggi ratusan meter dengan lengan dan kaki berselaput yang tampak seperti manusia, dan kepalanya digambarkan mirip seluruh tubuh gurita raksasa dengan sejumlah tentakel yang tidak diketahui jumlahnya mengelilingi mulutnya.
claim.en: Cthulhu is said to be hundreds of meters tall, with webbed, human-looking arms and legs, and his head is depicted as similar to the entirety of a gigantic octopus with an unknown number of tentacles surrounding his supposed mouth.

claims_provenance.quote: Cthulhu is said to be hundreds of meters tall, with webbed, human-looking arms and legs. Its head is depicted as similar to the entirety of a gigantic octopus, with an unknown number of tentacles surrounding its supposed mouth.

claim.id: Usianya digambarkan paling sedikit "vigintillions of years", dan ia juga disebut telah melontarkan mantra yang mengawetkan Great Old Ones sampai kebangkitan mereka.
claim.en: His age is described as at least "vigintillions of years", and he is also said to have cast spells which preserved the Great Old Ones until their reawakening.

claims_provenance.quote: His age is described to be at least "vigintillions of years". He is also said to have cast spells which preserved the Great Old Ones until their reawakening.

claim.id: Cerpen itu, terbit di Weird Tales pada 1928, menetapkan tokoh ini sebagai entitas jahat yang berhibernasi di R'lyeh, kota bawah air di Pasifik Selatan.
claim.en: The story, published in Weird Tales in 1928, established the character as a malevolent entity hibernating within R'lyeh, an underwater city in the South Pacific.

claims_provenance.quote: was published in Weird Tales in 1928, and established the character as a malevolent entity, hibernating within R'lyeh, an underwater city in the South Pacific.

claim.id: Cthulhu juga menjadi objek pemujaan oleh banyak kultus manusia, termasuk di Selandia Baru, Greenland, Louisiana, dan pegunungan Tiongkok, serta oleh monster Lovecraftian lain yang disebut Deep Ones dan Mi-Go.
claim.en: Cthulhu is also the object of worship by many human cults, including some within New Zealand, Greenland, Louisiana, and the Chinese mountains, and by other Lovecraftian monsters called Deep Ones and Mi-Go.

claims_provenance.quote: is also the object of worship, both by many human cults (including some within New Zealand, Greenland, Louisiana, and the Chinese mountains) and by other Lovecraftian monsters (called Deep Ones and Mi-Go).

claim.id: August Derleth, rekan korespondensi Lovecraft, memakai nama makhluk ini untuk menyebut sistem cerita yang dipakai Lovecraft dan para penerusnya, Cthulhu Mythos.
claim.en: August Derleth, a correspondent of Lovecraft's, used the creature's name to identify the system of lore employed by Lovecraft and his literary successors, the Cthulhu Mythos.

claims_provenance.quote: August Derleth, a correspondent of Lovecraft's, used the creature's name to identify the system of lore employed by Lovecraft and his literary successors, the Cthulhu Mythos.

claim.id: Menurut skema Derleth, Cthulhu yang agung adalah salah satu Water Elementals dan terlibat persaingan sejak lama dengan elemental udara Hastur the Unspeakable, yang disebut "saudara tiri" Cthulhu.
claim.en: According to Derleth's scheme, Great Cthulhu is one of the Water Elementals and was engaged in an age-old arch-rivalry with the air elemental Hastur the Unspeakable, described as Cthulhu's half-brother.

claims_provenance.quote: According to Derleth's scheme, "Great Cthulhu is one of the Water Elementals" and was engaged in an age-old arch-rivalry with a designated air elemental, Hastur the Unspeakable, described as Cthulhu's "half-brother."

claim.id: Buku Houellebecq H. P. Lovecraft: Against the World, Against Life (2005) mengecam Derleth karena berupaya membentuk ulang kelanjutan Lovecraft yang sepenuhnya amoral menjadi pertentangan stereotipikal antara kekuatan baik dan jahat yang objektif.
claim.en: Houellebecq's H. P. Lovecraft: Against the World, Against Life (2005) decries Derleth for attempting to reshape Lovecraft's strictly amoral continuity into a stereotypical conflict between forces of objective good and evil.

claims_provenance.quote: Houellebecq's H. P. Lovecraft: Against the World, Against Life (2005) decries Derleth for attempting to reshape Lovecraft's strictly amoral continuity into a stereotypical conflict between forces of objective good and evil.

claim.id: Lovecraft merancang silsilah terperinci untuk Cthulhu (terbit sebagai "Letter 617" dalam Selected Letters) dan menjadikan tokoh ini rujukan utama dalam karyanya.
claim.en: Lovecraft conceived a detailed genealogy for Cthulhu (published as "Letter 617" in Selected Letters) and made the character a central reference in his works.

claims_provenance.quote: Lovecraft conceived a detailed genealogy for Cthulhu (published as "Letter 617" in Selected Letters) and made the character a central reference in his works.

claim.id: Kotak info Wikipedia mencantumkan kerabat Cthulhu: Azathoth (kakek buyut), Yog-Sothoth (kakek), Shub-Niggurath (nenek), dan Nug (orang tua).
claim.en: The Wikipedia infobox lists Cthulhu's relatives: Azathoth (great-great-grandfather), Yog-Sothoth (grandfather), Shub-Niggurath (grandmother), and Nug (parent).

claims_provenance.quote: Relatives Azathoth (great-great-grandfather) Yog-Sothoth (grandfather) Shub-Niggurath (grandmother) Nug (parent)

claim.id: Cerpen "The Dunwich Horror" (1928) merujuk Cthulhu, sedangkan The Whisperer in Darkness (1930) mengisyaratkan bahwa salah satu tokohnya mengetahui asal makhluk itu.
claim.en: The short story "The Dunwich Horror" (1928) refers to Cthulhu, while The Whisperer in Darkness (1930) hints that one of its characters knows the creature's origins.

claims_provenance.quote: The short story "The Dunwich Horror" (1928) refers to Cthulhu, while The Whisperer in Darkness (1930) hints that one of his characters knows the creature's origins

claim.id: Novela At the Mountains of Madness (1931) merujuk "star-spawn of Cthulhu" yang berperang dengan ras lain bernama Elder Things sebelum fajar manusia.
claim.en: The 1931 novella At the Mountains of Madness refers to the "star-spawn of Cthulhu", who warred with another race called the Elder Things before the dawn of man.

claims_provenance.quote: The 1931 novella At the Mountains of Madness refers to the "star-spawn of Cthulhu", who warred with another race called the Elder Things before the dawn of man.

claim.id: Derleth menulis serangkaian cerita pendek yang terbit di Weird Tales (1944–1952) dan dikumpulkan sebagai The Trail of Cthulhu, yang menggambarkan perjuangan Dr. Laban Shrewsbury dan rekan-rekannya melawan Cthulhu dan para pengikutnya.
claim.en: Derleth wrote a series of short stories published in Weird Tales (1944–1952) and collected as The Trail of Cthulhu, depicting the struggle of Dr. Laban Shrewsbury and his associates against Cthulhu and his minions.

claims_provenance.quote: Derleth wrote a series of short stories published in Weird Tales (1944–1952) and collected as The Trail of Cthulhu, depicting the struggle of a Dr. Laban Shrewsbury and his associates against Cthulhu and his minions.

claim.id: Perusahaan gim TSR menyertakan satu bab penuh tentang mitos Cthulhu (termasuk statistik karakter) dalam cetakan pertama buku sumber Dungeons & Dragons, Deities & Demigods (1980).
claim.en: The games company TSR included an entire chapter on the Cthulhu mythos (including character statistics) in the first printing of the Dungeons & Dragons sourcebook Deities & Demigods (1980).

claims_provenance.quote: games company TSR included an entire chapter on the Cthulhu mythos (including character statistics) in the first printing of Dungeons & Dragons sourcebook Deities & Demigods (1980).

claim.id: Cthulhu muncul sebagai kandidat parodi dalam beberapa pemilu, termasuk pemilihan presiden Polandia 2010 serta pemilihan presiden AS 2012 dan 2016.
claim.en: Cthulhu has appeared as a parody candidate in several elections, including the 2010 Polish presidential election and the 2012 and 2016 US presidential elections.

claims_provenance.quote: Cthulhu has appeared as a parody candidate in several elections, including the 2010 Polish presidential election and the 2012 and 2016 US presidential elections.

claim.id: Beberapa organisme dinamai menurut Cthulhu, termasuk laba-laba California Pimoa cthulhu, ngengat Papua Nugini Speiredonia cthulhui, dan Sollasina cthulhu, echinodermata fosil.
claim.en: Several organisms have been named after Cthulhu, including the California spider Pimoa cthulhu, the New Guinea moth Speiredonia cthulhui, and Sollasina cthulhu, a fossil echinoderm.

claims_provenance.quote: Several organisms have been named after Cthulhu, including the California spider Pimoa cthulhu, the New Guinea moth Speiredonia cthulhui, and Sollasina cthulhu, a fossil echinoderm.

claim.id: Kotak info Wikipedia mencantumkan julukan Cthulhu: The Sleeper of R'lyeh dan High Priest of the Great Old Ones.
claim.en: The Wikipedia infobox lists Cthulhu's aliases: The Sleeper of R'lyeh and High Priest of the Great Old Ones.

claims_provenance.quote: Aliases The Sleeper of R'lyeh High Priest of the Great Old Ones

claim.id: Cthulhu juga dieja dengan banyak cara lain, termasuk Tulu, Katulu, dan Kutulu.
claim.en: Cthulhu has also been spelled in many other ways, including Tulu, Katulu, and Kutulu.

claims_provenance.quote: Cthulhu has also been spelled in many other ways, including Tulu, Katulu, and Kutulu.

text.id: Tokoh sastra yang diperkenalkan dalam cerpen yang terbit di majalah Weird Tales pada 1928.
text.en: A literary character introduced in a short story published in the magazine Weird Tales in 1928.

short_description.id: Cthulhu adalah entitas kosmik fiktif ciptaan H. P. Lovecraft dalam cerpen "The Call of Cthulhu" (1928), digambarkan sebagai makhluk raksasa berkepala bertentakel yang menunggu sambil bermimpi di R'lyeh.
short_description.en: Cthulhu is a fictional cosmic entity created by H. P. Lovecraft in the short story "The Call of Cthulhu" (1928), depicted as a gigantic being with a tentacled head who waits dreaming in R'lyeh.

long_description.id: Cthulhu adalah tokoh sastra, bukan makhluk dari cerita rakyat atau agama. Ia diciptakan oleh H. P. Lovecraft dan diperkenalkan dalam cerpen "The Call of Cthulhu", yang terbit di majalah pulp Weird Tales pada 1928. Wikipedia menyebutnya Great Old One dan nama bagi Cthulhu Mythos, sedangkan peneliti Corbacho Carrobles menggolongkan gaya Lovecraft sebagai kengerian kosmik, bukan lagi Gotik, karena teror dalam kisahnya berasal dari entitas asing yang berada di luar pemahaman manusia.
long_description.en: Cthulhu is a literary character, not a figure of folklore or religion. He was created by H. P. Lovecraft and introduced in the short story "The Call of Cthulhu", published in the pulp magazine Weird Tales in 1928. Wikipedia calls him a Great Old One and the namesake of the Cthulhu Mythos, while the researcher Corbacho Carrobles describes Lovecraft's style as cosmic horror rather than Gothic, since the terror in his tales relates to alien entities from beyond human understanding.

long_description.id: Dalam cerpen itu, patung kecil Cthulhu digambarkan sebagai monster berbentuk samar mirip manusia dengan kepala seperti gurita yang wajahnya berupa gumpalan sulur, tubuh bersisik dan berkesan seperti karet, cakar besar pada kaki depan dan belakang, serta sayap panjang yang sempit di belakang. Narator juga menyebut ukiran yang membuatnya membayangkan gurita, naga, dan karikatur manusia sekaligus, dengan kepala bertentakel yang gembung. Wikipedia menyebut ia digambarkan raksasa, ratusan meter tingginya, dalam wujud humanoid hijau yang memuat unsur gurita dan naga, sedangkan Corbacho Carrobles menyebutnya perpaduan ganjil dari berbagai konsep yang sulit digolongkan.
long_description.en: In the story, a small statue of Cthulhu is described as a monster of vaguely anthropoid outline with a head like an octopus whose face is a cluster of feelers, a scaly body that looks rubbery, enormous claws on its hind and front feet, and narrow wings at the back. The narrator also describes a carving that made him imagine an octopus, a dragon, and a human caricature at once, with a pulpy, tentacled head. Wikipedia says he is depicted as gigantic, hundreds of meters tall, in a green humanoid form incorporating elements of an octopus and a dragon, while Corbacho Carrobles calls him an odd blend of several concepts that resists easy definition or classification.

long_description.id: Menurut cerita, para pemuja menyembah Great Old Ones yang hidup berabad-abad sebelum ada manusia dan datang dari langit. Mereka menyanyikan bahwa di rumahnya di R'lyeh, Cthulhu yang mati menunggu sambil bermimpi. Para Great Old Ones berbaring di rumah-rumah batu di kota R'lyeh, diawetkan oleh mantra Cthulhu yang perkasa sampai saat kebangkitan ketika bintang-bintang kembali tepat. Cthulhu juga disebut sebagai imam agung yang kelak akan bangkit dari rumahnya di kota di bawah air. Menurut Wikipedia, ia adalah makhluk jahat yang tidur di R'lyeh, kota bawah laut di Pasifik Selatan, dan dipuja oleh banyak kultus manusia serta makhluk lain seperti Deep Ones dan Mi-Go. Dalam cerita ditegaskan bahwa tidak ada manusia yang pernah melihat Great Old Ones, dan arca ukiran itu adalah Cthulhu.
long_description.en: According to the story, cultists worship the Great Old Ones, beings who existed ages before humanity and arrived from the sky. They chant that in his house at R'lyeh dead Cthulhu waits dreaming. The Great Old Ones lie in R'lyeh, their great city of stone houses, kept intact by mighty Cthulhu's spells until the stars are right again for a glorious resurrection. Cthulhu is also called the great priest who is to rise from his dark house in the city under the waters. According to Wikipedia, he is a malevolent entity hibernating in R'lyeh, an underwater city in the South Pacific, worshipped by many human cults and by other monsters such as the Deep Ones and the Mi-Go. The story stresses that no man had ever seen the Old Ones, and the carven idol was great Cthulhu.

long_description.id: Dalam bagian akhir cerpen, Cthulhu terbangun dan, dalam kata-kata narator, "Benda itu tidak dapat dilukiskan" dan "sebuah gunung berjalan atau terhuyung". Setelah vigintillions tahun, ia lepas lagi, lalu meluncur ke air dan mengejar dengan ayunan besar yang menimbulkan gelombang. Johansen memacu kapalnya menabrak langsung makhluk itu; tubuhnya tercerai-berai, tetapi kemudian berkumpul kembali dalam wujud aslinya. Menurut Corbacho Carrobles, bagian ini menyingkap bahwa mimpi sang seniman bermula pada saat gempa dan badai membuat kota makam R'lyeh naik dari kedalaman.
long_description.en: In the story's final section, Cthulhu awakens and, in the narrator's words, "The Thing can not be described" and "A mountain walked or stumbled". After vigintillions of years he is loose again, then slides into the water and pursues with vast wave-raising strokes. Johansen drives his vessel head on against the creature; its form is scattered but then nebulously recombines in its hateful original form. According to Corbacho Carrobles, this part reveals that the artist's dreams began at the very time earthquakes and storms made the ancient tomb city of R'lyeh arise from the depths.

long_description.id: Setelah cerpen pertamanya, Cthulhu dirujuk dalam karya Lovecraft lain, termasuk novela At the Mountains of Madness (1931) yang menyebut "star-spawn of Cthulhu". August Derleth memakai namanya untuk menyebut sistem cerita Cthulhu Mythos dan menyusun kerangka tersendiri yang menempatkan Cthulhu sebagai salah satu Water Elementals yang bermusuhan dengan Hastur; Houellebecq mengkritik Derleth karena mengubah kelanjutan cerita Lovecraft yang sepenuhnya amoral menjadi pertentangan baik dan jahat yang stereotipikal.
long_description.en: After his first story, Cthulhu is referred to in other Lovecraft works, including the novella At the Mountains of Madness (1931), which mentions the "star-spawn of Cthulhu". August Derleth used his name to identify the system of lore called the Cthulhu Mythos and proposed a scheme of his own that makes Cthulhu one of the Water Elementals in an age-old rivalry with Hastur; Houellebecq criticizes Derleth for reshaping Lovecraft's strictly amoral continuity into a stereotypical conflict between objective good and evil.

cultural_context.id: Menurut Corbacho Carrobles, monster dalam Cthulhu Mythos berasal dari luar waktu dan ruang dan selalu dipakai untuk melambangkan kerapuhan dan ketidakberartian umat manusia.
cultural_context.en: Corbacho Carrobles writes that the Mythos monsters originate outside time and space and always stand for humanity's frailty and insignificance.

literal_meaning.id: Nama rekaan Lovecraft pada 1926 yang kemungkinan dipilih untuk menggemakan kata chthonic, dari bahasa Yunani Kuno yang berarti "dari bumi". Menurut Lovecraft, lafal yang ia tuliskan hanyalah yang terdekat yang dapat dicapai alat ucap manusia untuk meniru suku kata bahasa asing.
literal_meaning.en: A name invented by Lovecraft in 1926, probably chosen to echo the word chthonic, from Ancient Greek "of the earth". According to Lovecraft, his transcribed pronunciation is merely the closest the human vocal apparatus can come to reproducing the syllables of an alien language.

summary.en: The narrator traces statues, dreams, and a cult centred on Cthulhu. In the final section the city of R'lyeh rises from the sea, Cthulhu awakens, pursues the sailors' ship, and his scattered form recombines after being rammed.
