statement.en: According to Corbacho Carrobles, Cthulhu is the best known creature from Lovecraft's imaginary pantheon, and the silhouette of a gargantuan dragon-like creature with a pulpy head rising from the depths is the main image in anything inspired by Lovecraft's works.

claims.quote: The climax of the tale unveils during its last part, with the words of the late Sailor Gustaf Johansen as we learn that the dreams of the artist begin at the very same time as earthquakes and storms made the ancient tomb city of Cthulhu, R'lyeh, arise from the depths.

statement.id: Puncak cerita terungkap pada bagian akhir lewat kata-kata mendiang pelaut Gustaf Johansen, yaitu bahwa mimpi sang seniman bermula pada saat yang sama ketika gempa dan badai membuat kota makam kuno Cthulhu, R'lyeh, naik dari kedalaman.
statement.en: The climax of the tale unfolds in its last part through the words of the late sailor Gustaf Johansen, as we learn the artist's dreams began at the very time earthquakes and storms made Cthulhu's ancient tomb city, R'lyeh, arise from the depths.

claims.quote: The weird tales of the Cthulhu Mythos have become the axis for, not only a never ending amount of tales from renowned authors, but also for video-games, films, role-playing games, or graphic novels.

statement.id: Cerita-cerita aneh Cthulhu Mythos telah menjadi poros bukan hanya bagi tak terhitung kisah dari penulis ternama, tetapi juga bagi gim video, film, gim peran, dan novel grafis.
statement.en: The weird tales of the Cthulhu Mythos have become the axis not only for a never-ending number of tales by renowned authors but also for video-games, films, role-playing games, and graphic novels.

claims.quote: My research involves the most renowned tale by the master of modern horror H.P. Lovecraft, The call of Cthulhu, and its adaptations into contemporary comics and graphic novels, in particular the one by Swiss writer/artist Michael Zigerlig.

statement.id: Penelitian ini membahas kisah paling terkenal karya H.P. Lovecraft, The Call of Cthulhu, dan adaptasinya ke dalam komik dan novel grafis kontemporer, khususnya karya penulis dan seniman Swiss Michael Zigerlig.
statement.en: The research concerns H.P. Lovecraft's most renowned tale, The Call of Cthulhu, and its adaptations into contemporary comics and graphic novels, in particular the one by the Swiss writer and artist Michael Zigerlig.

claims.quote: And it is through nightmares that the creature gets in touch with the people of the world as we understand when reading the tale.

statement.id: Corbacho Carrobles mencatat bahwa lewat mimpi buruk sang makhluk berhubungan dengan orang-orang di dunia, seperti yang kita pahami saat membaca kisahnya.
statement.en: Corbacho Carrobles notes that it is through nightmares that the creature gets in touch with the people of the world, as we understand when reading the tale.

claims.quote: Cthulhu is a fictional cosmic entity created by writer H. P. Lovecraft. The character was introduced in his short story "The Call of Cthulhu", published by the American pulp magazine Weird Tales in 1928.

statement.id: Cthulhu adalah entitas kosmik fiktif ciptaan penulis H. P. Lovecraft, yang diperkenalkan dalam cerpen "The Call of Cthulhu" yang diterbitkan majalah pulp Amerika Weird Tales pada 1928.
statement.en: Cthulhu is a fictional cosmic entity created by writer H. P. Lovecraft, introduced in his short story "The Call of Cthulhu", published by the American pulp magazine Weird Tales in 1928.

claims.quote: Considered a Great Old One within the pantheon of Lovecraftian cosmic entities, he is depicted as a gigantic entity worshipped by cultists, in a green humanoid form incorporating visual elements similar to an octopus and dragon.

statement.id: Cthulhu dianggap Great Old One dalam panteon entitas kosmik Lovecraftian, digambarkan sebagai entitas raksasa yang dipuja para pemuja, dalam wujud humanoid hijau yang memuat unsur visual mirip gurita dan naga.
statement.en: Considered a Great Old One within the pantheon of Lovecraftian cosmic entities, Cthulhu is depicted as a gigantic entity worshipped by cultists, in a green humanoid form incorporating visual elements similar to an octopus and dragon.

claims.quote: Invented by Lovecraft in 1926, the name Cthulhu was probably chosen to echo the word chthonic (Ancient Greek "of the earth")

statement.id: Nama Cthulhu diciptakan Lovecraft pada 1926 dan kemungkinan dipilih untuk menggemakan kata chthonic (Yunani Kuno "dari bumi").
statement.en: The name Cthulhu was invented by Lovecraft in 1926 and was probably chosen to echo the word chthonic (Ancient Greek "of the earth").

claims.quote: According to Lovecraft, this is merely the closest that the human vocal apparatus can come to reproducing the syllables of an alien language.

statement.id: Menurut Lovecraft, lafal yang ia tuliskan hanyalah yang terdekat yang dapat dicapai alat ucap manusia untuk meniru suku kata bahasa asing.
statement.en: According to Lovecraft, his transcribed pronunciation is merely the closest that the human vocal apparatus can come to reproducing the syllables of an alien language.

claims.quote: Cthulhu is said to be hundreds of meters tall, with webbed, human-looking arms and legs. Its head is depicted as similar to the entirety of a gigantic octopus, with an unknown number of tentacles surrounding its supposed mouth.

statement.id: Cthulhu disebut setinggi ratusan meter dengan lengan dan kaki berselaput yang tampak seperti manusia, dan kepalanya digambarkan mirip seluruh tubuh gurita raksasa dengan sejumlah tentakel yang tidak diketahui jumlahnya mengelilingi mulutnya.
statement.en: Cthulhu is said to be hundreds of meters tall, with webbed, human-looking arms and legs, and his head is depicted as similar to the entirety of a gigantic octopus with an unknown number of tentacles surrounding his supposed mouth.

claims.quote: His age is described to be at least "vigintillions of years". He is also said to have cast spells which preserved the Great Old Ones until their reawakening.

statement.id: Usianya digambarkan paling sedikit "vigintillions of years", dan ia juga disebut telah melontarkan mantra yang mengawetkan Great Old Ones sampai kebangkitan mereka.
statement.en: His age is described as at least "vigintillions of years", and he is also said to have cast spells which preserved the Great Old Ones until their reawakening.

claims.quote: was published in Weird Tales in 1928, and established the character as a malevolent entity, hibernating within R'lyeh, an underwater city in the South Pacific.

statement.id: Cerpen itu, terbit di Weird Tales pada 1928, menetapkan tokoh ini sebagai entitas jahat yang berhibernasi di R'lyeh, kota bawah air di Pasifik Selatan.
statement.en: The story, published in Weird Tales in 1928, established the character as a malevolent entity hibernating within R'lyeh, an underwater city in the South Pacific.

claims.quote: is also the object of worship, both by many human cults (including some within New Zealand, Greenland, Louisiana, and the Chinese mountains) and by other Lovecraftian monsters (called Deep Ones and Mi-Go).

statement.id: Cthulhu juga menjadi objek pemujaan oleh banyak kultus manusia, termasuk di Selandia Baru, Greenland, Louisiana, dan pegunungan Tiongkok, serta oleh monster Lovecraftian lain yang disebut Deep Ones dan Mi-Go.
statement.en: Cthulhu is also the object of worship by many human cults, including some within New Zealand, Greenland, Louisiana, and the Chinese mountains, and by other Lovecraftian monsters called Deep Ones and Mi-Go.

claims.quote: August Derleth, a correspondent of Lovecraft's, used the creature's name to identify the system of lore employed by Lovecraft and his literary successors, the Cthulhu Mythos.

statement.id: August Derleth, rekan korespondensi Lovecraft, memakai nama makhluk ini untuk menyebut sistem cerita yang dipakai Lovecraft dan para penerusnya, Cthulhu Mythos.
statement.en: August Derleth, a correspondent of Lovecraft's, used the creature's name to identify the system of lore employed by Lovecraft and his literary successors, the Cthulhu Mythos.

claims.quote: According to Derleth's scheme, "Great Cthulhu is one of the Water Elementals" and was engaged in an age-old arch-rivalry with a designated air elemental, Hastur the Unspeakable, described as Cthulhu's "half-brother."

statement.id: Menurut skema Derleth, Cthulhu yang agung adalah salah satu Water Elementals dan terlibat persaingan sejak lama dengan elemental udara Hastur the Unspeakable, yang disebut "saudara tiri" Cthulhu.
statement.en: According to Derleth's scheme, Great Cthulhu is one of the Water Elementals and was engaged in an age-old arch-rivalry with the air elemental Hastur the Unspeakable, described as Cthulhu's half-brother.

claims.quote: Houellebecq's H. P. Lovecraft: Against the World, Against Life (2005) decries Derleth for attempting to reshape Lovecraft's strictly amoral continuity into a stereotypical conflict between forces of objective good and evil.

statement.id: Buku Houellebecq H. P. Lovecraft: Against the World, Against Life (2005) mengecam Derleth karena berupaya membentuk ulang kelanjutan Lovecraft yang sepenuhnya amoral menjadi pertentangan stereotipikal antara kekuatan baik dan jahat yang objektif.
statement.en: Houellebecq's H. P. Lovecraft: Against the World, Against Life (2005) decries Derleth for attempting to reshape Lovecraft's strictly amoral continuity into a stereotypical conflict between forces of objective good and evil.

claims.quote: Lovecraft conceived a detailed genealogy for Cthulhu (published as "Letter 617" in Selected Letters) and made the character a central reference in his works.

statement.id: Lovecraft merancang silsilah terperinci untuk Cthulhu (terbit sebagai "Letter 617" dalam Selected Letters) dan menjadikan tokoh ini rujukan utama dalam karyanya.
statement.en: Lovecraft conceived a detailed genealogy for Cthulhu (published as "Letter 617" in Selected Letters) and made the character a central reference in his works.

claims.quote: Relatives Azathoth (great-great-grandfather) Yog-Sothoth (grandfather) Shub-Niggurath (grandmother) Nug (parent)

statement.id: Kotak info Wikipedia mencantumkan kerabat Cthulhu: Azathoth (kakek buyut), Yog-Sothoth (kakek), Shub-Niggurath (nenek), dan Nug (orang tua).
statement.en: The Wikipedia infobox lists Cthulhu's relatives: Azathoth (great-great-grandfather), Yog-Sothoth (grandfather), Shub-Niggurath (grandmother), and Nug (parent).

claims.quote: The short story "The Dunwich Horror" (1928) refers to Cthulhu, while The Whisperer in Darkness (1930) hints that one of his characters knows the creature's origins

statement.id: Cerpen "The Dunwich Horror" (1928) merujuk Cthulhu, sedangkan The Whisperer in Darkness (1930) mengisyaratkan bahwa salah satu tokohnya mengetahui asal makhluk itu.
statement.en: The short story "The Dunwich Horror" (1928) refers to Cthulhu, while The Whisperer in Darkness (1930) hints that one of its characters knows the creature's origins.

claims.quote: The 1931 novella At the Mountains of Madness refers to the "star-spawn of Cthulhu", who warred with another race called the Elder Things before the dawn of man.

statement.id: Novela At the Mountains of Madness (1931) merujuk "star-spawn of Cthulhu" yang berperang dengan ras lain bernama Elder Things sebelum fajar manusia.
statement.en: The 1931 novella At the Mountains of Madness refers to the "star-spawn of Cthulhu", who warred with another race called the Elder Things before the dawn of man.

claims.quote: Derleth wrote a series of short stories published in Weird Tales (1944–1952) and collected as The Trail of Cthulhu, depicting the struggle of a Dr. Laban Shrewsbury and his associates against Cthulhu and his minions.

statement.id: Derleth menulis serangkaian cerita pendek yang terbit di Weird Tales (1944–1952) dan dikumpulkan sebagai The Trail of Cthulhu, yang menggambarkan perjuangan Dr. Laban Shrewsbury dan rekan-rekannya melawan Cthulhu dan para pengikutnya.
statement.en: Derleth wrote a series of short stories published in Weird Tales (1944–1952) and collected as The Trail of Cthulhu, depicting the struggle of Dr. Laban Shrewsbury and his associates against Cthulhu and his minions.

claims.quote: games company TSR included an entire chapter on the Cthulhu mythos (including character statistics) in the first printing of Dungeons & Dragons sourcebook Deities & Demigods (1980).

statement.id: Perusahaan gim TSR menyertakan satu bab penuh tentang mitos Cthulhu (termasuk statistik karakter) dalam cetakan pertama buku sumber Dungeons & Dragons, Deities & Demigods (1980).
statement.en: The games company TSR included an entire chapter on the Cthulhu mythos (including character statistics) in the first printing of the Dungeons & Dragons sourcebook Deities & Demigods (1980).

claims.quote: Cthulhu has appeared as a parody candidate in several elections, including the 2010 Polish presidential election and the 2012 and 2016 US presidential elections.

statement.id: Cthulhu muncul sebagai kandidat parodi dalam beberapa pemilu, termasuk pemilihan presiden Polandia 2010 serta pemilihan presiden AS 2012 dan 2016.
statement.en: Cthulhu has appeared as a parody candidate in several elections, including the 2010 Polish presidential election and the 2012 and 2016 US presidential elections.

claims.quote: Several organisms have been named after Cthulhu, including the California spider Pimoa cthulhu, the New Guinea moth Speiredonia cthulhui, and Sollasina cthulhu, a fossil echinoderm.

statement.id: Beberapa organisme dinamai menurut Cthulhu, termasuk laba-laba California Pimoa cthulhu, ngengat Papua Nugini Speiredonia cthulhui, dan Sollasina cthulhu, echinodermata fosil.
statement.en: Several organisms have been named after Cthulhu, including the California spider Pimoa cthulhu, the New Guinea moth Speiredonia cthulhui, and Sollasina cthulhu, a fossil echinoderm.

claims.quote: Aliases The Sleeper of R'lyeh High Priest of the Great Old Ones

statement.id: Kotak info Wikipedia mencantumkan julukan Cthulhu: The Sleeper of R'lyeh dan High Priest of the Great Old Ones.
statement.en: The Wikipedia infobox lists Cthulhu's aliases: The Sleeper of R'lyeh and High Priest of the Great Old Ones.

claims.quote: Cthulhu has also been spelled in many other ways, including Tulu, Katulu, and Kutulu.

statement.id: Cthulhu juga dieja dengan banyak cara lain, termasuk Tulu, Katulu, dan Kutulu.
statement.en: Cthulhu has also been spelled in many other ways, including Tulu, Katulu, and Kutulu.

topic.id: Sifat dunia cerita Cthulhu: amoral atau pertentangan baik dan jahat
topic.en: The nature of Cthulhu's story-world: amoral or a conflict of good and evil

summary.id: Menurut Wikipedia, kelanjutan cerita Lovecraft dinilai Houellebecq sebagai sepenuhnya amoral, dan Corbacho Carrobles menyebut monster Mythos melambangkan ketidakberartian manusia.
summary.en: According to Wikipedia, Houellebecq regards Lovecraft's continuity as strictly amoral, and Corbacho Carrobles says the Mythos monsters represent the meaninglessness of mankind.

summary.id: Skema August Derleth menempatkan Cthulhu sebagai salah satu Water Elementals yang bersaing dengan Hastur dalam kerangka entitas baik dan jahat.
summary.en: August Derleth's scheme places Cthulhu as one of the Water Elementals in rivalry with Hastur within a framework of cosmic good and evil entities.

short_description.id: Oceanus adalah dewa Titan Yunani yang melambangkan sungai air tawar besar yang dipercaya mengelilingi bumi.
short_description.en: Oceanus is a Greek Titan deity personifying a great freshwater river believed to encircle the earth.

long_description.id:
Oceanus adalah Titan tertua, anak Uranus dan Gaia, serta suami Tethys. Ia adalah dewa dan personifikasi sungai air tawar Oceanus yang dipercaya mengelilingi bumi dan menjadi sumber semua dewa dan makhluk hidup, walau dalam mitologi awal ia sering dipandang sebagai unsur, bukan dewa. Sumber air dari mata air, sumur, dan sungai berasal darinya, dan ia dikatakan mengatur benda-benda langit yang terbit dari dan terbenam ke perairannya. Tethys diperkirakan dibayangkan membagikan air penghidupannya ke seluruh bumi melalui akuifer bawah tanah.

Anak-anak Oceanus dan Tethys mencakup dewa-dewa sungai dan nimfa sumber air, antara lain Sungai Styx, Inachos raja Argos, serta para Oceanid seperti Eurynome, Electra, Metis, dan Theia; Homer menyebut tiga putri, yaitu Thetis, Eurynome, dan Perse. Ia dikatakan tinggal di tepi barat bumi dan tidak pernah meninggalkan rumahnya, bahkan untuk sidang para dewa. Dalam puisi Homerik ia tampil sebagai dewa perkasa yang tidak tunduk kepada siapa pun kecuali Zeus.

Oceanus tidak ikut mengebiri Uranus dan tidak bertempur langsung dalam Titanomakhia, sehingga tidak dipenjara di Tartarus, meski ia mengirim putrinya Styx dan anak-anaknya ke pihak Zeus. Ia juga tampil dalam kisah Hercules, yang menakutinya dengan busur hingga ia menenangkan ombak, dan dalam Prometheus Bound, tempat ia bersimpati kepada Prometheus. Bersama Tethys ia menyucikan Glaucus dari sifat fananya.

Dalam seni Yunani Oceanus digambarkan dengan ekor ikan panjang, torso manusia, dan kepala bertanduk, memegang tongkat kerajaan, dengan ikan dan ular sebagai atribut; sungai Oceanus juga ditunjukkan di tepi perisai Achilles buatan Hephaestus. Pada era Helenistik ia dibayangkan ulang sebagai dewa samudra, dan dalam seni mozaik ia digambarkan sebagai dewa laut bertanduk capit kepiting. Sumber modern menyatakan belum ada bukti kultus khusus bagi Oceanus, tetapi ia memiliki satu himne Orfik, dan samudra dinamai dengan namanya.
long_description.en:
Oceanus is the eldest Titan, child of Uranus and Gaia and husband of Tethys. He is the god and personification of the freshwater river Oceanus, believed to encircle the earth and to be the source of all gods and living creatures, although in early mythology he was often viewed as an element rather than a god. The waters of springs, wells, and rivers came from him, and he is said to have regulated the heavenly bodies that rose from and set into his waters. Tethys was probably envisioned distributing his nourishing waters across the earth through underground aquifers.

The children of Oceanus and Tethys include river gods and spring nymphs, among them the River Styx, Inachos the king of Argos, and Oceanids such as Eurynome, Electra, Metis, and Theia; Homer names three daughters, Thetis, Eurynome, and Perse. Tradition places his home on the western shores of the earth, and he never left it, even when the gods assembled. In the Homeric poems he is a mighty god, second only to Zeus.

Oceanus did not take part in the castration of Uranus and did not personally fight in the Titanomachy, so he was not imprisoned in Tartarus, though he sent his daughter Styx and her children to the side of Zeus. He also appears in the story of Hercules, who frightened him with a bow into calming the waves, and in Prometheus Bound, where he sympathises with Prometheus. With Tethys he cleansed Glaucus of his mortal characteristics.

In Greek art Oceanus appears with a human upper body, a horned head, and a long fish's tail, holding a sceptre, with a fish and serpent as attributes; the Oceanus river is also shown on the edges of Achilles' shield made by Hephaestus. In the Hellenistic era he was reimagined as a god of the oceans, and in mosaic art he appears as a sea-god with crab-claw horns. A modern source reports no evidence of a dedicated Oceanus cult, but he has an Orphic Hymn, and the ocean is named after him.

who.en: Oceanus is the eldest Titan and the personification of the freshwater river encircling the earth.

did_you_know.id: Badan air asin terbesar yang mengelilingi bumi dinamai dengan nama Oceanus, padahal sungai Oceanus dalam mitologi Yunani adalah sungai air tawar.
did_you_know.en: The largest body of saltwater encircling the earth is named after Oceanus, although the Oceanus of Greek mythology was a freshwater river.

cultural_context.id: Pemujaan dewa-dewa sungai bersifat lokal, dan tidak ada bukti kultus khusus bagi Oceanus; ia tampil dalam Himne-himne Orfik sebagai pencipta manusia fana dan para dewa.
cultural_context.en: Worship of river gods was local, and there is no evidence of a dedicated cult of Oceanus; he is featured in the Orphic Hymns as creator of mortal men and gods.

short_description.id: Oceanus adalah dewa Titan Yunani yang melambangkan sungai air tawar besar yang dipercaya mengelilingi bumi.
short_description.en: Oceanus is a Greek Titan deity personifying a great freshwater river believed to encircle the earth.

long_description.id: Oceanus adalah Titan tertua, anak Uranus dan Gaia, serta suami Tethys. Ia adalah dewa dan personifikasi sungai air tawar Oceanus yang dipercaya mengelilingi bumi dan menjadi sumber semua dewa dan makhluk hidup, walau dalam mitologi awal ia sering dipandang sebagai unsur, bukan dewa. Sumber air dari mata air, sumur, dan sungai berasal darinya, dan ia dikatakan mengatur benda-benda langit yang terbit dari dan terbenam ke perairannya. Tethys diperkirakan dibayangkan membagikan air penghidupannya ke seluruh bumi melalui akuifer bawah tanah.
long_description.en: Oceanus is the eldest Titan, child of Uranus and Gaia and husband of Tethys. He is the god and personification of the freshwater river Oceanus, believed to encircle the earth and to be the source of all gods and living creatures, although in early mythology he was often viewed as an element rather than a god. The waters of springs, wells, and rivers came from him, and he is said to have regulated the heavenly bodies that rose from and set into his waters. Tethys was probably envisioned distributing his nourishing waters across the earth through underground aquifers.

long_description.id: Anak-anak Oceanus dan Tethys mencakup dewa-dewa sungai dan nimfa sumber air, antara lain Sungai Styx, Inachos raja Argos, serta para Oceanid seperti Eurynome, Electra, Metis, dan Theia; Homer menyebut tiga putri, yaitu Thetis, Eurynome, dan Perse. Ia dikatakan tinggal di tepi barat bumi dan tidak pernah meninggalkan rumahnya, bahkan untuk sidang para dewa. Dalam puisi Homerik ia tampil sebagai dewa perkasa yang tidak tunduk kepada siapa pun kecuali Zeus.
long_description.en: The children of Oceanus and Tethys include river gods and spring nymphs, among them the River Styx, Inachos the king of Argos, and Oceanids such as Eurynome, Electra, Metis, and Theia; Homer names three daughters, Thetis, Eurynome, and Perse. Tradition places his home on the western shores of the earth, and he never left it, even when the gods assembled. In the Homeric poems he is a mighty god, second only to Zeus.

long_description.id: Oceanus tidak ikut mengebiri Uranus dan tidak bertempur langsung dalam Titanomakhia, sehingga tidak dipenjara di Tartarus, meski ia mengirim putrinya Styx dan anak-anaknya ke pihak Zeus. Ia juga tampil dalam kisah Hercules, yang menakutinya dengan busur hingga ia menenangkan ombak, dan dalam Prometheus Bound, tempat ia bersimpati kepada Prometheus. Bersama Tethys ia menyucikan Glaucus dari sifat fananya.
long_description.en: Oceanus did not take part in the castration of Uranus and did not personally fight in the Titanomachy, so he was not imprisoned in Tartarus, though he sent his daughter Styx and her children to the side of Zeus. He also appears in the story of Hercules, who frightened him with a bow into calming the waves, and in Prometheus Bound, where he sympathises with Prometheus. With Tethys he cleansed Glaucus of his mortal characteristics.

long_description.id: Dalam seni Yunani Oceanus digambarkan dengan ekor ikan panjang, torso manusia, dan kepala bertanduk, memegang tongkat kerajaan, dengan ikan dan ular sebagai atribut; sungai Oceanus juga ditunjukkan di tepi perisai Achilles buatan Hephaestus. Pada era Helenistik ia dibayangkan ulang sebagai dewa samudra, dan dalam seni mozaik ia digambarkan sebagai dewa laut bertanduk capit kepiting. Sumber modern menyatakan belum ada bukti kultus khusus bagi Oceanus, tetapi ia memiliki satu himne Orfik, dan samudra dinamai dengan namanya.
long_description.en: In Greek art Oceanus appears with a human upper body, a horned head, and a long fish's tail, holding a sceptre, with a fish and serpent as attributes; the Oceanus river is also shown on the edges of Achilles' shield made by Hephaestus. In the Hellenistic era he was reimagined as a god of the oceans, and in mosaic art he appears as a sea-god with crab-claw horns. A modern source reports no evidence of a dedicated Oceanus cult, but he has an Orphic Hymn, and the ocean is named after him.

cultural_context.id: Pemujaan dewa-dewa sungai bersifat lokal, dan tidak ada bukti kultus khusus bagi Oceanus; ia tampil dalam Himne-himne Orfik sebagai pencipta manusia fana dan para dewa.
cultural_context.en: Worship of river gods was local, and there is no evidence of a dedicated cult of Oceanus; he is featured in the Orphic Hymns as creator of mortal men and gods.

note.en: Tethys is Oceanus's sister and spouse.

note.id: Styx disebut sebagai putri Oceanus.

note.id: Para Oceanid adalah nimfa sumber air, anak Oceanus dan Tethys.
note.en: The Oceanids are nymphs of springs and fountains, children of Oceanus and Tethys.

note.id: Para Potamoi adalah dewa sungai, anak Okeanos dan Tethys.
note.en: The Potamoi are river gods, children of Okeanos and Tethys.

note.id: Cronus termasuk saudara Oceanus.

note.id: Rhea termasuk saudari Oceanus.

note.en: Prometheus is brother and son-in-law to Oceanus in Prometheus Bound.

note.en: Oceanus raised waves to stop Hercules, who frightened him with his bow.

claims.quote: Oceanus (also Okeanos) was the eldest of the Titans and a son of Uranus (Heaven) and Gaia (Earth) in Greek mythology.

statement.id: Oceanus adalah Titan tertua dan anak Uranus serta Gaia dalam mitologi Yunani.
statement.en: Oceanus is the eldest Titan and a child of Uranus and Gaia in Greek myth.

claims.quote: He was the god and personification of the freshwater river Oceanus, which was thought to encircle the earth

statement.id: Oceanus adalah dewa sekaligus personifikasi sungai air tawar yang dipercaya mengelilingi bumi.
statement.en: Oceanus is god and personification of a freshwater river believed to encircle the earth.

claims.quote: Oceanus was married to his sister, Tethys, and they had 3,000 sons together (the rivers of the earth) and 3,000 daughters (the nymphs of land and water).

statement.id: Oceanus menikah dengan Tethys; keturunan mereka dilukiskan sebagai tiga ribu sungai dan tiga ribu nimfa.
statement.en: Oceanus married Tethys, and their children were described as three thousand rivers and three thousand nymphs.

claims.quote: The ancient Greeks believed that the great freshwater river Oceanus surrounded the world.

statement.id: Orang Yunani kuno percaya sungai air tawar Oceanus mengelilingi dunia.
statement.en: Ancient Greeks believed the freshwater Oceanus river surrounded the world.

claims.quote: All the waters that flow from fountains, springs, wells, and rivers came from the mighty Oceanus.

statement.id: Mata air, sumur, dan sungai dipercaya memperoleh air dari Oceanus.
statement.en: Springs, wells, and rivers were believed to draw their water from Oceanus.

claims.quote: Oceanus did not personally get involved in the Titanomachy – the conflict between the Titans and the Olympian gods

statement.id: Oceanus tidak bertempur langsung dalam Titanomakhia.
statement.en: Oceanus did not personally fight in the Titanomachy.

claims.quote: Oceanus sent his daughter Styx and her children to fight on Zeus' side during the revolt.

statement.id: Oceanus mengirim putrinya Styx dan anak-anaknya membantu Zeus.
statement.en: Oceanus sent his daughter Styx and her children to aid Zeus.

claims.quote: Oceanus is depicted in Greek art with a long fishtail, a man's torso, and a horned head

statement.id: Seni Yunani menggambarkan Oceanus dengan ekor ikan, tubuh manusia, dan kepala bertanduk.
statement.en: Greek art depicts Oceanus with a fish tail, human torso, and horned head.

claims.quote: there is no evidence that Oceanus ever had a cult or specific cult worship dedicated to him.

statement.id: Artikel ini menyatakan tidak ada bukti kultus khusus bagi Oceanus.
statement.en: The article states there is no evidence of a specific cult dedicated to Oceanus.

claims.quote: OKEANOS (Oceanus) was the primordial Titan god of the great, earth-encircling River Okeanos

statement.id: Theoi menyebut Oceanus dewa Titan purba bagi sungai yang mengelilingi bumi.
statement.en: Theoi calls Oceanus the primordial Titan god of the earth-encircling river.

claims.quote: Their children were the Potamoi, gods of rivers, and the Okeanides (Oceanids), nymphs of springs and fountains.

statement.id: Anak-anak Oceanus dan Tethys mencakup dewa sungai Potamoi serta nimfa Okeanides.
statement.en: The children of Oceanus and Tethys include the river gods Potamoi and the nymphs Okeanides.

claims.quote: Okeanos was depicted in ancient Greek vase painting as a bull-horned god with the tail of a serpentine fish

statement.id: Lukisan vas menampilkan Oceanus bertanduk banteng dan berekor ikan menyerupai ular.
statement.en: Vase painting depicts Oceanus with bull horns and a serpentine fish tail.

claims.quote: The ancient Greeks believed that there was a great, wide, flowing stream that surrounded the earth. They called the stream Ocean.

statement.id: The Met juga mencatat kepercayaan Yunani tentang arus besar Ocean yang mengelilingi bumi.
statement.en: The Met also notes the Greek belief in a great encircling stream called Ocean.

claims.quote: font of all of the earth's fresh-water - rivers, wells, springs and rain-clouds. He was also the god who regulated the heavenly bodies which rose from and set into his waters.

statement.id: Okeanos adalah sumber seluruh air tawar bumi (sungai, sumur, mata air, dan awan hujan) dan dewa yang mengatur benda-benda langit yang terbit dari dan terbenam ke perairannya.
statement.en: Okeanos was the font of all the earth's fresh water (rivers, wells, springs, and rain-clouds) and the god who regulated the heavenly bodies that rose from and set into his waters.

claims.quote: Unlike his Titan-brothers Okeanos did not participate in the castration of their father Ouranos nor join the war against Zeus and the Olympian gods.

statement.id: Berbeda dari saudara-saudara Titannya, Okeanos tidak ikut mengebiri ayah mereka, Ouranos, dan tidak bergabung dalam perang melawan Zeus dan para dewa Olimpus.
statement.en: Unlike his Titan brothers, Okeanos did not take part in the castration of their father Ouranos nor join the war against Zeus and the Olympian gods.

claims.quote: Okeanos was probably identical to Ophion, an elder Titan in the Orphic myths who ruled heaven briefly before being wrestled and cast into the Ocean stream by Kronos (Cronus).

statement.id: Okeanos mungkin identik dengan Ophion, Titan yang lebih tua dalam mitos Orfik yang sebentar memerintah langit sebelum dikalahkan dan dilempar ke aliran Ocean oleh Kronos.
statement.en: Okeanos was probably identical to Ophion, an elder Titan in the Orphic myths who ruled heaven briefly before being wrestled and cast into the Ocean stream by Kronos.

claims.quote: His usual attributes were a fish and serpent.

statement.id: Atribut yang lazim bagi Okeanos adalah ikan dan ular.
statement.en: His usual attributes were a fish and serpent.

claims.quote: In the Hellenistic era, Okeanos was reimagined as the god of the then increasingly accessible Atlantic and Indian Oceans, and the old cosmological idea of a great, earth-encircling, fresh-water stream was discarded.

statement.id: Pada era Helenistik, Okeanos dibayangkan ulang sebagai dewa Samudra Atlantik dan Hindia yang makin mudah dijangkau, dan gagasan kosmologis lama tentang aliran air tawar yang mengelilingi bumi ditinggalkan.
statement.en: In the Hellenistic era Okeanos was reimagined as the god of the increasingly accessible Atlantic and Indian Oceans, and the old cosmological idea of an earth-encircling fresh-water stream was discarded.

claims.quote: In mosaic art he is therefore usually depicted as a sea-god or the sea itself personified, with crab-claw horns, and for attributes, a serpent, oar and school of fish.

statement.id: Dalam seni mozaik ia biasanya digambarkan sebagai dewa laut atau laut yang dipersonifikasikan, bertanduk capit kepiting, dengan atribut ular, dayung, dan kawanan ikan.
statement.en: In mosaic art he is usually depicted as a sea-god or the sea itself personified, with crab-claw horns and, as attributes, a serpent, oar, and school of fish.

claims.quote: Okeanos' wife Tethys "the Nurse" was probably envisioned distributing his nourishing waters across the earth through subterranean acquifers.

statement.id: Istri Okeanos, Tethys "Sang Pengasuh", mungkin dibayangkan membagikan air penghidupannya ke seluruh bumi melalui akuifer bawah tanah.
statement.en: Okeanos' wife Tethys "the Nurse" was probably envisioned distributing his nourishing waters across the earth through subterranean aquifers.

claims.quote: In the Homeric poems he appears as a mighty god, who yields to none save Zeus.

statement.id: Dalam puisi Homerik, Okeanos tampil sebagai dewa perkasa yang tidak tunduk kepada siapa pun kecuali Zeus.
statement.en: In the Homeric poems he appears as a mighty god who yields to none save Zeus.

claims.quote: Homer does not mention his parentage, but calls Tethys his wife, by whom he had three daughters, Thetis, Eurynome and Perse.

statement.id: Homer tidak menyebut orang tuanya, tetapi menyebut Tethys istrinya dan mereka memiliki tiga putri: Thetis, Eurynome, dan Perse.
statement.en: Homer does not mention his parentage but calls Tethys his wife, by whom he had three daughters, Thetis, Eurynome, and Perse.

claims.quote: [1.2] AITHER (or OURANOS) & GAIA (Hyginus Preface)

statement.id: Menurut Hyginus (Preface), orang tua Oceanus adalah Aither (atau Ouranos) dan Gaia.
statement.en: In Hyginus (Preface), Oceanus's parents are Aither (or Ouranos) and Gaia.

claims.quote: He was said to dwell on the western shores of the earth and never left his home, not even to attend the assemblies of the gods.

statement.id: Oceanus dikatakan tinggal di tepi barat bumi dan tidak pernah meninggalkan rumahnya, bahkan untuk menghadiri sidang para dewa.
statement.en: Oceanus was said to dwell on the western shores of the earth and never left his home, not even to attend the assemblies of the gods.

claims.quote: which was thought to encircle the earth and was said to be the source of all living gods and creatures. However, in early mythology, Oceanus was often viewed as an element rather than a god.

statement.id: Sungai Oceanus dianggap mengelilingi bumi dan dikatakan sumber semua dewa dan makhluk hidup; namun dalam mitologi awal Oceanus sering dipandang sebagai unsur, bukan dewa.
statement.en: The river Oceanus was thought to encircle the earth and was said to be the source of all living gods and creatures; in early mythology, however, Oceanus was often viewed as an element rather than a god.

claims.quote: so he did not share their dreadful fate of being imprisoned in Tartarus (the deepest part of the underworld). As a reward, Oceanus was allowed to rule over Oceanus in undisturbed peace.

statement.id: Karena tidak ikut bertempur, Oceanus tidak mengalami nasib buruk dipenjara di Tartarus; sebagai ganjaran ia dibiarkan memerintah Oceanus dengan damai.
statement.en: Because he did not fight, Oceanus did not share the dreadful fate of imprisonment in Tartarus; as a reward he was allowed to rule over Oceanus in undisturbed peace.

claims.quote: In an attempt to stop Hercules from reaching his grandson, Oceanus caused great waves to overcome the golden vessel that Hercules clung to. Hercules drew his bow and frightened Oceanus into calming the waters so he could reach Erytheia safely.

statement.id: Untuk menghentikan Hercules mencapai cucunya, Oceanus menimbulkan ombak besar yang menimpa kapal emas tempat Hercules berpegangan; Hercules menarik busurnya dan menakuti Oceanus hingga menenangkan air sehingga ia tiba dengan selamat di Erytheia.
statement.en: To stop Hercules from reaching his grandson, Oceanus caused great waves to overcome the golden vessel Hercules clung to; Hercules drew his bow and frightened Oceanus into calming the waters so he could reach Erytheia safely.

claims.quote: In Prometheus Bound, Prometheus, the Titan god of fire and brother and son-in-law to Oceanus, lies chained to a rock as punishment from Zeus after Prometheus gave fire to humankind

statement.id: Dalam Prometheus Bound, Prometheus, Titan api dan saudara sekaligus menantu Oceanus, terbelenggu pada batu sebagai hukuman Zeus setelah memberi api kepada manusia.
statement.en: In Prometheus Bound, Prometheus, Titan god of fire and brother and son-in-law to Oceanus, lies chained to a rock as Zeus's punishment after giving fire to humankind.

claims.quote: Oceanus travels to where Prometheus lies in chains and sympathised with his plight, telling him that even beyond their blood relation, there is nobody he is more fond of.

statement.id: Oceanus mendatangi Prometheus yang terbelenggu dan bersimpati pada nasibnya, mengatakan bahwa di luar hubungan darah pun tak ada yang lebih ia sayangi.
statement.en: Oceanus travels to where Prometheus lies in chains and sympathises with his plight, saying that even beyond their blood relation there is nobody he is more fond of.

claims.quote: The chorus is sung by Oceanus' many children who step onto the stage to welcome their father, who enters on a giant bird, most likely a griffin.

statement.id: Paduan suara dinyanyikan banyak anak Oceanus yang menyambut ayah mereka, yang masuk ke panggung dengan menunggang burung raksasa, kemungkinan griffin.
statement.en: The chorus is sung by Oceanus' many children, who welcome their father as he enters on a giant bird, most likely a griffin.

claims.quote: Glaucus was a fisherman who was transformed into a sea god. ... with Oceanus and Tethys purging him of all his mortal characteristics and performing a ritual cleansing.

statement.id: Oceanus dan Tethys membersihkan Glaucus dari seluruh sifat fananya dan melakukan ritual penyucian.
statement.en: Oceanus and Tethys purged Glaucus of all his mortal characteristics and performed a ritual cleansing.

claims.quote: As described in the Iliad, Oceanus is featured on Achilles' shield, which Hephaestus, the god of metallurgy, made. The Oceanus river was shown on the shield's edges, surrounding all the other images depicted on the shield.

statement.id: Seperti dalam Iliad, Oceanus tampil pada perisai Achilles buatan Hephaestus; sungai Oceanus ditunjukkan di tepi perisai, mengelilingi semua gambar lainnya.
statement.en: As described in the Iliad, Oceanus is featured on Achilles' shield, made by Hephaestus; the Oceanus river is shown on the shield's edges, surrounding all the other images.

claims.quote: He holds a sceptre to represent his power and rides on a sea creature alone or by the side of his wife, Tethys.

statement.id: Dalam seni Yunani ia memegang tongkat kerajaan sebagai lambang kekuasaan dan menunggang makhluk laut, sendiri atau di samping istrinya, Tethys.
statement.en: In art he holds a sceptre to represent his power and rides a sea creature alone or beside his wife Tethys.

claims.quote: He is, however, featured in The Orphic Hymns and has an Orphic Hymn dedicated to him. In the hymn, he is mentioned as being the creator of mortal men and gods.

statement.id: Oceanus tampil dalam Himne-himne Orfik dan memiliki satu himne khusus; dalam himne itu ia disebut pencipta manusia fana dan para dewa.
statement.en: Oceanus is featured in The Orphic Hymns and has an Orphic Hymn dedicated to him, in which he is called the creator of mortal men and gods.

claims.quote: Oceanus was given the ultimate honour of having the largest body of saltwater that encircles the earth named after him

statement.id: Oceanus mendapat kehormatan tertinggi: badan air asin terbesar yang mengelilingi bumi dinamai dengan namanya.
statement.en: Oceanus was given the ultimate honour of having the largest body of saltwater that encircles the earth named after him.

claims.quote: On the far side of Oceanus lay strange, mysterious places like the Garden of the Hesperides and the island of Erytheia.

statement.id: Di seberang Oceanus terletak tempat-tempat aneh dan misterius seperti Taman Hesperides dan pulau Erytheia.
statement.en: On the far side of Oceanus lay strange, mysterious places like the Garden of the Hesperides and the island of Erytheia.

claims.quote: Their most well-known children were the River Styx (the barrier between earth and the underworld), Inachos, the king of Argos, and the Oceanids Eurynome, Electra, Metis (Zeus' first notable wife), and Theia.

statement.id: Anak-anak mereka yang paling terkenal adalah Sungai Styx, Inachos raja Argos, dan para Oceanid Eurynome, Electra, Metis, dan Theia.
statement.en: Their best-known children were the River Styx, Inachos the king of Argos, and the Oceanids Eurynome, Electra, Metis, and Theia.

claims.quote: His siblings include Cronus, Hyperion, Mnemosyne, Rhea, Tethys, and Themis.

statement.id: Saudara-saudaranya antara lain Cronus, Hyperion, Mnemosyne, Rhea, Tethys, dan Themis.
statement.en: His siblings include Cronus, Hyperion, Mnemosyne, Rhea, Tethys, and Themis.

claims.quote: Helios, the sun god, lived in the east, near the banks of Oceanus.

statement.id: Helios, dewa matahari, tinggal di timur dekat tepi Oceanus.
statement.en: Helios, the sun god, lived in the east, near the banks of Oceanus.

short_description.id: Helios adalah dewa matahari Yunani yang mengendarai kereta emas melintasi langit setiap hari.
short_description.en: Helios is the Greek sun god who drives a golden chariot across the sky each day.

long_description.id:
Helios adalah dewa matahari Yunani, anak Hyperion dan Theia serta saudara Selene dan Eos. Ia dikisahkan membawa matahari dari timur ke barat dengan kereta emas yang ditarik empat kuda bersayap, dan juga disebut penjaga sumpah serta dewa penglihatan. Ia tinggal di istana emas di Sungai Okeanos di ujung bumi, lalu menyeberang kembali ke tempat terbitnya dengan cawan emas atau, menurut penyair kemudian, perahu emas buatan Hephaestus.

Ia digambarkan sebagai pria tampan, biasanya tak berjanggut, berjubah ungu dan bermahkota lingkar cahaya matahari; dalam seni Yunani dan Romawi ia biasanya pemuda bermahkota sinar matahari. Helios diidentifikasi dengan dewa api dan cahaya lain seperti Hephaistos dan Phoibos Apollon, dan kaitan Apollo dengan Matahari makin kuat sejak periode Helenistik. Ia disebut mengetahui segalanya: ia membongkar kepada Hephaestus ketidaksetiaan Aphrodite dan memberi tahu Demeter tentang penculikan putrinya, tetapi tidak tahu bahwa kawan-kawan Odysseus mencuri sapinya sampai diberi tahu oleh Lampetia.

Putranya, Phaethon, mencoba mengendarai kereta matahari, tetapi gagal menguasai kuda-kudanya, membakar bumi, dan disambar petir Zeus. Sapi keramat Helios di Thrinacia pernah dicuri raksasa Alkyoneus dan dibalas Hercules; kemudian kawan-kawan Odysseus memakan sebagian kawanannya, sehingga Helios meminta bantuan Zeus yang menghancurkan kapal dan menenggelamkan awaknya. Ketika Hercules mengancam menembaknya karena terik matahari, Helios justru menghadiahinya mangkuk emas. Helios juga memiliki anak dari Perseis, yaitu Circe dan Aietes.

Pemujaan Helios tidak meluas, tetapi di Yunani tempat pemujaan yang penting adalah Rhodes, tempat pertandingan Halieia diadakan setiap lima tahun dan setiap tahun sebuah kereta dengan empat kuda dilemparkan ke laut sebagai persembahan. Persembahan kepadanya berupa domba jantan putih, babi hutan, banteng, kambing, anak domba, terutama kuda putih, dan madu, dan ayam jantan keramat baginya. Dalam konteks Romawi ia juga dikenal sebagai Sol. Sebuah vas Yunani di sebuah museum menuliskan namanya dalam huruf Yunani kuno, dan panduan museum itu menyebut arus Ocean yang diyakini mengelilingi bumi.
long_description.en:
Helios is the Greek sun god, child of Hyperion and Theia and brother of Selene and Eos. He is said to carry the sun east to west in a golden chariot drawn by four winged horses, and is also called a guardian of oaths and god of sight. His golden palace stood in the River Okeanos at the earth's far ends, and he returned to his rising place in a golden cup or, according to later poets, a golden boat made by Hephaestus.

He was depicted as a handsome, usually beardless man in purple robes, crowned with the shining aureole of the sun; in Greek and Roman art he is usually a youth wearing a crown of sun rays. Helios was identified with other gods of fire and light such as Hephaistos and Phoibos Apollon, and the link between Apollo and the Sun grew stronger from the Hellenistic period. He is said to know everything: he betrayed Aphrodite's faithlessness to Hephaestus and told Demeter of the carrying off of her daughter, yet was unaware that the companions of Odysseus robbed his oxen until Lampetia informed him.

His son Phaethon tried to drive the sun chariot but could not control its horses, set the earth ablaze, and was struck down by Zeus's thunderbolt. The sacred cattle of Helios on Thrinacia were once stolen by the giant Alkyoneus and avenged by Hercules; later the comrades of Odysseus ate part of his flock, so Helios enlisted Zeus, who destroyed the ship and drowned the crew. When Hercules threatened to shoot him because of the burning sun, Helios instead rewarded him with a golden bowl. Helios also had children by Perseis, Circe and Aietes.

Worship of Helios was not widespread, but the one important place in Greece was Rhodes, where the Halieia games were held every five years and each year a chariot and four horses were thrown into the sea as an offering. Sacrificial victims included white rams, boars, bulls, goats, and lambs, with white horses singled out, and honey was offered too; the cock was sacred to him. In Roman contexts he was also known as Sol. A Greek vase in a museum bears his name in ancient Greek letters, and the museum guide describes the stream Ocean, believed to encircle the earth.

who.id: Helios adalah dewa matahari dalam mitologi Yunani.
who.en: Helios is the god of the Sun in Greek mythology.

origin.id: Helios adalah anak Titan Hyperion dan Theia.
origin.en: Helios is the offspring of the titans Hyperion and Theia.

role.id: Helios mengendarai kereta emas yang membawa Matahari melintasi langit setiap hari.
role.en: Helios rode a golden chariot that brought the Sun across the skies each day.

famous_for.id: Helios terkenal sebagai subjek Colossus of Rhodes dan sebagai ayah Phaethon.
famous_for.en: Helios is famous as the subject of the Colossus of Rhodes and as the father of Phaethon.

did_you_know.id: Hercules pernah mengancam menembak Helios karena terik matahari, tetapi Helios justru menghadiahinya mangkuk emas untuk berlayar lebih nyaman.
did_you_know.en: Hercules once threatened to shoot Helios over the burning sun, but Helios instead gave him a golden bowl to sail more comfortably.

cultural_context.id: Pemujaan Helios tidak meluas di Yunani; menurut Plato banyak orang, termasuk Socrates, menyambut Matahari dan berdoa setiap hari, sedangkan di Rhodes ia dipuja dengan pertandingan dan persembahan kereta.
cultural_context.en: Worship of Helios was not widespread in Greece; according to Plato many people, including Socrates, greeted the Sun and prayed daily, while on Rhodes he was honored with games and the offering of a chariot.

description.id: Helios membawa matahari melintasi langit dengan kereta emas yang ditarik empat kuda bersayap.
description.en: Helios carries the sun across the sky in a golden chariot drawn by four winged horses.

description.id: Helios digambarkan sebagai dewa yang melihat dan mendengar segalanya, sehingga dapat membongkar ketidaksetiaan Aphrodite kepada Hephaestus dan penculikan putri Demeter.
description.en: Helios is described as the god who sees and hears everything, so he could reveal Aphrodite's faithlessness to Hephaestus and the carrying off of Demeter's daughter.

name.en: Guardian of oaths and god of sight

description.id: Helios disebut dewa Titan matahari, penjaga sumpah, dan dewa penglihatan.
description.en: Helios is called the Titan god of the sun, a guardian of oaths, and the god of sight.

description.id: Atas perlakuan terhadap ternaknya, Helios meminta bantuan Zeus yang menghancurkan kapal dan menenggelamkan awak Odysseus.
description.en: For the treatment of his flock, Helios enlisted Zeus, who destroyed the ship and drowned the crew of Odysseus.

name.en: Unaware of the theft of his oxen

description.id: Walaupun digambarkan melihat dan mendengar segalanya, Helios tidak tahu kawan-kawan Odysseus mencuri sapinya sampai diberi tahu oleh Lampetia.
description.en: Although described as seeing and hearing everything, Helios was unaware that Odysseus' companions had robbed his oxen until Lampetia informed him.

description.id: Dalam konteks Romawi Helios juga dikenal sebagai Sol dan menjadi dewa kultus penting; Circus Maximus memiliki kuil untuk Sol dan Luna sejak abad ke-3 SM.
description.en: In Roman contexts Helios was also known as Sol and became an important cult god; the Circus Maximus had a temple dedicated to Sol and Luna from the 3rd century BCE.

summary.id: Phaethon, putra Helios, mencoba mengendarai kereta matahari; ia tak mampu mengendalikan kuda-kuda itu dan Zeus menjatuhkannya dengan petir agar seluruh dunia tidak terbakar.
summary.en: Phaethon, son of Helios, tried to drive the sun chariot; he could not control the horses and Zeus struck him down with a thunderbolt lest the whole world burn.

summary.en: Helios's sacred cattle on Thrinacia were stolen by Alkyoneus and avenged by Hercules; later Odysseus' comrades ate part of the flock, so Helios asked Zeus to destroy their ship.

summary.id: Hercules mengancam menembak Helios; Helios tidak menghukumnya, melainkan memberinya mangkuk emas untuk berlayar lebih nyaman.
summary.en: Hercules threatened to shoot Helios; Helios did not punish him but gave him a golden bowl to sail more comfortably.

summary.en: The Sun god shines on Aphrodite and Ares, revealing to Hephaistos his wife's affair.

short_description.id: Helios adalah dewa matahari Yunani yang mengendarai kereta emas melintasi langit setiap hari.
short_description.en: Helios is the Greek sun god who drives a golden chariot across the sky each day.

long_description.id: Helios adalah dewa matahari Yunani, anak Hyperion dan Theia serta saudara Selene dan Eos. Ia dikisahkan membawa matahari dari timur ke barat dengan kereta emas yang ditarik empat kuda bersayap, dan juga disebut penjaga sumpah serta dewa penglihatan. Ia tinggal di istana emas di Sungai Okeanos di ujung bumi, lalu menyeberang kembali ke tempat terbitnya dengan cawan emas atau, menurut penyair kemudian, perahu emas buatan Hephaestus.
long_description.en: Helios is the Greek sun god, child of Hyperion and Theia and brother of Selene and Eos. He is said to carry the sun east to west in a golden chariot drawn by four winged horses, and is also called a guardian of oaths and god of sight. His golden palace stood in the River Okeanos at the earth's far ends, and he returned to his rising place in a golden cup or, according to later poets, a golden boat made by Hephaestus.

long_description.id: Ia digambarkan sebagai pria tampan, biasanya tak berjanggut, berjubah ungu dan bermahkota lingkar cahaya matahari; dalam seni Yunani dan Romawi ia biasanya pemuda bermahkota sinar matahari. Helios diidentifikasi dengan dewa api dan cahaya lain seperti Hephaistos dan Phoibos Apollon, dan kaitan Apollo dengan Matahari makin kuat sejak periode Helenistik. Ia disebut mengetahui segalanya: ia membongkar kepada Hephaestus ketidaksetiaan Aphrodite dan memberi tahu Demeter tentang penculikan putrinya, tetapi tidak tahu bahwa kawan-kawan Odysseus mencuri sapinya sampai diberi tahu oleh Lampetia.
long_description.en: He was depicted as a handsome, usually beardless man in purple robes, crowned with the shining aureole of the sun; in Greek and Roman art he is usually a youth wearing a crown of sun rays. Helios was identified with other gods of fire and light such as Hephaistos and Phoibos Apollon, and the link between Apollo and the Sun grew stronger from the Hellenistic period. He is said to know everything: he betrayed Aphrodite's faithlessness to Hephaestus and told Demeter of the carrying off of her daughter, yet was unaware that the companions of Odysseus robbed his oxen until Lampetia informed him.

long_description.id: Putranya, Phaethon, mencoba mengendarai kereta matahari, tetapi gagal menguasai kuda-kudanya, membakar bumi, dan disambar petir Zeus. Sapi keramat Helios di Thrinacia pernah dicuri raksasa Alkyoneus dan dibalas Hercules; kemudian kawan-kawan Odysseus memakan sebagian kawanannya, sehingga Helios meminta bantuan Zeus yang menghancurkan kapal dan menenggelamkan awaknya. Ketika Hercules mengancam menembaknya karena terik matahari, Helios justru menghadiahinya mangkuk emas. Helios juga memiliki anak dari Perseis, yaitu Circe dan Aietes.
long_description.en: His son Phaethon tried to drive the sun chariot but could not control its horses, set the earth ablaze, and was struck down by Zeus's thunderbolt. The sacred cattle of Helios on Thrinacia were once stolen by the giant Alkyoneus and avenged by Hercules; later the comrades of Odysseus ate part of his flock, so Helios enlisted Zeus, who destroyed the ship and drowned the crew. When Hercules threatened to shoot him because of the burning sun, Helios instead rewarded him with a golden bowl. Helios also had children by Perseis, Circe and Aietes.

long_description.id: Pemujaan Helios tidak meluas, tetapi di Yunani tempat pemujaan yang penting adalah Rhodes, tempat pertandingan Halieia diadakan setiap lima tahun dan setiap tahun sebuah kereta dengan empat kuda dilemparkan ke laut sebagai persembahan. Persembahan kepadanya berupa domba jantan putih, babi hutan, banteng, kambing, anak domba, terutama kuda putih, dan madu, dan ayam jantan keramat baginya. Dalam konteks Romawi ia juga dikenal sebagai Sol. Sebuah vas Yunani di sebuah museum menuliskan namanya dalam huruf Yunani kuno, dan panduan museum itu menyebut arus Ocean yang diyakini mengelilingi bumi.
long_description.en: Worship of Helios was not widespread, but the one important place in Greece was Rhodes, where the Halieia games were held every five years and each year a chariot and four horses were thrown into the sea as an offering. Sacrificial victims included white rams, boars, bulls, goats, and lambs, with white horses singled out, and honey was offered too; the cock was sacred to him. In Roman contexts he was also known as Sol. A Greek vase in a museum bears his name in ancient Greek letters, and the museum guide describes the stream Ocean, believed to encircle the earth.

cultural_context.id: Pemujaan Helios tidak meluas di Yunani; menurut Plato banyak orang, termasuk Socrates, menyambut Matahari dan berdoa setiap hari, sedangkan di Rhodes ia dipuja dengan pertandingan dan persembahan kereta.
cultural_context.en: Worship of Helios was not widespread in Greece; according to Plato many people, including Socrates, greeted the Sun and prayed daily, while on Rhodes he was honored with games and the offering of a chariot.

who.id: Helios adalah dewa matahari dalam mitologi Yunani.
who.en: Helios is the god of the Sun in Greek mythology.

origin.id: Helios adalah anak Titan Hyperion dan Theia.
origin.en: Helios is the offspring of the titans Hyperion and Theia.

role.id: Helios mengendarai kereta emas yang membawa Matahari melintasi langit setiap hari.
role.en: Helios rode a golden chariot that brought the Sun across the skies each day.

famous_for.id: Helios terkenal sebagai subjek Colossus of Rhodes dan sebagai ayah Phaethon.
famous_for.en: Helios is famous as the subject of the Colossus of Rhodes and as the father of Phaethon.

did_you_know.id: Hercules pernah mengancam menembak Helios karena terik matahari, tetapi Helios justru menghadiahinya mangkuk emas untuk berlayar lebih nyaman.
did_you_know.en: Hercules once threatened to shoot Helios over the burning sun, but Helios instead gave him a golden bowl to sail more comfortably.

description.id: Helios membawa matahari melintasi langit dengan kereta emas yang ditarik empat kuda bersayap.
description.en: Helios carries the sun across the sky in a golden chariot drawn by four winged horses.

description.id: Helios digambarkan sebagai dewa yang melihat dan mendengar segalanya, sehingga dapat membongkar ketidaksetiaan Aphrodite kepada Hephaestus dan penculikan putri Demeter.
description.en: Helios is described as the god who sees and hears everything, so he could reveal Aphrodite's faithlessness to Hephaestus and the carrying off of Demeter's daughter.

name.en: Guardian of oaths and god of sight

description.id: Helios disebut dewa Titan matahari, penjaga sumpah, dan dewa penglihatan.
description.en: Helios is called the Titan god of the sun, a guardian of oaths, and the god of sight.

description.id: Atas perlakuan terhadap ternaknya, Helios meminta bantuan Zeus yang menghancurkan kapal dan menenggelamkan awak Odysseus.
description.en: For the treatment of his flock, Helios enlisted Zeus, who destroyed the ship and drowned the crew of Odysseus.

name.en: Unaware of the theft of his oxen

description.id: Walaupun digambarkan melihat dan mendengar segalanya, Helios tidak tahu kawan-kawan Odysseus mencuri sapinya sampai diberi tahu oleh Lampetia.
description.en: Although described as seeing and hearing everything, Helios was unaware that Odysseus' companions had robbed his oxen until Lampetia informed him.

description.id: Dalam konteks Romawi Helios juga dikenal sebagai Sol dan menjadi dewa kultus penting; Circus Maximus memiliki kuil untuk Sol dan Luna sejak abad ke-3 SM.
description.en: In Roman contexts Helios was also known as Sol and became an important cult god; the Circus Maximus had a temple dedicated to Sol and Luna from the 3rd century BCE.

summary.id: Phaethon, putra Helios, mencoba mengendarai kereta matahari; ia tak mampu mengendalikan kuda-kuda itu dan Zeus menjatuhkannya dengan petir agar seluruh dunia tidak terbakar.
summary.en: Phaethon, son of Helios, tried to drive the sun chariot; he could not control the horses and Zeus struck him down with a thunderbolt lest the whole world burn.

role.en: Owner of the sacred cattle who takes revenge

summary.id: Sapi keramat Helios di Thrinacia dicuri Alkyoneus dan dibalas Hercules; kemudian kawan-kawan Odysseus memakan sebagian kawanannya, sehingga Helios meminta Zeus menghancurkan kapal mereka.
summary.en: Helios's sacred cattle on Thrinacia were stolen by Alkyoneus and avenged by Hercules; later Odysseus' comrades ate part of the flock, so Helios asked Zeus to destroy their ship.

summary.id: Hercules mengancam menembak Helios; Helios tidak menghukumnya, melainkan memberinya mangkuk emas untuk berlayar lebih nyaman.
summary.en: Hercules threatened to shoot Helios; Helios did not punish him but gave him a golden bowl to sail more comfortably.

summary.id: Dewa Matahari menyinari Aphrodite dan Ares sehingga Hephaistos tahu perselingkuhan istrinya.
summary.en: The Sun god shines on Aphrodite and Ares, revealing to Hephaistos his wife's affair.

description.id: Satu-satunya tempat di Yunani tempat pemujaan Helios penting; ia pelindung pulau itu dan tempat pertandingan Halieia diadakan.
description.en: The one place in Greece where worship of Helios was important; he was the patron of the island, which held the Halieia games.

description.id: Patung perunggu raksasa Helios, dianggap salah satu Tujuh Keajaiban Dunia Kuno.
description.en: The giant bronze statue of Helios, considered one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World.

description.id: Pulau keramat Helios tempat kawanan sapi dan dombanya dirawat putri-putrinya.
description.en: Island sacred to Helios where his flocks were tended by his daughters.

name.en: Golden palace in the River Okeanos

description.id: Tempat tinggal Helios di ujung bumi, tempat ia muncul setiap fajar.
description.en: Helios's dwelling at the far ends of the earth, from which he emerged each dawn.

description.id: Di Roma, memiliki kuil untuk Sol dan Luna sejak abad ke-3 SM.
description.en: In Rome, had a temple dedicated to Sol and Luna from the 3rd century BCE.

description.id: Apollo dikaitkan dengan Matahari sejak abad ke-5 SM, dan kaitan itu makin kuat sejak periode Helenistik.
description.en: Apollo was linked with the Sun from the 5th century BCE, and the association grew stronger from the Hellenistic period.

title.id: Kuil Sol dan Luna di Circus Maximus
title.en: Temple of Sol and Luna at the Circus Maximus

description.id: Circus Maximus di Roma memiliki kuil untuk Sol dan Luna sejak abad ke-3 SM.
description.en: Rome's Circus Maximus had a temple dedicated to Sol and Luna from the 3rd century BCE.

description.id: Colossus dibangun antara 304 dan 280 SM dan roboh oleh gempa pada 228 atau 226 SM.
description.en: The Colossus was built between 304 and 280 BCE and toppled by an earthquake in either 228 or 226 BCE.

note.id: Hyperion adalah ayah Helios.
note.en: Hyperion is Helios's father.

note.id: Theia adalah ibu Helios; sumber lain menyebut ibu yang berbeda.
note.en: Theia is Helios's mother in the main account; other sources name different mothers.

note.id: Selene adalah saudari Helios.
note.en: Selene is Helios's sister.

note.id: Eos adalah saudari Helios.
note.en: Eos is Helios's sister.

note.id: Phaethon adalah putra Helios.
note.en: Phaethon is Helios's son.

note.id: Circe adalah anak Helios dengan Perseis.
note.en: Circe is a child of Helios and Perseis.

note.id: Raja Aietes adalah anak Helios dengan Perseis.
note.en: King Aietes is a child of Helios and Perseis.

note.id: Apollodorus menambahkan Pasiphae sebagai anak Helios.
note.en: Apollodorus adds Pasiphae as a child of Helios.

note.id: Helios diidentifikasi dengan Phoibos Apollon, dan Apollo dikaitkan dengan Matahari sejak abad ke-5 SM.
note.en: Helios was identified with Phoibos Apollon, and Apollo was linked with the Sun from the 5th century BCE.

note.id: Helios diidentifikasi dengan Hephaistos, dan ia membongkar perselingkuhan istri Hephaistos.
note.en: Helios was identified with Hephaistos, and he revealed the affair of Hephaistos's wife.

note.id: Helios menghadiahi Hercules mangkuk emas, dan Hercules membalas pencurian sapi Helios oleh Alkyoneus.
note.en: Helios gave Hercules a golden bowl, and Hercules avenged the theft of Helios's cattle by Alkyoneus.

note.id: Dalam konteks Romawi Helios juga dikenal sebagai Sol.
note.en: In Roman contexts Helios was also known as Sol.

claims.quote: Helios (also Helius) was the god of the Sun in Greek mythology.

statement.id: Helios adalah dewa matahari dalam mitologi Yunani.
statement.en: Helios is the Greek sun god.

claims.quote: Helios rode a golden chariot which brought the Sun across the skies each day from the east (Ethiopia) to the west (Hesperides).

statement.id: Helios mengendarai kereta emas yang membawa matahari dari timur ke barat setiap hari.
statement.en: Helios drove a golden chariot bearing the sun from east to west each day.

claims.quote: In Greek mythology, Helios is the offspring of the titans Hyperion and Theia.

statement.id: Helios adalah anak pasangan Titan Hyperion dan Theia.
statement.en: Helios is the child of the Titans Hyperion and Theia.

claims.quote: His sisters were Selene (the Moon) and Eos (Dawn).

statement.id: Saudari Helios adalah Selene sang bulan dan Eos sang fajar.
statement.en: Helios's sisters are Selene the moon and Eos the dawn.

claims.quote: Helios is also the father of Phaethon, whose mother was Clymene.

statement.id: Phaethon adalah putra Helios dan Clymene.
statement.en: Phaethon is the son of Helios and Clymene.

claims.quote: Phaethon proved unable to control Helios' wild horses, and when he spun out of control, Zeus was obliged to strike down Phaethon with a thunderbolt lest he set the whole world on fire.

statement.id: Phaethon gagal mengendalikan kuda kereta Helios; Zeus menyambarnya dengan petir agar bumi tidak terbakar.
statement.en: Phaethon lost control of Helios's horses, and Zeus struck him with lightning to avert a worldwide fire.

claims.quote: In vengeance, Helios enlisted the help of Zeus who destroyed the ship and drowned Odysseus' crew for their impiety.

statement.id: Setelah ternaknya dimakan awak Odysseus, Helios meminta Zeus menghukum mereka.
statement.en: After Odysseus's crew ate his cattle, Helios asked Zeus to punish them.

claims.quote: The one place in Greece where the worship of Helios was important was on Rhodes.

statement.id: Pemujaan Helios sangat penting di Rhodes.
statement.en: The worship of Helios was important on Rhodes.

claims.quote: In honour of Helios, Panhellenic games, the Halieia, were held on the island every five years

statement.id: Pertandingan Halieia di Rhodes diselenggarakan untuk menghormati Helios.
statement.en: The Halieia games on Rhodes honored Helios.

claims.quote: The Romans went one step further and made Helios, also known as Sol, an important cult god.

statement.id: Dalam konteks Romawi, Helios dikenal pula sebagai Sol.
statement.en: In Roman contexts Helios was also known as Sol.

claims.quote: HELIOS (Helius) was the Titan god of the sun, a guardian of oaths, and the god of sight.

statement.id: Theoi menyebut Helios dewa matahari dari golongan Titan, penjaga sumpah, dan dewa penglihatan.
statement.en: Theoi describes Helios as a Titan sun god, guardian of oaths, and god of sight.

claims.quote: he emerged each dawn, crowned with the aureole of the sun, driving a chariot drawn by four winged steeds.

statement.id: Helios muncul setiap fajar dengan mahkota cahaya dan kereta empat kuda bersayap.
statement.en: Helios appears at dawn with a solar aureole and a chariot drawn by four winged horses.

claims.quote: We can tell who Helios is on this vase because the artist wrote his name above, in ancient Greek letters.

statement.id: Sebuah vas Yunani menamai sosok Helios dalam huruf Yunani kuno.
statement.en: A Greek vase identifies Helios by writing his name in ancient Greek letters.

claims.quote: The ancient Greeks believed that there was a great, wide, flowing stream that surrounded the earth. They called the stream Ocean.

statement.id: Orang Yunani kuno membayangkan arus besar bernama Ocean mengelilingi bumi.
statement.en: Ancient Greeks imagined a great stream called Ocean encircling the earth.

claims.quote: He dwelt in a golden palace in the River Okeanos (Oceanus) at the far ends of the earth from which he emerged each dawn

statement.id: Helios tinggal di istana emas di Sungai Okeanos di ujung bumi, tempat ia muncul setiap fajar.
statement.en: Helios dwelt in a golden palace in the River Okeanos (Oceanus) at the far ends of the earth, from which he emerged each dawn.

claims.quote: When he reached the the land of the Hesperides in the far West he descended into a golden cup which bore him through the northern streams of Okeanos back to his rising place in the East.

statement.id: Sesampainya di negeri Hesperides di barat jauh, Helios turun ke dalam cawan emas yang membawanya melalui aliran utara Okeanos kembali ke tempat terbitnya di timur.
statement.en: On reaching the land of the Hesperides in the far West, Helios descended into a golden cup that bore him through the northern streams of Okeanos back to his rising place in the East.

claims.quote: Once his son Phaethon tried to drive the chariot of the sun, but he lost control and set the earth ablaze. Zeus struck the boy down with a thunderbolt.

statement.id: Putranya, Phaethon, pernah mencoba mengendarai kereta matahari, tetapi kehilangan kendali dan membakar bumi; Zeus menjatuhkan anak itu dengan petir.
statement.en: His son Phaethon once tried to drive the chariot of the sun but lost control and set the earth ablaze; Zeus struck the boy down with a thunderbolt.

claims.quote: Helios was depicted as a handsome, usually beardless, man clothed in purple robes and crowned with the shining aureole of the sun.

statement.id: Helios digambarkan sebagai pria tampan, biasanya tak berjanggut, berjubah ungu dan bermahkota lingkar cahaya matahari.
statement.en: Helios was depicted as a handsome, usually beardless man in purple robes, crowned with the shining aureole of the sun.

claims.quote: Helios was identified with several other gods of fire and light such as Hephaistos (Hephaestus) and light-bringing Phoibos Apollon (Phoebus Apollo).

statement.id: Helios diidentifikasi dengan beberapa dewa api dan cahaya lain seperti Hephaistos dan Phoibos Apollon.
statement.en: Helios was identified with several other gods of fire and light such as Hephaistos (Hephaestus) and Phoibos Apollon (Phoebus Apollo).

claims.quote: Helios is described even in the Homeric poems as the god who sees and hears every thing, but, notwithstanding this, he is unaware of the fact that the companions of Odysseus robbed his oxen, until he was informed of it by Lampetia.

statement.id: Bahkan dalam puisi Homerik Helios digambarkan sebagai dewa yang melihat dan mendengar segalanya, tetapi ia tidak tahu bahwa kawan-kawan Odysseus mencuri sapinya sampai diberi tahu oleh Lampetia.
statement.en: Even in the Homeric poems Helios is described as the god who sees and hears everything, yet he is unaware that the companions of Odysseus robbed his oxen until informed by Lampetia.

claims.quote: But, owing to his omniscience, he was able to betray to Hephaestus the faithlessness of Aphrodite, and to reveal to Demeter the carrying off of her daughter.

statement.id: Karena kemahatahuannya, Helios dapat membongkar kepada Hephaestus ketidaksetiaan Aphrodite dan memberi tahu Demeter tentang penculikan putrinya.
statement.en: Owing to his omniscience, Helios was able to betray to Hephaestus the faithlessness of Aphrodite and to reveal to Demeter the carrying off of her daughter.

claims.quote: The island of Thrinacia (Sicily) was sacred to Helios, and he there had flocks of oxen and sheep, each consisting of 350 heads, which never increased or decreased, and were attended to by his daughters Phaetusa and Lampetia.

statement.id: Pulau Thrinacia (Sisilia) keramat bagi Helios; di sana ia memiliki kawanan sapi dan domba masing-masing 350 ekor yang tidak pernah bertambah atau berkurang, dirawat putri-putrinya Phaetusa dan Lampetia.
statement.en: The island of Thrinacia (Sicily) was sacred to Helios, where he had flocks of oxen and sheep of 350 head each that never increased or decreased, tended by his daughters Phaetusa and Lampetia.

claims.quote: The sacrifices offered to Helios consisted of white rams, boars, bulls, goats, lambs, especially white horses, and honey.

statement.id: Persembahan kepada Helios berupa domba jantan putih, babi hutan, banteng, kambing, anak domba, terutama kuda putih, dan madu.
statement.en: The sacrifices offered to Helios consisted of white rams, boars, bulls, goats, lambs, especially white horses, and honey.

claims.quote: Among the animals sacred to him, the cock is especially mentioned.

statement.id: Di antara hewan yang keramat baginya, ayam jantan disebut secara khusus.
statement.en: Among the animals sacred to him, the cock is especially mentioned.

claims.quote: later poets make him sail in a golden boat round one-half of the earth, and thus arrive in the east at the point from which he has to rise again. This golden boat is the work of Hephaestus.

statement.id: Penyair kemudian membuatnya berlayar dengan perahu emas mengelilingi separuh bumi hingga tiba di titik timur tempat ia terbit lagi; perahu emas itu buatan Hephaestus.
statement.en: Later poets make him sail in a golden boat round one-half of the earth to arrive at the point in the east from which he must rise again; this golden boat is the work of Hephaestus.

claims.quote: [1.2] HYPERION & EURYPHAESSA (Homeric Hymn 31)

statement.id: Menurut Homeric Hymn 31, orang tua Helios adalah Hyperion dan Euryphaessa.
statement.en: In Homeric Hymn 31, Helios's parents are Hyperion and Euryphaessa.

claims.quote: [1.3] HYPERION & AETHRA (Hyginus Pref)

statement.id: Menurut Hyginus (Pref), orang tua Helios adalah Hyperion dan Aethra.
statement.en: In Hyginus (Preface), Helios's parents are Hyperion and Aethra.

claims.quote: Helios was famously the subject of the Colossus of Rhodes, the giant bronze statue considered one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World.

statement.id: Helios terkenal sebagai subjek Colossus of Rhodes, patung perunggu raksasa yang dianggap salah satu Tujuh Keajaiban Dunia Kuno.
statement.en: Helios was famously the subject of the Colossus of Rhodes, the giant bronze statue considered one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World.

claims.quote: Hesiod informs us in his Theogony that with Perseis, daughter of Ocean, he had two children, Circe and king Aietes, who ruled at Kolchis. Later, Apollodorus adds Pasiphae too.

statement.id: Hesiodos dalam Theogony menyebut bahwa Helios dengan Perseis, putri Ocean, memiliki dua anak, Circe dan raja Aietes yang memerintah di Kolchis; Apollodorus kemudian menambahkan Pasiphae.
statement.en: Hesiod tells in the Theogony that Helios had with Perseis, daughter of Ocean, two children, Circe and King Aietes, who ruled at Kolchis; Apollodorus later adds Pasiphae.

claims.quote: The famous sacred cattle of Helios, which he kept on Thrinacia (perhaps Sicily or Malta), were stolen once by the giant Alkyoneus, an outrageous act which was avenged by Hercules. Helios again had some of his flock attacked, and this time eaten too, by the hungry comrades of Odysseus

statement.id: Sapi keramat Helios di Thrinacia pernah dicuri raksasa Alkyoneus dan dibalas oleh Hercules; kemudian sebagian kawanannya diserang dan dimakan kawan-kawan Odysseus yang kelaparan.
statement.en: The sacred cattle of Helios on Thrinacia were once stolen by the giant Alkyoneus, avenged by Hercules; later some of his flock were attacked and eaten by Odysseus' hungry comrades.

claims.quote: Fed up with the burning sun on his outward voyage, Hercules threatened to fire one of his arrows at Helios. The god, rather than punish Hercules for his petulance, rewarded his daring by gifting him a golden bowl which he used to sail the seas in greater comfort.

statement.id: Hercules yang jengkel pada terik matahari mengancam akan menembak Helios dengan panah; Helios tidak menghukumnya, melainkan menghadiahinya mangkuk emas yang ia pakai untuk berlayar lebih nyaman.
statement.en: Fed up with the burning sun, Hercules threatened to shoot an arrow at Helios; instead of punishing him, the god rewarded his daring with a golden bowl that Hercules used to sail the seas in greater comfort.

claims.quote: The Sun god shines on the amorous couple Aphrodite and Ares revealing to Hephaistos the illicit shenanigans of his wife in the trap he had set.

statement.id: Dewa Matahari menyinari pasangan Aphrodite dan Ares dan mengungkapkan kepada Hephaistos perselingkuhan istrinya dalam jebakan yang ia pasang.
statement.en: The Sun god shines on the amorous couple Aphrodite and Ares, revealing to Hephaistos his wife's illicit affair in the trap he had set.

claims.quote: In its founding mythology, the name of the island derives from the nymph Rhodos who bore seven sons to Helios, the patron of the island.

statement.id: Dalam mitologi pendiriannya, nama pulau Rhodes berasal dari nimfa Rhodos yang melahirkan tujuh putra bagi Helios, pelindung pulau itu.
statement.en: In its founding mythology the island's name derives from the nymph Rhodos, who bore seven sons to Helios, the patron of the island.

claims.quote: each year a chariot and four horses (quadriga) were thrown into the sea as an offering to the god.

statement.id: Setiap tahun sebuah kereta dengan empat kuda (quadriga) dilemparkan ke laut sebagai persembahan bagi sang dewa.
statement.en: Each year a chariot and four horses (quadriga) were thrown into the sea as an offering to the god.

claims.quote: The god was not the subject of a wide-spread cult, but Plato informs us in his Symposium and other works that many people, including Socrates, would greet the Sun and offer prayers each day.

statement.id: Sang dewa bukan objek pemujaan yang meluas, tetapi menurut Plato banyak orang, termasuk Socrates, menyambut Matahari dan berdoa setiap hari.
statement.en: The god was not the subject of a wide-spread cult, but according to Plato many people, including Socrates, would greet the Sun and offer prayers each day.

claims.quote: The god Apollo was linked with the Sun from the 5th century BCE, and the association became ever stronger from the Hellenistic period

statement.id: Dewa Apollo dikaitkan dengan Matahari sejak abad ke-5 SM, dan kaitan itu makin kuat sejak periode Helenistik.
statement.en: The god Apollo was linked with the Sun from the 5th century BCE, and the association grew ever stronger from the Hellenistic period.

claims.quote: Helios appears in all forms of Greek and Roman art, where he is usually depicted as a youth wearing a crown of sun rays.
claims.locator: How is Helios Represented in Art?

statement.id: Helios muncul dalam semua bentuk seni Yunani dan Romawi, biasanya sebagai pemuda bermahkota sinar matahari.
statement.en: Helios appears in all forms of Greek and Roman art, usually depicted as a youth wearing a crown of sun rays.

claims.quote: Rome's Circus Maximus, for example, had a temple dedicated to Sol and Luna (the Moon) from the 3rd century BCE.

statement.id: Circus Maximus di Roma memiliki kuil untuk Sol dan Luna (Bulan) sejak abad ke-3 SM.
statement.en: Rome's Circus Maximus had a temple dedicated to Sol and Luna (the Moon) from the 3rd century BCE.

claims.quote: Built between 304 and 280 BCE, it was toppled by an earthquake in either 228 or 226 BCE.

statement.id: Colossus dibangun antara 304 dan 280 SM dan roboh oleh gempa pada 228 atau 226 SM.
statement.en: The Colossus was built between 304 and 280 BCE and toppled by an earthquake in either 228 or 226 BCE.

summary.id: Helios adalah anak Hyperion dan Theia.
summary.en: Helios is the child of Hyperion and Theia.

summary.id: Dalam Homeric Hymn 31, orang tuanya Hyperion dan Euryphaessa.
summary.en: In Homeric Hymn 31, his parents are Hyperion and Euryphaessa.

summary.id: Dalam Hyginus (Pref), orang tuanya Hyperion dan Aethra.
summary.en: In Hyginus (Preface), his parents are Hyperion and Aethra.
