statement.en: The Heibonsha encyclopedia's author interprets the Azumi as an ancient clan that supervised the ama (sea people), and Isora as probably a half-divine, half-human shaman handed down among them.

short_description.id: Bajang adalah makhluk halus dalam kepercayaan Melayu, roh jahat yang biasanya berwujud musang dan dipelihara untuk mencelakai musuh, serta dianggap sangat berbahaya bagi anak-anak.
short_description.en: The bajang is a spirit of Malay belief, a malign spirit usually taking the form of a pole-cat, kept to harm enemies and considered very dangerous to children.

long_description.id:
Dalam kepercayaan Melayu, bajang adalah sejenis makhluk halus dari golongan jin atau setan yang dipelihara untuk mencelakai musuh. Menurut Wikipedia bahasa Melayu ia dipuja dari mayat bayi yang lahir mati, setan jantan yang sering menjelma kucing musang, sering menyerang anak-anak, dan dapat menyebabkan penyakit misterius yang mematikan. Kamus Dewan mendefinisikannya sebagai hantu berkuku panjang yang suka mengganggu perempuan hamil atau kanak-kanak.

Pemiliknya menyimpan bajang di dalam tabung buluh yang disumbat daun khusus dan dikunci dengan tangkal, dan hanya mengeluarkannya untuk mengenai musuh. Bajang diberi makan telur dan susu; bila diabaikan, ia dapat menyerang tuannya, dan tuan yang belum menemukan penerima konon sukar mati. Menurut Wikipedia bahasa Melayu tidak ada cara membunuh bajang, dan tuannya yang diketahui biasanya dibunuh atau diusir dari kampung.

Walter William Skeat, dalam Malay Magic, mencatat bajang sebagai salah satu dari empat roh kelahiran yang biasanya berwujud musang dan mengganggu rumah tangga dengan mengeong seperti kucing besar. Seorang dukun Melayu pernah mengatakan kepadanya bahwa bajang dapat berwujud jangkrik rumah dan dipelihara oleh laki-laki, tetapi ia menilai keterangan itu tak boleh diterima begitu saja. Anak-anak kadang diberi gelang benang sutra hitam yang disebut gelang bajang untuk melindungi mereka.

Sebuah catatan yang dikutip Skeat menggambarkan korban jatuh sakit dengan gejala tak lazim, seperti kejang, pingsan, atau mengigau, lalu muncul dugaan bahwa ia korban bajang dan siapa pemiliknya. Menurut catatan itu, seorang pawang dapat mengikis bejana besi dengan pisau cukur sehingga rambut pelaku rontok, pelaku yang dianggap terbukti dahulu dibunuh, dan di Perak penduduk sebuah kampung pernah menghanyutkan seorang lelaki yang dituduh memelihara bajang bersama keluarganya. Bajang warisan disebut datang dari leluhur, sedangkan bajang yang diperoleh diambil dari jasad bayi lahir mati yang baru dikubur.

Di seluruh Semenanjung bajang dikatakan berjenis kelamin laki-laki dan umumnya dipercaya sebagai roh jahat yang menghantui manusia dan pertanda malapetaka; di Perak dan beberapa tempat lain ia dipandang sebagai iblis yang dapat diperbudak menjadi roh peliharaan dan diwariskan dalam keluarga. Menurut Wikipedia bahasa Inggris, dahulu benda logam tajam seperti gunting diletakkan di dekat bayi sebagai perlindungan, dan garis regangan kehamilan setengah bercanda disebut bekas serangan bajang.
long_description.en:
In Malay belief, the bajang is a kind of spirit of the jinn or devil class kept in order to harm enemies. According to Wikipedia it is raised from the corpse of a stillborn baby, a male devil that often takes the form of a pole-cat, frequently attacks children and can cause mysterious fatal illness. The Kamus Dewan defines it as a long-nailed ghost that likes to disturb pregnant women or children.

Its owner keeps the bajang in a bamboo tube stoppered with a special leaf and locked with a charm, releasing it only to strike at enemies. The bajang is fed eggs and milk; if neglected it may attack its master, and a master who has found no one to take it over is said to find it hard to die. According to Wikipedia there is no way to kill a bajang, and a master who is identified is usually killed or driven out of the village.

Walter William Skeat, in Malay Magic, recorded the bajang as one of four birth-spirits that usually takes the form of a pole-cat and disturbs the household by mewing like a great cat. A Malay magician told him the bajang could take the form of a house-cricket and be kept by a man, though he judged that statement should not be accepted without reserve. Children are sometimes given an armlet of black silk threads called a bajang bracelet to protect them.

An account quoted by Skeat describes a victim falling ill with unusual symptoms such as convulsions, unconsciousness or delirium, after which the suspicion arises that the victim is under a bajang and who the owner is. In that account, a pawang can scrape an iron vessel with a razor so that the culprit's hair falls off, culprits whose guilt was held to be established were formerly killed, and in Perak the people of a village once sent a man accused of keeping a bajang down the river with his family. A hereditary bajang is said to come from ancestors, while an acquired one is taken from the newly buried body of a stillborn child.

Across the Peninsula the bajang is said to be male and is usually believed to be a malignant spirit that haunts mankind and foretells disaster; in Perak and some other parts it is regarded as a demon that can be enslaved as a familiar spirit and handed down in families. According to Wikipedia, sharp metal objects such as scissors were formerly placed near babies as protection, and the striations of pregnancy are somewhat jokingly said to be scars left by a bajang's attack.

era: The oldest account opened is Skeat's book; the Perak case is said to have happened less than ten years before the quoted account was written.

cultural_context.en: In the account quoted by Skeat, an accusation of keeping a bajang could lead to severe punishment or expulsion of the accused, and the bajang was seen as the cause of unexplained illness.

claim.id: Menurut Wikipedia bahasa Melayu, bajang yang dipelihara diberi makan telur dan susu; bila tidak dijaga dan diberi makan, bajang yang kelaparan akan menyerang tuannya.
claim.en: According to Wikipedia, the kept bajang is fed eggs and milk; if not looked after and fed, the hungry bajang attacks its master.

claims_provenance.quote: Bajang yang dipelihara itu akan diberi makan telur dan juga susu. Sekiranya tidak dijaga dengan baik dan diberi makan, Bajang yang kelaparan itu akan menyerang tuannya.

claim.id: Menurut Wikipedia bahasa Melayu, bajang mengamuk bila tidak dijaga baik, dan tuannya sukar mati bila tidak ada orang yang mau menerimanya.
claim.en: According to Wikipedia, the bajang rampages if not properly looked after, and its master finds it hard to die if no one will take it over.

claims_provenance.quote: Bajang akan mengamuk sekiranya tidak dijaga dengan baik. Tuannya sukar untuk mati sekiranya tidak ada orang hendak menerimanya.

claim.id: Menurut Wikipedia bahasa Melayu, tidak ada cara membunuh bajang, tetapi bila tuannya diketahui biasanya ia dibunuh atau diusir dari kampung.
claim.en: According to Wikipedia, there is no way to kill a bajang, but if its master is identified he is usually killed or driven out of the village.

claims_provenance.quote: Tidak ada cara membunuh bajang tetapi biasanya sekiranya tuannya diketahui, dia akan dibunuh atau diusir dari kampung tersebut.

claim.id: Kamus Dewan Edisi Keempat mendefinisikan bajang (ejaan Jawi باجڠ) sebagai hantu berkuku panjang yang suka mengganggu perempuan yang sedang mengandung atau kanak-kanak.
claim.en: The Kamus Dewan, fourth edition, defines bajang (Jawi spelling باجڠ) as a long-nailed ghost that likes to disturb pregnant women or children.

claims_provenance.quote: باجڠ Definisi : 1. hantu yg berkuku panjang dan suka mengganggu perempuan yg sedang mengandung atau kanak-kanak;
claims_provenance.source_citation: Dewan Bahasa dan Pustaka (PRPM) — bajang (Kamus Dewan Edisi Keempat; Kamus Pelajar Edisi Kedua)

claim.id: Kamus Pelajar Edisi Kedua mendefinisikan bajang sebagai hantu berkuku panjang yang kononnya suka mengganggu wanita hamil atau kanak-kanak.
claim.en: The Kamus Pelajar, second edition, defines bajang as a long-nailed ghost said to like disturbing pregnant women or children.

claims_provenance.quote: 1 hantu berkuku panjang yg kononnya suka mengganggu wanita hamil atau kanak-kanak.
claims_provenance.source_citation: Dewan Bahasa dan Pustaka (PRPM) — bajang (Kamus Dewan Edisi Keempat; Kamus Pelajar Edisi Kedua)

claim.id: Penulis menyebut gumaman bajang, roh peliharaan, yang duduk di bubungan atap.
claim.en: The author mentions the mutterings of the bajang, a familiar spirit, as it sat on the roof-tree.

claims_provenance.quote: the mutterings of the bajang (a familiar spirit) as he sat on the roof-tree
claims_provenance.source_citation: Project Gutenberg — Malay Magic: Being an Introduction to the Folklore and Popular Religion of the Malay Peninsula

claim.id: Dalam catatan yang dikutip Skeat, korban dikatakan jatuh sakit dengan gejala tak lazim: kejang, pingsan, atau mengigau, kadang berhari-hari atau dengan jeda di antara serangan.
claim.en: In an account quoted by Skeat, the victim falls ill with unusual symptoms: convulsions, unconsciousness or delirium, possibly for days together or with intervals between attacks.

claims_provenance.quote: Some one in the village falls ill of a complaint the symptoms of which are unusual; there may be convulsions, unconsciousness, or delirium, possibly for some days together or with intervals between the attacks.
claims_provenance.source_citation: Project Gutenberg — Malay Magic: Being an Introduction to the Folklore and Popular Religion of the Malay Peninsula

claim.id: Dalam catatan itu, keluarga memanggil dukun setempat, lalu timbul kesan bahwa pasien menjadi korban bajang; kesan itu cepat menjadi keyakinan dan hal sepele pun dapat dianggap menunjuk pemilik roh jahat itu.
claim.en: In that account, relatives call a native doctor and an impression arises that the patient is the victim of a bajang; the impression quickly becomes certainty and any trifle may point to the owner of the evil spirit.

claims_provenance.quote: The relatives will call in a native doctor, and at her (she is usually an ancient female) suggestion, or without it, an impression will arise that the patient is the victim of a bâjang. Such an impression quickly develops into certainty, and any trifle will suggest the owner of the evil spirit.
claims_provenance.source_citation: Project Gutenberg — Malay Magic: Being an Introduction to the Folklore and Popular Religion of the Malay Peninsula

claim.id: Menurut catatan itu, seorang pawang menaruh tersangka di satu ruangan dan mengikis bejana besi dengan pisau cukur di ruangan lain; rambut pelaku dikatakan rontok seolah-olah pisau dipakai pada kepalanya.
claim.en: According to that account, a pawang places the suspected sorcerer in one room and scrapes an iron vessel with a razor in another; the culprit's hair is said to fall off as if the razor had been used on his head.

claims_provenance.quote: he will place the sorcerer in one room, and, while he in another scrapes an iron vessel with a razor, the culprit’s hair will fall off as though the razor had been applied to his head instead of to the vessel
claims_provenance.source_citation: Project Gutenberg — Malay Magic: Being an Introduction to the Folklore and Popular Religion of the Malay Peninsula

claim.id: Menurut catatan itu, sebelum pengaruh Inggris datang, penyihir yang kesalahannya terbukti menurut kepuasan orang Melayu biasanya dibunuh, dan hukuman mati itu masih dilakukan belum lama berselang.
claim.en: According to that account, before British influence arrived the practice was to kill the wizard or witch whose guilt was established to Malay satisfaction, and such executions were carried out not many years earlier.

claims_provenance.quote: Before the advent of British influence it was the practice to kill the wizard or witch whose guilt had been established to Malay satisfaction, and such executions were carried out not many years ago.
claims_provenance.source_citation: Project Gutenberg — Malay Magic: Being an Introduction to the Folklore and Popular Religion of the Malay Peninsula

claim.id: Catatan itu menceritakan kasus di Perak kurang dari sepuluh tahun sebelumnya: penduduk sebuah kampung hulu sungai menuduh seorang lelaki memelihara bajang, lalu menaikkannya bersama keluarga dan hartanya ke rakit dan menghanyutkannya ke hilir sungai.
claim.en: The account tells of a case in Perak less than ten years earlier: the people of an up-river village accused a man of keeping a bajang and put him, his family and his effects on a raft and sent them down the river.

claims_provenance.quote: I remember a case in Perak less than ten years ago, when the people of an up-river village accused a man of keeping a bâjang ... Before anything could be done they put him, his family, and effects on a raft and started them down the river.
claims_provenance.source_citation: Project Gutenberg — Malay Magic: Being an Introduction to the Folklore and Popular Religion of the Malay Peninsula

claim.id: Menurut catatan itu, bajang warisan datang sebagai pusaka tak dikehendaki dari leluhur yang bejat, sedangkan bajang yang diperoleh biasanya diambil dari jasad bayi lahir mati yang baru dikubur, yang dianggap tempat tinggal roh peliharaan sampai dibujuk keluar oleh orang yang berdiri di atas kubur pada tengah malam.
claim.en: According to that account, the hereditary bajang is the unsought heritage of a dissolute ancestry, while the acquired bajang is usually obtained from the newly buried body of a stillborn child, thought to house a familiar spirit until lured out by someone standing over the grave at dead of night.

claims_provenance.quote: The hereditary bâjang comes like other evils, the unsought heritage of a dissolute ancestry, but the acquired bâjang is usually obtained from the newly-buried body of a stillborn child, which is supposed to be the abiding-place of a familiar spirit until lured therefrom by the solicitations of some one who, at dead of night, stands over the grave
claims_provenance.source_citation: Project Gutenberg — Malay Magic: Being an Introduction to the Folklore and Popular Religion of the Malay Peninsula

claim.id: Penulis catatan itu mengaku diyakinkan bahwa bajang, berbentuk kadal, pernah terlihat keluar dari hidung orang yang ditenggelamkan.
claim.en: The account's author says he was assured that the bajang, in the shape of a lizard, has been seen to issue from the nose of the person being drowned.

claims_provenance.quote: I have also been assured that the bâjang, in the shape of a lizard, has been seen to issue from the drowning person’s nose.
claims_provenance.source_citation: Project Gutenberg — Malay Magic: Being an Introduction to the Folklore and Popular Religion of the Malay Peninsula

claim.id: Di Perak dan beberapa tempat lain di Semenanjung, bajang dipandang sebagai salah satu iblis yang menurut orang Melayu dapat diperbudak manusia dan menjadi roh peliharaannya; roh semacam itu dipercaya diwariskan dalam keluarga tertentu sebagai pusaka.
claim.en: In Perak and some other parts of the Peninsula the bajang is regarded as one of the demons that, the Malays hold, can be enslaved by man and become his familiar spirit; such familiars are believed to be handed down in certain families as heirlooms.

claims_provenance.quote: In Perak and some other parts of the Peninsula, however, the Bajang is regarded as one of the several kinds of demons which, the Malays hold, can be enslaved by man and become his familiar spirit. Such familiars, it is believed, are handed down in certain families as heirlooms.
claims_provenance.source_citation: Project Gutenberg — Malay Magic: Being an Introduction to the Folklore and Popular Religion of the Malay Peninsula

claim.id: Roh peliharaan itu diberi makan telur dan susu; bila tuannya hendak memakainya, ia dikirim untuk merasuki dan memangsa isi tubuh korban yang dipilih tuannya karena dendam.
claim.en: The familiar is fed eggs and milk; when its master wishes to use it he sends it forth to possess and prey upon the vitals of a victim chosen out of malice.

claims_provenance.quote: The familiar is fed with eggs and milk. When its master wishes to make use of it he sends it forth to possess and prey upon the vitals of any one whom his malice may select as a victim.
claims_provenance.source_citation: Project Gutenberg — Malay Magic: Being an Introduction to the Folklore and Popular Religion of the Malay Peninsula

claim.id: Korban langsung diserang penyakit mematikan yang tak terjelaskan dan hanya dapat disembuhkan dengan kekuatan gaib; bila bajang diabaikan dan tidak diberi makan teratur, pemiliknya konon sering menjadi korban roh peliharaannya sendiri.
claim.en: The victim is at once seized by a deadly, unaccountable ailment that can only be cured by magic; if the bajang is neglected and not fed regularly, its owner is said often to fall victim to his own familiar.

claims_provenance.quote: The individual thus persecuted is at once seized by a deadly and unaccountable ailment, which can only be cured by magic agencies. If the Bajang is neglected by its owner, and if the latter omits to feed it regularly, it is said that he often falls a victim to his own familiar.
claims_provenance.source_citation: Project Gutenberg — Malay Magic: Being an Introduction to the Folklore and Popular Religion of the Malay Peninsula

claim.id: Skeat memuat gambar yang tampaknya menggambarkan garis besar bajang, diubah secara "skriptural" untuk menjadi penangkal terhadap bajang itu sendiri.
claim.en: Skeat reproduces a drawing that appears to show the outline of a bajang, "scripturally" modified to serve as a counter-charm against the bajang itself.

claims_provenance.quote: which appears to represent the outline of a Bajang, “scripturally” modified to serve as a counter-charm against the Bajang itself.
claims_provenance.source_citation: Project Gutenberg — Malay Magic: Being an Introduction to the Folklore and Popular Religion of the Malay Peninsula

claim.id: Garis gambar penangkal itu tersusun dari berbagai gabungan nama "Allah", "Muhammad", "Ali", dan lain-lain dalam aksara Arab.
claim.en: The outlines of that counter-charm figure are made up of varying combinations of the names "Allah", "Muhammad", "Ali" and others in Arabic script.

claims_provenance.quote: The outlines of the figure are made up from varying combinations of the names “Allah,” “Muhammad,” “ʿAli,” etc., in the Arabic character.
claims_provenance.source_citation: Project Gutenberg — Malay Magic: Being an Introduction to the Folklore and Popular Religion of the Malay Peninsula

claim.id: Menurut kutipan dalam catatan kaki Skeat, langsuior, roh peliharaan perempuan, nyaris tak berbeda dari bajang kecuali sedikit lebih jahat.
claim.en: According to a quotation in Skeat's footnote, the langsuior, the female familiar, differs hardly at all from the bajang except in being a little more baneful.

claims_provenance.quote: Langsuior, the female familiar, differs hardly at all from the bâjang, except that she is a little more baneful, and when under the control of a man he sometimes becomes the victim of her attractions, and she will even bear him elfin children.
claims_provenance.source_citation: Project Gutenberg — Malay Magic: Being an Introduction to the Folklore and Popular Religion of the Malay Peninsula

claim.id: Sumbernya adalah Malay Magic, pengantar folklor dan agama rakyat Semenanjung Melayu karya Walter William Skeat dari dinas sipil Federated Malay States.
claim.en: The source is Malay Magic, an introduction to the folklore and popular religion of the Malay Peninsula by Walter William Skeat of the civil service of the Federated Malay States.

claims_provenance.quote: MALAY MAGIC BEING AN INTRODUCTION TO THE FOLKLORE AND POPULAR RELIGION OF THE MALAY PENINSULA BY WALTER WILLIAM SKEAT OF THE CIVIL SERVICE OF THE FEDERATED MALAY STATES
claims_provenance.source_citation: Project Gutenberg — Malay Magic: Being an Introduction to the Folklore and Popular Religion of the Malay Peninsula

claim.id: Menurut Wikipedia bahasa Inggris, bajang adalah roh peliharaan yang diperoleh seorang lelaki dengan mantra yang tepat di atas jasad bayi lahir mati yang baru dikubur; ia berwujud luwak atau musang dan dapat menyebabkan kejang, pingsan, atau mengigau.
claim.en: According to Wikipedia, the bajang is a familiar spirit acquired by a man reciting the proper incantations over the newly buried body of a stillborn child; it takes the form of a civet or musang and may cause convulsions, unconsciousness or delirium.

claims_provenance.quote: A kind of familiar spirit acquired by a male who says the proper incantations over the newly buried body of a stillborn child. It takes the form of a civet or musang and may cause convulsions, unconsciousness or delirium.

claim.id: Seperti roh sejenisnya, bajang dapat berbalik menyerang tuannya bila diabaikan; ia dapat disuruh menyerang siapa pun yang dipilih tuannya, tetapi dianggap sangat berbahaya bagi bayi dan anak kecil.
claim.en: Like other spirits of its type, a bajang may turn on its master if neglected; it can be made to attack anyone its master chooses but is considered particularly dangerous to infants and young children.

claims_provenance.quote: As with other spirits of this type, a bajang may turn on its master if it is neglected. Although a bajang can be made to attack any whom its master chooses, it is considered particularly dangerous to infants and young children.

claim.id: Pada masa lalu, sebagian anak diberi "gelang bajang" dari sutra hitam sebagai pelindung, dan benda logam tajam seperti gunting diletakkan di dekat bayi untuk tujuan yang sama.
claim.en: In former times some children were given black-silk "bajang bracelets" (gelang bajang) for protection, and sharp metal objects such as scissors were placed near babies for the same purpose.

claims_provenance.quote: In former times, some children would be given "bajang bracelets" (gelang bajang) made of black silk to protect them against it, and sharp metal objects such as scissors would be placed near babies for the same purpose.

claim.id: Garis-garis regangan akibat kehamilan bahkan setengah bercanda disebut bekas luka serangan bajang.
claim.en: Even the striations of pregnancy are somewhat jokingly said to be the scars left by a bajang's attack.

claims_provenance.quote: Even the striations of pregnancy are somewhat jokingly said to be the scars left by a bajang's attack.

claim.id: Pelesit dalam banyak hal sebanding dengan bajang, tetapi pemilik bajang selalu laki-laki, sedangkan pelesit hanya boleh dipelihara perempuan.
claim.en: The pelesit is in many ways comparable to the bajang, but a bajang's owner is always male whereas a pelesit may only be kept by a female.

claims_provenance.quote: The pelesit is in many ways comparable to the bajang, but whereas the bajang's owner is always male, the pelesit may only be kept by a female.

research_gaps.note: Skeat memuat diagram bajang (Plate 6) tetapi tidak ada berkas Commons yang terbukti menggambarkannya; images dibiarkan kosong.

text.id: Catatan tertua yang dibuka adalah buku Skeat; kasus Perak disebut terjadi kurang dari sepuluh tahun sebelum penulis catatan itu menulis.
text.en: The oldest account opened is Skeat's book; the Perak case is said to have happened less than ten years before the quoted account was written.

cultural_context.id: Dalam catatan yang dikutip Skeat, tuduhan memelihara bajang dapat berujung pada hukuman berat atau pengusiran terhadap tertuduh, dan bajang dipandang sebagai penyebab penyakit tak terjelaskan.
cultural_context.en: In the account quoted by Skeat, an accusation of keeping a bajang could lead to severe punishment or expulsion of the accused, and the bajang was seen as the cause of unexplained illness.

who.id: Roh jahat peliharaan yang biasanya berwujud musang.
who.en: A kept malign spirit usually shaped like a pole-cat.

origin.en: Malay belief in the Malay Peninsula.

role.id: Roh peliharaan yang dipakai untuk mencelakai musuh.
role.en: A kept spirit used to harm enemies.

famous_for.id: Gelang bajang dari benang sutra hitam untuk melindungi anak.
famous_for.en: The black-silk bajang bracelet protecting children.

did_you_know.id: Tanda regangan di kulit akibat kehamilan pun konon, sambil bercanda, dianggap bekas cakaran bajang.
did_you_know.en: Stretch marks left on the skin by pregnancy are, half in jest, said to be marks from a bajang's attack.

description.id: Biasanya menjelma musang; menurut seorang dukun juga dapat berwujud jangkrik, dan dalam satu cerita berwujud kadal.
description.en: Usually becomes a pole-cat; one magician said it can also be a cricket, and in one account it appears as a lizard.

description.id: Dikirim tuannya untuk merasuki dan memangsa isi tubuh korban yang dipilih.
description.en: Sent by its master to possess and prey upon the vitals of a chosen victim.

description.id: Menyebabkan penyakit misterius yang dapat mematikan korbannya, dengan gejala seperti kejang, pingsan, atau mengigau.
description.en: Causes mysterious, possibly fatal illness with symptoms such as convulsions, unconsciousness or delirium.

description.id: Bajang dapat dihindari dengan tangkal atau azimat.
description.en: The bajang can be warded off with charms or amulets.

name.id: Gelang bajang dan benda logam tajam
name.en: Bajang bracelets and sharp metal objects

description.id: Anak-anak diberi gelang benang sutra hitam, dan benda logam tajam seperti gunting diletakkan di dekat bayi, sebagai perlindungan.
description.en: Children are given black silk bracelets and sharp metal objects such as scissors are placed near babies for protection.

description.id: Skeat memuat gambar garis besar bajang yang diubah secara skriptural menjadi penangkal terhadap bajang.
description.en: Skeat reproduces a drawing of a bajang's outline scripturally modified as a counter-charm against it.

name.id: Tidak diberi makan dan tidak dirawat

description.id: Bajang yang diabaikan atau tidak diberi makan dapat berbalik menyerang tuannya sendiri.
description.en: A neglected or unfed bajang can turn on its own master.

description.id: Di seluruh Semenanjung bajang dikatakan berjenis kelamin laki-laki dan umumnya dipercaya sebagai roh jahat yang menghantui manusia.
description.en: Across the Peninsula the bajang is said to be male and is usually believed to be a malignant spirit that haunts mankind.

tradition.id: Perak dan beberapa bagian lain Semenanjung
tradition.en: Perak and some other parts of the Peninsula

description.id: Di sini bajang dipandang sebagai iblis yang dapat diperbudak manusia, disimpan dalam tabung buluh, dan diwariskan dalam keluarga.
description.en: Here the bajang is regarded as a demon that can be enslaved by man, kept in a bamboo tube and handed down in families.

tradition.id: Keterangan seorang dukun Melayu kepada Skeat
tradition.en: A Malay magician's statement to Skeat

description.id: Seorang dukun mengatakan bajang berwujud jangkrik rumah dan dapat dipelihara laki-laki, tetapi Skeat menilainya tidak dapat diterima tanpa kehati-hatian.
description.en: A magician said the bajang took the form of a house-cricket and could be kept by a man, but Skeat says this must not be accepted without reserve.

role.id: Bajang dituduhkan dipelihara oleh seorang lelaki
role.en: A man is accused of keeping a bajang

summary.id: Penduduk sebuah kampung hulu sungai di Perak menuduh seorang lelaki memelihara bajang dan menghanyutkannya bersama keluarga dan hartanya di atas rakit.
summary.en: The people of an up-river village in Perak accused a man of keeping a bajang and sent him, his family and his effects down the river on a raft.

description.id: Tempat kasus tuduhan bajang dalam catatan yang dikutip Skeat, dan daerah tempat bajang dipandang sebagai roh peliharaan.
description.en: The place of the bajang accusation in the account quoted by Skeat, and a region where the bajang is regarded as a familiar spirit.

description.id: Penulis catatan mengingat kasus di Perak kurang dari sepuluh tahun sebelumnya.
description.en: The account's author recalls a Perak case less than ten years earlier.

note.id: Dalam banyak hal sebanding dengan bajang, tetapi hanya dipelihara perempuan; bajang kadang dikacaukan dengan pelesit.
note.en: In many ways comparable to the bajang but kept only by females; the bajang is sometimes confused with the pelesit.

note.id: Salah satu roh kelahiran dalam daftar Skeat; langsuir perempuan, bajang laki-laki.
note.en: Another of the birth-spirits in Skeat's list; the langsuir is female, the bajang male.

note.id: Roh peliharaan perempuan yang nyaris tak berbeda dari bajang kecuali sedikit lebih jahat.
note.en: The female familiar that differs hardly at all from the bajang except in being a little more baneful.

learning_questions.id: Mengapa banyak kepercayaan tentang roh peliharaan berakhir dengan roh yang berbalik menyerang pemiliknya?
learning_questions.en: Why do many beliefs about kept spirits end with the spirit turning on its owner?

summary.id: Wikipedia bahasa Melayu: roh dari golongan jin atau setan yang dipelihara untuk mencelakai musuh.
summary.en: Malay Wikipedia: a spirit of the jinn or devil class kept in order to harm enemies.

summary.id: Kamus Dewan: hantu berkuku panjang yang suka mengganggu perempuan hamil atau kanak-kanak.
summary.en: Kamus Dewan: a long-nailed ghost that likes to disturb pregnant women or children.

summary.id: Catatan di Skeat: umumnya dipercaya sekadar roh jahat yang menghantui manusia, tetapi di Perak dan beberapa tempat lain dipandang sebagai iblis yang dapat diperbudak menjadi roh peliharaan.
summary.en: Skeat's notes: usually believed to be merely a malignant spirit that haunts mankind, but in Perak and some other parts regarded as a demon that can be enslaved as a familiar spirit.

summary.id: Musang (pole-cat) menurut Skeat dan Wikipedia bahasa Melayu; luwak atau musang menurut Wikipedia bahasa Inggris.
summary.en: A pole-cat (musang) according to Skeat and Malay Wikipedia; a civet or musang according to Wikipedia.

summary.id: Jangkrik rumah menurut seorang dukun kepada Skeat, yang menyarankan hati-hati menerimanya.
summary.en: A house-cricket according to a magician speaking to Skeat, who advises caution in accepting it.

summary.id: Kadal, dalam catatan lain yang dikutip Skeat.
summary.en: A lizard, in another account quoted by Skeat.

summary.id: Dipuja atau diperoleh dari jasad bayi lahir mati; juga diwariskan dalam keluarga.
summary.en: Raised or acquired from a stillborn baby's corpse; also inherited in families.

summary.id: Kamus Dewan hanya mendefinisikannya sebagai hantu berkuku panjang tanpa menyebut asal-usul peliharaan.
summary.en: The Kamus Dewan simply defines it as a long-nailed ghost without mentioning a kept origin.

short_description.id: Bajang adalah makhluk halus dalam kepercayaan Melayu, roh jahat yang biasanya berwujud musang dan dipelihara untuk mencelakai musuh, serta dianggap sangat berbahaya bagi anak-anak.
short_description.en: The bajang is a spirit of Malay belief, a malign spirit usually taking the form of a pole-cat, kept to harm enemies and considered very dangerous to children.

long_description.id: Dalam kepercayaan Melayu, bajang adalah sejenis makhluk halus dari golongan jin atau setan yang dipelihara untuk mencelakai musuh. Menurut Wikipedia bahasa Melayu ia dipuja dari mayat bayi yang lahir mati, setan jantan yang sering menjelma kucing musang, sering menyerang anak-anak, dan dapat menyebabkan penyakit misterius yang mematikan. Kamus Dewan mendefinisikannya sebagai hantu berkuku panjang yang suka mengganggu perempuan hamil atau kanak-kanak.
long_description.en: In Malay belief, the bajang is a kind of spirit of the jinn or devil class kept in order to harm enemies. According to Wikipedia it is raised from the corpse of a stillborn baby, a male devil that often takes the form of a pole-cat, frequently attacks children and can cause mysterious fatal illness. The Kamus Dewan defines it as a long-nailed ghost that likes to disturb pregnant women or children.

long_description.id: Pemiliknya menyimpan bajang di dalam tabung buluh yang disumbat daun khusus dan dikunci dengan tangkal, dan hanya mengeluarkannya untuk mengenai musuh. Bajang diberi makan telur dan susu; bila diabaikan, ia dapat menyerang tuannya, dan tuan yang belum menemukan penerima konon sukar mati. Menurut Wikipedia bahasa Melayu tidak ada cara membunuh bajang, dan tuannya yang diketahui biasanya dibunuh atau diusir dari kampung.
long_description.en: Its owner keeps the bajang in a bamboo tube stoppered with a special leaf and locked with a charm, releasing it only to strike at enemies. The bajang is fed eggs and milk; if neglected it may attack its master, and a master who has found no one to take it over is said to find it hard to die. According to Wikipedia there is no way to kill a bajang, and a master who is identified is usually killed or driven out of the village.

long_description.id: Walter William Skeat, dalam Malay Magic, mencatat bajang sebagai salah satu dari empat roh kelahiran yang biasanya berwujud musang dan mengganggu rumah tangga dengan mengeong seperti kucing besar. Seorang dukun Melayu pernah mengatakan kepadanya bahwa bajang dapat berwujud jangkrik rumah dan dipelihara oleh laki-laki, tetapi ia menilai keterangan itu tak boleh diterima begitu saja. Anak-anak kadang diberi gelang benang sutra hitam yang disebut gelang bajang untuk melindungi mereka.
long_description.en: Walter William Skeat, in Malay Magic, recorded the bajang as one of four birth-spirits that usually takes the form of a pole-cat and disturbs the household by mewing like a great cat. A Malay magician told him the bajang could take the form of a house-cricket and be kept by a man, though he judged that statement should not be accepted without reserve. Children are sometimes given an armlet of black silk threads called a bajang bracelet to protect them.

long_description.id: Sebuah catatan yang dikutip Skeat menggambarkan korban jatuh sakit dengan gejala tak lazim, seperti kejang, pingsan, atau mengigau, lalu muncul dugaan bahwa ia korban bajang dan siapa pemiliknya. Menurut catatan itu, seorang pawang dapat mengikis bejana besi dengan pisau cukur sehingga rambut pelaku rontok, pelaku yang dianggap terbukti dahulu dibunuh, dan di Perak penduduk sebuah kampung pernah menghanyutkan seorang lelaki yang dituduh memelihara bajang bersama keluarganya. Bajang warisan disebut datang dari leluhur, sedangkan bajang yang diperoleh diambil dari jasad bayi lahir mati yang baru dikubur.
long_description.en: An account quoted by Skeat describes a victim falling ill with unusual symptoms such as convulsions, unconsciousness or delirium, after which the suspicion arises that the victim is under a bajang and who the owner is. In that account, a pawang can scrape an iron vessel with a razor so that the culprit's hair falls off, culprits whose guilt was held to be established were formerly killed, and in Perak the people of a village once sent a man accused of keeping a bajang down the river with his family. A hereditary bajang is said to come from ancestors, while an acquired one is taken from the newly buried body of a stillborn child.

long_description.id: Di seluruh Semenanjung bajang dikatakan berjenis kelamin laki-laki dan umumnya dipercaya sebagai roh jahat yang menghantui manusia dan pertanda malapetaka; di Perak dan beberapa tempat lain ia dipandang sebagai iblis yang dapat diperbudak menjadi roh peliharaan dan diwariskan dalam keluarga. Menurut Wikipedia bahasa Inggris, dahulu benda logam tajam seperti gunting diletakkan di dekat bayi sebagai perlindungan, dan garis regangan kehamilan setengah bercanda disebut bekas serangan bajang.
long_description.en: Across the Peninsula the bajang is said to be male and is usually believed to be a malignant spirit that haunts mankind and foretells disaster; in Perak and some other parts it is regarded as a demon that can be enslaved as a familiar spirit and handed down in families. According to Wikipedia, sharp metal objects such as scissors were formerly placed near babies as protection, and the striations of pregnancy are somewhat jokingly said to be scars left by a bajang's attack.

claims.quote: Bajang merujuk kepada sejenis makhluk halus yang mana jelmaan rupa dari golongan jin/syaitan, yang dipelihara bagi tujuan memudaratkan musuh.

statement.id: Bajang adalah sejenis makhluk halus dari golongan jin atau setan yang dipelihara untuk mencelakai musuh.
statement.en: The bajang is a kind of spirit of the jinn or devil class kept to harm enemies.

claims.quote: Bajang merupakan makhluk setan yang dipuja daripada mayat bayi yang mati semasa lahir. Ia merupakan setan jantan yang sering kali menjelma sebagai kucing pole cat. Bajang seringkali menyerang kanak-kanak dan mampu menyebabkan penyakit misteri yang boleh membawa maut kepada mangsanya.

statement.id: Bajang adalah setan yang dipuja dari mayat bayi yang lahir mati, setan jantan yang sering menjelma kucing musang, sering menyerang anak-anak, dan dapat menyebabkan penyakit misterius yang mematikan.
statement.en: The bajang is a devil raised from a stillborn baby's corpse, a male devil often taking pole-cat form, frequently attacking children and causing mysterious fatal illness.

claims.quote: Bajang akan dikawal oleh pemiliknya dan akan disimpan di dalam tabung buluh. Sejenis daun khusus akan digunakan sebagai penyumbat tabungan tersebut dan dikunci dengan tangkal.

statement.id: Menurut Wikipedia bahasa Melayu, bajang dikawal pemiliknya dan disimpan dalam tabung buluh yang disumbat daun khusus dan dikunci dengan tangkal.
statement.en: According to Wikipedia, the bajang is controlled by its owner and kept in a bamboo tube stoppered with a special leaf and locked with a charm.

claims.quote: These are four in number: the Bajang, which generally takes the form of a pole-cat (musang) and disturbs the household by mewing like a great cat; the Langsuir, which takes the form of an owl with long claws

statement.id: Walter William Skeat dalam Malay Magic (1900) mencatat empat roh kelahiran; salah satunya bajang, yang biasanya berwujud musang dan mengganggu rumah tangga dengan mengeong seperti kucing besar.
statement.en: Walter William Skeat in Malay Magic (1900) lists four birth-spirits; one is the bajang, usually a pole-cat that disturbs the household by mewing like a great cat.

claims.quote: Thus a Malay magician once told me that the Bajang took the form of a house-cricket, and that when thus embodied it may be kept by a man, as the Pĕlĕsit may be kept by a woman.

statement.id: Seorang dukun Melayu memberi tahu Skeat bahwa bajang dapat berwujud jangkrik rumah dan dipelihara laki-laki, seperti pelesit dipelihara perempuan; bajang kadang dikacaukan dengan pelesit.
statement.en: A Malay magician told Skeat the bajang could take the form of a house-cricket and be kept by a man, as the pelesit is kept by a woman; the bajang is sometimes confused with the pelesit.

claims.quote: I need hardly say that it is considered very dangerous to children, who are sometimes provided with a sort of armlet of black silk threads, called a “bajang bracelet” (g’lang bajang), which, it is supposed, will protect them against it.

statement.id: Bajang dianggap sangat berbahaya bagi anak-anak, yang kadang diberi gelang benang sutra hitam, gelang bajang, untuk melindungi mereka.
statement.en: The bajang is thought very dangerous to children, who are sometimes given a black-silk armlet, the bajang bracelet, for protection.

claims.quote: In all parts of the Peninsula the Bajang is said to be of the male gender, while the Langsuir is supposed to be a female. It is usually believed by Malays that the Bajang is merely a malignant spirit which haunts mankind, and whose presence foretells disaster.

statement.id: Di seluruh Semenanjung Malaya bajang dianggap laki-laki dan langsuir perempuan; orang Melayu umumnya percaya bajang roh jahat yang menghantui manusia dan kehadirannya pertanda malapetaka.
statement.en: Across the Malay Peninsula the bajang is male and the langsuir female; Malays generally believe the bajang is a malignant spirit haunting people, its presence foretelling disaster.

claims.quote: Bajang boleh dihindari dengan menggunakan tangkal atau azimat.

statement.id: Bajang dapat dihindari dengan tangkal atau azimat.
statement.en: The bajang can be warded off with charms or amulets.

claims.quote: Bajang yang dipelihara itu akan diberi makan telur dan juga susu. Sekiranya tidak dijaga dengan baik dan diberi makan, Bajang yang kelaparan itu akan menyerang tuannya.

statement.id: Menurut Wikipedia bahasa Melayu, bajang yang dipelihara diberi makan telur dan susu; bila tidak dijaga dan diberi makan, bajang yang kelaparan akan menyerang tuannya.
statement.en: According to Wikipedia, the kept bajang is fed eggs and milk; if not looked after and fed, the hungry bajang attacks its master.

claims.quote: Bajang akan mengamuk sekiranya tidak dijaga dengan baik. Tuannya sukar untuk mati sekiranya tidak ada orang hendak menerimanya.

statement.id: Menurut Wikipedia bahasa Melayu, bajang mengamuk bila tidak dijaga baik, dan tuannya sukar mati bila tidak ada orang yang mau menerimanya.
statement.en: According to Wikipedia, the bajang rampages if not properly looked after, and its master finds it hard to die if no one will take it over.

claims.quote: Tidak ada cara membunuh bajang tetapi biasanya sekiranya tuannya diketahui, dia akan dibunuh atau diusir dari kampung tersebut.

statement.id: Menurut Wikipedia bahasa Melayu, tidak ada cara membunuh bajang, tetapi bila tuannya diketahui biasanya ia dibunuh atau diusir dari kampung.
statement.en: According to Wikipedia, there is no way to kill a bajang, but if its master is identified he is usually killed or driven out of the village.

claims.quote: باجڠ Definisi : 1. hantu yg berkuku panjang dan suka mengganggu perempuan yg sedang mengandung atau kanak-kanak;

statement.id: Kamus Dewan Edisi Keempat mendefinisikan bajang (ejaan Jawi باجڠ) sebagai hantu berkuku panjang yang suka mengganggu perempuan yang sedang mengandung atau kanak-kanak.
statement.en: The Kamus Dewan, fourth edition, defines bajang (Jawi spelling باجڠ) as a long-nailed ghost that likes to disturb pregnant women or children.

claims.quote: 1 hantu berkuku panjang yg kononnya suka mengganggu wanita hamil atau kanak-kanak.

statement.id: Kamus Pelajar Edisi Kedua mendefinisikan bajang sebagai hantu berkuku panjang yang kononnya suka mengganggu wanita hamil atau kanak-kanak.
statement.en: The Kamus Pelajar, second edition, defines bajang as a long-nailed ghost said to like disturbing pregnant women or children.

claims.quote: the mutterings of the bajang (a familiar spirit) as he sat on the roof-tree

statement.id: Penulis menyebut gumaman bajang, roh peliharaan, yang duduk di bubungan atap.
statement.en: The author mentions the mutterings of the bajang, a familiar spirit, as it sat on the roof-tree.

claims.quote: Some one in the village falls ill of a complaint the symptoms of which are unusual; there may be convulsions, unconsciousness, or delirium, possibly for some days together or with intervals between the attacks.

statement.id: Dalam catatan yang dikutip Skeat, korban dikatakan jatuh sakit dengan gejala tak lazim: kejang, pingsan, atau mengigau, kadang berhari-hari atau dengan jeda di antara serangan.
statement.en: In an account quoted by Skeat, the victim falls ill with unusual symptoms: convulsions, unconsciousness or delirium, possibly for days together or with intervals between attacks.

claims.quote: The relatives will call in a native doctor, and at her (she is usually an ancient female) suggestion, or without it, an impression will arise that the patient is the victim of a bâjang. Such an impression quickly develops into certainty, and any trifle will suggest the owner of the evil spirit.

statement.id: Dalam catatan itu, keluarga memanggil dukun setempat, lalu timbul kesan bahwa pasien menjadi korban bajang; kesan itu cepat menjadi keyakinan dan hal sepele pun dapat dianggap menunjuk pemilik roh jahat itu.
statement.en: In that account, relatives call a native doctor and an impression arises that the patient is the victim of a bajang; the impression quickly becomes certainty and any trifle may point to the owner of the evil spirit.

claims.quote: he will place the sorcerer in one room, and, while he in another scrapes an iron vessel with a razor, the culprit’s hair will fall off as though the razor had been applied to his head instead of to the vessel

statement.id: Menurut catatan itu, seorang pawang menaruh tersangka di satu ruangan dan mengikis bejana besi dengan pisau cukur di ruangan lain; rambut pelaku dikatakan rontok seolah-olah pisau dipakai pada kepalanya.
statement.en: According to that account, a pawang places the suspected sorcerer in one room and scrapes an iron vessel with a razor in another; the culprit's hair is said to fall off as if the razor had been used on his head.

claims.quote: Before the advent of British influence it was the practice to kill the wizard or witch whose guilt had been established to Malay satisfaction, and such executions were carried out not many years ago.

statement.id: Menurut catatan itu, sebelum pengaruh Inggris datang, penyihir yang kesalahannya terbukti menurut kepuasan orang Melayu biasanya dibunuh, dan hukuman mati itu masih dilakukan belum lama berselang.
statement.en: According to that account, before British influence arrived the practice was to kill the wizard or witch whose guilt was established to Malay satisfaction, and such executions were carried out not many years earlier.

claims.quote: I remember a case in Perak less than ten years ago, when the people of an up-river village accused a man of keeping a bâjang ... Before anything could be done they put him, his family, and effects on a raft and started them down the river.

statement.id: Catatan itu menceritakan kasus di Perak kurang dari sepuluh tahun sebelumnya: penduduk sebuah kampung hulu sungai menuduh seorang lelaki memelihara bajang, lalu menaikkannya bersama keluarga dan hartanya ke rakit dan menghanyutkannya ke hilir sungai.
statement.en: The account tells of a case in Perak less than ten years earlier: the people of an up-river village accused a man of keeping a bajang and put him, his family and his effects on a raft and sent them down the river.

claims.quote: The hereditary bâjang comes like other evils, the unsought heritage of a dissolute ancestry, but the acquired bâjang is usually obtained from the newly-buried body of a stillborn child, which is supposed to be the abiding-place of a familiar spirit until lured therefrom by the solicitations of some one who, at dead of night, stands over the grave

statement.id: Menurut catatan itu, bajang warisan datang sebagai pusaka tak dikehendaki dari leluhur yang bejat, sedangkan bajang yang diperoleh biasanya diambil dari jasad bayi lahir mati yang baru dikubur, yang dianggap tempat tinggal roh peliharaan sampai dibujuk keluar oleh orang yang berdiri di atas kubur pada tengah malam.
statement.en: According to that account, the hereditary bajang is the unsought heritage of a dissolute ancestry, while the acquired bajang is usually obtained from the newly buried body of a stillborn child, thought to house a familiar spirit until lured out by someone standing over the grave at dead of night.

claims.quote: I have also been assured that the bâjang, in the shape of a lizard, has been seen to issue from the drowning person’s nose.

statement.id: Penulis catatan itu mengaku diyakinkan bahwa bajang, berbentuk kadal, pernah terlihat keluar dari hidung orang yang ditenggelamkan.
statement.en: The account's author says he was assured that the bajang, in the shape of a lizard, has been seen to issue from the nose of the person being drowned.

claims.quote: In Perak and some other parts of the Peninsula, however, the Bajang is regarded as one of the several kinds of demons which, the Malays hold, can be enslaved by man and become his familiar spirit. Such familiars, it is believed, are handed down in certain families as heirlooms.

statement.id: Di Perak dan beberapa tempat lain di Semenanjung, bajang dipandang sebagai salah satu iblis yang menurut orang Melayu dapat diperbudak manusia dan menjadi roh peliharaannya; roh semacam itu dipercaya diwariskan dalam keluarga tertentu sebagai pusaka.
statement.en: In Perak and some other parts of the Peninsula the bajang is regarded as one of the demons that, the Malays hold, can be enslaved by man and become his familiar spirit; such familiars are believed to be handed down in certain families as heirlooms.

claims.quote: The familiar is fed with eggs and milk. When its master wishes to make use of it he sends it forth to possess and prey upon the vitals of any one whom his malice may select as a victim.

statement.id: Roh peliharaan itu diberi makan telur dan susu; bila tuannya hendak memakainya, ia dikirim untuk merasuki dan memangsa isi tubuh korban yang dipilih tuannya karena dendam.
statement.en: The familiar is fed eggs and milk; when its master wishes to use it he sends it forth to possess and prey upon the vitals of a victim chosen out of malice.

claims.quote: The individual thus persecuted is at once seized by a deadly and unaccountable ailment, which can only be cured by magic agencies. If the Bajang is neglected by its owner, and if the latter omits to feed it regularly, it is said that he often falls a victim to his own familiar.

statement.id: Korban langsung diserang penyakit mematikan yang tak terjelaskan dan hanya dapat disembuhkan dengan kekuatan gaib; bila bajang diabaikan dan tidak diberi makan teratur, pemiliknya konon sering menjadi korban roh peliharaannya sendiri.
statement.en: The victim is at once seized by a deadly, unaccountable ailment that can only be cured by magic; if the bajang is neglected and not fed regularly, its owner is said often to fall victim to his own familiar.

claims.quote: which appears to represent the outline of a Bajang, “scripturally” modified to serve as a counter-charm against the Bajang itself.

statement.id: Skeat memuat gambar yang tampaknya menggambarkan garis besar bajang, diubah secara "skriptural" untuk menjadi penangkal terhadap bajang itu sendiri.
statement.en: Skeat reproduces a drawing that appears to show the outline of a bajang, "scripturally" modified to serve as a counter-charm against the bajang itself.

claims.quote: The outlines of the figure are made up from varying combinations of the names “Allah,” “Muhammad,” “ʿAli,” etc., in the Arabic character.

statement.id: Garis gambar penangkal itu tersusun dari berbagai gabungan nama "Allah", "Muhammad", "Ali", dan lain-lain dalam aksara Arab.
statement.en: The outlines of that counter-charm figure are made up of varying combinations of the names "Allah", "Muhammad", "Ali" and others in Arabic script.

claims.quote: Langsuior, the female familiar, differs hardly at all from the bâjang, except that she is a little more baneful, and when under the control of a man he sometimes becomes the victim of her attractions, and she will even bear him elfin children.

statement.id: Menurut kutipan dalam catatan kaki Skeat, langsuior, roh peliharaan perempuan, nyaris tak berbeda dari bajang kecuali sedikit lebih jahat.
statement.en: According to a quotation in Skeat's footnote, the langsuior, the female familiar, differs hardly at all from the bajang except in being a little more baneful.

claims.quote: MALAY MAGIC BEING AN INTRODUCTION TO THE FOLKLORE AND POPULAR RELIGION OF THE MALAY PENINSULA BY WALTER WILLIAM SKEAT OF THE CIVIL SERVICE OF THE FEDERATED MALAY STATES

statement.id: Sumbernya adalah Malay Magic, pengantar folklor dan agama rakyat Semenanjung Melayu karya Walter William Skeat dari dinas sipil Federated Malay States.
statement.en: The source is Malay Magic, an introduction to the folklore and popular religion of the Malay Peninsula by Walter William Skeat of the civil service of the Federated Malay States.

claims.quote: A kind of familiar spirit acquired by a male who says the proper incantations over the newly buried body of a stillborn child. It takes the form of a civet or musang and may cause convulsions, unconsciousness or delirium.

statement.id: Menurut Wikipedia bahasa Inggris, bajang adalah roh peliharaan yang diperoleh seorang lelaki dengan mantra yang tepat di atas jasad bayi lahir mati yang baru dikubur; ia berwujud luwak atau musang dan dapat menyebabkan kejang, pingsan, atau mengigau.
statement.en: According to Wikipedia, the bajang is a familiar spirit acquired by a man reciting the proper incantations over the newly buried body of a stillborn child; it takes the form of a civet or musang and may cause convulsions, unconsciousness or delirium.

claims.quote: As with other spirits of this type, a bajang may turn on its master if it is neglected. Although a bajang can be made to attack any whom its master chooses, it is considered particularly dangerous to infants and young children.

statement.id: Seperti roh sejenisnya, bajang dapat berbalik menyerang tuannya bila diabaikan; ia dapat disuruh menyerang siapa pun yang dipilih tuannya, tetapi dianggap sangat berbahaya bagi bayi dan anak kecil.
statement.en: Like other spirits of its type, a bajang may turn on its master if neglected; it can be made to attack anyone its master chooses but is considered particularly dangerous to infants and young children.

claims.quote: In former times, some children would be given "bajang bracelets" (gelang bajang) made of black silk to protect them against it, and sharp metal objects such as scissors would be placed near babies for the same purpose.

statement.id: Pada masa lalu, sebagian anak diberi "gelang bajang" dari sutra hitam sebagai pelindung, dan benda logam tajam seperti gunting diletakkan di dekat bayi untuk tujuan yang sama.
statement.en: In former times some children were given black-silk "bajang bracelets" (gelang bajang) for protection, and sharp metal objects such as scissors were placed near babies for the same purpose.

claims.quote: Even the striations of pregnancy are somewhat jokingly said to be the scars left by a bajang's attack.

statement.id: Garis-garis regangan akibat kehamilan bahkan setengah bercanda disebut bekas luka serangan bajang.
statement.en: Even the striations of pregnancy are somewhat jokingly said to be the scars left by a bajang's attack.

claims.quote: The pelesit is in many ways comparable to the bajang, but whereas the bajang's owner is always male, the pelesit may only be kept by a female.

statement.id: Pelesit dalam banyak hal sebanding dengan bajang, tetapi pemilik bajang selalu laki-laki, sedangkan pelesit hanya boleh dipelihara perempuan.
statement.en: The pelesit is in many ways comparable to the bajang, but a bajang's owner is always male whereas a pelesit may only be kept by a female.

short_description.id: Naga hitam adalah sosok naga dalam tradisi Eropa dan Asia Timur.
short_description.en: The black dragon is a dragon figure in European and East Asian traditions.

long_description.id:
Naga hitam adalah sosok naga dalam tradisi Eropa dan Asia Timur. Dalam pemikiran lima unsur ia dikaitkan dengan air dan utara.

Ia ditafsirkan sebagai penjaga suci utara. Gambarnya sering memberi naga timur sisik hitam dan dua kaki depan.

Dalam teks klasik Huainanzi, Nüwa membunuh naga hitam untuk menyelamatkan Jizhou. Sebagian daerah menghormati naga hitam sebagai makhluk suci, dan Takaokami no Ōkami kadang disebut Kokuryū Daimyōjin. Di Hōgon-ji di Pulau Chikubu, naga hitam dipuja sebagai salah satu dari Delapan Raja Naga.
long_description.en:
The black dragon is a dragon figure in European and East Asian traditions. In five-phase thought it is associated with water and the north.

It is interpreted as a sacred guardian of the north. Its depictions often give an eastern dragon black scales and two forelegs.

In the classical text Huainanzi, Nüwa slays a black dragon to save Jizhou. Some regions worship the black dragon as a sacred being, and Takaokami no Ōkami is sometimes identified as Kokuryū Daimyōjin. At Hōgon-ji on Chikubu Island, the black dragon is enshrined as one of the Eight Dragon Kings.

role.en: The black dragon killed by Nüwa

summary.id: Dalam Huainanzi, Nüwa membunuh naga hitam untuk menyelamatkan Jizhou dan menimbun abu alang-alang untuk menghentikan banjir.
summary.en: In the Huainanzi, Nüwa slays a black dragon to save Jizhou and piles up reed ashes to stop the flood waters.

description.id: Di Kokuryū-dō di halaman kuil ini, naga hitam dipuja sebagai salah satu dari Delapan Raja Naga.
description.en: In the Kokuryū-dō (Black Dragon Hall) in the temple grounds, the black dragon is enshrined as one of the Eight Dragon Kings.

short_description.id: Cabraboc adalah makhluk setengah manusia setengah kambing dalam imajinasi rakyat Katalan yang mengejar pejalan malam di hutan.
short_description.en: The cabraboc is a half-human, half-goat being of Catalan folk imagination that chases night travellers in the forest.

long_description.id:
Cabraboc adalah makhluk setengah manusia di bagian atas dan setengah kambing di bagian bawah. Mereka makhluk hutan yang mengejar pejalan malam, sering sampai korban terjatuh dari tebing, dan kadang digambarkan bersayap kelelawar.

Dalam legenda Ripollet, seekor kucing keluar dari keranjang sepasang orang tua lalu berubah menjadi iblis Cabraboc. Legenda ini dipentaskan pada karnaval Ripollet, dan kelompok Diables de Caldes de Montbui menamai cabraboc helm berkepala kambing iblis utama mereka.

Sebuah buku legenda yang disusun di Ripollet mencatat versi yang sama. Cabraboc digambarkan setengah manusia di bagian atas dan setengah kambing di bagian bawah. pada hari Karnaval seorang kakek dan nenek berjalan-jalan dan sang nenek membawa keranjang berisi panci. Seorang iblis kecil memukul panci itu dan keluarlah seekor kucing yang secara ajaib berubah menjadi cabraboc. Karena begitu banyak dibicarakan, sejak itu kelompok comparsa menampilkannya setiap tahun saat Karnaval.
long_description.en:
The cabraboc is a being that is human above and goat below. They are forest creatures that chase night travellers, often until the victim falls off a cliff, and are sometimes described with bat wings.

In a Ripollet legend a cat came out of an old couple's basket and turned into the devil Cabraboc. The legend is staged at the Ripollet carnival, and the Diables de Caldes de Montbui call their main devil's goat-headed helmet a cabraboc.

A legend booklet compiled in Ripollet records the same version. The cabraboc is described as half person above and half goat below. on Carnival day an old man and an old woman went for a walk and the woman carried a basket with a pot. A little devil struck the pot and a cat came out that by magic turned into a cabraboc. Because it was talked about so much, the comparsa groups have portrayed it every year at Carnival ever since.

claim.id: Cabraboc adalah makhluk khayalan imajinasi rakyat Katalan, setengah manusia di bagian atas dan setengah kambing di bagian bawah.
claim.en: A cabraboc is a fantastic being of Catalan folk imagination, half human above and half goat below.

claims_provenance.quote: Un cabraboc és un ésser fantàstic propi de l'imaginari popular català, mig humà per la part de dalt i mig cabra o boc per la part de baix.

claim.id: Para cabraboc konon mengejar lelaki seperti kambing betina dan perempuan seperti kambing jantan; mereka makhluk hutan yang harus dihindari saat bepergian malam.
claim.en: Cabrabocs are said to chase men as if they were nanny goats and women as if they were billy goats; they are forest beings to be avoided when travelling at night.

claims_provenance.quote: Es diu que els cabrabocs persegueixen els homes com si fossin cabres i les dones com si fossin bocs. Són éssers del bosc i cal evitar-los quan es viatja de nit

claim.id: Pengejaran itu sering berakhir dengan korban terjatuh dari tebing, dan kadang mereka digambarkan bersayap kelelawar.
claim.en: The chases often end with the victim falling off a cliff, and they were sometimes described with bat wings.

claims_provenance.quote: sovint, les persecucions acaben fent estimbar la víctima per un penya-segat. Algunes vegades, se'ls descrivia amb ales de ratapinyada.

claim.id: Dalam legenda Ripollet El vell i la vella, seekor kucing keluar dari keranjang sepasang orang tua dan berubah menjadi iblis, si Cabraboc.
claim.en: In the Ripollet legend El vell i la vella, a cat came out of an old couple's basket and turned into one more devil, the Cabraboc.

claims_provenance.quote: Aleshores, del cistell en sortí un gat que es convertí en un diable més, el Cabraboc.

claim.id: Kelompok Diables de Caldes de Montbui menamai cabraboc helm yang dipakai iblis utama mereka, Llucifer.
claim.en: The Diables de Caldes de Montbui give the name cabraboc to the helmet worn by their main devil, Llucifer.

claims_provenance.quote: Els Diables de Caldes de Montbui donen el nom de cabraboc al casc que porta el diable principal, que anomenen Llucifer.

claim.id: Les Bruixes de Ripollet mementaskan legenda ini pada karnaval anak, dan Diables de Ripollet membawanya di depan pawai karnaval hari Sabtu.
claim.en: Les Bruixes de Ripollet stage the legend at the children's carnival, and the Diables de Ripollet carry it at the head of Saturday's carnival parade.

claims_provenance.quote: Les Bruixes de Ripollet n'escenifiquen la llegenda durant el carnaval infantil, i els Diables de Ripollet el treuen al capdavant de la rua de Carnaval de dissabte.

claim.id: Cabraboc adalah makhluk setengah manusia di bagian atas dan setengah kambing betina dan kambing jantan di bagian bawah.
claim.en: The Cabraboc is a being half person on the upper part and half goat and billy goat on the lower part.

claims_provenance.quote: El Cabraboc és un ésser mig persona per la part de dalt i mig cabra i boc per la part de sota.
claims_provenance.source_citation: Consorci per a la Normalització Lingüística — Viatge a través de llegendes i cançons (Oficina de Català de Ripollet, 2012): «El vell, la vella i el Cabraboc»

claim.id: Legenda mengatakan bahwa di Ripollet pada hari Karnaval seorang kakek dan nenek keluar berjalan-jalan; sang nenek membawa keranjang berisi panci, dan segalanya menunjukkan bahwa itu bekal makan siang.
claim.en: The legend says that in Ripollet on Carnival day an old man and an old woman went out for a walk; the old woman carried a basket with a pot inside, and everything suggested it held their lunch.

claims_provenance.quote: Explica la llegenda que a Ripollet la diada de Carnestoltes van sortir a passejar un vell i una vella. La vella portava un cistell amb una olla dins, tot feia pensar que hi portava el dinar.
claims_provenance.source_citation: Consorci per a la Normalització Lingüística — Viatge a través de llegendes i cançons (Oficina de Català de Ripollet, 2012): «El vell, la vella i el Cabraboc»

claim.id: Salah satu iblis kecil melihat si nenek dan keranjangnya lalu memukul panci dengan tongkat; alih-alih sup, keluar seekor kucing yang secara ajaib seketika berubah menjadi cabraboc.
claim.en: One of the little devils saw the old woman and her basket and struck the pot with a stick; instead of stew a cat came out of it, which by magic in no time turned into a cabraboc.

claims_provenance.quote: Un dels diablots va veure la vella i el cistell i va pensar: “Ara és la meva”, i amb un bastó que portava va donar un cop a l’olla. Tothom es va quedar parat, perquè de l’olla, en lloc d’escudella, en va sortir un gat, que per art de màgia i en un tres i no res es va convertir en cabraboc.
claims_provenance.source_citation: Consorci per a la Normalització Lingüística — Viatge a través de llegendes i cançons (Oficina de Català de Ripollet, 2012): «El vell, la vella i el Cabraboc»

claim.id: Peristiwa itu begitu banyak dibicarakan sehingga sejak itu setiap tahun saat Karnaval kelompok-kelompok comparsa menampilkannya.
claim.en: The event was talked about so much that from then on, every year at Carnival, the comparsa groups portray it.

claims_provenance.quote: Se’n va parlar tant, del fet, que des de llavors cada any per Carnaval les colles de comparses el representen.
claims_provenance.source_citation: Consorci per a la Normalització Lingüística — Viatge a través de llegendes i cançons (Oficina de Català de Ripollet, 2012): «El vell, la vella i el Cabraboc»

statement.id: Salah satu iblis kecil melihat si nenek dan keranjangnya lalu memukul panci dengan tongkat; alih-alih sup, keluar seekor kucing yang secara ajaib seketika berubah menjadi cabraboc.
statement.en: One of the little devils saw the old woman and her basket and struck the pot with a stick; instead of stew a cat came out of it, which by magic in no time turned into a cabraboc.

claims.quote: Se’n va parlar tant, del fet, que des de llavors cada any per Carnaval les colles de comparses el representen.

statement.id: Peristiwa itu begitu banyak dibicarakan sehingga sejak itu setiap tahun saat Karnaval kelompok-kelompok comparsa menampilkannya.
statement.en: The event was talked about so much that from then on, every year at Carnival, the comparsa groups portray it.

short_description.id: Camahueto adalah banteng legendaris bertanduk tunggal dalam mitologi Chilote yang tumbuh di sungai lalu pindah ke laut [camahueto-c01, camahueto-c02, camahueto-c03].
short_description.en: The Camahueto is a one-horned legendary bull of Chilote mythology that grows in rivers and moves to the sea [camahueto-c01, camahueto-c02, camahueto-c03].

long_description.id:
Camahueto adalah banteng legendaris mitologi Chilote [camahueto-c01] yang bertanduk tunggal seperti unicorn [camahueto-c02]. Ia tumbuh di sungai dan pindah ke laut setelah dewasa [camahueto-c03]. Berbagai versi menyebutnya memangsa manusia, mengendalikan waktu, dan menciptakan hujan atau petir [camahueto-c04], serta menyeret orang ke dasar laut [camahueto-c05]. Hanya machi yang dapat menggiringnya kembali ke laut dengan laso rumput laut [camahueto-c06].

Menurut Chiloé Mitológico, Camahueto lahir dari kedalaman bumi di puncak bukit dekat laut [camahueto-c08]. Wujudnya seperti anak sapi hijau dengan satu tanduk kecil di dahi, mirip unicorn Yunani [camahueto-c07]. Seorang machi menangkapnya dengan laso dari "boqui", mencabut tanduknya ("cacho"), lalu melepasnya menuju laut [camahueto-c09]. Potongan kecil tanduk itu ditanam para machi di bukit lain, dan setelah dua puluh lima tahun lahirlah camahueto lain [camahueto-c10]. Kerokan tanduknya disebut sebagai obat paling manjur dalam farmakope Chiloé kuno [camahueto-c11].

Sumber yang sama menyatakan bahwa kehidupan akuatik Camahueto hampir tidak diketahui; konon ia kembali ke laut karena laut adalah miliknya [camahueto-c14]. Keberadaannya di darat disebut sebagai pembalasan yang ditinggalkan roh air Coicoi-vilu untuk melanjutkan karya perusaknya [camahueto-c15]. Penulisnya menafsirkan hewan imajiner ini sebagai penjelasan atas longsor tanah yang tampak spontan [camahueto-c12], dan sebagai lambang kekuatan, kesuburan, dan kelimpahan [camahueto-c13].
long_description.en:
The Camahueto is a legendary bull of Chilote mythology [camahueto-c01] with a single unicorn-like horn [camahueto-c02]. It grows in rivers and moves to the ocean when grown [camahueto-c03]. Versions say it eats humans, controls time and makes rain or thunder [camahueto-c04], and drags people into the sea [camahueto-c05]. Only a machi can lead it back to sea with a kelp lasso [camahueto-c06].

According to Chiloé Mitológico, the Camahueto is born from the depths of the earth on a hill near the sea [camahueto-c08]. It looks like a green calf with a single small horn on its forehead, like the Greek unicorn [camahueto-c07]. A machi catches it with a lasso of "boqui", tears off its horn ("cacho") and lets it go on to the sea [camahueto-c09]. The machis plant small pieces of the horn on other hills, and after twenty-five years other camahuetos are born [camahueto-c10]. Scrapings of the horn are described as the most effective medicine of the early Chilote pharmacopoeia [camahueto-c11].

The same source says little is known of its aquatic life; it is said to return to the sea because the sea is where it belongs [camahueto-c14]. Its stay on land is described as revenge left behind by the water spirit Coicoi-vilu to continue his destructive work [camahueto-c15]. Its author interprets the imaginary animal as an explanation for apparently spontaneous landslides [camahueto-c12] and as a symbol of strength, fertility and abundance [camahueto-c13].

claims.quote: se recurrió a este animal imaginario, para explicar los frecuentes y aparentemente espontáneos derrumbes de tierra, que ocasionan las aguas que se van acumulando bajo tierra

statement.id: Menurut penafsiran penulis situs ini, hewan imajiner ini dipakai untuk menjelaskan longsor tanah yang sering terjadi dan tampak spontan, akibat air yang menumpuk di bawah tanah.
statement.en: In the site author's interpretation, this imaginary animal was used to explain the frequent, apparently spontaneous landslides caused by water accumulating underground.

claims.quote: Además representa la fuerza, la fecundidad y la abundancia.

statement.id: Penulis situs ini menambahkan bahwa Camahueto melambangkan kekuatan, kesuburan, dan kelimpahan.
statement.en: The site author adds that the Camahueto represents strength, fertility and abundance.

claims.quote: De la vida acuática el camahueto, se sabe muy poco y por tal motivo lo incluimos entre los mitos terrestres; se dice que regresa al mar, porque a él pertenece y allí realizará su verdadera existencia.

statement.id: Kehidupan akuatik Camahueto hampir tidak diketahui sehingga ia digolongkan sebagai mitos darat; konon ia kembali ke laut karena laut adalah miliknya dan di sanalah ia menjalani keberadaan sejatinya.
statement.en: Little is known of the Camahueto's aquatic life, so it is classed among the land myths; it is said to return to the sea because it belongs there and will live its true existence there.

claims.quote: Y que su estadía en la tierra, sólo representa una forma de venganza, que dejó en su retirada, el espíritu de las aguas, Coicoi-vilu, para continuar su obra destructora en la tierra.

statement.id: Menurut sumber ini, keberadaannya di darat hanyalah bentuk pembalasan yang ditinggalkan roh air Coicoi-vilu saat mundur, untuk melanjutkan karya perusaknya di darat.
statement.en: According to this source, its stay on land is only a form of revenge left behind by the water spirit Coicoi-vilu on his retreat, to continue his destructive work on land.

short_description.id: Crinisus (Crimisus) adalah dewa sungai Crinisus di Sisilia yang, menurut kebanyakan versi, dalam wujud anjing menjadi ayah Acestes dari seorang perempuan Troya.
short_description.en: Crinisus (Crimisus) is the god of the Sicilian river Crinisus who, in most versions, fathered Acestes with a Trojan woman in the form of a dog.

long_description.id:
Crinisus, atau Crimisus, adalah dewa sungai Crinisus di Sisilia dalam mitologi Yunani dan Romawi. Sungainya terletak di barat laut Sikelia dan bermuara ke Laut Tengah dekat koloni Yunani Egesta.

Menurut kebanyakan versi mitos, ia dalam wujud anjing menjadi ayah Acestes dari seorang perempuan Troya, putri seorang pemukim Troya. Dalam Alexandra karya Lycophron, ia mengambil putri itu sebagai pengantin dan melahirkan anak mulia; Aeneid karya Virgil menyebut Acestes lahir dari ibu Troya oleh dewa sungai Crimisus. Komentar Servius menambahkan bahwa ia berubah menjadi beruang atau anjing dan menurunkan Egestus, pendiri Egesta, yang kemudian dikenal sebagai Segesta.

Menurut Aelian, orang Egesta menghormatinya dalam wujud manusia, bertentangan dengan kisah wujud anjing. Koin Segesta dari 475-390 SM sering bergambar anjing pada satu sisi dan kepala perempuan pada sisi lain, yang secara tradisional dikaitkan dengan Crinisus dan Segesta.
long_description.en:
Crinisus, also called Crimisus, was the god of the river Crinisus in Sicily in Greek and Roman myth. His river lay in north-western Sikelia and flowed into the Mediterranean close to the Greek colony of Egesta.

In most versions of the myth he fathered Acestes with a Trojan woman, the daughter of a Trojan settler, in the form of a dog. In Lycophron's Alexandra he takes the daughter as his bride and begets a noble whelp; Virgil's Aeneid says Acestes was born of a Trojan mother to the river god Crimisus. Servius's commentary adds that he turned into a bear or a dog and fathered Egestus, founder of Egesta, later known as Segesta.

According to Aelian, the Egestans honour him in the form of men, unlike the dog-form story. Coins from Segesta dating 475-390 BCE often carry a dog and a woman's head on opposite faces, traditionally linked with Crinisus and Segesta.

short_description.id: Cuca adalah salah satu makhluk mitologi utama dalam cerita rakyat Brasil: penyihir tua berwajah aligator yang menculik anak-anak.
short_description.en: The Cuca is one of the main mythological beings of Brazilian folklore: an old witch with an alligator appearance who kidnaps children.

long_description.id:
Cuca adalah salah satu makhluk mitologi utama dalam cerita rakyat Brasil. Ia digambarkan sebagai penyihir yang menculik anak-anak dan dapat berwujud perempuan tua atau penyihir berkepala aligator. Dalam versi lain ia adalah entitas berwujud penyihir tua berpenampilan aligator yang usianya tidak diketahui pasti tetapi bisa lebih dari 3 ribu tahun. Menurut legenda, ia tidur sekali setiap tujuh tahun.

Menurut sebagian tradisi, Cuca baru muncul dari sebuah telur setiap 1.000 tahun; Cuca sebelumnya berubah menjadi burung berkicau sedih, sedangkan yang baru menjalankan perannya dan menimbulkan lebih banyak kerugian. Ada pula versi yang mengenal lebih dari satu cuca, seolah subkelas bicho-papão.

Asal-usulnya diperdebatkan. Legenda ini diturunkan dari Coca (atau Coco) dalam cerita rakyat Iberia yang diduga masuk ke Brasil pada masa kolonisasi. Menurut Câmara Cascudo, Cuca adalah mitos asal Portugis yang terkait dengan Coca, tokoh dalam prosesi di provinsi Minho, tempat "cuca" juga nama sejenis labu yang dilubangi membentuk mata dan mulut. Kemungkinan lain adalah Farricoco, tokoh prosesi Passos di Algarve.

Di Brasil, Cuca dipopulerkan oleh buku "O Saci" (1921) karya Monteiro Lobato, satu-satunya karya Lobato tempat ia muncul. Di sana ia digambarkan sebagai "penyihir mengerikan" berpendengaran sangat tajam, "setua waktu", tinggal di gua di hutan dan hanya tidur satu malam setiap tujuh tahun, berwajah seperti aligator dan bercakar seperti elang. Dalam dua serial adaptasi karya Lobato oleh Rede Globo, lima kostum berbeda dipakai untuknya.
long_description.en:
The Cuca is one of the main mythological beings of Brazilian folklore. She is described as a witch who kidnaps children and can take the form of an old woman or a witch with an alligator head. In another version she is an entity in the form of an old witch with an alligator appearance whose age is not known for sure but may exceed 3,000 years. According to legend, she sleeps once every seven years.

According to some traditions, a new Cuca emerges from an egg every 1,000 years; the previous Cuca turns into a bird with a sad song, while the new one takes up her role, causing more harm. There are also versions in which more than one cuca exists, as a kind of subclass of the bicho-papão.

Its origin is debated. The legend derives from the Coca (or Coco) of Iberian folklore, probably introduced into Brazil at the time of colonisation. According to Câmara Cascudo, the Cuca is a myth of Portuguese origin related to the Coca, a figure in processions in the province of Minho, where "cuca" is also the name of a kind of pumpkin pierced with the outlines of eyes and mouth. Another possibility is the Farricoco, a figure of the Passos procession in the Algarve.

In Brazil the Cuca was popularised by Monteiro Lobato's book "O Saci" (1921), the only work by Lobato in which she appears. There she is described as a "horrible witch" with very fine hearing, "as old as time", living in a cave in the forest and sleeping only one night every seven years, with a face like an alligator and claws like hawks. In the two series adapted from Lobato's work by Rede Globo, five different costumes were used for her.

statement.id: Dalam buku "O Saci" (1921) karya Monteiro Lobato, Cuca digambarkan sebagai "penyihir mengerikan" berpendengaran sangat tajam, "setua waktu", tinggal di gua di hutan dan hanya tidur satu malam setiap tujuh tahun; itu satu-satunya karya Lobato tempat ia muncul.
statement.en: In Monteiro Lobato's book "O Saci" (1921), the Cuca is described as a "horrible witch" with very fine hearing, "as old as time", living in a cave in the forest and sleeping only one night every seven years; it is the only work by the writer in which she appears.

claims.quote: Selon le livre, la Cuca a « un visage comme un alligator et des griffes sur ses doigts comme les faucons ».

statement.id: Menurut buku itu, Cuca memiliki "wajah seperti aligator dan cakar di jari-jarinya seperti elang".
statement.en: According to the book, the Cuca has "a face like an alligator and claws on her fingers like hawks".

claims.quote: Dans les deux séries adaptatées de l'œuvre de Monteiro Lobato produites par Rede Globo, cinq costumes différents ont été utilisés pour la Cuca.

statement.id: Dalam dua serial adaptasi karya Monteiro Lobato yang diproduksi Rede Globo, lima kostum berbeda dipakai untuk Cuca.
statement.en: In the two series adapted from Monteiro Lobato's work produced by Rede Globo, five different costumes were used for the Cuca.

claims.quote: Reza a lenda que a bruxa Cuca dorme uma vez a cada sete anos.

statement.id: Menurut legenda ("Reza a lenda"), bruxa (penyihir) Cuca dorme (tidur) uma vez a cada sete anos (sekali setiap tujuh tahun).
statement.en: Legend has it ("Reza a lenda") that the bruxa (witch) Cuca dorme (sleeps) uma vez a cada sete anos (once every seven years).
